;;; $8008: Is sprite touching a block on its side (IsTouchingObjSide) ;;;
{
;; Returns: A = [sprite object status] & 3, non-zero if blocked on its left or right. Z flag set accordingly.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:89B9: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:8A2C: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE)
;;     $01:93DF: Sprite vertical check and map16 lookup
;;     $01:95A1: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
;;     $01:95DB: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
;;     $01:98D8: Disco shell: kicked behaviour
;;     $01:9984: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
;;     $01:9A96: Erase sprite and status 5 handler (SpinJumpEraseSpr)
;;     $01:B04C: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:C485: Power-up behaviour, contact and spark effect (DrawBerryGfx)
;;     $01:D69C: Parachute sprites: draw and physics
;;     $01:DB8D: Sprite B4: Grinder (not line-guided) (Grinder)
;;     ... and 3 more
$01:8008 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:800B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / A = [sprite object status] & 3: non-zero if blocked on its left or right side
$01:800D 60           RTS                             ; Return
; status bar
}

;;; $800E: Is sprite on the ground (IsOnGround) ;;;
{
;; Returns: A = [sprite object status] & 4, non-zero if standing on a block.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8164: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C) (HandleGoalPowerup)
;;     $01:88D7: Check shell proximity and jump (HandleJumpOver)
;;     $01:8927: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:89C0: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:89FD: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE)
;;     $01:8A38: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE)
;;     $01:8B0A: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement (Spr0to13Main)
;;     $01:8B4C: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement (Spr0to13Main)
;;     $01:8C2B: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8C9B: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8D69: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8F21: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     ... and 26 more
$01:800E BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:8011 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; / A = [sprite object status] & 4: non-zero if standing on the ground
$01:8013 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8014: Is sprite touching a ceiling (IsTouchingCeiling) ;;;
{

;;; $801A: Update sprite Y position, no gravity (UpdateYPosNoGrvty) ;;;
{
;; Long-call wrapper (sets the data bank to $01) for SubSprYPosNoGrvty: Y position += Y speed.
;; Parameters: X: sprite slot.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:FBF3: Level-end coin sprite and helpers (LvlEndSprCoinsRt)
;;     $03:8186: Big Boo boss: remaining states and helpers
;;     $03:8472: Grey falling platform main routine (GreyFallingPlat)
;;     $03:8522: Blurp main routine (Blurp)
;;     $03:8582: Porcu-Puffer main routine (PorcuPuffer)
;;     $03:8636: Flying grey turnblocks main routine (FlyingTurnBlocks)
;;     $03:871B: Gray lava platform main (GrayLavaPlatform)
;;     $03:88CF: Swooper bat main (Swooper)
;;     $03:8C5C: Carrot top lift main routine (CarrotTopLift)
;;     $03:8FC2: Boo stream main routine (BooStream)
;;     $03:90E3: Fishin' Boo main routine (FishinBoo)
;;     $03:92CE: Creating/eating block main routine (CreateEatBlock)
;;     ... and 13 more
$01:801A 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:801B 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($01)
$01:801C AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:801D 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Y position += Y speed (SubSprYPosNoGrvty, no gravity or block checks)
$01:8020 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:8021 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;; Parameters: X: sprite slot.
;; Called by:
;;     $02:BCDB: Wall-follower sprites main and Spike Top graphics (WallFollowersMain)
;;     $02:C261: Chuck: physics and state dispatch
;;     $02:D95D: Bubble sprite: logic and contents release (BubbleSprGfxProp4)
;;     $02:F03F: Wiggler main routine (WigglerMainRt)
;;     $03:8793: Mega Mole main (MegaMole)
;;     $03:9581: Rex: wall turn and Mario contact (RexHalfSmushed)
$01:8032 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:8033 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($01)
$01:8034 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:8035 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Sprite-to-sprite contact check (SubSprSprInteract)
$01:8038 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:8039 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

}

;;; 09:56 -!- Topic for #serioushax: The new #serioushax, your primary channel for
;;;           65c816 and SMW hacking questions, as well as random discussions |
;;;           .............................. is a good place to post your ASM. |
;;;           Check InvertAccum: in all.log ($01804A) if you need something to
;;;           laugh at.
;;; 09:56 -!- Topic set by Alcaro [] [Tue Aug 25 13:20:30 2009]
;;;
;;; This short subroutine negates the accumulator.
;;;
;;; A "JSR.W InvertAccum" [20 4A 80] is three bytes.
;;; The code to negate A [49 FF 1A] is three bytes.
;;; So there is no reason to type "JSR.W InvertAccum" instead of "EOR.B #$FF\nINC A".
;;; SMW uses this routine only twice, from $0197DA an $0197E1.
;;;
}

;;; $804A: Negate A, skid smoke, run all sprites (InvertAccum) ;;;
{
;; Contains several routines that follow each other.
;; $01804A: A = -A.
;; $01804E: spawns a smoke puff under a sprite on the ground (every 4th frame, non-slippery levels, on screen)
;;     into a free slot of the four smoke slots at $17C0-$17CF.
;; $01808C (long call): main sprite loop. Resets per-frame Mario carry/platform/Yoshi flags, then for slots
;;     11..0 sets the OAM index, decrements timers and calls HandleSprite. Clears Mario's Yoshi flags if no Yoshi
;;     sprite ran.
;; $0180D2: sets the OAM index of slot X and decrements its seven timers.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:97DA: Bounce sprite off the ground
;;     $01:97E1: Bounce sprite off the ground
$01:804A 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:804C 1A           INC A                           ; / A = -A (two's complement)
$01:804D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:804E BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = sprite's object status (blocked flags)
$01:8051 F0 1F        BEQ $8072                       ; Zero (in the air, touching nothing): return
$01:8053 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:8055 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:8057 05 86        ORA $86                         ; } Return unless [frame counter] & 3 = 0 and [$86] (slippery level flag) = 0
$01:8059 D0 17        BNE $8072                       ; /
$01:805B A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:805D 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $04: X offset of the smoke puff
$01:805F A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:8061 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = $0A: Y offset of the smoke puff
$01:8063 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; A = non-zero if the sprite is off screen
$01:8066 D0 0A        BNE $8072                       ; Off screen: return
$01:8068 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: search the four smoke slots
$01:806A B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; A = smoke type in slot Y ($17C0)
$01:806D F0 04        BEQ $8073                       ; Slot is free: use it
$01:806F 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$01:8070 10 F8        BPL $806A                       ; Loop for slots 3..0
$01:8072 60           RTS                             ; Return (no free slot)

$01:8073 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:8075 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Smoke slot Y type = 3 (probably the ground skid puff)
$01:8078 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:807A 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Smoke X position ($17C8,Y) = sprite X + [$00]
$01:807C 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; /
$01:807F B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:8081 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } Smoke Y position ($17C4,Y) = sprite Y + [$01]
$01:8083 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; /
$01:8086 A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$01:8088 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Smoke timer ($17CC,Y) = $13 frames
$01:808B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:808C 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:808D 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($01)
$01:808E AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:808F AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$01:8092 8D 70 14     STA.W $1470                     ; / [$1470] = [$148F]: remember whether Mario carried a sprite last frame
$01:8095 9C 8F 14     STZ.W $148F                     ; [$148F] = 0: Mario carries nothing (a carried sprite sets it again this frame)
$01:8098 9C 71 14     STZ.W $1471                     ; [$1471] = 0: Mario is not on a sprite platform (platforms set it again)
$01:809B 9C C2 18     STZ.W $18C2                     ; [$18C2] = 0: per-frame flag, purpose unclear
$01:809E AD DF 18     LDA.W $18DF                     ; \
$01:80A1 8D E2 18     STA.W $18E2                     ; / [$18E2] = [$18DF]: remember last frame's Yoshi slot (+1)
$01:80A4 9C DF 18     STZ.W $18DF                     ; [$18DF] = 0: no Yoshi yet this frame (the Yoshi sprite sets it again)
$01:80A7 A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; X = $0B: loop over the 12 sprite slots
$01:80A9 8E E9 15     STX.W $15E9                     ; [$15E9] = current sprite slot
$01:80AC 20 D2 80     JSR.W $80D2                     ; Set OAM index and decrement timers for this slot ($80D2)
$01:80AF 20 27 81     JSR.W HandleSprite              ; Run the sprite according to its status (HandleSprite)
$01:80B2 CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$01:80B3 10 F4        BPL $80A9                       ; Loop for slots 11..0
$01:80B5 AD B8 18     LDA.W $18B8                     ; \
$01:80B8 F0 04        BEQ $80BE                       ; / Skip the next call if [$18B8] = 0
$01:80BA 22 08 F8 02  JSL.L $F808                     ; Run extra sprite code in bank $02 ($F808), not analysed
$01:80BE AD DF 18     LDA.W $18DF                     ; A = [$18DF]: did a Yoshi sprite run this frame?
$01:80C1 D0 06        BNE $80C9                       ; Yes: skip
$01:80C3 9C 7A 18     STZ.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:80C6 9C 8B 18     STZ.W $188B                     ; / No Yoshi: Mario is not on Yoshi (clear RAM_OnYoshi and [$188B])
$01:80C9 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:80CA 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $80CB: Is sprite off screen (IsSprOffScreen) ;;;
{
;; Returns: A = [horizontal off screen flag] OR [vertical off screen flag]; non-zero if off screen.
;; $0180D2 (following code, same section): sets the OAM index for slot X from the tables at $07:F000/$07:F0B4
;;     and decrements the sprite timers [$1540], [$154C], [$1558], [$1564], [$1FE2], [$15AC], [$163E] if non-zero,
;;     unless the slot is empty or sprites are locked.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8063: Negate A, skid smoke, run all sprites (InvertAccum)
;;     $01:8F64: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:9853: Bounce sprite off the ground
;;     $01:99E1: Break Throw Block sprite (BreakThrowBlock)
;;     $01:AB72: Spawn contact smoke at sprite
;;     $01:AB99: Spawn contact smoke at Mario (DisplayContactGfx)
;;     $01:AC33: Erase sprite when far off-screen (bank 1) (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
;;     $01:E317: Monty Mole states and routines (Ptrs01E2D8)
;;     $01:E703: Draw smushed sprite (SmushedGfxRt)
;;     $01:F060: Yoshi: draw, wings, mouth and tongue state (HandleOffYoshi)
;;     $01:F769: Yoshi egg main routine (YoshiEgg)
;;     $01:F7C8: Yoshi egg main routine (YoshiEgg)
$01:80CB BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$01:80CE 1D 6C 18     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; / A = [horizontal off screen flag] OR [vertical off screen flag]: non-zero = off screen
$01:80D1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:80D2 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite slot
$01:80D3 8A           TXA                             ; A = sprite slot
$01:80D4 AE 92 16     LDX.W $1692                     ; X = [$1692]: sprite memory setting (selects an OAM allotment row)
$01:80D7 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:80D8 7F B4 F0 07  ADC.L $F0B4,X                   ; / A = slot + $F0B4[X]
$01:80DC AA           TAX                             ; X = index into the OAM index table
$01:80DD BF 00 F0 07  LDA.L $F000,X                   ; A = $F000[X]: first OAM slot for this sprite
$01:80E1 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite slot
$01:80E2 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Store as the sprite's OAM index
$01:80E5 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$01:80E8 F0 3C        BEQ $8126                       ; Status 0 (no sprite): skip the timers
$01:80EA A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = [RAM_SpritesLocked]
$01:80EC D0 38        BNE $8126                       ; Sprites locked: skip the timers
$01:80EE BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:80F1 F0 03        BEQ $80F6                       ; } Decrement [$1540,X] if non-zero
$01:80F3 DE 40 15     DEC.W $1540,X                   ; /
$01:80F6 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:80F9 F0 03        BEQ $80FE                       ; } Decrement [RAM_DisableInter,X] if non-zero
$01:80FB DE 4C 15     DEC.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; /
$01:80FE BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:8101 F0 03        BEQ $8106                       ; } Decrement [$1558,X] if non-zero
$01:8103 DE 58 15     DEC.W $1558,X                   ; /
$01:8106 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$01:8109 F0 03        BEQ $810E                       ; } Decrement [$1564,X] if non-zero
$01:810B DE 64 15     DEC.W $1564,X                   ; /
$01:810E BD E2 1F     LDA.W $1FE2,X                   ; \
$01:8111 F0 03        BEQ $8116                       ; } Decrement [$1FE2,X] if non-zero
$01:8113 DE E2 1F     DEC.W $1FE2,X                   ; /
$01:8116 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:8119 F0 03        BEQ $811E                       ; } Decrement [$15AC,X] if non-zero
$01:811B DE AC 15     DEC.W $15AC,X                   ; /
$01:811E BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:8121 F0 03        BEQ $8126                       ; } Decrement [$163E,X] if non-zero
$01:8123 DE 3E 16     DEC.W $163E,X                   ; /
$01:8126 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8127: Run sprite by status (HandleSprite) ;;;
{
;; Status 0 erases the sprite, status 8 runs its main routine directly, any other status jumps through
;;     SpriteStatusRtPtr.
;; Parameters: X: sprite slot.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:80AF: Negate A, skid smoke, run all sprites (InvertAccum)
$01:8127 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = sprite status
$01:812A F0 25        BEQ EraseSprite                 ; Status 0: erase the sprite
$01:812C C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:812E D0 03        BNE $8133                       ; / Status other than 8: use the pointer table
$01:8130 4C C3 85     JMP.W CallSpriteMain            ; Status 8 (normal): run the sprite's main routine

$01:8133 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the routine for this status (SpriteStatusRtPtr)

}

;;; $8137: Pointer table: sprite status routines (SpriteStatusRtPtr) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by the sprite status in [$14C8,X], 16-bit pointers.
$01:8137 51 81        .dw EraseSprite                 ; 00 - Empty: EraseSprite (normally bypassed above)
$01:8139 72 81        .dw CallSpriteInit              ; 01 - Initialization
$01:813B A2 9A        .dw HandleSprKilled             ; 02 - Killed, falling off screen (star, shell, etc.)
$01:813D E4 9A        .dw HandleSprSmushed            ; 03 - Smushed
$01:813F 52 9A        .dw HandleSprSpinJump           ; 04 - Spin-jumped on
$01:8141 7B 9A        .dw $9A7B                       ; 05 - Handled at $019A7B, purpose unclear
$01:8143 6D 81        .dw HandleSprLvlEnd             ; 06 - End of level: turn into a coin
$01:8145 56 81        .dw $8156                       ; 07 - Unused (just returns)
$01:8147 C2 85        .dw $85C2                       ; 08 - Normal (bypassed above)
$01:8149 3C 95        .dw HandleSprStunned            ; 09 - Stationary (carryable, flipped, stunned)
$01:814B 13 99        .dw HandleSprKicked             ; 0A - Kicked
$01:814D 71 9F        .dw HandleSprCarried            ; 0B - Carried
$01:814F 57 81        .dw HandleGoalPowerup           ; 0C - Powerup that appears when carrying a sprite past the goal tape

}

;;; $8151: Erase sprite permanently (EraseSprite) ;;;
{
;; Sets the sprite's index in the level sprite table to $FF so it is not reloaded when the screen scrolls
;;     back. Status stays 0.
;; Parameters: X: sprite slot.
$01:8151 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:8153 9D 1A 16     STA.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X       ; / Level sprite index = $FF: the sprite will never be reloaded
$01:8156 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8157: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C) (HandleGoalPowerup) ;;;
{
;; Runs the sprite's main routine, despawns it when off screen, moves it with gravity (reduced by 2 per frame)
;;     and sets a Y speed when it lands.
$01:8157 20 C3 85     JSR.W CallSpriteMain            ; Run the sprite's main routine
$01:815A 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off screen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:815D 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Move sprite by its speeds with gravity and block interaction
$01:8160 D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:8162 D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed -= 2 (cancels part of gravity)
$01:8164 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; A = non-zero if on the ground
$01:8167 F0 03        BEQ $816C                       ; In the air: return
$01:8169 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Landed: set a bounce Y speed
$01:816C 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $816D: Handle sprite at level end (status 6) (HandleSprLvlEnd) ;;;
{
;; Calls LvlEndSprCoins to turn the sprite into a coin.
$01:816D 22 AC FB 00  JSL.L LvlEndSprCoins            ; Turn sprites into coins at level end (LvlEndSprCoins)
$01:8171 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8172: Initialize sprite (CallSpriteInit) ;;;
{
;; Sets the sprite status to 8 (normal) and jumps through SpriteInitPtr by sprite number.
;; Parameters: X: sprite slot.
$01:8172 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:8174 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal), then run its init routine
$01:8177 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:8179 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the init routine in SpriteInitPtr

}

;;; $830F: Init grey platform on lava (InitGreyLavaPlat) ;;;
{
;; Y position += 2.
$01:830F F6 D8        INC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:8311 F6 D8        INC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Y position += 2
$01:8313 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8314: Init Bowser statue (InitBowserStatue) ;;;
{
;; Direction = 1. Picks a variant like an exploding block; sprite state = variant; variant 2 uses palette 1.
$01:8314 FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = 1
$01:8317 20 A4 83     JSR.W InitExplodingBlk          ; Pick variant from X position (InitExplodingBlk, returns Y = 0-3)
$01:831A 94 C2        STY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = Y
$01:831C C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; \
$01:831E D0 05        BNE $8325                       ; / Variant other than 2: return
$01:8320 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:8322 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Sprite palette = 1
$01:8325 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8326: Init timed lift (InitTimedPlat) ;;;
{
;; [$1570,X] = $3F if X position bit 4 is set, else $FF (initial timer value, probably).
$01:8326 A0 3F        LDY.B #$3F                      ; Y = $3F
$01:8328 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:832A 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } X position bit 4 set: keep Y = $3F
$01:832C D0 02        BNE $8330                       ; /
$01:832E A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Else Y = $FF
$01:8330 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:8331 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; / [$1570,X] = Y: initial platform timer value (probably)
$01:8334 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8335: Data: Yoshi egg palettes (YoshiPal) ;;;
{
$01:8335              .db $09,$07,$05,$07             ; Yoshi egg palettes, indexed by (X position >> 4) & 3

}

;;; $8339: Init Yoshi egg (InitYoshiEgg) ;;;
{
;; Palette is chosen from bits 4-5 of the X position. Increments [$187B,X] (probably makes it unstompable).
$01:8339 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:833B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:833C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:833D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:833E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:833F 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = (X position low >> 4) & 3: egg colour comes from its position
$01:8341 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:8342 B9 35 83     LDA.W YoshiPal,Y                ; \
$01:8345 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Sprite palette = YoshiPal[Y]
$01:8348 FE 7B 18     INC.W $187B,X                   ; [$187B,X]++ (probably prevents stomping the egg)
$01:834B 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $834C: Data: diagonal bouncer X speeds (DiagBounceInitSpeed) ;;;
{
$01:834C              .db $10,$F0                     ; Initial X speeds: $10 (moves right), $F0 (moves left)

}

;;; $834E: Init diagonal bouncer (InitDiagBouncer) ;;;
{
;; Faces Mario, X speed $10 or $F0 by direction, Y speed $F0 (up). Used by the reflecting Boo stream and
;;     reflecting fireball.
$01:834E 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario (Y = direction)
$01:8351 B9 4C 83     LDA.W DiagBounceInitSpeed,Y     ; \
$01:8354 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = DiagBounceInitSpeed[Y]
$01:8356 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:8358 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F0 (moving up)
$01:835A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $835B: Init wooden spike (InitWoodSpike) ;;;
{
;; Moves the sprite $40 pixels up from its placed position.
$01:835B B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:835D 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:835E E9 40        SBC.B #$40                      ; } Y position low -= $40
$01:8360 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:8362 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:8365 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Y position high -= borrow: spawn $40 pixels above the placed position
$01:8367 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:836A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $836B: Init wooden spike, up first (InitWoodSpike2) ;;;
{
;; Same as InitMontyMole.
$01:836B 4C CE 84     JMP.W InitMontyMole             ; Same init as Monty Mole

}

;;; $836E: Init Bowser scene trigger (InitBowserScene) ;;;
{
;; Calls $A0F1 in bank $03.
$01:836E 22 F1 A0 03  JSL.L $A0F1                     ; Run Bowser scene init ($A0F1)
$01:8372 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8373: Init Sumo Brother (InitSumoBrother) ;;;
{
;; Sprite state = 3, [$1540,X] = $70. Also the entry for InitSlidingKoopa ($018379).
$01:8373 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:8375 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Sprite state = 3
$01:8377 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$01:8379 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540,X] = $70 timer
$01:837C 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $837D: Init sliding Koopa (InitSlidingKoopa) ;;;
{
;; [$1540,X] = 4 via the store in InitSumoBrother.
$01:837D A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:837F 80 F8        BRA $8379                       ; / A = 4, stored to [$1540,X] at $018379

}

;;; $8381: Init growing pipe end (InitGrowingPipe) ;;;
{
;; [$1534,X] = $40.
$01:8381 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:8383 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; / [$1534,X] = $40
$01:8386 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8387: Init Banzai Bill (InitBanzai) ;;;
{
;; If Mario is to the right of the spawn point the sprite is erased (it only flies left); otherwise plays
;;     sound $09 to [$1DFC].
$01:8387 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = 0 if Mario is right of the sprite, else 1
$01:838A 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$01:838B D0 03        BNE $8390                       ; Mario is on the left: go play the sound
$01:838D 4C 80 AC     JMP.W OffScrEraseSprite         ; Mario is on the right (Banzai Bill flies left): erase the sprite

$01:8390 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:8392 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $09 (Banzai Bill)
$01:8395 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8396: Init ball and chain (InitBallNChain) ;;;
{
;; A = $38, stored at $01839C in [$187B,X] (probably chain length).
$01:8396 A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; A = $38
$01:8398 80 02        BRA $839C                       ; Go store it at $01839C

}

;;; $839A: Init grey platform on chain (InitGreyChainPlat) ;;;
{
;; [$187B,X] = $30 (probably chain length). Shared tail for InitBallNChain.
$01:839A A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30
$01:839C 9D 7B 18     STA.W $187B,X                   ; [$187B,X] = A (probably chain length)
$01:839F 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $83A0: Data: exploding block states (ExplodingBlkSpr) ;;;
{
$01:83A0              .db $15,$0F,$00,$04             ; Exploding block states: $15, $0F, $00, $04

}

;;; $83A4: Init exploding block (InitExplodingBlk) ;;;
{
;; Sprite state = ExplodingBlkSpr[(X position >> 4) & 3]. Returns: Y = 0-3 variant.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8317: Init Bowser statue (InitBowserStatue)
;;     $01:8564: Init bubble with sprite (InitBubbleSpr)
$01:83A4 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:83A6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83A7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83A8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83A9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83AA 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = (X position low >> 4) & 3: block type from its position
$01:83AC A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:83AD B9 A0 83     LDA.W ExplodingBlkSpr,Y         ; \
$01:83B0 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Sprite state = ExplodingBlkSpr[Y]
$01:83B2 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $83B3: Data: scale platform offsets (ScalePlatWidth) ;;;
{
$01:83B3              .db $80,$40                     ; Scale platform offsets: $80, $40

}

;;; $83B5: Init scale platforms (InitScalePlats) ;;;
{
;; Saves the start Y position ([$1534], [$151C]) and sets state/[$1602] to X position + $80 or $40 (type from
;;     X bit 4), probably the partner platform position.
$01:83B5 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:83B7 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; / [$1534,X] = Y position low (remember the start)
$01:83BA BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:83BD 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = Y position high
$01:83C0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:83C2 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$01:83C4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83C5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83C6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:83C7 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = X position bit 4 (0 or 1): platform type
$01:83C8 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:83C9 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:83CB 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:83CC 79 B3 83     ADC.W ScalePlatWidth,Y          ; } Sprite state = X position low + ScalePlatWidth[Y]
$01:83CF 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$01:83D1 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:83D4 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } [$1602,X] = X position high + carry
$01:83D6 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$01:83D9 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $83DA: Init message box and side exit (InitMsg+SideExit) ;;;
{
;; [$1564,X] = $28 timer (blocks sprite contact).
$01:83DA A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:83DC 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / [$1564,X] = $28: timer that blocks sprite contact
$01:83DF 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $83E0: Init Yoshi (InitYoshi) ;;;
{
;; Direction = 1. Erases the sprite if Mario already has Yoshi from the overworld.
$01:83E0 DE 0E 16     DEC.W $160E,X                   ; [$160E,X] -= 1 (to $FF)
$01:83E3 FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = 1
$01:83E6 AD C1 0D     LDA.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; \
$01:83E9 F0 03        BEQ $83EE                       ; / If Mario already has Yoshi (overworld flag), return
$01:83EB 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Else erase this sprite (status 0)
$01:83EE 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $83EF..83F0: Data: urchin init speeds ;;;
{
;; Speed pairs used by InitUrchin: X speed table at $0183EF, Y speed table at $0183F0.
$01:83EF              .db $08                         ; Urchin speed table: $08, then shared with next byte

$01:83F0              .db $00,$08                     ; $00, $08: X speed for Y = 1; Y speed for Y = 0 and 1

}

;;; $83F2: Init Spike Top (InitSpikeTop) ;;;
{
;; Sets direction bit from Mario's side, enters InitUrchin at $01841D for speeds, clears [$164A,X].
$01:83F2 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = 0 if Mario is right of the sprite, else 1
$01:83F5 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:83F6 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:83F8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:83F9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:83FA 0A           ASL                             ; } A = (Y EOR 1) << 4: $10 if Mario is on the right, else 0
$01:83FB 0A           ASL                             ; /
$01:83FC 20 1D 84     JSR.W $841D                     ; Set direction bit and speeds (InitUrchin entry at $01841D)
$01:83FF 9E 4A 16     STZ.W $164A,X                   ; [$164A,X] = 0
$01:8402 80 0A        BRA $840E                       ; Continue at $01840E

}

;;; $8404: Init wall-following Urchin (InitUrchinWallFllw) ;;;
{
;; Y position += 1, then falls into InitFuzzBall+Spark.
$01:8404 F6 D8        INC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Y position low += 1 (sprite hugs the wall)
$01:8406 D0 03        BNE InitFuzzBall+Spark          ; No overflow: go to InitFuzzBall+Spark
$01:8408 FE D4 14     INC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Carry into Y position high
}

;;; $840B: Init Fuzzball and Sparky (InitFuzzBall+Spark) ;;;
{
;; Runs InitUrchin, then flips the direction bit in [$151C,X] and sets state = [$151C] >> 2.
$01:840B 20 1B 84     JSR.W InitUrchin                ; Initialize like an Urchin
$01:840E BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:8411 49 10        EOR.B #$10                      ; } [$151C,X] EOR= $10: flip the direction bit
$01:8413 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; /
$01:8416 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:8417 4A           LSR                             ; } Sprite state = [$151C,X] >> 2
$01:8418 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$01:841A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $841B: Init Urchin (InitUrchin) ;;;
{
;; Direction bit [$151C,X] = X position bit 4; speeds from $83EF/0183F0. Falls into InitRipVanFish.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:840B: Init Fuzzball and Sparky (InitFuzzBall+Spark)
$01:841B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = X position low
$01:841D A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$01:841F 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; A = X position bit 4
$01:8421 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C,X] = direction bit
$01:8424 D0 01        BNE $8427                       ; Bit set: keep Y = 0
$01:8426 C8           INY                             ; Else Y = 1
$01:8427 B9 EF 83     LDA.W $83EF,Y                   ; A = $83EF[Y]
$01:842A 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = A
$01:842C B9 F0 83     LDA.W $83F0,Y                   ; A = $83F0[Y]
$01:842F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = A (then falls into InitRipVanFish)
}

;;; $8431: Init Rip Van Fish (InitRipVanFish) ;;;
{
;; [$164A,X]++ (probably the in-water flag).
$01:8431 FE 4A 16     INC.W $164A,X                   ; [$164A,X]++ (probably the in-water flag)
$01:8434 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

{
;; Sprite status = 9 (carryable).
$01:8435 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:8437 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$01:843A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $843B: Init changing item (InitChangingItem) ;;;
{
;; Sprite state += 1.

$01:843D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $843E: Init pea bouncer (InitPeaBouncer) ;;;
{
;; X position -= 8.
$01:843E B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:8440 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:8441 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } X position low -= 8
$01:8443 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:8445 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:8448 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } X position high -= borrow
$01:844A 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:844D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $844E: Init P-switch (InitPSwitch) ;;;
{
;; Type [$151C,X] = (X >> 4) & 1 (blue/silver), palette from PSwitchPal, status 9 (carryable).
$01:844E B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:8450 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8451 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8452 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8453 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8454 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } [$151C,X] = (X position >> 4) & 1: 0 = blue, 1 = silver
$01:8456 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; /
$01:8459 A8           TAY                             ; \
$01:845A B9 66 84     LDA.W PSwitchPal,Y              ; } Sprite palette = PSwitchPal[Y]
$01:845D 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:8460 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:8462 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$01:8465 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8466: Data: P-switch palettes (PSwitchPal) ;;;
{
;; $018468 (code after the table): erases the sprite once off screen (jump target for InitLakitu).
$01:8466              .db $06,$02                     ; P-switch palettes: $06 (blue), $02 (silver)

$01:8468 4C 80 AC     JMP.W OffScrEraseSprite         ; Erase this sprite once off screen (used by InitLakitu)

}

;;; $846B: Init Lakitu and spawn cloud (InitLakitu) ;;;
{
;; If another Lakitu or Lakitu cloud exists the sprite is erased. Otherwise clears respawn state, saves its Y
;;     position in [$18C3], spawns a Lakitu cloud ($87) in a free slot at its position and falls into
;;     InitMontyMole.
$01:846B A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: look through sprite slots 9..0
$01:846D CC E9 15     CPY.W $15E9                     ; Skip this sprite's own slot
$01:8470 F0 12        BEQ $8484                       ; Own slot: next slot
$01:8472 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; A = status of slot Y
$01:8475 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:8477 D0 0B        BNE $8484                       ; / Not status 8 (normal): next slot
$01:8479 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = sprite number in slot Y
$01:847C C9 87        CMP.B #$87                      ; \
$01:847E F0 E8        BEQ $8468                       ; / Lakitu's cloud ($87) already exists: erase this sprite
$01:8480 C9 1E        CMP.B #$1E                      ; \
$01:8482 F0 E4        BEQ $8468                       ; / Another Lakitu ($1E) exists: erase this sprite
$01:8484 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$01:8485 10 E6        BPL $846D                       ; Loop for slots 9..0
$01:8487 9C C0 18     STZ.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn       ; Respawn timer = 0
$01:848A 9C BF 18     STZ.W $18BF                     ; [$18BF] = 0
$01:848D 9C B9 18     STZ.W RAM_GeneratorNum          ; Generator number = 0 (no generator)
$01:8490 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:8492 8D C3 18     STA.W $18C3                     ; |
$01:8495 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } Save Lakitu's Y position in [$18C3]/[$18C4]
$01:8498 8D C4 18     STA.W $18C4                     ; /
$01:849B 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; Find a free sprite slot (Y; N set if none)
$01:849F 30 2D        BMI InitMontyMole               ; None free: skip the cloud
$01:84A1 8C E1 18     STY.W $18E1                     ; [$18E1] = slot of the cloud
$01:84A4 A9 87        LDA.B #$87                      ; \
$01:84A6 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / New sprite number = $87 (Lakitu's cloud)
$01:84A9 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:84AB 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:84AE B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:84B0 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; / Cloud X position low = Lakitu's
$01:84B3 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:84B6 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / Cloud X position high = Lakitu's
$01:84B9 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:84BB 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; / Cloud Y position low = Lakitu's
$01:84BE BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:84C1 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / Cloud Y position high = Lakitu's
$01:84C4 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:84C5 BB           TYX                             ; |
$01:84C6 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; } Initialize the cloud's sprite tables (X = cloud slot)
$01:84CA FA           PLX                             ; /
$01:84CB 9C E0 18     STZ.W $18E0                     ; [$18E0] = 0 (then falls into InitMontyMole)
}

;;; $84CE: Init Monty Mole (InitMontyMole) ;;;
{
;; [$151C,X] = X position bit 4 (variant flag).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:836B: Init wooden spike, up first (InitWoodSpike2)
$01:84CE B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:84D0 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } [$151C,X] = X position bit 4 (variant flag)
$01:84D2 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; /
$01:84D5 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $84D6: Init creating/eating block (InitCreateEatBlk) ;;;
{
;; [$1909] = $FF, then InitMontyMole.
$01:84D6 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:84D8 8D 09 19     STA.W $1909                     ; / [$1909] = $FF
$01:84DB 80 F1        BRA InitMontyMole               ; Then set the variant flag (InitMontyMole)

}

;;; $84DD: Init Bullet Bill (InitBulletBill) ;;;
{
;; Sprite state = side Mario is on, [$1540,X] = $10.
$01:84DD 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = 0 if Mario is right of the sprite, else 1
$01:84E0 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:84E1 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Sprite state = Y (direction)
$01:84E3 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:84E5 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540,X] = $10 timer
$01:84E8 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

$01:84E9 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = chuck type 8 (Clappin')
$01:84EB 80 2D        BRA $851A                       ; Go store it at $01851A

}

;;; $84ED: Init Pitchin' Chuck (InitPitchinChuck) ;;;
{
;; [$187B,X] = (X position & $30) >> 4; chuck type $0A.

$01:84F1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:84F2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:84F3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:84F4 4A           LSR                             ; } [$187B,X] = (X position & $30) >> 4: variant 0-3 (probably)
$01:84F5 9D 7B 18     STA.W $187B,X                   ; /
$01:84F8 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:84FA 80 1E        BRA $851A                       ; / A = chuck type $0A (Pitchin'), go store it at $01851A

}

;;; $84FC: Init Puntin' Chuck (InitPuntinChuck) ;;;
{
;; Chuck type 9.
$01:84FC A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:84FE 80 1A        BRA $851A                       ; / A = chuck type 9 (Puntin'), go store it at $01851A

}

;;; $8500: Init Whistlin' Chuck (InitWhistlinChuck) ;;;
{
;; Chuck type $0B.
$01:8500 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:8502 80 16        BRA $851A                       ; / A = chuck type $0B (Whistlin'), go store it at $01851A

;;; $8504: Init Splittin'/Bouncin' Chuck (InitChuck) ;;;
{
;; Chuck type 5.
$01:8504 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$01:8506 80 12        BRA $851A                       ; / A = chuck type 5 (Splittin'/Bouncin'), go store it at $01851A

}

;;; $8508: Init Diggin' Chuck and set chuck type (InitDigginChuck) ;;;
{
;; $018508: [$1540,X] = $30, direction from X bit 4, type 4.
;; $01851A (shared by all chucks): sprite state = chuck type, faces Mario, [$151C,X] = $8526[Y].
;; Parameters: A: chuck type (for entry $01851A).
$01:8508 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:850A 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540,X] = $30 timer
$01:850D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:850F 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$01:8511 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8512 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8513 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8514 4A           LSR                             ; } Direction = X position bit 4
$01:8515 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$01:8518 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = chuck type 4 (Diggin')
$01:851A 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = chuck type (chucks share most of their code)
$01:851C 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario (Y = direction)
$01:851F B9 26 85     LDA.W $8526,Y                   ; \
$01:8522 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = $8526[Y]
$01:8525 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8526..8526: Data: chuck init values ;;;
{
$01:8526              .db $00,$04                     ; Chuck init values: $00, $04

}

;;; $8528: Init Super Koopa (InitSuperKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Y speed = $28, then FaceMario.
$01:8528 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:852A 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $28 (moving down)
$01:852C 80 4E        BRA FaceMario                   ; Face Mario

}

;;; $852E: Init feather Super Koopa (InitSuperKoopaFthr) ;;;
{
;; Faces Mario. If X bit 4 is set sets sprite tweaker bytes 1656, 1662, 1686; otherwise [$1534,X] += 1.
$01:852E 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:8531 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:8533 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } X position bit 4 clear: go to $018547
$01:8535 F0 10        BEQ $8547                       ; /
$01:8537 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:8539 9D 56 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X         ; / Sprite tweaker 1656 = $10
$01:853C A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:853E 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; / Sprite tweaker 1662 = $80
$01:8541 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:8543 9D 86 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; / Sprite tweaker 1686 = $10
$01:8546 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8547 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534,X] += 1
$01:854A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $854B: Init Pokey (InitPokey) ;;;
{
;; State = segment bit mask: $1F (5 segments) on Yoshi, $07 (3) otherwise. Then FaceMario.
$01:854B A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; A = $1F: 5 Pokey segments (one bit each)
$01:854D AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:8550 D0 02        BNE $8554                       ; / On Yoshi: keep $1F
$01:8552 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; Not on Yoshi: A = $07, 3 segments
$01:8554 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = segment bit mask
$01:8556 80 24        BRA FaceMario                   ; Face Mario

}

;;; $8558: Init Dino Rhino and Torch (InitDinos) ;;;
{
;; [$151C,X] = 4, falls into InitBomb.
$01:8558 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:855A 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = 4 (falls into InitBomb)
}

;;; $855D: Init Bob-omb (InitBomb) ;;;
{
;; [$1540,X] = $FF fuse timer, then FaceMario.
$01:855D A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:855F 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540,X] = $FF timer
$01:8562 80 18        BRA FaceMario                   ; Face Mario

}

;;; $8564: Init bubble with sprite (InitBubbleSpr) ;;;
{
;; Variant from InitExplodingBlk stored in state, [$1534,X] -= 1, FaceMario.
$01:8564 20 A4 83     JSR.W InitExplodingBlk          ; Choose variant like an exploding block (Y = 0-3)
$01:8567 94 C2        STY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = Y
$01:8569 DE 34 15     DEC.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534,X] -= 1
$01:856C 80 0E        BRA FaceMario                   ; Face Mario

}

;;; $856E: Init green bouncing Koopa (InitGrnBounceKoopa) ;;;
{
;; [$160E,X] = Y position bit 4, falls into InitStandardSprite.
$01:856E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:8570 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } [$160E,X] = Y position bit 4
$01:8572 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; /
}

;;; $8575: Init standard sprite (InitStandardSprite) ;;;
{
;; [$1570,X] = random number, falls into FaceMario.
$01:8575 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; A = random number
$01:8579 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570,X] = A (falls into FaceMario)
}

;;; $857C: Face Mario (FaceMario) ;;;
{
;; Sprite direction = side Mario is on (0 = Mario to the right).
;; Parameters: X: sprite slot.
;; Returns: Y = direction.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:834E: Init diagonal bouncer (InitDiagBouncer)
;;     $01:851C: Init Diggin' Chuck and set chuck type (InitDigginChuck)
;;     $01:852E: Init feather Super Koopa (InitSuperKoopaFthr)
;;     $01:8597: Init Fishbone (InitFishbone)
;;     $01:895B: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:8B6C: Walking sprite on the ground (SpriteOnGround)
;;     $01:8C38: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8D74: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8F61: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:9679: Koopa spawn table; Bob-omb and shell timers (SpriteKoopasSpawn)
;;     $01:98BA: Disco shell: kicked behaviour
;;     $01:B00B: Init vertical Cheep Cheep (InitVerticalFish)
;;     ... and 9 more
$01:857C 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = 0 if Mario is right of the sprite, else 1
$01:857F 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$01:8580 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Sprite direction = Y (face Mario)
$01:8583 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8584: Init Bowser's fireball (InitBowsersFire) ;;;
{
;; Plays sound $17, then FaceMario.
$01:8584 A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$01:8586 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $17 (Bowser's fire)
$01:8589 80 F1        BRA FaceMario                   ; Face Mario

}

;;; $858B: Init powerup (InitPowerUp) ;;;
{
;; Sprite state += 1.
$01:858B F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state += 1
$01:858D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $858E: Init Fishbone (InitFishbone) ;;;
{
;; [$1540,X] = random number & $1F, then FaceMario.
$01:858E 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; A = random number
$01:8592 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:8594 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540,X] = random number & $1F
$01:8597 4C 7C 85     JMP.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario

}

;;; $859A: Init upside-down Piranha Plant (InitDownPiranha) ;;;
{
;; Sets bit 7 of the palette byte (vertical flip) and moves the sprite up $10 pixels.
$01:859A 1E F6 15     ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:859D 38           SEC                             ; } Set bit 7 of the sprite palette byte (vertical flip)
$01:859E 7E F6 15     ROR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:85A1 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:85A3 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:85A4 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; } Y position low -= $10
$01:85A6 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:85A8 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:85AB E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Y position high -= borrow
$01:85AD 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
}

;;; $85B0: Init: Piranha Plant position (InitPiranha) ;;;
{
;; Centers the plant horizontally between the two pipe tiles (X += 8) and moves it up one pixel (16-bit
;;     decrement of Y).
$01:85B0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:85B2 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:85B3 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Sprite X position += 8 (center on the pipe)
$01:85B5 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:85B7 D6 D8        DEC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Sprite Y position low -= 1
$01:85B9 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = new Y low
$01:85BB C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; Borrow out of the low byte?
$01:85BD D0 03        BNE $85C2                       ; No: done
$01:85BF DE D4 14     DEC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Borrow: Y position high -= 1
$01:85C2 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $85C3: Dispatch sprite main routine (CallSpriteMain) ;;;
{
;; Runs the main routine for the current sprite (status 8) through the pointer table SpriteMainPtr that
;;     follows the JSL.
;; Parameters: X = sprite slot. Clears [$1491] first.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8130: Run sprite by status (HandleSprite)
;;     $01:8157: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C) (HandleGoalPowerup)
;;     $01:9AA8: Sprite status: killed (HandleSprKilled)
;;     $01:9B1A: Draw killed sprite (HandleSpriteDeath)
$01:85C3 9C 91 14     STZ.W $1491                     ; [$1491] = 0 (clear horizontal movement this frame)
$01:85C6 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number [$9E,X]
$01:85C8 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the routine at SpriteMainPtr[A] (ExecutePtr reads the inline word table)

}

;;; $85CC: Pointer table: sprite main routines (SpriteMainPtr) ;;;
{
;; 2-byte pointers (bank $01), indexed by sprite number $00-$C8. Used by CallSpriteMain for sprites in normal
;;     status.
;; Sprites handled in other banks go through small wrapper routines below (Bank3SprHandler etc.).
$01:85CC 04 89        .dw ShellessKoopas              ; 00 - Green Koopa, no shell
$01:85CE 04 89        .dw ShellessKoopas              ; 01 - Red Koopa, no shell
$01:85D0 04 89        .dw ShellessKoopas              ; 02 - Blue Koopa, no shell
$01:85D2 04 89        .dw ShellessKoopas              ; 03 - Yellow Koopa, no shell
$01:85D4 FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 04 - Green Koopa
$01:85D6 FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 05 - Red Koopa
$01:85D8 FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 06 - Blue Koopa
$01:85DA FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 07 - Yellow Koopa
$01:85DC 4D 8C        .dw GreenParaKoopa              ; 08 - Green Koopa, flying left
$01:85DE 4D 8C        .dw GreenParaKoopa              ; 09 - Green bouncing Koopa
$01:85E0 C3 8C        .dw RedVertParaKoopa            ; 0A - Red vertical flying Koopa
$01:85E2 BE 8C        .dw RedHorzParaKoopa            ; 0B - Red horizontal flying Koopa
$01:85E4 FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 0C - Yellow Koopa with wings
$01:85E6 E5 8A        .dw Bobomb                      ; 0D - Bob-omb
$01:85E8 C8 E1        .dw Keyhole                     ; 0E - Keyhole
$01:85EA FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 0F - Goomba
$01:85EC 2E 8D        .dw WingedGoomba                ; 10 - Bouncing Goomba with wings
$01:85EE FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 11 - Buzzy Beetle
$01:85F0 7B F8        .dw $F87B                       ; 12 - Unused
$01:85F2 FC 8A        .dw Spr0to13Start               ; 13 - Spiny
$01:85F4 18 8C        .dw SpinyEgg                    ; 14 - Spiny falling
$01:85F6 33 B0        .dw Fish                        ; 15 - Fish, horizontal
$01:85F8 33 B0        .dw Fish                        ; 16 - Fish, vertical
$01:85FA 92 B1        .dw GeneratedFish               ; 17 - Fish, created from generator

$01:8762 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8763: Goal Point Question Sphere (GoalSphere) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 4A, the sphere that ends the level (secret exit goal). Draws itself, sparkles, and when Mario
;;     touches it erases itself,
;; starts the end-of-level timer and requests the course clear music.
$01:8763 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite (standard 16x16 graphics)
$01:8766 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8768 D0 1E        BNE $8788                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:876A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:876C 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$01:876E 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } Sparkle effect when ([$13] AND $1F) = 0, only if on-screen and not locked ($B152)
$01:8770 20 52 B1     JSR.W $B152                     ; /
$01:8773 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Check contact with Mario
$01:8776 90 10        BCC $8788                       ; No contact: return
$01:8778 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the sprite (status 0)
$01:877B A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:877D 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; } [$1493] = [$0DDA] = $FF: end-of-level timer started
$01:8780 8D DA 0D     STA.W $0DDA                     ; /
$01:8783 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:8785 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request [$1DFB] = $0B (course clear)
$01:8788 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8898: Yellow Koopa: jump over incoming shells (JumpOverShells) ;;;
{
;; Every 4th frame (staggered by sprite slot) looks for a kicked shell (status $0A) in slots 9..0. If one is
;;     close enough to the
;; sprite and the sprite is on the ground and facing the other way, the sprite jumps (Y speed $C0).
;; Parameters: X = Koopa sprite slot.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8B7F: Walking sprite: jump over shells (DontFollowMario)
$01:8898 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:8899 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; } Only run when ([X] EOR [$13]) AND 3 = 0, i.e. once every 4 frames
$01:889B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; /
$01:889D D0 0C        BNE $88AB                       ; Not this frame: return
$01:889F A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: first sprite slot to check
}

;;; $88A1: Shell search loop: test status (JumpLoopStart) ;;;
{
$01:88A1 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:88A4 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; / Status of slot Y = $0A (kicked shell)?
$01:88A6 F0 04        BEQ HandleJumpOver              ; Yes: test whether to jump it
}

;;; $88A8: Shell search loop: next slot (JumpLoopNext) ;;;
{
$01:88A8 88           DEY                             ; Y--
$01:88A9 10 F6        BPL JumpLoopStart               ; Loop for slots 9..0
$01:88AB 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $88AC: Check shell proximity and jump (HandleJumpOver) ;;;
{
;; Builds a detection box around the shell in slot Y: X = shell X - $1A (16-bit), width $44, Y = shell Y,
;;     height $10,
;; tests it against this sprite's hitbox, then makes the sprite jump if it is on the ground and facing the
;;     opposite way to the shell.
$01:88AC B9 E4 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; \
$01:88AF 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:88B0 E9 1A        SBC.B #$1A                      ; |
$01:88B2 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:88B4 B9 E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; |
$01:88B7 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } [$00]/[$08] = shell X position - $1A (box left edge, low/high)
$01:88B9 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$01:88BB A9 44        LDA.B #$44                      ; \
$01:88BD 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $44: box width
$01:88BF B9 D8 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; \
$01:88C2 85 01        STA $01                         ; |
$01:88C4 B9 D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; } [$01]/[$09] = shell Y position (box top, low/high)
$01:88C7 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$01:88C9 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:88CB 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = $10: box height
$01:88CD 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Hitbox of this sprite into $04-$07, $0A, $0B
$01:88D1 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Test overlap of the two boxes
$01:88D5 90 D1        BCC JumpLoopNext                ; No overlap: try the next slot
$01:88D7 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; This sprite on the ground?
$01:88DA F0 CC        BEQ JumpLoopNext                ; No: try the next slot
$01:88DC B9 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; A = shell direction
$01:88DF DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Same direction as this sprite?
$01:88E2 F0 07        BEQ $88EB                       ; Yes: don't jump, return
$01:88E4 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; Jump speed:
$01:88E6 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = $C0 (jump)
$01:88E8 9E 3E 16     STZ.W $163E,X                   ; Clear timer [$163E,X]
$01:88EB 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $88EC: Table: walking speed X (Spr0to13SpeedX) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by direction (0 right, 1 left), +2 for fast sprites: right $08, left $F8, fast right $0C, fast left
;;     $F4.
$01:88EC              .db $08,$F8,$0C,$F4             ; $08 right, $F8 left, $0C fast right, $F4 fast left

}

;;; $88F0: Table: Koopa/Goomba property flags (Spr0to13Prop) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by sprite number $00-$13. Bit 0 = fast walker, bit 1 = stays on ledges (turns at edges), bit 2 =
;;     turns to follow Mario,
;; bit 3 = jumps over shells, bit 7 = flutters wings in the air. Other bits are not used by this code.
$01:88F0              .db $00,$02,$03,$0D,$40,$42,$43,$45 ; Sprites 00-07 (shelless Koopas, Koopas)
$01:88F8              .db $50,$50,$50,$5C,$DD,$05,$00,$20 ; Sprites 08-0F (para Koopas, Bob-omb, Keyhole, Goomba)
$01:8900              .db $20,$00,$00,$00             ; Sprites 10-13 (winged Goomba, Buzzy Beetle, unused, Spiny)

}

;;; $8904: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for the naked Koopas. Not locked: runs the timer/kick logic below. Locked: animates and
;;     interacts only.
;; Uses timer [$163E,X] (wait/kick), [$160E,X] (slot of the sprite it kicks), [$1528,X], [$1534,X] (kick state
;;     flags), [$C2,X] (kick pose timer).
;; The blue Koopa (sprite 02) behaves slightly differently from the others.
$01:8904 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$01:8906 F0 4A        BEQ $8952                       ; Not locked: go to the main logic at $018952
$01:8908 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; Timer [$163E,X]
$01:890B C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; Timer >= $80?
$01:890D 90 10        BCC $891F                       ; Yes: skip the animation, go to $01891F
$01:890F A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$01:8911 D0 0C        BNE $891F                       ; Yes: skip the animation
$01:8913 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance the walk animation (SetAnimationFrame)
$01:8916 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:8919 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:891A 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; } Animation frame [$1602,X] += 5 (select the Koopa frame set without shell)
$01:891C 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$01:891F 20 31 89     JSR.W $8931                     ; Interact with Mario ($8931)
$01:8922 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Apply speed to position
$01:8925 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = 0
$01:8927 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:892A F0 02        BEQ $892E                       ; No: keep Y speed
$01:892C 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$01:892E 4C 03 8B     JMP.W $8B03                     ; Go to sprite interaction and graphics ($018B03)

$01:8931 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:8933 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Blue Koopa (02)?
$01:8935 D0 05        BNE $893C                       ; No: go to $01893C
$01:8937 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Blue: plain interaction with Mario
$01:893A 80 15        BRA $8951                       ; Return

$01:893C 1E 7A 16     ASL.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:893F 38           SEC                             ; } Set bit 7 of tweaker [$167A,X] for the duration of the interaction
$01:8940 7E 7A 16     ROR.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; /
$01:8943 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:8946 90 03        BCC $894B                       ; No contact: skip
$01:8948 20 2A B1     JSR.W $B12A                     ; Contact: Mario kills it (kick sound, knocked away, status 2, points) ($B12A)
$01:894B 1E 7A 16     ASL.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:894E 5E 7A 16     LSR.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; / Restore bit 7 of tweaker [$167A,X] to 0
$01:8951 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8952 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; Timer [$163E,X]
$01:8955 F0 5D        BEQ $89B4                       ; Zero: go to $0189B4
$01:8957 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; Timer = $80?
$01:8959 D0 10        BNE $896B                       ; No: go to $01896B
$01:895B 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:895E B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:8960 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Blue Koopa (02)?
$01:8962 F0 04        BEQ $8968                       ; Yes: no hop
$01:8964 A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$01:8966 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Not blue: Y speed = $E0 (small hop)
$01:8968 9E 3E 16     STZ.W $163E,X                   ; Clear timer [$163E,X]
$01:896B C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1?
$01:896D D0 99        BNE $8908                       ; No: go to $018908 (animate and interact)
$01:896F BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = slot of the sprite to kick [$160E,X]
$01:8972 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Status of that sprite
$01:8975 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9 (carryable/stunned)?
$01:8977 D0 8F        BNE $8908                       ; No: go to $018908
$01:8979 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:897B 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:897C F9 E4 00     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$01:897F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8980 69 12        ADC.B #$12                      ; } Within +-$12 pixels horizontally of that sprite?
$01:8982 C9 24        CMP.B #$24                      ; /
$01:8984 B0 82        BCS $8908                       ; No: go to $018908
$01:8986 20 28 A7     JSR.W PlayKickSfx               ; Play the kick sound
$01:8989 20 55 A7     JSR.W $A755                     ; [$C2,X] = [$1558,X] = $20 (kick pose timers)
$01:898C BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = this sprite's direction
$01:898F B9 D7 A6     LDA.W $A6D7,Y                   ; A = kick speed for that direction ($30 or $D0)
$01:8992 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = slot of the kicked sprite
$01:8995 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; Kicked sprite X speed = A
$01:8998 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:899A 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Kicked sprite status = $0A (kicked)
$01:899D B9 40 15     LDA.W $1540,Y                   ; \
$01:89A0 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; / Kicked sprite [$C2] = its [$1540]
$01:89A3 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:89A5 99 64 15     STA.W $1564,Y                   ; / Kicked sprite [$1564] = 8 (briefly ignore other sprites)
$01:89A8 B9 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,Y         ; \
$01:89AB 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Tweaker bit 4 (kickable like a shell) clear? Then give it an upward kick
$01:89AD F0 05        BEQ $89B4                       ; /
$01:89AF A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$01:89B1 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / Unused here: kicked sprite Y speed = $E0
$01:89B4 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528,X] flag
$01:89B7 F0 5C        BEQ $8A15                       ; Zero: go to $018A15
$01:89B9 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Touching a wall?
$01:89BC F0 02        BEQ $89C0                       ; No: keep X speed
$01:89BE 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = 0
$01:89C0 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:89C3 F0 21        BEQ $89E6                       ; No: go to $0189E6
$01:89C5 A5 86        LDA $86                         ; \
$01:89C7 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:89C9 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:89CB 90 01        BCC $89CE                       ; } [$00] = friction: 2 normally, 1 on slippery levels ([$86] non-zero)
$01:89CD 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:89CE 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = friction
$01:89D0 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = sprite X speed
$01:89D2 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |speed| < 2?
$01:89D4 90 27        BCC $89FD                       ; Yes: stopped, go to $0189FD
$01:89D6 10 06        BPL $89DE                       ; Positive: just subtract friction
$01:89D8 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:89D9 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:89DB 18           CLC                             ; } Negative: speed += 2 * friction (then minus friction below)
$01:89DC 65 00        ADC $00                         ; /
$01:89DE 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:89DF E5 00        SBC $00                         ; / A -= friction
$01:89E1 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store as sprite X speed
$01:89E3 20 4E 80     JSR.W $804E                     ; Spawn sliding smoke ($804E)
$01:89E6 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Animation counter [$1570,X] = 0

$01:89E9 20 43 8B     JSR.W $8B43                     ; Offscreen check, move, animate, ground check ($8B43)
$01:89EC A9 E6        LDA.B #$E6                      ; \
$01:89EE B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; |
$01:89F0 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; |
$01:89F2 F0 02        BEQ $89F6                       ; } A = tile $E6 for the blue Koopa, $86 for the others
$01:89F4 A9 86        LDA.B #$86                      ; /
$01:89F6 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$01:89F9 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Set the tile number of its first OAM entry
$01:89FC 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $89FD: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE) ;;;
{
;; Continuation of ShellessKoopas (the 'NOTE' label comes from a stray comment in the source).
;; $0189FD: stopped sliding, set wait timer. $018A15: follow-through of a kick (slow the kicked sprite).
;;     $018A88: kick pose timer.
;; $018A9B: when [$1558,X] = 1, check the touched sprite and, on contact, erase the Koopa and mark that sprite
;;     (shell re-entry, probably).
$01:89FD              usually, Y has index to sprite kicked, X is index to sprite ; On the ground?

$01:89FD 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8A00 F0 0D        BEQ $8A0F                       ; No: skip setting the timer

; the sprite timer
$01:8A02 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:8A04 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; |
$01:8A06 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; } A = $FF wait timer, but $A0 for the blue Koopa
$01:8A08 D0 02        BNE $8A0C                       ; /
$01:8A0A A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; Blue Koopa: A = $A0
$01:8A0C 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; Timer [$163E,X] = A
$01:8A0F 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; Clear [$1528,X]


$01:8A12 4C 13 89     JMP.W $8913                     ; Go back to the animation code ($018913)

$01:8A15 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534,X]: kicking something?
$01:8A18 F0 6E        BEQ $8A88                       ; No: go to $018A88
$01:8A1A BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = slot of the kicked sprite
$01:8A1D B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Its status
$01:8A20 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Still kicked ($0A)?
$01:8A22 F0 05        BEQ $8A29                       ; Yes: follow it
$01:8A24 9E 34 15     STZ.W $1534,X                   ; Clear [$1534,X]
$01:8A27 80 39        BRA $8A62                       ; Reset the frame and return ($018A62)

$01:8A29 99 28 15     STA.W $1528,Y                   ; Kicked sprite [$1528] = $0A

; (?)
$01:8A2C 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Touching a wall?
$01:8A2F F0 07        BEQ $8A38                       ; No: keep going
$01:8A31 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:8A33 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; } Wall hit: X speed of the kicked sprite and of the Koopa = 0
$01:8A36 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:8A38 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8A3B F0 25        BEQ $8A62                       ; No: go to $018A62
$01:8A3D A5 86        LDA $86                         ; \
$01:8A3F C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:8A41 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; } A = 2, or 1 on slippery levels ([$86] non-zero) after the LSR below
$01:8A43 90 01        BCC $8A46                       ; /
$01:8A45 4A           LSR                             ; Slippery: A = 1
$01:8A46 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = friction
$01:8A48 B9 B6 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; A = kicked sprite X speed
$01:8A4B C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |speed| < 2?
$01:8A4D 90 1A        BCC $8A69                       ; Yes: stopped, go to $018A69
$01:8A4F 10 06        BPL $8A57                       ; Positive: subtract friction
$01:8A51 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:8A52 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:8A54 18           CLC                             ; } Negative: speed += 2 * friction
$01:8A55 65 00        ADC $00                         ; /
$01:8A57 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:8A58 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; / Speed -= friction (towards zero)
$01:8A5A 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; Kicked sprite X speed = A
$01:8A5D 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Koopa X speed = A (slides with it)
$01:8A5F 20 4E 80     JSR.W $804E                     ; Spawn sliding smoke ($804E)
$01:8A62 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Animation counter [$1570,X] = 0
$01:8A65 20 43 8B     JSR.W $8B43                     ; Offscreen check, move, animate ($8B43)
$01:8A68 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8A69 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:8A6B 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } Both sprites X speed = 0
$01:8A6D 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; /
$01:8A70 9E 34 15     STZ.W $1534,X                   ; Clear [$1534,X]
$01:8A73 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:8A75 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Kicked sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$01:8A78 DA           PHX                             ; Save the Koopa slot
$01:8A79 BB           TYX                             ; X = kicked sprite slot
$01:8A7A 20 0B AA     JSR.W $AA0B                     ; Set stunned timer for it ($AA0B)
$01:8A7D BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Its timer [$1540]
$01:8A80 F0 05        BEQ $8A87                       ; Zero: leave it
$01:8A82 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:8A84 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Non-zero: [$1540] = $FF
$01:8A87 FA           PLX                             ; X = Koopa slot again
$01:8A88 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; [$C2,X] kick pose timer
$01:8A8A F0 0F        BEQ $8A9B                       ; Zero: go to $018A9B
$01:8A8C D6 C2        DEC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; [$C2,X]--

; it a timer)
$01:8A8E C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Old value >= 8?
$01:8A90 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Frame 4 (kick pose)
$01:8A92 B0 02        BCS $8A96                       ; Yes: use 4
$01:8A94 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; No: frame 0
$01:8A96 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602,X] = A
$01:8A99 80 65        BRA $8B00                       ; Go to interaction and graphics ($018B00)

$01:8A9B BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; Timer [$1558,X]
$01:8A9E C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; = 1?
$01:8AA0 D0 68        BNE Spr0to13Main                ; No: normal walking (Spr0to13Main)
$01:8AA2 BC 94 15     LDY.W $1594,X                   ; Y = [$1594,X] (sprite it touched)
$01:8AA5 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Its status
$01:8AA8 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; < 8?

; kicked, etc
$01:8AAA 90 2D        BCC $8AD9                       ; Yes: not active, return
$01:8AAC B9 AA 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; Its Y speed
$01:8AAF 30 28        BMI $8AD9                       ; Moving up: return
$01:8AB1 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Its sprite number
$01:8AB4 C9 21        CMP.B #$21                      ; Moving coin (21)?
$01:8AB6 F0 21        BEQ $8AD9                       ; Yes: return
$01:8AB8 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Hitbox of this Koopa to $04-$07 (A)
$01:8ABC DA           PHX                             ; Save the Koopa slot
$01:8ABD BB           TYX                             ; X = slot of the other sprite
$01:8ABE 22 E5 B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB        ; Hitbox of the other sprite to $00-$03 (B)
$01:8AC2 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the Koopa slot
$01:8AC3 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Test overlap
$01:8AC7 90 10        BCC $8AD9                       ; No contact: return
$01:8AC9 20 80 AC     JSR.W OffScrEraseSprite         ; Contact: erase the Koopa (OffScrEraseSprite)
$01:8ACC BC 94 15     LDY.W $1594,X                   ; Y = [$1594,X]
$01:8ACF A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:8AD1 99 58 15     STA.W $1558,Y                   ; / Other sprite [$1558] = $10
$01:8AD4 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:8AD6 99 0E 16     STA.W $160E,Y                   ; / Other sprite [$160E] = Koopa's sprite number
$01:8AD9 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8ADA: Bob-omb explodes (ExplodeBomb) ;;;
{
;; Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls ExplodeBombRt (bank $02), which turns the Bob-omb into an
;;     explosion.
$01:8ADA 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:8ADB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:8ADD 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:8ADE AB           PLB                             ; } Data bank = $02
$01:8ADF 22 86 80 02  JSL.L ExplodeBombRt             ; / Run ExplodeBombRt
$01:8AE3 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:8AE4 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8AE5: Bob-omb (Bobomb) ;;;
{
;; Bob-omb main routine. [$1534,X] set: exploding. Otherwise walks like a Koopa until its fuse timer [$1540,X]
;;     is zero,
;; then becomes a stunned sprite (status 9) with a $40 frame fuse and keeps drawing itself.
$01:8AE5 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; Exploding flag [$1534,X]
$01:8AE8 D0 F0        BNE ExplodeBomb                 ; Set: explode
$01:8AEA BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Fuse timer [$1540,X]
$01:8AED D0 0D        BNE Spr0to13Start               ; Running: walk normally (Spr0to13Start)
$01:8AEF A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:8AF1 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 9 (stunned/carryable)
$01:8AF4 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:8AF6 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Fuse timer [$1540,X] = $40 frames
$01:8AF9 4C 0D 9F     JMP.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite and return

}

;;; $8AFC: Koopa/Goomba/etc: start (Spr0to13Start) ;;;
{
;; Entry for sprites 04-07, 0C, 0F, 11, 13 and the walking Bob-omb. Locked: only interact with Mario and
;;     sprites, and draw.
;; Otherwise falls into Spr0to13Main.
$01:8AFC A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
