$01:8AFE F0 0A        BEQ Spr0to13Main                ; No: run the main logic
$01:8B00 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:8B03 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Interact with other sprites
$01:8B06 20 C3 8B     JSR.W Spr0to13Gfx               ; Draw the sprite
$01:8B09 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8B0A: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement (Spr0to13Main) ;;;
{
;; Per-frame logic for the generic walkers. On the ground: sets the walking speed from direction and the
;;     property table.
;; Stops at walls and ceilings, despawns offscreen, moves and animates, then continues in SpriteOnGround /
;;     SpriteInAir.
$01:8B0A 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8B0D F0 1F        BEQ $8B2E                       ; No: skip setting speed
$01:8B0F B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Y = sprite number
$01:8B11 B9 F0 88     LDA.W Spr0to13Prop,Y            ; A = property flags
$01:8B14 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 (fast) into carry
$01:8B15 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$01:8B18 90 02        BCC $8B1C                       ; Slow: keep the index
$01:8B1A C8           INY                             ; \
$01:8B1B C8           INY                             ; / Fast: index += 2
$01:8B1C B9 EC 88     LDA.W Spr0to13SpeedX,Y          ; A = walking speed for direction/speed
$01:8B1F 5D B8 15     EOR.W $15B8,X                   ; EOR slope speed offset [$15B8,X]
$01:8B22 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = signs differ (slope pushes against walking direction)
$01:8B23 B9 EC 88     LDA.W Spr0to13SpeedX,Y          ; A = walking speed again
$01:8B26 90 04        BCC $8B2C                       ; Signs equal: use it unchanged
$01:8B28 18           CLC                             ; Opposite:
$01:8B29 7D B8 15     ADC.W $15B8,X                   ; Add slope offset
$01:8B2C 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = A
$01:8B2E BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$01:8B31 98           TYA                             ; A = direction
$01:8B32 1A           INC A                           ; A = direction + 1 (1 = right wall, 2 = left wall)
$01:8B33 3D 88 15     AND.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; AND object contact flags
$01:8B36 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Wall flags only
$01:8B38 F0 02        BEQ $8B3C                       ; Not touching a wall in the walking direction
$01:8B3A 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Touching: X speed = 0
$01:8B3C 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; Touching a ceiling?
$01:8B3F F0 02        BEQ $8B43                       ; No: go on
$01:8B41 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Ceiling: Y speed = 0
$01:8B43 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn if offscreen
$01:8B46 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Apply speed to position
$01:8B49 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance the walk animation
$01:8B4C 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8B4F F0 33        BEQ SpriteInAir                 ; No: go to SpriteInAir
}

;;; $8B51: Walking sprite on the ground (SpriteOnGround) ;;;
{
;; Sets the resting Y speed, then handles the follow-Mario and jump-over-shell property flags.
$01:8B51 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set the ground Y speed (0, or $18 on slopes)
$01:8B54 9E 1C 15     STZ.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C,X] = 0 (clear ledge-turn flag)
$01:8B57 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Y = sprite number
$01:8B59 B9 F0 88     LDA.W Spr0to13Prop,Y            ; A = property flags
$01:8B5C 48           PHA                             ; Save them
$01:8B5D 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; Bit 2 (follow Mario)
$01:8B5F F0 19        BEQ DontFollowMario             ; Not set: skip
$01:8B61 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = [$1570,X]
$01:8B64 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; Low 7 bits
$01:8B66 D0 12        BNE DontFollowMario             ; Not zero: skip (only turn once per $80 frames)
$01:8B68 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = current direction
$01:8B6B 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:8B6C 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:8B6F 68           PLA                             ; A = old direction
$01:8B70 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Changed direction?
$01:8B73 F0 05        BEQ DontFollowMario             ; No: skip
$01:8B75 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Yes: turning timer
$01:8B77 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; [$15AC,X] = 8
}

;;; $8B7A: Walking sprite: jump over shells (DontFollowMario) ;;;
{
;; Restores the property flags and, if bit 3 is set, runs JumpOverShells; then continues at $018BB0.
$01:8B7A 68           PLA                             ; Restore the property flags
$01:8B7B 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; Bit 3 (jump over shells)
$01:8B7D F0 03        BEQ $8B82                       ; Not set: skip
$01:8B7F 20 98 88     JSR.W JumpOverShells            ; Look for shells to jump over
$01:8B82 80 2C        BRA $8BB0                       ; Continue at $018BB0

}

;;; $8B84: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour (SpriteInAir) ;;;
{
;; Shared tail for sprites 0-13 (Koopas, shells, para-Koopas) that are not on the ground. Animates if the
;;     sprite has flutter wings
;; (bit 7 of Spr0to13Prop), turns around at a ledge if it stays-on-ledges (bit 1) and then handles Mario and
;;     sprite interaction.
;; Falls into Spr0to13Gfx after flipping direction when touching an object.
$01:8B84 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Y = sprite number
$01:8B86 B9 F0 88     LDA.W Spr0to13Prop,Y            ; Sprite properties for this sprite number (Spr0to13Prop)
$01:8B89 10 05        BPL $8B90                       ; Bit 7 clear (no flutter wings): skip to clearing the animation counter
$01:8B8B 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Flutter wings: advance the animation frame
$01:8B8E 80 03        BRA $8B93                       ; Skip the clear

$01:8B90 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; No wings: animation counter [$1570,X] = 0
$01:8B93 B9 F0 88     LDA.W Spr0to13Prop,Y            ; Sprite properties again
$01:8B96 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; Bit 1: stay on ledges
$01:8B98 F0 16        BEQ $8BB0                       ; Not set: skip the ledge check
$01:8B9A BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:8B9D 1D 58 15     ORA.W $1558,X                   ; |
$01:8BA0 1D 28 15     ORA.W $1528,X                   ; |
$01:8BA3 1D 34 15     ORA.W $1534,X                   ; } If any of [$151C,X], [$1558,X], [$1528,X], [$1534,X] is non-zero, skip the turn (flags not explained)
$01:8BA6 D0 08        BNE $8BB0                       ; /
$01:8BA8 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Turn around (in the air above a ledge)
$01:8BAB A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:8BAD 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = 1 (turned already)
$01:8BB0 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528,X] (state flag)
$01:8BB3 F0 05        BEQ $8BBA                       ; Zero: normal Mario interaction
$01:8BB5 20 31 89     JSR.W $8931                     ; Non-zero: alternate interaction routine ($8931)
$01:8BB8 80 03        BRA $8BBD                       ; Skip normal Mario interaction

$01:8BBA 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:8BBD 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Interact with other sprites
$01:8BC0 20 89 90     JSR.W FlipIfTouchingObj         ; Turn around if touching an object
}

;;; $8BC3: Draw Koopa-type sprite (sprites 0-13) (Spr0to13Gfx) ;;;
{
;; Graphics routine for sprites 0-13. Shows the turning image while the turn timer [$15AC,X] is set (direction
;;     is flipped
;; temporarily for the first 3 frames of the turn). Draws a 1-tile or 2-tile high sprite according to bit 6 of
;;     Spr0to13Prop and
;; adds wings for sprite numbers >= 8. Quirk: the 2-tile path subtracts $0F or $10 from Y depending on the
;;     animation frame (SBC with the
;; carry from LSR [$1602,X]).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8B06: Koopa/Goomba/etc: start (Spr0to13Start)
;;     $01:8CB7: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
$01:8BC3 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:8BC6 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite direction on the stack
$01:8BC7 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; Y = turn timer [$15AC,X]
$01:8BCA F0 12        BEQ $8BDE                       ; Timer is 0: skip the turning image
$01:8BCC A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:8BCE 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Image [$1602,X] = 2 (turning)
$01:8BD1 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: direction unchanged
$01:8BD3 C0 05        CPY.B #$05                      ; \
$01:8BD5 90 01        BCC $8BD8                       ; / Timer >= 5: A = 1 (flip direction for this draw)
$01:8BD7 1A           INC A                           ; Timer >= 5: A = 1
$01:8BD8 5D 7C 15     EOR.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:8BDB 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction ^= A (temporary, restored later)
$01:8BDE B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Y = sprite number
$01:8BE0 B9 F0 88     LDA.W Spr0to13Prop,Y            ; Sprite properties
$01:8BE3 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; Bit 6: sprite is 2 tiles high
$01:8BE5 D0 05        BNE $8BEC                       ; 2 tiles high: go draw it
$01:8BE7 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw a 1-tile sprite
$01:8BEA 80 27        BRA DoneWithSprite              ; Done

$01:8BEC BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Carry := bit 0 of the animation frame (affects the SBC below)
$01:8BEF 4A           LSR                             ; Shift animation frame bit into carry
$01:8BF0 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:8BF2 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:8BF3 E9 0F        SBC.B #$0F                      ; } Y position low -= $0F or $10 (borrow from carry), old value kept on stack
$01:8BF5 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:8BF7 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:8BFA 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:8BFB E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Y position high -= borrow, old value kept on stack
$01:8BFD 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:8C00 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw the 2-tile sprite
$01:8C03 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:8C04 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore Y position high
$01:8C07 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:8C08 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore Y position low
$01:8C0A B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Sprite number
$01:8C0C C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$01:8C0E 90 03        BCC DoneWithSprite              ; Number < 8: no wings
$01:8C10 20 28 9E     JSR.W KoopaWingGfxRt            ; Draw Koopa wings
}

;;; $8C13: Restore sprite direction and return (DoneWithSprite) ;;;
{
;; Pops the direction saved by Spr0to13Gfx back into [RAM_SpriteDir,X].
$01:8C13 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:8C14 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Restore the sprite direction
$01:8C17 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8C18: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg) ;;;
{
;; Sprite thrown by Lakitu. Falls with reduced gravity; when it lands it turns into a Spiny (sprite $13), re-
;;     initialises its tables
;; and faces Mario. Only runs while sprites are not locked and status is 8 (normal).
$01:8C18 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8C1A D0 28        BNE $8C44                       ; / Sprites locked: just draw
$01:8C1C BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:8C1F C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:8C21 D0 21        BNE $8C44                       ; } Sprite status != 8 (normal): just draw
$01:8C23 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate
$01:8C26 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Move with gravity
$01:8C29 D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Reduce the gravity just added by 1
$01:8C2B 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Touching the ground?
$01:8C2E F0 0E        BEQ $8C3E                       ; No: skip the landing code
$01:8C30 A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$01:8C32 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / Sprite = Spiny ($13)
$01:8C34 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset the sprite tables for the new sprite
$01:8C38 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:8C3B 20 D5 97     JSR.W $97D5                     ; Subroutine $97D5 (Spiny landing init, not traced)
$01:8C3E 20 89 90     JSR.W FlipIfTouchingObj         ; Turn around if touching an object
$01:8C41 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:8C44 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:8C47 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2 (egg graphics selector)
$01:8C49 20 F3 9C     JSR.W SubSprGfx0Entry0          ; Draw the egg
$01:8C4C 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8C4D: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Sprites 8 (flying, bobbing up and down with no gravity) and 9 (bouncing along the ground). Sets X speed
;;     from the direction table,
;; stops against walls, hops on landing and then draws via Spr0to13Gfx. Also the shared draw/return stub at
;;     $8CB7 used by the red para-Koopas.
$01:8C4D A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8C4F D0 66        BNE $8CB7                       ; / Sprites locked: only draw
$01:8C51 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$01:8C54 B9 EC 88     LDA.W Spr0to13SpeedX,Y          ; A = X speed for this direction
$01:8C57 5D B8 15     EOR.W $15B8,X                   ; A ^ [$15B8,X]: sign bit set if the signs differ
$01:8C5A 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = signs differ
$01:8C5B B9 EC 88     LDA.W Spr0to13SpeedX,Y          ; Reload the base X speed
$01:8C5E 90 04        BCC $8C64                       ; Same sign: use base speed
$01:8C60 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:8C61 7D B8 15     ADC.W $15B8,X                   ; / Add [$15B8,X] to the speed (probably slope adjustment)
$01:8C64 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store X speed
$01:8C66 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:8C67 1A           INC A                           ; / A = direction + 1 (bit 0 right, bit 1 left)
$01:8C68 3D 88 15     AND.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:8C6B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Touching an object on that side?
$01:8C6D F0 02        BEQ $8C71                       ; |
$01:8C6F 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Yes: X speed = 0
$01:8C71 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Sprite number
$01:8C73 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8 (flying)
$01:8C75 D0 15        BNE $8C8C                       ; Not flying (bouncing sprite 9): use gravity path
$01:8C77 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move in X with no gravity
$01:8C7A A0 FC        LDY.B #$FC                      ; Y speed = $FC (up)
$01:8C7C BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:8C7F 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Bit 5 of the animation counter chooses up or down
$01:8C81 F0 02        BEQ $8C85                       ; |
$01:8C83 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; / Bit set: Y speed = $04 (down)
$01:8C85 94 AA        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store Y speed
$01:8C87 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y with no gravity
$01:8C8A 80 05        BRA $8C91                       ; Skip the gravity path

$01:8C8C 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Move with gravity (bouncing)
$01:8C8F D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Reduce gravity by 1
$01:8C91 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:8C94 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; Touching a ceiling?
$01:8C97 F0 02        BEQ $8C9B                       ; No
$01:8C99 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$01:8C9B 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8C9E F0 0E        BEQ $8CAE                       ; No: skip the bounce
$01:8CA0 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Ground contact Y speed fix (SetSomeYSpeed??)
$01:8CA3 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0 (bounce speed)
$01:8CA5 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = [$160E,X]
$01:8CA8 D0 02        BNE $8CAC                       ; Non-zero: keep $D0
$01:8CAA A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; Zero: A = $B0 (higher bounce)
$01:8CAC 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = bounce speed
$01:8CAE 20 89 90     JSR.W FlipIfTouchingObj         ; Turn around if touching an object
$01:8CB1 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate
$01:8CB4 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:8CB7 4C C3 8B     JMP.W Spr0to13Gfx               ; Draw (also entered from the red para-Koopa routine)


}

;;; $8CBA..8CBC: Table: red para-Koopa speed step and limit ;;;
{
;; Two tables: speed increment per direction ($FF/$01) at $018CBA and the speed limit ($F0/$10) at $018CBC.
$01:8CBA              .db $FF,$01                     ; $FF,$01 - speed step: left / right

$01:8CBC              .db $F0,$10                     ; $F0,$10 - speed limit: left / right

}

;;; $8CBE: Red horizontal para-Koopa: entry (RedHorzParaKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Uses horizontal offscreen handling (SubOffscreen1) then joins RedVertParaKoopa.
$01:8CBE 20 2B AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen1Bnk1         ; Horizontal offscreen handling
$01:8CC1 80 03        BRA $8CC6                       ; Join the common code

}

;;; $8CC3: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $0A moves vertically only, the other (horizontal) moves sideways while bobbing up and down. Every 4
;;     frames the speed is changed by
;; +/-1 until it reaches $F0 or $10, then the sprite pauses for $30 frames and reverses. Starts the turning
;;     timer when the direction changes.
$01:8CC3 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Vertical offscreen handling
$01:8CC6 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8CC8 D0 60        BNE $8D2A                       ; / Sprites locked: only draw
$01:8CCA BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:8CCD 48           PHA                             ; / Save the current direction
$01:8CCE 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Face the direction of the speed (UpdateDirection)
$01:8CD1 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:8CD2 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction changed?
$01:8CD5 F0 05        BEQ $8CDC                       ; No: skip
$01:8CD7 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:8CD9 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Turn timer [$15AC,X] = 8
$01:8CDC 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate
$01:8CDF B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:8CE1 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; / Sprite $0A (vertical)?
$01:8CE3 D0 05        BNE $8CEA                       ; No: horizontal path
$01:8CE5 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Vertical: move in Y only
$01:8CE8 80 13        BRA $8CFD                       ; Go to the speed ramp

$01:8CEA A0 FC        LDY.B #$FC                      ; Y speed = $FC (up)
$01:8CEC BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:8CEF 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Bit 5 of the animation counter chooses up or down
$01:8CF1 F0 02        BEQ $8CF5                       ; |
$01:8CF3 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; / Bit set: Y speed = $04
$01:8CF5 94 AA        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store the bob speed
$01:8CF7 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y
$01:8CFA 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move in X
$01:8CFD BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Pause timer [$1540,X]
$01:8D00 D0 25        BNE $8D27                       ; Running: skip the speed change
$01:8D02 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Count a frame in [RAM_SpriteState,X]
$01:8D04 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:8D06 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Only every 4th frame
$01:8D08 D0 1D        BNE $8D27                       ; /
$01:8D0A BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:8D0D 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = ramp direction bit [$151C,X] & 1
$01:8D0F A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:8D10 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:8D12 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8D13 79 BA 8C     ADC.W $8CBA,Y                   ; } Speed += step for this direction ...
$01:8D16 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; |
$01:8D18 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / ... stored as both X and Y speed
$01:8D1A D9 BC 8C     CMP.W $8CBC,Y                   ; Reached the limit for this direction?
$01:8D1D D0 08        BNE $8D27                       ; No: keep ramping
$01:8D1F FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Reverse the ramp direction
$01:8D22 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:8D24 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Pause timer [$1540,X] = $30
$01:8D27 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:8D2A 20 B7 8C     JSR.W $8CB7                     ; Draw
$01:8D2D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8D2E: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba) ;;;
{
;; Walks in the facing direction at speed 8 and hops: three small hops (Y speed $F0) then one big hop (Y speed
;;     $D0) followed by a random
;; wait of $50-$8F frames. Wings flap faster while rising; they stop flapping while it waits on the ground.
;;     Counter [$151C,X] counts the small hops.
$01:8D2E 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:8D31 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$01:8D33 F0 04        BEQ $8D39                       ; No: run normally
$01:8D35 20 AC 8D     JSR.W $8DAC                     ; Locked: just draw
$01:8D38 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8D39 20 BB 8D     JSR.W $8DBB                     ; Set X speed from the direction (+/-8)
$01:8D3C 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Move with gravity
$01:8D3F D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Reduce gravity by 1
$01:8D41 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:8D43 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8D44 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8D45 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8D46 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Image [$1602,X] = bit 3 of [RAM_SpriteState,X] (body animation)
$01:8D48 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$01:8D4B 20 AC 8D     JSR.W $8DAC                     ; Draw wings and body
$01:8D4E F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Count a frame in [RAM_SpriteState,X]
$01:8D50 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Hop counter [$151C,X]
$01:8D53 D0 0A        BNE $8D5F                       ; Non-zero: only 1 wing step
$01:8D55 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:8D57 10 06        BPL $8D5F                       ; / Moving up?
$01:8D59 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:8D5C FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; / Wing counter += 2 extra (flap faster while rising)
$01:8D5F FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Wing counter [$1570,X]++
$01:8D62 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; Touching a ceiling?
$01:8D65 F0 02        BEQ $8D69                       ; No
$01:8D67 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$01:8D69 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8D6C F0 37        BEQ $8DA5                       ; No: skip
$01:8D6E B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:8D70 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; / Every 64 frames...
$01:8D72 D0 03        BNE $8D77                       ; ...not due yet: skip
$01:8D74 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; ...face Mario
$01:8D77 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Ground contact Y speed fix (SetSomeYSpeed??)
$01:8D7A BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Hop counter zero?
$01:8D7D D0 03        BNE $8D82                       ; No
$01:8D7F 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Waiting: stop the wings (counter = 0)
$01:8D82 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Wait timer [$1540,X]
$01:8D85 D0 1E        BNE $8DA5                       ; Still waiting: no hop
$01:8D87 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Hop counter++
$01:8D8A A0 F0        LDY.B #$F0                      ; Y = $F0: small hop speed
$01:8D8C BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:8D8F C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; } Fourth hop?
$01:8D91 D0 10        BNE $8DA3                       ; No: do a small hop
$01:8D93 9E 1C 15     STZ.W $151C,X                   ; Reset hop counter
$01:8D96 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$01:8D9A 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; |
$01:8D9C 09 50        ORA.B #$50                      ; } Wait timer [$1540,X] = $50 | (random & $3F)
$01:8D9E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; /
$01:8DA1 A0 D0        LDY.B #$D0                      ; Y = $D0: big hop speed
$01:8DA3 94 AA        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = hop speed
$01:8DA5 20 89 90     JSR.W FlipIfTouchingObj         ; Turn around if touching an object
$01:8DA8 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:8DAB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8DAC 20 E9 8D     JSR.W GoombaWingGfxRt           ; Draw the wings
$01:8DAF BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:8DB2 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8DB3 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:8DB5 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; } Skip the 4 OAM bytes between the wings (body goes there)... OAM index += 4
$01:8DB8 4C 0D 9F     JMP.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; / Draw the body

$01:8DBB A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; A = $F8 (-8)
$01:8DBD BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$01:8DC0 D0 02        BNE $8DC4                       ; Facing left: keep -8
$01:8DC2 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Facing right: A = +8
$01:8DC4 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = +/-8
$01:8DC6 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8DC7..8DCF: Table: winged Goomba wing X offsets ;;;
{
;; 16 X offsets: 2 wings per frame, 4 frames, for the left-facing case; the second 8 for right-facing.
$01:8DC7              .db $F7,$0B,$F6,$0D,$FD,$0C,$FC,$0D ; Wing X offsets, left-facing (frames 0-3, 2 each) ...
$01:8DCF              .db $0B,$F5,$0A,$F3,$0B,$FC,$0C,$FB ; ... then right-facing
}

;;; $8DD7..8DD7: Table: winged Goomba wing Y offsets ;;;
{
;; 8 Y offsets: 2 wings per frame for 4 frames.
$01:8DD7              .db $F7,$F7,$F8,$F8,$01,$01,$02,$02 ; Wing Y offsets (frames 0-3, 2 each)
}

;;; $8DDF: Table: Goomba wing OAM properties (GoombaWingGfxProp) ;;;
{
$01:8DDF              .db $46,$06                     ; OAM properties of the wings: $46, $06

}

;;; $8DE1: Table: Goomba wing tile numbers (GoombaWingTiles) ;;;
{
$01:8DE1              .db $C6,$C6,$5D,$5D             ; Wing tiles per frame: $C6,$C6,$5D,$5D

}

;;; $8DE5: Table: Goomba wing tile sizes (GoombaWingTileSize) ;;;
{
$01:8DE5              .db $02,$02,$00,$00             ; Wing tile sizes per frame: 16x16,16x16,8x8,8x8

}

;;; $8DE9: Draw Goomba wings (GoombaWingGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws the two wing tiles (spaced 8 OAM slots apart so the body fits between) for the animation frame in
;;     [$1570,X]/[$1602,X].
;; Frames 0-1 use 16x16 tile $C6, frames 2-3 use 8x8 tile $5D. The right wing is X-flipped. Priority bits come
;;     from [$64].
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8DAC: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
$01:8DE9 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get the sprite's on-screen position ($00/$01)
$01:8DEC BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:8DEF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8DF0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8DF1 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } A = ([$1570,X] >> 2) & 2
$01:8DF3 18           CLC                             ; /
$01:8DF4 7D 02 16     ADC.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:8DF7 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = wing frame = A + [$1602,X]
$01:8DF9 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:8DFA 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = frame * 2
$01:8DFC BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:8DFF 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = sprite direction
$01:8E01 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:8E04 DA           PHX                             ; Save X (sprite index)
$01:8E05 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; \
$01:8E07 86 03        STX $03                         ; / X = 1 (wing number), [$03] = wing number; loop start
$01:8E09 8A           TXA                             ; A = wing number
$01:8E0A 18           CLC 
$01:8E0B 65 02        ADC $02                         ; A += [$02] (frame * 2)
$01:8E0D 48           PHA                             ; Keep the wing/frame index on the stack
$01:8E0E A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = direction
$01:8E10 D0 03        BNE $8E15                       ; Facing left: skip
$01:8E12 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:8E13 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / Facing right: index += 8 (second half of the X table)
$01:8E15 AA           TAX                             ; X = index into X offset table
$01:8E16 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:8E18 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8E19 7D C7 8D     ADC.W $8DC7,X                   ; } OAM X = sprite screen X + wing X offset
$01:8E1C 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:8E1F FA           PLX                             ; X = wing/frame index (from the stack)
$01:8E20 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:8E22 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8E23 7D D7 8D     ADC.W $8DD7,X                   ; } OAM Y = sprite screen Y + wing Y offset
$01:8E26 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:8E29 A6 05        LDX $05                         ; X = wing frame [$05]
$01:8E2B BD E1 8D     LDA.W GoombaWingTiles,X         ; \
$01:8E2E 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = wing tile for this frame
$01:8E31 5A           PHY                             ; Save the OAM index
$01:8E32 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:8E33 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8E34 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8E35 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4 (index into the size table)
$01:8E36 BD E5 8D     LDA.W GoombaWingTileSize,X      ; \
$01:8E39 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / OAM size bit = size for this frame
$01:8E3C 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the OAM index
$01:8E3D A6 03        LDX $03                         ; X = wing number
$01:8E3F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$01:8E41 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = direction
$01:8E42 BD DF 8D     LDA.W GoombaWingGfxProp,X       ; A = wing property
$01:8E45 B0 02        BCS $8E49                       ; Facing left: keep
$01:8E47 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; Facing right: X-flip
$01:8E49 05 64        ORA $64                         ; \
$01:8E4B 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM property = wing property | priority [$64]
$01:8E4E 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:8E4F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8E50 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:8E52 A8           TAY                             ; } OAM index += 8 (next wing slot)
$01:8E53 CA           DEX                             ; \
$01:8E54 10 B1        BPL $8E07                       ; / Next wing (X = 1, then 0)
$01:8E56 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the sprite index
$01:8E57 A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Y = $FF: tile sizes already set
$01:8E59 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: number of tiles - 1 spanned (wings are 8 slots apart)
$01:8E5B 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish the OAM write
$01:8E5E 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8E5F: Advance two-frame animation (SetAnimationFrame) ;;;
{
;; Increments the animation counter [$1570,X] and sets [$1602,X] = bit 3 of it, so the image toggles every 8
;;     frames.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8913: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:8B49: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement (Spr0to13Main)
;;     $01:8B8B: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour (SpriteInAir)
;;     $01:8C23: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8CB1: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8CDC: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8EA1: Piranha plant main routine (ClassicPiranhas)
;;     $01:8F14: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:A178: Draw stunned Cheep Cheep (StunFish)
;;     $01:B041: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B199: Generated Cheep Cheep main (GeneratedFish)
;;     $01:B206: Surface jumping Cheep Cheep main (JumpingFish)
;;     ... and 11 more
$01:8E5F FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Animation counter [$1570,X]++
$01:8E62 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:8E65 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8E66 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8E67 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:8E68 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Image [$1602,X] = bit 3 of the counter (toggles every 8 frames)
$01:8E6A 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$01:8E6D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $8E6E: Table: Piranha plant Y speeds per state (PiranhaSpeed) ;;;
{
$01:8E6E              .db $00,$F0,$00,$10             ; Y speed per state: hidden $00, rising $F0, up $00, retracting $10

}

;;; $8E72: Table: Piranha plant time per state (PiranTimeInState) ;;;
{
$01:8E72              .db $20,$30,$20,$30             ; Time per state: $20, $30, $20, $30 frames

}

;;; $8E76: Piranha plant main routine (ClassicPiranhas) ;;;
{
;; Handles the normal and upside-down (sprite $2A) pipe Piranha plants. Draws the plant (behind objects unless
;;     eaten by Yoshi) and
;; recolours the stem tile. State [$C2,X] & 3: 0 hidden, 1 rising, 2 up, 3 retracting. Moves with PiranhaSpeed
;;     while the timer [$1540,X]
;; runs, else goes to ChangePiranhaState. [$1594,X] set = Mario nearby: plant stays hidden and is not drawn or
;;     interacted with.
$01:8E76 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; Mario nearby flag [$1594,X]
$01:8E79 D0 1F        BNE $8E9A                       ; Set: skip drawing
$01:8E7B A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:8E7D 48           PHA                             ; / Save priority [$64]
$01:8E7E BD D0 15     LDA.W $15D0,X                   ; Eaten flag [$15D0,X]
$01:8E81 D0 04        BNE $8E87                       ; Set: keep priority
$01:8E83 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:8E85 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Priority [$64] = $10 (draw behind objects)
$01:8E87 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw the plant
$01:8E8A BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:8E8D B9 0B 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; \
$01:8E90 29 F1        AND.B #$F1                      ; |
$01:8E92 09 0B        ORA.B #$0B                      ; } Fourth tile (stem): palette 5, second graphics page
$01:8E94 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; /
$01:8E97 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:8E98 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore priority [$64]
$01:8E9A 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:8E9D A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8E9F D0 26        BNE $8EC7                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:8EA1 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate
$01:8EA4 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; Mario nearby flag
$01:8EA7 D0 03        BNE $8EAC                       ; Set: no interaction
$01:8EA9 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:8EAC B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:8EAE 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:8EB0 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = state & 3
$01:8EB1 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; State timer [$1540,X]
$01:8EB4 F0 12        BEQ ChangePiranhaState          ; Zero: change state
$01:8EB6 B9 6E 8E     LDA.W PiranhaSpeed,Y            ; A = Y speed for this state
$01:8EB9 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:8EBB C0 2A        CPY.B #$2A                      ; / Sprite $2A (upside-down plant)?
$01:8EBD D0 03        BNE $8EC2                       ; No
$01:8EBF 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:8EC1 1A           INC A                           ; / Yes: negate the speed
$01:8EC2 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store Y speed
$01:8EC4 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y
$01:8EC7 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8EC8: Piranha plant: next state (ChangePiranhaState) ;;;
{
;; State 0: stay hidden while Mario is within $1B pixels horizontally of the plant (sets [$1594,X] = 1).
;;     Otherwise clears that flag,
;; loads the state timer from PiranTimeInState and advances to the next state.
$01:8EC8 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:8ECA 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:8ECC 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = state & 3
$01:8ECE D0 11        BNE $8EE1                       ; Not state 0: advance
$01:8ED0 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal distance to Mario in [$0F]
$01:8ED3 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:8ED5 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8ED6 69 1B        ADC.B #$1B                      ; |
$01:8ED8 C9 37        CMP.B #$37                      ; } Carry = |distance| >= $1B (Mario not close)
$01:8EDA A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; [$1594,X] = 1 (assume Mario near)
$01:8EDC 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; /
$01:8EDF 90 0D        BCC $8EEE                       ; Mario close: stay hidden, return
$01:8EE1 9E 94 15     STZ.W $1594,X                   ; Clear the Mario nearby flag
$01:8EE4 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = state
$01:8EE6 B9 72 8E     LDA.W PiranTimeInState,Y        ; \
$01:8EE9 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540,X] = time for this state
$01:8EEC F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Next state
$01:8EEE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8EEF A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Y = 7: search the extended sprite slots
$01:8EF1 B9 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; Slot's extended sprite number
$01:8EF4 F0 11        BEQ $8F07                       ; Free: done
$01:8EF6 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:8EF7 10 F8        BPL $8EF1                       ; / Next slot
$01:8EF9 CE FC 18     DEC.W $18FC                     ; \
$01:8EFC 10 05        BPL $8F03                       ; / No free slot: decrement the round-robin index [$18FC]
$01:8EFE A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:8F00 8D FC 18     STA.W $18FC                     ; / Wrap to 7
$01:8F03 AC FC 18     LDY.W $18FC                     ; Y = round-robin slot (it will be overwritten)
$01:8F06 60           RTS                             ; Return Y = slot

$01:8F07 BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Sprite off-screen horizontally flag
$01:8F0A D0 FA        BNE $8F06                       ; Off-screen: return
$01:8F0C 60           RTS                             ; Return Y = free slot

}

;;; $8F0D: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame) ;;;
{
;; Sprite that hops on the ground and spits a flame. Contains the helper at $018EEF (find a free extended
;;     sprite slot, Y = slot) and
;; the jump/spawn helper at $018F50. After landing a random timer of $20-$3F runs; when it reaches 1 the flame
;;     jumps (Y speed $D0-$DF)
;; and creates extended sprite 3 (hopping flame's flame) if on screen.
$01:8F0D A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8F0F D0 38        BNE $8F49                       ; / Sprites locked: only draw
$01:8F11 FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; Image [$1602,X]++
$01:8F14 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate
$01:8F17 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Move with gravity
$01:8F1A D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Reduce gravity by 1
$01:8F1C 20 BB 8D     JSR.W $8DBB                     ; X speed = +/-8 by direction
$01:8F1F 16 B6        ASL RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed *= 2 (+/-16)
$01:8F21 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:8F24 F0 1D        BEQ $8F43                       ; No: skip
$01:8F26 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:8F28 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Ground contact Y speed fix
$01:8F2B BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X]
$01:8F2E F0 08        BEQ $8F38                       ; Zero: start a new wait
$01:8F30 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer - 1
$01:8F31 D0 10        BNE $8F43                       ; Not 1: keep waiting
$01:8F33 20 50 8F     JSR.W $8F50                     ; Timer = 1: jump and spit a flame
$01:8F36 80 0B        BRA $8F43                       ; Continue

$01:8F38 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$01:8F3C 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$01:8F3E 09 20        ORA.B #$20                      ; |
$01:8F40 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; } Timer [$1540,X] = $20 | (random & $1F)
$01:8F43 20 89 90     JSR.W FlipIfTouchingObj         ; Turn around if touching an object
$01:8F46 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:8F49 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:8F4C 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw
$01:8F4F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:8F50 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$01:8F54 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:8F56 09 D0        ORA.B #$D0                      ; |
$01:8F58 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed = $D0 | (random & $0F): jump
$01:8F5A AD 8D 14     LDA.W RAM_RandomByte1           ; \
$01:8F5D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:8F5F D0 03        BNE $8F64                       ; } 1 in 4 chance: face Mario
$01:8F61 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; /
$01:8F64 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Is the sprite off-screen?
$01:8F67 D0 2D        BNE $8F96                       ; Yes: no flame
$01:8F69 20 EF 8E     JSR.W $8EEF                     ; Find a free extended sprite slot (Y)
$01:8F6C B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:8F6E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8F6F 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:8F71 99 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; } Extended sprite X low = sprite X + 4
$01:8F74 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:8F77 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:8F79 99 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y         ; } Extended sprite X high (carry)
$01:8F7C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:8F7E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:8F7F 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:8F81 99 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; } Extended sprite Y low = sprite Y + 8
$01:8F84 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:8F87 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:8F89 99 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y         ; } Extended sprite Y high (carry)
$01:8F8C A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:8F8E 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / Extended sprite = hopping flame's flame (3)
$01:8F91 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:8F93 99 6F 17     STA.W $176F,Y                   ; / Extended sprite timer [$176F,Y] = $FF
$01:8F96 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $8F97: Lakitu graphics and interaction (Lakitu) ;;;
{
;; Draws Lakitu (image 2 while the throw timer [$1558,X] runs, with the second tile raised by 3 pixels). If
;;     [$151C,X] is set calls the
;; bank 2 routine $E672 (probably the cloud/Lakitu follow routine). Falls into SubSprSpr+MarioSpr.
$01:8F97 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: normal image
$01:8F99 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; Throw timer [$1558,X]
$01:8F9C F0 02        BEQ $8FA0                       ; Zero: image 0
$01:8F9E A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: throwing image
$01:8FA0 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:8FA1 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Image [$1602,X] = Y
$01:8FA4 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw Lakitu
$01:8FA7 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; Throw timer
$01:8FAA F0 0C        BEQ $8FB8                       ; Zero: skip
$01:8FAC BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:8FAF B9 05 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; \
$01:8FB2 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:8FB3 E9 03        SBC.B #$03                      ; |
$01:8FB5 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; } Tile 2 Y -= 3 (raise the second tile while throwing)
$01:8FB8 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C,X]
$01:8FBB F0 04        BEQ SubSprSpr+MarioSpr          ; Zero: just interact
$01:8FBD 22 72 E6 02  JSL.L $E672                     ; Non-zero: call $E672 (probably the cloud routine)
}

;;; $8FC1: Interact with sprites and Mario (SubSprSpr+MarioSpr) ;;;
{
;; Calls SubSprSprInteract then jumps to MarioSprInteractRt.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:803D: Sprite and Mario contact check (SprSpr+MarioSprRts)
;;     $01:8C41: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8C91: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8D27: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8DA8: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8EA9: Piranha plant main routine (ClassicPiranhas)
;;     $01:9011: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move (timerCODE_019001)
;;     $01:95F2: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
;;     $01:998C: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
;;     $01:B209: Surface jumping Cheep Cheep main (JumpingFish)
;;     $01:BCBD: Spawn sprite from the magic (StoreSpriteNum)
;;     $01:BE71: Magikoopa visible state, fade, goal tape init
;;     ... and 2 more
$01:8FC1 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Interact with other sprites
$01:8FC4 4C E4 A7     JMP.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario and return


}

;;; $8FC7: Tables: Bullet Bill properties per direction (BulletGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by direction [$C2,X] 0-7: 0 right, 1 left, 2 up, 3 down, 4 up-right, 5 down-right, 6 down-left, 7
;;     up-left.
;; BulletGfxProp = OAM property (palette/flip), $8FCF = animation frame.
$01:8FC7              .db $42,$02,$03,$83,$03,$43,$03,$43 ; OAM properties per direction (palette/flip)
$01:8FCF              .db $00,$00,$01,$01,$02,$03,$03,$02 ; Animation frame per direction
}

;;; $8FD7: Table: Bullet Bill X speeds (BulletSpeedX) ;;;
{
$01:8FD7              .db $20,$E0,$00,$00,$18,$18,$E8,$E8 ; X speed per direction
}

;;; $8FDF: Table: Bullet Bill Y speeds (BulletSpeedY) ;;;
{
$01:8FDF              .db $00,$00,$E0,$20,$E8,$18,$18,$E8 ; Y speed per direction

}

;;; $8FE7: Bullet Bill main routine (BulletBill) ;;;
{
;; Sets direction = 1, then (unless sprites are locked) sets palette, frame and X/Y speed from the direction
;;     in [$C2,X], moves with no gravity,
;; interacts with blocks and with Mario/sprites. Kills the sprite when it leaves the screen vertically. While
;;     [$1540,X] is set it uses the
;; graphics routine at $9546 (purpose not traced, probably a death/explosion state).
$01:8FE7 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:8FE9 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction = 1 (always)
$01:8FEC A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:8FEE D0 24        BNE $9014                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$01:8FF0 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = flight direction [$C2,X] (0-7)
$01:8FF2 B9 C7 8F     LDA.W BulletGfxProp,Y           ; \
$01:8FF5 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Palette/flip = BulletGfxProp[direction]
$01:8FF8 B9 CF 8F     LDA.W $8FCF,Y                   ; \
$01:8FFB 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Image [$1602,X] = $8FCF[direction]
$01:8FFE B9 D7 8F     LDA.W BulletSpeedX,Y            ; A = X speed for this direction

}

;;; $9001: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move (timerCODE_019001) ;;;
{
;; Middle of BulletBill (label created by a stray comment): stores X and Y speed, moves, interacts, offscreen-
;;     kills, draws.
$01:9001 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store X speed
$01:9003 B9 DF 8F     LDA.W BulletSpeedY,Y            ; \
$01:9006 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = BulletSpeedY[direction]
$01:9008 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move in X
$01:900B 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y
$01:900E 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks ($9140)
$01:9011 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:9014 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:9017 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:9019 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:901A E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:901C C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; } Compare Y - screen Y with $F0
$01:901E 90 03        BCC $9023                       ; On screen: keep
$01:9020 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Off screen: sprite status = 0 (free)
$01:9023 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X]
$01:9026 F0 03        BEQ $902B                       ; Zero: normal draw
$01:9028 4C 46 95     JMP.W $9546                     ; Timer set: other graphics routine ($9546)

$01:902B 4C 0D 9F     JMP.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw


}

;;; $902E..9030: Table: terminal Y speed per medium ;;;
{
;; $40 in air, $10 in water.
$01:902E              .db $40,$10                     ; Terminal Y speed: $40 (air), $10 (water)

$01:9030              .db $03,$01                     ; Gravity: 3 (air), 1 (water)

}

;;; $9032: Update sprite position with gravity (SubUpdateSprPos) ;;;
{
;; Moves the sprite in Y, applies gravity to Y speed, then moves it in X and does block interaction
;;     ($9140).
;; Medium is chosen by the water flag [$164A,X]: air gravity +3, terminal speed $40; water gravity +1,
;;     terminal speed $10, upward speed limited
;; to $E8 and X speed scaled to 3/4 for the move. If [$15DC,X] is set the sprite ignores objects (object
;;     status cleared).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:802D: Update sprite position with gravity (UpdateSpritePos)
;;     $01:815D: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C) (HandleGoalPowerup)
;;     $01:8922: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:8B46: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement (Spr0to13Main)
;;     $01:8C26: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8C8C: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8D3C: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8F17: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:9574: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
;;     $01:98B0: Disco shell: kicked behaviour
;;     $01:994D: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
;;     $01:9ADA: Sprite status: killed (HandleSprKilled)
;;     ... and 11 more
$01:9032 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y
$01:9035 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: air
$01:9037 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; Water flag [$164A,X]
$01:903A F0 0D        BEQ $9049                       ; Air: skip
$01:903C C8           INY                             ; Y = 1: water
$01:903D B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed
$01:903F 10 08        BPL $9049                       ; Moving down or still: skip
$01:9041 C9 E8        CMP.B #$E8                      ; \
$01:9043 B0 04        BCS $9049                       ; / Upward speed slower than $E8?
$01:9045 A9 E8        LDA.B #$E8                      ; \
$01:9047 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / No: limit upward speed to $E8
$01:9049 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:904B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:904C 79 30 90     ADC.W $9030,Y                   ; |
$01:904F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed += gravity (3 air, 1 water)
$01:9051 30 0A        BMI $905D                       ; Moving up: done
$01:9053 D9 2E 90     CMP.W $902E,Y                   ; \
$01:9056 90 05        BCC $905D                       ; / Below the terminal speed?
$01:9058 B9 2E 90     LDA.W $902E,Y                   ; \
$01:905B 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Otherwise Y speed = terminal speed
$01:905D B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:905F 48           PHA                             ; / Save X speed
$01:9060 BC 4A 16     LDY.W $164A,X                   ; Y = water flag
$01:9063 F0 11        BEQ $9076                       ; Air: move normally
$01:9065 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:9066 76 B6        ROR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Water: X speed halved (arithmetic shift)
$01:9068 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:906A 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:906B 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:906D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:906E 66 00        ROR $00                         ; } $00 = speed / 2 again
$01:9070 68           PLA                             ; |
$01:9071 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9072 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:9074 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = speed/2 + speed/4 (3/4 of the original)
$01:9076 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move in X
$01:9079 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:907A 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Restore the original X speed
$01:907C BD DC 15     LDA.W $15DC,X                   ; \
$01:907F D0 04        BNE $9085                       ; / [$15DC,X] set? (ignore objects)
$01:9081 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks
$01:9084 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9085 9E 88 15     STZ.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; Ignore objects: clear the object status
$01:9088 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9089: Turn around if touching object (FlipIfTouchingObj) ;;;
{
;; Flips the sprite if it is touching an object in the direction it is facing (bit 0 for right, bit 1 for left
;;     in [RAM_SprObjStatus,X]).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8BC0: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour (SpriteInAir)
;;     $01:8C3E: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8CAE: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8DA5: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8F43: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:E5BC: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
$01:9089 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:908C 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:908D 3D 88 15     AND.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; |
$01:9090 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Touching an object in the facing direction?
$01:9092 F0 03        BEQ $9097                       ; No: return
$01:9094 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Yes: flip direction
$01:9097 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9098: Flip sprite direction (FlipSpriteDir) ;;;
{
;; Unless the turn timer [$15AC,X] is running: sets it to 8, negates the X speed and toggles
;;     [RAM_SpriteDir,X].
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8BA8: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour (SpriteInAir)
;;     $01:9094: Turn around if touching object (FlipIfTouchingObj)
;;     $01:937D: Sprite vertical check and map16 lookup
;;     $01:A5CE: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop (SubSprSprInteract)
;;     $01:A630: Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce
;;     $01:B051: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B99A: Net Koopa main (ClimbingKoopa)
;;     $01:BA0C: Net Koopa main (ClimbingKoopa)
;;     $01:C48A: Power-up behaviour, contact and spark effect (DrawBerryGfx)
;;     $01:DB92: Sprite B4: Grinder (not line-guided) (Grinder)
;;     $01:E418: Monty Mole states 2 and 3
;;     $01:E572: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
;;     ... and 1 more
$01:9098 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:909B D0 14        BNE $90B1                       ; / Turn timer set: return
$01:909D A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:909F 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Turn timer [$15AC,X] = 8
$01:90A2 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:90A4 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:90A6 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:90A7 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed = -X speed
$01:90A9 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:90AC 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:90AE 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } Toggle the direction
$01:90B1 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $90B2: Long-call generic sprite graphics (GenericSprGfxRt2) ;;;
{
;; Sets the data bank to the program bank ($01) and runs SubSprGfx2Entry1; returns long (RTL).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:FBDB: Level-end coin sprite and helpers (LvlEndSprCoinsRt)
;;     $02:B681: Pokey main routine entry (PokeyMainRt)
;;     $02:BD1D: Wall-follower sprites main and Spike Top graphics (WallFollowersMain)
;;     $02:BE54: Fuzzball/Sparky and Hothead graphics
;;     $02:BFCD: Rip Van Fish main routine (RipVanFishMain)
;;     $02:D8C4: Bubble sprite: logic and contents release (BubbleSprGfxProp4)
;;     $02:E0E4: Jumping Piranha Plant main (JumpingPiranhaMain)
;;     $02:E245: Directional Coins main (DirectionCoinsMain)
;;     $02:E41F: Exploding Block main (ExplodingBlkMain)
;;     $02:E727: Jumping fish sprite main (SwimJumpFishMain)
;;     $02:E7C9: Digging Chuck's rock main (ChucksRockMain)
;;     $02:EDF6: Floating skull raft main (FloatingSkullMain)
;;     ... and 16 more
$01:90B2 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:90B3 4B           PHK                             ; |
$01:90B4 AB           PLB                             ; } Data bank = program bank
$01:90B5 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw
$01:90B8 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$01:90B9 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $90BA: Table: sprite-object clipping X offsets (SpriteObjClippingX) ;;;
{
;; Probably 4 bytes per clipping index: X offsets of the sprite's right side, left side and the centre points
;;     used for floor/ceiling
;; checks (exact roles not traced). Each row below is two indices.
$01:90BA              .db $0E,$02,$08,$08,$0E,$02,$07,$07 ; Clipping entries 0,1
$01:90C2              .db $07,$07,$07,$07,$0E,$02,$08,$08 ; Clipping entries 2,3
$01:90CA              .db $10,$00,$08,$08,$0D,$02,$08,$08 ; Clipping entries 4,5
$01:90D2              .db $07,$00,$04,$04,$1F,$01,$10,$10 ; Clipping entries 6,7
$01:90DA              .db $0F,$00,$08,$08,$10,$00,$08,$08 ; Clipping entries 8,9
$01:90E2              .db $0D,$02,$08,$08,$0E,$02,$08,$08 ; Clipping entries 10,11
$01:90EA              .db $0D,$02,$08,$08,$10,$00,$08,$08 ; Clipping entries 12,13
$01:90F2              .db $1F,$00,$10,$10,$08         ; Clipping entry 14 and the first byte of entry 15 (data continues)

}

;;; $90F7: Sprite-block interaction and Y clip table (SpriteObjClippingY) ;;;
{
;; Y offsets of each sprite's four clipping points (right, left, down, up), 4 entries per clipping set (low
;;     nibble of [$1656]).
;; $019138: long-callable wrapper. Clears the sprite's blocked status, slope and liquid flags, then checks
;;     layer 1 and (if
;; [$5B] bit 7) layer 2: liquid and water/lava splash, the layer 2 carry, pushing the sprite out of walls,
;;     then calls the
;; vertical ($0192C9) and horizontal ($019288) block checks. Layer in use is kept in [$185E] (0 = layer 1, 1 =
;;     layer 2).
;; Quirk: $9283 is also the Y = 0 entry of the wall push-out tables below.
$01:90F7              .db $08,$08,$10,$02,$12,$12,$20,$02 ; Y offsets, clipping sets 0-1: per set right, left, down, up
$01:90FF              .db $07,$07,$07,$07,$10,$10,$20,$0B ; Y offsets, clipping sets 2-3: per set right, left, down, up
$01:9107              .db $12,$12,$20,$02,$18,$18,$20,$10 ; Y offsets, clipping sets 4-5: per set right, left, down, up
$01:910F              .db $04,$04,$08,$00,$10,$10,$1F,$01 ; Y offsets, clipping sets 6-7: per set right, left, down, up
$01:9117              .db $08,$08,$0F,$00,$08,$08,$10,$00 ; Y offsets, clipping sets 8-9: per set right, left, down, up
$01:911F              .db $48,$48,$50,$42,$04,$04,$08,$00 ; Y offsets, clipping sets A-B: per set right, left, down, up
$01:9127              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$08,$08,$10,$00 ; Y offsets, clipping sets C-D: per set right, left, down, up
$01:912F              .db $08,$08,$10,$00,$04         ; Y offsets, set E, then first byte of set F ($3C = liquid test point)

$01:9134              .db $01,$02,$04,$08             ; Blocked-status bit per clipping point 0-3 (right, left, down, up), indexed by [$0F]

$01:9138 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$01:9139 4B           PHK                             ; \
$01:913A AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($01)
$01:913B 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Run the sprite-block interaction
$01:913E AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:913F 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$01:9140 9C 94 16     STZ.W $1694                     ; [$1694] = 0: no surface offset
$01:9143 9E 88 15     STZ.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; Clear sprite-object status (blocked bits)
$01:9146 9E B8 15     STZ.W $15B8,X                   ; Clear slope steepness [$15B8]
$01:9149 9C 5E 18     STZ.W $185E                     ; [$185E] = 0: layer 1 is checked first
$01:914C BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:914F 8D 95 16     STA.W $1695                     ; } [$1695] = last frame's liquid flags [$164A]; [$164A] = 0
$01:9152 9E 4A 16     STZ.W $164A,X                   ; /
$01:9155 20 11 92     JSR.W $9211                     ; Find liquid (water/lava) at the sprite's layer 1 position
$01:9158 A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$01:915A 10 62        BPL $91BE                       ; / Bit 7 of [$5B] (layer 2 interaction) clear: skip layer 2
$01:915C EE 5E 18     INC.W $185E                     ; [$185E] = 1: now layer 2
$01:915F B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:9161 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9162 65 26        ADC $26                         ; |
$01:9164 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:9166 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:9169 65 27        ADC $27                         ; } Sprite X += [$26]/[$27] (layer 2 offset)
$01:916B 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:916E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:9170 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9171 65 28        ADC $28                         ; |
$01:9173 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:9175 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:9178 65 29        ADC $29                         ; } Sprite Y += [$28]/[$29] (layer 2 offset)
$01:917A 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:917D 20 11 92     JSR.W $9211                     ; Find liquid again at the layer 2 position
$01:9180 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:9182 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:9183 E5 26        SBC $26                         ; |
$01:9185 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:9187 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:918A E5 27        SBC $27                         ; } Sprite X -= [$26]/[$27] (restore)
$01:918C 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:918F B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:9191 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:9192 E5 28        SBC $28                         ; |
$01:9194 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:9196 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:9199 E5 29        SBC $29                         ; } Sprite Y -= [$28]/[$29] (restore)
$01:919B 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:919E BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:91A1 10 1B        BPL $91BE                       ; / Status bit 7 (on layer 2 from above) clear: skip
$01:91A3 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$01:91A5 D0 17        BNE $91BE                       ; / Touching left or right: skip
$01:91A7 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (high byte of the shift)
$01:91A9 AD BF 17     LDA.W $17BF                     ; \
$01:91AC 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:91AE 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:91AF 10 01        BPL $91B2                       ; } A = -[$17BF] (layer 2 X shift this frame); Y = $FF if negative
$01:91B1 88           DEY                             ; /
$01:91B2 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:91B3 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:91B5 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:91B7 98           TYA                             ; |
$01:91B8 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Sprite X += that, so it rides a moving layer 2
$01:91BB 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:91BE BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:91C1 10 2A        BPL $91ED                       ; / [$190F] bit 7 ('don't get stuck in walls') clear: skip
$01:91C3 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:91C6 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Not touching left or right: skip
$01:91C8 F0 23        BEQ $91ED                       ; /
$01:91CA A8           TAY                             ; Y = left/right bits of status (1 = right, 2 = left)
$01:91CB BD D0 15     LDA.W $15D0,X                   ; \
$01:91CE D0 1D        BNE $91ED                       ; / Sprite eaten ([$15D0]): skip
$01:91D0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:91D2 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:91D3 79 83 92     ADC.W $9283,Y                   ; |
$01:91D6 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:91D8 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:91DB 79 85 92     ADC.W $9285,Y                   ; } Push sprite out of the wall: X += -4 if right, +4 if left (16-bit)
$01:91DE 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:91E1 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:91E3 D0 08        BNE $91ED                       ; / Sprite moving horizontally: skip
$01:91E5 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:91E8 29 FC        AND.B #$FC                      ; } Standing still: clear the left/right blocked bits
$01:91EA 9D 88 15     STA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; /
$01:91ED BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:91F0 4D 95 16     EOR.W $1695                     ; } Liquid flags changed since last frame? No: return
$01:91F3 F0 1B        BEQ $9210                       ; /
$01:91F5 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = bit 7 (in lava)
$01:91F6 BD 6E 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X         ; \
$01:91F9 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; |
$01:91FB 1D E2 1F     ORA.W $1FE2,X                   ; } Return if [$166E] bit 6 (probably 'no splash') or timer [$1FE2] set
$01:91FE D0 10        BNE $9210                       ; /
$01:9200 B0 0A        BCS $920C                       ; Lava: lava splash
$01:9202 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; \
$01:9205 30 05        BMI $920C                       ; / Water: Mode 7 boss room ([$0D9B] bit 7) also uses the lava splash
$01:9207 22 C0 84 02  JSL.L $84C0                     ; Water splash ($84C0)
$01:920B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:920C 22 28 85 02  JSL.L $8528                     ; Lava splash ($8528)
$01:9210 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9211 AD 0E 19     LDA.W $190E                     ; \
$01:9214 F0 45        BEQ $925B                       ; / [$190E] = 0 (liquid check off): skip to $01925B
$01:9216 A5 85        LDA RAM_IsWaterLevel            ; \
$01:9218 D0 3E        BNE $9258                       ; / Water level ([$85] non-zero): in liquid, store at $019258
$01:921A A0 3C        LDY.B #$3C                      ; Y = $3C: clipping index used for the liquid test
$01:921C 20 4D 94     JSR.W $944D                     ; Get map16 tile at that point ($944D)
$01:921F F0 12        BEQ $9233                       ; Page 0 tile: go to $019233
$01:9221 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; \
$01:9224 C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; } Page 1 tile with acts-like < $6E: not liquid ($01925B)
$01:9226 90 33        BCC $925B                       ; /
$01:9228 22 4D F0 00  JSL.L $F04D                     ; Carry set if the tile is in the slope table ($F04D)
$01:922C AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; A = acts-like tile
$01:922F 90 2A        BCC $925B                       ; Not a slope tile: not liquid
$01:9231 B0 07        BCS $923A                       ; Slope tile: treat as liquid ($01923A)
$01:9233 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; \
$01:9236 C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; } Page 0 tile >= 6: not liquid ($01925B)
$01:9238 B0 21        BCS $925B                       ; /
$01:923A A8           TAY                             ; Y = tile ($04 = lava)
$01:923B BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:923E 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; } A = liquid flags | 1 (water), compare tile with 4
$01:9240 C0 04        CPY.B #$04                      ; /
$01:9242 D0 14        BNE $9258                       ; Not lava: store flags at $019258
$01:9244 48           PHA                             ; Save flags
$01:9245 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9247 C9 35        CMP.B #$35                      ; } Yoshi always sinks in lava ($019252)
$01:9249 F0 07        BEQ $9252                       ; /
$01:924B BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:924E 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } [$167A] bit 1 (process interaction every frame): no sinking
$01:9250 D0 03        BNE $9255                       ; /
$01:9252 20 30 93     JSR.W $9330                     ; Sink in lava ($9330)
$01:9255 68           PLA                             ; Restore flags
$01:9256 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; Bit 7 = in lava
$01:9258 9D 4A 16     STA.W $164A,X                   ; [$164A] = liquid flags (bit 0 water, bit 7 lava)
$01:925B BD 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; \
$01:925E 30 B0        BMI $9210                       ; / [$1686] bit 7 set (no object interaction): return
$01:9260 AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; \
$01:9263 F0 0A        BEQ $926F                       ; / Layer 1 pass ([$185E] = 0): go check blocks ($01926F)
$01:9265 2C 0E 19     BIT.W $190E                     ; \
$01:9268 70 56        BVS $92C0                       ; / [$190E] bit 6 set: skip layer 2 (return)
$01:926A BD 6E 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X         ; \
$01:926D 30 51        BMI $92C0                       ; / [$166E] bit 7 set: skip layer 2 (return)
$01:926F 20 C9 92     JSR.W $92C9                     ; Vertical check: floor/ceiling ($92C9)
$01:9272 BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:9275 10 11        BPL $9288                       ; / [$190F] bit 7 clear: normal horizontal check ($019288)
$01:9277 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:9279 1D AC 15     ORA.W $15AC,X                   ; } X speed or turn timer [$15AC] non-zero: normal horizontal check
$01:927C D0 0A        BNE $9288                       ; /
$01:927E A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$01:9280 20 8E 92     JSR.W $928E                     ; Horizontal check, side alternates every frame ($928E)
$01:9283 60           RTS                             ; Return (this $60 byte is also the Y = 0 entry of the table below)


}

;;; $9284..9285: Data: sprite wall push-out offsets ;;;
{
;; X offsets (low and high bytes) used to push a sprite out of a wall: -4 for right, +4 for left.
$01:9284              .db $FC                         ; X push-out low byte for Y = 1 (-4); Y = 2 and 3 use the following bytes

$01:9285              .db $04,$FF,$00                 ; Y = 2: +4; high bytes: Y = 1: $FF, Y = 2: $00
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Sprite object clipping: SpriteH
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
}

;;; $9288: Sprite horizontal block check ;;;
{
;; Looks up the tile at the sprite's side clipping point (right if moving right, left if moving left) and, if
;;     solid ($11-$6D
;; acts-like), marks the side as blocked. Sets [$1862], [$18A7], [$1860] and status bit 6 for layer 2.
;; $01928E: alternate entry, side taken from bit 0 of A.
$01:9288 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:928A F0 34        BEQ $92C0                       ; / X speed zero: return
$01:928C 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:928D 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:928E 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = 1 if moving left, 0 if right (entry $01928E uses bit 0 of A)
$01:9290 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9291 20 41 94     JSR.W $9441                     ; Get map16 tile at point Y ($9441)
$01:9294 8D 62 18     STA.W $1862                     ; [$1862] = tile high byte (page)
$01:9297 F0 21        BEQ $92BA                       ; Page 0: no block ($0192BA)
$01:9299 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; \
$01:929C C9 11        CMP.B #$11                      ; } Acts-like < $11: not solid
$01:929E 90 1A        BCC $92BA                       ; /
$01:92A0 C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; \
$01:92A2 B0 16        BCS $92BA                       ; / Acts-like >= $6E: not solid
$01:92A4 20 25 94     JSR.W $9425                     ; Set block position and blocked bit ($9425)
$01:92A7 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; \
$01:92AA 8D A7 18     STA.W $18A7                     ; / [$18A7] = tile touched from the side
$01:92AD AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; \
$01:92B0 F0 08        BEQ $92BA                       ; / Layer 1: skip
$01:92B2 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:92B5 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; } Status bit 6: touching layer 2 from the side
$01:92B7 9D 88 15     STA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; /
$01:92BA AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; \
$01:92BD 8D 60 18     STA.W $1860                     ; / [$1860] = acts-like tile (horizontal check)
$01:92C0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $92C1..92C7: Data: sprite X nudge on rope tiles ;;;
{
;; $0192C1 is unreferenced. $0192C5/$0192C7: X offsets (+1/-1) for acts-like tiles $0C/$0D.
$01:92C1              .db $FE,$02,$FF,$00             ; Unused. X offsets $FE, $02 and high bytes $FF, $00

$01:92C5              .db $01,$FF                     ; Rope tile X nudge, low byte: tile $0C -> +1, tile $0D -> -1

$01:92C7              .db $00,$FF                     ; Rope tile X nudge, high byte
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Sprite object clipping: SpriteV
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
}

;;; $92C9: Sprite vertical check and map16 lookup ;;;
{
;; $0192C9: checks the bottom point (moving down) or top point (moving up) against the map. Ceilings mark the
;;     block; floors
;; handle lava, slopes and landing, setting [$1694] (surface offset) and [$15B8] (slope steepness).
;; $019425: copies the clip point to the block position [$98]-[$9B]; $019435: sets the blocked bit from [$0F].
;; $019441: reads the tile at clipping point Y (0-3) and returns it in [$1693] (acts-like), Z set for page 0
;;     tiles.
;; Handles horizontal and vertical levels and both layers, out-of-level points return tile 0.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:926F: Sprite-block interaction and Y clip table (SpriteObjClippingY)
;;     $01:93AC: Sprite vertical check and map16 lookup
$01:92C9 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: bottom clipping point
$01:92CB B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:92CD 10 01        BPL $92D0                       ; / Moving down or still: keep Y = 2
$01:92CF C8           INY                             ; Moving up: Y = 3 (top point)
$01:92D0 20 41 94     JSR.W $9441                     ; Get map16 tile at point Y ($9441)
$01:92D3 8D D7 18     STA.W $18D7                     ; [$18D7] = tile high byte (page)
$01:92D6 08           PHP                             ; \
$01:92D7 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; |
$01:92DA 8D 5F 18     STA.W $185F                     ; } [$185F] = acts-like tile (flags preserved)
$01:92DD 28           PLP                             ; /
$01:92DE F0 2F        BEQ $930F                       ; Page 0: return
$01:92E0 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; A = acts-like tile
$01:92E3 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; \
$01:92E5 F0 29        BEQ $9310                       ; / Bottom point: floor handling ($019310)
$01:92E7 C9 11        CMP.B #$11                      ; \
$01:92E9 90 24        BCC $930F                       ; / Ceiling: acts-like < $11: return
