$01:92EB C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; \
$01:92ED 90 0A        BCC $92F9                       ; / < $6E: solid, go to $0192F9
$01:92EF CD 30 14     CMP.W $1430                     ; \
$01:92F2 90 1B        BCC $930F                       ; |
$01:92F4 CD 31 14     CMP.W $1431                     ; } Else only if [$1430] <= tile < [$1431]
$01:92F7 B0 16        BCS $930F                       ; /
$01:92F9 20 25 94     JSR.W $9425                     ; Set block position and blocked bit ($9425)
$01:92FC AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; \
$01:92FF 8D 68 18     STA.W $1868                     ; / [$1868] = tile hit from below
$01:9302 AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; \
$01:9305 F0 08        BEQ $930F                       ; / Layer 1: return
$01:9307 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:930A 09 20        ORA.B #$20                      ; } Status bit 5: touching layer 2 from below
$01:930C 9D 88 15     STA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; /
$01:930F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9310 C9 59        CMP.B #$59                      ; \
$01:9312 90 27        BCC $933B                       ; |
$01:9314 C9 5C        CMP.B #$5C                      ; } Acts-like $59-$5B (cave lava)? Otherwise $01933B
$01:9316 B0 23        BCS $933B                       ; /
$01:9318 AC 31 19     LDY.W $1931                     ; \
$01:931B C0 0E        CPY.B #$0E                      ; |
$01:931D F0 04        BEQ $9323                       ; |
$01:931F C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; } Only on tilesets 3 and $0E (underground), else $01933B
$01:9321 D0 18        BNE $933B                       ; /
$01:9323 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9325 C9 35        CMP.B #$35                      ; } Yoshi: sink ($019330)
$01:9327 F0 07        BEQ $9330                       ; /
$01:9329 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:932C 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } [$167A] bit 1 set: no sinking ($01933B)
$01:932E D0 0B        BNE $933B                       ; /
$01:9330 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$01:9332 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 5 (sinking in lava)
$01:9335 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:9337 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Sink timer [$1558] = $40
$01:933A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:933B C9 11        CMP.B #$11                      ; \
$01:933D 90 71        BCC $93B0                       ; / Acts-like < $11: go to $0193B0
$01:933F C9 6E        CMP.B #$6E                      ; \
$01:9341 90 75        BCC $93B8                       ; / < $6E: ordinary solid floor ($0193B8)
$01:9343 C9 D8        CMP.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:9345 B0 3F        BCS $9386                       ; / Acts-like >= $D8: go to $019386
$01:9347 22 19 FA 00  JSL.L $FA19                     ; Get slope pointers: [$05] = height table, [$08] = slope index ($FA19)
$01:934B B7 05        LDA [$05],Y                     ; \
$01:934D C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; |
$01:934F F0 5E        BEQ $93AF                       ; } Slope height at this point: = $10 return, > $10 go to $019386
$01:9351 B0 33        BCS $9386                       ; /
$01:9353 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9355 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; |
$01:9357 B0 04        BCS $935D                       ; } Return if [$00] is above the slope surface (probably X within tile)
$01:9359 D7 05        CMP [$05],Y                     ; |
$01:935B 90 52        BCC $93AF                       ; /
$01:935D B7 05        LDA [$05],Y                     ; \
$01:935F 8D 94 16     STA.W $1694                     ; / [$1694] = surface offset on the slope
$01:9362 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:9363 A6 08        LDX $08                         ; |
$01:9365 BF 3D E5 00  LDA.L $E53D,X                   ; } A = slope steepness $E53D[[$08]]
$01:9369 FA           PLX                             ; /
$01:936A 9D B8 15     STA.W $15B8,X                   ; [$15B8] = slope steepness
$01:936D C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$01:936F F0 04        BEQ $9375                       ; |
$01:9371 C9 FC        CMP.B #$FC                      ; } Steep slope ($04 or $FC)? No: $019384
$01:9373 D0 0F        BNE $9384                       ; /
$01:9375 55 B6        EOR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \

;;; $9562: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus) ;;;
{
;; $019562: sets sprite status 8 (normal) and goes to the shared graphics routine.
;; $01956A: if sprites are not locked, runs the stun logic, moves the sprite, handles landing (halve X speed,
;;     bounce), egg hatching,
;; ceiling hits (hit the block above), and walls (X speed / 4), then interaction, graphics and off-screen
;;     check.
;; $0196CB (second routine with the same name): status = 8 and clear vertical flip.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9589: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
$01:9562 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:9564 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:9567 4C 87 A1     JMP.W $A187                     ; Continue with the stationary/carried sprite graphics ($A187)

$01:956A A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \

$01:9581 C9 16        CMP.B #$16                      ; |
$01:9583 F0 04        BEQ $9589                       ; |
$01:9585 C9 15        CMP.B #$15                      ; } Fish sprite ($15/$16): set normal status
$01:9587 D0 03        BNE $958C                       ; /
$01:9589 4C 62 95     JMP.W SetNormalStatus           ; Set normal status (SetNormalStatus)

$01:958C C9 2C        CMP.B #$2C                      ; \
$01:958E D0 08        BNE $9598                       ; / Not Yoshi egg ($2C): skip
$01:9590 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:9592 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F0 (bounce up)
$01:9594 22 4C F7 01  JSL.L $F74C                     ; Egg hatches: status 8, timer $20, sound ($F74C)
$01:9598 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; A = touching ceiling? (IsTouchingCeiling)
$01:959B F0 3E        BEQ $95DB                       ; No: go to $0195DB
$01:959D A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:959F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $10 (bounce down off the ceiling)
$01:95A1 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; \

$01:95A6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:95A8 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:95A9 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:95AB 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$01:95AD BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:95B0 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Block X [$9A] = sprite X + 8
$01:95B2 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; /
$01:95B4 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:95B6 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:95B8 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |

$01:95BD 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; /
$01:95BF BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:95C2 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; |
$01:95C4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:95C5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:95C6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:95C7 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:95C8 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } [$1933] = 1 if hit from below on layer 2 (status bit 5), else 0
$01:95CA 8D 33 19     STA.W $1933                     ; /
$01:95CD A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$01:95CF AD 68 18     LDA.W $1868                     ; A = tile hit from below ([$1868])
$01:95D2 22 60 F1 00  JSL.L $F160                     ; Activate the block ($F160)
$01:95D6 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:95D8 9D E2 1F     STA.W $1FE2,X                   ; / [$1FE2] = 8 (short timer)

$01:95E0 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \

;;; $961C: Koopa spawn table; Bob-omb and shell timers (SpriteKoopasSpawn) ;;;
{
;; $01961C: shelless Koopa sprite number for each shelled Koopa sprite number ($04-$07 -> $00-$03).
;; $019624: Bob-omb explosion (fuse = 1: sound, [$1540] = $40) and flashing; other sprites: when [$1558] = 1
;;     reload tables, face
;; Mario and become normal or kicked; then the stun timer ([$1540]) logic.
$01:961C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$02,$03 ; Shelled Koopa $04-$07 -> shelless Koopa sprite $00-$03 (used by GeneralResetSpr)

$01:9624 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9626 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; } Not a Bob-omb ($0D): go to $01965C
$01:9628 D0 32        BNE $965C                       ; /
$01:962A BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:962D C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Fuse timer [$1540] = 1? No: go to $01964E
$01:962F D0 1D        BNE $964E                       ; /
$01:9631 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:9633 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $09 (explosion)
$01:9636 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:9638 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; / [$1534] = 1 (exploding)
$01:963B A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:963D 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $40: explosion timer
$01:9640 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:9642 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:9645 BD 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; \
$01:9648 29 F7        AND.B #$F7                      ; } Clear [$1686] bit 3: interacts with other sprites
$01:964A 9D 86 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; /
$01:964D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:964E C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; \
$01:9650 B0 09        BCS $965B                       ; / Fuse timer >= $40: return
$01:9652 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:9653 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; |
$01:9655 5D F6 15     EOR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; } Flash: [$15F6] ^= ([$1540] * 2) & $0E
$01:9658 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:965B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:965C BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:965F 1D 58 15     ORA.W $1558,X                   ; } Sprite state [$C2] = [$1540] | [$1558]
$01:9662 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$01:9664 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:9667 F0 33        BEQ $969C                       ; |
$01:9669 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Only when [$1558] = 1: else go to $01969C
$01:966B D0 2F        BNE $969C                       ; /
$01:966D BC 94 15     LDY.W $1594,X                   ; \
$01:9670 B9 D0 15     LDA.W $15D0,Y                   ; } Sprite [$1594]'s eaten flag set (probably the owner): skip
$01:9673 D0 27        BNE $969C                       ; /
$01:9675 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload this sprite's default tables (LoadSpriteTables)
$01:9679 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario (FaceMario)
$01:967C 1E F6 15     ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:967F 5E F6 15     LSR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Clear [$15F6] bit 7 (vertical flip)
$01:9682 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = [$160E]
$01:9685 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:9687 C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; } A = 8 (normal) unless [$160E] = 3
$01:9689 D0 0D        BNE $9698                       ; /
$01:968B FE 7B 18     INC.W $187B,X                   ; [$187B] += 1
$01:968E BD 6E 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X         ; \
$01:9691 09 30        ORA.B #$30                      ; } [$166E] |= $30: disable fireball and cape killing
$01:9693 9D 6E 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X         ; /
$01:9696 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; A = $0A (kicked)
$01:9698 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status = A (8 normal or $0A kicked)
$01:969B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:969C BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:969F F0 FA        BEQ $969B                       ; / Stun timer 0: return
$01:96A1 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$01:96A3 F0 04        BEQ UnstunSprite                ; / Timer = 3: wake up
$01:96A5 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:96A7 D0 2E        BNE IncrmntStunTimer            ; / Neither 3 nor 1: go slow the timer; 1 falls into UnstunSprite
}

;;; $96A9: Wake up stunned sprite (UnstunSprite) ;;;
{
;; Called when [$1540] is 3 or 1. Buzzy Beetle, Spike Top, Mecha-Koopa and Goomba return to normal; Baby Yoshi
;;     and Yoshi egg
;; stay; Throw Block vanishes; any other sprite spawns a shelless Koopa (GeneralResetSpr).
$01:96A9 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:96AB C9 11        CMP.B #$11                      ; } Buzzy Beetle ($11): set normal status
$01:96AD F0 1C        BEQ SetNormalStatus             ; /
$01:96AF C9 2E        CMP.B #$2E                      ; \
$01:96B1 F0 18        BEQ SetNormalStatus             ; / Spike Top ($2E): set normal status
$01:96B3 C9 2D        CMP.B #$2D                      ; \
$01:96B5 F0 13        BEQ $96CA                       ; / Baby Yoshi ($2D): return
$01:96B7 C9 A2        CMP.B #$A2                      ; \
$01:96B9 F0 10        BEQ SetNormalStatus             ; / Mecha-Koopa ($A2): set normal status
$01:96BB C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:96BD F0 0C        BEQ SetNormalStatus             ; / Goomba ($0F): set normal status
$01:96BF C9 2C        CMP.B #$2C                      ; \
$01:96C1 F0 07        BEQ $96CA                       ; / Yoshi egg ($2C): return
$01:96C3 C9 53        CMP.B #$53                      ; \
$01:96C5 D0 1A        BNE GeneralResetSpr             ; / Not Throw Block ($53): spawn a shelless Koopa (GeneralResetSpr)
$01:96C7 20 CB 9A     JSR.W $9ACB                     ; Throw block: make it vanish ($9ACB)
$01:96CA 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $96CB: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus) ;;;
{
;; $019562: sets sprite status 8 (normal) and goes to the shared graphics routine.
;; $01956A: if sprites are not locked, runs the stun logic, moves the sprite, handles landing (halve X speed,
;;     bounce), egg hatching,
;; ceiling hits (hit the block above), and walls (X speed / 4), then interaction, graphics and off-screen
;;     check.
;; $0196CB (second routine with the same name): status = 8 and clear vertical flip.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9589: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
$01:96CB A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:96CD 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:96D0 1E F6 15     ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:96D3 5E F6 15     LSR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Clear [$15F6] bit 7 (vertical flip)
$01:96D6 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $96D7: Slow the stun timer (IncrmntStunTimer) ;;;
{
;; Adds 1 to [$1540] every other frame, so the stun counts down at half speed.
$01:96D7 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:96D9 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:96DB D0 03        BNE $96E0                       ; } Every other frame: [$1540]++ (slows the countdown)
$01:96DD FE 40 15     INC.W $1540,X                   ; /
$01:96E0 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $96E1: Spawn shelless Koopa from shell (GeneralResetSpr) ;;;
{
;; Turns the Koopa in X into a shelless (beheaded) Koopa: takes a free sprite slot, makes it a walking
;;     shelless Koopa of the matching colour at the
;; same position, and hops it away from Mario. If the old [$1540] timer was 1 it instead gets a fast X speed
;;     and a short
;; no-contact delay, and a Yellow Koopa also spawns a moving coin (SpawnMovingCoin).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index of the Koopa. Returns: nothing; returns early if no sprite slot is free.
$01:96E1 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; \
$01:96E5 30 E3        BMI $96CA                       ; / Find a free sprite slot (Y); return if none
$01:96E7 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:96E9 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:96EC B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:96EE AA           TAX                             ; |
$01:96EF BD 1C 96     LDA.W SpriteKoopasSpawn,X       ; } New sprite number = shelless Koopa for this Koopa colour (SpriteKoopasSpawn)
$01:96F2 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; /
$01:96F5 BB           TYX                             ; \
$01:96F6 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; } Initialise the new sprite's tables, then X = old Koopa again
$01:96FA AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; /
$01:96FD B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:96FF 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$01:9702 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:9705 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; |
$01:9708 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:970A 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$01:970D BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } New sprite position = old Koopa position
$01:9710 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$01:9713 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:9715 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / New sprite direction = 0
$01:9718 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:971A 99 64 15     STA.W $1564,Y                   ; / New sprite [$1564] timer = $10
$01:971D BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:9720 99 4A 16     STA.W $164A,Y                   ; / New sprite inherits the in-water flag [$164A]
$01:9723 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:9726 9E 40 15     STZ.W $1540,X                   ; |
$01:9729 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } A = old [$1540], then clear it; if it was 1, go to the fast pop-out case
$01:972B F0 1A        BEQ $9747                       ; /
$01:972D A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$01:972F 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / New sprite Y speed = $D0 (hop upward)
$01:9732 5A           PHY                             ; \
$01:9733 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; |
$01:9736 98           TYA                             ; |
$01:9737 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:9739 7A           PLY                             ; } New sprite faces away from Mario
$01:973A 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; /
$01:973D DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:973E AA           TAX                             ; |
$01:973F BD EC 88     LDA.W Spr0to13SpeedX,X          ; |
$01:9742 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; } New sprite X speed = Spr0to13SpeedX[direction] (walk speed)
$01:9745 FA           PLX                             ; /
$01:9746 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9747 5A           PHY                             ; \
$01:9748 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; |
$01:974B B9 AD 97     LDA.W $97AD,Y                   ; |
$01:974E 84 00        STY $00                         ; |
$01:9750 7A           PLY                             ; } Y = side of Mario; new sprite X speed = $C0 or $40 (away from him); [$00] = Y
$01:9751 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; /
$01:9754 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9756 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:9758 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; } New sprite direction = [$00] XOR 1 (away from Mario), also kept in [$01]
$01:975B 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:975D A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:975F 99 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,Y        ; / New sprite no-contact timer = $10
$01:9762 99 28 15     STA.W $1528,Y                   ; New sprite [$1528] = $10 (do not stun it right away)
$01:9765 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9767 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; } Only a Yellow Koopa (sprite $07) spawns a coin; others return
$01:9769 D0 0A        BNE $9775                       ; /
$01:976B A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; \
$01:976D B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; |
$01:9770 F0 04        BEQ SpawnMovingCoin             ; |
$01:9772 88           DEY                             ; } Find a free slot in sprite slots 0-8 for the coin
$01:9773 10 F8        BPL $976D                       ; /
$01:9775 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9776: Spawn moving coin from Koopa (SpawnMovingCoin) ;;;
{
;; Spawns a Moving Coin (sprite $21) at the position of the sprite in X, tossed upward ($D0) in direction
;;     [$01].
;; Parameters: X: spawning sprite, Y: free sprite slot, [$01]: direction for the coin.
$01:9776 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:9778 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Coin sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:977B A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$01:977D 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Coin sprite number = $21 (Moving Coin)
$01:9780 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:9782 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$01:9785 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Coin X position = Koopa X position
$01:9788 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$01:978B B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:978D 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$01:9790 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } Coin Y position = Koopa Y position
$01:9793 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$01:9796 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:9797 BB           TYX                             ; |
$01:9798 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; } Initialise the coin's sprite tables, then X = Koopa again
$01:979C FA           PLX                             ; /
$01:979D A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$01:979F 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / Coin Y speed = $D0 (tossed upward)
$01:97A2 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:97A4 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / Coin direction = [$01]
$01:97A7 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:97A9 99 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,Y        ; / Coin no-contact timer = $20
$01:97AC 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $97AD..97CF: Table: X speed for shelless Koopa popped out ;;;
{
;; Indexed by SubHorizPos result: $C0 (-$40) if Mario is on the right, $40 if on the left. Used by
;;     GeneralResetSpr.
$01:97AD              .db $C0,$40                     ; Koopa pop-out X speed: $C0 (Mario on right) or $40 (Mario on left)

$01:97AF              .db $00,$00,$00,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F8 ; Bounce Y speed by [Y speed]/4: $00-$07
$01:97B7              .db $F8,$F7,$F6,$F5,$F4,$F3,$F2,$E8 ; Bounce Y speed: $08-$0F
$01:97BF              .db $E8,$E8,$E8,$00,$00,$00,$00,$FE ; Bounce Y speed: $10-$18 (Goomba table starts at $13)
$01:97C7              .db $FC,$F8,$EC,$EC,$EC,$E8,$E4,$E0 ; Goomba bounce Y speeds: $1B-$22
$01:97CF              .db $DC,$D8,$D4,$D0,$CC,$C8     ; Goomba bounce Y speeds: $23-$25

}

;;; $97D5: Bounce sprite off the ground ;;;
{
;; Called when a dropped or thrown sprite lands: halves its X speed (sign preserved) and sets its Y speed from
;;     a bounce table
;; indexed by the old Y speed / 4 (Goombas add $13 to the index and bounce higher). Keeps the speed if [$1588]
;;     bit 7 is set.
;; Followed (starting at $019806) by the stunned/default sprite drawing routine: body via SubSprGfx2Entry1,
;;     plus wake-up feet.
;; The feet are two 8x8 tiles drawn in the first OAM slots, only for frame 6 and only while the stun timer is
;;     running out; the body shakes by 1 pixel.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8C3B: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:957C: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
;;     $01:E635: Portable springboard main routine (SpringBoard)
$01:97D5 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:97D7 08           PHP                             ; |
$01:97D8 10 03        BPL $97DD                       ; } A = X speed; if negative take its absolute value
$01:97DA 20 4A 80     JSR.W InvertAccum               ; /
$01:97DD 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:97DE 28           PLP                             ; |
$01:97DF 10 03        BPL $97E4                       ; } Halve the speed, restore its sign
$01:97E1 20 4A 80     JSR.W InvertAccum               ; /
$01:97E4 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store the halved X speed
$01:97E6 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:97E8 48           PHA                             ; / Save the old Y speed
$01:97E9 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set normal ground Y speed (0 or $18 on slopes)
$01:97EC 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:97ED 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:97EE 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = old Y speed / 4 (bounce table index)
$01:97EF A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:97F0 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:97F2 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:97F4 D0 05        BNE $97FB                       ; |
$01:97F6 98           TYA                             ; |
$01:97F7 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:97F8 69 13        ADC.B #$13                      ; } Goomba: Y += $13 (use its higher bounce table half)
$01:97FA A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:97FB B9 AF 97     LDA.W $97AF,Y                   ; A = bounce Y speed from $97AF
$01:97FE BC 88 15     LDY.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:9801 30 02        BMI $9805                       ; / Object status [$1588] bit 7 set: keep the speed set above
$01:9803 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = bounce speed
$01:9805 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9806 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:9808 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; |
$01:980B D0 02        BNE $980F                       ; } A = animation frame: 6, or 8 if the OAM index is 0
$01:980D A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; /
$01:980F 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; [$1602] = animation frame
$01:9812 BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:9815 48           PHA                             ; / Save OAM index
$01:9816 F0 03        BEQ $981B                       ; \
$01:9818 18           CLC                             ; } Skip body 2 slots (OAM index + 8) unless the index is 0
$01:9819 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; /
$01:981B 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Body goes in the later OAM slots; first slots stay for the feet
$01:981E 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the 16x16 body tile (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:9821 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9822 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / Restore OAM index
$01:9825 AD EB 1E     LDA.W $1EEB                     ; \
$01:9828 30 7C        BMI $98A6                       ; / [$1EEB] bit 7 set: no feet, return
$01:982A BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:982D C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; } Feet only for animation frame 6
$01:982F D0 75        BNE $98A6                       ; /
$01:9831 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:9834 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:9837 D0 09        BNE $9842                       ; / [$1558] non-zero: always shake the body
$01:9839 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:983C F0 68        BEQ $98A6                       ; |
$01:983E C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; } Otherwise only shake during the last $30 frames of [$1540]
$01:9840 B0 0B        BCS $984D                       ; /
$01:9842 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:9843 B9 08 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; / A = timer / 2: carry = timer bit 0
$01:9846 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; \
$01:9848 B0 03        BCS $984D                       ; } Body X += carry (1 pixel shake on alternate frames)
$01:984A 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; /
$01:984D B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:984F C9 11        CMP.B #$11                      ; } Buzzy Beetle ($11): no feet
$01:9851 F0 53        BEQ $98A6                       ; /
$01:9853 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; \
$01:9856 D0 4E        BNE $98A6                       ; / Return if the sprite is off screen
$01:9858 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:985B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:985C A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; |
$01:985E 90 02        BCC $9862                       ; } [$00] = Y offset for the feet: 8, or 0 if drawn upside down
$01:9860 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; /
$01:9862 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$01:9864 B9 08 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; |
$01:9867 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9868 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } Foot 1 X = body X + 2
$01:986A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:986D 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:986E 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } Foot 2 X = body X + 6
$01:9870 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$01:9873 B9 09 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; \
$01:9876 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9877 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:9879 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; } Both feet Y = body Y + [$00]
$01:987C 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; /
$01:987F 5A           PHY                             ; \
$01:9880 A0 64        LDY.B #$64                      ; |
$01:9882 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$01:9884 29 F8        AND.B #$F8                      ; |
$01:9886 D0 02        BNE $988A                       ; } Y = foot tile: $64, or $4D during the first 8 of every 256 frames
$01:9888 A0 4D        LDY.B #$4D                      ; /
$01:988A 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:988B 7A           PLY                             ; |
$01:988C 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; } Both feet use this tile (A = tile, Y = OAM index)
$01:988F 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; /
$01:9892 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \

;;; $98A9: Disco shell: kicked behaviour ;;;
{
;; Kicked-state routine for sprites with [$187B] set (the disco shell). It homes in on Mario: faces him every
;;     32 frames, accelerates
;; by 2 per frame up to +-$20, bounces off walls and cycles its palette every other frame. Sprites locked:
;;     draws only.
;; Ends by jumping into the shared interaction/offscreen code of HandleSprKicked ($01998C).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9918: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
$01:98A9 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:98AB F0 03        BEQ $98B0                       ; / Sprites locked?
$01:98AD 4C 2A 9A     JMP.W $9A2A                     ; Yes: just draw the shell ($019A2A)

$01:98B0 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position
$01:98B3 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:98B6 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$01:98B8 D0 03        BNE $98BD                       ; } Every 32 frames (by [$151C]) turn toward Mario
$01:98BA 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; /
$01:98BD B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:98BF BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$01:98C2 C0 00        CPY.B #$00                      ; } A = X speed; branch on facing direction
$01:98C4 D0 0A        BNE $98D0                       ; /
$01:98C6 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; \
$01:98C8 10 0E        BPL $98D8                       ; / Facing right: accelerate until X speed >= $20
$01:98CA F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:98CC F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed += 2
$01:98CE 80 08        BRA $98D8                       ; Done accelerating

$01:98D0 C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; \
$01:98D2 30 04        BMI $98D8                       ; / Facing left: accelerate until X speed <= -$20
$01:98D4 D6 B6        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:98D6 D6 B6        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed -= 2
$01:98D8 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; \
$01:98DB F0 0D        BEQ $98EA                       ; / Touching a wall?
$01:98DD 48           PHA                             ; Save blocked status
$01:98DE 20 9E 99     JSR.W $999E                     ; Wall hit reaction (sound, flip, block hit)
$01:98E1 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:98E2 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:98E4 A8           TAY                             ; |
$01:98E5 B9 A6 98     LDA.W $98A6,Y                   ; } X speed = $E0 or $20 depending on which wall was hit
$01:98E8 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:98EA 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:98ED F0 07        BEQ $98F6                       ; / On the ground?
$01:98EF 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set ground Y speed (0 or $18 on slopes)
$01:98F2 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:98F4 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $10 (keep pushing down)
$01:98F6 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; \
$01:98F9 F0 02        BEQ $98FD                       ; / Touching ceiling?
$01:98FB 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$01:98FD A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:98FF 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Every other frame (by [$13]) ...
$01:9901 D0 0A        BNE $990D                       ; /
$01:9903 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:9906 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:9907 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:9908 29 CF        AND.B #$CF                      ; } ... advance the palette by 2 (colour cycling), clearing priority bits
$01:990A 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:990D 4C 8C 99     JMP.W $998C                     ; Interaction with sprites and Mario, then offscreen check ($01998C)


}

;;; $9913: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for sprite status $0A. Disco shells divert to $0198A9. Handles slowing down (turns into a
;;     stunned shell when the X speed
;; drops below $20 and [$1528] is clear), gravity/slope handling, wall bounces, and sprite/Mario interaction.
;; Throw blocks continue at StunThrowBlock; everything else is drawn by $019A2A.
;; Sub-entry $01999E: wall hit reaction (sound, flip direction, hit the block if on screen, break Throw
;;     Blocks).

$01:991B BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \

$01:9922 20 0B AA     JSR.W $AA0B                     ; Yes: stun it ($AA0B) ...
$01:9925 4C 87 A1     JMP.W $A187                     ; ... and continue at $A187

$01:9928 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:992B D0 0C        BNE $9939                       ; / [$1528] non-zero: skip the speed check
$01:992D B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:992F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9930 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; |
$01:9932 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } If |X speed| < $20 the shell has slowed down ...
$01:9934 B0 03        BCS $9939                       ; /
$01:9936 20 0B AA     JSR.W $AA0B                     ; ... stun it (it becomes a stationary shell)
$01:9939 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = 0
$01:993C A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:993E 1D 3E 16     ORA.W $163E,X                   ; } Sprites locked or [$163E] timer running?
$01:9941 F0 03        BEQ $9946                       ; /
$01:9943 4C 8F 99     JMP.W $998F                     ; Yes: skip movement, go to offscreen/draw ($01998F)

$01:9946 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Direction from X speed
$01:9949 BD B8 15     LDA.W $15B8,X                   ; \
$01:994C 48           PHA                             ; / Save old slope [$15B8]
$01:994D 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position
$01:9950 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9951 F0 16        BEQ $9969                       ; / Restore old slope; branch if it was 0
$01:9953 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$01:9955 BC 4A 16     LDY.W $164A,X                   ; } [$00] = old slope; skip if in water ([$164A])
$01:9958 D0 0F        BNE $9969                       ; /
$01:995A DD B8 15     CMP.W $15B8,X                   ; \
$01:995D F0 0A        BEQ $9969                       ; / Skip if the slope did not change
$01:995F 55 B6        EOR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:9961 30 06        BMI $9969                       ; / Skip if the old slope and X speed point opposite ways
$01:9963 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$01:9965 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Left a slope: Y speed = $F8 (small upward hop)
$01:9967 80 0C        BRA $9975                       ; Go on

$01:9969 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:996C F0 16        BEQ $9984                       ; / On the ground?
$01:996E 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set ground Y speed (0 or $18 on slopes)
$01:9971 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:9973 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $10
$01:9975 AD 60 18     LDA.W $1860                     ; \
$01:9978 C9 B5        CMP.B #$B5                      ; |
$01:997A F0 04        BEQ $9980                       ; |
$01:997C C9 B4        CMP.B #$B4                      ; } Standing on Map16 tile $B5 or $B4?
$01:997E D0 04        BNE $9984                       ; /
$01:9980 A9 B8        LDA.B #$B8                      ; \
$01:9982 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Yes: Y speed = $B8 (launched upward)
$01:9984 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; \
$01:9987 F0 03        BEQ $998C                       ; / Touching a wall?
$01:9989 20 9E 99     JSR.W $999E                     ; Wall hit reaction
$01:998C 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Sprite-sprite and sprite-Mario interaction (SubSprSpr+MarioSpr)
$01:998F 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:9992 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9994 C9 53        CMP.B #$53                      ; } Throw Block ($53)?
$01:9996 F0 03        BEQ $999B                       ; /
$01:9998 4C 2A 9A     JMP.W $9A2A                     ; No: draw the shell ($019A2A)

$01:999B 4C D4 A1     JMP.W StunThrowBlock            ; Throw Block: StunThrowBlock

$01:999E A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:99A0 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 1 (block hit)
$01:99A3 20 A2 90     JSR.W $90A2                     ; Flip direction without a timer
$01:99A6 BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$01:99A9 D0 27        BNE $99D2                       ; / Off screen horizontally: skip the block hit
$01:99AB B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:99AD 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:99AE E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:99B0 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:99B1 69 14        ADC.B #$14                      ; } A = on-screen X + $14; skip the block hit if < $1C (sprite at the screen edge)
$01:99B3 C9 1C        CMP.B #$1C                      ; /
$01:99B5 90 1B        BCC $99D2                       ; Too close to the edge
$01:99B7 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:99BA 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; |
$01:99BC 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:99BD 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:99BE 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:99BF 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } [$1933] = bit 6 of the blocked status (which layer was hit)
$01:99C1 8D 33 19     STA.W $1933                     ; /
$01:99C4 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$01:99C6 AD A7 18     LDA.W $18A7                     ; A = Map16 tile hit ([$18A7])
$01:99C9 22 60 F1 00  JSL.L $F160                     ; Make the block react to the hit ($F160)
$01:99CD A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \

$01:99D2 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \

$01:99D6 D0 03        BNE $99DB                       ; /

;;; $99DC: Break Throw Block sprite (BreakThrowBlock) ;;;
{
;; Frees the sprite slot and, if on screen, shatters a brick at the sprite's position using ShatterBlock (bank
;;     2).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index of the Throw Block.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:99D8: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
;;     $01:9AB8: Sprite status: killed (HandleSprKilled)
$01:99DC 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Free the sprite slot
$01:99DF A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Y = $FF (shatter type)
$01:99E1 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; \
$01:99E4 D0 1D        BNE $9A03                       ; / Return if the block is off screen
$01:99E6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:99E8 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$01:99EA BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Block X position = sprite X position
$01:99ED 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; /
$01:99EF B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:99F1 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$01:99F3 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } Block Y position = sprite Y position
$01:99F6 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; /
$01:99F8 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:99F9 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:99FB 48           PHA                             ; } Save data bank, set it to $02
$01:99FC AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:99FD 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:99FE 22 63 86 02  JSL.L ShatterBlock              ; } Shatter the brick (A = Y = $FF), restore data bank
$01:9A02 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:9A03 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9A04: Set Y speed when on ground (SetSomeYSpeed??) ;;;
{

;;     Keeps the sprite glued to slopes.

;; Called by:
;;     $01:8169: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C) (HandleGoalPowerup)
;;     $01:8B51: Walking sprite on the ground (SpriteOnGround)

;;     $01:996E: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
;;     $01:9AF9: Move and draw smushed sprite (ShowSmushedGfx)
;;     $01:AF0F: Thwomp states: wait, fall, rise (ThwompStatePtrs)

;;     ... and 5 more
$01:9A04 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \

$01:9A09 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:9A0B BC B8 15     LDY.W $15B8,X                   ; } Otherwise A = 0 unless on a slope ([$15B8] non-zero)

$01:9A12 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = A

}

$01:9A15 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:9A17 B4 B6        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } A = 0; X speed 0: leave direction unchanged

;;; $9AA2: Sprite status: killed (HandleSprKilled) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for sprite status 2 (falling off screen). Special cases: Wiggler calls its main routine,
;;     Lakitu sets [$18E0] = $FF,
;; Throw Blocks break, Exploding Block Enemy explodes. Sprites whose tweaker [$1656] bit 7 is set turn into

;; Others move (unless locked), run SubOffscreen and are drawn by HandleSpriteDeath.
$01:9AA2 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \

$01:9AAB C9 1E        CMP.B #$1E                      ; \
$01:9AAD D0 05        BNE $9AB4                       ; / Lakitu ($1E)?
$01:9AAF A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:9AB1 8C E0 18     STY.W $18E0                     ; / Yes: [$18E0] = $FF
$01:9AB4 C9 53        CMP.B #$53                      ; \
$01:9AB6 D0 04        BNE $9ABC                       ; / Throw Block ($53)?
$01:9AB8 20 DC 99     JSR.W BreakThrowBlock           ; Yes: break it and return
$01:9ABB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9ABC C9 4C        CMP.B #$4C                      ; \
$01:9ABE D0 04        BNE $9AC4                       ; / Exploding Block Enemy ($4C)?
$01:9AC0 22 63 E4 02  JSL.L $E463                     ; Yes: explode ($E463)
$01:9AC4 BD 56 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X         ; \
$01:9AC7 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; } Tweaker [$1656] bit 7 (disappear in puff of smoke) set?
$01:9AC9 F0 0B        BEQ $9AD6                       ; /
$01:9ACB A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:9ACD 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Yes: sprite status = 4 (spin jump killed) ...
$01:9AD0 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:9AD2 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / ... with smoke timer [$1540] = $1F
$01:9AD5 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9AD6 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:9AD8 D0 03        BNE $9ADD                       ; / Sprites locked?
$01:9ADA 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; No: update sprite position
$01:9ADD 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Offscreen handling
$01:9AE0 20 13 9B     JSR.W HandleSpriteDeath         ; Draw the dying sprite
$01:9AE3 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9AE4: Sprite status: smushed (HandleSprSmushed) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for sprite status 3. Frees the slot when [$1540] reaches 0; otherwise falls into
;;     ShowSmushedGfx.
$01:9AE4 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:9AE6 D0 16        BNE $9AFE                       ; / Sprites locked: just draw
$01:9AE8 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:9AEB D0 04        BNE ShowSmushedGfx              ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: keep it
$01:9AED 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Timer ran out: free the sprite slot
$01:9AF0 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9AF1: Move and draw smushed sprite (ShowSmushedGfx) ;;;
{
;; Moves the sprite, zeroes X speed on the ground and draws it: Dino Torch uses the standard 16x16 routine
;;     with tile $AC,
;; everything else uses SmushedGfxRt ($01E700). Entry $019AFE draws without moving.
$01:9AF1 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position
$01:9AF4 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:9AF7 F0 05        BEQ $9AFE                       ; / On the ground?
$01:9AF9 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set ground Y speed
$01:9AFC 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:9AFE B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9B00 C9 6F        CMP.B #$6F                      ; } Dino Torch ($6F)?
$01:9B02 D0 0C        BNE $9B10                       ; /
$01:9B04 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw with the standard 16x16 routine ...
$01:9B07 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:9B0A A9 AC        LDA.B #$AC                      ; } ... and replace the tile with $AC
$01:9B0C 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$01:9B0F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9B10 4C 00 E7     JMP.W SmushedGfxRt              ; Draw with the smushed graphics routine (SmushedGfxRt)

}

;;; $9B13: Draw killed sprite (HandleSpriteDeath) ;;;
{
;; Draws a sprite that died (status 2/5): if tweaker [$167A] bit 0 is set the main routine draws it.
;;     Otherwise, 2-tile-high death
;; frames go through SubSprGfx1 (flipped upside down unless Lakitu), the rest through SubSprGfx2Entry0 with a
;;     vertical flip (A = $80, or $00 if Y = $1C; Y is not set here).
;; Sprites behind scenery temporarily set layer priority [$64] = $10 while drawing.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9AE0: Sprite status: killed (HandleSprKilled)
$01:9B13 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:9B16 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Tweaker [$167A] bit 0: main routine handles its own death?
$01:9B18 F0 03        BEQ $9B1D                       ; /
$01:9B1A 4C C3 85     JMP.W CallSpriteMain            ; Yes: call the main routine

$01:9B1D 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602] = 0
$01:9B20 BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:9B23 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Tweaker [$190F] bit 5 (death frame 2 tiles high) clear: use 16x16 path
$01:9B25 F0 3D        BEQ $9B64                       ; /
$01:9B27 BD 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; \
$01:9B2A 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; } Tweaker [$1662] bit 6 (shell as death frame) set?
$01:9B2C D0 31        BNE $9B5F                       ; /
$01:9B2E B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9B30 C9 1E        CMP.B #$1E                      ; } Lakitu?
$01:9B32 F0 09        BEQ $9B3D                       ; /
$01:9B34 C9 4B        CMP.B #$4B                      ; \
$01:9B36 D0 0C        BNE $9B44                       ; / Pipe Lakitu ($4B)?
$01:9B38 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:9B3A 9D 32 16     STA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; / Pipe Lakitu: sprite goes behind scenery
$01:9B3D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:9B3F 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame 1
$01:9B42 80 08        BRA $9B4C                       ; Go on

$01:9B44 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:9B47 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; } Draw upside down: set vertical flip in the palette byte
$01:9B49 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:9B4C A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:9B4E 48           PHA                             ; / Save layer priority [$64]
$01:9B4F BC 32 16     LDY.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; \
$01:9B52 F0 02        BEQ $9B56                       ; } Behind scenery: [$64] = $10 ...
$01:9B54 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; /
$01:9B56 85 64        STA $64                         ; ... for the draw routine
$01:9B58 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw the two stacked tiles (SubSprGfx1)
$01:9B5B 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9B5C 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64]
$01:9B5E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9B5F A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:9B61 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Use the shell frame: animation frame 6
$01:9B64 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:9B66 C0 1C        CPY.B #$1C                      ; |
$01:9B68 F0 02        BEQ $9B6C                       ; |
$01:9B6A A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; } [$00] = vertical flip bit: $00 if Y = $1C, else $80
$01:9B6C 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:9B6E A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:9B70 48           PHA                             ; / Save layer priority [$64]
$01:9B71 BC 32 16     LDY.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; \
$01:9B74 F0 02        BEQ $9B78                       ; } Behind scenery: [$64] = $10 ...
$01:9B76 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; /
$01:9B78 85 64        STA $64                         ; ... for the draw routine
$01:9B7A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9B7C 20 09 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry0          ; / Draw the 16x16 sprite with A = flip bit (SubSprGfx2Entry0)
$01:9B7F 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9B80 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64]
$01:9B82 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9CF3: Draw 2x2 sprite (default Y offset) (SubSprGfx0Entry0) ;;;
{

;; Called by:
;;     $01:8045: Generic sprite graphics routine (GenericSprGfxRt0)
;;     $01:8C49: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:B008: Thwimp main (Thwimp)
;;     $01:D653: Parachute sprites: draw and physics

$01:9CF3 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (no extra Y offset)
}

;;; $9CF5: Draw sprite from four 8x8 tiles (SubSprGfx0Entry1) ;;;
{
;; Draws a 2x2 sprite of four 8x8 tiles in the sprite's OAM slots. Tile numbers from SprTilemap, flips from
;;     GeneralSprGfxProp.
;; Parameters: A: property row (0-5), Y: Y offset added to the drawing Y position.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:E6F9: Portable springboard main routine (SpringBoard)
$01:9CF5 85 05        STA $05                         ; [$05] = property row
$01:9CF7 84 0F        STY $0F                         ; [$0F] = Y offset
$01:9CF9 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; \
$01:9CFC A4 0F        LDY $0F                         ; / Get on-screen X in [$00], Y in [$01] and OAM index
$01:9CFE 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:9CFF 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9D00 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } Add the Y offset to the Y position
$01:9D02 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:9D04 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9D06 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:9D09 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9D0A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9D0B 79 7F 9C     ADC.W SprTilemapOffset,Y        ; } [$02] = SprTilemapOffset[sprite number] + [$1602] * 4
$01:9D0E 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$01:9D10 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:9D13 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } [$03] = palette | layer priority
$01:9D15 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:9D17 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:9D1A A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:9D1C 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = tile counter, 3 down to 0
$01:9D1E DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:9D1F A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = tile counter
$01:9D21 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9D23 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9D24 7D D3 9C     ADC.W GeneralSprDispX,X         ; } Tile X = [$00] + GeneralSprDispX[X]
$01:9D27 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:9D2A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:9D2C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9D2D 7D D7 9C     ADC.W GeneralSprDispY,X         ; } Tile Y = [$01] + GeneralSprDispY[X]
$01:9D30 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:9D33 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:9D35 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9D36 65 04        ADC $04                         ; |
$01:9D38 AA           TAX                             ; |
$01:9D39 BD 83 9B     LDA.W SprTilemap,X              ; } Tile = SprTilemap[[$02] + tile counter]
$01:9D3C 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$01:9D3F A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$01:9D41 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9D42 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9D43 65 04        ADC $04                         ; } X = [$05] * 4 + tile counter
$01:9D45 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:9D46 BD DB 9C     LDA.W GeneralSprGfxProp,X       ; \
$01:9D49 05 03        ORA $03                         ; } Properties = GeneralSprGfxProp[X] | [$03]
$01:9D4B 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:9D4E C8           INY                             ; \
$01:9D4F C8           INY                             ; |
$01:9D50 C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot
$01:9D51 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:9D52 C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \
$01:9D54 10 C9        BPL $9D1F                       ; / Next tile
$01:9D56 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:9D57 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:9D59 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; } Finish OAM: 4 tiles, 8x8 size (FinishOAMWriteRt)
$01:9D5B 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; /
$01:9D5E 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9D5F: Long call to SubSprGfx1 (GenericSprGfxRt1) ;;;
{
;; Sets the data bank to $01 and calls SubSprGfx1 (RTL, for use from other banks).
;; Called by:
;;     $02:BC09: Dolphin main routine (DolphinMain)
$01:9D5F 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:9D60 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $01
$01:9D61 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:9D62 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw (SubSprGfx1)
$01:9D65 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:9D66 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $9D67: Draw sprite from two stacked tiles (SubSprGfx1) ;;;
{
;; Draws a 16x32 sprite (two 16x16 tiles stacked) using SubSprGfx1Hlpr0, or the upside-down variant if
;;     [RAM_SpritePal] bit 7 is set.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8C00: Draw Koopa-type sprite (sprites 0-13) (Spr0to13Gfx)
;;     $01:8E87: Piranha plant main routine (ClassicPiranhas)
;;     $01:8FA4: Lakitu graphics and interaction (Lakitu)
;;     $01:9B58: Draw killed sprite (HandleSpriteDeath)
;;     $01:9D62: Long call to SubSprGfx1 (GenericSprGfxRt1)
;;     $01:B9EC: Net Koopa main (ClimbingKoopa)
;;     $01:BA74: Net Koopa main (ClimbingKoopa)
;;     $01:BE65: Magikoopa states and helpers (MagiKoopaPtrs)
;;     $01:BEAC: Magikoopa visible state, fade, goal tape init
;;     $01:BF19: Magikoopa visible state, fade, goal tape init
$01:9D67 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:9D6A 10 04        BPL SubSprGfx1Hlpr0             ; / Palette byte bit 7 (draw upside down)?
$01:9D6C 20 D9 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1Hlpr1           ; Yes: use the upside-down version
$01:9D6F 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9D70: Draw two stacked tiles, upright (SubSprGfx1Hlpr0) ;;;
{
;; Writes top and bottom 16x16 tiles from SprTilemap ([$1602] * 2 + offset), Y offset $10 apart, X flip
;;     depending on direction.
;; Sprites numbered below $0F use OAM slots one further in (Y + 4). Marks the tiles 16x16 and handles off-
;;     screen via $A3DF.
$01:9D70 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get on-screen position and OAM index
$01:9D73 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:9D76 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = direction
$01:9D78 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:9D79 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; |
$01:9D7B C0 0F        CPY.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:9D7D B0 02        BCS $9D81                       ; } A = OAM index; + 4 for sprites below $0F
$01:9D7F 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; /
$01:9D81 A8           TAY                             ; \
$01:9D82 5A           PHY                             ; / Y = OAM index; save it
$01:9D83 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9D85 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:9D88 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9D89 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9D8A 79 7F 9C     ADC.W SprTilemapOffset,Y        ; } X = SprTilemapOffset[sprite number] + [$1602] * 2
$01:9D8D AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:9D8E 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$01:9D8F BD 83 9B     LDA.W SprTilemap,X              ; \
$01:9D92 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Top tile
$01:9D95 BD 84 9B     LDA.W SprTilemap+1,X            ; \
$01:9D98 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; / Bottom tile
$01:9D9B AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; Restore sprite index
$01:9D9E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:9DA0 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / Top tile Y = [$01]
$01:9DA3 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:9DA4 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Bottom tile Y = [$01] + $10
$01:9DA6 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; /
$01:9DA9 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9DAB 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; } Both tiles X = [$00]
$01:9DAE 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$01:9DB1 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:9DB4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9DB5 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; } A = palette; direction 1 (left) needs no flip
$01:9DB7 1D F6 15     ORA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:9DBA B0 02        BCS $9DBE                       ; \
$01:9DBC 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; / Direction 0 (right): X flip
$01:9DBE 05 64        ORA $64                         ; \
$01:9DC0 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; } Properties = A | layer priority [$64] for both tiles
$01:9DC3 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; /
$01:9DC6 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:9DC7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9DC8 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$01:9DC9 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9DCA A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:9DCC 1D A0 15     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; |
$01:9DCF 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; } Both tiles 16x16, X bit 8 from the offscreen flag
$01:9DD2 99 61 04     STA.W $0461,Y                   ; /
$01:9DD5 20 DF A3     JSR.W $A3DF                     ; Handle vertical off-screen tiles
$01:9DD8 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9DD9: Draw two stacked tiles for sprite (SubSprGfx1Hlpr1) ;;;
{
;; Fills the second pair of OAM slots (index + 8) with two vertically stacked tiles from SprTilemap, 16 pixels
;;     apart.
;; Then jumps into the shared drawing code at $9DA9. Returns via that code.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9D6C: Draw sprite from two stacked tiles (SubSprGfx1)
$01:9DD9 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get draw info: Y = OAM index, [$00]/[$01] = X/Y on screen
$01:9DDC BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:9DDF 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = sprite direction
$01:9DE1 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:9DE2 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9DE3 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Y = OAM index + 8 (second pair of OAM slots)
$01:9DE5 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9DE6 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$01:9DE7 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9DE9 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:9DEC 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9DED 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9DEE 79 7F 9C     ADC.W SprTilemapOffset,Y        ; } X = tilemap index = [$1602] * 2 + SprTilemapOffset[sprite number]
$01:9DF1 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:9DF2 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$01:9DF3 BD 83 9B     LDA.W SprTilemap,X              ; Tile of the second OAM slot = SprTilemap[X]
$01:9DF6 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y
$01:9DF9 BD 84 9B     LDA.W SprTilemap+1,X            ; Tile of the first OAM slot = SprTilemap[X+1]
$01:9DFC 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y
$01:9DFF AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:9E02 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:9E04 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / First slot Y position = [$01]
$01:9E07 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:9E08 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Second slot Y position = [$01] + 16
$01:9E0A 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; /
$01:9E0D 4C A9 9D     JMP.W $9DA9                     ; Continue in the shared 2-tile drawing code ($9DA9)


}

;;; $9E28: Draw Koopa wings (KoopaWingGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; $019E28: draws one wing as one OAM tile. Frame [$02] is 0 on the ground, else [$1602] AND 1; table index =
;;     direction * 2 + frame.
;; Returns early when offscreen vertically; the OAM X is stored before the horizontal offscreen check.
;; $019E95: entry that draws both wings: shifts the sprite by (-2,+2), draws the dir 0 wing, moves X by +4,
;;     draws the dir 1 wing
;; with the same frame ([$1570] >> 3 AND 1), using the next two OAM slots, then restores position, OAM index
;;     and direction.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8C10: Draw Koopa-type sprite (sprites 0-13) (Spr0to13Gfx)
$01:9E28 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$01:9E2A 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; / Y = 0 (wing frame when on ground)
$01:9E2D D0 06        BNE $9E35                       ; On the ground: keep frame 0
$01:9E2F BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:9E32 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } In the air: Y = animation frame, [$1602] AND 1
$01:9E34 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9E35 84 02        STY $02                         ; [$02] = wing frame (0 or 1)
$01:9E37 BD 6C 18     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; \
$01:9E3A D0 58        BNE $9E94                       ; / Return if offscreen vertically
$01:9E3C B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:9E3E 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = sprite X position low
$01:9E40 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:9E43 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = sprite X position high
$01:9E45 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:9E47 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = sprite Y position low
$01:9E49 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:9E4C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:9E4D BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:9E50 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:9E51 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } X = sprite direction * 2 + wing frame (table index)
$01:9E53 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:9E54 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9E56 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9E57 7D 10 9E     ADC.W KoopaWingDispXLo,X        ; |
$01:9E5A 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:9E5C A5 04        LDA $04                         ; |
$01:9E5E 7D 14 9E     ADC.W KoopaWingDispXHi,X        ; |
$01:9E61 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:9E62 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$01:9E64 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:9E65 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } OAM X = sprite X + wing X offset - screen X boundary
$01:9E67 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:9E6A 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9E6B E5 1B        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; } Skip if the wing is off screen horizontally (high byte differs)
$01:9E6D D0 24        BNE $9E93                       ; /
$01:9E6F A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:9E71 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:9E72 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:9E74 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9E75 7D 18 9E     ADC.W KoopaWingDispY,X          ; } OAM Y = sprite Y - screen Y boundary + wing Y offset
$01:9E78 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:9E7B BD 1C 9E     LDA.W KoopaWingTiles,X          ; \
$01:9E7E 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = KoopaWingTiles[X]
$01:9E81 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:9E83 1D 20 9E     ORA.W KoopaWingGfxProp,X        ; } OAM property = [$64] (sprite priority bits) OR wing flip bits
$01:9E86 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:9E89 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:9E8A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9E8B 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$01:9E8C A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9E8D BD 24 9E     LDA.W KoopaWingTileSize,X       ; \
$01:9E90 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / OAM size bits = KoopaWingTileSize[X] (high table)
$01:9E93 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:9E94 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:9E95 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Draw both Koopa wings: save sprite Y low
$01:9E97 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:9E98 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9E99 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } Sprite Y += 2 (original saved)
$01:9E9B 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:9E9D BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Save sprite Y high
$01:9EA0 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:9EA1 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Sprite Y high += carry
$01:9EA3 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:9EA6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Save sprite X low
$01:9EA8 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:9EA9 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:9EAA E9 02        SBC.B #$02                      ; } Sprite X -= 2 (shift left wing slightly)
$01:9EAC 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:9EAE BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Save sprite X high
$01:9EB1 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:9EB2 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Sprite X high -= borrow
$01:9EB4 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:9EB7 BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Save OAM index
$01:9EBA 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:9EBB 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9EBC 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } OAM index += 4 (wings use the next OAM slots)
$01:9EBE 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$01:9EC1 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Save sprite direction
$01:9EC4 48           PHA 
$01:9EC5 9E 7C 15     STZ.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = 0 (first wing)
$01:9EC8 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:9ECB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9ECC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9ECD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9ECE 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = wing frame = ([$1570] >> 3) AND 1
$01:9ED0 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9ED1 20 35 9E     JSR.W $9E35                     ; Draw left wing (entry after the frame is set)
$01:9ED4 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:9ED6 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9ED7 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:9ED9 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:9EDB BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:9EDE 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Sprite X += 4 (move to the right wing)
$01:9EE0 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:9EE3 BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:9EE6 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:9EE7 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } OAM index += 4 (next OAM slot)
$01:9EE9 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$01:9EEC FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction = 1 (second wing)
$01:9EEF 20 37 9E     JSR.W $9E37                     ; Draw second wing (same frame as the first)
$01:9EF2 68           PLA                             ; Restore direction
$01:9EF3 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X
$01:9EF6 68           PLA                             ; Restore OAM index
$01:9EF7 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X
$01:9EFA 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9EFB 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Restore sprite X high
$01:9EFE 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9EFF 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Restore sprite X low
$01:9F01 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9F02 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore sprite Y high
$01:9F05 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9F06 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore sprite Y low
$01:9F08 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $9F09: Draw 16x16 sprite, extra property in A (SubSprGfx2Entry0) ;;;
{
;; Stores A in [$04] (extra OAM property bits, for example $80 for Y flip) and joins SubSprGfx2Entry1.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9B7C: Draw killed sprite (HandleSpriteDeath)
;;     $01:A14F: Draw stunned Goomba (StunGoomba)
$01:9F09 85 04        STA $04                         ; [$04] = extra OAM property bits from A (for example $80 = Y flip)
$01:9F0B 80 02        BRA $9F0F                       ; Join the common code

}

;;; $9F0D: Draw single 16x16 tile sprite (SubSprGfx2Entry1) ;;;
{
;; Draws a sprite as one 16x16 OAM tile: tile = SprTilemap[[$1602] + SprTilemapOffset[sprite number]],
;;     position from GetDrawInfoBnk1,
;; property = palette | X flip when direction is 0 | [$04] | [$64]. Hides it via $A3DF when offscreen
;;     vertically.
;; Parameters: [$04] set by the entry (0 here).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8763: Goal Point Question Sphere (GoalSphere)
;;     $01:8AF9: Bob-omb (Bobomb)
;;     $01:8BE7: Draw Koopa-type sprite (sprites 0-13) (Spr0to13Gfx)
;;     $01:8DB8: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8F4C: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:902B: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move (timerCODE_019001)
;;     $01:90B5: Long-call generic sprite graphics (GenericSprGfxRt2)
;;     $01:954D: Stunned sprite: egg and special cases (YoshiShellSts9)
;;     $01:981E: Bounce sprite off the ground
;;     $01:9A57: Sprite status: spin jump killed (HandleSprSpinJump)
;;     $01:9B04: Move and draw smushed sprite (ShowSmushedGfx)
;;     $01:A183: Draw stunned Cheep Cheep (StunFish)
;;     ... and 23 more
$01:9F0D 64 04        STZ $04                         ; [$04] = 0 (no extra property bits)
$01:9F0F 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get draw info: Y = OAM index, [$00]/[$01] = X/Y on screen
$01:9F12 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:9F15 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = sprite direction
$01:9F17 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9F19 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:9F1C 18           CLC                             ; } A = [$1602] (frame) + SprTilemapOffset[sprite number]
$01:9F1D 79 7F 9C     ADC.W SprTilemapOffset,Y        ; /
$01:9F20 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:9F23 AA           TAX                             ; X = tilemap index
$01:9F24 BD 83 9B     LDA.W SprTilemap,X              ; \
$01:9F27 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = SprTilemap[X]
$01:9F2A AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:9F2D A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:9F2F 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = [$00]
$01:9F32 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:9F34 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = [$01]
$01:9F37 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:9F3A 4A           LSR                             ; } Carry = direction bit 0, A = 0
$01:9F3B A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; /
$01:9F3D 1D F6 15     ORA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; A = sprite palette bits
$01:9F40 B0 02        BCS $9F44                       ; \
$01:9F42 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; / Direction 0 (right): flip X, graphics face left
$01:9F44 05 04        ORA $04                         ; \
$01:9F46 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } OAM property = A OR [$04] OR [$64]
$01:9F48 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:9F4B 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:9F4C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:9F4D 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$01:9F4E A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:9F4F A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:9F51 1D A0 15     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; } OAM size = 16x16 with X high bit from offscreen-horizontal flag
$01:9F54 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; /
$01:9F57 20 DF A3     JSR.W $A3DF                     ; Hide the tile if offscreen vertically ($A3DF)
$01:9F5A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $9F5B..9F69: Table: carried sprite X offset from Mario ;;;
{
;; Two 6-byte tables (low bytes, then high bytes) indexed by pose: 0 right, 1 left, 2-4 Mario facing the
;;     camera, 5 pipe/turning/climbing.
$01:9F5B              .db $0B,$F5,$04,$FC,$04,$00     ; Carried sprite X offset low: $0B, $F5, $04, $FC, $04, $00

$01:9F61              .db $00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$00     ; Carried sprite X offset high: sign extension of the low bytes


;;; all.log 019F67..01A0B0
;;;
;;; RAM_IsFlying $72 acts as a "Mario is in the air" flag. This is nonzero when Mario is in the air
;;; (whether flying, jumping or falling). This is zero when Mario stands on a platform.
;;;
;;; RAM_YoshiInPipe $7E1419 is actually the "sprites go behind stuff" flag; see RAM map at
;;; SMWcentral. So whether or not Mario has Yoshi, we use this flag to make the carried sprites go
;;; behind stuff like pipes.
;;;
;;; Mysterious RAM locations:
;;; RAM_ChangingDir $7E13DD, not in SMWcentral RAM Map
;;;                 $7E13F3, might be the pose of Mario while using the P-balloon
;;;                 $7E1626, SMWcentral says "Consecutive enemies jumped on table."
;;;
;;; New labels (not in original all.log):
;;;         $64 => RAM_SpriteProp (vhoopppN)
;;;     $7E14C8 => RAM_SpriteAction ("sprite status table")
;;;     $7E1891 => RAM_BalloonTimer
;;; $9FC4 => BalloonExpired
;;; $9FCA => BalloonActive
;;; $9FE0 => NotCarryingBalloon
;;; $A015 => ReleaseSprCarried
;;; $A068 => TossUpSprCarried
;;; $A079 => KickSprCarried
;;; $A0A6 => StartKickPose
;;; $D214 => ControlSprCarried
;;;
;;; SMWcentral RAM map names RAM_SpriteAction $7E14C8 as the "sprite status table", but this is not
;;; the same table as RAM_SpriteState $C2 or RAM_SprObjStatus $7E1588.
;;;
;;; Values for RAM_SpriteAction,X:
;;; $00 => empty sprite slot
;;; $07 => in mouth of Yoshi
;;; $08 => normal
;;; $09 => stunned
;;; $0A => kicked
;;; $0B => carried by Mario
;;;   See http://www.smwcentral.net/?p=thread&id=11960 for other values.

;; X position of carried sprite relative to Mario,
;; in table indexed by RAM_MarioDirection $76.
;;
;; $9F67,0 with $9F69,0 = position when facing left
;; $9F67,1 with $9F69,1 = position when facing right
;;
$01:9F67              .db $F3,$0D                     ; Drop X offset low: -13 (facing left), 13 (facing right)
$01:9F69              .db $FF,$00                     ; Drop X offset high bytes

;; Sprite X speed when kicking a sprite.
