;; Index 0 => Mario faces left, no Yoshi
;;       1 => Mario faces right, no Yoshi
;;       2 => Mario and Yoshi face left
;;       3 => Mario and Yoshi face right
;;
}

;;; $9F6B: Table: kick X speeds (ShellSpeedX) ;;;
{
;; Also includes $9F67/019F69 above (sprite X offset when dropped: -13/+13). Index: 0 left, 1 right, +2
;;     when on Yoshi. $019F6F: two unused bytes.
$01:9F6B              .db $D2,$2E,$CC,$34             ; Kick X speed: -46, 46 (no Yoshi), -52, 52 (on Yoshi)

$01:9F6F              .db $00,$10                     ; Unused bytes

;;; JSR subroutine
;;; precondition that data bank = $01
;;;          and that Mario carries this sprite (so RAM_SpriteAction,X is $0B)
;;; takes X = index of this common sprite in the common sprite tables in RAM
;;; preserves X
;;;
;;; Handles a sprite while Mario carries the sprite. Positions the sprite in front of Mario. Also
;;; tosses up, kicks or drops the sprite if the player releases the Y (or X) button.
;;;
;;; This routine also handles the P-balloon. While Mario uses the P-balloon, Mario carries the
;;; P-balloon sprite. This routine handles the balloon timer and the animation for low time.
;;;
;;; Mario normally carries only one sprite, but you can set the common sprite tables such that,
;;; because there are 12 common sprite slots, Mario can carry simultaneously as many as 12 sprites.
;;; You can observe this with the glitch for carrying 2 sprites. There would be problems if Mario
;;; would carry 2 P-balloons, because the balloons would share some variables.
;;;
;;; TODO - does any part of this routine handle when sprites are in the mouth of Yoshi?
;;;
}

;;; $9F71: Handle sprite carried by Mario (HandleSprCarried) ;;;
{
;; Called for sprites with status $0B. Runs $9F9B (balloon timer, release, collisions), hides the sprite
;;     in OAM when Mario turns, is in a pipe
;; or faces the camera, then draws it via $A187 (property forced to $10 in a pipe).
;; Parameters: X = sprite index. Preserves X and [RAM_SpriteProp].
$01:9F71 20 9B 9F     JSR.W $9F9B                     ; Run the first part: balloon timer, release and collisions ($9F9B)
$01:9F74 AD DD 13     LDA.W RAM_ChangingDir           ; \
$01:9F77 D0 0A        BNE $9F83                       ; |
$01:9F79 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; |
$01:9F7C D0 05        BNE $9F83                       ; |
$01:9F7E AD 99 14     LDA.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; } If turning, in a pipe or Mario faces the camera:
$01:9F81 F0 03        BEQ $9F86                       ; /
$01:9F83 9E EA 15     STZ.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; OAM index = 0 for the carried sprite
$01:9F86 A5 64        LDA RAM_SpriteProp              ; \
$01:9F88 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite property bits [$64]
$01:9F89 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:9F8C F0 04        BEQ $9F92                       ; |
$01:9F8E A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; } In a pipe: sprite property = $10 (priority 1, palette 0)
$01:9F90 85 64        STA RAM_SpriteProp              ; /
$01:9F92 20 87 A1     JSR.W $A187                     ; Draw the carried or stunned sprite ($A187)
$01:9F95 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:9F96 85 64        STA RAM_SpriteProp              ; / Restore sprite property bits
$01:9F98 60           RTS                             ; Return

;; Sprite X speed relative to Mario X speed when dropping a
;; carried sprite in table indexed by RAM_MarioDirection $76.
;;
}

;;; $9F99..9F99: Table: drop X speed relative to Mario ;;;
{
;; Index by Mario direction: -4 (left), +4 (right).
$01:9F99              .db $FC,$04                     ; Drop X speed relative to Mario: -4 (facing left), 4 (right)

;;; JSR subroutine, first part of HandleSprCarried
;;;
}

;;; $9F9B: Carried sprite: balloon and release checks ;;;
{
;; First part of HandleSprCarried. For the P-balloon (sprite $7D) counts down [$1891] every 4 frames and sets
;;     the warning pose in [$13F3].
;; A Mario animation kills the balloon. Other sprites continue at NotCarryingBalloon.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9F71: Handle sprite carried by Mario (HandleSprCarried)
$01:9F9B B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:9F9D C9 7D        CMP.B #$7D                      ; } Not the P-balloon (sprite $7D): go to NotCarryingBalloon
$01:9F9F D0 3F        BNE NotCarryingBalloon          ; /
$01:9FA1 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:9FA3 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Only every 4th frame: otherwise skip to $019FBE
$01:9FA5 D0 17        BNE $9FBE                       ; /
$01:9FA7 CE 91 18     DEC.W RAM_BalloonTimer          ; Decrement the P-balloon timer [$1891]
$01:9FAA F0 18        BEQ BalloonExpired              ; Timer ran out: balloon expired
$01:9FAC AD 91 18     LDA.W RAM_BalloonTimer          ; \
$01:9FAF C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; } Timer >= 48: no warning, skip to $019FBE
$01:9FB1 B0 0B        BCS $9FBE                       ; /
$01:9FB3 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; \
$01:9FB5 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$01:9FB7 F0 02        BEQ $9FBB                       ; } Low timer: Y = 1 or 9, alternating every 4 ticks
$01:9FB9 A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; /
$01:9FBB 8C F3 13     STY.W $13F3                     ; [$13F3] = Y (balloon pose, makes Mario flash his pose)
;; Come here if skipping ahead
$01:9FBE A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$01:9FC0 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } No Mario animation running: keep the balloon
$01:9FC2 90 06        BCC BalloonActive               ; /
;; If animating Mario, then fall through to kill the P-balloon.
;; For example, if Mario grows into Super Mario then he loses the balloon.
}

;;; $9FC4: P-balloon expired (BalloonExpired) ;;;
{
;; Clears [$13F3] and erases the balloon sprite (tail call, returns from $9F9B).
$01:9FC4 9C F3 13     STZ.W $13F3                     ; Clear balloon pose [$13F3]
$01:9FC7 4C 80 AC     JMP.W OffScrEraseSprite         ; Erase the balloon sprite and return

}

;;; $9FCA: P-balloon: control and position (BalloonActive) ;;;
{
;; Switches to data bank 2, runs ControlSprCarried (controller input and speed), restores the bank, positions
;;     the sprite at Mario
;; and hides its OAM tile (Y = $F0) since the balloon is drawn as part of Mario.
$01:9FCA 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$01:9FCB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:9FCD 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $02
$01:9FCE AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:9FCF 22 14 D2 02  JSL.L ControlSprCarried         ; Control sprite from the controller (ControlSprCarried)
$01:9FD3 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:9FD4 20 B1 A0     JSR.W $A0B1                     ; Position the sprite at Mario ($A0B1)
;;
;; RAM $7E0200..$7E041F is a mirror of OAM. This code uses $0301,Y
;; which would be the Y-position (relative to the screen) of the
;; sprite with OAM slot = (Y / 4) + 64. (TODO - is this correct?)
;;
$01:9FD7 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:9FDA A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; } Y = OAM index, OAM Y = $F0 (hide the balloon sprite)
$01:9FDC 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:9FDF 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; all.log 019F67..01A0B0
;;; continued from SMWDISC19

;;; continuation of JSR subroutine $9F9B
;;;
}

;;; $9FE0: Carried sprite: interaction and release (NotCarryingBalloon) ;;;
{
;; Resets interaction variables ($9140). A Mario animation (not in a pipe) drops the sprite as stunned.
;;     Otherwise, if sprites are locked,
;; only positions it; else runs per-sprite checks, sprite-vs-sprite interaction and releases it when the Y/X
;;     button ($40) is not held.
$01:9FE0 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Reset sprite-vs-level interaction variables ($9140)
$01:9FE3 A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$01:9FE5 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } No Mario animation running: skip to $019FF4
$01:9FE7 90 0B        BCC $9FF4                       ; /
$01:9FE9 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:9FEC D0 06        BNE $9FF4                       ; / In a pipe: skip to $019FF4
;; We are animating Mario and are not in a pipe
$01:9FEE A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:9FF0 9D C8 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X        ; / Mario is animating: sprite status = 9 (stunned, drops from Mario)
$01:9FF3 60           RTS                             ; Return
;; Come here if we are not animating Mario or we are in a pipe
$01:9FF4 BD C8 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X        ; \
$01:9FF7 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Return if sprite status is 8 (normal)
$01:9FF9 F0 19        BEQ $A014                       ; /
$01:9FFB A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:9FFD F0 03        BEQ $A002                       ; / Sprites locked: just position it at Mario
$01:9FFF 4C B1 A0     JMP.W $A0B1                     ; Position sprite at Mario and return (tail call)
$01:A002 20 24 96     JSR.W $9624                     ; Per-sprite checks for carried sprites (Bob-omb explosion, etc.)
$01:A005 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Sprite-vs-sprite interaction
$01:A008 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:A00B D0 04        BNE $A011                       ; / In a pipe: skip the release check
$01:A00D 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; Test Y/X button bit ($40) of controller A
$01:A00F 50 04        BVC ReleaseSprCarried           ; Button not held: release the sprite
$01:A011 20 B1 A0     JSR.W $A0B1                     ; Position sprite at Mario ($A0B1)
$01:A014 60           RTS                             ; Return

;; Mario carries a sprite but the player released the Y or X
;; button, so release the sprite.
;;
}

;;; $A015: Release carried sprite (ReleaseSprCarried) ;;;
{
;; Sets status 9 (stunned), then chooses: up held = toss up, sprite < $15 kicks unless down held, sprite >=
;;     $15 kicks if left/right held,
;; otherwise drops it at Mario X +/- 13 with X speed Mario +/- 4 and Y speed 0. Ends at StartKickPose.
$01:A015 9E 26 16     STZ.W $1626,X                   ; Clear [$1626] (consecutive enemies stomped counter, probably)
$01:A018 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (default Y speed)
$01:A01A B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A01C C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:A01E D0 06        BNE $A026                       ; |
$01:A020 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; |
$01:A022 D0 02        BNE $A026                       ; } Goomba released while Mario is on the ground: Y = -20 (dead code, no effect)
$01:A024 A0 EC        LDY.B #$EC                      ; /
;;
;; The next line only affects kicked sprites. Later code will
;; set the vertical speed of tossed-up or dropped sprites.
;; Thus edits to address $01A019 affect only kicked sprites.
;;
$01:A026 94 AA        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = Y
$01:A028 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:A02A 9D C8 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X        ; / Sprite status = 9 (stunned)
;;
;; Decide whether to branch to the code for tossing up the sprite,
;; branch to the code for kicking the sprite, or continue with the
;; code for normally dropping the sprite.
;;
;; Bob-ombs $OD, Goombas $0F, Buzzy Beetles $11 are < $15.
;; Koopa shells are also < $15.
;; Most other carried sprites, like springboards $2F and
;;   P-switches $3E are >= $15.
;; 
$01:A02D A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:A02F 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Up held: toss the sprite up
$01:A031 D0 35        BNE TossUpSprCarried            ; /
$01:A033 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A035 C9 15        CMP.B #$15                      ; } Sprite number >= $15: branch to the second check
$01:A037 B0 08        BCS $A041                       ; /
$01:A039 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:A03B 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Sprite < $15 (shells and similar): kick unless down is held
$01:A03D F0 3A        BEQ KickSprCarried              ; /
$01:A03F 80 06        BRA $A047                       ; Down held: drop it
$01:A041 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:A043 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Sprite >= $15: kick if left or right is held
$01:A045 D0 32        BNE KickSprCarried              ; /
;;
;; Continue if not tossing up nor kicking the sprite.
;; Drop the sprite.
;;
$01:A047 A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Y = Mario direction (0 left, 1 right)
$01:A049 A5 D1        LDA $D1                         ; \
$01:A04B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A04C 79 67 9F     ADC.W $9F67,Y                   ; |
$01:A04F 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:A051 A5 D2        LDA $D2                         ; |
;; carry for 16-bit add   ;  |
$01:A053 79 69 9F     ADC.W $9F69,Y                   ; } Sprite X = Mario X +/- 13 (16-bit)
$01:A056 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:A059 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = which side of the sprite Mario is on (SubHorizPos)
$01:A05C B9 99 9F     LDA.W $9F99,Y                   ; \
$01:A05F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A060 65 7B        ADC RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; } Sprite X speed = Mario X speed +/- 4
$01:A062 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:A064 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$01:A066 80 3E        BRA StartKickPose               ; Show Mario's kick pose and finish

;; Mario released the sprite, but the player held up from the
;; Control Pad, so we need to toss the sprite in the air.
;;
}

;;; $A068: Toss carried sprite upward (TossUpSprCarried) ;;;
{
;; Plays kick sound and smoke, sprite Y speed = -112, X speed = Mario X speed / 2. Falls to StartKickPose.
$01:A068 22 6F AB 01  JSL.L $AB6F                     ; Play kick sound, spawn contact smoke ($AB6F)
$01:A06C A9 90        LDA.B #$90                      ; \
$01:A06E 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = -112 (toss up)
$01:A070 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:A072 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$01:A074 0A           ASL                             ; } Sprite X speed = Mario X speed / 2 (signed)
$01:A075 76 B6        ROR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:A077 80 2D        BRA StartKickPose               ; Show Mario's kick pose and finish

;; Mario released and kicked the sprite.
;;
}

;;; $A079: Kick carried sprite (KickSprCarried) ;;;
{
;; Plays kick sound and smoke, status = $0A (kicked), X speed from ShellSpeedX indexed by direction (+2 on
;;     Yoshi),
;; plus half Mario X speed when both move the same way.
$01:A079 22 6F AB 01  JSL.L $AB6F                     ; Play kick sound, spawn contact smoke ($AB6F)
$01:A07D BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:A080 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Sprite state [$C2] = [$1540] (probably a timer carried over)
$01:A082 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:A084 9D C8 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X        ; / Sprite status = $0A (kicked)
$01:A087 A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$01:A089 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$01:A08C F0 02        BEQ $A090                       ; |
$01:A08E C8           INY                             ; } Y = direction (0/1), + 2 if Mario is on Yoshi
$01:A08F C8           INY                             ; /
$01:A090 B9 6B 9F     LDA.W ShellSpeedX,Y             ; \
$01:A093 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Sprite X speed = ShellSpeedX[Y]
$01:A095 45 7B        EOR RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Compare sign of kick speed and Mario X speed
$01:A097 30 0D        BMI StartKickPose               ; Opposite signs: done
$01:A099 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:A09B 85 00        STA $00                         ; } Same sign: copy Mario X speed to [$00], shift sign into carry
$01:A09D 06 00        ASL $00                         ; /
$01:A09F 6A           ROR                             ; \
$01:A0A0 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A0A1 79 6B 9F     ADC.W ShellSpeedX,Y             ; } Sprite X speed += Mario X speed / 2
$01:A0A4 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
;; fall through to StartKickPose

;; Give the released sprite some time to move away from Mario.
;; (If Mario tries to toss up or drop a Koopa shell, we do want
;;  the collision code to immediately kick the shell.)
;;
;; Show the pose of Mario kicking the sprite with the foot.
;;
}

;;; $A0A6: Start Mario kick pose and carry positioning (StartKickPose) ;;;
{
;; $01A0A6: disables Mario contact with the sprite for 16 frames and shows the kick pose for 12 frames
;;     ([$149A]).
;; $01A0B1 ($A0B1): places a carried sprite at Mario using $9F5B/61 X offsets and Y offset $0D
;;     ($0F when small, ducking or picking up),
;; and sets the carrying flags [$148F] and [$1470].
$01:A0A6 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:A0A8 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable Mario contact with this sprite for 16 frames
$01:A0AB A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:A0AD 8D 9A 14     STA.W RAM_KickImgTimer          ; / Show kick pose for 12 frames ([$149A])
$01:A0B0 60           RTS                             ; Return


$01:A0B1 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$01:A0B3 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$01:A0B5 D0 01        BNE $A0B8                       ; } Y = 1 if Mario faces left, 0 if right
$01:A0B7 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:A0B8 AD 99 14     LDA.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; \
$01:A0BB F0 07        BEQ $A0C4                       ; / Not facing the camera: skip to pipe check
$01:A0BD C8           INY                             ; \
$01:A0BE C8           INY                             ; / Facing camera: Y += 2
$01:A0BF C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$01:A0C1 90 01        BCC $A0C4                       ; } Timer >= 5: Y += 1
$01:A0C3 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:A0C4 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:A0C7 F0 04        BEQ $A0CD                       ; |
$01:A0C9 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } In a pipe: Y = 5 when [$1419] = 2 (otherwise continue)
$01:A0CB F0 07        BEQ $A0D4                       ; /
$01:A0CD AD DD 13     LDA.W RAM_ChangingDir           ; \
$01:A0D0 05 74        ORA RAM_IsClimbing              ; } Turning or climbing: Y = 5 (centered)
$01:A0D2 F0 02        BEQ $A0D6                       ; /
$01:A0D4 A0 05        LDY.B #$05                      ; Y = 5 (carry in front of Mario's centre)
$01:A0D6 5A           PHY                             ; Save table index
$01:A0D7 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: use Mario position copy at $94
$01:A0D9 AD 71 14     LDA.W $1471                     ; \
$01:A0DC C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; / [$1471] = 3 (probably riding a platform): use Y = 0
$01:A0DE F0 02        BEQ $A0E2
$01:A0E0 A0 3D        LDY.B #$3D                      ; Otherwise Y = $3D: use the copy at $D1
$01:A0E2 B9 94 00     LDA.W RAM_MarioXPos,Y           ; \
$01:A0E5 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:A0E7 B9 95 00     LDA.W RAM_MarioXPosHi,Y         ; } [$00]/[$01] = Mario X position (low/high)
$01:A0EA 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:A0EC B9 96 00     LDA.W RAM_MarioYPos,Y           ; \
$01:A0EF 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$01:A0F1 B9 97 00     LDA.W RAM_MarioYPosHi,Y         ; } [$02]/[$03] = Mario Y position (low/high)
$01:A0F4 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:A0F6 7A           PLY                             ; Restore table index
$01:A0F7 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:A0F9 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A0FA 79 5B 9F     ADC.W $9F5B,Y                   ; } Sprite X low = Mario X + $9F5B[Y]
$01:A0FD 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:A0FF A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:A101 79 61 9F     ADC.W $9F61,Y                   ; } Sprite X high = Mario X high + $9F61[Y]
$01:A104 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:A107 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; A = $0D (Y offset below Mario's top)
$01:A109 A4 73        LDY RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$01:A10B D0 04        BNE $A111                       ; / Ducking: use $0F
$01:A10D A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$01:A10F D0 02        BNE $A113                       ; / Big Mario: keep $0D
$01:A111 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; Small Mario: A = $0F
$01:A113 AC 98 14     LDY.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; \
$01:A116 F0 02        BEQ $A11A                       ; / Picking up pose active: use $0F
$01:A118 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; A = $0F
$01:A11A 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:A11B 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } Sprite Y low = Mario Y + A
$01:A11D 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:A11F A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$01:A121 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Sprite Y high = Mario Y high + carry
$01:A123 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:A126 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:A128 8D 8F 14     STA.W $148F                     ; / [$148F] = 1 (probably also a carrying flag)
$01:A12B 8D 70 14     STA.W $1470                     ; [$1470] = 1 (carrying enemy flag)
$01:A12E 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; New labels (not in orignal all.log):
;;;   $7E14C8 => RAM_SpriteAction ("sprite status table")
;;;
;;; The next code is part of subroutine $A187. The code is before the start of the subroutine
;;; so that branch instructions (having range -128..127) can reach the code.

;; Show a stunned (stationary or carried) Goomba. The sprite
;; appears vertically flipped (up-side-down) and moves its legs,
;; alternating its image after every 8 frames.
;;
;; The timer at table $1540 counts the frames until the Goomba
;; walks. If the timer is below 48, then the Goomba hastens its
;; animation, alternating its image after every 4 frames, to warn
;; the player that it will soon walk.
;;
}

;;; $A12F: Draw stunned Goomba (StunGoomba) ;;;
{
;; Animates the upside-down Goomba (frame 0/1 every 8 frames, every 4 below timer 48 in [$1540]). At timer 8
;;     on the ground it hops (Y speed -40).
;; Draws via SubSprGfx2Entry0 with A = $80 (Y flip).
$01:A12F A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:A131 4A           LSR                             ; } A = [$14] frame counter / 4
$01:A132 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:A133 BC 40 15     LDY.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:A136 C0 30        CPY.B #$30                      ; |
$01:A138 90 01        BCC $A13B                       ; } Timer [$1540] < 48: A = frame counter / 8 (faster animation)
$01:A13A 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:A13B 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$01:A13D 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = A AND 1
$01:A140 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$01:A142 D0 09        BNE $A14D                       ; / Timer = 8? otherwise skip the hop
$01:A144 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:A147 F0 04        BEQ $A14D                       ; / And on the ground: make the Goomba hop
$01:A149 A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:A14B 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = -40 (hop just before it wakes up)
$01:A14D A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80 (Y flip, extra property bits)
$01:A14F 4C 09 9F     JMP.W SubSprGfx2Entry0          ; Draw the upside-down Goomba

;; Show a stunned (stationary or carried) Mecha Koopa. The sprite
;; appears flattened. If the timer is below 48, then the Mecha
;; Koopa shakes to warn the player that it will soon walk. To
;; shake the sprite, we temporily move layer 1 left or right by
;; one pixel.
;;
}

;;; $A152: Draw stunned Mecha Koopa (StunMechaKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Below timer 48 in [$1540], shakes it by toggling bit 0 of the screen X boundary during the draw. Carried:
;;     faces opposite Mario.
$01:A152 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$01:A154 48           PHA                             ; / Save low byte of screen X boundary
$01:A155 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:A158 C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; } Timer [$1540] >= 48: do not shake
$01:A15A B0 06        BCS $A162                       ; /
$01:A15C 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$01:A15E 45 1A        EOR RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } Odd timer: screen X boundary XOR 1 (1-pixel shake)
$01:A160 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; /
;; Come here if timer >= 48
$01:A162 22 07 B3 03  JSL.L $B307                     ; Draw the Mecha Koopa (bank 3 wrapper, probably the graphics)
$01:A166 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:A167 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; / Restore screen X boundary
$01:A169 BD C8 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X        ; \
$01:A16C C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; } Sprite not carried (status != $0B): return
$01:A16E D0 07        BNE $A177                       ; /
$01:A170 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$01:A172 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Sprite direction = opposite of Mario direction
$01:A174 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$01:A177 60           RTS                             ; Return

;; Draw a stunned Cheep-Cheep. (TODO - what is this?)
}

;;; $A178: Draw stunned Cheep Cheep (StunFish) ;;;
{
;; Advances the animation, sets palette bit 7 and draws with SubSprGfx2Entry1.
$01:A178 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance animation frame ([$1570])
$01:A17B BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:A17E 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; } Set sprite palette bit 7 (probably Y flip or priority flag)
$01:A180 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:A183 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite as one 16x16 tile
$01:A186 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; JSR subroutine
;;; takes X = index of this common sprite in the common sprite tables in RAM
;;; preserves X
;;;
;;; Shows graphics of a stationary sprite or a carried sprite. Without this routine, these sprites
;;; would be invisible. This routine handles all carryable sprites (including Koopa shells and
;;; P-balloons) and some other sprites?
;;;
;;; Kicked sprites (like kicked Koopa shells) use a different routine.
;;;
;;; RAM_SpriteAction,X is probably $09 (stationary or stunned) or $0B (carried by Mario).
;;;
$01:A187 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:A18A 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Sprite does not turn into a shell: skip to default drawing
$01:A18C F0 42        BEQ $A1D0                       ; /
;;
;; Given a sprite number, branch to the correct case (so that at a
;; shell looks like a shell, not a springboard). We have here a
;; sequence of comparisons instead of a jump table.
;;
;; http://www.smwcentral.net/?p=thread&id=7562 is a list of sprite
;; numbers. Sprite $53 is not in the list, but we verified that it
;; is a grab block (aka a throw block).
;;
$01:A18E B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:A190 C9 A2        CMP.B #$A2                      ; \
$01:A192 F0 BE        BEQ StunMechaKoopa              ; / $A2 Mecha Koopa
$01:A194 C9 15        CMP.B #$15                      ; \
$01:A196 F0 E0        BEQ StunFish                    ; / $15 horizontal Cheep Cheep
$01:A198 C9 16        CMP.B #$16                      ; \
$01:A19A F0 DC        BEQ StunFish                    ; / $16 vertical Cheep Cheep
$01:A19C C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:A19E F0 8F        BEQ StunGoomba                  ; / $0F Goomba
$01:A1A0 C9 53        CMP.B #$53                      ; \
$01:A1A2 F0 30        BEQ StunThrowBlock              ; / $53 grab block
$01:A1A4 C9 2C        CMP.B #$2C                      ; \
$01:A1A6 F0 40        BEQ StunYoshiEgg                ; / $2C Yoshi egg
$01:A1A8 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; \
$01:A1AA F0 47        BEQ StunKey                     ; / $80 key
$01:A1AC C9 7D        CMP.B #$7D                      ; \
$01:A1AE F0 23        BEQ $A1D3                       ; / $7D P-balloon: nothing to draw here
$01:A1B0 C9 3E        CMP.B #$3E                      ; \
$01:A1B2 F0 49        BEQ StunPow                     ; / $3E P-switch
$01:A1B4 C9 2F        CMP.B #$2F                      ; \
$01:A1B6 F0 71        BEQ StunSpringBoard             ; / $2F springboard
$01:A1B8 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; \
$01:A1BA F0 30        BEQ StunBomb                    ; / $0D Bob-omb
$01:A1BC C9 2D        CMP.B #$2D                      ; \
$01:A1BE F0 6C        BEQ StunBabyYoshi               ; / $2D baby Yoshi
$01:A1C0 C9 85        CMP.B #$85                      ; \
$01:A1C2 D0 0C        BNE $A1D0                       ; / Unused sprite $85: otherwise default
$01:A1C4 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw as one 16x16 tile
$01:A1C7 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:A1CA A9 47        LDA.B #$47                      ; } OAM tile = $47
$01:A1CC 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$01:A1CF 60           RTS                             ; Return
$01:A1D0 20 06 98     JSR.W $9806                     ; Draw all other sprites ($9806)
$01:A1D3 60           RTS                             ; Return

;; Draw a grab block (aka throw block) that is carried or is
;; stationary after being carried. In Super Mario World, grab
;; blocks start as blocks but become common sprites when someone
;; grabs them. As sprites, they blink by changing palettes.
;;
}

;;; $A1D4: Draw grab block (blinking) (StunThrowBlock) ;;;
{
;; Below timer $40 in [$1540], changes the palette every other frame (+2 mod $10) to blink, then draws like
;;     the Yoshi egg.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:999B: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
$01:A1D4 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:A1D7 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } Timer [$1540] >= 64: always change palette
$01:A1D9 B0 03        BCS $A1DE                       ; /
$01:A1DB 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:A1DC B0 0A        BCS StunYoshiEgg                ; / Below 64: skip the palette change on odd timer values
$01:A1DE BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:A1E1 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:A1E2 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:A1E3 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Sprite palette = ([palette] + 2) AND $0F (blink)
$01:A1E5 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
;; fall through to StunYoshiEgg

;; For Yoshi egg: call SubSprGfx2Entry1 immediately.
;; For grab block: call it after running above code.
}

;;; $A1E8: Draw Yoshi egg (StunYoshiEgg) ;;;
{
;; Draws one 16x16 tile via SubSprGfx2Entry1.
$01:A1E8 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw as one 16x16 tile
$01:A1EB 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $A1EC: Draw stunned Bob-omb (StunBomb) ;;;
{
;; Draws a 16x16 tile, then overrides its tile with $CA.
$01:A1EC 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw as one 16x16 tile
$01:A1EF A9 CA        LDA.B #$CA                      ; A = $CA (Bob-omb tile)
$01:A1F1 80 2F        BRA $A222                       ; Store tile

}

;;; $A1F3: Draw key (StunKey) ;;;
{
;; Faces opposite Mario if carried, draws a 16x16 tile, then overrides its tile with $EC.
$01:A1F3 20 69 A1     JSR.W $A169                     ; Face the opposite way when carried ($A169)
$01:A1F6 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw as one 16x16 tile
$01:A1F9 A9 EC        LDA.B #$EC                      ; A = $EC (key tile)
$01:A1FB 80 25        BRA $A222                       ; Store tile

}

;;; $A1FD: Draw P-switch (StunPow) ;;;
{
;; By [$163E] (probably press timer): 0 draws tile $42, 1 finishes via $9ACB, other values draw the
;;     squashed switch.
$01:A1FD BC 3E 16     LDY.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:A200 F0 16        BEQ $A218                       ; / Y = [$163E] (probably the pressed/squash timer): 0 = normal
$01:A202 C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; \
$01:A204 D0 03        BNE $A209                       ; / Not 1: continue
$01:A206 4C CB 9A     JMP.W $9ACB                     ; Timer = 1: finish the squash animation ($9ACB)

$01:A209 20 00 E7     JSR.W SmushedGfxRt              ; Draw the squashed P-switch
$01:A20C BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:A20F B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; |
$01:A212 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; } Clear bit 0 of OAM property (undo flip)
$01:A214 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:A217 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A218 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:A21A 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction = 1
$01:A21D 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw as one 16x16 tile
$01:A220 A9 42        LDA.B #$42                      ; A = $42 (P-switch tile)
$01:A222 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:A225 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Y = OAM index, set OAM tile = A
$01:A228 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $A229: Draw portable springboard (StunSpringBoard) ;;;
{
;; Tail call to $E6F0.
$01:A229 4C F0 E6     JMP.W $E6F0                     ; Draw the springboard ($E6F0)

}

;;; $A22C: Baby Yoshi: stunned/carried logic and draw (StunBabyYoshi) ;;;
{
;; Handles a carried or stationary baby Yoshi: looks for sprites to eat ($EA4E, [$160E] = slot of the
;;     item in the mouth, [$163E] eat timer),
;; hops when stunned, animates the eating (frames from $A35A) and moves the item into its mouth. A
;;     power-up ($74-$77) makes it grow into Yoshi
;; (sprite $35); other items count up in [$1570] and the fifth also grows it. Finally draws it and the item
;;     ($EA25).
;; Also contains the unused-looking branch for status $81 changing item.
$01:A22C A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:A22E D0 4B        BNE $A27B                       ; / Sprites locked: skip to the draw code
$01:A230 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A232 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A233 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:A235 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:A237 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:A23A 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } [$00]/[$08] = sprite X + 8 (low/high)
$01:A23C 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$01:A23E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:A240 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A241 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:A243 85 01        STA $01                         ; |
$01:A245 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:A248 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } [$01]/[$09] = sprite Y + 8 (low/high)
$01:A24A 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$01:A24C 22 FA B9 02  JSL.L $B9FA                     ; Look up the level tile at that point ($B9FA)
$01:A250 22 4E EA 02  JSL.L $EA4E                     ; Look for a sprite to eat ($EA4E)
$01:A254 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:A257 D0 25        BNE $A27E                       ; / Eating timer [$163E] non-zero: go to eating code
$01:A259 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:A25A 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / [$160E] = $FF (no sprite in mouth)
$01:A25D BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:A260 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; } Status not stunned (9): skip the hop
$01:A262 D0 09        BNE $A26D                       ; /
$01:A264 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:A267 F0 04        BEQ $A26D                       ; / Not on the ground: skip the hop
$01:A269 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:A26B 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = -16 (hop)
$01:A26D A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$01:A26F A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$01:A271 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; } Y = 0 unless frame counter bits 3-4 are clear
$01:A273 D0 02        BNE $A277                       ; /
$01:A275 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Blink frame: Y = 3
$01:A277 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:A278 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = Y
$01:A27B 4C 4F A3     JMP.W $A34F                     ; Go to the draw code

$01:A27E 9E EA 15     STZ.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Eating in progress: OAM index = 0
$01:A281 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; \
$01:A283 F0 03        BEQ $A288                       ; / Eat timer = $20: item gets swallowed now
$01:A285 4C 0A A3     JMP.W $A30A                     ; Otherwise go on with the eating animation ($A30A)

$01:A288 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = slot of the sprite in the mouth ([$160E])
$01:A28B A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:A28D 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Clear its sprite status (remove it)
$01:A290 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:A292 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $06
$01:A295 B9 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,Y                   ; \
$01:A298 D0 5A        BNE $A2F4                       ; / Eaten sprite's [$160E] non-zero: go to the counter at $01A2F4
$01:A29A B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:A29D C9 81        CMP.B #$81                      ; } Not the changing power-up sprite ($81): use its sprite number
$01:A29F D0 0C        BNE $A2AD                       ; /
$01:A2A1 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:A2A3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:A2A4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:A2A5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:A2A6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:A2A7 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = ([frame counter] >> 4) AND 3
$01:A2A9 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:A2AA B9 13 C3     LDA.W ChangingItemSprite,Y      ; A = sprite number shown by the changing item
$01:A2AD C9 74        CMP.B #$74                      ; \
$01:A2AF 90 43        BCC $A2F4                       ; / Below $74: not a power-up
$01:A2B1 C9 78        CMP.B #$78                      ; \
$01:A2B3 B0 3F        BCS $A2F4                       ; / $78 or above: not a power-up
$01:A2B5 9C AC 18     STZ.W $18AC                     ; Clear [$18AC]
$01:A2B8 9C 1E 14     STZ.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; No Yoshi wings
$01:A2BB A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; \
$01:A2BD 9D 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,X           ; / Sprite = $35 (Yoshi)
$01:A2C0 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:A2C2 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:A2C5 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:A2C7 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $1F
$01:A2CA B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:A2CC E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:A2CE 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:A2D0 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:A2D3 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Sprite Y -= 16
$01:A2D5 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:A2D8 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Save palette
$01:A2DB 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:A2DC 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; } Reset sprite tables (InitSpriteTables), restore palette
$01:A2E0 68           PLA                             ; /
$01:A2E1 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; \
$01:A2E3 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Clear palette bit 0
$01:A2E6 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:A2E8 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602] = $0C
$01:A2EB DE 0E 16     DEC.W $160E,X                   ; [$160E] = $FF
$01:A2EE A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:A2F0 8D E8 18     STA.W $18E8                     ; / [$18E8] = $40 (probably cooldown before it can eat again)
$01:A2F3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A2F4 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:A2F7 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; / Count of non-power-ups eaten: [$1570]++
$01:A2FA C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$01:A2FC D0 02        BNE $A300                       ; / Fifth item: grow anyway
$01:A2FE 80 B5        BRA $A2B5                       ; Grow into Yoshi

$01:A300 22 4A B3 05  JSL.L $B34A                     ; Run bonus routine ($B34A, increments [$13CC])
$01:A304 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:A306 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; / Give points (index 1)
$01:A30A BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:A30D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:A30E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:A30F 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = eating timer / 8
$01:A310 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:A311 B9 5A A3     LDA.W $A35A,Y                   ; \
$01:A314 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602] = $A35A[Y]
$01:A317 64 01        STZ $01                         ; [$01] = 0
$01:A319 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:A31C C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; } Timer < $20: skip moving the item
$01:A31E 90 2F        BCC $A34F                       ; /
$01:A320 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; \
$01:A322 4A           LSR                             ; } A = (timer - $10) / 4: item X offset
$01:A323 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:A324 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:A327 F0 05        BEQ $A32E                       ; |
$01:A329 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:A32B 1A           INC A                           ; } Direction 1 (left): negate offset, [$01] = $FF
$01:A32C C6 01        DEC $01                         ; /
$01:A32E BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = slot of the sprite in the mouth
$01:A331 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:A332 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:A334 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$01:A337 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:A33A 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } Item X = baby Yoshi X + offset (16-bit)
$01:A33C 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$01:A33F B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:A341 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A342 E9 02        SBC.B #$02                      ; |
$01:A344 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$01:A347 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:A34A E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Item Y = baby Yoshi Y - 2 (16-bit)
$01:A34C 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$01:A34F 20 69 A1     JSR.W $A169                     ; Face the opposite way when carried ($A169)
$01:A352 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw as one 16x16 tile
$01:A355 22 25 EA 02  JSL.L $EA25                     ; Draw the item in the mouth ($EA25)
$01:A359 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A35A..A363: Table: baby Yoshi eating frames ;;;
{
;; $01A35A: frames by eat timer / 8. $01A361 and $01A363: unreferenced two-byte tables.
$01:A35A              .db $00,$03,$02,$02,$01,$01,$01 ; Baby Yoshi eating frames, indexed by timer / 8

$01:A361              .db $10,$20                     ; Unused data: $10, $20

$01:A363              .db $01,$02                     ; Unused data: $01, $02

}

;;; $A365: Get sprite draw info and off-screen flags (GetDrawInfoBnk1) ;;;
{
;; Computes whether the sprite is off screen: [$15A0] horizontal, [$186C] bits 0-1 vertical, [$15C4] far off
;;     screen horizontally.
;; If far off screen, drops its return address so the caller returns to its own caller (skipping the draw
;;     routine).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
;; Returns: Y: OAM index of the sprite; $00: X relative to screen; $01: Y relative to screen.
;; $01A3DF (separate routine): hides OAM tiles 1/2 by setting X bit 8 when [$186C] bits are set.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8DE9: Draw Goomba wings (GoombaWingGfxRt)
;;     $01:9CF9: Draw sprite from four 8x8 tiles (SubSprGfx0Entry1)
;;     $01:9D70: Draw two stacked tiles, upright (SubSprGfx1Hlpr0)
;;     $01:9DD9: Draw two stacked tiles for sprite (SubSprGfx1Hlpr1)
;;     $01:9F0F: Draw single 16x16 tile sprite (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
;;     $01:AF54: Draw Thwomp (ThwompGfx)
;;     $01:B2DF: Draw checkerboard platform
;;     $01:B395: Draw staggered 8x8 platform (rock, orange) (FlyRockPlatTiles)
;;     $01:B666: Draw floating spike ball (FloatMineGfxProp)
;;     $01:B710: Turn block bridge, horizontal only (HorzTurnBlkBridge)
;;     $01:BCF0: Magikoopa magic graphics, smoke spawn (MagiKoopasMagicGfx)
;;     $01:C132: Goal tape movement, check and draw
;;     ... and 12 more
$01:A365 9E 6C 18     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; Clear vertical off-screen flags of this sprite
$01:A368 9E A0 15     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Clear horizontal off-screen flag ($15A0)
$01:A36B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A36D C5 1A        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:A36F BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:A372 E5 1B        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; |
$01:A374 F0 03        BEQ $A379                       ; } Horizontal off-screen flag [$15A0] = 1 if sprite X is not in the screen column
$01:A376 FE A0 15     INC.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; /
$01:A379 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:A37C EB           XBA                             ; |
$01:A37D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:A37F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; |
$01:A381 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A382 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:A384 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A385 69 40 00     ADC.W #$0040                    ; |
$01:A388 C9 80 01     CMP.W #$0180                    ; } Carry = 1 if (sprite X - screen X + $40) >= $0180: far off screen horizontally
$01:A38B E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /
$01:A38D 2A           ROL                             ; Carry into bit 0
$01:A38E 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Keep bit 0 only
$01:A390 9D C4 15     STA.W $15C4,X                   ; [$15C4] = 1 if the sprite is far off screen horizontally, else 0
$01:A393 D0 36        BNE $A3CB                       ; Far off screen: skip to the early exit
$01:A395 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: vertical test index (Y = 1 for tall sprites)
$01:A397 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:A39A C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; |
$01:A39C F0 08        BEQ $A3A6                       ; / Stunned (status 9): keep Y = 0
$01:A39E BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:A3A1 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Tweaker $190F bit 5 clear (not a 2-tile-high death frame): keep Y = 0
$01:A3A3 F0 01        BEQ $A3A6                       ; /
$01:A3A5 C8           INY                             ; Y = 1: use the taller extent
$01:A3A6 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = sprite Y low
$01:A3A8 18           CLC                             ; Prepare addition
$01:A3A9 79 61 A3     ADC.W $A361,Y                   ; A = Y + $A361[Y] ($10 or $20): bottom of the sprite
$01:A3AC 08           PHP                             ; Save carry of the addition
$01:A3AD C5 1C        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Compare with screen boundary Y low
$01:A3AF 26 00        ROL $00                         ; Shift the comparison carry into $00
$01:A3B1 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry of the addition
$01:A3B2 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; A = sprite Y high
$01:A3B5 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Add carry: high byte of Y + offset
$01:A3B7 46 00        LSR $00                         ; Recover comparison carry into carry
$01:A3B9 E5 1D        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; Subtract screen boundary Y high (with borrow)
$01:A3BB F0 09        BEQ $A3C6                       ; Zero: this extent is on screen, no flag
$01:A3BD BD 6C 18     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; \
$01:A3C0 19 63 A3     ORA.W $A363,Y                   ; } [$186C] |= $A363[Y] (bit 0/1: off screen at this extent)
$01:A3C3 9D 6C 18     STA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; /
$01:A3C6 88           DEY                             ; Next extent
$01:A3C7 10 DD        BPL $A3A6                       ; Loop for Y = 1 and 0
$01:A3C9 80 02        BRA $A3CD                       ; Done: skip the early exit

$01:A3CB 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:A3CC 68           PLA                             ; / Far off screen: drop the return address so the caller returns to its own caller
$01:A3CD BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of this sprite ($15EA)
$01:A3D0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A3D2 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A3D3 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } $00 = sprite X position relative to the screen
$01:A3D5 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:A3D7 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:A3D9 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A3DA E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } $01 = sprite Y position relative to the screen
$01:A3DC 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:A3DE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A3DF BD 6C 18     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; A = vertical off-screen flags [$186C]
$01:A3E2 F0 26        BEQ $A40A                       ; None: nothing to hide
$01:A3E4 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A3E5 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 into carry
$01:A3E6 90 10        BCC $A3F8                       ; Clear: skip first tile
$01:A3E8 48           PHA                             ; Save remaining flags
$01:A3E9 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$01:A3EB 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; OAM high bit for tile 1 = 1 (X bit 8, pushes it off screen)
$01:A3EE 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:A3EF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:A3F0 0A           ASL                             ; } X = OAM index * 4 (offset of the first tile)
$01:A3F1 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:A3F2 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80
$01:A3F4 9D 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,X               ; Tile 1 X = $80 (with X bit 8 set: off screen)
$01:A3F7 68           PLA                             ; Restore flags
$01:A3F8 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 1 into carry
$01:A3F9 90 0E        BCC $A409                       ; Clear: skip second tile
$01:A3FB A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$01:A3FD 99 61 04     STA.W $0461,Y                   ; OAM high bit for tile 2 = 1 (X bit 8)
$01:A400 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:A401 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:A402 0A           ASL                             ; } X = OAM index * 4
$01:A403 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:A404 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80
$01:A406 9D 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,X          ; Tile 2 X = $80 (off screen)
$01:A409 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A40A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A40B..A40B: Table: Y hitbox offsets for sprite interaction ;;;
{
$01:A40B              .db $02,$0A                     ; Hitbox Y offsets: $02 and $0A (small / tall by tweaker $1662)
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Sprite <-> Sprite interaction subroutine. To be called using JSL $018032 (SprSprInteract)
;How this works:
;
;-There are 12 sprite slots numbered from 0 (bottom) to 11 (top). And we need check
; every possible pair of sprites to see if a collision occurs. This handles it in
; colexicographical order-- like most loops, whose index decreases until -1 ($FF)
; and uses BMI/BPL to exit the loop.
;-How it processes every possible pair of sprites work like this:
; (1): We set the current sprite index X to be sprite A (the caller of $018032 (SprSprInteract)) and gets moved to the Y index.
;      We then take that current index, -1 it, and that will be the starting index for sprite B that is the X index to check with.
; (2): Each time we loop, the X index (for sprite B) goes from [Sprite_A_Slot - 1] to 0 (meaning all the lower slots to check
;      with Sprite A) to find every possible sprites slot index numbers to interact with.
; Here is what it looks like visually assuming sprite A is slot 11:
;  A dash, B and A represent a sprite slot. A is sprite A (current sprite), and B is sprite B.
;   ----------BA (Sprite_A:11, Sprite_B:10)
;   ---------B-A (Sprite_A:11, Sprite_B:09)
;   --------B--A (Sprite_A:11, Sprite_B:08)
;   ....
;   -B---------A (Sprite_A:11, Sprite_B:01)
;   B----------A (Sprite_A:11, Sprite_B:00)
;
;Also, this only runs every other frame because this is very performance-heavy. Assume all 12 slots uses this subroutine,
;and we select 2 sprites to see if they overlap. Using the combination formula with 12 items and selecting 2: (12!)/(2!(12-2)!),
;there are 66 possible combinations of pairs of sprites interacting with each other, without repetition (any slot should not
;interact with itself). Done by checking if sprite A's index and the frame counter are both even or odd, then don't process,
;else if one is even and other is odd, then process interaction.
;
;Because of this, when 2 sprites are colliding, only one sprite with the highest slot number that called $018032 will process
;the interaction of both. With this "one-way" handling, this also prevents executing the code twice for each of the 2 sprites
;being processed.
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
}

;;; $A40D: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop (SubSprSprInteract) ;;;
{
;; Called via JSL $018032. Tests sprite A (X on entry) against every lower slot B, every other frame, and
;;     dispatches on both statuses.
;; Outcomes: turn both around, a kicked/carried sprite kills the other, or both die. Statuses: 8 normal, 9
;;     stunned, 10 kicked, 11 carried.
;; Parameters: X: sprite A index. Uses $1695 = sprite B, $00-$03 as scratch. Returns with X = sprite A.
;; Outcome code at $01A5C4: kicked/carried sprite B kills A (hedged: roles of X/Y swap inside $01A77C).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8035: Sprite-to-sprite interaction (SprSprInteract)
;;     $01:8B03: Koopa/Goomba/etc: start (Spr0to13Start)
;;     $01:8BBD: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour (SpriteInAir)
;;     $01:8FC1: Interact with sprites and Mario (SubSprSpr+MarioSpr)
;;     $01:A005: Carried sprite: interaction and release (NotCarryingBalloon)
;;     $01:ADF8: Flying question block main (Flying?Block)
;;     $01:B0EA: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:E5B9: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
$01:A40D 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:A40E F0 FA        BEQ $A40A                       ; / No sprites below sprite A (slot 0): nothing to do
$01:A410 A8           TAY                             ; Y = sprite A index (the caller)
$01:A411 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:A413 4A           LSR                             ; } Return unless sprite A and the frame counter differ in bit 0 (runs every other frame)
$01:A414 90 F4        BCC $A40A                       ; /
$01:A416 CA           DEX                             ; X = sprite B = first slot below sprite A
;---------------------------------------------------------------------
;This is where the loop starts and handles each slot below sprite_A
;---------------------------------------------------------------------
$01:A417 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:A41A C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:A41C B0 03        BCS $A421                       ; } Sprite B status < 8: skip to next slot
$01:A41E 4C B0 A4     JMP.W $A4B0                     ; /

$01:A421 BD 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; \
$01:A424 19 86 16     ORA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y         ; } A = (tweaker $1686 of B or A) bit 3: no sprite-sprite interaction
$01:A427 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; /
$01:A429 1D 64 15     ORA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$01:A42C 19 64 15     ORA.W $1564,Y                   ; / OR in the intangibility timers $1564 of both sprites
$01:A42F 1D D0 15     ORA.W $15D0,X                   ; OR in $15D0 (B is on Yoshi's tongue)
$01:A432 1D 32 16     ORA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; \
$01:A435 59 32 16     EOR.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,Y       ; / OR in layer difference: sprites must be in front of/behind the scenery together
$01:A438 D0 76        BNE $A4B0                       ; Any condition set: next slot
$01:A43A 8E 95 16     STX.W $1695                     ; $1695 = sprite B index (X gets reused)
$01:A43D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A43F 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:A441 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:A444 85 01        STA $01                         ; |
$01:A446 B9 E4 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$01:A449 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$01:A44B B9 E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; } $00-$01 = X position of B, $02-$03 = X position of A
$01:A44E 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:A450 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:A452 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:A454 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A455 E5 02        SBC $02                         ; |
$01:A457 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A458 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; |
$01:A45B C9 20 00     CMP.W #$0020                    ; } If |X distance| >= $10 (A + $10 >= $20): not touching, next slot
$01:A45E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; |
$01:A460 B0 4E        BCS $A4B0                       ; /
$01:A462 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: hitbox offset index for B
$01:A464 BD 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; \
$01:A467 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:A469 F0 01        BEQ $A46C                       ; } Y = 1 if tweaker $1662 low nibble of B is non-zero (tall hitbox)
$01:A46B C8           INY                             ; /
$01:A46C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:A46E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A46F 79 0B A4     ADC.W $A40B,Y                   ; |
$01:A472 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:A474 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:A477 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $00-$01 = Y position of B + $A40B[Y]
$01:A479 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:A47B AC E9 15     LDY.W $15E9                     ; Y = sprite A index again ($15E9)
$01:A47E A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: hitbox offset index for A
$01:A480 B9 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,Y         ; \
$01:A483 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:A485 F0 01        BEQ $A488                       ; } X = 1 if tweaker $1662 low nibble of A is non-zero (tall hitbox)
$01:A487 E8           INX                             ; /
$01:A488 B9 D8 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; \
$01:A48B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A48C 7D 0B A4     ADC.W $A40B,X                   ; |
$01:A48F 85 02        STA $02                         ; |
$01:A491 B9 D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; |
$01:A494 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $02-$03 = Y position of A + $A40B[X]
$01:A496 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:A498 AE 95 16     LDX.W $1695                     ; X = sprite B index again
$01:A49B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:A49D A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:A49F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A4A0 E5 02        SBC $02                         ; |
$01:A4A2 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A4A3 69 0C 00     ADC.W #$000C                    ; |
$01:A4A6 C9 18 00     CMP.W #$0018                    ; } If |Y distance| >= $0C (A + $0C >= $18): not touching, next slot
$01:A4A9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; |
$01:A4AB B0 03        BCS $A4B0                       ; /
$01:A4AD 20 BA A4     JSR.W $A4BA                     ; Contact: decide the outcome from both statuses
$01:A4B0 CA           DEX                             ; \
$01:A4B1 30 03        BMI $A4B6                       ; } Next slot, loop until X < 0
$01:A4B3 4C 17 A4     JMP.W $A417                     ; /

$01:A4B6 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite A index
$01:A4B9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A4BA B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; A = status of sprite A
$01:A4BD C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8?
$01:A4BF F0 0D        BEQ $A4CE                       ; Normal: dispatch on B at $01A4CE
$01:A4C1 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9?
$01:A4C3 F0 1D        BEQ $A4E2                       ; Stunned: $01A4E2
$01:A4C5 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Status 10?
$01:A4C7 F0 3D        BEQ $A506                       ; Kicked: $01A506
$01:A4C9 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; Status 11?
$01:A4CB F0 4D        BEQ $A51A                       ; Carried: $01A51A
$01:A4CD 60           RTS                             ; Other status: no interaction

$01:A4CE BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = status of sprite B
$01:A4D1 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8?
$01:A4D3 F0 68        BEQ $A53D                       ; A normal, B normal: $01A53D (turn both around)
$01:A4D5 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9?
$01:A4D7 F0 67        BEQ $A540                       ; A normal, B stunned: $01A540
$01:A4D9 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Status 10?
$01:A4DB F0 5A        BEQ $A537                       ; A normal, B kicked: $01A537 (B kills A)
$01:A4DD C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; Status 11?
$01:A4DF F0 53        BEQ $A534                       ; A normal, B carried: $01A534 (both die)
$01:A4E1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A4E2 B9 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,Y        ; \
$01:A4E5 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } A is stunned: branch if A is on the ground
$01:A4E7 D0 09        BNE $A4F2                       ; /
$01:A4E9 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:A4EC C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; } A is a Goomba (sprite $0F)? then both die
$01:A4EE F0 44        BEQ $A534                       ; /
$01:A4F0 80 14        BRA $A506                       ; Otherwise handle like a kicked A

$01:A4F2 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = status of sprite B (A stunned on ground)
$01:A4F5 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8?
$01:A4F7 F0 47        BEQ $A540                       ; B normal: $01A540
$01:A4F9 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9?
$01:A4FB F0 58        BEQ $A555                       ; B stunned: $01A555
$01:A4FD C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Status 10?
$01:A4FF F0 39        BEQ $A53A                       ; B kicked: $01A5C4
$01:A501 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; Status 11?
$01:A503 F0 2F        BEQ $A534                       ; B carried: $01A534 (both die)
$01:A505 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A506 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = status of sprite B (A kicked)
$01:A509 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8?
$01:A50B F0 21        BEQ $A52E                       ; B normal: $01A52E (A kills B)
$01:A50D C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9?
$01:A50F F0 20        BEQ $A531                       ; B stunned: $01A531
$01:A511 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Status 10?
$01:A513 F0 1F        BEQ $A534                       ; B kicked: $01A534 (both die)
$01:A515 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; Status 11?
$01:A517 F0 1B        BEQ $A534                       ; B carried: $01A534 (both die)
$01:A519 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A51A BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = status of sprite B (A carried)
$01:A51D C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8?
$01:A51F F0 13        BEQ $A534                       ; Any of statuses 8-11 for B: both die ($01A534)
$01:A521 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9?
$01:A523 F0 0F        BEQ $A534                       ; B stunned: both die
$01:A525 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Status 10?
$01:A527 F0 0B        BEQ $A534                       ; B kicked: both die
$01:A529 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; Status 11?
$01:A52B F0 07        BEQ $A534                       ; B carried: both die
$01:A52D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A52E 4C 25 A6     JMP.W $A625                     ; Jump: A kicked kills B normal ($01A625)

$01:A531 4C 42 A6     JMP.W $A642                     ; Jump: A kicked hits B stunned ($01A642)

$01:A534 4C 85 A6     JMP.W $A685                     ; Jump: both sprites die ($01A685)

$01:A537 4C C4 A5     JMP.W $A5C4                     ; Jump: B kicked kills A ($01A5C4)

$01:A53A 4C C4 A5     JMP.W $A5C4                     ; Jump: B kicked kills A ($01A5C4)

$01:A53D 4C 6D A5     JMP.W $A56D                     ; Jump: both turn around ($01A56D)

$01:A540 20 D9 A6     JSR.W $A6D9                     ; Maybe kick/hop for X over Y (X = B, Y = A)
$01:A543 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A544 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:A545 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:A546 9B           TXY                             ; } Swap X and Y
$01:A547 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:A548 20 D9 A6     JSR.W $A6D9                     ; Same check with the roles swapped
$01:A54B 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:A54C FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A54D BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:A550 19 58 15     ORA.W $1558,Y                   ; } Return if either sprite has its $1558 timer running (kick/hop in progress)
$01:A553 D0 6E        BNE $A5C3                       ; /
$01:A555 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = status of sprite B
$01:A558 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; Status 9?
$01:A55A D0 11        BNE $A56D                       ; Not stunned: turn around
$01:A55C 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Is B on the ground?
$01:A55F D0 0C        BNE $A56D                       ; On ground: turn around
$01:A561 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A563 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; } Airborne stunned B: Goomba (sprite $0F)? if not, B kills A
$01:A565 D0 03        BNE $A56A                       ; /
$01:A567 4C 85 A6     JMP.W $A685                     ; Goomba: both die

$01:A56A 4C C4 A5     JMP.W $A5C4                     ; Jump: B kills A ($01A5C4)

$01:A56D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A56F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A570 F9 E4 00     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$01:A573 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:A576 F9 E0 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; |
$01:A579 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:A57A 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } $00 = 1 if B is left of A (sign of X difference B - A)
$01:A57C 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:A57E B9 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y         ; \
$01:A581 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Tweaker $1686 bit 4 of A set (do not turn when touched): skip A
$01:A583 D0 1C        BNE $A5A1                       ; /
$01:A585 AC E9 15     LDY.W $15E9                     ; Y = sprite A index
$01:A588 B9 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; \
$01:A58B 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:A58C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$01:A58E 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; } Set A facing = $00, remembering the old direction
$01:A591 68           PLA                             ; /
$01:A592 D9 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; Did the direction change?
$01:A595 F0 0A        BEQ $A5A1                       ; No: skip the turn timer
$01:A597 B9 AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,Y                   ; \
$01:A59A D0 05        BNE $A5A1                       ; / Turn timer $15AC of A already set: skip
$01:A59C A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:A59E 99 AC 15     STA.W $15AC,Y                   ; / $15AC,A = 8 (turning animation)
$01:A5A1 BD 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; \
$01:A5A4 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Tweaker $1686 bit 4 of B set: return
$01:A5A6 D0 1B        BNE $A5C3                       ; /
$01:A5A8 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:A5AB 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:A5AC A5 00        LDA $00                         ; |
$01:A5AE 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:A5B0 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } Set B facing = $00 EOR 1, remembering the old direction
$01:A5B3 68           PLA                             ; /
$01:A5B4 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Did the direction change?
$01:A5B7 F0 0A        BEQ $A5C3                       ; No: return
$01:A5B9 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:A5BC D0 05        BNE $A5C3                       ; / Turn timer $15AC of B already set: return
$01:A5BE A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:A5C0 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / $15AC,B = 8 (turning animation)
$01:A5C3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A5C4 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:A5C7 38           SEC                             ; } Is sprite A a Flying Question Block ($83 or $84)? If not, go kill it
$01:A5C8 E9 83        SBC.B #$83                      ; |
$01:A5CA C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; /
$01:A5CC B0 0C        BCS $A5DA                       ; Not a flying block: $01A5DA
$01:A5CE 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Flip B's direction (it bounces off the block)
$01:A5D1 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; B Y speed = 0
$01:A5D3 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A5D4 BB           TYX                             ; X = block sprite (A)
$01:A5D5 20 E2 B4     JSR.W $B4E2                     ; Block bounce: timer and sound
$01:A5D8 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A5D9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A5DA AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite A index
$01:A5DD AC 95 16     LDY.W $1695                     ; Y = sprite B index ($1695)
$01:A5E0 20 7C A7     JSR.W $A77C                     ; Special case: Shell-less Koopa hit by a shell (may skip the kill)
$01:A5E3 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:A5E5 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Sprite A status = 2 (killed, falls off screen)
$01:A5E8 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A5E9 BB           TYX                             ; X = sprite A
$01:A5EA 22 72 AB 01  JSL.L $AB72                     ; Kick sound, smoke puff at the killed sprite
$01:A5EE FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A5EF B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = B X speed
$01:A5F1 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = direction of motion
$01:A5F2 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$01:A5F4 90 02        BCC $A5F8                       ; Moving right: keep $10
$01:A5F6 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; Moving left: A = $F0
$01:A5F8 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; A speed X = $10 / $F0 (away)
$01:A5FB A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$01:A5FD 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; A Y speed = $D0 (jumps up as it dies)
$01:A600 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:A601 FE 26 16     INC.W $1626,X                   ; \
$01:A604 BC 26 16     LDY.W $1626,X                   ; / B consecutive-kill counter $1626++, Y = count
$01:A607 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$01:A609 B0 06        BCS $A611                       ; / Count >= 8: no sound
$01:A60B B9 1D A6     LDA.W $A61D,Y                   ; \
$01:A60E 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $1DF9 = rising pitch kill sound for this count
$01:A611 98           TYA                             ; } A = min(count, 8)
$01:A612 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:A614 90 02        BCC $A618                       ; |
$01:A616 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; /
$01:A618 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:A619 22 E1 AC 02  JSL.L $ACE1                     ; Give points for the kill (A = chain count)
$01:A61D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}
