;;; $A625: Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce ;;;
{
;; $01A625: kicked A hits normal B (B killed, unless Flying Question Block, which bounces).
;; $01A642: kicked A hits stunned B (killed if B on ground, else both die).
;; $01A64A: kill B: counts A's chain in $1626, plays sound, gives points, sets status 2, knocks B away.
;; $01A685: both sprites die (or flying blocks bounce): Y speed $D0, 1000 points?, pushed apart.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A52E: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop (SubSprSprInteract)
$01:A625 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A627 38           SEC                             ; } Is sprite B a Flying Question Block ($83/$84)? If not, kill it
$01:A628 E9 83        SBC.B #$83                      ; |
$01:A62A C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; /
$01:A62C B0 0F        BCS $A63D                       ; Not a flying block: $01A63D
$01:A62E DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A62F BB           TYX                             ; X = sprite A
$01:A630 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Flip A's direction
$01:A633 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A634 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$01:A636 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; A Y speed = 0
$01:A639 20 E2 B4     JSR.W $B4E2                     ; Block bounce for B (timer, sound)
$01:A63C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A63D 20 7C A7     JSR.W $A77C                     ; Special case: Shell-less Koopa hit by a shell
$01:A640 80 08        BRA $A64A                       ; Go kill B

$01:A642 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Is B on the ground?
$01:A645 D0 03        BNE $A64A                       ; On the ground: kill B ($01A64A)
$01:A647 4C 85 A6     JMP.W $A685                     ; Airborne: both die

$01:A64A DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A64B B9 26 16     LDA.W $1626,Y                   ; \
$01:A64E 1A           INC A                           ; } A consecutive-kill counter $1626++
$01:A64F 99 26 16     STA.W $1626,Y                   ; /
$01:A652 BE 26 16     LDX.W $1626,Y                   ; \
$01:A655 E0 08        CPX.B #$08                      ; |
$01:A657 B0 06        BCS $A65F                       ; |
$01:A659 BD 1D A6     LDA.W $A61D,X                   ; } Play kill sound for this count (max 7)
$01:A65C 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; /
$01:A65F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:A660 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } A = min(count, 8)
$01:A662 90 02        BCC $A666                       ; |
$01:A664 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; /
$01:A666 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A667 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points (200, 400, 800, 1000... by chain)
$01:A66B A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:A66D 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / B status = 2 (killed)
$01:A670 22 72 AB 01  JSL.L $AB72                     ; Kick sound, smoke puff at B
$01:A674 B9 B6 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; A = A X speed
$01:A677 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = direction
$01:A678 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$01:A67A 90 02        BCC $A67E                       ; Moving right: keep
$01:A67C A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; Moving left: A = $F0
$01:A67E 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; B X speed = $10 / $F0 (away from A)
$01:A680 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$01:A682 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; B Y speed = $D0
$01:A684 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A685 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A687 C9 83        CMP.B #$83                      ; |
$01:A689 F0 0F        BEQ $A69A                       ; } Is B a Flying Question Block ($83/$84)? then bounce it instead of killing
$01:A68B C9 84        CMP.B #$84                      ; |
$01:A68D F0 0B        BEQ $A69A                       ; /
$01:A68F A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:A691 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / B status = 2 (killed)
$01:A694 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$01:A696 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; B Y speed = $D0
$01:A698 80 03        BRA $A69D                       ; Continue with A

$01:A69A 20 E2 B4     JSR.W $B4E2                     ; Block bounce for B
$01:A69D B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:A6A0 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; |
$01:A6A2 F0 17        BEQ $A6BB                       ; |
$01:A6A4 C9 83        CMP.B #$83                      ; |
$01:A6A6 F0 10        BEQ $A6B8                       ; } A is Key ($80)? skip. Flying Question Block ($83/$84)? bounce it
$01:A6A8 C9 84        CMP.B #$84                      ; |
$01:A6AA F0 0C        BEQ $A6B8                       ; /
$01:A6AC A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:A6AE 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / A status = 2 (killed)
$01:A6B1 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$01:A6B3 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; A Y speed = $D0
$01:A6B6 80 03        BRA $A6BB                       ; Continue

$01:A6B8 20 D3 A5     JSR.W $A5D3                     ; Block bounce for A
$01:A6BB 22 6F AB 01  JSL.L $AB6F                     ; Kick sound, smoke puff
$01:A6BF A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4
$01:A6C1 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points (4 = 1000?)
$01:A6C5 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = B X speed
$01:A6C7 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = sign
$01:A6C8 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$01:A6CA B0 02        BCS $A6CE                       ; Moving left: keep $10
$01:A6CC A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; Moving right: A = $F0
$01:A6CE 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; B X speed = $10 / $F0 (reverse)
$01:A6D0 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:A6D2 1A           INC A                           ; / A = -A
$01:A6D3 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; A X speed = opposite of B (bounce apart)
$01:A6D6 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$01:A6D7              .db $30,$D0                     ; Kick speeds: $30 (right), $D0 (left)

;;; $A6D9: Shell-less Koopa walks into shell ;;;
{
;; If X kicks/hops into shells (tweaker $1656 bit 6), both are on the ground, facing and not within 8 pixels:
;; Blue Shell-less Koopa starts a kick animation; other sprites go to HopIntoShell.
;; Parameters: X: sprite, Y: other sprite.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A540: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop (SubSprSprInteract)
;;     $01:A548: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop (SubSprSprInteract)
$01:A6D9 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = Y index
$01:A6DB 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Is X on the ground?
$01:A6DE F0 4D        BEQ $A72D                       ; No: return
$01:A6E0 B9 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,Y        ; \
$01:A6E3 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Return unless Y is on the ground
$01:A6E5 F0 46        BEQ $A72D                       ; /
$01:A6E7 BD 56 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X         ; \
$01:A6EA 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; } Return unless X kicks/hops into shells (tweaker $1656 bit 6)
$01:A6EC F0 3F        BEQ $A72D                       ; /
$01:A6EE B9 58 15     LDA.W $1558,Y                   ; \
$01:A6F1 1D 58 15     ORA.W $1558,X                   ; } Return if either $1558 timer is running
$01:A6F4 D0 37        BNE $A72D                       ; /
$01:A6F6 64 02        STZ $02                         ; $02 = 0
$01:A6F8 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A6FA 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:A6FB F9 E4 00     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; } A = X low difference X - Y; sign selects side
$01:A6FE 30 02        BMI $A702                       ; /
$01:A700 E6 02        INC $02                         ; $02 = 1 if X is right of Y
$01:A702 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:A703 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:A705 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; } Return if the sprites are within 8 pixels horizontally
$01:A707 90 24        BCC $A72D                       ; /
$01:A709 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:A70C C5 02        CMP $02                         ; } Return unless X faces toward Y
$01:A70E D0 1D        BNE $A72D                       ; /
$01:A710 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A712 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Not a Blue Shell-less Koopa (sprite 2): hop into the shell
$01:A714 D0 18        BNE HopIntoShell                ; /
$01:A716 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$01:A718 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; $163E,X = $20 (kick animation timer?)
$01:A71B 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; $1558,X = $20
$01:A71E A9 23        LDA.B #$23                      ; A = $23
$01:A720 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; $1564,X = $23
$01:A723 98           TYA                             ; A = Y index
$01:A724 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; $160E,X = shell sprite index
$01:A727 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $A728: Play kick sound (PlayKickSfx) ;;;
{
;; Sound effect $1DF9 = 3 (kick). Its RTS is shared with the early-out branches of the previous routine.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8986: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:A8F2: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:AA97: Bounce Mario off a sprite (BoostMarioSpeed)
;;     $01:AB6F: Spawn contact smoke at sprite
$01:A728 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:A72A 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $1DF9 = 3 (kick)
$01:A72D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $A72E: Hop into or flip shell (HopIntoShell) ;;;
{
;; Y = shell sprite (number < $0F), X = Koopa. If the shell is upside down it is flipped back up; otherwise
;;     the Koopa hops up
;; and the pair are linked via $1594.
$01:A72E B9 40 15     LDA.W $1540,Y                   ; \
$01:A731 D0 44        BNE $A777                       ; / Return if $1540,Y timer is set
$01:A733 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:A736 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; } Return if sprite Y is >= $0F (not a Koopa or shell)
$01:A738 B0 3D        BCS $A777                       ; /
$01:A73A B9 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,Y        ; \
$01:A73D 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Return if Y is not on the ground
$01:A73F F0 36        BEQ $A777                       ; /
$01:A741 B9 F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,Y           ; \
$01:A744 10 17        BPL $A75D                       ; / $15F6,Y bit 7 clear (shell right-side up): go hop
$01:A746 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; \
$01:A748 99 F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,Y           ; / Shell is upside down: clear the flip bit
$01:A74B A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$01:A74D 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / Y Y speed = $E0 (toss the shell up)
$01:A750 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:A752 99 64 15     STA.W $1564,Y                   ; / $1564,Y = $20
$01:A755 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$01:A757 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Koopa X state [$C2] = $20
$01:A759 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; $1558,X = $20
$01:A75C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A75D A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$01:A75F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / X Y speed = $E0 (hop up)
$01:A761 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; A = $164A,X (in water flag)
$01:A764 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Carry = 1 if in water
$01:A766 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; A = $18
$01:A768 90 02        BCC $A76C                       ; Out of water: keep $18
$01:A76A A9 2C        LDA.B #$2C                      ; In water: A = $2C
$01:A76C 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; $1558,X = hop timer
$01:A76F 8A           TXA                             ; A = X
$01:A770 99 94 15     STA.W $1594,Y                   ; $1594,Y = X (link the pair)
$01:A773 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$01:A774 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; $1594,X = Y
$01:A777 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A77C: Shell-less Koopa catches shell ;;;
{
;; Special case for sprite 2 (Blue Shell-less Koopa): when hit by a shell facing the opposite way, places the
;;     shell at its side
;; and skips the kill code by dropping its return address. Falls into the encoded STZ at Instr01A799.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A5E0: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop (SubSprSprInteract)
;;     $01:A63D: Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce
$01:A77C B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number of X
$01:A77E C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Blue Shell-less Koopa (2)?
$01:A780 D0 40        BNE $A7C2                       ; No: normal handling
$01:A782 B9 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,Y                   ; A = $187B,Y
$01:A785 D0 3B        BNE $A7C2                       ; Non-zero: normal handling
$01:A787 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:A78A D9 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; } Same facing as Y: normal handling
$01:A78D F0 33        BEQ $A7C2                       ; /
$01:A78F 84 01        STY $01                         ; $01 = Y index
$01:A791 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; Y = $1534,X
$01:A794 D0 2A        BNE $A7C0                       ; Already set: return to the caller's caller ($01A7C0)
$01:A796 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; Clear $1528,X

}

;;; $A799: STZ $163E,X then position shell (Instr01A799) ;;;
{
;; The first three bytes are an STZ.W $163E,X written as data. Then the shell is moved next to the Koopa and
;;     linked with $160E/$1534.
$01:A799              .db $9E,$3E,$16                 ; STZ $163E,X (stored as data bytes)

$01:A79C A8           TAY                             ; Y = A (facing of X)
$01:A79D 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = facing
$01:A79F B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:A7A1 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:A7A2 79 78 A7     ADC.W $A778,Y                   ; |
$01:A7A5 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; } Shell X low = X low + $A778[facing]
$01:A7A7 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; /
$01:A7AA BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:A7AD A4 00        LDY $00                         ; |
$01:A7AF 79 7A A7     ADC.W $A77A,Y                   ; |
$01:A7B2 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; } Shell X high = X high + $A77A[facing]
$01:A7B4 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$01:A7B7 98           TYA                             ; A = shell index
$01:A7B8 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; $160E,X = shell index
$01:A7BB A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$01:A7BD 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; $1534,X = 1
$01:A7C0 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:A7C1 68           PLA                             ; / Drop the return address (skip the caller's kill code)
$01:A7C2 AE 95 16     LDX.W $1695                     ; X = sprite B index
$01:A7C5 AC E9 15     LDY.W $15E9                     ; Y = sprite A index
$01:A7C8 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

{
$01:A7C9              .db $00,$01,$02,$03,$04,$05,$06,$07 ; 00-07 - identity
$01:A7D1              .db $04,$04,$05,$05,$07,$00,$00,$0F ; 08-0F - 04,04,05,05,07,00,00,0F
$01:A7D9              .db $0F,$0F,$0D                 ; 10-12 - 0F,0F,0D

;;; $A7DC: Long wrapper: Mario-sprite interaction (MarioSprInteract) ;;;
{
;; Sets data bank to $01 and calls MarioSprInteractRt. Returns Carry = contact.
;; Called by:
;;     $02:80BC: Bob-omb explosion: damage and graphics (ExplodeBombGfx)
;;     $02:B6BA: Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)
;;     $02:BD46: Wall-follower sprites main and Spike Top graphics (WallFollowersMain)
;;     $02:C7A2: Chuck: interact with Mario
;;     $02:D59F: Banzai Bill main
;;     $02:D750: Banzai Bill, ball and chain, chained platform (Banzai+Rotating)
;;     $02:D961: Bubble sprite: logic and contents release (BubbleSprGfxProp4)
;;     $02:E34D: Gas Bubble movement
;;     $02:E5E8: Moving ledge (hole) sprite main (MovingLedgeMain)
;;     $02:EADA: Warp hole sprite and Feather spawn (WarpBlocksMain)
;;     $02:EE57: Floating skull raft main (FloatingSkullMain)
;;     $03:87D7: Mega Mole: turn at walls, Mario contact (MegaMoleOnGround)
;;     ... and 17 more
$01:A7DC 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$01:A7DD 4B           PHK                             ; Push bank
$01:A7DE AB           PLB                             ; Data bank = $01
$01:A7DF 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Run the interaction check (Carry = contact)
$01:A7E2 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:A7E3 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $A7E4: Mario-sprite interaction rate check (MarioSprInteractRt) ;;;
{
;; Runs ProcessInteract every frame if tweaker $167A bit 5 is set, else only every other frame and when on
;;     screen.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8773: Goal Point Question Sphere (GoalSphere)
;;     $01:8937: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:8943: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03) (ShellessKoopas)
;;     $01:8B00: Koopa/Goomba/etc: start (Spr0to13Start)
;;     $01:8BBA: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour (SpriteInAir)
;;     $01:8F46: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:8FC4: Interact with sprites and Mario (SubSprSpr+MarioSpr)
;;     $01:A7DF: Long wrapper: Mario-sprite interaction (MarioSprInteract)
;;     $01:AEB4: Thwomp main (Thwomp)
;;     $01:AFAD: Thwimp main (Thwimp)
;;     $01:B0ED: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B5AF: Floating platforms and spike ball physics (Platforms2)
;;     ... and 14 more
$01:A7E4 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:A7E7 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Tweaker $167A bit 5: process every frame
$01:A7E9 D0 0C        BNE ProcessInteract             ; /
$01:A7EB 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:A7EC 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$01:A7EE 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:A7F0 1D A0 15     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; } Only every other frame, and only if on screen horizontally
$01:A7F3 F0 02        BEQ ProcessInteract             ; /
}

;;; $A7F5: Return: no contact (ReturnNoContact) ;;;
{
;; Carry clear, return.
$01:A7F5 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear: no contact
$01:A7F6 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $A7F7: Test Mario against sprite (ProcessInteract) ;;;
{
;; Checks distance, animation, layer and hitbox overlap. Returns Carry = 1 on contact.
;; If tweaker $167A bit 7 is clear, continues into DefaultInteractR.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:B457: Make Mario stand on or bump sprite (InvisBlkMainRt)
;;     $01:E6B0: Portable springboard main routine (SpringBoard)
;;     $01:E809: Lakitu's cloud logic (NoCloudGfx)
$01:A7F7 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal distance to Mario: $0F, Y = side
$01:A7FA A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = $0F
$01:A7FC 18           CLC                             ; Prepare
$01:A7FD 69 50        ADC.B #$50                      ; A + $50
$01:A7FF C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; Within +/-$50 horizontally?
$01:A801 B0 F2        BCS ReturnNoContact             ; No: no contact
$01:A803 20 42 AD     JSR.W $AD42                     ; Vertical distance to Mario into $0E
$01:A806 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; A = $0E
$01:A808 18           CLC                             ; Prepare
$01:A809 69 60        ADC.B #$60                      ; A + $60
$01:A80B C9 C0        CMP.B #$C0                      ; Within +/-$60 vertically?
$01:A80D B0 E6        BCS ReturnNoContact             ; No: no contact
$01:A80F A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$01:A811 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Mario animation sequence active: no contact
$01:A813 B0 E0        BCS ReturnNoContact             ; /
$01:A815 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:A817 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; } Boss room mode 7 ([$0D9B] bit 6): skip the layer test
$01:A81A 70 06        BVS $A822                       ; /
$01:A81C AD F9 13     LDA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; A = Mario behind scenery flag
$01:A81F 5D 32 16     EOR.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; EOR the sprite behind-scenery flag
$01:A822 D0 58        BNE ReturnNoContact2            ; Different layers: no contact
$01:A824 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario hitbox
$01:A828 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get sprite hitbox
$01:A82C 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Test boxes for overlap (Carry = contact)
$01:A830 90 4A        BCC ReturnNoContact2            ; No overlap: no contact
$01:A832 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:A835 10 04        BPL DefaultInteractR            ; / Tweaker $167A bit 7 clear: use default interaction
$01:A837 38           SEC                             ; Carry set: contact; the sprite handles it itself
$01:A838 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $A839..A839: Table: star kill X speed ;;;
{
$01:A839              .db $F0,$10                     ; X speed by side of Mario: $F0, $10

}

;;; $A83B: Default Mario interaction: star kill (DefaultInteractR) ;;;
{
;; If Mario has star power and the sprite is not immune ($167A bit 1): kill the sprite with a chain score and
;;     sound, flung away from Mario.
;; Otherwise branches to $01A87E (next chunk).
$01:A83B AD 90 14     LDA.W $1490                     ; \
$01:A83E F0 3E        BEQ $A87E                       ; / Mario has star power ($1490)? if not, normal interaction
$01:A840 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:A843 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } Tweaker $167A bit 1 set (immune to star): normal interaction
$01:A845 D0 37        BNE $A87E                       ; /
$01:A847 22 6F AB 01  JSL.L $AB6F                     ; Kick sound, smoke puff
$01:A84B EE D2 18     INC.W $18D2                     ; Star kill counter $18D2++
$01:A84E AD D2 18     LDA.W $18D2                     ; A = counter
$01:A851 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Count < 8?
$01:A853 90 05        BCC $A85A                       ; Yes: ok
$01:A855 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8
$01:A857 8D D2 18     STA.W $18D2                     ; Cap counter at 8
$01:A85A 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points (200, 400, 800... by chain)
$01:A85E AC D2 18     LDY.W $18D2                     ; Y = counter
$01:A861 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Count >= 8?
$01:A863 B0 06        BCS $A86B                       ; Yes: no sound
$01:A865 B9 1D A6     LDA.W $A61D,Y                   ; A = star kill sound from $A61E
$01:A868 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$01:A86B A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:A86D 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)
$01:A870 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$01:A872 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = $D0
$01:A874 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side of Mario
$01:A877 B9 39 A8     LDA.W $A839,Y                   ; A = $A839[Y]
$01:A87A 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = knocked away from Mario
}

;;; $A87C: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2) ;;;
{
;; Tail of the Mario/sprite contact routine (CLC/RTS at $01A87C is the shared 'no contact' exit).
;; $01A87E: contact entered; ignored while [$154C,X] is set, otherwise sets it to 8. A stunned sprite (status
;;     9) goes to the pick-up/kick code.
;; Mario above the sprite and falling stomps it: bounce, points, sprite changes (winged to wingless, Dino
;;     Rhino to Torch), is smushed (status 3),
;; knocked off screen (status 2), or stunned (status 9). Otherwise it is side contact: a sliding Mario kills
;;     it, else HurtMario.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index. Returns: carry set when Mario interacted in a way that counts as contact.
$01:A87C 18           CLC                             ; No contact: clear carry
$01:A87D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A87E 9C D2 18     STZ.W $18D2                     ; Clear [$18D2]
$01:A881 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:A884 D0 0F        BNE $A895                       ; / Contact already blocked by [$154C,X] timer: skip to no contact (CLC, RTS)
$01:A886 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:A888 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / [$154C,X] = 8: block repeat contact with this sprite for 8 frames
$01:A88B BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:A88E C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; } Sprite status 9 (stunned/carryable)? If not, go to normal contact at $01A897
$01:A890 D0 05        BNE $A897                       ; /
$01:A892 20 42 AA     JSR.W $AA42                     ; Stunned sprite: Mario picks up or kicks it (handled at $01AA42)
$01:A895 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear: no stomp/hurt happened
$01:A896 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A897 A9 14        LDA.B #$14                      ; Height of the stomp zone above the sprite = $14
$01:A899 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = $14
$01:A89B A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$01:A89D 38           SEC                             ; } A = sprite clipping top Y [$05] - $14 (16-bit with high byte [$0B])
$01:A89E E5 01        SBC $01                         ; /
$01:A8A0 26 00        ROL $00                         ; \
$01:A8A2 C5 D3        CMP $D3                         ; |
$01:A8A4 08           PHP                             ; } Compare low byte with Mario Y [$D3], keep borrow in P, restore [$00]
$01:A8A5 46 00        LSR $00                         ; /
$01:A8A7 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$01:A8A9 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:A8AB 28           PLP                             ; } 16-bit result: sprite stomp line - Mario Y ([$D4] high byte)
$01:A8AC E5 D4        SBC $D4                         ; /
$01:A8AE 30 36        BMI $A8E6                       ; Mario is below the stomp line (not above the sprite): go to side contact at $01A8E6
$01:A8B0 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$01:A8B2 10 0C        BPL $A8C0                       ; Falling or still: go check stomp conditions
$01:A8B4 BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:A8B7 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Rising Mario: if tweaker [$190F,X] bit 4 is set (probably), still allow stomp
$01:A8B9 D0 05        BNE $A8C0                       ; /
$01:A8BB AD 97 16     LDA.W $1697                     ; \
$01:A8BE F0 26        BEQ $A8E6                       ; / Else only allow if the consecutive-stomp counter [$1697] is non-zero, otherwise side contact
$01:A8C0 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Check whether Mario is on the ground (IsOnGround)
$01:A8C3 F0 04        BEQ $A8C9                       ; Not on ground: continue at $01A8C9
$01:A8C5 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; On ground: A = Mario flying/cape flag
$01:A8C7 F0 1D        BEQ $A8E6                       ; Not flying: side contact, grounded Mario cannot stomp
$01:A8C9 BD 56 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X         ; \
$01:A8CC 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Tweaker [$1656,X] bit 4 set (can be jumped on): go to stomp at $01A91C
$01:A8CE D0 4C        BNE $A91C                       ; /
$01:A8D0 AD 0D 14     LDA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; A = spin jump flag
$01:A8D3 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; OR with riding Yoshi flag
$01:A8D6 F0 0E        BEQ $A8E6                       ; Neither: side contact (Mario hurts or kicks)
$01:A8D8 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Sound effect 2 (spin-jump bounce off an unstompable sprite)
$01:A8DA 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$01:A8DD 22 33 AA 01  JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed           ; Bounce Mario upward (BoostMarioSpeed)
$01:A8E1 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Show contact star at Mario (DisplayContactGfx)
$01:A8E5 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A8E6 AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; Side contact: A = Mario sliding flag [$13ED]
$01:A8E9 F0 0E        BEQ $A8F9                       ; Not sliding: go check for hurting Mario
$01:A8EB BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:A8EE 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Tweaker [$190F,X] bit 2 (takes 5 fireballs): not killed by slide, hurt Mario
$01:A8F0 D0 07        BNE $A8F9                       ; /
$01:A8F2 20 28 A7     JSR.W PlayKickSfx               ; Play kick sound effect
$01:A8F5 20 47 A8     JSR.W $A847                     ; Sliding Mario kills the sprite ($A847)
$01:A8F8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A8F9 AD 97 14     LDA.W $1497                     ; \
$01:A8FC D0 1D        BNE $A91B                       ; / Return if Mario is invincible ([$1497] timer non-zero)
$01:A8FE AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = riding Yoshi flag
$01:A901 D0 18        BNE $A91B                       ; On Yoshi: return, Yoshi absorbs the hit
$01:A903 BD 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; \
$01:A906 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Tweaker [$1686,X] bit 4 set: keep the sprite's current direction
$01:A908 D0 07        BNE $A911                       ; /
$01:A90A 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Get side of Mario relative to the sprite (SubHorizPos)
$01:A90D 98           TYA                             ; A = 0 if Mario on the right, 1 if on the left
$01:A90E 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Sprite faces Mario
$01:A911 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:A913 C9 53        CMP.B #$53                      ; Compare with $53 (Throw block)
$01:A915 F0 04        BEQ $A91B                       ; Throw block does not hurt Mario: return
$01:A917 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario (HurtMario)
$01:A91B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A91C AD 0D 14     LDA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; A = spin jump flag
$01:A91F 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; OR with riding Yoshi flag
$01:A922 F0 23        BEQ $A947                       ; Normal jump: go to ordinary stomp at $01A947
$01:A924 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Spin jump or Yoshi stomp: show contact star (DisplayContactGfx)
$01:A928 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; A = $F8: bounce speed
$01:A92A 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = -8
$01:A92C AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = riding Yoshi flag
$01:A92F F0 04        BEQ $A935                       ; Not on Yoshi: skip the bigger boost
$01:A931 22 33 AA 01  JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed           ; On Yoshi: boost Mario upward (BoostMarioSpeed)
$01:A935 20 CB 9A     JSR.W $9ACB                     ; Kill the sprite as spin-jump killed, status 4 ($9ACB)
$01:A938 22 3B FC 07  JSL.L $FC3B                     ; Spawn spin-jump stars ($FC3B)
$01:A93C 20 46 AB     JSR.W $AB46                     ; Give stomp points and sound ($AB46)
$01:A93F A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Sound effect 8 (spin kill)
$01:A941 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$01:A944 4C F2 A9     JMP.W $A9F2                     ; Continue at $01A9F2 (Lakitu cloud check)

$01:A947 20 D8 A8     JSR.W $A8D8                     ; Bounce Mario and show contact star (via $01A8D8)
$01:A94A BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; A = per-sprite flag [$187B,X] (probably 'pushes Mario away')
$01:A94D F0 0E        BEQ $A95D                       ; Not set: normal stomp at $01A95D
$01:A94F 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Get side of Mario relative to the sprite
$01:A952 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; A = $18: push speed to the right
$01:A954 C0 00        CPY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (Mario on the right)?
$01:A956 F0 02        BEQ $A95A                       ; Yes: keep +$18
$01:A958 A9 E8        LDA.B #$E8                      ; No: A = $E8 (push left)
$01:A95A 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = pushed away from the sprite
$01:A95C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A95D 20 46 AB     JSR.W $AB46                     ; Give stomp points and sound ($AB46)
$01:A960 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Y = sprite number
$01:A962 BD 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; \
$01:A965 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; } Tweaker [$1686,X] bit 6 clear: no sprite change, go to $01A9BE
$01:A967 F0 55        BEQ $A9BE                       ; /
$01:A969 C0 72        CPY.B #$72                      ; Sprite number >= $72?
$01:A96B 90 0C        BCC $A979                       ; No: go to $01A979
$01:A96D DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:A96E 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:A96F 22 F2 EA 02  JSL.L $EAF2                     ; Spawn an extra sprite at this one's position ($EAF2)
$01:A973 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:A974 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:A975 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$01:A977 80 22        BRA $A99B                       ; Sprite number = 2 (replacement for sprites >= $72)

$01:A979 C0 6E        CPY.B #$6E                      ; Sprite $6E (Dino Rhino)?
$01:A97B D0 0D        BNE $A98A                       ; No: go to $01A98A
$01:A97D A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$01:A97F 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = 2
$01:A981 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF
$01:A983 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X] = $FF
$01:A986 A9 6F        LDA.B #$6F                      ; A = $6F: becomes Dino Torch
$01:A988 80 11        BRA $A99B                       ; Store new sprite number

$01:A98A C0 3F        CPY.B #$3F                      ; Sprite number >= $3F?
$01:A98C 90 0A        BCC $A998                       ; No: use the basic table at $01A998
$01:A98E A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80
$01:A990 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X] = $80
$01:A993 B9 9B A7     LDA.W ADDR_01A79B,Y             ; A = replacement sprite number from ADDR_01A79B[sprite number]
$01:A996 80 03        BRA $A99B                       ; Store new sprite number

$01:A998 B9 C9 A7     LDA.W SpriteToSpawn,Y           ; A = replacement sprite number from SpriteToSpawn[sprite number] (e.g. winged to wingless)
$01:A99B 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Sprite number = replacement
$01:A99D BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; A = sprite palette/properties
$01:A9A0 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; Keep palette bits
$01:A9A2 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; Save in [$0F]
$01:A9A4 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload sprite tables for the new sprite number (LoadSpriteTables)
$01:A9A8 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; A = sprite palette/properties
$01:A9AB 29 F1        AND.B #$F1                      ; Clear palette bits
$01:A9AD 05 0F        ORA $0F                         ; Merge the saved palette back in
$01:A9AF 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store: the sprite keeps its original palette
$01:A9B2 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$01:A9B4 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = new sprite number
$01:A9B6 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Compare with $02
$01:A9B8 D0 03        BNE $A9BD                       ; Other: return
$01:A9BA FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Sprite $02: [$151C,X]++
$01:A9BD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A9BE B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:A9C0 38           SEC                             ; Minus $04
$01:A9C1 E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; (sprite - 4)
$01:A9C3 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; Koopa-type sprite (numbers $04-$10)?
$01:A9C5 B0 05        BCS $A9CC                       ; No: use the tweaker check at $01A9CC
$01:A9C7 AD 07 14     LDA.W $1407                     ; Koopa: A = cape flag [$1407]
$01:A9CA D0 07        BNE $A9D3                       ; Non-zero: smush the sprite
$01:A9CC BD 56 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X         ; \
$01:A9CF 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Tweaker [$1656,X] bit 5 clear (does not die when jumped on): go to $01A9E2
$01:A9D1 F0 0F        BEQ $A9E2                       ; /
$01:A9D3 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:A9D5 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 3 (smushed)
$01:A9D8 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$01:A9DA 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X] = $20 (time before the smushed sprite disappears)
$01:A9DD 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:A9DF 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite X and Y speed = 0
$01:A9E1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:A9E2 BD 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; \
$01:A9E5 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; } Tweaker [$1662,X] bit 7 clear (does not fall straight down): go to $01AA01
$01:A9E7 F0 18        BEQ $AA01                       ; /
$01:A9E9 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:A9EB 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed, falling off screen)
$01:A9EE 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:A9F0 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite X and Y speed = 0
$01:A9F2 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:A9F4 C9 1E        CMP.B #$1E                      ; } Return unless sprite is Lakitu ($1E)
$01:A9F6 D0 08        BNE $AA00                       ; /
$01:A9F8 AC E1 18     LDY.W $18E1                     ; Y = slot of Lakitu's cloud [$18E1]
$01:A9FB A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; A = $1F
$01:A9FD 99 40 15     STA.W $1540,Y                   ; Cloud timer [$1540,Y] = $1F (cloud disappears)
$01:AA00 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AA01 BC C8 14     LDY.W $14C8,X                   ; Y = sprite status
$01:AA04 9E 26 16     STZ.W $1626,X                   ; Clear [$1626,X] (kill chain counter)
$01:AA07 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Status 8 (normal)?
$01:AA09 F0 09        BEQ SetStunnedTimer             ; Yes: set stunned timer
$01:AA0B B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = sprite state
$01:AA0D D0 05        BNE SetStunnedTimer             ; State non-zero: set stunned timer
$01:AA0F 9E 40 15     STZ.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X] = 0
$01:AA12 80 19        BRA SetAsStunned                ; Go to SetAsStunned (status 9)

}

;;; $AA14: Set stunned timer then stun sprite (SetStunnedTimer) ;;;
{
;; [$1540,X] = $FF for Goomba, Bob-omb, Buzzy Beetle and Mechakoopa, otherwise $02. Falls through to
;;     SetAsStunned.
$01:AA14 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:AA16 B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; |
$01:AA18 C0 0F        CPY.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:AA1A F0 0C        BEQ $AA28                       ; |
$01:AA1C C0 11        CPY.B #$11                      ; |
$01:AA1E F0 08        BEQ $AA28                       ; |
$01:AA20 C0 A2        CPY.B #$A2                      ; |
$01:AA22 F0 04        BEQ $AA28                       ; |
$01:AA24 C0 0D        CPY.B #$0D                      ; |
$01:AA26 D0 02        BNE $AA2A                       ; } A = $FF stun timer for Goomba ($0F), Bob-omb ($0D), Buzzy Beetle ($11), Mechakoopa ($A2); else $02
$01:AA28 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; /
$01:AA2A 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Store stun timer in [$1540,X]
}

;;; $AA2D: Set sprite status to stunned (SetAsStunned) ;;;
{
;; Sprite status [$14C8,X] = 9 (stunned/carryable).
$01:AA2D A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:AA2F 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 9 (stunned, can be picked up or kicked)
$01:AA32 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $AA33: Bounce Mario off a sprite (BoostMarioSpeed) ;;;
{
;; Sets Mario Y speed to $D0, or $A8 if the A button is held. Does nothing while climbing. Followed at $01AA42
;;     by the code for kicking and
;; picking up stunned sprites, key and P-switch standing handling (Mario standing on top, P-switch
;;     activation).
;; Parameters: X = sprite index (for the code after the RTL).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A8DD: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:A931: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:E5F7: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
;;     $01:FCD3: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
;;     $02:C7DB: Chuck: interact with Mario
;;     $02:F270: Wiggler draw, contact and flower spawn (WigglerTiles)
;;     $03:95A3: Mario stomps Rex (MarioBeatsRex)
;;     $03:CEBD: Koopa Kid states 5-6 and Mario contact
$01:AA33 A5 74        LDA RAM_IsClimbing              ; \
$01:AA35 D0 0A        BNE $AA41                       ; / Return if Mario is climbing
$01:AA37 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0: Mario Y speed -48 (normal bounce)
$01:AA39 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; Test controller A (B/A button state)
$01:AA3B 10 02        BPL $AA3F                       ; Button not held: use $D0
$01:AA3D A9 A8        LDA.B #$A8                      ; A = $A8: Mario Y speed -88 (higher bounce)
$01:AA3F 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = bounce speed
$01:AA41 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:AA42 AD 0D 14     LDA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; A = spin jump flag
$01:AA45 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; OR with riding Yoshi flag
$01:AA48 F0 0E        BEQ $AA58                       ; Neither: go to $01AA58
$01:AA4A A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$01:AA4C 30 0A        BMI $AA58                       ; Rising: go to $01AA58
$01:AA4E BD 56 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X         ; \
$01:AA51 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Tweaker [$1656,X] bit 4 clear (can't be jumped on): go to $01AA58
$01:AA53 F0 03        BEQ $AA58                       ; /
$01:AA55 4C 24 A9     JMP.W $A924                     ; Spin jump or Yoshi stomp: go to $01A924

$01:AA58 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; A = controller A
$01:AA5A 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; Isolate X/Y button (grab)
$01:AA5C F0 16        BEQ $AA74                       ; Not held: kick it instead
$01:AA5E AD 70 14     LDA.W $1470                     ; \
$01:AA61 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; } Already carrying a sprite or riding Yoshi: kick instead
$01:AA64 D0 0E        BNE $AA74                       ; /
$01:AA66 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:AA68 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = $0B (carried)
$01:AA6B EE 70 14     INC.W $1470                     ; Set carrying flag [$1470]
$01:AA6E A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8
$01:AA70 8D 98 14     STA.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; Pick-up pose timer = 8 frames
$01:AA73 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AA74 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:AA76 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; } Key ($80): handled at $01AAB7
$01:AA78 F0 3D        BEQ $AAB7                       ; /
$01:AA7A C9 3E        CMP.B #$3E                      ; \
$01:AA7C F0 34        BEQ $AAB2                       ; / P-switch ($3E): handled at $01AAB2
$01:AA7E C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; \
$01:AA80 F0 15        BEQ $AA97                       ; / Bob-omb ($0D): kick without extra points
$01:AA82 C9 2D        CMP.B #$2D                      ; \
$01:AA84 F0 11        BEQ $AA97                       ; / Baby Yoshi ($2D): kick without extra points
$01:AA86 C9 A2        CMP.B #$A2                      ; \
$01:AA88 F0 0D        BEQ $AA97                       ; / Mechakoopa ($A2): kick without extra points
$01:AA8A C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:AA8C D0 06        BNE $AA94                       ; / Not Goomba ($0F): give stomp points at $01AA94
$01:AA8E A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; Unused: A = $F0 (Goomba hop)
$01:AA90 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Unused: sprite Y speed = -16
$01:AA92 80 03        BRA $AA97                       ; Unused: continue to kick

$01:AA94 20 46 AB     JSR.W $AB46                     ; Give stomp points and sound ($AB46)
$01:AA97 20 28 A7     JSR.W PlayKickSfx               ; Play kick sound effect
$01:AA9A BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = timer [$1540,X]
$01:AA9D 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Restore it into the sprite state
$01:AA9F A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:AAA1 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = $0A (kicked)
$01:AAA4 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$01:AAA6 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; Disable contact timer [$154C,X] = $10
$01:AAA9 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Get side of Mario relative to the sprite
$01:AAAC B9 6B 9F     LDA.W ShellSpeedX,Y             ; A = kick speed from ShellSpeedX[Y]
$01:AAAF 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = kick speed, away from Mario
$01:AAB1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AAB2 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; P-switch: A = [$163E,X] (pressed timer)
$01:AAB5 D0 75        BNE $AB2C                       ; Already pressed: return
$01:AAB7 9E 4C 15     STZ.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; Disable contact timer = 0 (key falls through here)
$01:AABA B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = sprite Y low
$01:AABC 38           SEC                             ; Minus Mario Y
$01:AABD E5 D3        SBC $D3                         ; [A] = sprite Y - Mario Y
$01:AABF 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:AAC0 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; + 8
$01:AAC2 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; Compare with $20
$01:AAC4 90 6B        BCC $AB31                       ; In range: Mario touches from the side, push him out ($01AB31)
$01:AAC6 10 05        BPL $AACD                       ; Sprite is below: go to landing check at $01AACD
$01:AAC8 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; Sprite is above Mario: A = $10
$01:AACA 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 16 (bump head)
$01:AACC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AACD A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$01:AACF 30 5B        BMI $AB2C                       ; Rising: return
$01:AAD1 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$01:AAD3 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario flying flag = 0
$01:AAD5 EE 71 14     INC.W $1471                     ; [$1471]++: Mario is standing on a sprite
$01:AAD8 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; A = $1F: standing height offset
$01:AADA AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Y = riding Yoshi flag
$01:AADD F0 02        BEQ $AAE1                       ; Not on Yoshi: use $1F
$01:AADF A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; On Yoshi: A = $2F
$01:AAE1 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = standing height
$01:AAE3 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:AAE5 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:AAE6 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Mario Y = sprite Y - [$00] (low byte)
$01:AAE8 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$01:AAEA BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:AAED E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Mario Y high byte = sprite Y high - borrow
$01:AAEF 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$01:AAF1 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:AAF3 C9 3E        CMP.B #$3E                      ; P-switch ($3E)?
$01:AAF5 D0 35        BNE $AB2C                       ; No: return
$01:AAF7 1E 7A 16     ASL.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:AAFA 5E 7A 16     LSR.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; / Clear bit 7 of tweaker [$167A,X] (stop being interactable once pressed)
$01:AAFD A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; Sound effect $0B (switch)
$01:AAFF 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$01:AB02 AD DA 0D     LDA.W $0DDA                     ; A = music flag [$0DDA]
$01:AB05 30 05        BMI $AB0C                       ; Bit 7 set: skip the music change
$01:AB07 A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; A = $0E: P-switch music
$01:AB09 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; Change music
$01:AB0C A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$01:AB0E 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; [$163E,X] = $20: squashed animation timer
$01:AB11 5E F6 15     LSR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:AB14 1E F6 15     ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Clear bit 0 of sprite palette/properties [$15F6,X]
$01:AB17 BC 1C 15     LDY.W $151C,X                   ; Y = switch color (0 blue, 1 silver) from [$151C,X]
$01:AB1A A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; A = $B0
$01:AB1C 99 AD 14     STA.W RAM_BluePowTimer,Y        ; Switch timer [$14AD+Y] = $B0 (176 frames)
$01:AB1F A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:AB21 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Ground shake timer = $20
$01:AB24 C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; Silver switch (Y = 1)?
$01:AB26 D0 04        BNE $AB2C                       ; No: return
$01:AB28 22 BD B9 02  JSL.L $B9BD                     ; Turn enemies into silver coins ($B9BD)
$01:AB2C 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AB31: Push Mario out of a sprite ;;;
{
;; Zeroes Mario X speed and moves Mario 1 pixel away from the sprite, depending on which side he is on.
;; $01AB46: gives stomp points and a sound according to the consecutive stomp counter [$1697] plus the
;;     sprite's own chain count [$1626,X].
;; Called by:
;;     $01:E6E2: Portable springboard main routine (SpringBoard)
$01:AB31 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$01:AB33 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Get side of Mario relative to the sprite
$01:AB36 98           TYA                             ; A = side (0/1)
$01:AB37 0A           ASL                             ; Times 2 (16-bit table index)
$01:AB38 A8           TAY                             ; Y = word index
$01:AB39 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:AB3B A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; A = Mario X position
$01:AB3D 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:AB3E 79 2D AB     ADC.W $AB2D,Y                   ; Add push offset $AB2D[Y] (+1 or -1)
$01:AB41 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; Mario X position = pushed out by 1 pixel
$01:AB43 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:AB45 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AB46 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:AB47 AD 97 16     LDA.W $1697                     ; A = consecutive stomp counter [$1697]
$01:AB4A 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:AB4B 7D 26 16     ADC.W $1626,X                   ; Add the sprite's kill chain count [$1626,X]
$01:AB4E EE 97 16     INC.W $1697                     ; [$1697]++
$01:AB51 A8           TAY                             ; Y = chain index
$01:AB52 C8           INY                             ; Y + 1 = 1 up to 8
$01:AB53 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$01:AB55 B0 06        BCS $AB5D                       ; 8 or more: no sound
$01:AB57 B9 1D A6     LDA.W $A61D,Y                   ; A = sound effect for this chain step (table at $01A61D)
$01:AB5A 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$01:AB5D 98           TYA                             ; A = chain index
$01:AB5E C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Compare with 8
$01:AB60 90 02        BCC $AB64                       ; Below 8: keep
$01:AB62 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Cap at 8
$01:AB64 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points for chain step (GivePoints)
$01:AB68 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:AB69 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AB6F: Spawn contact smoke at sprite ;;;
{
;; Plays the kick sound and spawns a smoke-puff (type 2, 8 frames) at the sprite position in a free slot of
;;     $17C0-$17C3, if the sprite is on screen.
;; Called by the kick, toss and sliding kill code. Long routine (RTL).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A068: Toss carried sprite upward (TossUpSprCarried)
;;     $01:A079: Kick carried sprite (KickSprCarried)
;;     $01:A6BB: Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce
;;     $01:A847: Default Mario interaction: star kill (DefaultInteractR)
;;     $02:9451: Bounce block and cape hit sprites
;;     $02:DC09: Place Hammer Bro on platform and move platform (PutHammerBroOnPlat)
;;     $03:8029: Football sprite main routine (Football)
;;     $03:B15B: Bowser Mario and Mecha-Koopa contact
$01:AB6F 20 28 A7     JSR.W PlayKickSfx               ; Play kick sound effect
$01:AB72 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Is the sprite off-screen? (IsSprOffScreen)
$01:AB75 D0 21        BNE $AB98                       ; Off-screen: return, no smoke
$01:AB77 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:AB78 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; \
$01:AB7A B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; |
$01:AB7D F0 04        BEQ $AB83                       ; |
$01:AB7F 88           DEY                             ; } Find a free smoke slot among $17C0-$17C3 (Y = 3 down to 0)
$01:AB80 10 F8        BPL $AB7A                       ; /
$01:AB82 C8           INY                             ; None free: use slot 0
$01:AB83 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:AB85 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Smoke slot Y type = 2 (contact star/smoke puff)
$01:AB88 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:AB8A 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; |
$01:AB8D B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; } Smoke X/Y = sprite position (low bytes)
$01:AB8F 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; /
$01:AB92 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:AB94 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Smoke display timer = 8 frames
$01:AB97 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:AB98 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $AB99: Spawn contact smoke at Mario (DisplayContactGfx) ;;;
{
;; Like the code above, but the smoke is placed at Mario's X and Y + $14 ($1E on Yoshi). Does nothing if off-
;;     screen. Long routine (RTL).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:A8E1: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:A924: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:D36A: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs
;;     $01:E5EE: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
;;     $01:FCF0: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
;;     $02:C7D7: Chuck: interact with Mario
;;     $02:F27C: Wiggler draw, contact and flower spawn (WigglerTiles)
;;     $03:95A7: Mario stomps Rex (MarioBeatsRex)
;;     $03:CEB3: Koopa Kid states 5-6 and Mario contact
$01:AB99 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Is the sprite off-screen? (IsSprOffScreen)
$01:AB9C D0 2D        BNE $ABCB                       ; Yes: return
$01:AB9E 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:AB9F A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; \
$01:ABA1 B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; |
$01:ABA4 F0 04        BEQ $ABAA                       ; |
$01:ABA6 88           DEY                             ; } Find a free smoke slot among $17C0-$17C3
$01:ABA7 10 F8        BPL $ABA1                       ; /
$01:ABA9 C8           INY                             ; None free: use slot 0
$01:ABAA A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:ABAC 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Smoke slot Y type = 2 (contact puff)
$01:ABAF A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:ABB1 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; / Smoke X = Mario X position low byte
$01:ABB4 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:ABB7 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } A = riding Yoshi flag compared with 1 (carry set if on Yoshi)
$01:ABB9 A9 14        LDA.B #$14                      ; /
$01:ABBB 90 02        BCC $ABBF                       ; A = $14: Y offset when on foot
$01:ABBD A9 1E        LDA.B #$1E                      ; On Yoshi: A = $1E
$01:ABBF 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:ABC0 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:ABC2 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; / Smoke Y = Mario Y + offset
$01:ABC5 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:ABC7 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Smoke display timer = 8 frames
$01:ABCA 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:ABCB 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $ABCC: Update sprite X position (SubSprXPosNoGrvty) ;;;
{
;; Applies the sprite's X speed to its X position by entering SubSprYPosNoGrvty with X + 12. Restores X
;;     afterwards.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8025: Update sprite X position (UpdateXPosNoGrvty)
;;     $01:8C77: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8CFA: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa)
;;     $01:9008: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move (timerCODE_019001)
;;     $01:9076: Update sprite position with gravity (SubUpdateSprPos)
;;     $01:ADEC: Flying question block main (Flying?Block)
;;     $01:AFB0: Thwimp main (Thwimp)
;;     $01:B0E0: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B19C: Generated Cheep Cheep main (GeneratedFish)
;;     $01:B2AB: Moving platforms main (Platforms)
;;     $01:B541: Orange platform main routine (OrangePlatform)
;;     $01:B57D: Floating platforms and spike ball physics (Platforms2)
;;     ... and 21 more
$01:ABCC 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:ABCD 18           CLC                             ; } X += 12 to index the X speed instead of the Y speed
$01:ABCE 69 0C        ADC.B #$0C                      ; /
$01:ABD0 AA           TAX                             ; X = X speed slot
$01:ABD1 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply speed to position (same routine as Y)
$01:ABD4 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; Restore X = sprite index
$01:ABD7 60           RTS                             ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Update sprite position by speed. This is similar to Player's version
;at $00DC4F.
;
;Due to the table format differences (such as low and high
;bytes of positions) the code has to be different in order to work.
;If X index is:
;$00-$0B (00-11): Handle Y speed
;$0C-$17 (12-23): Handle X speed
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
}

;;; $ABD8: Update sprite Y position (SubSprYPosNoGrvty) ;;;
{
;; Adds the sprite's speed to its position: low nybble is 1/16 pixel units in a sub-pixel accumulator, high
;;     nybble (signed) is whole pixels.
;; Writes the pixels moved to [$1491] so platforms can carry Mario. Entered with X + 12 it does the same for
;;     X.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:801D: Update sprite Y position, no gravity (UpdateYPosNoGrvty)
;;     $01:8C87: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8CE5: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8CF7: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8EC4: Piranha plant main routine (ClassicPiranhas)
;;     $01:900B: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move (timerCODE_019001)
;;     $01:9032: Update sprite position with gravity (SubUpdateSprPos)
;;     $01:ABD1: Update sprite X position (SubSprXPosNoGrvty)
;;     $01:ADB7: Flying question block main (Flying?Block)
;;     $01:AEFA: Thwomp states: wait, fall, rise (ThwompStatePtrs)
;;     $01:AF3C: Thwomp states: wait, fall, rise (ThwompStatePtrs)
;;     $01:AFB3: Thwimp main (Thwimp)
;;     ... and 29 more
$01:ABD8 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = sprite speed (Y, or X when entered with X + 12)
$01:ABDA F0 2D        BEQ $AC09                       ; Speed 0: skip to $01AC09
$01:ABDC 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:ABDD 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:ABDE 0A           ASL                             ; } A = low nybble of speed shifted up (sub-pixel part)
$01:ABDF 0A           ASL                             ; /
$01:ABE0 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:ABE1 7D EC 14     ADC.W $14EC,X                   ; } Add to sub-pixel accumulator [$14EC,X] (1/16 pixel units)
$01:ABE4 9D EC 14     STA.W $14EC,X                   ; /
$01:ABE7 08           PHP                             ; \
$01:ABE8 08           PHP                             ; / Save carry from the sub-pixel add (twice)
$01:ABE9 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the movement
$01:ABEB B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = speed
$01:ABED 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:ABEE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:ABEF 4A           LSR                             ; } A = whole pixels per frame (speed / 16, signed nybble)
$01:ABF0 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:ABF1 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Speed >= 8: negative
$01:ABF3 90 03        BCC $ABF8                       ; Positive: go on
$01:ABF5 09 F0        ORA.B #$F0                      ; Negative: sign extend to $F0-$FF
$01:ABF7 88           DEY                             ; Y = $FF: high byte of the movement
$01:ABF8 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry from the sub-pixel add
$01:ABF9 48           PHA                             ; Save pixel displacement
$01:ABFA 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:ABFC 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Position low byte += displacement + carry
$01:ABFE 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:ABFF 7D D4 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } Position high byte += sign byte + carry
$01:AC02 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:AC05 68           PLA                             ; Restore pixel displacement
$01:AC06 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry
$01:AC07 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Add carry: total pixels moved this frame
$01:AC09 8D 91 14     STA.W $1491                     ; [$1491] = pixels moved (signed), used to carry Mario with platforms
$01:AC0C 60           RTS                             ; Return


}
