;;; $AC0F: Table: vertical off-screen margins (high) (SpriteOffScreen2) ;;;
{
$01:AC0F              .db $01,$FF                     ; High byte of those Y offsets: $01 / $FF

}

;;; $AC11: Table: horizontal off-screen margins (low) (SpriteOffScreen3) ;;;
{
$01:AC11              .db $30,$C0,$A0,$C0,$A0,$F0,$60,$90 ; Horizontal offsets by entry: $30,$C0 / $A0,$C0 / $A0,$F0 / $60,$90
}

;;; $AC19: Table: horizontal off-screen margins (high) (SpriteOffScreen4) ;;;
{
$01:AC19              .db $01,$FF,$01,$FF,$01,$FF,$01,$FF ; High bytes: $01,$FF pairs

}

;;; $AC21: Off-screen check, entry 3 (bank 1) (SubOffscreen3Bnk1) ;;;
{
;; Entries 3 to 0 set [$03] = 6, 4, 2 or 0 to pick which horizontal margin pair of the tables is used, then
;;     share the code of SubOffscreen0Bnk1.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:F8BB: Eerie and wave Eerie main (Eerie)
$01:AC21 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:AC23 85 03        STA $03                         ; } Entry 3: [$03] = 6 (selects the wide horizontal margin), skip to common code
$01:AC25 80 06        BRA $AC2D                       ; /

}

;;; $AC27: Off-screen check, entry 2 (bank 1) (SubOffscreen2Bnk1) ;;;
{
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C773: Brown chained platform main (BrownChainedPlat)
$01:AC27 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Entry 2: A = 4
$01:AC29 80 02        BRA $AC2D                       ; Store in [$03]

}

;;; $AC2B: Off-screen check, entry 1 (bank 1) (SubOffscreen1Bnk1) ;;;
{
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8CBE: Red horizontal para-Koopa: entry (RedHorzParaKoopa)
;;     $01:B2BF: Moving platforms main (Platforms)
;;     $01:D74D: Line-guided fuzzy and platforms main (LineFuzzy+Plats)
;;     $01:F8D5: Big Boo main routine (BigBoo)
$01:AC2B A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Entry 1: A = 2
$01:AC2D 85 03        STA $03                         ; \
$01:AC2F 80 02        BRA $AC33                       ; / Store in [$03] and go to $01AC33

}

;;; $AC31: Erase sprite when far off-screen (bank 1) (SubOffscreen0Bnk1) ;;;
{
;; Does nothing if the sprite is on screen or has the process-off-screen tweaker bit. Erases it if it fell
;;     below the level or if it is outside the
;; horizontal margin (checked on alternate frames with different margins). Vertical levels use the
;;     VerticalLevel code.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index; entry point selects the margin.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:815A: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C) (HandleGoalPowerup)
;;     $01:8B43: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement (Spr0to13Main)
;;     $01:8C44: Spiny egg main routine (SpinyEgg)
;;     $01:8CB4: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing) (GreenParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8CC3: Red para-Koopa main routine (RedVertParaKoopa)
;;     $01:8D2E: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8E9A: Piranha plant main routine (ClassicPiranhas)
;;     $01:8F49: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:9014: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move (timerCODE_019001)
;;     $01:95F8: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status (SetNormalStatus)
;;     $01:998F: Sprite status: kicked (shell) (HandleSprKicked)
;;     $01:9ADD: Sprite status: killed (HandleSprKilled)
;;     ... and 23 more
$01:AC31 64 03        STZ $03                         ; Entry 0: [$03] = 0
$01:AC33 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Is the sprite off-screen? (IsSprOffScreen)
$01:AC36 F0 6C        BEQ $ACA4                       ; No: return
$01:AC38 A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$01:AC3A 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Vertical level? Go to VerticalLevel
$01:AC3C D0 67        BNE VerticalLevel               ; /
$01:AC3E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:AC40 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AC41 69 50        ADC.B #$50                      ; |
$01:AC43 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:AC46 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:AC48 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } If sprite Y + $50 reaches high byte 2 or more (fell below the level), erase it
$01:AC4A 10 34        BPL OffScrEraseSprite           ; /
$01:AC4C BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:AC4F 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Tweaker [$167A,X] bit 2 (process off-screen) set: return
$01:AC51 D0 51        BNE $ACA4                       ; /
$01:AC53 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:AC55 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:AC57 05 03        ORA $03                         ; |
$01:AC59 85 01        STA $01                         ; } [$01] = Y = [$03] | (frame counter & 1): index into the offset tables
$01:AC5B A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:AC5C A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$01:AC5E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AC5F 79 11 AC     ADC.W SpriteOffScreen3,Y        ; |
$01:AC62 26 00        ROL $00                         ; |
$01:AC64 D5 E4        CMP RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } Compare screen X low + offset with sprite X low, remember result
$01:AC66 08           PHP                             ; /
$01:AC67 A5 1B        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; \
$01:AC69 46 00        LSR $00                         ; |
$01:AC6B 79 19 AC     ADC.W SpriteOffScreen4,Y        ; |
$01:AC6E 28           PLP                             ; |
$01:AC6F FD E0 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } 16-bit compare with sprite X high: sign of (screen + offset - sprite X)
$01:AC72 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:AC74 46 01        LSR $01                         ; Test bit 0 of [$01]: left or right side
$01:AC76 90 04        BCC $AC7C                       ; Left side: keep sign
$01:AC78 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; Right side: flip the sign
$01:AC7A 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store result
$01:AC7C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = signed distance beyond the margin
$01:AC7E 10 24        BPL $ACA4                       ; Still inside the margin: return, otherwise erase
}

;;; $AC80: Erase sprite off-screen (OffScrEraseSprite) ;;;
{
;; Magikoopa is queued to respawn. Sprites with status < 8 or spawned at runtime are killed; level sprites are
;;     marked as not loaded so they
;; reappear when scrolled back. Falls into OffScrKillSprite.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:838D: Init Banzai Bill (InitBanzai)
;;     $01:8468: Data: P-switch palettes (PSwitchPal)
;;     $01:8AC9: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2 (NOTE)
;;     $01:9A77: Erase sprite and status 5 handler (SpinJumpEraseSpr)
;;     $01:9FC7: P-balloon expired (BalloonExpired)
;;     $01:C1C8: Growing vine (GrowingVine)
$01:AC80 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:AC82 C9 1F        CMP.B #$1F                      ; } If sprite is Magikoopa ($1F)...
$01:AC84 D0 08        BNE $AC8E                       ; /
$01:AC86 8D C1 18     STA.W RAM_SpriteToRespawn       ; \
$01:AC89 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; } ...mark it to respawn and set the respawn timer to $FF
$01:AC8B 8D C0 18     STA.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn       ; /
$01:AC8E BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:AC91 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Sprite status < 8: kill permanently
$01:AC93 90 0C        BCC OffScrKillSprite            ; /
$01:AC95 BC 1A 16     LDY.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X       ; \
$01:AC98 C0 FF        CPY.B #$FF                      ; } Y = level sprite index; $FF means spawned, so kill permanently
$01:AC9A F0 05        BEQ OffScrKillSprite            ; /
$01:AC9C A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:AC9E 99 38 19     STA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,Y       ; / Mark the level sprite as not yet loaded so it can respawn when scrolled back
}

;;; $ACA1: Set sprite status to empty (OffScrKillSprite) ;;;
{
;; Sprite status [$14C8,X] = 0.
$01:ACA1 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status = 0: erase sprite
$01:ACA4 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $ACA5: Off-screen check for vertical levels (VerticalLevel) ;;;
{
;; Erases the sprite when beyond the level width or outside the vertical margins. Skips the Net Koopas on
;;     alternate frames. Runs every other frame.
$01:ACA5 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:ACA8 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Tweaker [$167A,X] bit 2 (process off-screen) set: return
$01:ACAA D0 F8        BNE $ACA4                       ; /
$01:ACAC A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:ACAE 4A           LSR                             ; } Run only every other frame
$01:ACAF B0 F3        BCS $ACA4                       ; /
$01:ACB1 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:ACB3 C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; |
$01:ACB5 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:ACB8 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:ACBA C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } If sprite X high byte is 2 or more (off the side of the level), erase it
$01:ACBC B0 C2        BCS OffScrEraseSprite           ; /
$01:ACBE A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:ACC0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:ACC1 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } [$01] = (frame counter >> 1) & 1
$01:ACC3 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:ACC5 A8           TAY                             ; Y = [$01]
$01:ACC6 F0 0A        BEQ $ACD2                       ; 0: skip the Net Koopa check
$01:ACC8 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:ACCA C9 22        CMP.B #$22                      ; |
$01:ACCC F0 D6        BEQ $ACA4                       ; |
$01:ACCE C9 24        CMP.B #$24                      ; } Return if Green or Red Net Koopa ($22, $24) on alternate frames
$01:ACD0 F0 D2        BEQ $ACA4                       ; /
$01:ACD2 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$01:ACD4 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:ACD5 79 0D AC     ADC.W SpriteOffScreen1,Y        ; |
$01:ACD8 26 00        ROL $00                         ; } Compare screen Y low + offset (SpriteOffScreen1) with sprite Y low
$01:ACDA D5 D8        CMP RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:ACDC 08           PHP                             ; Remember result
$01:ACDD AD 1D 00     LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYHi        ; \
$01:ACE0 46 00        LSR $00                         ; |
$01:ACE2 79 0F AC     ADC.W SpriteOffScreen2,Y        ; |
$01:ACE5 28           PLP                             ; } 16-bit compare with sprite Y high (SpriteOffScreen2)
$01:ACE6 FD D4 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:ACE9 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store result
$01:ACEB A4 01        LDY $01                         ; Y = [$01]
$01:ACED F0 04        BEQ $ACF3                       ; 0: keep sign
$01:ACEF 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; \
$01:ACF1 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Flip sign for the other edge
$01:ACF3 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = signed distance beyond the margin
$01:ACF5 10 AD        BPL $ACA4                       ; Still inside the margin: return
$01:ACF7 30 87        BMI OffScrEraseSprite           ; Otherwise erase the sprite
}

;;; $ACF9: Generate random numbers (GetRand) ;;;
{
;; Updates both random bytes [$148D] and [$148E] by calling the generator at $01AD07 twice (Y = 1 then Y = 0).
;;     Preserves Y.
;; Returns: [$148D], [$148E]. The generator is a 16-bit-state LFSR-like step: seed1 = seed1*5+1, seed2 shifted
;;     with a bit-5 feedback, result = seed1 XOR seed2.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8575: Init standard sprite (InitStandardSprite)
;;     $01:858E: Init Fishbone (InitFishbone)
;;     $01:8D96: Winged Goomba main routine (WingedGoomba)
;;     $01:8F38: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:8F50: Hopping flame main routine (HoppingFlame)
;;     $01:B062: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B070: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B08E: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:B159: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:BC71: Magikoopa magic main (MagikoopasMagic)
;;     $01:BE08: Magikoopa states and helpers (MagiKoopaPtrs)
;;     $01:BE1E: Magikoopa states and helpers (MagiKoopaPtrs)
;;     ... and 41 more
$01:ACF9 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:ACFA A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1
$01:ACFC 22 07 AD 01  JSL.L $AD07                     ; Update random byte 2 ([$148E])
$01:AD00 88           DEY                             ; Y = 0
$01:AD01 22 07 AD 01  JSL.L $AD07                     ; Update random byte 1 ([$148D])
$01:AD05 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:AD06 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:AD07 AD 8B 14     LDA.W $148B                     ; \
$01:AD0A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:AD0B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:AD0C 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:AD0D 6D 8B 14     ADC.W $148B                     ; } [$148B] = [$148B] * 5 + 1
$01:AD10 8D 8B 14     STA.W $148B                     ; /
$01:AD13 0E 8C 14     ASL.W $148C                     ; [$148C] <<= 1
$01:AD16 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$01:AD18 2C 8C 14     BIT.W $148C                     ; Test bit 5 of [$148C]
$01:AD1B 90 04        BCC $AD21                       ; Carry clear: go to $01AD21
$01:AD1D F0 07        BEQ $AD26                       ; Carry set and bit 5 clear: skip
$01:AD1F D0 02        BNE $AD23                       ; Carry set and bit 5 set: go to $01AD23
$01:AD21 D0 03        BNE $AD26                       ; Carry clear and bit 5 set: skip
$01:AD23 EE 8C 14     INC.W $148C                     ; Set bit 0 of [$148C] (feedback)
$01:AD26 AD 8C 14     LDA.W $148C                     ; A = [$148C]
$01:AD29 4D 8B 14     EOR.W $148B                     ; XOR with [$148B]
$01:AD2C 99 8D 14     STA.W RAM_RandomByte1,Y         ; Store in random byte [$148D+Y]
$01:AD2F 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $AD30: Mario horizontal position relative to sprite (SubHorizPos) ;;;
{
;; Y = 0 if Mario is to the right of (or level with) the sprite, 1 if to the left. [$0F] = low byte of Mario X
;;     - sprite X.
;; $01AD42 (SubVertPos): same for vertical position, Y = 0 if Mario is below, [$0E] = low byte of the
;;     difference.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index. Returns: Y, [$0F].
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8387: Init Banzai Bill (InitBanzai)
;;     $01:83F2: Init Spike Top (InitSpikeTop)
;;     $01:84DD: Init Bullet Bill (InitBulletBill)
;;     $01:857C: Face Mario (FaceMario)
;;     $01:8ED0: Piranha plant: next state (ChangePiranhaState)
;;     $01:9733: Spawn shelless Koopa from shell (GeneralResetSpr)
;;     $01:9748: Spawn shelless Koopa from shell (GeneralResetSpr)
;;     $01:A059: Release carried sprite (ReleaseSprCarried)
;;     $01:A7F7: Test Mario against sprite (ProcessInteract)
;;     $01:A874: Default Mario interaction: star kill (DefaultInteractR)
;;     $01:A90A: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:A94F: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     ... and 27 more
$01:AD30 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: Mario on the right
$01:AD32 A5 D1        LDA $D1                         ; A = Mario X low [$D1]
$01:AD34 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$01:AD35 F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Minus sprite X low
$01:AD37 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; [$0F] = low byte of horizontal distance
$01:AD39 A5 D2        LDA $D2                         ; A = Mario X high [$D2]
$01:AD3B FD E0 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Minus sprite X high
$01:AD3E 10 01        BPL $AD41                       ; Positive: Mario is on the right (Y = 0)
$01:AD40 C8           INY                             ; Negative: Y = 1 (Mario on the left)
$01:AD41 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AD42 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Vertical twin of SubHorizPos: Y = 0 (Mario below the sprite)
$01:AD44 A5 D3        LDA $D3                         ; A = Mario Y low [$D3]
$01:AD46 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$01:AD47 F5 D8        SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Minus sprite Y low
$01:AD49 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; [$0E] = low byte of vertical distance
$01:AD4B A5 D4        LDA $D4                         ; A = Mario Y high [$D4]
$01:AD4D FD D4 14     SBC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Minus sprite Y high
$01:AD50 10 01        BPL $AD53                       ; Positive: Y = 0
$01:AD52 C8           INY                             ; Negative: Y = 1 (Mario above)
$01:AD53 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AD54..AD54: Unused. Padding $FF bytes ;;;
{
$01:AD54              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

}

;;; $AD59: Init flying question block (InitFlying?Block) ;;;
{
;; [$151C,X] = (sprite X low >> 4) & 3 and the direction is incremented. Used for sprites $83-$85.
$01:AD59 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = sprite X low
$01:AD5B 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:AD5C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:AD5D 4A           LSR                             ; } A = X low >> 4
$01:AD5E 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:AD5F 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Keep 2 bits
$01:AD61 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C,X] = (X >> 4) & 3: staggers the flight phase
$01:AD64 FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Sprite direction [$157C,X]++
$01:AD67 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AD68..AD6C: Unused. Data bytes $FF,$01,$F4,$0C,$F0,$10 (purpose unclear) ;;;
{
$01:AD68              .db $FF,$01

$01:AD6A              .db $F4,$0C

$01:AD6C              .db $F0,$10

}

;;; $AD6E: Flying question block main (Flying?Block) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $83 (flies left) and $84 (bobs and hovers): a winged ? block. Y speed oscillates by 1 every other
;;     frame between $F4 and $0C;
;; sprite $84 also oscillates X speed (+-1 every 4th frame, limit $F0/$10, 32-frame pause at each end). Mario
;;     can stand on it and be carried.
;; When hit from below ([$1558] = 8) it advances [$C2], spawns its contents ($AE88, chosen by [$151C];
;;     small Mario gets different entries)
;; and bounces using $AE7F. Tile $2A while in state 0, $2E after. Wings are drawn only in state 0
;;     ($9E95).
$01:AD6E BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:AD71 F0 0D        BEQ $AD80                       ; / Hit timer [$163E] (set when Mario hits the block) = 0: skip
$01:AD73 9E EA 15     STZ.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Hit timer running: OAM index = 0 (first OAM slots, probably for draw priority)
$01:AD76 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:AD79 D0 05        BNE $AD80                       ; / Mario on Yoshi: leave OAM index = 0
$01:AD7B A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:AD7D 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / OAM index = 4 when not on Yoshi
$01:AD80 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the block (generic 16x16 sprite graphics)
$01:AD83 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the block tile
$01:AD86 B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$01:AD89 3A           DEC A                           ; } Block tile Y position -= 1
$01:AD8A 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:AD8D 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = 0 (riding carry delta, set again below)
$01:AD90 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:AD92 D0 64        BNE $ADF8                       ; / State [$C2] non-zero (wings gone after being hit): skip movement
$01:AD94 20 95 9E     JSR.W $9E95                     ; Draw the wings ($9E95)
$01:AD97 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:AD99 D0 5D        BNE $ADF8                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$01:AD9B A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:AD9D 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Every other frame: apply vertical acceleration
$01:AD9F D0 16        BNE $ADB7                       ; /
$01:ADA1 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; \
$01:ADA4 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [$1594] bit 0 (vertical bob direction)
$01:ADA6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:ADA7 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:ADA9 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:ADAA 79 68 AD     ADC.W $AD68,Y                   ; } Y speed += $AD68[Y] (-1 or +1)
$01:ADAD 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:ADAF D9 6A AD     CMP.W $AD6A,Y                   ; \
$01:ADB2 D0 03        BNE $ADB7                       ; / Y speed reached limit $AD6A[Y] ($F4/$0C)? If not, skip
$01:ADB4 FE 94 15     INC.W $1594,X                   ; Reverse the bob direction: [$1594]++
$01:ADB7 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed to Y position (no gravity)
$01:ADBA B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:ADBC C9 83        CMP.B #$83                      ; } Sprite $83 (left flying block): go to constant X speed
$01:ADBE F0 28        BEQ $ADE8                       ; /
$01:ADC0 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:ADC3 D0 21        BNE $ADE6                       ; / Horizontal pause timer [$1540] running: keep X speed
$01:ADC5 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:ADC7 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Only accelerate X every 4th frame
$01:ADC9 D0 1B        BNE $ADE6                       ; /
$01:ADCB BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:ADCE 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [$1534] bit 0 (horizontal direction)
$01:ADD0 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:ADD1 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:ADD3 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:ADD4 79 68 AD     ADC.W $AD68,Y                   ; } X speed += $AD68[Y] (-1 or +1)
$01:ADD7 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:ADD9 D9 6C AD     CMP.W $AD6C,Y                   ; \
$01:ADDC D0 08        BNE $ADE6                       ; / X speed reached limit $AD6C[Y] ($F0/$10)? If not, skip
$01:ADDE FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Reverse the direction: [$1534]++
$01:ADE1 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:ADE3 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Pause the horizontal acceleration for $20 frames
$01:ADE6 80 04        BRA $ADEC                       ; Skip the constant speed

$01:ADE8 A9 F4        LDA.B #$F4                      ; \
$01:ADEA 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Sprite $83: X speed = $F4 (flies left)
$01:ADEC 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed to X position (no gravity)
$01:ADEF AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; \
$01:ADF2 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / [$1528] = [$1491] (X movement this frame, carries Mario)
$01:ADF5 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Wing animation counter [$1570]++
$01:ADF8 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Sprite-to-sprite interaction
$01:ADFB 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; Solid block interaction with Mario (hit from below sets [$1558])
$01:ADFE 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:AE01 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:AE04 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Hit timer [$1558] = 8 (the moment of the hit)? If not, skip to bounce
$01:AE06 D0 56        BNE $AE5E                       ; /
$01:AE08 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:AE0A C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; } State [$C2] already 2: skip spawning
$01:AE0C F0 50        BEQ $AE5E                       ; /
$01:AE0E 48           PHA                             ; Save the hit timer
$01:AE0F F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2]++ (wings fall off)
$01:AE11 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$01:AE13 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; / [$163E] = $50: draw-priority timer
$01:AE16 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:AE18 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$01:AE1A BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Block X position = sprite X position (16-bit)
$01:AE1D 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; /
$01:AE1F B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:AE21 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$01:AE23 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; } Block Y position = sprite Y position (16-bit)
$01:AE26 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; /
$01:AE28 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:AE2A 9D 1A 16     STA.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X       ; / Level index = $FF: never respawn this sprite
$01:AE2D BC 1C 15     LDY.W $151C,X                   ; Y = [$151C] (block contents type)
$01:AE30 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$01:AE32 D0 04        BNE $AE38                       ; / Mario is small (power-up 0)? If not, use the big Mario entries
$01:AE34 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:AE35 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:AE36 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: small Mario table entries
$01:AE37 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:AE38 B9 88 AE     LDA.W $AE88,Y                   ; A = block contents ID from $AE88[Y]
$01:AE3B 85 05        STA $05                         ; $05 = contents ID for the spawn routine
$01:AE3D 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:AE3E A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:AE40 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $02
$01:AE41 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:AE42 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:AE43 22 7D 88 02  JSL.L $887D                     ; Spawn the block contents ($887D)
$01:AE47 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:AE48 AC 5E 18     LDY.W $185E                     ; Y = index of the sprite just spawned
$01:AE4B A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:AE4D 99 28 15     STA.W $1528,Y                   ; / Spawned sprite [$1528] = 1
$01:AE50 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:AE53 C9 75        CMP.B #$75                      ; } Spawned sprite number = $75?
$01:AE55 D0 05        BNE $AE5C                       ; /
$01:AE57 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:AE59 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; / Yes: its state [$C2] = $FF
$01:AE5C AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:AE5D 68           PLA                             ; Restore the hit timer
$01:AE5E 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:AE5F A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1558] / 2
$01:AE60 B9 7F AE     LDA.W $AE7F,Y                   ; \
$01:AE63 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = hit bounce offset $AE7F[Y]
$01:AE65 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the block tile
$01:AE68 B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$01:AE6B 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:AE6C E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Block tile Y position -= bounce offset
$01:AE6E 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:AE71 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:AE73 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / State [$C2] < 1 (wings still on)?
$01:AE75 A9 2A        LDA.B #$2A                      ; A = $2A (flying question block tile)
$01:AE77 90 02        BCC $AE7B                       ; Yes: keep it
$01:AE79 A9 2E        LDA.B #$2E                      ; No: A = $2E (used block tile)
$01:AE7B 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Set the block tile number
$01:AE7E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $AE7F..AE87: Table: block bounce offsets ;;;
{
;; Y pixel offsets for the hit bounce animation, indexed by [$1558] / 2.
$01:AE7F              .db $00,$03,$05,$07,$08,$08,$07,$05 ; Hit bounce offsets in pixels, indexed by timer / 2
$01:AE87              .db $03                         ; (last offset)

}

;;; $AE88..AE88: Table: flying block contents ;;;
{
;; Contents IDs for $887D, indexed by [$151C] (+4 if Mario is small). 1 mushroom, 2 flower, 4 feather, 5
;;     1-Up, 6 probably coin.
$01:AE88              .db $06,$02,$04,$05,$06,$01,$01,$05 ; Block contents: big Mario - coin, flower, feather, 1-Up

}

;;; $AE90: Init: palace switch (nothing to do) ;;;
{
;; Return stub used as the init routine of sprite $60.
$01:AE90 60           RTS                             ; Init routine for the palace switch: nothing to do

}

;;; $AE91: Main: palace switch (PalaceSwitch) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $60 main routine: runs $CD2D in bank 2.
$01:AE91 22 2D CD 02  JSL.L $CD2D                     ; Run the switch palace switch routine ($CD2D)
$01:AE95 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $AE96: Init Thwomp (InitThwomp) ;;;
{
;; Remembers the starting Y position in [$151C] (to return to after a fall) and shifts X right by 8 pixels.
$01:AE96 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:AE98 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Remember the spawn Y position in [$151C]
$01:AE9B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:AE9D 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AE9E 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Sprite X position += 8 (centers the Thwomp)
$01:AEA0 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:AEA2 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $AEA3: Thwomp main (Thwomp) ;;;
{
;; Draws the Thwomp, then (only if status 8 and sprites not locked) offscreen-checks, interacts with Mario and
;;     runs the state routine from [$C2].
$01:AEA3 20 54 AF     JSR.W ThwompGfx                 ; Draw the Thwomp
$01:AEA6 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:AEA9 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Not sprite status 8 (normal): return
$01:AEAB D0 F5        BNE $AEA2                       ; /
$01:AEAD A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:AEAF D0 F1        BNE $AEA2                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:AEB1 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:AEB4 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:AEB7 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state [$C2]
$01:AEB9 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the state routine below

}

;;; $AEBD: Thwomp states: wait, fall, rise (ThwompStatePtrs) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table, then the three state routines.
;; State 0: waits. Face [$1528]: 0 neutral, 1 when Mario is within +-$40 horizontally, 2 (angry) and drops
;;     when Mario is roughly underneath.
;; State 1: falls (Y speed +4 up to $3E); on landing shakes the ground (RAM_ShakeGrndTimer = $18), plays sound
;;     $09 and waits $40 frames.
;; State 2: after the wait, rises at Y speed $F0 until back at [$151C], then returns to state 0.
$01:AEBD C3 AE        .dw $AEC3                       ; Thwomp state 0: waiting
$01:AEBF FA AE        .dw $AEFA                       ; Thwomp state 1: falling
$01:AEC1 24 AF        .dw $AF24                       ; Thwomp state 2: rising

$01:AEC3 BD 6C 18     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; \
$01:AEC6 D0 26        BNE $AEEE                       ; / Offscreen vertically: start falling right away
$01:AEC8 BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$01:AECB D0 2C        BNE $AEF9                       ; / Offscreen horizontally: return
$01:AECD 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side Mario is on, $0F = horizontal distance
$01:AED0 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:AED1 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Sprite direction = toward Mario
$01:AED4 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; Face [$1528] = 0 (neutral)
$01:AED7 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:AED9 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AEDA 69 40        ADC.B #$40                      ; |
$01:AEDC C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; } ([$0F] + $40) >= $80 (Mario far horizontally)? Skip
$01:AEDE B0 05        BCS $AEE5                       ; /
$01:AEE0 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:AEE2 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / Face [$1528] = 1 (Mario near: show eyes)
$01:AEE5 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:AEE7 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AEE8 69 24        ADC.B #$24                      ; |
$01:AEEA C9 50        CMP.B #$50                      ; } ([$0F] + $24) >= $50 (Mario not underneath)? Return
$01:AEEC B0 0B        BCS $AEF9                       ; /
$01:AEEE A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:AEF0 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / Face [$1528] = 2 (angry face)
$01:AEF3 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2] = 1: fall
$01:AEF5 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:AEF7 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = 0
$01:AEF9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AEFA 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$01:AEFD B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:AEFF C9 3E        CMP.B #$3E                      ; } Y speed >= $3E (terminal speed)?
$01:AF01 B0 04        BCS $AF07                       ; /
$01:AF03 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; \
$01:AF05 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / No: Y speed += 4 (gravity)
$01:AF07 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks
$01:AF0A 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:AF0D F0 14        BEQ $AF23                       ; / Not on the ground: return
$01:AF0F 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set the ground-contact Y speed
$01:AF12 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$01:AF14 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Shake the ground for $18 frames
$01:AF17 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:AF19 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $09 (Thwomp slam) on $1DFC
$01:AF1C A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:AF1E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Wait timer [$1540] = $40 frames
$01:AF21 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2] = 2: rise
$01:AF23 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AF24 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:AF27 D0 16        BNE $AF3F                       ; / Wait timer still running: return
$01:AF29 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; Face [$1528] = 0 (neutral)
$01:AF2C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:AF2E DD 1C 15     CMP.W $151C,X                   ; } At the original Y position [$151C]? If not, rise
$01:AF31 D0 05        BNE $AF38                       ; /
$01:AF33 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:AF35 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Yes: state [$C2] = 0, wait again
$01:AF37 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:AF38 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:AF3A 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F0 (rise slowly)
$01:AF3C 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$01:AF3F 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

{
;; Four corners then the face tile.
$01:AF40              .db $FC,$04,$FC,$04,$00         ; Tile X offsets: four corners, then center

}

;;; $AF45: Table: Thwomp tile Y offsets (ThwompDispY) ;;;
{
;; Four corners then the face tile.
$01:AF45              .db $00,$00,$10,$10,$08         ; Tile Y offsets: four corners, then center

}

;;; $AF4A: Table: Thwomp tile numbers (ThwompTiles) ;;;
{
;; Corners $8E/$AE, face $C8 ($CA for the angry face).
$01:AF4A              .db $8E,$8E,$AE,$AE,$C8         ; Tile numbers: corners $8E/$AE, face $C8

}

;;; $AF4F: Table: Thwomp tile properties (ThwompGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Palette/flip bits ORed with [$64].
$01:AF4F              .db $03,$43,$03,$43,$03         ; Tile properties: palette 1, X flip on right-hand tiles

}

;;; $AF54: Draw Thwomp (ThwompGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws four 16x16 corner tiles; the face tile (index 4) is added only when [$1528] is non-zero ($CA instead
;;     of $C8 when it is 2).
;; Finishes through $B37E with A = 4 (5 tiles) and size 16x16.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:AEA3: Thwomp main (Thwomp)
$01:AF54 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index and screen position
$01:AF57 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:AF5A 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = face [$1528]
$01:AF5C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:AF5D A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; \
$01:AF5F C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; |
$01:AF61 F0 01        BEQ $AF64                       ; } X = 3 (corners only), or 4 if a face is shown
$01:AF63 E8           INX                             ; /
$01:AF64 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:AF66 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AF67 7D 40 AF     ADC.W ThwompDispX,X             ; } Tile X position = base X + ThwompDispX[X]
$01:AF6A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:AF6D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:AF6F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:AF70 7D 45 AF     ADC.W ThwompDispY,X             ; } Tile Y position = base Y + ThwompDispY[X]
$01:AF73 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:AF76 BD 4F AF     LDA.W ThwompGfxProp,X           ; \
$01:AF79 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } Tile properties = ThwompGfxProp[X] | sprite priority [$64]
$01:AF7B 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:AF7E BD 4A AF     LDA.W ThwompTiles,X             ; A = tile number ThwompTiles[X]
$01:AF81 E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$01:AF83 D0 0A        BNE $AF8F                       ; / Corner tile: use as is
$01:AF85 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:AF86 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; |
$01:AF88 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; |
$01:AF8A D0 02        BNE $AF8E                       ; } Face tile: use $CA instead of $C8 when [$1528] = 2 (angry)
$01:AF8C A9 CA        LDA.B #$CA                      ; /
$01:AF8E FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:AF8F 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Set the tile number
$01:AF92 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:AF93 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:AF94 C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot
$01:AF95 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:AF96 CA           DEX                             ; \
$01:AF97 10 CB        BPL $AF64                       ; / Next tile, loop until X < 0
$01:AF99 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:AF9A A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:AF9C 4C 7E B3     JMP.W $B37E                     ; / Finish OAM write: 5 tiles of 16x16

}

;;; $AF9F: Thwimp main (Thwimp) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $27. Hops: waits $40 frames on the ground (sound $01), then jumps with Y speed $A0 and X speed
;;     alternating $10/$F0 by [$C2] bit 0.
;; Gravity +8 when falling (+3 while rising), terminal Y speed $40; ceiling contact sets Y speed $10. Drawn
;;     with SubSprGfx0Entry0.
$01:AF9F BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:AFA2 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Not sprite status 8 (normal): just draw
$01:AFA4 D0 60        BNE $B006                       ; /
$01:AFA6 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:AFA8 D0 5C        BNE $B006                       ; / Sprites locked: just draw
$01:AFAA 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:AFAD 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:AFB0 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed to X position
$01:AFB3 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$01:AFB6 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks
$01:AFB9 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:AFBB 30 06        BMI $AFC3                       ; / Y speed negative (rising)? Add 3 gravity
$01:AFBD C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; \
$01:AFBF B0 07        BCS $AFC8                       ; / Y speed >= $40? Cap it
$01:AFC1 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; Y speed += 5
$01:AFC3 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:AFC4 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; / Y speed += 3 (total +8 when falling, +3 when rising)
$01:AFC6 80 02        BRA $AFCA                       ; Store it

$01:AFC8 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:AFCA 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $40 (terminal speed)
$01:AFCC 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; \
$01:AFCF F0 04        BEQ $AFD5                       ; / Touching ceiling?
$01:AFD1 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:AFD3 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Yes: Y speed = $10 (bounce off)
$01:AFD5 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:AFD8 F0 2C        BEQ $B006                       ; / Not on the ground: draw
$01:AFDA 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set the ground-contact Y speed
$01:AFDD 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:AFDF 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / X and Y speed = 0
$01:AFE1 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:AFE4 F0 16        BEQ $AFFC                       ; / Wait timer [$1540] = 0: start waiting
$01:AFE6 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:AFE7 D0 1D        BNE $B006                       ; / Timer is not 1: keep waiting
$01:AFE9 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$01:AFEB 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $A0 (big hop)
$01:AFED F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2]++ (alternates hop direction)
$01:AFEF B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:AFF1 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = state bit 0
$01:AFF2 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10 (move right)
$01:AFF4 90 02        BCC $AFF8                       ; Bit 0 clear: keep it
$01:AFF6 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; A = $F0 (move left)
$01:AFF8 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = A
$01:AFFA 80 0A        BRA $B006                       ; Draw

$01:AFFC A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:AFFE 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $01 on $1DF9 (landing)

$01:B001 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:B003 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Wait timer [$1540] = $40 frames
$01:B006 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B008 4C F3 9C     JMP.W SubSprGfx0Entry0          ; / Draw with the generic sprite graphics routine

}

$01:B01F              .db $00,$00,$08,$F8             ; Swim Y speeds: horizontal fish (0, 0), vertical fish

$01:B023              .db $F0,$10                     ; Flop kick X speeds when killed: left, right

$01:B025              .db $E0,$E8,$D0,$D8             ; Flop Y speeds out of water

$01:B029              .db $08,$F8,$10,$F0,$04,$FC,$14,$EC ; Flop X speeds out of water
$01:B031              .db $03,$0C                     ; Wall contact masks: horizontal fish $03 (sides), vertical fish $0C (up/down)

}

;;; $B033: Cheep Cheep main (Fish) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $15/$16. In water ([$164A] set) swims back and forth, reversing on wall contact or every $80
;;     frames; vertical ones swim up/down.
;; Out of water it flops: random X/Y speeds on each ground contact, random Y flip and turning. Contact hurts
;;     Mario, unless the fish is out of water or Mario has a star, then it is kicked away.
;; Also contains: $01B10A (animate and draw), $01B12A (kill: knocked away, 10 points) and $01B14E (spawns a
;;     random water bubble, called by other sprites).
$01:B033 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:B036 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Not sprite status 8 (normal): just draw
$01:B038 D0 04        BNE $B03E                       ; /
$01:B03A A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B03C F0 03        BEQ $B041                       ; / Sprites not locked: continue
$01:B03E 4C 0A B1     JMP.W $B10A                     ; Just draw

$01:B041 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance the animation frame
$01:B044 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:B047 D0 5E        BNE $B0A7                       ; / In water [$164A]: swim
$01:B049 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update position with gravity (out of water)
$01:B04C 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; \
$01:B04F F0 03        BEQ $B054                       ; / Touching a wall?
$01:B051 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Yes: turn around
$01:B054 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:B057 F0 43        BEQ $B09C                       ; / In the air: skip the flop
$01:B059 AD 0E 19     LDA.W $190E                     ; \
$01:B05C F0 04        BEQ $B062                       ; / [$190E] = 0: skip the splash effect
$01:B05E 22 BC 84 02  JSL.L $84BC                     ; Spawn a splash ($84BC), probably
$01:B062 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Randomize
$01:B066 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:B068 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Y = (random + frame counter) & 7
$01:B06A A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:B06B B9 29 B0     LDA.W $B029,Y                   ; \
$01:B06E 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $B029[Y]
$01:B070 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Randomize
$01:B074 AD 8E 14     LDA.W RAM_RandomByte2           ; \
$01:B077 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:B079 A8           TAY                             ; } Y speed = $B025[random & 3]
$01:B07A B9 25 B0     LDA.W $B025,Y                   ; /
$01:B07D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X
$01:B07F AD 8D 14     LDA.W RAM_RandomByte1           ; \
$01:B082 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; } Random bit 6 set? Keep Y flip
$01:B084 D0 08        BNE $B08E                       ; /
$01:B086 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:B089 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; } Else toggle the Y flip bit in the sprite properties
$01:B08B 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:B08E 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Randomize
$01:B092 AD 8D 14     LDA.W RAM_RandomByte1           ; \
$01:B095 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; } Random bit 7 set? Keep direction
$01:B097 D0 03        BNE $B09C                       ; /
$01:B099 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Else face the direction of travel
$01:B09C BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:B09F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B0A0 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } Animation frame [$1602] += 2 (flopping frames)
$01:B0A2 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$01:B0A5 80 43        BRA $B0EA                       ; Go to interaction

$01:B0A7 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks (swimming)
$01:B0AA 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Face the direction of travel
$01:B0AD 1E F6 15     ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:B0B0 5E F6 15     LSR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Clear Y flip
$01:B0B3 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = block contact flags
$01:B0B6 BC 1C 15     LDY.W $151C,X                   ; Y = [$151C] (0 horizontal, 1 vertical)
$01:B0B9 39 31 B0     AND.W $B031,Y                   ; \
$01:B0BC D0 05        BNE $B0C3                       ; / Hit a wall in the swim direction ($B031[Y])? Then turn
$01:B0BE BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:B0C1 D0 07        BNE $B0CA                       ; / Else turn timer [$1540] still running? Keep swimming
$01:B0C3 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:B0C5 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Turn timer [$1540] = $80 frames
$01:B0C8 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2]++ (reverses direction)
$01:B0CA B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B0CC 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = state bit 0
$01:B0CE A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:B0CF BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B0D2 F0 02        BEQ $B0D6                       ; |
$01:B0D4 C8           INY                             ; } Vertical fish: Y += 2
$01:B0D5 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:B0D6 B9 1D B0     LDA.W $B01D,Y                   ; \
$01:B0D9 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $B01D[Y]
$01:B0DB B9 1F B0     LDA.W $B01F,Y                   ; \
$01:B0DE 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $B01F[Y]
$01:B0E0 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed
$01:B0E3 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:B0E5 D0 03        BNE $B0EA                       ; / [A] & $0C non-zero: skip vertical movement (A as returned by the X move)
$01:B0E7 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed
$01:B0EA 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Sprite-to-sprite interaction
$01:B0ED 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:B0F0 90 18        BCC $B10A                       ; No contact: draw
$01:B0F2 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:B0F5 F0 10        BEQ $B107                       ; / Fish out of water: kill it
$01:B0F7 AD 90 14     LDA.W $1490                     ; \
$01:B0FA D0 0B        BNE $B107                       ; / Mario has a star: kill it
$01:B0FC AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:B0FF D0 09        BNE $B10A                       ; / Mario on Yoshi: draw only
$01:B101 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$01:B105 80 03        BRA $B10A                       ; Draw

$01:B107 20 2A B1     JSR.W $B12A                     ; Kill the fish ($B12A)
$01:B10A BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:B10D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B10E 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } $00 = (animation frame / 2) EOR 1
$01:B110 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:B112 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:B115 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; |
$01:B117 05 00        ORA $00                         ; } Sprite properties bit 0 = $00 (selects the tile page)
$01:B119 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:B11C 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the fish (generic 16x16 graphics)
$01:B11F 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:B122 5E F6 15     LSR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:B125 38           SEC                             ; } Sprite properties bit 0 = 1 again
$01:B126 3E F6 15     ROL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; /
$01:B129 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B12A A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B12C 8D 9A 14     STA.W RAM_KickImgTimer          ; / Kick image timer = $10
$01:B12F A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:B131 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $03 on $1DF9
$01:B134 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side Mario is on
$01:B137 B9 23 B0     LDA.W $B023,Y                   ; \
$01:B13A 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $B023[Y] (knocked away from Mario)
$01:B13C A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$01:B13E 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $E0 (knocked up)
$01:B140 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:B142 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)
$01:B145 84 76        STY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Mario direction = Y
$01:B147 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B149 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; / Give 10 points
$01:B14D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B14E A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:B150 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:B152 1D 6C 18     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; |
$01:B155 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } Only every 4th frame, while on-screen vertically and sprites not locked
$01:B157 D0 38        BNE $B191                       ; /
$01:B159 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$01:B15D 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; / Random 0-15
$01:B15F 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B160 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; } A = random - 4, Y = X high offset (0)
$01:B162 69 FC        ADC.B #$FC                      ; /
$01:B164 10 01        BPL $B167                       ; \
$01:B166 88           DEY                             ; / Negative: Y = $FF
$01:B167 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B168 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } $02 = random offset + sprite X low
$01:B16A 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$01:B16C 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B16D 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / A = X high + sprite X high
$01:B170 48           PHA                             ; Save the high byte
$01:B171 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:B173 C5 1A        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; / Compare low byte with the screen X boundary
$01:B175 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B176 E5 1B        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; / High byte - screen X high - borrow
$01:B178 D0 17        BNE $B191                       ; Not on the screen horizontally: return
$01:B17A AD 8E 14     LDA.W RAM_RandomByte2           ; \
$01:B17D 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; / Random 0-15
$01:B17F 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B180 69 FE        ADC.B #$FE                      ; } A = random - 2 + sprite Y low
$01:B182 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:B184 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = bubble Y low
$01:B186 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B189 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } $01 = sprite Y high + carry
$01:B18B 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:B18D 22 BA 85 02  JSL.L $85BA                     ; Spawn a water bubble ($85BA)
$01:B191 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B192: Generated Cheep Cheep main (GeneratedFish) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $17, created by the fish generator. Flies with gravity (+1 per frame up to Y speed $20), interacts
;;     and draws via $B209.
$01:B192 20 09 B2     JSR.W $B209                     ; Interact with sprites and Mario, and draw
$01:B195 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B197 D0 17        BNE $B1B0                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:B199 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance the animation frame
$01:B19C 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed
$01:B19F 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed
$01:B1A2 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks
$01:B1A5 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B1A7 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; } Y speed >= $20? Skip gravity
$01:B1A9 10 03        BPL $B1AE                       ; /
$01:B1AB 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B1AC 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; / Y speed += 1
$01:B1AE 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store Y speed
$01:B1B0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B1B1..B1B1: Table: jumping fish Y speeds ;;;
{
;; Jump Y speed by state: $D0, $D0, $B0.
$01:B1B1              .db $D0,$D0,$B0                 ; Jump Y speeds by state: $D0, $D0, $B0

}

;;; $B1B4: Surface jumping Cheep Cheep main (JumpingFish) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $18. [$C2] counts jumps 0-3; each time it is in water it jumps with Y speed from $B1B1; state
;;     3 is a longer rise.
;; When it leaves the water in state 3 it resets to state 0 and jumps again with Y speed $D0. Ends in the
;;     shared interact/draw code at $01B209.
$01:B1B4 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B1B6 D0 51        BNE $B209                       ; / Sprites locked: just interact and draw
$01:B1B8 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:B1BB 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C] = previous in-water flag
$01:B1BE 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update position with gravity
$01:B1C1 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:B1C4 F0 24        BEQ $B1EA                       ; / Out of water: go to exit handling
$01:B1C6 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B1C8 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; } State [$C2] = 3 (final high jump)?
$01:B1CA F0 12        BEQ $B1DE                       ; /
$01:B1CC F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2]++
$01:B1CE A8           TAY                             ; \
$01:B1CF B9 B1 B1     LDA.W $B1B1,Y                   ; } Y speed = $B1B1[old state]
$01:B1D2 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B1D4 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B1D6 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $10
$01:B1D9 9E 4A 16     STZ.W $164A,X                   ; Clear in-water flag
$01:B1DC 80 28        BRA $B206                       ; Animate and draw

$01:B1DE D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed -= 1 (keeps rising)
$01:B1E0 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:B1E2 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Every 4th frame...
$01:B1E4 D0 02        BNE $B1E8                       ; /
$01:B1E6 D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; ...Y speed -= 1 again
$01:B1E8 80 1C        BRA $B206                       ; Animate and draw

$01:B1EA FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:B1ED FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; / Animation counter [$1570] += 2
$01:B1F0 DD 1C 15     CMP.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B1F3 F0 11        BEQ $B206                       ; / Was out of water last frame too: animate and draw
$01:B1F5 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B1F7 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $10
$01:B1FA B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B1FC C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; } State [$C2] != 3: animate and draw
$01:B1FE D0 06        BNE $B206                       ; /
$01:B200 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2] = 0
$01:B202 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$01:B204 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $D0 (jump again)
$01:B206 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance the animation frame
$01:B209 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with sprites and Mario
$01:B20C 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Face the direction of travel
$01:B20F 4C 0A B1     JMP.W $B10A                     ; Draw ($B10A)


}

;;; $B212..B212: Table: floating spike ball X speeds ;;;
{
;; Right, left, fast right, fast left.
$01:B212              .db $08,$F8,$10,$F0             ; Initial X speeds: right, left, fast right, fast left

}

;;; $B216: Init floating spike ball (InitFloatSpkBall) ;;;
{
;; Faces Mario, picks an X speed by direction (faster if X position bit 4 is set), then falls into
;;     InitFloatingPlat.
$01:B216 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:B219 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = sprite direction
$01:B21C B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B21E 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Sprite X position bit 4 clear?
$01:B220 F0 02        BEQ $B224                       ; /
$01:B222 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:B223 C8           INY                             ; / No: Y += 2 (fast speeds)
$01:B224 B9 12 B2     LDA.W $B212,Y                   ; \
$01:B227 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $B212[Y]
$01:B229 80 0B        BRA InitFloatingPlat            ; Continue as a floating platform

}

;;; $B22B: Init falling platform (InitFallingPlat) ;;;
{
;; Sets animation frame [$1602] (long platform), then continues into InitOrangePlat.
$01:B22B FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; Falling platform: use the long platform (animation frame 1)
}

;;; $B22E: Init orange platform (InitOrangePlat) ;;;
{
;; If [$190E] is set (probably a water level flag) floats it in water via InitFloatingPlat, else state [$C2] =
;;     1.
$01:B22E AD 0E 19     LDA.W $190E                     ; \
$01:B231 D0 03        BNE InitFloatingPlat            ; / [$190E] (probably water level flag) set: float in water
$01:B233 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Else state [$C2] = 1
$01:B235 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B236: Init platform floating in water (InitFloatingPlat) ;;;
{
;; Moves the sprite down 8 pixels at a time (checking block interaction) until it is in water ([$164A] set),
;;     at most 4 times.
;; If it never finds water the status is set back to 1 (initialization).
$01:B236 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:B238 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C] = 3 (tries left)
$01:B23B 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks (finds out if in water)
$01:B23E BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:B241 D0 1A        BNE $B25D                       ; / In water: done
$01:B243 DE 1C 15     DEC.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B246 30 1A        BMI $B262                       ; / Out of tries: set status to initialization
$01:B248 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B24A 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B24B 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Sprite Y position += 8
$01:B24D 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:B24F BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B252 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Add carry to Y high
$01:B254 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:B257 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; \
$01:B259 B0 02        BCS $B25D                       ; / Y high >= 2 (bottom of level): done
$01:B25B 80 DE        BRA $B23B                       ; Try again

$01:B25D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B25E: Init checkerboard platform (InitChckbrdPlat) ;;;
{
;; Sets animation frame [$1602] = 1 (long version).
$01:B25E FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; Checkerboard platform: use the long platform (frame 1)
$01:B261 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B262 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B264 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 1 (initialization)
$01:B267 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B268..B26A: Tables: platform speed steps and limits ;;;
{
;; Speed step -1/+1, and the speed limits $F0/$10.
$01:B268              .db $FF,$01                     ; Platform speed steps: -1, +1

$01:B26A              .db $F0,$10                     ; Platform speed limits: $F0, $10

}

;;; $B26C: Moving platforms main (Platforms) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $55-$58 (checkerboard / flying rock platforms, horizontal and vertical). Speed ramps +-1 every 4th
;;     frame to +-$10 and back,
;; pausing at each end ($18 frames, 8 for sprite $55). Moves in X for sprites below $57, otherwise Y. Mario
;;     rides it via $B457 and [$1528].
$01:B26C 20 D1 B2     JSR.W $B2D1                     ; Draw the platform
$01:B26F A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B271 D0 4F        BNE $B2C2                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:B273 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:B276 D0 2D        BNE $B2A5                       ; / End-of-travel pause timer [$1540] running: just move
$01:B278 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State [$C2]++ (frame counter)
$01:B27A B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B27C 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Only accelerate every 4th frame
$01:B27E D0 25        BNE $B2A5                       ; /
$01:B280 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B283 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [$151C] bit 0 (direction)
$01:B285 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:B286 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B288 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B289 79 68 B2     ADC.W $B268,Y                   ; |
$01:B28C 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } X speed and Y speed += $B268[Y]
$01:B28E 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:B290 D9 6A B2     CMP.W $B26A,Y                   ; \
$01:B293 D0 10        BNE $B2A5                       ; / Not at the limit $B26A[Y]: move
$01:B295 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Reverse direction: [$151C]++
$01:B298 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; A = $18 (pause frames)
$01:B29A B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B29C C0 55        CPY.B #$55                      ; } Sprite $55 (checkerboard horizontal)? Else keep $18
$01:B29E D0 02        BNE $B2A2                       ; /
$01:B2A0 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Sprite $55: pause only 8 frames
$01:B2A2 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Set the pause timer [$1540]
$01:B2A5 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B2A7 C9 57        CMP.B #$57                      ; } Sprite number >= $57 (vertical platforms)?
$01:B2A9 B0 05        BCS $B2B0                       ; /
$01:B2AB 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Horizontal: apply X speed
$01:B2AE 80 06        BRA $B2B6                       ; Go to carry handling

$01:B2B0 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Vertical: apply Y speed
$01:B2B3 9C 91 14     STZ.W $1491                     ; No horizontal carry for Mario: [$1491] = 0
$01:B2B6 AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; \
$01:B2B9 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / [$1528] = [$1491] (X movement that carries Mario)
$01:B2BC 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; Solid platform interaction with Mario
$01:B2BF 20 2B AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen1Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen (platform version)
$01:B2C2 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B2C3..B2CB: Table: platform draw styles ;;;
{
;; Indexed by sprite number - $55. 0 = checkerboard tiles drawn by $B2D1, 1 = alternate routine at
;;     $B395.
$01:B2C3              .db $00,$01,$00,$01,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Draw style by sprite $55-$62: 0 = checkerboard tiles, 1 = other
$01:B2CB              .db $01,$01,$00,$00,$00,$00     ; (more draw styles, same table)

}

;;; $B2D1: Draw checkerboard platform ;;;
{
;; Draws a 3-tile wide (frame 0, tiles $60,$61,$62) or 5-tile wide (frame 1, tiles $EA,$EB,$EB,$EB,$EC)
;;     platform of 16x16 tiles.
;; Other platform types jump to $B395.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:B26C: Moving platforms main (Platforms)
;;     $01:B53A: Orange platform main routine (OrangePlatform)
;;     $01:B657: Floating platforms and spike ball physics (Platforms2)
$01:B2D1 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B2D3 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B2D4 E9 55        SBC.B #$55                      ; } Y = sprite number - $55
$01:B2D6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:B2D7 B9 C3 B2     LDA.W $B2C3,Y                   ; \
$01:B2DA F0 03        BEQ $B2DF                       ; / Draw style 0 (checkerboard)?
$01:B2DC 4C 95 B3     JMP.W $B395                     ; Other platform: use the alternate draw routine

$01:B2DF 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index and screen position
$01:B2E2 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:B2E5 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = animation frame [$1602] (0 short, 1 long)
$01:B2E7 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B2E9 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B2EA E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:B2EC 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; |
$01:B2EF 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; } All tile Y positions = sprite Y - screen Y (first three tiles)
$01:B2F2 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; /
$01:B2F5 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; \
$01:B2F7 F0 06        BEQ $B2FF                       ; / Short platform: skip the extra tiles
$01:B2F9 99 0D 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispY,Y          ; \
$01:B2FC 99 11 03     STA.W $0311,Y                   ; / Long platform: tiles 4 and 5 Y position too
$01:B2FF AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:B302 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B304 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B305 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } First tile X position = sprite X - screen X
$01:B307 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:B30A 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B30B 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Second tile X = +16
$01:B30D 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$01:B310 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B311 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Third tile X = +32
$01:B313 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; /
$01:B316 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; \
$01:B318 F0 0C        BEQ $B326                       ; / Short platform: skip
$01:B31A 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B31B 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Fourth tile X = +48
$01:B31D 99 0C 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispX,Y          ; /
$01:B320 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B321 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Fifth tile X = +64
$01:B323 99 10 03     STA.W $0310,Y                   ; /
$01:B326 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:B329 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:B32B F0 17        BEQ $B344                       ; / Short platform: use the other tiles
$01:B32D A9 EA        LDA.B #$EA                      ; \
$01:B32F 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Long left end tile $EA
$01:B332 A9 EB        LDA.B #$EB                      ; \
$01:B334 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; |
$01:B337 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; } Middle tiles $EB
$01:B33A 99 0E 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y               ; /
$01:B33D A9 EC        LDA.B #$EC                      ; \
$01:B33F 99 12 03     STA.W $0312,Y                   ; / Right end tile $EC
$01:B342 80 15        BRA $B359                       ; Go set properties

$01:B344 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$01:B346 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Short left end tile $60
$01:B349 A9 61        LDA.B #$61                      ; \
$01:B34B 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; |
$01:B34E 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; } Middle tiles $61
$01:B351 99 0E 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y               ; /
$01:B354 A9 62        LDA.B #$62                      ; \
$01:B356 99 12 03     STA.W $0312,Y                   ; / Right end tile $62
$01:B359 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:B35B 1D F6 15     ORA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; } Tile properties = priority [$64] | sprite properties (first tile)
$01:B35E 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:B361 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; \
$01:B364 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; |
$01:B367 99 0F 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4Prop,Y           ; } Same properties for the other tiles
$01:B36A 99 13 03     STA.W $0313,Y                   ; /
$01:B36D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:B36F D0 05        BNE $B376                       ; / Long platform: skip
$01:B371 A9 62        LDA.B #$62                      ; \
$01:B373 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; / Short platform: third tile = $62 (right end)
$01:B376 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:B378 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; } A = 4 (5 tiles) for the long platform
$01:B37A D0 02        BNE $B37E                       ; /
$01:B37C A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2 (3 tiles) for the short platform
$01:B37E A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$01:B380 4C BB B7     JMP.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; / Size 16x16: finish the OAM write


}

;;; $B383: Table: diagonal platform tiles (DiagPlatTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile numbers. Probably a leftover copy: bank 3 has its own DiagPlatTiles.
$01:B383              .db $CB,$E4,$CC,$E5,$CC,$E5,$CC,$E4 ; Diagonal platform tile numbers
$01:B38B              .db $CB                         ; (last tile)

}

;;; $B38C: Draw staggered 8x8 platform (rock, orange) (FlyRockPlatTiles) ;;;
{
;; Graphics for the rock and orange platforms (sprites $56, $58, $5D, $5E), reached from $B2D1; starts
;;     with the rock tile table.
;; Draws 5 tiles (9 for sprite $5E): even slots form a top row, odd slots a row 16 pixels lower, each tile 8
;;     pixels right of the last.
;; Tiles come from DiagPlatTiles (sprite >= $5B) or the rock table; all but the first two are X-flipped.
;; Quirk: the short rock platform path (sprite < $5B, $00 = 0) is unused; the short orange one gets its end
;;     caps patched in.
$01:B38C              .db $85,$88,$86,$89,$86,$89,$86,$88 ; Rock platform tiles: $85,$88,$86,$89,$86,$89,$86,$88, then $85 on the next row (9 tiles)
$01:B394              .db $85                         ; Ninth rock platform tile

$01:B395 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index in Y (GetDrawInfo)
$01:B398 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$01:B399 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$01:B39B B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; |
$01:B39D C9 5E        CMP.B #$5E                      ; |
$01:B39F D0 01        BNE $B3A2                       ; |
$01:B3A1 C8           INY                             ; } $00 = 1 if sprite $5E (long, 9-tile platform), else 0 (5 tiles)
$01:B3A2 84 00        STY $00                         ; /
$01:B3A4 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$01:B3A5 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B3A7 38           SEC                             ; } A = sprite Y - screen Y (top row Y)
$01:B3A8 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; /
$01:B3AA 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Tile 0 Y = A (top row)
$01:B3AD 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; Tile 2 Y = A (top row)
$01:B3B0 99 11 03     STA.W $0311,Y                   ; Tile 4 Y = A (top row)
$01:B3B3 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$01:B3B5 F0 06        BEQ $B3BD                       ; / Short platform: skip tiles 6 and 8
$01:B3B7 99 19 03     STA.W $0319,Y                   ; Tile 6 Y = A (long platform only)
$01:B3BA 99 21 03     STA.W $0321,Y                   ; Tile 8 Y = A (long platform only)
$01:B3BD 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B3BE 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; / A += $10: bottom row Y
$01:B3C0 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Tile 1 Y = A (bottom row)
$01:B3C3 99 0D 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispY,Y          ; Tile 3 Y = A (bottom row)
$01:B3C6 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$01:B3C8 F0 06        BEQ $B3D0                       ; / Short platform: skip tiles 5 and 7
$01:B3CA 99 15 03     STA.W $0315,Y                   ; Tile 5 Y = A (long platform only)
$01:B3CD 99 1D 03     STA.W $031D,Y                   ; Tile 7 Y = A (long platform only)
$01:B3D0 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:B3D2 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; |
$01:B3D4 D0 02        BNE $B3D8                       ; |
$01:B3D6 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; } $01 = tile loop counter: 8 (long) or 4 (short)
$01:B3D8 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:B3DA 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:B3DB 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = [$01] - 1: tiles with a counter below this get X flipped
$01:B3DD AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:B3E0 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:B3E3 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = sprite palette bits
$01:B3E5 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B3E7 C9 5B        CMP.B #$5B                      ; |
$01:B3E9 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$01:B3EB B0 02        BCS $B3EF                       ; |
$01:B3ED A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; } Push tile table offset: 0 (DiagPlatTiles) for sprite >= $5B, 9 (rock tiles) below
$01:B3EF 48           PHA                             ; /
$01:B3F0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B3F2 38           SEC                             ; } A = sprite X - screen X (first tile X)
$01:B3F3 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; /
$01:B3F5 FA           PLX                             ; X = tile table offset
$01:B3F6 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Tile X = A
$01:B3F9 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B3FA 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / A += 8: X of the next tile
$01:B3FC 48           PHA                             ; Save next tile X
$01:B3FD BD 83 B3     LDA.W DiagPlatTiles,X           ; \
$01:B400 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile number = table[X]
$01:B403 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:B405 05 03        ORA $03                         ; / A = priority bits [$64] | palette [$03]
$01:B407 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:B408 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; |
$01:B40A E4 02        CPX $02                         ; } Compare loop counter [$01] with [$02], keeping X
$01:B40C FA           PLX                             ; /
$01:B40D B0 02        BCS $B411                       ; \
$01:B40F 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; / X flip every tile after the first two ([$01] < [$02])
$01:B411 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store tile properties
$01:B414 68           PLA                             ; A = X of the next tile
$01:B415 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:B416 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B417 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$01:B418 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:B419 E8           INX                             ; Next tile table entry
$01:B41A C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$01:B41C 10 D8        BPL $B3F6                       ; / Loop for all tiles ([$01] = 8..0 or 4..0)
