$01:B41E AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:B421 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = sprite OAM index
$01:B424 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B426 D0 1C        BNE $B444                       ; / Long platform: skip the end tile fixups
$01:B428 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B42A C9 5B        CMP.B #$5B                      ; } Sprite < $5B (rock)? else go to the orange end caps at $01B43A
$01:B42C B0 0C        BCS $B43A                       ; /
$01:B42E A9 85        LDA.B #$85                      ; \
$01:B430 99 12 03     STA.W $0312,Y                   ; / Unused: tile 4 = $85
$01:B433 A9 88        LDA.B #$88                      ; \
$01:B435 99 0E 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y               ; / Unused: tile 3 = $88
$01:B438 80 0A        BRA $B444                       ; Unused: skip to the end

$01:B43A A9 CB        LDA.B #$CB                      ; \
$01:B43C 99 12 03     STA.W $0312,Y                   ; / Short orange platform: tile 4 = $CB (end cap)
$01:B43F A9 E4        LDA.B #$E4                      ; \
$01:B441 99 0E 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y               ; / Tile 3 = $E4 (end cap)
$01:B444 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:B446 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; |
$01:B448 D0 02        BNE $B44C                       ; } A = tile count - 1: 8 (long) or 4 (short)
$01:B44A A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; /
$01:B44C 4C 7E B3     JMP.W $B37E                     ; Finish with Y = 2 (16x16) via $B37E: FinishOAMWriteRt

}

;;; $B44F: Make Mario stand on or bump sprite (InvisBlkMainRt) ;;;
{
;; Long-callable wrapper (sets data bank) used by sprites in bank 3. Makes the sprite a solid block for Mario.
;; $B457 does the work: standing on top snaps Mario to the sprite and carries him by [$1528]; touching
;;     from below bumps
;; him down (sprites >= $83 also start a hit animation); touching the side pushes him out via $B505.
;; Returns: carry set if Mario is standing on the sprite. Sets [$1471] = 1 when standing.
;; Called by:
;;     $02:BBFB: Dolphin main routine (DolphinMain)
;;     $02:CD7F: Palace Switch: generate block and draw
;;     $02:D71E: Banzai Bill, ball and chain, chained platform (Banzai+Rotating)
;;     $02:DBE0: Place Hammer Bro on platform and move platform (PutHammerBroOnPlat)
;;     $02:E554: Scale platform tile generation and balance (MushrmScaleTiles)
;;     $02:E8B5: Growing pipe logic and right tile table (GrowingPipeTiles2)
;;     $03:8476: Grey falling platform main routine (GreyFallingPlat)
;;     $03:8649: Flying grey turnblocks main routine (FlyingTurnBlocks)
;;     $03:871F: Gray lava platform main (GrayLavaPlatform)
;;     $03:8A57: Bowser statue states (BowserStatuePtrs)
;;     $03:8D6F: Message box main routine (InfoBox)
;;     $03:8DE3: Timed lift main routine (TimedLift)
;;     ... and 6 more
$01:B44F 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:B450 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($01)
$01:B451 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:B452 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; Run the solid sprite interaction ($B457)
$01:B455 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$01:B456 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:B457 20 F7 A7     JSR.W ProcessInteract           ; Check Mario contact with the sprite (ProcessInteract), carry = touching
$01:B45A 90 56        BCC $B4B2                       ; No contact: return carry clear
$01:B45C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B45E 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B45F E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } $00 = sprite Y position on screen
$01:B461 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:B463 A5 80        LDA $80                         ; \
$01:B465 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B466 69 18        ADC.B #$18                      ; } Compare Mario's feet ([$80] + $18) with the sprite top ([$00])
$01:B468 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; /
$01:B46A 10 48        BPL $B4B4                       ; Feet at or below the sprite top: side/underneath checks ($B4B4)
$01:B46C A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:B46E 30 42        BMI $B4B2                       ; / Mario moving up: do not land, return no contact
$01:B470 A5 77        LDA RAM_MarioObjStatus          ; \
$01:B472 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Mario hitting a ceiling (object status bit 3): no contact
$01:B474 D0 3C        BNE $B4B2                       ; /
$01:B476 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B478 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $10: keep him pressed onto the sprite
$01:B47A A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B47C 8D 71 14     STA.W $1471                     ; / [$1471] = 1: Mario is standing on a sprite
$01:B47F A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:B481 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$01:B484 F0 02        BEQ $B488                       ; |
$01:B486 A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; } $01 = Mario's height above the sprite: $1F, or $2F on Yoshi
$01:B488 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:B48A B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B48C 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B48D E5 01        SBC $01                         ; } Mario Y low = sprite Y low - [$01]
$01:B48F 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$01:B491 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B494 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Mario Y high = sprite Y high - borrow
$01:B496 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$01:B498 A5 77        LDA RAM_MarioObjStatus          ; \
$01:B49A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Mario touching a wall (object status bits 0-1): do not carry him
$01:B49C D0 12        BNE $B4B0                       ; /
$01:B49E A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the carry amount
$01:B4A0 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:B4A3 10 01        BPL $B4A6                       ; } A = sprite's X movement [$1528]; Y = $FF if negative
$01:B4A5 88           DEY                             ; /
$01:B4A6 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B4A7 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } Mario X low += A
$01:B4A9 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$01:B4AB 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B4AC 65 95        ADC RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; } Mario X high += sign extension + carry
$01:B4AE 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; /
$01:B4B0 38           SEC                             ; Carry set: Mario is standing on the sprite
$01:B4B1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B4B2 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear: no solid contact
$01:B4B3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B4B4 BD 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X         ; \
$01:B4B7 4A           LSR                             ; } Sprite is passable (tweaker $190F bit 0): no contact
$01:B4B8 B0 F8        BCS $B4B2                       ; /
$01:B4BA A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:B4BC A4 73        LDY RAM_IsDucking               ; |
$01:B4BE D0 04        BNE $B4C4                       ; |
$01:B4C0 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$01:B4C2 D0 02        BNE $B4C6                       ; } A = Mario head offset: 0 if big and standing, 8 if small or ducking
$01:B4C4 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; /
$01:B4C6 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:B4C9 F0 02        BEQ $B4CD                       ; } On Yoshi: A += 8
$01:B4CB 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; /
$01:B4CD 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B4CE 65 80        ADC $80                         ; } Compare Mario's head ([$80] + A) with the sprite top ([$00])
$01:B4D0 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; /
$01:B4D2 90 31        BCC $B505                       ; Head above the sprite top: Mario is beside it, push him out sideways ($B505)
$01:B4D4 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:B4D6 10 1F        BPL $B4F7                       ; / Mario falling or still: no bump, return carry clear
$01:B4D8 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B4DA 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $10: bumped back down
$01:B4DC B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B4DE C9 83        CMP.B #$83                      ; } Sprite number < $83: skip the hit animation
$01:B4E0 90 10        BCC $B4F2                       ; /
$01:B4E2 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:B4E4 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / [$1564] = $0F (timer, probably hit animation)
$01:B4E7 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B4E9 D0 07        BNE $B4F2                       ; / Sprite state non-zero (already hit): skip
$01:B4EB F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state = 1 (hit)
$01:B4ED A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B4EF 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / [$1558] = $10 (timer)
$01:B4F2 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B4F4 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect 1 (hit head) via [$1DF9]
$01:B4F7 18           CLC                             ; Return carry clear
$01:B4F8 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B4F9..B4FF: Table: Mario X offsets for side push ;;;
{
$01:B4F9              .db $0E,$F1,$10,$E0,$1F,$F1     ; Mario X offset from sprite X, low bytes: $0E/$F1 normal, $10/$E0 for $A9, $1F/$F1 for $9C,$BB,$60,$49

$01:B4FF              .db $00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF     ; Mario X offset, high bytes: $00 (Mario on the right), $FF (left)

}

;;; $B505: Push Mario out sideways ;;;
{
;; Places Mario beside the sprite: X = sprite X + offset, picked by which side he is on (SubHorizPos) and
;;     sprite type
;; ($A9 uses the second pair, $9C/$BB/$60/$49 the third), and zeroes his X speed. Returns carry clear.
$01:B505 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = 0 if Mario is right of the sprite, 1 if left (SubHorizPos)
$01:B508 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B50A C9 A9        CMP.B #$A9                      ; } Sprite $A9: Y += 2 (at $01B520)
$01:B50C F0 12        BEQ $B520                       ; /
$01:B50E C9 9C        CMP.B #$9C                      ; \
$01:B510 F0 0C        BEQ $B51E                       ; / Sprite $9C: Y += 4
$01:B512 C9 BB        CMP.B #$BB                      ; \
$01:B514 F0 08        BEQ $B51E                       ; / Sprite $BB: Y += 4
$01:B516 C9 60        CMP.B #$60                      ; \
$01:B518 F0 04        BEQ $B51E                       ; / Sprite $60: Y += 4
$01:B51A C9 49        CMP.B #$49                      ; \
$01:B51C D0 04        BNE $B522                       ; / Sprite $49: Y += 4, any other sprite: no change
$01:B51E C8           INY                             ; Y += 1 (entry for $9C, $BB, $60, $49)
$01:B51F C8           INY                             ; Y += 1
$01:B520 C8           INY                             ; Y += 1 (entry for $A9)
$01:B521 C8           INY                             ; Y += 1
$01:B522 B9 F9 B4     LDA.W $B4F9,Y                   ; \
$01:B525 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B526 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } Mario X low = sprite X low + offset table [Y]
$01:B528 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$01:B52A B9 FF B4     LDA.W $B4FF,Y                   ; \
$01:B52D 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Mario X high = sprite X high + high byte + carry
$01:B530 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; /
$01:B532 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$01:B534 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear
$01:B535 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B536: Orange platform main routine (OrangePlatform) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $5E. Normal state runs Platforms2. The rest (state non-zero) is unreferenced: draw, move on X and
;;     run away to the right
;; (X speed 8) once Mario touches it.
$01:B536 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B538 F0 29        BEQ Platforms2                  ; / State 0 (normal): run the shared platform code (Platforms2)
$01:B53A 20 D1 B2     JSR.W $B2D1                     ; Unused: draw the platform ($B2D1)
$01:B53D A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B53F D0 17        BNE $B558                       ; / Unused: return if sprites are locked
$01:B541 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Unused: move sprite horizontally by its X speed
$01:B544 AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; \
$01:B547 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / Unused: [$1528] = [$1491] (probably carry amount for Mario)
$01:B54A 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; \
$01:B54D 90 09        BCC $B558                       ; / Unused: solid interaction, return if Mario is not on it
$01:B54F A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B551 8D 9A 1B     STA.W $1B9A                     ; / Unused: [$1B9A] = 1 (purpose unclear)
$01:B554 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:B556 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Unused: sprite X speed = 8 (platform runs away once stepped on)
$01:B558 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B559: Floating spike ball main routine (FloatingSpikeBall) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $A4. Runs Platforms2 while sprite status is 8 (normal); otherwise only draws.
$01:B559 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:B55C C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; } Sprite status 8 (normal): run Platforms2
$01:B55E F0 03        BEQ Platforms2                  ; /
$01:B560 4C 66 B6     JMP.W $B666                     ; Other status: only draw ($B666)

}

;;; $B563: Floating platforms and spike ball physics (Platforms2) ;;;
{
;; Shared main routine for sprites $5B-$5D (floating/falling platforms) and $A4 (floating spike ball). Applies
;;     gravity, water
;; buoyancy, sinking under Mario's weight and a dip when he jumps off, damps Y speed, then despawns and draws.
;; Platforms use the solid interaction ($B457); the spike ball hurts Mario instead.
;; Uses [$185E] = Mario on platform now, [$151C] = same flag last frame, [$164A] = sprite in water.
$01:B563 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B565 F0 03        BEQ $B56A                       ; / Sprites not locked: continue
$01:B567 4C 4E B6     JMP.W $B64E                     ; Locked: skip to offscreen check and draw ($B64E)

$01:B56A BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:B56D 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; } Blocked above or below (object status bits 2-3): skip Y movement
$01:B56F D0 03        BNE $B574                       ; /
$01:B571 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move sprite vertically by its Y speed
$01:B574 9C 91 14     STZ.W $1491                     ; [$1491] = 0
$01:B577 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B579 C9 A4        CMP.B #$A4                      ; } Only sprite $A4 (spike ball) also moves in X
$01:B57B D0 03        BNE $B580                       ; /
$01:B57D 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move sprite horizontally by its X speed
$01:B580 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B582 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; |
$01:B584 10 02        BPL $B588                       ; } Gravity: Y speed += 1 up to $40
$01:B586 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B588 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:B58B F0 19        BEQ $B5A6                       ; / Not in water ([$164A] = 0): skip buoyancy
$01:B58D A0 F8        LDY.B #$F8                      ; \
$01:B58F B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; |
$01:B591 C9 5D        CMP.B #$5D                      ; |
$01:B593 90 02        BCC $B597                       ; |
$01:B595 A0 FC        LDY.B #$FC                      ; } $00 = max upward speed: $F8 for sprites < $5D, $FC otherwise
$01:B597 84 00        STY $00                         ; /
$01:B599 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B59B 10 04        BPL $B5A1                       ; |
$01:B59D C5 00        CMP $00                         ; } Y speed negative and past the limit: stop accelerating
$01:B59F 90 05        BCC $B5A6                       ; /
$01:B5A1 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B5A2 E9 02        SBC.B #$02                      ; } Buoyancy: Y speed -= 2 (float up)
$01:B5A4 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B5A6 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:B5A8 48           PHA                             ; / Save Mario's Y speed
$01:B5A9 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B5AB C9 A4        CMP.B #$A4                      ; } Sprite $A4 (spike ball)? else use the platform interaction at $01B5B5
$01:B5AD D0 06        BNE $B5B5                       ; /
$01:B5AF 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Spike ball: normal Mario sprite interaction (MarioSprInteractRt)
$01:B5B2 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear: not a solid platform contact
$01:B5B3 80 03        BRA $B5B8                       ; Continue at $B5B8

$01:B5B5 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; Platform: solid sprite interaction ($B457), carry = Mario on it
$01:B5B8 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B5B9 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = Mario's Y speed before the interaction
$01:B5BB 9C 5E 18     STZ.W $185E                     ; [$185E] = 0: Mario not on the platform
$01:B5BE 90 27        BCC $B5E7                       ; No contact: skip to $B5E7
$01:B5C0 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B5C2 C9 5D        CMP.B #$5D                      ; } Sprite < $5D (brown/checkerboard): skip the sinking
$01:B5C4 90 14        BCC $B5DA                       ; /
$01:B5C6 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; \
$01:B5C8 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$01:B5CA D0 01        BNE $B5CD                       ; |
$01:B5CC 88           DEY                             ; } $00 = 3 (big Mario) or 2 (small): sink speed limit
$01:B5CD 84 00        STY $00                         ; /
$01:B5CF B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B5D1 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; } Sprite Y speed >= limit: skip
$01:B5D3 10 05        BPL $B5DA                       ; /
$01:B5D5 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B5D6 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } Y speed += 2: platform sinks under Mario's weight
$01:B5D8 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B5DA EE 5E 18     INC.W $185E                     ; [$185E]++: Mario is standing on the platform
$01:B5DD A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B5DF C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; } Mario's old Y speed < $20 (soft landing): skip
$01:B5E1 90 04        BCC $B5E7                       ; /
$01:B5E3 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:B5E4 4A           LSR                             ; } Hard landing: sprite Y speed = Mario's old Y speed / 4
$01:B5E5 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B5E7 AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; \
$01:B5EA DD 1C 15     CMP.W $151C,X                   ; |
$01:B5ED 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; } Compare on-platform flag with last frame's ([$151C]) and save it; same: skip
$01:B5F0 F0 1E        BEQ $B610                       ; /
$01:B5F2 AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; \
$01:B5F5 D0 19        BNE $B610                       ; / Mario is on it now: skip (only handle stepping off)
$01:B5F7 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:B5F9 10 15        BPL $B610                       ; / Mario Y speed >= 0 (not jumping off): skip
$01:B5FB A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; \
$01:B5FD A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$01:B5FF D0 02        BNE $B603                       ; |
$01:B601 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; } $00 = 8 (big Mario) or 6 (small): dip when jumping off
$01:B603 84 00        STY $00                         ; /
$01:B605 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B607 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; } Sprite Y speed >= $20: skip
$01:B609 10 05        BPL $B610                       ; /
$01:B60B 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B60C 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Y speed += [$00]: platform dips as Mario jumps off
$01:B60E 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B610 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B612 25 13        AND RAM_FrameCounter            ; } Odd frame: skip damping and offset check
$01:B614 D0 38        BNE $B64E                       ; /
$01:B616 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:B618 F0 0A        BEQ $B624                       ; / Y speed 0: skip damping
$01:B61A 10 03        BPL $B61F                       ; \
$01:B61C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B61D 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; |
$01:B61F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B620 E9 01        SBC.B #$01                      ; } Damping: Y speed moves 1 toward zero (negative: +2 - 1, positive: -1)
$01:B622 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:B624 AC 5E 18     LDY.W $185E                     ; \
$01:B627 F0 08        BEQ $B631                       ; / Mario not on it: offset Y = 0
$01:B629 A0 05        LDY.B #$05                      ; \
$01:B62B A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$01:B62D D0 02        BNE $B631                       ; } Mario on it: offset Y = 5 (big) or 2 (small)
$01:B62F A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; /
$01:B631 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = offset
$01:B633 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B635 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite Y low
$01:B636 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B637 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Sprite Y low -= [$00]
$01:B639 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:B63B BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B63E 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite Y high
$01:B63F E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; \
$01:B641 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y high -= borrow
$01:B644 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Sprite vs block interaction at the shifted position ($9140)
$01:B647 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B648 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore sprite Y high
$01:B64B 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B64C 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore sprite Y low
$01:B64E 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far offscreen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:B651 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:B653 C9 A4        CMP.B #$A4                      ; } Sprite $A4 (spike ball)? draw it at $B666
$01:B655 F0 0F        BEQ $B666                       ; /
$01:B657 4C D1 B2     JMP.W $B2D1                     ; Draw the platform ($B2D1)


}

;;; $B65A..B65E: Table: spike ball tile offsets ;;;
{
$01:B65A              .db $F8,$08,$F8,$08             ; Spike ball tile X offsets: -8, +8, -8, +8

$01:B65E              .db $F8,$F8,$08,$08             ; Spike ball tile Y offsets: -8, -8, +8, +8

}

;;; $B662: Draw floating spike ball (FloatMineGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Table of tile properties followed by the graphics routine for sprite $A4: four 16x16 tiles in a 2x2 block
;;     around the sprite,
;; tile $AA or $AC alternating every 16 frames, with X/Y flips from the table.
$01:B662              .db $31,$71,$A1,$F1             ; Tile properties: priority 3, tile page 1; no flip, X flip, Y flip, X+Y flip

$01:B666 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index in Y, screen X/Y in $00/$01 (GetDrawInfo)
$01:B669 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:B66A A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: four tiles
$01:B66C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B66E 18           CLC                             ; } A = sprite screen X + X offset [X]
$01:B66F 7D 5A B6     ADC.W $B65A,X                   ; /
$01:B672 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Tile X
$01:B675 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:B677 18           CLC                             ; } A = sprite screen Y + Y offset [X]
$01:B678 7D 5E B6     ADC.W $B65E,X                   ; /
$01:B67B 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Tile Y
$01:B67E A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:B680 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B681 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B682 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$01:B684 4A           LSR                             ; } Tile = $AA or $AC, toggles every 16 frames ([$14] bit 4)
$01:B685 69 AA        ADC.B #$AA                      ; /
$01:B687 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Tile number
$01:B68A BD 62 B6     LDA.W FloatMineGfxProp,X        ; \
$01:B68D 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Tile properties from table
$01:B690 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:B691 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B692 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$01:B693 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:B694 CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$01:B695 10 D5        BPL $B66C                       ; Loop for all four tiles
$01:B697 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:B698 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$01:B69A A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; } Y = 2 (16x16 tiles), A = 3 (four tiles)
$01:B69C 4C BB B7     JMP.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; / Set OAM size bits and return (FinishOAMWriteRt)


}

;;; $B69F: Table: bridge length (BlkBridgeLength) ;;;
{
$01:B69F              .db $20,$00                     ; Target extension length: $20 (extend), $00 (retract)

}

;;; $B6A1: Table: bridge speed (TurnBlkBridgeSpeed) ;;;
{
$01:B6A1              .db $01,$FF                     ; Extension speed: +1 (extend), -1 (retract)

}

;;; $B6A3: Table: bridge pause timers (BlkBridgeTiming) ;;;
{
$01:B6A3              .db $40,$40                     ; Pause at each end: $40 frames

}

;;; $B6A5: Turn block bridge, horizontal and vertical (TurnBlockBridge) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $59. [$151C] is how far the outer blocks are from the center (0-$20). State bit 0 selects extending
;;     or retracting, and the
;; state increments at each end after a $40 frame pause, so bit 1 flips every second step and the bridge
;;     alternates between axes.
$01:B6A5 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far offscreen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:B6A8 20 10 B7     JSR.W $B710                     ; Draw the five turn blocks ($B710)
$01:B6AB 20 52 B8     JSR.W $B852                     ; Mario vs bridge: stand on it ($B852)
$01:B6AE 20 B2 B6     JSR.W $B6B2                     ; Update the extension ($B6B2)
$01:B6B1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B6B2 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B6B4 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [state] & 1: 0 = extending, 1 = retracting
$01:B6B6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:B6B7 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B6BA D9 9F B6     CMP.W BlkBridgeLength,Y         ; } Compare extension [$151C] with its target length
$01:B6BD F0 12        BEQ $B6D1                       ; / Reached the target: turn around ($01B6D1)
$01:B6BF BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:B6C2 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } Pause timer [$1540] running or sprites locked: do not move
$01:B6C4 D0 0A        BNE $B6D0                       ; /
$01:B6C6 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B6C9 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B6CA 79 A1 B6     ADC.W TurnBlkBridgeSpeed,Y      ; } Extension += speed (+1 or -1)
$01:B6CD 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; /
$01:B6D0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B6D1 B9 A3 B6     LDA.W BlkBridgeTiming,Y         ; \
$01:B6D4 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Pause timer [$1540] = $40
$01:B6D7 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State++: reverse direction (bit 1 toggles every second step, switching axis)
$01:B6D9 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B6DA: Turn block bridge, horizontal only (HorzTurnBlkBridge) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $5A. Same as TurnBlockBridge but the state toggles between 0 and 1, so it only moves along X.
;; $B710 (included here) draws five turn blocks (tile $40): the center plus two on each side at full and
;;     half extension,
;; with the axis chosen by state bit 1.
$01:B6DA 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far offscreen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:B6DD 20 10 B7     JSR.W $B710                     ; Draw the five turn blocks ($B710)
$01:B6E0 20 52 B8     JSR.W $B852                     ; Mario vs bridge: stand on it ($B852)
$01:B6E3 20 E7 B6     JSR.W $B6E7                     ; Update the extension ($B6E7)
$01:B6E6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B6E7 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = state (0 = extending, 1 = retracting)
$01:B6E9 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B6EC D9 9F B6     CMP.W BlkBridgeLength,Y         ; } Compare extension [$151C] with its target length
$01:B6EF F0 12        BEQ $B703                       ; / Reached the target: turn around ($01B703)
$01:B6F1 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:B6F4 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } Pause timer [$1540] running or sprites locked: do not move
$01:B6F6 D0 0A        BNE $B702                       ; /
$01:B6F8 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B6FB 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B6FC 79 A1 B6     ADC.W TurnBlkBridgeSpeed,Y      ; } Extension += speed (+1 or -1)
$01:B6FF 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; /
$01:B702 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B703 B9 A3 B6     LDA.W BlkBridgeTiming,Y         ; \
$01:B706 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Pause timer [$1540] = $40
$01:B709 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B70B 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } State ^= 1: reverse direction
$01:B70D 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$01:B70F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B710 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index and screen position (GetDrawInfo)
$01:B713 64 00        STZ $00                         ; \
$01:B715 64 01        STZ $01                         ; |
$01:B717 64 02        STZ $02                         ; } $00-$03 = 0
$01:B719 64 03        STZ $03                         ; /
$01:B71B B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B71D 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } Y = state & 2: 0 = horizontal arms, 2 = vertical arms
$01:B71F A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:B720 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:B723 99 00 00     STA.W $0000,Y                   ; |
$01:B726 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00+Y] = extension, [$01+Y] = extension / 2
$01:B727 99 01 00     STA.W $0001,Y                   ; /
$01:B72A BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = sprite OAM index
$01:B72D B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B72F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B730 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Center tile (4) Y = sprite Y - screen Y
$01:B732 99 11 03     STA.W $0311,Y                   ; /
$01:B735 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:B736 48           PHA                             ; } Push the center Y three times
$01:B737 48           PHA                             ; /
$01:B738 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B739 E5 02        SBC $02                         ; } Tile 2 Y = center Y - [$02]
$01:B73B 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; /
$01:B73E 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B73F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B740 E5 03        SBC $03                         ; } Tile 3 Y = center Y - [$03]
$01:B742 99 0D 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispY,Y          ; /
$01:B745 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B746 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B747 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } Tile 0 Y = center Y + [$02]
$01:B749 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:B74C 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B74D 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B74E 65 03        ADC $03                         ; } Tile 1 Y = center Y + [$03]
$01:B750 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; /
$01:B753 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B755 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B756 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } Center tile (4) X = sprite X - screen X
$01:B758 99 10 03     STA.W $0310,Y                   ; /
$01:B75B 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:B75C 48           PHA                             ; } Push the center X three times
$01:B75D 48           PHA                             ; /
$01:B75E 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B75F E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Tile 2 X = center X - [$00]
$01:B761 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; /
$01:B764 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B765 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B766 E5 01        SBC $01                         ; } Tile 3 X = center X - [$01]
$01:B768 99 0C 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispX,Y          ; /
$01:B76B 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B76C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B76D 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Tile 0 X = center X + [$00]
$01:B76F 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:B772 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B773 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B774 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } Tile 1 X = center X + [$01]
$01:B776 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$01:B779 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:B77B 4A           LSR                             ; } Leftover: [state] >> 2 is never used
$01:B77C 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:B77D A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; A = $40: turn block tile
$01:B77F 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; Tile 1 = $40
$01:B782 99 0E 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y               ; Tile 3 = $40
$01:B785 99 12 03     STA.W $0312,Y                   ; Tile 4 (center) = $40
$01:B788 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; Tile 2 = $40
$01:B78B 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Tile 0 = $40
$01:B78E A5 64        LDA $64                         ; A = sprite priority bits [$64]
$01:B790 99 0F 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4Prop,Y           ; Tile 3 properties
$01:B793 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; Tile 1 properties
$01:B796 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; Tile 2 properties
$01:B799 99 13 03     STA.W $0313,Y                   ; Tile 4 (center) properties
$01:B79C 09 60        ORA.B #$60                      ; \
$01:B79E 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Tile 0 properties = [$64] | $60 (X flip and a priority bit)
$01:B7A1 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B7A3 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:B7A4 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; } Save [$00] and [$02] (probably clobbered by the OAM write)
$01:B7A6 48           PHA                             ; /
$01:B7A7 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:B7A9 20 7E B3     JSR.W $B37E                     ; / A = 4 (five 16x16 tiles): finish OAM via $B37E
$01:B7AC 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B7AD 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Restore [$02]
$01:B7AF 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B7B0 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Restore [$00]
$01:B7B2 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $B7B3: Finish OAM write (long wrapper) (FinishOAMWrite) ;;;
{
;; Sets the data bank to $01 and calls FinishOAMWriteRt, which sets the OAM size bits and hides offscreen
;;     tiles.
;; Parameters: Y = tile size, A = number of tiles - 1.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C69C: Table: edge-on coin tiles (MovingCoinTiles)
;;     $02:B7A7: Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)
;;     $02:F9A1: Sumo Bro lightning flames (SumoBroFlameTiles)
;;     $03:844F: Big Boo graphics routine, flip table (BigBooGfxProp)
;;     $03:84BF: Falling platform tiles and graphics routine (FallingPlatTiles)
;;     $03:85EF: Porcu-Puffer graphics routine (PocruPufferGfxProp)
;;     $03:86FA: Flying turn blocks graphics routine (ForestPlatTileSize)
;;     $03:8769: Gray lava platform graphics (LavaPlatTiles)
;;     $03:889B: Mega Mole: tile properties (MegaMoleGfxNoFlip)
;;     $03:8BA5: Bowser statue graphics routine (BowserStatueGfx)
;;     $03:8D61: Carrot top lift graphics (CarrotTopLiftGfx)
;;     $03:8E6C: Timed lift graphics (TimedPlatformGfx)
;;     ... and 20 more
$01:B7B3 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:B7B4 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank (old bank saved)
$01:B7B5 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:B7B6 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish the OAM write: size bits, offscreen tiles (FinishOAMWriteRt)
$01:B7B9 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$01:B7BA 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $B7BB: Finish OAM write and solid-sprite helpers (FinishOAMWriteRt) ;;;
{
;; FinishOAMWriteRt: converts the tiles a sprite wrote to the OAM buffer. The OAM positions are screen-
;;     relative; this recomputes each tile's
;; level position and sets the OAM X bit 8 for tiles past the screen edge, hides tiles that are off-screen
;;     vertically (Y = $F0), and sets tile size.
;; Parameters: A: number of tiles - 1, Y: size bits ($00 = 8x8, $02 = 16x16), X: sprite index. Returns: X =
;;     sprite index.
;; $01B844: carry = tile X in $04/$05 off-screen. $01B852: solid sprite (turn block bridge): Mario stands on,
;;     bumps or is pushed away; $00/$02 set by caller.
;; $01B8FF: builds the sprite box from $00/$02 and tests contact with Mario (carry).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:8E5B: Draw Goomba wings (GoombaWingGfxRt)
;;     $01:9D5B: Draw sprite from four 8x8 tiles (SubSprGfx0Entry1)
;;     $01:B380: Draw checkerboard platform
;;     $01:B69C: Draw floating spike ball (FloatMineGfxProp)
;;     $01:B7B6: Finish OAM write (long wrapper) (FinishOAMWrite)
;;     $01:BD95: Magikoopa magic graphics, smoke spawn (MagiKoopasMagicGfx)
;;     $01:C172: Goal tape movement, check and draw
;;     $01:D4E4: Boss fireball main routine (BossFireball)
;;     $01:DC06: Grinder and fuzz ball graphics
;;     $01:E266: Keyhole main (Keyhole)
;;     $01:E4B0: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
;;     $01:E94E: Draw Lakitu's cloud (LakituCloudGfx)
;;     ... and 2 more
$01:B7BB 84 0B        STY $0B                         ; $0B = OAM size/X-high bits for the tiles (Y on entry: $00 = 8x8, $02 = 16x16)
$01:B7BD 85 08        STA $08                         ; $08 = number of tiles - 1 (loop counter; A on entry)
$01:B7BF BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite's first tile
$01:B7C2 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B7C4 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = sprite Y position low
$01:B7C6 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B7C7 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:B7C9 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = sprite Y on screen = Y low - screen Y
$01:B7CB BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B7CE 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = sprite Y position high
$01:B7D0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B7D2 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = sprite X position low
$01:B7D4 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B7D5 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:B7D7 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = sprite X on screen = X low - screen X
$01:B7D9 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:B7DC 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = sprite X position high
$01:B7DE 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B7DF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B7E0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B7E1 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM index / 4 (index into the size table at $0460)
$01:B7E2 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$01:B7E4 10 0A        BPL $B7F0                       ; / [$0B] is never negative here (0 or 2), so this branch is always taken
$01:B7E6 BD 60 04     LDA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; \
$01:B7E9 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$01:B7EB 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; / Unused: keep only the size bit of the old entry, drop X bit 8
$01:B7EE 80 03        BRA $B7F3                       ; Skip the normal store

$01:B7F0 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; OAM size entry = [$0B] (size bit, X bit 8 = 0)
$01:B7F3 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0 (high byte of the sign extension)
$01:B7F5 B9 00 03     LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; A = tile's X on screen (set by the caller relative to the sprite)
$01:B7F8 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B7F9 E5 07        SBC $07                         ; / A -= [$07]: tile offset from the sprite's left edge
$01:B7FB 10 01        BPL $B7FE                       ; \
$01:B7FD CA           DEX                             ; / X = $FF if the offset is negative (sign extension)
$01:B7FE 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B7FF 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$01:B801 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = tile X in the level = offset + sprite X low
$01:B803 8A           TXA                             ; A = $00 or $FF (sign extension)
$01:B804 65 03        ADC $03                         ; \
$01:B806 85 05        STA $05                         ; / $05 = tile X in the level, high byte = sign + sprite X high
$01:B808 20 44 B8     JSR.W $B844                     ; Carry = tile is off-screen horizontally ($B844)
$01:B80B 90 0C        BCC $B819                       ; On-screen: leave X bit 8 clear
$01:B80D 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B80E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B80F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:B810 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM index / 4
$01:B811 BD 60 04     LDA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; \
$01:B814 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; |
$01:B816 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; / Set bit 0 (X bit 8) of the size entry so the tile is not shown wrapped
$01:B819 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0 (high byte of the sign extension)
$01:B81B B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$01:B81E 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B81F E5 06        SBC $06                         ; / A = tile Y - [$06]: offset from the sprite's top edge
$01:B821 10 01        BPL $B824                       ; \
$01:B823 CA           DEX                             ; / X = $FF if the offset is negative (sign extension)
$01:B824 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B825 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:B827 85 09        STA $09                         ; / $09 = tile Y in the level = offset + sprite Y low
$01:B829 8A           TXA                             ; A = $00 or $FF (sign extension)
$01:B82A 65 01        ADC $01                         ; \
$01:B82C 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / $0A = tile Y in the level, high byte
$01:B82E 20 BF C9     JSR.W $C9BF                     ; Carry = tile is off-screen vertically ($C9BF)
$01:B831 90 05        BCC $B838                       ; On-screen: keep the tile
$01:B833 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:B835 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / Off-screen vertically: Y = $F0 hides the tile (also marks the OAM slot as free)
$01:B838 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:B839 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B83A C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B83B C8           INY                             ; / Next OAM slot: Y += 4
$01:B83C C6 08        DEC $08                         ; Count down the tiles
$01:B83E 10 9E        BPL $B7DE                       ; Loop until all tiles are done
$01:B840 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:B843 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B844 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:B846 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$01:B848 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B849 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:B84B C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; / Carry = (tile X in level [$04] - screen X) >= $0100: off-screen horizontally
$01:B84E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:B850 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B851 60           RTS                             ; Return (unreferenced)

$01:B852 BD C4 15     LDA.W $15C4,X                   ; $15C4 non-zero (probably sprite is off-screen): no interaction
$01:B855 D0 5A        BNE $B8B1                       ; Return
$01:B857 A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$01:B859 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / Only interact while Mario's animation state is 0 (normal)
$01:B85B B0 54        BCS $B8B1                       ; Mario animating: return
$01:B85D 20 FF B8     JSR.W $B8FF                     ; Carry = Mario overlaps the sprite's box ($B8FF)
$01:B860 90 4F        BCC $B8B1                       ; No contact: return
$01:B862 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B864 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B865 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:B867 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = sprite Y on screen
$01:B869 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:B86A E5 0D        SBC $0D                         ; |
$01:B86C 85 09        STA $09                         ; / $09 = sprite Y on screen - [$0D] (top of the solid box)
$01:B86E A5 80        LDA $80                         ; \
$01:B870 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B871 69 18        ADC.B #$18                      ; |
$01:B873 C5 09        CMP $09                         ; / Mario's feet ([$80] + $18) vs. the top of the box
$01:B875 B0 3B        BCS $B8B2                       ; Mario not clearly above the top: handle underside and sides
$01:B877 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed
$01:B879 30 36        BMI $B8B1                       ; Moving up: let him pass
$01:B87B 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0: standing on the sprite
$01:B87D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:B87F 8D 71 14     STA.W $1471                     ; / [$1471] = 1: Mario is standing on a solid sprite
$01:B882 A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; \
$01:B884 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B885 69 1F        ADC.B #$1F                      ; / A = [$0D] + $1F: distance from sprite Y to Mario's Y when standing on it
$01:B887 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Y = riding Yoshi flag
$01:B88A F0 03        BEQ $B88F                       ; Not on Yoshi
$01:B88C 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B88D 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; / On Yoshi: + $10 (taller)
$01:B88F 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = standing offset
$01:B891 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B893 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B894 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; |
$01:B896 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y low = sprite Y low - offset
$01:B898 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B89B E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:B89D 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; / Mario Y high = sprite Y high - borrow
$01:B89F A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (sign extension high byte)
$01:B8A1 AD 91 14     LDA.W $1491                     ; A = [$1491] (sprite's X movement this frame)
$01:B8A4 10 01        BPL $B8A7                       ; Positive: Y stays 0
$01:B8A6 88           DEY                             ; Negative: Y = $FF
$01:B8A7 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B8A8 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; |
$01:B8AA 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X low += sprite movement (carried along)
$01:B8AC 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B8AD 65 95        ADC RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; |
$01:B8AF 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; / Mario X high += sign extension
$01:B8B1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B8B2 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:B8B4 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B8B5 65 0D        ADC $0D                         ; |
$01:B8B7 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = sprite Y on screen + [$0D]: bottom of the solid box
$01:B8B9 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF: offset for big Mario standing
$01:B8BB A4 73        LDY RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$01:B8BD D0 04        BNE $B8C3                       ; / Ducking: use the small offset
$01:B8BF A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$01:B8C1 D0 02        BNE $B8C5                       ; / Powered up (not ducking): keep $FF
$01:B8C3 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Small or ducking Mario: A = $08
$01:B8C5 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:B8C6 65 80        ADC $80                         ; |
$01:B8C8 C5 02        CMP $02                         ; |
$01:B8CA 90 09        BCC $B8D5                       ; / Mario head (A + [$80]) below the box bottom? Yes: push sideways
$01:B8CC A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed
$01:B8CE 10 04        BPL $B8D4                       ; Not moving up: return
$01:B8D0 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B8D2 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Moving up into the underside: bounce down, Y speed = $10
$01:B8D4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B8D5 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$01:B8D7 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B8D8 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:B8DA 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = [$0E] + $10: horizontal push distance
$01:B8DC A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (sign extension high byte)
$01:B8DE B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B8E0 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B8E1 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:B8E3 C5 7E        CMP $7E                         ; / Sprite X on screen >= [$7E] (Mario's X on screen)?
$01:B8E5 90 08        BCC $B8EF                       ; No: push Mario to the right of the sprite
$01:B8E7 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B8E9 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:B8EB 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:B8EC 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Yes: negate $00, push Mario to the left
$01:B8EE 88           DEY                             ; Y = $FF
$01:B8EF B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B8F1 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B8F2 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:B8F4 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X low = sprite X low + push
$01:B8F6 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B8F7 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:B8FA 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; / Mario X high = sprite X high + sign extension
$01:B8FC 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$01:B8FE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B8FF A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B901 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / $0E = [$00] (half width margin)
$01:B903 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:B905 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; / $0D = [$02] (half height margin)
$01:B907 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:B909 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B90A E5 00        SBC $00                         ; |
$01:B90C 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = sprite X low - [$00]
$01:B90E BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:B911 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:B913 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / $0A = sprite X high - borrow
$01:B915 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:B917 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:B918 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B919 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:B91B 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = [$00] * 2 + $10: box width
$01:B91D B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B91F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B920 E5 02        SBC $02                         ; |
$01:B922 85 05        STA $05                         ; / $05 = sprite Y low - [$02]
$01:B924 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B927 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:B929 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; / $0B = sprite Y high - borrow
$01:B92B A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:B92D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:B92E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:B92F 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:B931 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = [$02] * 2 + $10: box height
$01:B933 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario's clipping box
$01:B937 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Carry = the boxes overlap
$01:B93B 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B93C: Table: horizontal net Koopa speed (HorzNetKoopaSpeed) ;;;
{
$01:B93C              .db $08,$F8                     ; $08 - Mario to the right (speed +8), $F8 - to the left (speed -8)

}

;;; $B93E: Init horizontal net Koopa (InitHorzNetKoopa) ;;;
{
;; X speed = +8 or -8 toward Mario, then runs the common net Koopa init at $01B950.
$01:B93E 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = 0 if Mario is to the right, 1 if left (SubHorizPos)
$01:B941 B9 3C B9     LDA.W HorzNetKoopaSpeed,Y       ; A = speed toward Mario
$01:B944 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = speed toward Mario
$01:B946 80 08        BRA $B950                       ; Join the shared net Koopa init

}

;;; $B948: Init vertical net Koopa and net Koopa common init (InitVertNetKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Vertical (sprites $22/$23): state = 1, X speed = 1, Y speed = $F8. Common part at $01B950: sets the in-
;;     front/behind-net flag from X bit 4
;; and doubles both speeds when palette bit 1 of the sprite is clear (probably the green, faster one).
;; Horizontal Koopas ($24/$25) enter at $01B93E and share this code.
$01:B948 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 1 (moves vertically)
$01:B94A F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 1 (0 + 1)
$01:B94C A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$01:B94E 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F8 (climbing up)
$01:B950 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = sprite X low
$01:B952 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$01:B954 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; \
$01:B956 D0 01        BNE $B959                       ; / If bit 4 of X is clear...
$01:B958 C8           INY                             ; ...Y = 1
$01:B959 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:B95A 9D 32 16     STA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; / Behind-scenery flag = 0 (in front of the net) or 1 (behind), set by X position
$01:B95D BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:B960 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; / Palette bit 1 set?
$01:B962 D0 04        BNE $B968                       ; Yes: keep the base speed
$01:B964 16 B6        ASL RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Palette bit 1 clear: double X speed
$01:B966 16 AA        ASL RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; ...and double Y speed
$01:B968 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $B969..B971: Table: net Koopa turn frames ;;;
{
$01:B969              .db $02,$02,$03,$04,$03,$02,$02,$02 ; Turn frames (state 0): $1602 values, bit = vertical / flip / behind
$01:B971              .db $01,$02                     ; Turn frames cont. (Y = 8, 9)

}

;;; $B973..B97B: Table: net Koopa turn palette bit ;;;
{
$01:B973              .db $01,$01,$00,$00,$00,$01,$01,$01 ; Palette bit 0 for each turn frame
$01:B97B              .db $01,$01                     ; Palette bit 0 cont. (Y = 8, 9)

}

;;; $B97D..B97D: Table: net Koopa blocked masks ;;;
{
$01:B97D              .db $03,$0C                     ; $03 - horizontal Koopa: side blocked, $0C - vertical Koopa: top/bottom blocked

}

;;; $B97F: Net Koopa main (ClimbingKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $22-$25. Walks along the net (state 0 horizontal, 1 vertical) and turns around when blocked or when
;;     it runs off the net tiles (Map16 $07-$1C).
;; [$1540] is the turn timer: $50 at start, while $30-$3F draws turning frames, at $40 it flips the in-
;;     front/behind flag, direction and Y speed.
;; Draws with SubSprGfx1; animation direction flips every 8 frames using [$1570]. Behind-net sprites use
;;     priority [$64] = $10.
$01:B97F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = turn-around timer [$1540]
$01:B982 F0 77        BEQ $B9FB                       ; Zero: walk normally
$01:B984 C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; Timer < $30: still turning, just keep moving
$01:B986 90 18        BCC $B9A0
$01:B988 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; Timer < $40 ($30-$3F): draw the turning frames
$01:B98A 90 17        BCC $B9A3                       ; Timer > $40: keep moving
$01:B98C D0 12        BNE $B9A0                       ; \
$01:B98E A4 9D        LDY RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } Timer = $40 exactly. Skip if sprites are locked
$01:B990 D0 0E        BNE $B9A0                       ; Locked: keep moving
$01:B992 BD 32 16     LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; \
$01:B995 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:B997 9D 32 16     STA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; / Toggle the in-front/behind net flag
$01:B99A 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Flip direction (negate X speed, flip sprite)
$01:B99D 20 7F BA     JSR.W $BA7F                     ; Negate Y speed
$01:B9A0 4C 37 BA     JMP.W $BA37                     ; Continue at the movement code

$01:B9A3 B4 D8        LDY RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B9A5 5A           PHY                             ; / Save Y position low on the stack
$01:B9A6 BC D4 14     LDY.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B9A9 5A           PHY                             ; / Save Y position high on the stack
$01:B9AA A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: frame index
$01:B9AC C9 38        CMP.B #$38                      ; Timer >= $38?
$01:B9AE 90 01        BCC $B9B1                       ; \
$01:B9B0 C8           INY                             ; / Second half of the turn: Y = 1
$01:B9B1 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state (0 horizontal, 1 vertical)
$01:B9B3 F0 17        BEQ $B9CC                       ; Horizontal: skip
$01:B9B5 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:B9B6 C8           INY                             ; / Vertical: frame index += 2
$01:B9B7 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:B9B9 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:B9BA E9 0C        SBC.B #$0C                      ; |
$01:B9BC 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y low -= $0C (shift the turn graphics up)
$01:B9BE BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:B9C1 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:B9C3 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y high -= borrow
$01:B9C6 BD 32 16     LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; Behind-scenery flag
$01:B9C9 F0 01        BEQ $B9CC                       ; In front: skip
$01:B9CB C8           INY                             ; Behind: frame index += 1
$01:B9CC AD EB 1E     LDA.W $1EEB                     ; \
$01:B9CF 10 05        BPL $B9D6                       ; / [$1EEB] bit 7 (probably Special Zone cleared) set?
$01:B9D1 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:B9D2 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B9D3 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B9D4 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:B9D5 C8           INY                             ; / Yes: frame index += 5 (alternate frames)
$01:B9D6 B9 69 B9     LDA.W $B969,Y                   ; A = animation frame from $B969
$01:B9D9 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; $1602 = animation frame
$01:B9DC B9 73 B9     LDA.W $B973,Y                   ; A = palette bit 0 from $B973
$01:B9DF 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = palette bit 0
$01:B9E1 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; A = sprite palette
$01:B9E4 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:B9E5 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; \
$01:B9E7 05 00        ORA $00                         ; / Palette bit 0 replaced by [$00]
$01:B9E9 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store the temporary palette
$01:B9EC 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw the sprite (SubSprGfx1)
$01:B9EF 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B9F0 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Restore the real palette
$01:B9F3 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B9F4 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore Y position high
$01:B9F7 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:B9F8 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore Y position low
$01:B9FA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:B9FB A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:B9FD D0 54        BNE $BA53                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement, just draw
$01:B9FF 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Sprite-object interaction ($9140)
$01:BA02 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = state (0 horizontal, 1 vertical)
$01:BA04 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; A = blocked-status bits
$01:BA07 39 7D B9     AND.W $B97D,Y                   ; \
$01:BA0A F0 08        BEQ $BA14                       ; / Blocked in the movement direction (mask from $B97D)?
$01:BA0C 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Yes: flip direction
$01:BA0F 20 7F BA     JSR.W $BA7F                     ; Negate Y speed
$01:BA12 80 23        BRA $BA37                       ; Continue at the movement code

$01:BA14 AD 5F 18     LDA.W $185F                     ; A = Map16 tile touched at the sprite's position ($185F)
$01:BA17 B4 AA        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y = Y speed
$01:BA19 F0 0C        BEQ $BA27                       ; Zero: use the second tile
$01:BA1B 10 02        BPL $BA1F                       ; Moving down: check the first tile
$01:BA1D 30 0B        BMI $BA2A                       ; Moving up: use the first tile too
$01:BA1F C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; \
$01:BA21 90 E9        BCC $BA0C                       ; / Tile < $07: not a net tile, bounce
$01:BA23 C9 1D        CMP.B #$1D                      ; \
$01:BA25 B0 E5        BCS $BA0C                       ; / Tile >= $1D: not a net tile, bounce
$01:BA27 AD 60 18     LDA.W $1860                     ; A = second Map16 tile ($1860)
$01:BA2A C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; \
$01:BA2C 90 04        BCC $BA32                       ; / Tile < $07: ran off the net, start turning
$01:BA2E C9 1D        CMP.B #$1D                      ; \
$01:BA30 90 05        BCC $BA37                       ; / Tile in $07-$1C (net): keep moving
$01:BA32 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$01:BA34 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Off the net: turn-around timer = $50
$01:BA37 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:BA39 D0 18        BNE $BA53                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$01:BA3B FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Animation frame counter ++
$01:BA3E 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Set direction from X speed
$01:BA41 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = state
$01:BA43 D0 05        BNE $BA4A                       ; Vertical: move vertically
$01:BA45 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position (no gravity)
$01:BA48 80 03        BRA $BA4D                       ; Skip

$01:BA4A 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$01:BA4D 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Interact with Mario
$01:BA50 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:BA53 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = direction
$01:BA56 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:BA57 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:BA5A 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$01:BA5C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:BA5D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:BA5E 4A           LSR                             ; / Direction = bit 3 of the counter: flips every 8 frames (walk animation)
$01:BA5F 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Store the animation direction
$01:BA62 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; A = sprite priority/property bits [$64]
$01:BA64 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:BA65 BD 32 16     LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; \
$01:BA68 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / $1602 = animation frame = behind-scenery flag
$01:BA6B BD 32 16     LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; A = behind-scenery flag
$01:BA6E F0 04        BEQ $BA74                       ; In front: keep priority
$01:BA70 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:BA72 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Behind: [$64] = $10 (draw behind the layer)
$01:BA74 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw the sprite (SubSprGfx1)
$01:BA77 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:BA78 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64]
$01:BA7A 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:BA7B 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Restore the real direction
$01:BA7E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:BA7F B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:BA81 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:BA83 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:BA84 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = -Y speed
$01:BA86 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $BA87: Init climbing net door (InitClimbingDoor) ;;;
{
;; Offsets the sprite by (+8, +7).
$01:BA87 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:BA89 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BA8A 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:BA8C 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Sprite X += 8
$01:BA8E B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:BA90 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; |
$01:BA92 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y += 7 (carry from the add above is clear)
$01:BA94 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $BA95..BA9F: Unused data, then door X offset table ;;;
{
$01:BA95              .db $30,$54                     ; Unused data ($30, $54)

$01:BA97              .db $00,$01,$02,$04,$06,$09,$0C,$0D ; Door tile X offsets per animation step (indexed by timer / 2)
$01:BA9F              .db $14,$0D,$0C,$09,$06,$04,$02,$01 ; Door X offsets cont.
}

;;; $BAA7..BAAF: Table: climbing door frames per step ;;;
{
$01:BAA7              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$01,$01 ; Door frame (0 = closed, 1 = half, 2 = open) per animation step
$01:BAAF              .db $02,$01,$01,$01,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Door frames cont.
}

;;; $BAB7..BAC7: Table: climbing door tile numbers ;;;
{
$01:BAB7              .db $00,$10,$00,$00,$10,$00,$01,$11 ; Door tile numbers: 9 per frame (frame 0)
$01:BABF              .db $01,$05,$15,$05,$05,$15,$05,$00 ; Door tile numbers cont. (frame 1 starts at $BAC0)
$01:BAC7              .db $00,$00,$03,$13,$03         ; Door tile numbers (frame 2)

}

;;; $BACC: Return stub for climbing door ;;;
{
$01:BACC 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $BACD: Climbing net door main (ClimbingDoor) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $54. When Mario punches the net next to it ([$149E] probably the punch flag) a 6 frame delay starts
;;     in [$154C]; at 1 it plays sound $0F,
;; generates tile $19, and starts the $1F frame door swing in [$1540]. At [$1540] = $10 it toggles Mario's
;;     behind-scenery flag [$13F9]; at 1 it generates tile $1A.
;; Draws nine 16x16 tiles at OAM $0330: the door halves slide by $BA97 and unused columns get X bit 8 so
;;     they are hidden.
;; $01BC1D: sets Mario's 16x16 clipping box ($00-$03, $08, $09).
$01:BACD 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when off-screen
$01:BAD0 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; A = interaction-disable timer [$154C]
$01:BAD3 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Reached 1?
$01:BAD5 D0 1E        BNE $BAF5                       ; No: skip
$01:BAD7 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:BAD9 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $0F
$01:BADC A9 19        LDA.B #$19                      ; \
$01:BADE 22 00 C0 03  JSL.L GenTileFromSpr2           ; / Generate tile $19 at the sprite (GenTileFromSpr2)
$01:BAE2 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:BAE4 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Door animation timer [$1540] = $1F
$01:BAE7 8D 9D 14     STA.W $149D                     ; [$149D] = $1F (probably a Mario-side timer for passing through)
$01:BAEA A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:BAEC 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BAED E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:BAEF 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BAF0 F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:BAF2 8D 78 18     STA.W $1878                     ; / [$1878] = Mario X - $10 - sprite X
$01:BAF5 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:BAF8 1D 4C 15     ORA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / OR with the disable timer: both zero means the door is idle
$01:BAFB D0 19        BNE $BB16                       ; Door busy: skip the punch check
$01:BAFD 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Sprite clipping box A
$01:BB01 20 1D BC     JSR.W $BC1D                     ; Mario clipping: 16x16 at Mario's position ($BC1D)
$01:BB04 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Carry = Mario touches the door
$01:BB08 90 0C        BCC $BB16                       ; No: skip
$01:BB0A AD 9E 14     LDA.W $149E                     ; \
$01:BB0D C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / [$149E] (probably net punch flag) = 1?
$01:BB0F D0 05        BNE $BB16                       ; No: skip
$01:BB11 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:BB13 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Punched: start the opening delay, [$154C] = 6
$01:BB16 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = door timer
$01:BB19 F0 B1        BEQ $BACC                       ; Zero: return
$01:BB1B C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1?
$01:BB1D D0 08        BNE $BB27                       ; No: skip
$01:BB1F 48           PHA                             ; Save the timer
$01:BB20 A9 1A        LDA.B #$1A                      ; \
$01:BB22 22 00 C0 03  JSL.L GenTileFromSpr2           ; / Generate tile $1A at the sprite (GenTileFromSpr2)
$01:BB26 68           PLA                             ; Restore the timer
$01:BB27 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; Timer = $10? (midpoint)
$01:BB29 D0 08        BNE $BB33                       ; No: skip
$01:BB2B AD F9 13     LDA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; \
$01:BB2E 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:BB30 8D F9 13     STA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; / Toggle Mario's behind-scenery flag [$13F9]
$01:BB33 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:BB35 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / OAM index = $30
$01:BB38 85 03        STA $03                         ; $03 = OAM index
$01:BB3A A8           TAY                             ; Y = OAM index
$01:BB3B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:BB3D 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BB3E E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:BB40 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = sprite X on screen
$01:BB42 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:BB44 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BB45 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:BB47 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = sprite Y on screen
$01:BB49 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:BB4C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:BB4D 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = timer / 2: animation step
$01:BB4F AA           TAX                             ; X = animation step
$01:BB50 BD A7 BA     LDA.W $BAA7,X                   ; \
$01:BB53 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = door frame (0-2) for this step
$01:BB55 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BB57 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BB58 7D 97 BA     ADC.W $BA97,X                   ; |
$01:BB5B 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / Tile 0 X = sprite X + offset
$01:BB5E 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; Tile 1 X
$01:BB61 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; Tile 2 X (left door column)
$01:BB64 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = door frame
$01:BB66 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Frame 2 (fully open)?
$01:BB68 F0 24        BEQ $BB8E                       ; Yes: no right-hand columns
$01:BB6A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BB6C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BB6D 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; |
$01:BB6F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BB70 FD 97 BA     SBC.W $BA97,X                   ; / A = sprite X + $20 - offset: right door column
$01:BB73 99 0C 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispX,Y          ; Tile 3 X
$01:BB76 99 10 03     STA.W $0310,Y                   ; Tile 4 X
$01:BB79 99 14 03     STA.W $0314,Y                   ; Tile 5 X
$01:BB7C A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = door frame
$01:BB7E D0 0E        BNE $BB8E                       ; Frame 1: no middle column
$01:BB80 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BB82 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BB83 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; / A = sprite X + $10: middle column
$01:BB85 99 18 03     STA.W $0318,Y                   ; Tile 6 X
$01:BB88 99 1C 03     STA.W $031C,Y                   ; Tile 7 X
$01:BB8B 99 20 03     STA.W $0320,Y                   ; Tile 8 X
$01:BB8E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = sprite Y on screen
$01:BB90 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Tile 0 Y
$01:BB93 99 0D 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispY,Y          ; Tile 3 Y
$01:BB96 99 19 03     STA.W $0319,Y                   ; Tile 6 Y
$01:BB99 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:BB9A 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; / A += $10: second row
$01:BB9C 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Tile 1 Y
$01:BB9F 99 11 03     STA.W $0311,Y                   ; Tile 4 Y
$01:BBA2 99 1D 03     STA.W $031D,Y                   ; Tile 7 Y
$01:BBA5 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:BBA6 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; / A += $10: third row
$01:BBA8 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; Tile 2 Y
$01:BBAB 99 15 03     STA.W $0315,Y                   ; Tile 5 Y
$01:BBAE 99 21 03     STA.W $0321,Y                   ; Tile 8 Y
$01:BBB1 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:BBB3 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = 8: nine tiles
$01:BBB5 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$01:BBB7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:BBB8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:BBB9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:BBBA 65 06        ADC $06                         ; |
$01:BBBC AA           TAX                             ; / X = frame * 9: index into $BAB7
$01:BBBD BD B7 BA     LDA.W $BAB7,X                   ; A = tile number
$01:BBC0 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store the tile
$01:BBC3 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:BBC4 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:BBC5 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:BBC6 C8           INY                             ; / Next OAM slot: Y += 4
$01:BBC7 E8           INX                             ; Next tile number
$01:BBC8 C6 07        DEC $07                         ; Count down
$01:BBCA 10 F1        BPL $BBBD                       ; Loop for 9 tiles
$01:BBCC A4 03        LDY $03                         ; Y = OAM index
$01:BBCE A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: tile counter
$01:BBD0 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:BBD2 09 09        ORA.B #$09                      ; / A = [$64] | $09: priority bits, palette and page
$01:BBD4 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$01:BBD6 B0 02        BCS $BBDA                       ; / Tiles X < 6...
$01:BBD8 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; ...are X-flipped
$01:BBDA E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; \
$01:BBDC F0 08        BEQ $BBE6                       ; / Tiles 0, 3, 6...
