$01:BBDE E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; \
$01:BBE0 F0 04        BEQ $BBE6                       ; / ...
$01:BBE2 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$01:BBE4 D0 02        BNE $BBE8                       ; / ...are Y-flipped
$01:BBE6 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; Y flip
$01:BBE8 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store the OAM properties
$01:BBEB C8           INY                             ; \
$01:BBEC C8           INY                             ; |
$01:BBED C8           INY                             ; |
$01:BBEE C8           INY                             ; / Next OAM slot: Y += 4
$01:BBEF CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$01:BBF0 10 DE        BPL $BBD0                       ; Loop for 9 tiles
$01:BBF2 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; A = door frame
$01:BBF4 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:BBF5 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:BBF8 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:BBFA 20 7E B3     JSR.W $B37E                     ; / Finish the OAM write: nine 16x16 tiles ($B37E)
$01:BBFD A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; Y = $0C: first OAM size entry used by the door ($30 / 4)
$01:BBFF 68           PLA                             ; Restore the door frame
$01:BC00 F0 1A        BEQ $BC1C                       ; Frame 0: all columns shown, return
$01:BC02 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Frame 2?
$01:BC04 D0 0B        BNE $BC11                       ; No: frame 1
$01:BC06 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:BC08 99 63 04     STA.W $0463,Y                   ; / Frame 2 (open):
$01:BC0B 99 64 04     STA.W $0464,Y                   ; Hide tile 4 (X bit 8 set)
$01:BC0E 99 65 04     STA.W $0465,Y                   ; Hide tile 5
$01:BC11 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:BC13 99 66 04     STA.W $0466,Y                   ; / Frames 1 and 2: hide tile 6 (X bit 8 and size set)
$01:BC16 99 67 04     STA.W $0467,Y                   ; Hide tile 7
$01:BC19 99 68 04     STA.W $0468,Y                   ; Hide tile 8
$01:BC1C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:BC1D A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:BC1F 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = Mario X low
$01:BC21 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:BC23 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = Mario Y low
$01:BC25 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:BC27 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = $03 = $10: 16x16 box
$01:BC29 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:BC2B A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$01:BC2D 85 08        STA $08                         ; / $08 = Mario X high
$01:BC2F A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$01:BC31 85 09        STA $09                         ; / $09 = Mario Y high
$01:BC33 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $BC34: Table: Magikoopa magic palettes (MagiKoopasMagicPals) ;;;
{
$01:BC34              .db $05,$07,$09,$0B        !@#  ; Palette cycle for the magic: $05, $07, $09, $0B

}

;;; $BC38: Magikoopa magic main (MagikoopasMagic) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $20. Moves and checks the block above it; when it hits a ceiling it plays sound 1, dies, and if the
;;     block tile is $11-$2D turns it into a sprite chosen
;; from a random number ($78 1-Up, $21, $27, else $07) and replaces the block with block $02. Also spawns
;;     smoke ($BD98).
;; Otherwise interacts with sprites and Mario, cycles its palette from MagiKoopasMagicPals and despawns below
;;     the screen.
$01:BC38 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$01:BC3A F0 03        BEQ $BC3F                       ; No: run
$01:BC3C 4C BD BC     JMP.W $BCBD                     ; Locked: just draw

$01:BC3F 20 4E B1     JSR.W $B14E                     ; Spawn the magic trail particle ($B14E)
$01:BC42 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position
$01:BC45 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position
$01:BC48 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:BC4A 48           PHA                             ; / Save Y speed
$01:BC4B A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:BC4D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $FF while checking block contact
$01:BC4F 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Sprite-object interaction ($9140)
$01:BC52 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:BC53 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Restore Y speed
$01:BC55 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; A = hit the ceiling (a block above)?
$01:BC58 F0 63        BEQ $BCBD                       ; No: draw
$01:BC5A BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Off-screen horizontally?
$01:BC5D D0 5E        BNE $BCBD                       ; Yes: draw only
$01:BC5F A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:BC61 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 1
$01:BC64 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Kill the magic (status 0)
$01:BC67 AD 5F 18     LDA.W $185F                     ; A = Map16 tile touched ($185F)
$01:BC6A 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:BC6B E9 11        SBC.B #$11                      ; |
$01:BC6D C9 1D        CMP.B #$1D                      ; / A = tile - $11: tiles $11-$2D qualify
$01:BC6F B0 48        BCS $BCB9                       ; Not one of them: just smoke
$01:BC71 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Random number
$01:BC75 6D 8E 14     ADC.W RAM_RandomByte2           ; \
$01:BC78 65 7B        ADC RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; |
$01:BC7A 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; / Mix in RAM_RandomByte2, Mario X speed and frame counter
$01:BC7C A0 78        LDY.B #$78                      ; \
$01:BC7E C9 35        CMP.B #$35                      ; / Y = $78 (1-Up Mushroom) if A = $35
$01:BC80 F0 0E        BEQ StoreSpriteNum              ; Sprite = $78
$01:BC82 A0 21        LDY.B #$21                      ; \
$01:BC84 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / Y = $21 if A < $08
$01:BC86 90 08        BCC StoreSpriteNum              ; Sprite = $21
$01:BC88 A0 27        LDY.B #$27                      ; \
$01:BC8A C9 F7        CMP.B #$F7                      ; / Y = $27 if A >= $F7
$01:BC8C B0 02        BCS StoreSpriteNum              ; Sprite = $27
$01:BC8E A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Otherwise Y = $07
}

;;; $BC90: Spawn sprite from the magic (StoreSpriteNum) ;;;
{
;; Entry with Y = sprite number from the random pick; initialises it at the block position.
$01:BC90 94 9E        STY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Sprite number = Y
$01:BC92 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:BC94 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:BC97 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialise the sprite tables
$01:BC9B A5 9B        LDA RAM_BlockXHi                ; \
$01:BC9D 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Sprite X high = block X high
$01:BCA0 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$01:BCA2 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:BCA4 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Sprite X low = block X low rounded to 16
$01:BCA6 A5 99        LDA RAM_BlockYHi                ; \
$01:BCA8 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y high = block Y high
$01:BCAB A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$01:BCAD 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:BCAF 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y low = block Y low rounded to 16
$01:BCB1 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:BCB3 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; / Block to generate = $02 (probably blank/empty)
$01:BCB5 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; Generate the tile in the level
$01:BCB9 20 98 BD     JSR.W $BD98                     ; Spawn a smoke puff ($BD98)
$01:BCBC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:BCBD 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Sprite-to-sprite and Mario interaction
$01:BCC0 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:BCC2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:BCC3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:BCC4 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:BCC6 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = (frame counter / 4) AND 3
$01:BCC7 B9 34 BC     LDA.W MagiKoopasMagicPals,Y     ; A = palette from MagiKoopasMagicPals
$01:BCCA 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Cycle the sprite palette
$01:BCCD 20 F0 BC     JSR.W MagiKoopasMagicGfx        ; Draw the magic (MagiKoopasMagicGfx)
$01:BCD0 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn handling
$01:BCD3 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:BCD5 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BCD6 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:BCD8 C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; / A = Y on screen; compare with $E0
$01:BCDA 90 03        BCC $BCDF                       ; On-screen: return
$01:BCDC 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Below the screen: kill the sprite
$01:BCDF 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $BCE0: Table: Magikoopa magic offsets (MagiKoopasMagicDisp) ;;;
{
$01:BCE0              .db $00,$01,$02,$05,$08,$0B,$0E,$0F ; Offsets for the magic graphics (MagiKoopasMagicGfx)
$01:BCE8              .db $10,$0F,$0E,$0B,$08,$05,$02,$01 ; Offsets cont.

}

;;; $BCF0: Magikoopa magic graphics, smoke spawn (MagiKoopasMagicGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws the Magikoopa's magic sprite as three 8x8 tiles ($88, $89, $98) orbiting the sprite's center on a
;;     16-step circle (MagiKoopasMagicDisp), phase driven by [FrameCounterB].
;; Tail ($01BD98, called by the magic sprite when it hits something): spawns a puff of smoke (type 1, timer
;;     $1B) in the first free of the four smoke slots at $17C0.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:BCCD: Spawn sprite from the magic (StoreSpriteNum)
$01:BCF0 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index into Y and screen-relative position into $00 (X), $01 (Y)
$01:BCF3 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:BCF5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:BCF6 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:BCF8 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = ([FrameCounterB] / 2) & $0F: phase index for the X offset
$01:BCFA 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:BCFB 69 0C        ADC.B #$0C                      ; |
$01:BCFD 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:BCFF 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = ([$03] + $0C) & $0F: Y phase, a quarter turn behind X
$01:BD01 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:BD03 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BD04 E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:BD06 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Screen Y -= 4 (center the 8x8 tiles)
$01:BD08 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BD0A 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:BD0B E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:BD0D 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Screen X -= 4
$01:BD0F A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = Y phase index
$01:BD11 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:BD13 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD14 7D E0 BC     ADC.W MagiKoopasMagicDisp,X     ; |
$01:BD17 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / Tile 1 Y = screen Y + MagiKoopasMagicDisp[[$02]]
$01:BD1A A6 03        LDX $03                         ; X = X phase index
$01:BD1C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BD1E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD1F 7D E0 BC     ADC.W MagiKoopasMagicDisp,X     ; |
$01:BD22 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / Tile 1 X = screen X + MagiKoopasMagicDisp[[$03]]
$01:BD25 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:BD27 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD28 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; |
$01:BD2A 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:BD2C 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = ([$02] + 5) & $0F: next tile is 5 of 16 steps further round the circle
$01:BD2E AA           TAX                             ; X = Y phase for tile 2
$01:BD2F A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:BD31 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD32 7D E0 BC     ADC.W MagiKoopasMagicDisp,X     ; |
$01:BD35 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; / Tile 2 Y = screen Y + MagiKoopasMagicDisp[[$02]]
$01:BD38 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$01:BD3A 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD3B 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; |
$01:BD3D 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:BD3F 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = ([$03] + 5) & $0F
$01:BD41 AA           TAX                             ; X = X phase for tile 2
$01:BD42 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BD44 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD45 7D E0 BC     ADC.W MagiKoopasMagicDisp,X     ; |
$01:BD48 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; / Tile 2 X = screen X + MagiKoopasMagicDisp[[$03]]
$01:BD4B A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:BD4D 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD4E 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; |
$01:BD50 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:BD52 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = ([$02] + 5) & $0F
$01:BD54 AA           TAX                             ; X = Y phase for tile 3
$01:BD55 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:BD57 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD58 7D E0 BC     ADC.W MagiKoopasMagicDisp,X     ; |
$01:BD5B 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; / Tile 3 Y = screen Y + MagiKoopasMagicDisp[[$02]]
$01:BD5E A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$01:BD60 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD61 69 05        ADC.B #$05                      ; |
$01:BD63 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:BD65 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = ([$03] + 5) & $0F
$01:BD67 AA           TAX                             ; X = X phase for tile 3
$01:BD68 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:BD6A 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BD6B 7D E0 BC     ADC.W MagiKoopasMagicDisp,X     ; |
$01:BD6E 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; / Tile 3 X = screen X + MagiKoopasMagicDisp[[$03]]
$01:BD71 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = Sprite index
$01:BD74 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:BD77 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } Tile properties = sprite palette | sprite priority bits [$64]
$01:BD79 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; |
$01:BD7C 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; |
$01:BD7F 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; / Same properties for all three tiles
$01:BD82 A9 88        LDA.B #$88                      ; \
$01:BD84 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile 1 = $88
$01:BD87 A9 89        LDA.B #$89                      ; \
$01:BD89 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; / Tile 2 = $89
$01:BD8C A9 98        LDA.B #$98                      ; \
$01:BD8E 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; / Tile 3 = $98
$01:BD91 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$01:BD93 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:BD95 4C BB B7     JMP.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; / Y = 0 (8x8 tiles), A = 2 (three tiles): finish OAM write

$01:BD98 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: search the four smoke sprite slots
$01:BD9A B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; Is smoke slot Y free?
$01:BD9D F0 04        BEQ $BDA3                       ; Yes: use it
$01:BD9F 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$01:BDA0 10 F8        BPL $BD9A                       ; Loop until all four checked
$01:BDA2 60           RTS                             ; No free slot: return

$01:BDA3 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:BDA5 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Smoke sprite type = 1 (puff of smoke)
$01:BDA8 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:BDAA 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; / Smoke X position = sprite X
$01:BDAD B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:BDAF 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; / Smoke Y position = sprite Y
$01:BDB2 A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; \
$01:BDB4 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Smoke timer = $1B frames
$01:BDB7 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $BDB8: Init Magikoopa (InitMagikoopa) ;;;
{
;; Erases this sprite if another Magikoopa (sprite $1F) already exists, so only one is ever active. Otherwise
;;     clears the kill flag [$18BF].
$01:BDB8 A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: check the other sprite slots
$01:BDBA CC E9 15     CPY.W $15E9                     ; Skip this sprite's own slot
$01:BDBD F0 10        BEQ $BDCF                       ; It is ourselves: next slot
$01:BDBF B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Sprite status of slot Y
$01:BDC2 F0 0B        BEQ $BDCF                       ; Empty slot: next slot
$01:BDC4 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Sprite number of slot Y
$01:BDC7 C9 1F        CMP.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:BDC9 D0 04        BNE $BDCF                       ; / Not a Magikoopa (sprite $1F): next slot
$01:BDCB 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Another Magikoopa exists: erase this one (only one at a time)
$01:BDCE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:BDCF 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$01:BDD0 10 E8        BPL $BDBA                       ; Loop for slots 9 to 0
$01:BDD2 9C BF 18     STZ.W $18BF                     ; No other Magikoopa: clear [$18BF] (Magikoopa kill flag)
$01:BDD5 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $BDD6: Magikoopa main (Magikoopa) ;;;
{
;; Resets to state 0 when off-screen horizontally, then runs the state in [state] & 3:
;; 0 hidden (waits for a random spot, then fades in), 1 fading in, 2 visible and casting, 3 fading out (then
;;     back to 0 after a $10 frame cooldown).
$01:BDD6 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:BDD8 9D D0 15     STA.W $15D0,X                   ; / [$15D0,X] = 1 (probably: not edible by Yoshi while hidden)
$01:BDDB BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$01:BDDE F0 02        BEQ $BDE2                       ; / Off-screen horizontally?
$01:BDE0 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yes: reset to state 0 (hidden)
$01:BDE2 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:BDE4 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / A = [state] & 3
$01:BDE6 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine below

}

;;; $BDEA: Magikoopa states and helpers (MagiKoopaPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table (hidden, fading in, visible, fading out) followed by the state routines.
;; State 0 ($01BDF2): picks a random screen position, requires Mario at least $20 pixels away horizontally and
;;     ground below, then fades in.
;; State 1 ($01BE5F) and state 3 ($01BF16): palette fade using $C004 / $BFE3.
;; $01BF1D: spawns the magic sprite ($20) aimed at Mario. $01BF6A: aim routine. A = speed; returns $00 = Y
;;     speed, $01 = X speed.
;; $01BFE3 / $01C004: step the fade timers. $01C028 queues one 16-byte palette block (MagiKoopaPals) for the
;;     CGRAM upload at $0681.
$01:BDEA F2 BD        .dw $BDF2                       ; State 0: hidden, waiting to teleport in
$01:BDEC 5F BE        .dw $BE5F                       ; State 1: fading in
$01:BDEE 6E BE        .dw $BE6E                       ; State 2: visible, casting
$01:BDF0 16 BF        .dw $BF16                       ; State 3: fading out

$01:BDF2 AD BF 18     LDA.W $18BF                     ; State 0: [$18BF] set (Magikoopa kill flag)?
$01:BDF5 F0 04        BEQ $BDFB                       ; No: continue
$01:BDF7 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Yes: erase the sprite
$01:BDFA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:BDFB A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \ Branch if sprites locked
$01:BDFD D0 5F        BNE $BE5E                       ; /
$01:BDFF A0 24        LDY.B #$24                      ; \
$01:BE01 84 40        STY $40                         ; / [$40] (color math layers) = $24: normal
$01:BE03 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Cooldown timer [$1540] still running?
$01:BE06 D0 56        BNE $BE5E                       ; Yes: return
$01:BE08 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; A = random number
$01:BE0C C9 D1        CMP.B #$D1                      ; \
$01:BE0E B0 4E        BCS $BE5E                       ; / Random >= $D1: not this frame, return
$01:BE10 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:BE11 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:BE13 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:BE15 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y = (random + screen Y) & $F0: random row on screen
$01:BE17 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; \
$01:BE19 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:BE1B 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y high byte (carry from the add)
$01:BE1E 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; A = random number
$01:BE22 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:BE23 65 1A        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:BE25 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:BE27 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Sprite X = (random + screen X) & $F0: random column on screen
$01:BE29 A5 1B        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; \
$01:BE2B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:BE2D 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Sprite X high byte (carry from the add)
$01:BE30 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal distance to Mario in $0F
$01:BE33 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:BE35 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:BE36 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; |
$01:BE38 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; / Is |distance| < $20?
$01:BE3A 90 22        BCC $BE5E                       ; Too close to Mario: try again next frame
$01:BE3C 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$01:BE3E A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:BE40 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Sprite X speed = 1 (for the object interaction check)
$01:BE42 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks (sets [$1588,X] contact flags)
$01:BE45 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Is the sprite standing on something?
$01:BE48 F0 14        BEQ $BE5E                       ; No: try again
$01:BE4A AD 62 18     LDA.W $1862                     ; Extra block check [$1862] (probably: blocked by a special tile)
$01:BE4D D0 0F        BNE $BE5E                       ; Non-zero: try again
$01:BE4F F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Next state (fade in)
$01:BE51 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Fade step counter [$1570,X] = 0
$01:BE54 20 82 BE     JSR.W $BE82                     ; Run the visible-state code once (sets color math, draws)
$01:BE57 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal direction to Mario in Y
$01:BE5A 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:BE5B 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Face Mario
$01:BE5E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:BE5F 20 04 C0     JSR.W $C004                     ; State 1: palette fade-in step
$01:BE62 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame = 0
$01:BE65 20 67 9D     JSR.W SubSprGfx1                ; Draw the sprite
$01:BE68 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $BE69..BE6C: Data: Magikoopa pose frames, wand offsets ;;;
{
$01:BE69              .db $04,$02,$00                 ; Frame base by phase: $04 casting after spell, $02 raising wand, $00 (unused)

$01:BE6C              .db $10,$F8                     ; Wand X offset by direction: $10 right, $F8 left

}

;;; $BE6E: Magikoopa visible state, fade, goal tape init ;;;
{
;; $01BE6E: state 2. Faces Mario and counts [$1540]: casts the magic at timer $40, then poses and draws with a
;;     wand tile, sparkles while the wand is raised.
;; $01BFE3..$01C061: fade helpers (see above).
;; $01C062: unused, calls InitGoalTape and moves the sprite up $4C pixels.
$01:BE6E 9E D0 15     STZ.W $15D0,X                   ; State 2: [$15D0,X] = 0
$01:BE71 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Interact with Mario and other sprites

$01:BF87 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |

$01:BF8C 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; /

$01:BF90 A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; \

$01:BF94 B0 09        BCS $BF9F                       ; Branch if no swap

$01:C004 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Fade-in step: timer [$1540,X]

$01:C01C C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; \

$01:C022 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \

$01:C028 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:C02B 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$01:C02C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:C02D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:C02E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:C02F 0A           ASL                             ; } X = ([step] - 1) * 16: offset into MagiKoopaPals
$01:C030 AA           TAX                             ; /
