;;; $C075: Init goal tape (InitGoalTape) ;;;
{
;; Stores the tape's X position - 8 in [state], X high in [$151C], Y low/high in [$1528]/[$1534], and the
;;     level's extra bits from the Y high byte in [$187B].
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C062: Magikoopa visible state, fade, goal tape init
$01:C075 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:C077 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C078 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } [state,X] = sprite X low - 8: tape X position
$01:C07A 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$01:C07C BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:C07F E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:C081 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = X high byte (minus borrow)
$01:C084 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:C086 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / [$1528,X] = sprite Y low: anchor Y
$01:C089 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \ Save extra bits into $187B,x
$01:C08C 9D 7B 18     STA.W $187B,X                   ; /
$01:C08F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \ Clear extra bits out of position
$01:C091 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:C094 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534,X] = Y high byte, anchor
$01:C097 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C098: Goal tape main (GoalTape) ;;;
{
;; Draws the bar, then (unless sprites locked or already triggered) oscillates it vertically and checks Mario
;;     against it.
;; On crossing: sets secret-exit flag [$141C], level clear music, end-of-level timer, awards a bonus by height
;;     if Mario touches the bar, then calls TriggerGoalTape.
$01:C098 20 2D C1     JSR.W $C12D                     ; Draw the goal tape bar
$01:C09B A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \ Branch if sprites locked
$01:C09D D0 05        BNE $C0A4                       ; /
$01:C09F BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Already triggered ([$1602,X])?
$01:C0A2 F0 03        BEQ $C0A7                       ; No: process movement and collision
$01:C0A4 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C0A5..C0A5: Data: goal tape Y speeds ;;;
{
$01:C0A5              .db $10,$F0                     ; Bar Y speed: $10 down, $F0 up

}

;;; $C0A7: Goal tape movement, check and draw ;;;
{
;; $01C0A7: bar movement and Mario crossing test (continuation of GoalTape).
;; $01C12D: draws the bar as three 8x8 tiles ($D4, $D5, $D5), or after it was hit, animates it and erases it
;;     when the timer ends.
$01:C0A7 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540,X] running?
$01:C0AA D0 08        BNE $C0B4                       ; Yes
$01:C0AC A9 7C        LDA.B #$7C                      ; \
$01:C0AE 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $7C
$01:C0B1 FE 88 15     INC.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; Flip direction [$1588,X]++
$01:C0B4 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:C0B7 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:C0B9 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = direction bit
$01:C0BA B9 A5 C0     LDA.W $C0A5,Y                   ; \
$01:C0BD 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite Y speed = $C0A5[Y]
$01:C0BF 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move the bar vertically
$01:C0C2 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C0C4 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = tape X low
$01:C0C6 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C0C9 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = tape X high
$01:C0CB C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:C0CD A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:C0CF 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C0D0 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; |
$01:C0D2 C9 10 00     CMP.W #$0010                    ; / Mario X - tape X < $10?
$01:C0D5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:C0D7 B0 53        BCS $C12C                       ; No: Mario not at the tape, return
$01:C0D9 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:C0DC C5 96        CMP RAM_MarioYPos               ; |
$01:C0DE BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; |
$01:C0E1 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:C0E3 E5 97        SBC RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; / Compare anchor Y with Mario Y (16 bit)
$01:C0E5 90 45        BCC $C12C                       ; Mario is below the tape: return
$01:C0E7 BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; \ $141C = #01 if Goal Tape triggers secret exit
$01:C0EA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C0EB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C0EC 8D 1C 14     STA.W $141C                     ; /
$01:C0EF A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:C0F1 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music: [$1DFB] = $0C (level clear)
$01:C0F4 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:C0F6 8D DA 0D     STA.W $0DDA                     ; / [$0DDA] = $FF (music flag)
$01:C0F9 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:C0FB 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / [$1493] = $FF: end-of-level timer
$01:C0FE 9C 90 14     STZ.W $1490                     ; Zero out star timer
$01:C101 FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; Mark as triggered ([$1602,X]++)
$01:C104 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Mario contact check
$01:C107 90 1C        BCC $C125                       ; No contact: skip bonus
$01:C109 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \ Play sound effect
$01:C10B 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; /
$01:C10E FE 0E 16     INC.W $160E,X                   ; Mark as hit ([$160E,X]++)
$01:C111 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:C114 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C115 F5 D8        SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:C117 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; / [$1594,X] = anchor Y - current Y (hit height)
$01:C11A A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:C11C 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer = $80
$01:C11F 22 52 F2 07  JSL.L $F252                     ; Give bonus by hit height
$01:C123 80 03        BRA $C128                       ; Go end the level

$01:C125 9E 86 16     STZ.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X         ; Clear tweaker byte [$1686,X]
$01:C128 22 80 FA 00  JSL.L TriggerGoalTape           ; End the level (goal tape triggered)
$01:C12C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C12D BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; Hit already ([$160E,X])?
$01:C130 D0 43        BNE $C175                       ; Yes: animate the broken bar
$01:C132 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get draw info
$01:C135 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:C137 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C138 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:C13A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / Tile 1 X = screen X - 8
$01:C13D 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:C13E 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:C140 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; / Tile 2 X = tile 1 X + 8
$01:C143 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:C144 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:C146 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; / Tile 3 X = tile 2 X + 8
$01:C149 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:C14B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C14C 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:C14E 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; } Tile 1 Y = screen Y + 8
$01:C151 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; |
$01:C154 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; / Same Y for tiles 2 and 3
$01:C157 A9 D4        LDA.B #$D4                      ; \
$01:C159 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile 1 = $D4
$01:C15C 1A           INC A                           ; \
$01:C15D 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; } Tile 2 = $D5
$01:C160 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; / Tile 3 = $D5
$01:C163 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; \
$01:C165 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; } Properties $32 for all three tiles
$01:C168 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; |
$01:C16B 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; /
$01:C16E A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$01:C170 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:C172 4C BB B7     JMP.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; / Y = 0 (8x8), A = 2 (three tiles): finish OAM write

$01:C175 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Hit: timer [$1540,X] running?
$01:C178 F0 05        BEQ $C17F                       ; No: erase
$01:C17A 22 CA F1 07  JSL.L $F1CA                     ; Draw the moving bar and score
$01:C17E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C17F 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the sprite
$01:C182 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C183: Growing vine (GrowingVine) ;;;
{
;; Draws the vine head (tile $AC/$AE alternating) and moves it up at speed $F0, generating a vine block (Map16
;;     $03) at every 16 pixels of height.
;; Drawn behind layers while [$1540] >= $20. Erased when it hits a block or leaves the top of the level.
$01:C183 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:C185 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite priority bits [$64]
$01:C186 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:C189 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; |
$01:C18B 90 04        BCC $C191                       ; |
$01:C18D A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; |
$01:C18F 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Timer >= $20: priority = $10 (drawn behind layers while growing out of block)
$01:C191 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw sprite
$01:C194 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = Index into sprite OAM
$01:C197 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:C199 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C19A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C19B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C19C 4A           LSR                             ; } Carry = bit 4 of [FrameCounterB]
$01:C19D A9 AC        LDA.B #$AC                      ; |
$01:C19F 90 02        BCC $C1A3                       ; |
$01:C1A1 A9 AE        LDA.B #$AE                      ; / Tile = $AC or $AE (alternates every 16 frames)
$01:C1A3 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store tile
$01:C1A6 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C1A7 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64]
$01:C1A9 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \ Branch if sprites locked
$01:C1AB D0 40        BNE $C1ED                       ; /
$01:C1AD A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:C1AF 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F0 (up)
$01:C1B1 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move up
$01:C1B4 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:C1B7 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; |
$01:C1B9 B0 10        BCS $C1CB                       ; / Timer < $20? Then interact with blocks
$01:C1BB 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Block interaction
$01:C1BE BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:C1C1 D0 05        BNE $C1C8                       ; / Touching a block?
$01:C1C3 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:C1C6 10 03        BPL $C1CB                       ; / No: Y high byte >= 0: continue
$01:C1C8 4C 80 AC     JMP.W OffScrEraseSprite         ; Blocked or above level: erase

$01:C1CB B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:C1CD 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:C1CF C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; |
$01:C1D1 D0 1A        BNE $C1ED                       ; / Only at Y multiple of 16
$01:C1D3 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \ $9A = Sprite X position
$01:C1D5 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$01:C1D7 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:C1DA 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; /
$01:C1DC B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \ $98 = Sprite Y position
$01:C1DE 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$01:C1E0 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:C1E3 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; /
$01:C1E5 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \ Block to generate = Vine
$01:C1E7 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; /
$01:C1E9 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; Generate the tile
$01:C1ED 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C1EE..C1F0: Data: tables for the next sprite ;;;
{
$01:C1EE              .db $FF,$01                     ; Unused here (used by next sprite): $FF,$01

$01:C1F0              .db $F0,$10                     ; Unused here (used by next sprite): $F0,$10

}

;;; $C1F2: Balloon, flying coin, 1-up and key main (BalloonKeyFlyObjs) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for sprites $7D P-balloon, $7E flying red coin, $7F flying 1-up and $80 key (sprite number
;;     selects the case).
;; Movement: the balloon bobs and drifts right at X speed $0C; the others share it. Flying objects (state 2)
;;     sparkle and cycle their palette.
;; Contact: $7E gives 5 coins and score; $7F gives a 1-up; $80 becomes carryable on a stomp; $7D drops any
;;     carried sprite and puts Mario in balloon mode ([$13F3] = 9, [$1891] = $FF).
;; Quirk: the [$1540,X] branch at $01C203 (balloon rising) is unreferenced.
$01:C1F2 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:C1F5 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; / Sprite status = $0C: skip the movement, just draw and interact
$01:C1F7 F0 5C        BEQ $C255                       ; Status $0C: skip to $01C255
$01:C1F9 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:C1FB D0 58        BNE $C255                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$01:C1FD B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C1FF C9 7D        CMP.B #$7D                      ; / Sprite number = $7D (P-balloon)?
$01:C201 D0 1A        BNE $C21D                       ; No: normal movement at $01C21D
$01:C203 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:C206 F0 15        BEQ $C21D                       ; / [$1540,X] = 0: normal movement
$01:C208 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; Unreferenced: save level priority [$64]
$01:C20A 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:C20B A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:C20D 85 64        STA $64                         ; / [$64] = $10 (draw behind layers)
$01:C20F 20 1A C6     JSR.W $C61A                     ; Draw the sprite ($C61A)
$01:C212 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C213 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64]
$01:C215 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$01:C217 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F8 (rise)
$01:C219 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move up by its Y speed
$01:C21C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C21D A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:C21F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:C221 D0 16        BNE $C239                       ; / Every other frame: update the bobbing Y speed, otherwise skip to $01C239
$01:C223 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C226 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:C228 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$151C,X] & 1: bob direction
$01:C229 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:C22B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C22C 79 EE C1     ADC.W $C1EE,Y                   ; |
$01:C22F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed += $C1EE[Y] (acceleration up or down)
$01:C231 D9 F0 C1     CMP.W $C1F0,Y                   ; \
$01:C234 D0 03        BNE $C239                       ; / Reached the limit $C1F0[Y]? If not, skip the direction flip
$01:C236 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Flip bob direction: [$151C,X]++
$01:C239 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:C23B 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $0C (drifts right)
$01:C23D 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally by its X speed
$01:C240 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:C242 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:C243 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C244 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C245 E9 02        SBC.B #$02                      ; |
$01:C247 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Temporarily Y speed -= 2 for the position update
$01:C249 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically by the reduced Y speed
$01:C24C 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C24D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Restore the real Y speed
$01:C24F 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:C252 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570,X]++ (frame counter used for animation)
$01:C255 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C257 C9 7D        CMP.B #$7D                      ; / Sprite number = $7D?
$01:C259 D0 07        BNE $C262                       ; No: go to $01C262
$01:C25B A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:C25D 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Balloon always faces right (direction = 1)
$01:C260 80 1D        BRA $C27F                       ; Skip to the state check at $01C27F

$01:C262 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C264 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; / [$C2,X] = 2?
$01:C266 D0 14        BNE $C27C                       ; No: skip the sparkle and palette effect
$01:C268 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:C26A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:C26C D0 03        BNE $C271                       ; / Every 4th frame: spawn a sparkle ($B14E)
$01:C26E 20 4E B1     JSR.W $B14E                     ; Spawn sparkle near the sprite
$01:C271 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:C273 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C274 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; |
$01:C276 5D F6 15     EOR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; |
$01:C279 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; } Cycle the sprite palette: [$15F6,X] ^= ([$14] >> 1) & $0E
$01:C27C 20 95 9E     JSR.W $9E95                     ; Interact with other sprites/objects ($9E95)
$01:C27F B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C281 F0 04        BEQ $C287                       ; / [$C2,X] = 0 (normal)? Then draw and test Mario contact
$01:C283 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Only set up draw info (no tiles drawn)
$01:C286 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C287 20 1A C6     JSR.W $C61A                     ; Draw the sprite ($C61A)
$01:C28A 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Test contact with Mario
$01:C28D 90 43        BCC $C2D2                       ; No contact: return
$01:C28F B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C291 C9 7E        CMP.B #$7E                      ; / Sprite number = $7E (flying red coin)?
$01:C293 D0 11        BNE $C2A6                       ; No: go to $01C2A6
$01:C295 20 F0 C4     JSR.W $C4F0                     ; Spawn sparkle effect at the sprite ($C4F0)
$01:C298 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; A = 5 coins
$01:C29A 22 29 B3 05  JSL.L $B329                     ; Add 5 coins to the coin counter ($B329)
$01:C29E A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: score index
$01:C2A0 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$01:C2A4 80 69        BRA $C30F                       ; Remove the sprite

$01:C2A6 C9 7F        CMP.B #$7F                      ; \
$01:C2A8 D0 05        BNE $C2AF                       ; / Sprite number = $7F (flying 1-up)?
$01:C2AA 20 FE C5     JSR.W GiveMario1Up              ; Give the 1-up award (GiveMario1Up)
$01:C2AD 80 60        BRA $C30F                       ; Remove the sprite

$01:C2AF C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; \
$01:C2B1 D0 1B        BNE $C2CE                       ; / Sprite number = $80 (key)? No: go to $01C2CE
$01:C2B3 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:C2B5 30 1B        BMI $C2D2                       ; / Mario moving up: no pickup, return
$01:C2B7 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:C2B9 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$01:C2BC A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$01:C2BE 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $D0 (bounce off it)
$01:C2C0 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$01:C2C2 9E 40 15     STZ.W $1540,X                   ; [$1540,X] = 0
$01:C2C5 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:C2C8 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; |
$01:C2CA 9D 7A 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; / Clear bit 7 of tweaker [$167A,X]: default interaction with Mario
$01:C2CD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C2CE C9 7D        CMP.B #$7D                      ; \
$01:C2D0 F0 01        BEQ $C2D3                       ; / Sprite number = $7D (P-balloon)? Otherwise return
$01:C2D2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C2D3 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: loop over all sprite slots
$01:C2D5 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:C2D8 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; / Slot status = $0B (carried)?
$01:C2DA D0 0C        BNE $C2E8                       ; No: next slot
$01:C2DC B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:C2DF C9 7D        CMP.B #$7D                      ; / Skip the balloon itself
$01:C2E1 F0 05        BEQ $C2E8                       ; Another sprite is being carried
$01:C2E3 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:C2E5 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Make it carryable (status 9): Mario drops it
$01:C2E8 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:C2E9 10 EA        BPL $C2D5                       ; / Next slot
$01:C2EB A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0 (sprite removed)
$01:C2ED AC F3 13     LDY.W $13F3                     ; \
$01:C2F0 D0 02        BNE $C2F4                       ; / [$13F3] (Mario balloon flag) set: keep A = 0
$01:C2F2 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; A = $0B: sprite status "carried"
$01:C2F4 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; Balloon status = carried, or removed if Mario already has one
$01:C2F7 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:C2F9 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Balloon Y speed = Mario Y speed
$01:C2FB A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:C2FD 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Balloon X speed = Mario X speed
$01:C2FF A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:C301 8D F3 13     STA.W $13F3                     ; / [$13F3] = 9: Mario is in balloon mode
$01:C304 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:C306 8D 91 18     STA.W $1891                     ; / [$1891] = $FF: P-balloon timer
$01:C309 A9 1E        LDA.B #$1E                      ; \
$01:C30B 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $1E
$01:C30E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C30F 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Remove the sprite (status 0)
$01:C312 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C313: Table: changing item cycle order (ChangingItemSprite) ;;;
{
;; Sprite numbers cycled by ChangingItem: $74 mushroom, $75 flower, $77 feather, $76 star.
$01:C313              .db $74,$75,$77,$76             ; Sprite number cycle: $74 mushroom, $75 flower, $77 feather, $76 star

}

;;; $C317: Changing item (cycling power-up) main (ChangingItem) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $81. Advances [$187B,X] each frame; every 64 frames it acts like the next power-up in
;;     ChangingItemSprite.
;; Temporarily swaps [RAM_SpriteNum] to that power-up, runs PowerUpRt, then restores $81 and reloads the
;;     sprite tables.
$01:C317 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:C319 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = 1 (flag read by PowerUpRt: spawned from a block/box)
$01:C31C BD D0 15     LDA.W $15D0,X                   ; \
$01:C31F D0 03        BNE $C324                       ; / [$15D0,X] non-zero: frozen, do not advance the counter
$01:C321 FE 7B 18     INC.W $187B,X                   ; [$187B,X]++ (cycle timer)
$01:C324 BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; \
$01:C327 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C328 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C329 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C32A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C32B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C32C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C32D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:C32F A8           TAY                             ; } Y = ([$187B,X] >> 6) & 3: which power-up it currently acts like
$01:C330 B9 13 C3     LDA.W ChangingItemSprite,Y      ; \
$01:C333 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / Sprite number = ChangingItemSprite[Y]
$01:C335 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload the sprite tables (tweaker bytes) for the new type
$01:C339 20 53 C3     JSR.W PowerUpRt                 ; Run the power-up code (PowerUpRt)
$01:C33C A9 81        LDA.B #$81                      ; \
$01:C33E 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / Sprite number = $81 (changing item) again
$01:C340 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload the sprite tables for it
$01:C344 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C345: Table: eaten berry OAM properties (EatenBerryGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; OAM property (palette) bytes indexed by [$18D6], the type of berry being eaten.
$01:C345              .db $02,$02,$04,$06             ; OAM property byte (palette) when drawn as a berry: Y-indexed by berry type

}

;;; $C349: Fire flower main (FireFlower) ;;;
{
;; Sets [$157C,X] to alternate 0/1 every 8 frames (flower flips) and falls into PowerUpRt.
$01:C349 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:C34B 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$01:C34D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C34E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C34F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C350 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } Flower animation: [$157C,X] = ([$14] >> 3) & 1 (flips every 8 frames)
}

;;; $C353: Power-up sprite main (flower, mushroom, star, 1-up, feather) (PowerUpRt) ;;;
{
;; Shared routine for sprites $74-$78 and the coin $21. If [$160E,X] is non-zero the sprite is drawn as an
;;     eaten berry; otherwise it runs the item behaviour.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C339: Changing item (cycling power-up) main (ChangingItem)
$01:C353 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:C356 F0 19        BEQ $C371                       ; / [$160E,X] non-zero: draw the sprite as an eaten berry, else run the item
}

;;; $C358: Power-up behaviour, contact and spark effect (DrawBerryGfx) ;;;
{
;; $01C358: draws an eaten berry (tile $80, palette from EatenBerryGfxProp[[$18D6]]).
;; $01C371: item behaviour. Dropped-from-item-box items ([$1534,X]) fall at speed $10 and blink; items
;;     emerging from a block ([$1540,X]) rise at -4; otherwise they move with gravity, bounce (coin, star), and
;;     turn at walls, then draw via $C61A.
;; $01C4AC: touch test. Ignored while still emerging ([$1540,X] >= $18) or while [$154C,X] is set. Collecting
;;     removes the sprite and jumps to TouchedPowerUp (coins get their own coin count and score).
;; $01C4F0: spawns effect type 5 (sparkle) in a free [$17C0] slot.
$01:C358 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite normally (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:C35B BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$01:C35E A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:C360 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = $80 (berry)
$01:C363 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:C364 AE D6 18     LDX.W $18D6                     ; |
$01:C367 BD 45 C3     LDA.W EatenBerryGfxProp,X       ; |
$01:C36A 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$01:C36C 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; } OAM prop = EatenBerryGfxProp[[$18D6]] | [$64] (berry type picks the palette)
$01:C36F FA           PLX                             ; / Restore X
$01:C370 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C371 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:C373 48           PHA                             ; / Save level priority [$64] for the draw at the end
$01:C374 20 AC C4     JSR.W $C4AC                     ; Test Mario touching the item ($C4AC)
$01:C377 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:C37A F0 13        BEQ $C38F                       ; / [$1534,X] non-zero (dropped from the item box)? No: go to $01C38F
$01:C37C A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:C37E D0 07        BNE $C387                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$01:C380 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:C382 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $10 (falls)
$01:C384 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$01:C387 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:C389 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; |
$01:C38B D0 1E        BNE $C3AB                       ; / Blink: draw only on frames where ([$14] & $0C) = 0
$01:C38D 68           PLA                             ; Discard saved [$64]
$01:C38E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C38F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:C392 F0 1A        BEQ $C3AE                       ; / [$1540,X] = 0 (done emerging)? Then free movement at $01C3AE
$01:C394 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Process block interaction ($9140)
$01:C397 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:C39A D0 04        BNE $C3A0                       ; / [$1528,X] non-zero: skip the priority change
$01:C39C A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:C39E 85 64        STA $64                         ; / [$64] = $10: draw behind layers while emerging from a block
$01:C3A0 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:C3A2 D0 07        BNE $C3AB                       ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$01:C3A4 A9 FC        LDA.B #$FC                      ; \
$01:C3A6 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $FC (rise out of the block)
$01:C3A8 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$01:C3AB 4C 8D C4     JMP.W $C48D                     ; Go to the draw code at $01C48D

$01:C3AE A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:C3B0 D0 F9        BNE $C3AB                       ; / Sprites locked: only draw
$01:C3B2 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:C3B5 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; / Status $0C: only draw
$01:C3B7 F0 F2        BEQ $C3AB                       ; Status $0C: only draw
$01:C3B9 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C3BB C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; / Sprite number = $76 (star)? Branch does nothing either way
$01:C3BD D0 00        BNE $C3BF                       ; Useless branch (target is the next instruction)
$01:C3BF FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570,X]++ (animation frame counter)
$01:C3C2 20 BB 8D     JSR.W $8DBB                     ; Set X speed to +/-8 from the direction ($8DBB)
$01:C3C5 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C3C7 C9 75        CMP.B #$75                      ; / Sprite number = $75 (fire flower)?
$01:C3C9 D0 07        BNE $C3D2                       ; No: skip
$01:C3CB BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C3CE D0 02        BNE $C3D2                       ; / [$151C,X] zero (not from a changing item): flower does not move
$01:C3D0 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:C3D2 C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; \
$01:C3D4 F0 0B        BEQ $C3E1                       ; / Sprite number = $76 (star): keep the X speed
$01:C3D6 C9 21        CMP.B #$21                      ; \
$01:C3D8 F0 07        BEQ $C3E1                       ; / Sprite number = $21 (moving coin): keep the X speed
$01:C3DA BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C3DD D0 02        BNE $C3E1                       ; / [$151C,X] = 0: double the X speed (mushroom, 1-up and feather move at +/-16)
$01:C3DF 16 B6        ASL RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed *= 2
$01:C3E1 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C3E3 F0 0E        BEQ $C3F3                       ; / [$C2,X] = 0: normal path at $01C3F3
$01:C3E5 30 0A        BMI $C3F1                       ; Negative state: skip block interaction
$01:C3E7 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Process block interaction ($9140)
$01:C3EA BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:C3ED D0 02        BNE $C3F1                       ; / Still touching something: keep the state
$01:C3EF 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Clear the state once it is free
$01:C3F1 80 44        BRA $C437                       ; Skip the normal movement

$01:C3F3 AD 9B 0D     LDA.W $0D9B                     ; \
$01:C3F6 C9 C1        CMP.B #$C1                      ; / [$0D9B] = $C1 (Bowser fight)? Then normal movement
$01:C3F8 F0 32        BEQ $C42C                       ; Bowser fight: normal movement
$01:C3FA 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; \
$01:C3FD 50 2D        BVC $C42C                       ; / [$0D9B] bit 6 clear: normal movement
$01:C3FF 9E 88 15     STZ.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; Unreferenced (Mode 7 boss room movement): clear contact flags
$01:C402 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:C404 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:C407 D0 15        BNE $C41E                       ; / Y position high byte non-zero: skip the floor snap
$01:C409 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:C40B C9 A0        CMP.B #$A0                      ; |
$01:C40D 90 0F        BCC $C41E                       ; / Y low < $A0: skip the floor snap
$01:C40F 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:C411 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Snap Y to a 16-pixel boundary
$01:C413 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:C416 09 04        ORA.B #$04                      ; |
$01:C418 9D 88 15     STA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; / Set "on ground" flag (bit 2)
$01:C41B 20 BB 8D     JSR.W $8DBB                     ; Set X speed from the direction
$01:C41E 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally
$01:C421 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$01:C424 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:C426 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; |
$01:C428 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += 3 (gravity)
$01:C42A 80 03        BRA $C42F                       ; Go to $01C42F

$01:C42C 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Move with block interaction and gravity (SubUpdateSprPos)
$01:C42F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:C431 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:C433 F0 02        BEQ $C437                       ; / Three frames out of four: Y speed -= 1 (reduces gravity)
$01:C435 D6 AA        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed -= 1
$01:C437 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:C43A 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; Touching a ceiling?
$01:C43D F0 04        BEQ $C443                       ; No: skip
$01:C43F A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:C441 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = 0
$01:C443 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Is the sprite on the ground?
$01:C446 D0 02        BNE $C44A                       ; Yes: bounce/landing handling
$01:C448 80 34        BRA $C47E                       ; No: go to $01C47E

$01:C44A B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C44C C9 21        CMP.B #$21                      ; / Sprite number = $21 (moving coin)?
$01:C44E D0 1C        BNE $C46C                       ; No: go to $01C46C
$01:C450 20 BB 8D     JSR.W $8DBB                     ; Set X speed from the direction
$01:C453 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:C455 1A           INC A                           ; / A = Y speed + 1 (saved)
$01:C456 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:C457 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Reset Y speed for the surface under it
$01:C45A 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C45B 4A           LSR                             ; / Bounce: A = ([saved] + 1) >> 1
$01:C45C 20 EC CC     JSR.W $CCEC                     ; Negate A
$01:C45F C9 FC        CMP.B #$FC                      ; \
$01:C461 B0 07        BCS $C46A                       ; / Bounce speed >= -4: stop bouncing
$01:C463 BC 88 15     LDY.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:C466 30 02        BMI $C46A                       ; / Sprite touching the ceiling flag set: no bounce
$01:C468 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = bounce speed
$01:C46A 80 12        BRA $C47E                       ; Go to $01C47E

$01:C46C 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Reset Y speed for the surface under it
$01:C46F BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C472 D0 06        BNE $C47A                       ; / [$151C,X] = 0 and not a star: skip the jump
$01:C474 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C476 C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; |
$01:C478 D0 04        BNE $C47E                       ; / Sprite number = $76 (star)?
$01:C47A A9 C8        LDA.B #$C8                      ; \
$01:C47C 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $C8 (star bounces high, changing item also jumps)
$01:C47E BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:C481 15 C2        ORA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; |
$01:C483 D0 08        BNE $C48D                       ; / [$1558,X] timer or [$C2,X] state non-zero: skip wall check
$01:C485 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Touching a wall?
$01:C488 F0 03        BEQ $C48D                       ; No: skip
$01:C48A 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Turn around
$01:C48D BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:C490 C9 36        CMP.B #$36                      ; / [$1540,X] >= $36: not drawn yet (still emerging)
$01:C492 B0 14        BCS $C4A8                       ; [$1540,X] >= $36: skip drawing
$01:C494 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C496 F0 04        BEQ $C49C                       ; / [$C2,X] = 0: check the behind-scenery flag
$01:C498 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:C49A D0 05        BNE $C4A1                       ; / [$C2,X] != $FF: draw behind layers
$01:C49C BD 32 16     LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X       ; \
$01:C49F F0 04        BEQ $C4A5                       ; / Sprite is not behind scenery: draw normally
$01:C4A1 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:C4A3 85 64        STA $64                         ; / [$64] = $10: draw behind layers
$01:C4A5 20 1A C6     JSR.W $C61A                     ; Draw the sprite ($C61A)
$01:C4A8 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C4A9 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64] saved at $01C371
$01:C4AB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C4AC 20 0F A8     JSR.W $A80F                     ; Test contact with Mario ($A80F)
$01:C4AF 90 FA        BCC $C4AB                       ; No contact: return
$01:C4B1 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C4B4 F0 04        BEQ $C4BA                       ; / [$151C,X] = 0: collect now
$01:C4B6 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C4B8 D0 40        BNE $C4FA                       ; / [$151C,X] set and [$C2,X] != 0: not collectable yet, return
$01:C4BA BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:C4BD D0 3B        BNE $C4FA                       ; / [$154C,X] interaction-disable timer set: return
$01:C4BF BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:C4C2 C9 18        CMP.B #$18                      ; / [$1540,X] >= $18: still emerging, return
$01:C4C4 B0 34        BCS $C4FA                       ; Return
$01:C4C6 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Remove the sprite (status 0)
$01:C4C9 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C4CB C9 21        CMP.B #$21                      ; / Sprite number = $21 (moving coin)?
$01:C4CD D0 69        BNE TouchedPowerUp              ; No: this is a power-up, go to TouchedPowerUp
$01:C4CF 22 4A B3 05  JSL.L $B34A                     ; Add 1 to the coin counter ($B34A)
$01:C4D3 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:C4D6 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; |
$01:C4D8 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; / Palette bits = 2?
$01:C4DA F0 04        BEQ $C4E0                       ; Yes: use the chained score at $01C4E0
$01:C4DC A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:C4DE 80 0C        BRA $C4EC                       ; / Score index = 1

$01:C4E0 AD DD 18     LDA.W $18DD                     ; \
$01:C4E3 EE DD 18     INC.W $18DD                     ; / A = [$18DD], then [$18DD]++ (chained score counter)
$01:C4E6 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:C4E8 90 02        BCC $C4EC                       ; / Below $0A: use it
$01:C4EA A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; A = $0A (cap)
$01:C4EC 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$01:C4F0 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: effect table slots
$01:C4F2 B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; \
$01:C4F5 F0 04        BEQ $C4FB                       ; / Slot [$17C0,Y] free? Then use it
$01:C4F7 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:C4F8 10 F8        BPL $C4F2                       ; / Next slot
$01:C4FA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C4FB A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$01:C4FD 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Effect [$17C0,Y] = 5 (sparkle)
$01:C500 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:C502 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; / Effect X = sprite X
$01:C505 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:C507 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; / Effect Y = sprite Y
$01:C50A A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:C50C 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Effect timer = $10
$01:C50F 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C510: Table: item box value (ItemBoxSprite) ;;;
{
;; 20 bytes: (sprite - $74) * 4 + Mario power-up. Values: 0 nothing, 1 mushroom, 2 flower, 4 cape.
$01:C510              .db $00,$01,$01,$01,$00,$01,$04,$02 ; Item box value (1 mushroom, 2 flower, 3 star, 4 cape): $74 mushroom
$01:C518              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$04,$02 ; $75 fire flower: small-, big-, cape- and fire-Mario columns
$01:C520              .db $00,$00,$00,$00             ; $76 star (no item box change), then $77 feather: no, big, cape, fire

}

;;; $C524: Table: power-up action (GivePowerPtrIndex) ;;;
{
;; 20 bytes indexed like ItemBoxSprite. Indices into HandlePowerUpPtrs: 0 grow, 1 no change, 2 star, 3 cape, 4
;;     fire, 5 1-up.
$01:C524              .db $00,$01,$01,$01,$04,$04,$04,$01 ; Power-up action by (item * 4 + Mario power-up): $74 mushroom
$01:C52C              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$03,$03,$01,$03 ; $75 flower, $76 star, $77 feather
$01:C534              .db $05,$05,$05,$05             ; $78 1-up

}

;;; $C538: Collect power-up: item box and action (TouchedPowerUp) ;;;
{
;; Y = (sprite - $74) * 4 + [$19]. Stores ItemBoxSprite[Y] in the item box [$0DC2] (sound $0B) when non-zero,
;;     then calls the action GivePowerPtrIndex[Y] via ExecutePtr.
$01:C538 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:C539 E9 74        SBC.B #$74                      ; |
$01:C53B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:C53C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:C53D 05 19        ORA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$01:C53F A8           TAY                             ; } Y = (sprite number - $74) * 4 + [$19] (Mario power-up)
$01:C540 B9 10 C5     LDA.W ItemBoxSprite,Y           ; \
$01:C543 F0 08        BEQ NoItem                      ; / Item box value from ItemBoxSprite[Y]; 0 = nothing to store
$01:C545 8D C2 0D     STA.W $0DC2                     ; Store it in the item box ([$0DC2])
$01:C548 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:C54A 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $0B (item to box)
}

;;; $C54D: Run power-up action (NoItem) ;;;
{
;; Entry that skips the item box store. A = GivePowerPtrIndex[Y], then JSL ExecutePtr.
;; Parameters: Y: table index.
$01:C54D B9 24 C5     LDA.W GivePowerPtrIndex,Y       ; \
$01:C550 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the action in GivePowerPtrIndex[Y] (pointer table follows)

}

;;; $C554: Pointer table: power-up actions (HandlePowerUpPtrs) ;;;
{
;; 0 Big, 1 no change, 2 star, 3 cape, 4 fire, 5 1-up. Followed by an unreachable RTS.
$01:C554 61 C5        .dw GiveMarioMushroom           ; 0 - Grow to big
$01:C556 6F C5        .dw $C56F                       ; 1 - No change (points and sound only)
$01:C558 92 C5        .dw GiveMarioStar               ; 2 - Star
$01:C55A 98 C5        .dw GiveMarioCape               ; 3 - Cape
$01:C55C EC C5        .dw GiveMarioFire               ; 4 - Fire
$01:C55E FE C5        .dw GiveMario1Up                ; 5 - 1-up

$01:C560 60           RTS                             ; Unreachable return

}

;;; $C561: Give Mario a power-up (grow, star) (GiveMarioMushroom) ;;;
{
;; Grow: Mario animation 2, timer $2F for the growth animation and sprite lock. Then $01C56F gives points
;;     (unless [$1534,X] is set) and plays sound $0A.
;; $01C580: star setup ([$1490] = $FF, music $0D, set bit 7 of [$0DDA]). Called by JSL. The source contains
;;     this block twice with different comments.
$01:C561 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:C563 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = 2 (growing)
$01:C565 A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; \
$01:C567 99 96 14     STA.W $1496,Y                   ; |
$01:C56A 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; / Growth animation timer = $2F, and lock sprites for the same time
$01:C56C 4C 6F C5     JMP.W $C56F                     ; Falls through to the next instruction (JMP to the next address)

$01:C56F A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: score index
$01:C571 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:C574 D0 04        BNE $C57A                       ; / [$1534,X] set (dropped from the item box): no points
$01:C576 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$01:C57A A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:C57C 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $0A (power-up)
$01:C57F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C580 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:C582 8D 90 14     STA.W $1490                     ; / Star timer [$1490] = $FF
$01:C585 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$01:C587 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request $0D (star music)
$01:C58A 0E DA 0D     ASL.W $0DDA                     ; \
$01:C58D 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C58E 6E DA 0D     ROR.W $0DDA                     ; / Set bit 7 of [$0DDA] (music state mirror)
$01:C591 6B           RTL                             ; Return

}

;;; $C592: Give Mario a power-up (grow, star) (GiveMarioMushroom) ;;;
{
;; Grow: Mario animation 2, timer $2F for the growth animation and sprite lock. Then $01C56F gives points
;;     (unless [$1534,X] is set) and plays sound $0A.
;; $01C580: star setup ([$1490] = $FF, music $0D, set bit 7 of [$0DDA]). Called by JSL. The source contains
;;     this block twice with different comments.
$01:C592 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Run the star setup ($C580)
$01:C563 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = 2 (growing)
$01:C565 A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; \
$01:C567 99 96 14     STA.W $1496,Y                   ; |
$01:C56A 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; / Growth animation timer = $2F, and lock sprites for the same time
$01:C56C 4C 6F C5     JMP.W $C56F                     ; Falls through to the next instruction (JMP to the next address)

$01:C56F A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: score index
$01:C571 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:C574 D0 04        BNE $C57A                       ; / [$1534,X] set (dropped from the item box): no points
$01:C576 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$01:C57A A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:C57C 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $0A (power-up)
$01:C57F 60           RTS                             ; Return

; Star code

$01:C580 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:C582 8D 90 14     STA.W $1490                     ; / Star timer [$1490] = $FF
$01:C585 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$01:C587 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request $0D (star music)
$01:C58A 0E DA 0D     ASL.W $0DDA                     ; \
$01:C58D 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C58E 6E DA 0D     ROR.W $0DDA                     ; / Set bit 7 of [$0DDA] (music state mirror)
$01:C591 6B           RTL                             ; Return

}

;;; $C592: Give Mario a star (GiveMarioStar) ;;;
{
;; JSL to the star setup at $01C580, then branches to the shared points and sound code.
$01:C592 22 80 C5 01  JSL.L $C580                     ; Run the star setup ($C580)
$01:C596 80 D7        BRA $C56F                       ; Go to the shared points and sound code

}

;;; $C598: Give Mario a cape (GiveMarioCape) ;;;
{
;; Sets power-up 2, sound $0D, score, locks sprites, then $C5AE starts the transformation (animation 3,
;;     timer $18) and a smoke puff at Mario unless his position high bytes are non-zero.
$01:C598 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:C59A 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; / Mario power-up = 2 (cape)
$01:C59C A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$01:C59E 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $0D (cape)
$01:C5A1 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: score index
$01:C5A3 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$01:C5A7 22 AE C5 01  JSL.L $C5AE                     ; Start the cape poof effect and animation ($C5AE)
$01:C5AB E6 9D        INC RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites one more frame
$01:C5AD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C5AE A5 81        LDA $81                         ; \
$01:C5B0 05 7F        ORA $7F                         ; / Mario X or Y position high byte non-zero?
$01:C5B2 D0 37        BNE $C5EB                       ; Yes: Mario is outside the first screen, skip the effect
$01:C5B4 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:C5B6 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = 3 (cape transformation)
$01:C5B8 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$01:C5BA 8D 96 14     STA.W $1496                     ; / Animation timer [$1496] = $18
$01:C5BD A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: effect slots
$01:C5BF B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; \
$01:C5C2 F0 10        BEQ $C5D4                       ; / Slot [$17C0,Y] free? Then use it
$01:C5C4 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:C5C5 10 F8        BPL $C5BF                       ; / Next slot
$01:C5C7 CE 63 18     DEC.W $1863                     ; All slots full: [$1863]-- (rotating slot)
$01:C5CA 10 05        BPL $C5D1                       ; Still >= 0: use it
$01:C5CC A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:C5CE 8D 63 18     STA.W $1863                     ; / Wrap [$1863] to 3
$01:C5D1 AC 63 18     LDY.W $1863                     ; Y = [$1863]
$01:C5D4 A9 81        LDA.B #$81                      ; \
$01:C5D6 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / Effect type $81 (smoke puff)
$01:C5D9 A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; \
$01:C5DB 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / Effect timer = $1B
$01:C5DE A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:C5E0 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C5E1 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:C5E3 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; / Effect Y = Mario Y + 8
$01:C5E6 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:C5E8 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; / Effect X = Mario X
$01:C5EB 6B           RTL                             ; Return


}

;;; $C5EC: Give Mario fire power (GiveMarioFire) ;;;
{
;; Flashing palette and sprite lock for $20 frames, Mario animation 4, power-up 3, then the shared points and
;;     sound code.
$01:C5EC A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:C5EE 8D 9B 14     STA.W RAM_FlashingPalTimer      ; / Flashing palette timer = $20
$01:C5F1 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites for the same time
$01:C5F3 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:C5F5 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = 4 (power-up, flashing)
$01:C5F7 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:C5F9 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; / Mario power-up = 3 (fire)
$01:C5FB 4C 6F C5     JMP.W $C56F                     ; Go to the shared points and sound code

}

;;; $C5FE: Give 1-up score (GiveMario1Up) ;;;
{
;; Awards score index 8 + [$1594,X] through GivePoints. Called for the flying 1-up.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C2AA: Balloon, flying coin, 1-up and key main (BalloonKeyFlyObjs)
$01:C5FE A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:C600 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C601 7D 94 15     ADC.W $1594,X                   ; / A = 8 + [$1594,X]: score index (1-up)
$01:C604 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points
$01:C608 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C609: Table: power-up tile numbers (PowerUpTiles) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by sprite - $74: mushroom $24, flower $26, star $48, feather $0E, 1-up $24, 4 unused, balloon $E4,
;;     flying coin $E8, flying 1-up $24, key $EC.
$01:C609              .db $24,$26,$48,$0E,$24,$00,$00,$00 ; Tile numbers by sprite - $74: mushroom, flower, star, feather, 1-up, then unused
$01:C611              .db $00,$E4,$E8,$24,$EC         ; $7D balloon, $7E flying red coin, $7F 1-up, $80 key

}

;;; $C616: Table: star palette XOR, and power-up draw (StarPalValues) ;;;
{
;; $01C616: palette values XORed into the star's OAM property, cycled every 2 frames.
;; $01C61A: draws a power-up sprite: coin to CoinSprGfx, others to PowerUpGfxRt. In Mode 7 boss rooms (except
;;     Bowser) the OAM index is forced to $D8.
$01:C616              .db $00,$04,$08,$04             ; Star palette XOR values, cycled every 2 frames

$01:C61A 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Set up draw info for the sprite (GetDrawInfoBnk1)
$01:C61D 64 0A        STZ $0A                         ; [$0A] = 0: palette XOR
$01:C61F AD 0F 14     LDA.W $140F                     ; \
$01:C622 D0 12        BNE $C636                       ; / [$140F] non-zero: keep the default OAM index
$01:C624 AD 9B 0D     LDA.W $0D9B                     ; \
$01:C627 C9 C1        CMP.B #$C1                      ; / [$0D9B] = $C1 (Bowser fight)? Keep OAM index
$01:C629 F0 0B        BEQ $C636                       ; Bowser fight: keep OAM index
$01:C62B 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; \
$01:C62E 50 06        BVC $C636                       ; / [$0D9B] bit 6 clear: keep OAM index
$01:C630 A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:C632 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / Mode 7 boss room: OAM index = $D8
$01:C635 A8           TAY                             ; Y = OAM index
$01:C636 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C638 C9 21        CMP.B #$21                      ; / Sprite number = $21 (moving coin)?
$01:C63A D0 65        BNE PowerUpGfxRt                ; No: draw as a power-up
$01:C63C 22 41 C6 01  JSL.L CoinSprGfx                ; Draw the coin
$01:C640 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C641: Draw moving coin (long entry) (CoinSprGfx) ;;;
{
;; Long-call wrapper for CoinSprGfxSub.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:FC1E: Level-end coin sprite and helpers (LvlEndSprCoinsRt)
;;     $01:C63C: Table: star palette XOR, and power-up draw (StarPalValues)
;;     $02:E23F: Directional Coins main (DirectionCoinsMain)
$01:C641 20 45 C6     JSR.W CoinSprGfxSub             ; Draw the coin (CoinSprGfxSub)
$01:C644 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

}

;;; $C645: Draw spinning coin (CoinSprGfxSub) ;;;
{
;; Draws sprite $21. One 16x16 tile $E8 when spin phase = 0, else two 8x8 tiles (the second vertically
;;     flipped) from MovingCoinTiles.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C641: Draw moving coin (long entry) (CoinSprGfx)
$01:C645 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Set up draw info for the sprite (GetDrawInfoBnk1)
$01:C648 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:C64A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = sprite screen X
$01:C64D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:C64F 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = sprite screen Y
$01:C652 A9 E8        LDA.B #$E8                      ; \
$01:C654 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = $E8 (full coin)
$01:C657 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:C65A 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$01:C65C 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM prop = palette | priority [$64]
$01:C65F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:C660 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C661 65 14        ADC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$01:C663 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C664 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C665 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } A = (([X] + [$14]) >> 2) & 3: spin phase
$01:C667 D0 07        BNE $C670                       ; Phase 0: edge-on frames at $01C670
$01:C669 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$01:C66B 80 2D        BRA $C69A                       ; / Phase 0: Y = 2 (16x16 tile), finish with one tile


}

;;; $C66D: Table: edge-on coin tiles (MovingCoinTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tiles for spin phases 1-3: $EA, $FA, $EA.
$01:C66D              .db $EA,$FA,$EA                 ; Edge-on coin tiles by phase (1-3)

$01:C670 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:C671 AA           TAX                             ; / Save X; X = phase
$01:C672 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:C674 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C675 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; / Tile X = sprite X + 4
$01:C677 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; \
$01:C67A 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; / Both tiles use that X
$01:C67D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:C67F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C680 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / Tile 2 Y = sprite Y + 8
$01:C682 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Store tile 2 Y
$01:C685 BF 6C C6 01  LDA.L MovingCoinTiles-1,X       ; \
$01:C689 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = MovingCoinTiles[phase - 1]
$01:C68C 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; Tile 2 uses the same tile
$01:C68F B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$01:C692 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; |
$01:C694 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; / Tile 2 prop = tile 1 prop with vertical flip
$01:C697 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:C698 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$01:C69A A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: two tiles
$01:C69C 22 B3 B7 01  JSL.L FinishOAMWrite            ; Finish OAM write (FinishOAMWrite)
$01:C6A0 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C6A1: Draw power-up tile (PowerUpGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Star gets a flashing palette XOR from StarPalValues. Sets OAM position (Y - 1), flip, priority [$64] and
;;     palette, tile = PowerUpTiles[sprite - $74], then finishes with a 16x16 tile.
$01:C6A1 C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; \
$01:C6A3 D0 0D        BNE NoFlashingPal               ; / Sprite number = $76 (star)? No: skip flashing
$01:C6A5 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:C6A7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C6A8 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / Y = ([$13] >> 1) & 3
$01:C6AA 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$01:C6AB A8           TAY                             ; Y = phase
$01:C6AC B9 16 C6     LDA.W StarPalValues,Y           ; \
$01:C6AF 7A           PLY                             ; / A = StarPalValues[Y]; restore OAM index
$01:C6B0 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; [$0A] = palette XOR for the star
}

;;; $C6B2: Draw power-up tile (non-star entry) (NoFlashingPal) ;;;
{
;; Common part of PowerUpGfxRt: position, flip, property byte and tile of the power-up.
$01:C6B2 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:C6B4 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / OAM X = sprite screen X
$01:C6B7 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:C6B9 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$01:C6BA 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / OAM Y = sprite screen Y - 1
$01:C6BD BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:C6C0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:C6C1 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$01:C6C3 B0 02        BCS $C6C7                       ; / Flip horizontally unless [$157C,X] bit 0 is set (flower/cape)
$01:C6C5 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; Add X flip bit
$01:C6C7 05 64        ORA $64                         ; \
$01:C6C9 1D F6 15     ORA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; |
$01:C6CC 45 0A        EOR $0A                         ; |
$01:C6CE 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; } OAM prop = flip | [$64] | [$15F6,X] ^ [$0A]
$01:C6D1 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:C6D3 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C6D4 E9 74        SBC.B #$74                      ; |
$01:C6D6 AA           TAX                             ; / X = sprite number - $74
$01:C6D7 BD 09 C6     LDA.W PowerUpTiles,X            ; \
$01:C6DA 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = PowerUpTiles[X]
$01:C6DD AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:C6E0 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: one tile
$01:C6E2 20 7E B3     JSR.W $B37E                     ; Finish OAM write, 16x16 size ($B37E)
$01:C6E5 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C6E6..C6EA: Data: feather swing and fall tables ;;;
{
;; $C6E6: X acceleration +2/-2. $C6E8: X speed limits $20/$E0. $C6EA: Y speed bases $0A,
;;     $F6, $08.
$01:C6E6              .db $02,$FE                     ; Feather X acceleration by swing direction

$01:C6E8              .db $20,$E0                     ; Feather X speed limits: $20, $E0

$01:C6EA              .db $0A,$F6,$08                 ; Feather Y speed base: $0A, $F6, $08

}

;;; $C6ED: Feather main (Feather) ;;;
{
;; Floating cape feather: swings left and right (X speed +/-2 up to +/-$20) while falling at a speed from
;;     $C6EA + 6. Then tests contact ($C4AC) and draws ($C61A).
;; Special cases: sprites locked, status $0C, [$154C,X] set (falls straight with +1 per frame), [$C2,X] non-
;;     zero (block interaction until free).
$01:C6ED A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:C6EF D0 53        BNE $C744                       ; / Sprites locked: only touch test and draw
$01:C6F1 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:C6F3 F0 0C        BEQ $C701                       ; / [$C2,X] = 0: normal movement
$01:C6F5 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Process block interaction ($9140)
$01:C6F8 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:C6FB D0 02        BNE $C6FF                       ; / Touching something: keep the state
$01:C6FD 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Clear the state
$01:C6FF 80 40        BRA $C741                       ; Go to the direction update

$01:C701 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:C704 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; / Status $0C: only touch test and draw
$01:C706 F0 3C        BEQ $C744                       ; Status $0C: only touch test and draw
$01:C708 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:C70B F0 08        BEQ $C715                       ; / [$154C,X] = 0: swing normally
$01:C70D 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$01:C710 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed += 1
$01:C712 4C 41 C7     JMP.W $C741                     ; Go to the direction update

$01:C715 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:C718 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:C71A A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1528,X] & 1: swing direction
$01:C71B B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:C71D 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C71E 79 E6 C6     ADC.W $C6E6,Y                   ; |
$01:C721 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed += $C6E6[Y] (+2 or -2)
$01:C723 D9 E8 C6     CMP.W $C6E8,Y                   ; \
$01:C726 D0 03        BNE $C72B                       ; / Reached the limit $C6E8[Y]? No: skip
$01:C728 FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Reverse swing: [$1528,X]++
$01:C72B B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:C72D 10 01        BPL $C730                       ; / X speed positive: use Y as is
$01:C72F C8           INY                             ; X speed negative: Y++
$01:C730 B9 EA C6     LDA.W $C6EA,Y                   ; \
$01:C733 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C734 69 06        ADC.B #$06                      ; |
$01:C736 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed = $C6EA[Y] + 6 (falls at varying speed)
$01:C738 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:C73B 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move horizontally
$01:C73E 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move vertically
$01:C741 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Face the direction of travel (UpdateDirection)
$01:C744 20 AC C4     JSR.W $C4AC                     ; Test Mario touching the feather ($C4AC)
$01:C747 4C 1A C6     JMP.W $C61A                     ; Draw it ($C61A)

}

;;; $C74A: Init brown chained platform (InitBrwnChainPlat) ;;;
{
;; Sets [$151C,X] = $80, [$1528,X] = 1 and moves the sprite by +$78 X and +$68 Y (16-bit), probably to the
;;     centre of its circular path.
$01:C74A A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:C74C 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C,X] = $80
$01:C74F A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:C751 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / [$1528,X] = 1
$01:C754 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:C756 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C757 69 78        ADC.B #$78                      ; |
$01:C759 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:C75B BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:C75E 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:C760 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Sprite X += $0078 (16-bit)
$01:C763 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:C765 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C766 69 68        ADC.B #$68                      ; |
$01:C768 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:C76A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:C76D 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:C76F 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y += $0068 (16-bit)
$01:C772 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $C773: Brown chained platform main (BrownChainedPlat) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 5F: a platform on a chain that swings around a pivot like a pendulum. Angle is [$1528,X]:[$151C,X]
;;     ($0000-$01FF),
;; swing speed is [$1504,X], [$1602,X] = Mario standing on it, [$160E,X] = Mario touching it.
;; Each frame: damps the speed when nobody stands on it, computes the platform position from the (mirrored)
;;     angle, draws the chain
;; (6 links) and the platform (4 tiles, 10 OAM slots), then advances the angle and handles Mario riding it
;;     (pumps the swing, carries him).
$01:C773 20 27 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen2Bnk1         ; Despawn check when far off-screen (SubOffscreen2Bnk1)
$01:C776 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:C778 D0 1B        BNE $C795                       ; / Sprites locked: skip the swing damping
$01:C77A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:C77C 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:C77E 1D 02 16     ORA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:C781 D0 12        BNE $C795                       ; / Damp only every 4th frame and only if Mario is not standing on it ([$1602,X] = 0)
$01:C783 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = +1 (step toward zero)
$01:C785 BC 04 15     LDY.W $1504,X                   ; \
$01:C788 F0 0B        BEQ $C795                       ; / Swing speed [$1504,X] = 0: nothing to damp
$01:C78A 30 02        BMI $C78E                       ; Speed negative: keep +1
$01:C78C A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; Speed positive: step = -1
$01:C78E 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:C78F 7D 04 15     ADC.W $1504,X                   ; |
$01:C792 9D 04 15     STA.W $1504,X                   ; / Swing speed [$1504,X] moves one step toward 0 (friction)
$01:C795 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:C798 48           PHA                             ; / Save the real angle: [$151C,X] low byte
$01:C799 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:C79C 48           PHA                             ; / Save the real angle: [$1528,X] high byte
$01:C79D A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:C79F 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C7A0 FD 1C 15     SBC.W $151C,X                   ; |
$01:C7A3 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; } Angle low = 0 - [$151C,X]
$01:C7A6 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:C7A8 FD 28 15     SBC.W $1528,X                   ; |
$01:C7AB 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:C7AD 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; } Angle high = (2 - [$1528,X] - borrow) & 1: angle is mirrored (negated mod $200) for drawing
$01:C7B0 20 CB CA     JSR.W $CACB                     ; Set pivot ($14B0/$14B2) from the sprite position, radius $50, copy angle to [$36]
$01:C7B3 20 20 CB     JSR.W $CB20                     ; Look up sine and cosine of the angle ([$14C2], [$14C5])
$01:C7B6 20 53 CB     JSR.W $CB53                     ; Rotate the radius vector: platform position = ([$14B8], [$14BA])
$01:C7B9 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C7BA 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / Restore the real angle high byte
$01:C7BD 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:C7BE 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Restore the real angle low byte
$01:C7C1 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:C7C4 48           PHA                             ; |

;;; $C9B7..C9B7: Table: platform tile X offsets ;;;
{
$01:C9B7              .db $E0,$F0,$00,$10             ; Platform tile X offsets: $E0,$F0,$00,$10

}

;;; $C9BB: Table: platform tiles, then off-screen Y check (BrwnChainPlatTiles) ;;;
{
;; The tile table ($60,$61,$61,$62) is followed by $C9BF: sets carry if the 16-bit Y in [$09] is off-
;;     screen vertically.
;; Parameters: [$09]-[$0A]: world Y. Returns: carry set if off-screen.
$01:C9BB              .db $60,$61,$61,$62             ; Platform tiles: $60 left end, $61 middle x2, $62 right end

$01:C9BF C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$01:C9C1 A5 09        LDA $09                         ; |
$01:C9C3 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:C9C4 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C9C5 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; |
$01:C9C8 85 09        STA $09                         ; |
$01:C9CA 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C9CB E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:C9CD C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; |
$01:C9D0 68           PLA                             ; |
$01:C9D1 85 09        STA $09                         ; } Carry set if the 16-bit Y in [$09] is off-screen vertically (Y + $10 - screen Y >= $100)
$01:C9D3 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /
$01:C9D5 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $C9D6..C9D8: Table: swing speed steps and limits ;;;
{
;; $01C9D6: speed step per half of the swing (+1,-1). $01C9D8: matching maximum speed (+$40,-$40).
$01:C9D6              .db $01,$FF                     ; Swing speed steps: +1, -1

$01:C9D8              .db $40,$C0                     ; Maximum swing speeds: +$40, -$40

}

;;; $C9DA: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers ;;;
{
;; $01C9DA: clears the Mario contact flag and updates Mario after riding. $01C9EC: Mario touch/stand test,
;;     carries Mario with the platform
;; and pumps the swing speed up to +/-$40. $01CA9C: platform contact box. $01CACB: pivot from sprite position.
;;     $01CB20: sine/cosine lookup
;; from CircleCoords. $01CB53: rotates the radius vector by the angle. $01CC28: 16x16 multiply (via the
;;     hardware multiplier) into [$04]-[$07].
$01:C9DA BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:C9DD F0 0C        BEQ $C9EB                       ; / [$160E,X] = 0: Mario was not touching it, return
$01:C9DF 9E 0E 16     STZ.W $160E,X                   ; Clear the Mario contact flag
$01:C9E2 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:C9E3 22 BD E2 00  JSL.L $E2BD                     ; Update Mario after riding a sprite ($E2BD)
$01:C9E7 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:C9E8 8E E9 15     STX.W $15E9                     ; [$15E9] = sprite index
$01:C9EB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:C9EC AD B9 14     LDA.W $14B9                     ; \
$01:C9EF EB           XBA                             ; |
$01:C9F0 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; |
$01:C9F3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; |
$01:C9F5 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:C9F6 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:C9F8 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:C9F9 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; |
$01:C9FC C9 20 01     CMP.W #$0120                    ; |
$01:C9FF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; |
$01:CA01 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:CA02 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } A = 1 if the platform is more than $10 px off-screen horizontally, else 0
$01:CA04 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:CA06 9D C4 15     STA.W $15C4,X                   ; / [$15C4,X] = off-screen flag (also set when sprites are locked)
$01:CA09 D0 CA        BNE $C9D5                       ; Off-screen or locked: no Mario interaction
$01:CA0B 20 9C CA     JSR.W $CA9C                     ; Check whether Mario touches the platform (carry = contact)
$01:CA0E 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Mario standing flag [$1602,X] = 0
$01:CA11 90 C7        BCC $C9DA                       ; No contact: clear contact flag and return
$01:CA13 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:CA15 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Mario contact flag [$160E,X] = 1
$01:CA18 AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:CA1B 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:CA1C E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:CA1E 85 03        STA $03                         ; } [$03] = platform screen Y
$01:CA20 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:CA21 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:CA23 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; } [$0E] = platform screen Y - 8 (top of the platform)
$01:CA25 A5 80        LDA $80                         ; \
$01:CA27 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:CA28 69 18        ADC.B #$18                      ; } A = Mario screen Y ([$80]) + $18 (his feet)
$01:CA2A C5 0E        CMP $0E                         ; \
$01:CA2C B0 6D        BCS $CA9B                       ; / Feet at or below the platform top: Mario is touching from the side/below, return
$01:CA2E A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:CA30 30 B0        BMI $C9E2                       ; / Mario moving up: do not land
$01:CA32 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$01:CA34 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:CA36 8D 71 14     STA.W $1471                     ; / [$1471] = 3: Mario is standing on a solid sprite
$01:CA39 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; [$1602,X] = 3: Mario is standing on this platform
$01:CA3C A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; A = $28: Mario standing height
$01:CA3E AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:CA41 F0 02        BEQ $CA45                       ; / On Yoshi
$01:CA43 A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; Yoshi is taller: $38
$01:CA45 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; [$0F] = Mario standing height
$01:CA47 AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
