;;; $CC94: Delay, Mode 7 rotated tile check, helpers (DoNothing) ;;;
{
;; DoNothing: 8 NOPs + RTS, a delay for the hardware multiplier/divider. $01CC9D: long routine, probably for
;;     the Mode 7 boss room: rotates the point
;; [$14B4]/[$14B6] by angle [$36] around the Mode 7 center ([$2A],[$2C]) and returns carry set if the tile at
;;     $0AF6 is >= $15 (solid).
;; $01CCEC: negate A. $01CCF0: advance the swing angle by speed/16 with a fractional accumulator [$1510,X].
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C80F: Brown chained platform main (BrownChainedPlat)
;;     $01:C83C: Brown chained platform main (BrownChainedPlat)
;;     $01:CC32: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
;;     $01:CC49: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
;;     $01:CC65: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
;;     $01:CC81: Platform: Mario interaction and geometry helpers
$01:CC94 EA           NOP                             ; \
$01:CC95 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:CC96 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:CC97 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:CC98 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:CC99 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:CC9A EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:CC9B EA           NOP                             ; } Delay a few cycles so the hardware multiplier/divider can finish
$01:CC9C 60           RTS                             ; /

$01:CC9D AD B5 14     LDA.W $14B5                     ; \
$01:CCA0 0D B7 14     ORA.W $14B7                     ; |
$01:CCA3 D0 20        BNE $CCC5                       ; } Point's X high or Y high byte non-zero: outside the room, no contact
$01:CCA5 20 C7 CC     JSR.W $CCC7                     ; Pivot = Mode 7 center, radius = point - center
$01:CCA8 20 20 CB     JSR.W $CB20                     ; Sine and cosine of the angle in [$36]
$01:CCAB 20 53 CB     JSR.W $CB53                     ; Rotate the point by the angle
$01:CCAE AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:CCB1 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; / [$00] = rotated Y & $F0 (row of the 16x16 tile)
$01:CCB3 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = tile row
$01:CCB5 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:CCB8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CCB9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CCBA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CCBB 4A           LSR                             ; / A = rotated X / 16 (column)
$01:CCBC 05 00        ORA $00                         ; \
$01:CCBE A8           TAY                             ; / Y = row * 16 + column: index into the Mode 7 room tile grid
$01:CCBF B9 F6 0A     LDA.W $0AF6,Y                   ; Tile number from the grid at $0AF6
$01:CCC2 C9 15        CMP.B #$15                      ; Carry set if the tile is $15 or higher (solid)
$01:CCC4 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:CCC5 18           CLC                             ; Out of range: carry clear
$01:CCC6 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:CCC7 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:CCC9 A5 2A        LDA $2A                         ; \
$01:CCCB 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0                     ; / Pivot X [$14B0] = [$2A] (Mode 7 center X)
$01:CCCE A5 2C        LDA $2C                         ; \
$01:CCD0 8D B2 14     STA.W $14B2                     ; / Pivot Y [$14B2] = [$2C] (Mode 7 center Y)
$01:CCD3 AD B4 14     LDA.W $14B4                     ; \
$01:CCD6 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:CCD7 ED B0 14     SBC.W $14B0                     ; |
$01:CCDA 8D BC 14     STA.W $14BC                     ; } Radius X [$14BC] = point X [$14B4] - pivot X
$01:CCDD AD B6 14     LDA.W $14B6                     ; \
$01:CCE0 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:CCE1 ED B2 14     SBC.W $14B2                     ; |
$01:CCE4 8D BF 14     STA.W $14BF                     ; } Radius Y [$14BF] = point Y [$14B6] - pivot Y
$01:CCE7 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit

$01:CCEA 60           RTS                             ; Unused return

$01:CCEB 60           RTS                             ; Unused return

$01:CCEC 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:CCEE 1A           INC A                           ; / Negate A (A = -A)

$01:CCF0 BD 04 15     LDA.W $1504,X                   ; \
$01:CCF3 0A           ASL                             ; |

$01:CCF5 0A           ASL                             ; |

$01:CD16 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:CD17 7D 28 15     ADC.W $1528,X                   ; |
$01:CD1A 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; } Angle high [$1528,X] += sign extension + carry
$01:CD1D 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CD1E..CD26: Padding ($FF) ;;;
{
$01:CD1E              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:CD26              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

}

;;; $CD2A: Pipe-room Koopa kid main routine (PipeKoopaKids) ;;;
{
;; Sprite main routine for the two Koopa kid entries after Lemmy/Wendy in the pointer table; calls the shared
;;     code in bank 3 ($CC09).
$01:CD2A 22 09 CC 03  JSL.L $CC09                     ; Koopa kid sprite code in bank 3 ($CC09)
$01:CD2E 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $CD2F: Init Koopa Kid (InitKoopaKid) ;;;
{
;; Sets the Koopa Kid number [state] from the high nibble of the initial Y position (0 Morton, 1 Roy, 2
;;     Ludwig, 3 Iggy, 4 Larry, 5 Lemmy, 6 Wendy)
;; and sets up that boss fight: spawn position for Lemmy/Wendy, Mode 7 room and walk limits for
;;     Morton/Roy/Ludwig, Iggy/Larry platform init.
$01:CD2F B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:CD31 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CD32 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CD33 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CD34 4A           LSR                             ; } Koopa Kid number [state] = initial Y position high nibble (0 Morton, 1 Roy, 2 Ludwig, 3 Iggy, 4 Larry, 5 Lemmy, 6 Wendy)
$01:CD35 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; /
$01:CD37 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; Lemmy or Wendy (state >= 5)?
$01:CD39 90 13        BCC $CD4E                       ; No: go to CD4E
$01:CD3B A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; \
$01:CD3D 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Sprite X = $78
$01:CD3F A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:CD41 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y low = $40
$01:CD43 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:CD45 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Sprite Y high = 1 (Y = $0140)
$01:CD48 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:CD4A 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Spawn delay timer [$1540] = $80
$01:CD4D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CD4E A0 90        LDY.B #$90                      ; \
$01:CD50 94 D8        STY RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y low = $90
$01:CD52 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Morton, Roy or Ludwig (state < 3)?
$01:CD54 90 08        BCC $CD5E                       ; Yes: go to CD5E
$01:CD56 22 F5 FC 00  JSL.L $FCF5                     ; Init Iggy/Larry platform ($FCF5)
$01:CD5A 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:CD5D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CD5E A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:CD60 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Direction = 1 (facing right)
$01:CD63 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:CD65 85 38        STA $38                         ; } Mode 7 room parameters [$38] = [$39] = $20
$01:CD67 85 39        STA $39                         ; /
$01:CD69 22 7D DD 03  JSL.L $DD7D                     ; Init the Mode 7 room for this Koopa Kid (sets [$13FC] = kid number)
$01:CD6D B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:CD6F B9 92 CD     LDA.W $CD92,Y                   ; } [$187B] = $CD92[kid number]: 1 = Morton/Roy, 0 = Ludwig
$01:CD72 9D 7B 18     STA.W $187B,X                   ; /
$01:CD75 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Morton/Roy ([$187B] = 1)?
$01:CD77 F0 0E        BEQ $CD87                       ; Yes: go to CD87
$01:CD79 C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; Ludwig ([$187B] = 0)?
$01:CD7B D0 04        BNE $CD81                       ; No: skip the X position
$01:CD7D A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$01:CD7F 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Ludwig: sprite X low = $70
$01:CD81 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:CD83 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Sprite X high = 1
$01:CD86 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CD87 A9 26        LDA.B #$26                      ; \
$01:CD89 9D 34 15     STA.W $1534,X                   ; / Walk limit [$1534] = $26 (left wall X)
$01:CD8C A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:CD8E 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Walk limit [$160E] = $D8 (right wall X)
$01:CD91 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CD92..CDA4: Tables: Koopa Kid type, frame rows and flip ;;;
{
;; [$187B] by kid number (1 Morton/Roy, 0 Ludwig), animation row offset by kid number, frame offsets 0-8.
$01:CD92              .db $01,$01,$00,$02,$02,$03,$03 ; Table: [$187B] by kid number: 1 = Morton/Roy, 0 = Ludwig, 2 = Iggy/Larry, 3 = Lemmy/Wendy

$01:CD99              .db $00,$09,$12                 ; Table: Koopa Kid row offset (animation frame base) by kid number: Morton 0, Roy 9, Ludwig $12

$01:CD9C              .db $00,$01,$02,$03,$04,$05,$06,$07 ; Table: animation frame offset: 00-08
$01:CDA4              .db $08                         ; Frame offset 08 (last of the table)

}

;;; $CDA5..CDA5: Table: sprite X-flip bit by direction ;;;
{
$01:CDA5              .db $00,$80                     ; Table: X-flip bit for [$1BA2] by direction: right $00, left $80

}

;;; $CDA7: Get draw info wrapper ;;;
{
;; Calls GetDrawInfoBnk1 (OAM index and off-screen flags).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:CDDC: Morton, Roy and Ludwig main routine (WallKoopaKids)
$01:CDA7 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Set up OAM index and off-screen flags (GetDrawInfoBnk1)
$01:CDAA 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $CDAB: Morton, Roy and Ludwig main routine (WallKoopaKids) ;;;
{
;; Builds the graphics index [$1BA2] = kid row + animation frame + X-flip, draws the Mode 7 room, checks
;;     contact with Mario and Mario's fireballs,
;; turns Ludwig towards Mario, then runs the main state [$151C] through MortonPtrs1.
;; Main states: 0 waiting, 1 dropping in, 2 fighting, 3 hit, 4 defeated, 5 waiting to end the level.
;; Room variables: [$36]/[$37] = 9-bit rotation angle, [$38]/[$39] = room size/height parameters (probably).
$01:CDAB 9C FB 13     STZ.W $13FB                     ; Clear [$13FB]
$01:CDAE BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:CDB1 C9 1B        CMP.B #$1B                      ; } Animation frame [$1602] >= $1B? Yes: use it directly as the graphics index
$01:CDB3 B0 20        BCS $CDD5                       ; /
$01:CDB5 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:CDB8 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / Compare turn timer [$15AC] with 8 (carry set if >= 8)
$01:CDBA BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:CDBD B9 A5 CD     LDA.W $CDA5,Y                   ; / A = X-flip bit for the sprite direction
$01:CDC0 B0 02        BCS $CDC4                       ; \
$01:CDC2 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; / Turn timer < 8: invert the flip bit (sprite appears to turn around)
$01:CDC4 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = flip bit
$01:CDC6 B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:CDC8 B9 99 CD     LDA.W $CD99,Y                   ; / A = row offset for this Koopa Kid
$01:CDCB BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:CDCE 18           CLC                             ; } A += animation frame offset
$01:CDCF 79 9C CD     ADC.W $CD9C,Y                   ; /
$01:CDD2 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:CDD3 65 00        ADC $00                         ; / A += flip bit
$01:CDD5 8D A2 1B     STA.W $1BA2                     ; [$1BA2] = graphics index (kid row + frame + flip), used by the Mode 7 drawing code
$01:CDD8 22 DF DE 03  JSL.L $DEDF                     ; Update/draw the Mode 7 room and Koopa Kid ($DEDF)
$01:CDDC 20 A7 CD     JSR.W $CDA7                     ; Get draw info
$01:CDDF A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:CDE1 D0 5A        BNE $CE3D                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$01:CDE3 20 A8 D2     JSR.W $D2A8                     ; Check contact with Mario (stomp/hurt)
$01:CDE6 20 B1 D3     JSR.W $D3B1                     ; Check contact with Mario's fireballs
$01:CDE9 BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; \
$01:CDEC C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Morton/Roy ([$187B] = 1): do not turn to face Mario, go to CE0B
$01:CDEE F0 1B        BEQ $CE0B                       ; /
$01:CDF0 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:CDF3 D0 16        BNE $CE0B                       ; / Turn cooldown [$163E] non-zero: go to CE0B
$01:CDF5 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:CDF8 48           PHA                             ; / Save current direction
$01:CDF9 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal distance/direction to Mario in Y
$01:CDFC 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:CDFD 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Sprite direction = direction towards Mario
$01:CE00 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:CE01 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; } Direction unchanged: go to CE0B
$01:CE04 F0 05        BEQ $CE0B                       ; /
$01:CE06 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:CE08 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Direction changed: turn timer [$15AC] = $10
$01:CE0B BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:CE0E 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the state routine for main state [$151C] (MortonPtrs1)

}

;;; $CE12: Pointer table: wall Koopa Kid main states (MortonPtrs1) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$151C].
$01:CE12 1E CE        .dw $CE1E                       ; 00 - Waiting for the fight to start
$01:CE14 3E CE        .dw $CE3E                       ; 01 - Dropping into the room
$01:CE16 5F CE        .dw $CE5F                       ; 02 - Fighting (per-kid AI, MortonPtrs2)
$01:CE18 7D CF        .dw $CF7D                       ; 03 - Hit (stunned, room shrinking)
$01:CE1A E0 CF        .dw $CFE0                       ; 04 - Defeated, room collapsing
$01:CE1C 43 D0        .dw $D043                       ; 05 - Waiting to end the level

$01:CE1E BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; \
$01:CE21 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; / [$187B] = 1 (Morton/Roy)?
$01:CE23 D0 0F        BNE $CE34                       ; No (Ludwig): go to CE34
$01:CE25 9C 11 14     STZ.W $1411                     ; Clear [$1411]
$01:CE28 EE A8 18     INC.W $18A8                     ; [$18A8]++
$01:CE2B 9C AA 18     STZ.W $18AA                     ; Clear [$18AA]
$01:CE2E E6 9D        INC RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites ([$9D]++)
$01:CE30 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Main state = 1 (drop in)
$01:CE33 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CE34 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$01:CE36 C9 7E        CMP.B #$7E                      ; / Ludwig: screen X low [$1A] < $7E?
$01:CE38 90 03        BCC $CE3D                       ; Yes: keep waiting
$01:CE3A FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Main state = 1 (drop in)
$01:CE3D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CE3E 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$01:CE40 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update sprite Y position (no gravity)
$01:CE43 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:CE45 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } Fall speed < $40?
$01:CE47 10 03        BPL $CE4C                       ; /
$01:CE49 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:CE4A 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } Yes: Y speed += 3
$01:CE4C 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:CE4E 20 C0 D0     JSR.W $D0C0                     ; Check landing on the room floor ($D0C0)
$01:CE51 90 EA        BCC $CE3D                       ; Not landed: return
$01:CE53 FE 1C 15     INC.W $151C,X                   ; Main state = 2 (fight)
$01:CE56 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:CE58 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Morton/Roy (state < 2): return
$01:CE5A 90 E1        BCC $CE3D                       ; /
$01:CE5C 4C A8 CE     JMP.W $CEA8                     ; Ludwig: set the first timer ($1540 = $FF)

$01:CE5F B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:CE61 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the AI for this kid number (MortonPtrs2)

}

;;; $CE65: Pointer table: wall Koopa Kid AI by kid number (MortonPtrs2) ;;;
{
;; Morton and Roy use the wall-walking AI at $D116; Ludwig uses $CE6B.
$01:CE65 16 D1        .dw $D116                       ; 00 - Morton: walk around the room walls
$01:CE67 16 D1        .dw $D116                       ; 01 - Roy: walk around the room walls
$01:CE69 6B CE        .dw $CE6B                       ; 02 - Ludwig: walk/jump/fire (CE6B)

$01:CE6B BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:CE6E 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run Ludwig sub-state [$1528] (Ptrs01CE72)

}

;;; $CE72: Ludwig AI: stand, fire, walk, jump (Ptrs01CE72) ;;;
{
;; Sub-state [$1528]: 0 stand and shoot a boss fireball ($D059), 1 walk towards Mario and start a jump,
;;     2 jump (room rotates in the jump direction).
;; Also contains the shared recovery code $CEA8 (timer [$1540] = $FF).
$01:CE72 78 CE        .dw $CE78                       ; 00 - Stand and shoot a fireball
$01:CE74 B6 CE        .dw $CEB6                       ; 01 - Walk towards the middle
$01:CE76 FD CE        .dw $CEFD                       ; 02 - Jump

$01:CE78 64 36        STZ $36                         ; \
$01:CE7A 64 37        STZ $37                         ; / Room rotation angle [$36]/[$37] = 0
$01:CE7C BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:CE7F F0 24        BEQ $CEA5                       ; / Timer [$1540] = 0? Yes: go to CEA5
$01:CE81 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3 (stand frame)
$01:CE83 29 30        AND.B #$30                      ; \
$01:CE85 D0 01        BNE $CE88                       ; / Timer bit 4/5 set?
$01:CE87 C8           INY                             ; No: Y = 4 (mouth open frame)
$01:CE88 98           TYA                             ; A = frame
$01:CE89 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:CE8C F0 02        BEQ $CE90                       ; / Turn timer zero? Yes: keep frame
$01:CE8E A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; Turning: frame = 5
$01:CE90 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602] = A
$01:CE93 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:CE96 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; |
$01:CE98 C9 2E        CMP.B #$2E                      ; } Timer & $3F = $2E?
$01:CE9A D0 08        BNE $CEA4                       ; /
$01:CE9C A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:CE9E 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; / No: return. Yes: fire cooldown [$163E] = $30
$01:CEA1 20 59 D0     JSR.W $D059                     ; Spawn a boss fireball ($D059)
$01:CEA4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CEA5 FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Sub-state [$1528]++ (next: walk)
$01:CEA8 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:CEAA 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $FF
$01:CEAD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $CEAE..CEB4: Tables: Ludwig walk and jump values ;;;
{
;; Max X speed by direction, walk animation frames, jump X speed.
$01:CEAE              .db $30,$D0                     ; Table: Ludwig max X speed by direction: $30, $D0 (-$30)

$01:CEB0              .db $1B,$1C,$1D,$1B             ; Table: Ludwig walk animation frames: $1B, $1C, $1D, $1B

$01:CEB4              .db $14,$EC                     ; Table: Ludwig jump X speed by side of Mario: $14, $EC (-$14)

}

;;; $CEB6: Ludwig sub-states: walk and jump; hit and death states ;;;
{
;; $01CEB6: sub-state 1, accelerate towards Mario and start a jump when lined up. $01CEFD: sub-state 2, jump
;;     with gravity and room rotation.
;; $01CF7D: main state 3 (hit): stunned, room returns to normal, counts hits; the third hit ends the fight.
;; $01CFE0: main state 4 (defeated): kid rises while the room spins and collapses, then smoke. $01D043: main
;;     state 5: erase the kid and end the level.
$01:CEB6 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:CEB9 D0 21        BNE $CEDC                       ; / Timer [$1540] non-zero: go to CEDC
$01:CEBB 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; \
$01:CEBE 98           TYA                             ; |
$01:CEBF DD E0 14     CMP.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } Mario on the side of the sprite's X high byte? No: go to CEDC
$01:CEC2 D0 18        BNE $CEDC                       ; /
$01:CEC4 FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Sub-state [$1528]++ (jump)
$01:CEC7 B9 B4 CE     LDA.W $CEB4,Y                   ; \
$01:CECA 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Jump X speed [$160E] = table by direction to Mario
$01:CECD A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:CECF 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $30
$01:CED2 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$01:CED4 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Timer [$1558] = $60
$01:CED7 A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:CED9 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $D8 (jump up)
$01:CEDB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CEDC 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Direction to Mario in Y
$01:CEDF B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:CEE1 D9 AE CE     CMP.W $CEAE,Y                   ; } X speed already at the limit? Yes: skip
$01:CEE4 F0 06        BEQ $CEEC                       ; /
$01:CEE6 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:CEE7 79 E7 D4     ADC.W $D4E7,Y                   ; } X speed += 1 or -1 (accelerate towards Mario)
$01:CEEA 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:CEEC 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update sprite X position (no gravity)
$01:CEEF A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:CEF1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CEF2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:CEF3 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Y = (frame counter >> 2) & 3
$01:CEF5 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:CEF6 B9 B0 CE     LDA.W $CEB0,Y                   ; \
$01:CEF9 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = walk frame table[Y]
$01:CEFC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CEFD BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:CF00 F0 1A        BEQ $CF1C                       ; / Timer [$1540] = 0? Yes: go to CF1C
$01:CF02 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:CF03 D0 0A        BNE $CF0F                       ; / Timer - 1 non-zero: go to CF0F
$01:CF05 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:CF08 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Timer ran out: X speed = jump speed [$160E]
$01:CF0A A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:CF0C 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $08
$01:CF0F B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:CF11 F0 08        BEQ $CF1B                       ; / X speed zero: return
$01:CF13 10 04        BPL $CF19                       ; X speed positive: go to CF19
$01:CF15 F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:CF17 F6 B6        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed += 2
$01:CF19 D6 B6        DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed -= 1 (so it moves 1 step towards zero)
$01:CF1B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CF1C 20 C0 D0     JSR.W $D0C0                     ; Check landing on the room floor ($D0C0)
$01:CF1F 90 0E        BCC $CF2F                       ; Not landed: go to CF2F
$01:CF21 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:CF23 30 0A        BMI $CF2F                       ; / Landed but moving up: go to CF2F
$01:CF25 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:CF27 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Speed X = 0, speed Y = 0
$01:CF29 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; Sub-state [$1528] = 0 (stand)
$01:CF2C 4C A8 CE     JMP.W $CEA8                     ; Set the timer ([$1540] = $FF)

$01:CF2F 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update sprite X position (no gravity)
$01:CF32 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update sprite Y position (no gravity)
$01:CF35 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:CF37 4A           LSR                             ; } Every other frame: apply gravity, else go to CF44
$01:CF38 B0 0A        BCS $CF44                       ; /
$01:CF3A B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:CF3C 30 04        BMI $CF42                       ; / Y speed negative: go to CF42
$01:CF3E C9 70        CMP.B #$70                      ; \
$01:CF40 B0 02        BCS $CF44                       ; / Y speed >= $70: no more gravity
$01:CF42 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed += 1
$01:CF44 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:CF47 D0 06        BNE $CF4F                       ; / Timer [$1558] non-zero: rotate the room
$01:CF49 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:CF4B 05 37        ORA $37                         ; } Room angle zero: skip rotation
$01:CF4D F0 18        BEQ $CF67                       ; /
$01:CF4F B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:CF51 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:CF52 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; |
$01:CF54 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; } A = +4 and Y = 0 (moving right; branch skips the next two)
$01:CF56 90 03        BCC $CF5B                       ; /
$01:CF58 A9 FC        LDA.B #$FC                      ; \
$01:CF5A 88           DEY                             ; / ...moving left: A = -4, Y = -1
$01:CF5B 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:CF5C 65 36        ADC $36                         ; |
$01:CF5E 85 36        STA $36                         ; |
$01:CF60 98           TYA                             ; |
$01:CF61 65 37        ADC $37                         ; |
$01:CF63 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Room angle [$36]/[$37] += A (9-bit angle, wraps at $200)
$01:CF65 85 37        STA $37                         ; /
$01:CF67 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:CF69 B4 AA        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } A = $06 (rising frame); Y speed negative: use it
$01:CF6B 30 0C        BMI $CF79                       ; /
$01:CF6D C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$01:CF6F 90 08        BCC $CF79                       ; / Y speed < 8: use $06
$01:CF71 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$01:CF73 C0 10        CPY.B #$10                      ; / A = $05 (falling frame)
$01:CF75 90 02        BCC $CF79                       ; \

$01:CF98 C8           INY                             ; /

$01:CFA9 A5 39        LDA $39                         ; \
$01:CFAB C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; |
$01:CFAD F0 02        BEQ $CFB1                       ; } Room parameter [$39] moves back towards $20 (--)
$01:CFAF C6 39        DEC $39                         ; /
$01:CFB1 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:CFB3 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = 7 (getting up)
$01:CFB6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:CFB7 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \

$01:CFBC B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \

$01:CFC0 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \

$01:CFCC C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \

$01:CFD0 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:CFD2 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Sound effect $1F (defeated)
$01:CFD5 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \

$01:CFDA A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \

$01:CFF3 98           TYA                             ; \

$01:CFF6 F0 02        BEQ $CFFA                       ; /

$01:CFFA 80 13        BRA $D00F                       ; Go to D00F

$01:CFFC A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:CFFE 18           CLC                             ; |

;;; $D059: Spawn boss fireball ;;;
{
;; Finds a free sprite slot and creates sprite $34 (boss fireball) in front of the Koopa Kid, moving away at X
;;     speed +/-$20.
;; Plays sound effect $17. Returns without spawning if no slot is free.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:CEA1: Ludwig AI: stand, fire, walk, jump (Ptrs01CE72)
$01:D059 A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$01:D05B 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $17
$01:D05E A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4: search the sprite slots
$01:D060 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:D063 F0 04        BEQ $D069                       ; / Slot Y free? Yes: go to D069
$01:D065 88           DEY                             ; \

$01:D068 60           RTS                             ; No free slot: return

$01:D069 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:D06B 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:D06E A9 34        LDA.B #$34                      ; \
$01:D070 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / New sprite number = $34 (boss fireball)
$01:D073 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D075 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$01:D077 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } [$00]/[$01] = Koopa Kid X position

$01:D07C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D07E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D07F 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } New sprite Y low = Kid Y + 3
$01:D081 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; /
$01:D084 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:D087 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } New sprite Y high = Kid Y high + carry
$01:D089 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$01:D08C BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = sprite direction
$01:D08F DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:D090 AA           TAX                             ; / Save X, X = direction
$01:D091 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:D093 18           CLC                             ; } A = [$00] + table offset (-1 or -15)
$01:D094 7D 57 D0     ADC.W $D057,X                   ; /
$01:D097 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; New sprite X low
$01:D09A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \

$01:D09E 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$01:D0A1 FA           PLX                             ; \
$01:D0A2 DA           PHX                             ; } Restore X, Save X, X = new sprite
$01:D0A3 BB           TYX                             ; /
$01:D0A4 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialise the new sprite's tables
$01:D0A8 FA           PLX                             ; \
$01:D0A9 DA           PHX                             ; / Restore X, save X
$01:D0AA BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:D0AD 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / New sprite direction = Kid direction
$01:D0B0 AA           TAX                             ; \
$01:D0B1 BD BE D0     LDA.W $D0BE,X                   ; } New sprite X speed = table by direction
$01:D0B4 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; /
$01:D0B7 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:D0B9 99 40 15     STA.W $1540,Y                   ; / New sprite timer [$1540] = $30
$01:D0BC FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:D0BD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D0C0: Check landing on room floor ;;;
{
;; Snaps the sprite to the floor height of the Mode 7 room for the current [$39] and zeroes its Y speed if it
;;     has reached it.
;; Returns: carry set if landed, clear if still in the air (also clear when moving up or Y high is non-zero).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:CE4E: Pointer table: wall Koopa Kid main states (MortonPtrs1)
;;     $01:CF1C: Ludwig sub-states: walk and jump; hit and death states
;;     $01:CF82: Ludwig sub-states: walk and jump; hit and death states
;;     $01:D286: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs
$01:D0C0 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:D0C2 30 18        BMI $D0DC                       ; / Sprite Y speed negative (rising)? Yes: no landing
$01:D0C4 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:D0C7 D0 13        BNE $D0DC                       ; / Sprite Y high non-zero? Yes: no landing
$01:D0C9 A5 39        LDA $39                         ; \
$01:D0CB 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = [$39] / 2 (index into the floor height table)
$01:D0CC A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:D0CD B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D0CF D9 D6 D0     CMP.W ADDR_01D0D6,Y             ; } Sprite Y < floor Y for this room height? Yes: no landing
$01:D0D2 90 08        BCC $D0DC                       ; /

}

;;; $D0D4: Floor lookup stored as data bytes (Instr01D0D4) ;;;
{
;; Bytes B9 D6 D0 are the instruction LDA.W $D0D6,Y (A = floor Y), hidden as data because the code at $01D0CF
;;     jumps over them.
$01:D0D4              .db $B9,$D6,$D0                 ; LDA.W $D0D6,Y: floor Y for this room height (stored as data bytes)

$01:D0D7 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Sprite Y = floor Y
$01:D0D9 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$01:D0DB 60           RTS                             ; Return (carry set: landed)

$01:D0DC 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry (not landed)
$01:D0DD 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$01:D0DE              .db $80,$83,$85,$88,$8A,$8B,$8D,$8F ; Table: floor Y by room parameter [$39] / 2, offset by 8: [$39] = $10-$1F
$01:D0E6              .db $90,$91,$91,$92,$92,$93,$93,$94 ; [$39] = $20-$2F

;;; $D146: Morton/Roy walk around the room ;;;
{
;; Animates the kid, narrows the walk limits after hits (Roy and Ludwig-style arena), and walks along the four
;;     room walls ([$1594] = 0 floor, 1 right, 2 ceiling, 3 left).
;; At a wall end the kid turns the corner and the room rotates 90 degrees ([$36]/[$37] angle +/-4 per frame).
;;     On the ceiling, when Mario is within $10 pixels below,
;; sub-state [$1528] becomes 1 (drop on Mario).
$01:D146 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:D148 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = hit counter [$1626]; A = frame counter B >> 1
$01:D149 BC 26 16     LDY.W $1626,X                   ; /
$01:D14C C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; \
$01:D14E B0 01        BCS $D151                       ; } Fewer than 2 hits: animate at half speed (>> 2)
$01:D150 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:D151 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D153 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = A & 3
$01:D154 B9 42 D1     LDA.W $D142,Y                   ; A = walk frame from $D142
$01:D157 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:D15A F0 02        BEQ $D15E                       ; / Turn timer zero? Yes: keep frame
$01:D15C A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; Turning: frame = 5
$01:D15E 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602] = A
$01:D161 BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:D164 F0 16        BEQ $D17C                       ; / Timer [$164A] zero: go to D17C
$01:D166 B4 E4        LDY RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D168 C0 50        CPY.B #$50                      ; } Sprite X < $50: go to D17C
$01:D16A 90 10        BCC $D17C                       ; /
$01:D16C C0 80        CPY.B #$80                      ; \
$01:D16E B0 0C        BCS $D17C                       ; / Sprite X >= $80: go to D17C
$01:D170 DE 4A 16     DEC.W $164A,X                   ; Timer [$164A]--
$01:D173 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:D174 B0 06        BCS $D17C                       ; / Every other frame:
$01:D176 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Left walk limit [$1534]++
$01:D179 DE 0E 16     DEC.W $160E,X                   ; Right walk limit [$160E]--
$01:D17C BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:D17F 85 05        STA $05                         ; |
$01:D181 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$01:D183 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; } [$05],[$06],[$0B],[$0C] = left limit [$1534]
$01:D185 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; /
$01:D187 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:D18A 85 07        STA $07                         ; |
$01:D18C 85 08        STA $08                         ; |
$01:D18E 85 09        STA $09                         ; } [$07]-[$0A] = right limit [$160E]
$01:D190 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; /
$01:D192 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:D194 0A           ASL                             ; } Room angle [$36] * 2 = 0 (aligned to a wall)?
$01:D195 F0 03        BEQ $D19A                       ; /
$01:D197 4C 24 D2     JMP.W $D224                     ; Not aligned: go on rotating the room (D224)

$01:D19A BC 94 15     LDY.W $1594,X                   ; \
$01:D19D 98           TYA                             ; / Y = A = current wall number [$1594] (0 floor, 1 right, 2 ceiling, 3 left)
$01:D19E 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:D19F B0 14        BCS $D1B5                       ; / Odd wall (side wall)? Yes: go to D1B5
$01:D1A1 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D1A3 C0 00        CPY.B #$00                      ; } Floor or ceiling: A = sprite X; floor (wall 0)? No: go to D1AE
$01:D1A5 D0 07        BNE $D1AE                       ; /
$01:D1A7 DD 34 15     CMP.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:D1AA 90 69        BCC $D215                       ; / Floor: X < left limit? Yes: turn at the corner
$01:D1AC 80 2A        BRA $D1D8                       ; Else keep walking

$01:D1AE DD 0E 16     CMP.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:D1B1 B0 62        BCS $D215                       ; / Ceiling: X >= right limit? Yes: turn at the corner
$01:D1B3 80 23        BRA $D1D8                       ; Else keep walking

$01:D1B5 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:D1B8 D0 04        BNE $D1BE                       ; / Side wall: facing right? Yes: skip
$01:D1BA C8           INY                             ; \
$01:D1BB C8           INY                             ; |
$01:D1BC C8           INY                             ; } Facing left: Y += 4 (use the other half of the limit list)
$01:D1BD C8           INY                             ; /
$01:D1BE B9 05 00     LDA.W $0005,Y                   ; \
$01:D1C1 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Sprite X = limit for this wall
$01:D1C3 BC 94 15     LDY.W $1594,X                   ; \
$01:D1C6 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Y = wall number, A = sprite Y low
$01:D1C8 C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D1CA F0 07        BEQ $D1D3                       ; / Wall 3: go to D1D3
$01:D1CC D9 3E D1     CMP.W $D13E,Y                   ; \
$01:D1CF 90 44        BCC $D215                       ; / Wall 1: Y < limit? Yes: turn at the corner
$01:D1D1 80 05        BRA $D1D8                       ; Else keep walking

$01:D1D3 D9 3E D1     CMP.W $D13E,Y                   ; \
$01:D1D6 B0 3D        BCS $D215                       ; / Wall 3: Y >= limit? Yes: turn at the corner
$01:D1D8 BD 26 16     LDA.W $1626,X                   ; \
$01:D1DB C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; / A = hit counter [$1626]
$01:D1DD 90 02        BCC $D1E1                       ; \
$01:D1DF A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; / Capped at 2
$01:D1E1 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:D1E2 0A           ASL                             ; } A = hits * 4 + wall number
$01:D1E3 7D 94 15     ADC.W $1594,X                   ; /
$01:D1E6 A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$01:D1E7 B9 22 D1     LDA.W $D122,Y                   ; \
$01:D1EA 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $D122[Y]
$01:D1EC B9 2E D1     LDA.W $D12E,Y                   ; \
$01:D1EF 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $D12E[Y]
$01:D1F1 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update sprite X position (no gravity)
$01:D1F4 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update sprite Y position (no gravity)
$01:D1F7 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; A = wall number
$01:D1FA BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:D1FD D0 02        BNE $D201                       ; } Facing left: wall number XOR 2
$01:D1FF 49 02        EOR.B #$02                      ; /
$01:D201 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; \
$01:D203 D0 0F        BNE $D214                       ; / On the ceiling: otherwise return
$01:D205 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal distance to Mario
$01:D208 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:D20A 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D20B 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:D20D C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; } Mario within $10 pixels horizontally of the kid? No: return
$01:D20F B0 03        BCS $D214                       ; /
$01:D211 FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Yes: sub-state [$1528]++ (drop on Mario)
$01:D214 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D215 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:D218 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; |
$01:D21B 18           CLC                             ; } Turn the corner: A = wall number + $D23D[direction] (+1 or -1)
$01:D21C 79 3D D2     ADC.W $D23D,Y                   ; /
$01:D21F 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D221 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; / Wall number [$1594] = A & 3
$01:D224 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:D227 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; |
$01:D229 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D22A 79 39 D2     ADC.W $D239,Y                   ; } Room angle [$36] += $D239[direction] (+4 or -4)
$01:D22D 85 36        STA $36                         ; /
$01:D22F A5 37        LDA $37                         ; \
$01:D231 79 3B D2     ADC.W $D23B,Y                   ; |
$01:D234 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Room angle high byte [$37] = ([$37] + sign) & 1
$01:D236 85 37        STA $37                         ; /
$01:D238 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D239..D23D: Tables: room rotation and wall step by direction ;;;
{
$01:D239              .db $FC,$04                     ; Table: room rotation per frame by direction: -4, +4 (low byte)

$01:D23B              .db $FF,$00                     ; Table: room rotation high byte by direction: $FF, $00

$01:D23D              .db $FF,$01                     ; Table: wall number change by direction: -1, +1

}

;;; $D23F: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs ;;;
{
;; Part of the Koopa Kid boss (Ludwig/Iggy/Larry) code. $01D23F: wait timer, then turn toward Mario and fall
;;     under gravity
;; until the floor check at $D0C0 reports a landing (ground shake, Mario locked, thud sound).
;; $01D2A8: Mario contact. On the ground Mario is hurt; in the air a stomp from above tilts the platform
;;     ([$38]/[$39]) and stuns the boss (state 3).
;; $01D3B1: Mario fireballs (extended sprite 5, slots $0A-$08) puff into smoke; the 12th hit defeats the boss
;;     ($CFD0).
;; $01D40B: builds the boss hitbox in [$04]-[$07],[$0A],[$0B]. Names inferred; not fully traced.
$01:D23F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Sprite timer [$1540]; non-zero = waiting after landing
$01:D242 F0 1A        BEQ $D25E                       ; Timer 0: fall ($D25E)
$01:D244 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D246 D0 5F        BNE $D2A7                       ; / Only act on the last frame of the wait (timer = 1)
$01:D248 9E 28 15     STZ.W $1528,X                   ; [$1528] = 0 (reset counter)
$01:D24B 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = direction toward Mario (SubHorizPos)
$01:D24E 98           TYA                             ; A = [Y]
$01:D24F 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Face Mario
$01:D252 0A           ASL                             ; A = direction * 2
$01:D253 49 02        EOR.B #$02                      ; Flip bit 1: surface/orientation index ([$1594], 0-3) for the new facing
$01:D255 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; Store orientation index in [$1594]
$01:D258 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:D25A 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Set turning timer [$15AC] = $0A
$01:D25D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D25E A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; Animation frame 6 (falling pose)
$01:D260 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store frame in [$1602]
$01:D263 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed to Y position (no gravity)
$01:D266 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed
$01:D268 C9 70        CMP.B #$70                      ; \
$01:D26A B0 05        BCS $D271                       ; / Already at terminal speed $70 or more: skip gravity
$01:D26C 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:D26D 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } } Y speed += 4 (gravity)
$01:D26F 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:D271 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:D273 05 37        ORA $37                         ; } } If rotation angle [$36]/[$37] is non-zero, keep it turning
$01:D275 F0 0F        BEQ $D286                       ; /
$01:D277 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:D279 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D27A 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } } [$36] += 8
$01:D27C 85 36        STA $36                         ; /
$01:D27E A5 37        LDA $37                         ; \
$01:D280 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:D282 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } } [$37] = (carry from [$36]) & 1: angle wraps at $200
$01:D284 85 37        STA $37                         ; /
$01:D286 20 C0 D0     JSR.W $D0C0                     ; Check landing on the boss room floor ($D0C0), carry set if landed
$01:D289 90 1C        BCC $D2A7                       ; Not landed: return
$01:D28B A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:D28D 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Ground shake timer = $20
$01:D290 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario flying/in air?
$01:D292 D0 05        BNE $D299                       ; Yes: do not lock Mario
$01:D294 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:D296 8D BD 18     STA.W RAM_LockMarioTimer        ; / Lock Mario in place for $28 frames
$01:D299 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:D29B 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $09 (boss landing thud)
$01:D29E A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:D2A0 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Wait timer [$1540] = $28 before the next move
$01:D2A3 64 36        STZ $36                         ; \
$01:D2A5 64 37        STZ $37                         ; / Rotation angle [$36]/[$37] = 0
$01:D2A7 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D2A8 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Sprite state [$151C]
$01:D2AB C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D2AD B0 69        BCS $D318                       ; / State 3 or more (hurt/dying): no contact
$01:D2AF BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; [$187B] (boss variant)
$01:D2B2 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D2B4 D0 07        BNE $D2BD                       ; / Variant 3 only: also check [$1528]
$01:D2B6 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; \
$01:D2B9 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; } } Variant 3: skip contact if [$1528] >= 3
$01:D2BB B0 5B        BCS $D318                       ; /
$01:D2BD 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario's hitbox (GetMarioClipping)
$01:D2C1 20 0B D4     JSR.W $D40B                     ; Build boss hitbox ($D40B)
$01:D2C4 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check for contact between the two boxes
$01:D2C8 90 4E        BCC $D318                       ; No contact: return
$01:D2CA BD E2 1F     LDA.W $1FE2,X                   ; Contact cooldown [$1FE2]
$01:D2CD D0 49        BNE $D318                       ; Still cooling down: return
$01:D2CF A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:D2D1 9D E2 1F     STA.W $1FE2,X                   ; / Contact cooldown = 8 frames
$01:D2D4 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario in the air? ([$72])
$01:D2D6 F0 41        BEQ $D319                       ; On the ground: hurt Mario
$01:D2D8 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Boss animation frame
$01:D2DB C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$01:D2DD B0 04        BCS $D2E3                       ; / Frame $10 or more: check stomp position
$01:D2DF C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; \
$01:D2E1 B0 3B        BCS $D31E                       ; / Frames 6-$0F (falling/shell pose): bounce Mario off harmlessly
$01:D2E3 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Mario Y position
$01:D2E5 18           CLC                             ; (+8)
$01:D2E6 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; Add 8 pixels of leeway
$01:D2E8 D5 D8        CMP RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D2EA B0 32        BCS $D31E                       ; / } Mario below the top of the boss: side bounce
$01:D2EC BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; Orientation index [$1594]
$01:D2EF 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 into carry: odd = on a wall
$01:D2F0 B0 42        BCS $D334                       ; On a wall: use wall bounce ($D334)
$01:D2F2 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed
$01:D2F4 30 27        BMI $D31D                       ; Moving up: return without hitting
$01:D2F6 20 51 D3     JSR.W $D351                     ; Show contact stars at the boss ($D351)
$01:D2F9 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$01:D2FB 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $D0 (bounce up)
$01:D2FD A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:D2FF 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $02
$01:D302 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Boss animation frame
$01:D305 C9 1B        CMP.B #$1B                      ; \
$01:D307 90 70        BCC $D379                       ; / Frame below $1B: boss is stomped ($D379)
$01:D309 A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; Y = $20: push Mario right
$01:D30B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Boss X position
$01:D30D 38           SEC                             ; Subtract 8
$01:D30E E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; (boss X - 8)
$01:D310 C5 94        CMP RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:D312 30 02        BMI $D316                       ; / } Mario to the left of the boss? Keep push right
$01:D314 A0 E0        LDY.B #$E0                      ; Y = $E0: push Mario left
$01:D316 84 7B        STY RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = push
$01:D318 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D319 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Mario hurt by the boss (HurtMario)
$01:D31D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D31E A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D320 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $01
$01:D323 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed
$01:D325 10 05        BPL $D32C                       ; Falling: go bounce away
$01:D327 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:D329 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Moving up: bonk Mario down, Y speed = $10
$01:D32B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D32C 20 09 D3     JSR.W $D309                     ; Push Mario sideways ($D309)
$01:D32F A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$01:D331 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $D0 (bounce up)
$01:D333 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D334 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D336 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $01
$01:D339 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed
$01:D33B 10 05        BPL $D342                       ; Falling: go bounce away
$01:D33D A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:D33F 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Moving up: Mario Y speed = $20 (pushed down)
$01:D341 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D342 A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; Y = $20
$01:D344 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Boss X low
$01:D346 10 02        BPL $D34A                       ; Positive: keep $20
$01:D348 A0 E0        LDY.B #$E0                      ; Y = $E0
$01:D34A 84 7B        STY RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = Y
$01:D34C A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; \
$01:D34E 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $B0 (bounce up)
$01:D350 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D351 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Save the boss position, shift it, show contact gfx, restore
$01:D353 48           PHA                             ; Save X low
$01:D354 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:D355 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } X low -= 8
$01:D357 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:D359 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; X high
$01:D35C 48           PHA                             ; Save X high
$01:D35D E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; \
$01:D35F 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / X high -= borrow
$01:D362 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Y low
$01:D364 48           PHA                             ; Save Y low
$01:D365 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:D366 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Y low += 8
$01:D368 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:D36A 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Display contact stars (DisplayContactGfx)
$01:D36E 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y low
$01:D36F 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Store Y low
$01:D371 68           PLA                             ; Restore X high
$01:D372 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store X high
$01:D375 68           PLA                             ; Restore X low
$01:D376 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store X low
$01:D378 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D379 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$01:D37B 85 38        STA $38                         ; / Platform tilt target [$38] = $18
$01:D37D DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:D37E A5 39        LDA $39                         ; [$39]: current tilt step * 2
$01:D380 4A           LSR                             ; /2
$01:D381 AA           TAX                             ; X = old tilt step
$01:D382 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:D384 85 39        STA $39                         ; / [$39] = $28 (new tilt)
$01:D386 4A           LSR                             ; /2
$01:D387 A8           TAY                             ; Y = new tilt step
$01:D388 B9 D6 D0     LDA.W ADDR_01D0D6,Y             ; Floor height for new tilt (table at $01D0D6)
$01:D38B 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$01:D38C FD D6 D0     SBC.W ADDR_01D0D6,X             ; Minus floor height for old tilt
$01:D38F FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:D390 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D391 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Add the floor height change to the boss Y
$01:D393 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Store Y low
$01:D395 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Y high
$01:D398 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Carry into high byte
$01:D39A 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$01:D39D 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:D39F 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Sprite X and Y speed = 0
$01:D3A1 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:D3A3 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $80
$01:D3A6 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D3A8 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / State [$151C] = 3 (stomped, stunned)
$01:D3AB A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:D3AD 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $28
$01:D3B0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D3B1 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; State [$151C]
$01:D3B4 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$01:D3B6 B0 52        BCS $D40A                       ; / State 3 or more: ignore fireballs
$01:D3B8 A0 0A        LDY.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:D3BA 8C 95 16     STY.W $1695                     ; / Y = $0A: extended sprite slot, loop $0A-$08 ([$1695] = slot)
$01:D3BD B9 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; Extended sprite number
$01:D3C0 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$01:D3C2 D0 41        BNE $D405                       ; / Not Mario's fireball (5): next slot
$01:D3C4 B9 1F 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; Fireball X low
$01:D3C7 85 00        STA $00                         ; To [$00]
$01:D3C9 B9 33 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y         ; Fireball X high
$01:D3CC 85 08        STA $08                         ; To [$08]
$01:D3CE B9 15 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; Fireball Y low
$01:D3D1 85 01        STA $01                         ; To [$01]
$01:D3D3 B9 29 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y         ; Fireball Y high
$01:D3D6 85 09        STA $09                         ; To [$09]
$01:D3D8 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:D3DA 85 02        STA $02                         ; } } Fireball hitbox is 8x8: [$02] = [$03] = 8
$01:D3DC 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:D3DE 5A           PHY                             ; Save slot
$01:D3DF 20 0B D4     JSR.W $D40B                     ; Build boss hitbox ($D40B)
$01:D3E2 7A           PLY                             ; Restore slot
$01:D3E3 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check for contact
$01:D3E7 90 1C        BCC $D405                       ; No contact: next slot
$01:D3E9 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D3EB 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / Turn the fireball into a smoke puff (extended sprite 1)
$01:D3EE A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; Puff timer = $0F
$01:D3F0 99 6F 17     STA.W $176F,Y                   ; Store in [$176F,Y]
$01:D3F3 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D3F5 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $01
$01:D3F8 FE 26 16     INC.W $1626,X                   ; Fireball hit count [$1626]++
$01:D3FB BD 26 16     LDA.W $1626,X                   ; Hit count
$01:D3FE C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:D400 90 03        BCC $D405                       ; / Fewer than 12 hits: keep going
$01:D402 20 D0 CF     JSR.W $CFD0                     ; 12 hits: boss defeated ($CFD0)
$01:D405 88           DEY                             ; Next extended sprite slot
$01:D406 C0 07        CPY.B #$07                      ; \
$01:D408 D0 B0        BNE $D3BA                       ; / Loop until Y = 7
$01:D40A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D40B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Boss X low
$01:D40D 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:D40E E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } } Hitbox X = boss X - 8 (low)
$01:D410 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$01:D412 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Boss X high
$01:D415 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; \
$01:D417 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / } Hitbox X high
$01:D419 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:D41B 85 06        STA $06                         ; / Hitbox width [$06] = $10
$01:D41D A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:D41F 85 07        STA $07                         ; / Hitbox height [$07] = $10
$01:D421 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Boss animation frame
$01:D424 C9 69        CMP.B #$69                      ; \
$01:D426 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; / Frame >= $69 (never used) takes the extra offset below
$01:D428 90 02        BCC $D42C                       ; Y offset 8 normally
$01:D42A 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; Frame >= $69: offset 8 + $0A + 1 (unused)
$01:D42C 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D42D 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; + boss Y low
$01:D42F 85 05        STA $05                         ; Hitbox Y low [$05]
$01:D431 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Boss Y high
$01:D434 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Carry
$01:D436 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; Hitbox Y high [$0B]
$01:D438 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D439..D439: Table: boss fireball OAM indexes ;;;
{
$01:D439              .db $A8,$B0,$B8,$C0,$C8         ; OAM index per sprite slot (slots 0-4): $A8, $B0, $B8, $C0, $C8

}

;;; $D43E: Unused. Erase sprite ;;;
{
$01:D43E 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Unreachable: erase sprite
$01:D441 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D442..D442: Table: boss fireball X offsets ;;;
{
$01:D442              .db $00,$F0,$00,$10             ; X offset of the two tiles by facing: right 00/F0, left 00/10

;;; $D446: Table: boss fireball tiles and properties (LudwigFireTiles) ;;;
{
$01:D446              .db $4A,$4C,$6A,$6C             ; Tile numbers: frame 0 = $4A,$4C; frame 1 = $6A,$6C

$01:D44A              .db $45,$45,$05,$05             ; Properties: $45 = X-flip, $05 = no flip (palette 2, priority)

;;; $D44E: Boss fireball main routine (BossFireball) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 34. Moves horizontally, damages Mario, erases itself when far off-screen, and draws one or two 16x16
;;     tiles
;; (one tile while the spawn timer [$1540] is >= 8). Y-flip alternates every two frames.
;; While [$1540] is non-zero (spawn delay) it neither moves nor hurts.
$01:D44E A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked?
$01:D450 0D FB 13     ORA.W $13FB                     ; OR cutscene/boss-defeated flag [$13FB]
$01:D453 D0 32        BNE $D487                       ; Locked: only draw
$01:D455 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540] (spawn-in delay)
$01:D458 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$01:D45A B0 2B        BCS $D487                       ; / Timer >= $10: only draw
$01:D45C A8           TAY                             ; Y = timer
$01:D45D D0 09        BNE $D468                       ; Timer non-zero: skip animation and Mario contact
$01:D45F 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate (frame toggle)
$01:D462 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate again (twice per frame = faster)
$01:D465 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Mario interaction (hurts Mario)
$01:D468 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed
$01:D46B B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D46D 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D46E 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; Offset by $20 so off-screen test is one-sided
$01:D470 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = X low + $20
$01:D472 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; X high
$01:D475 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Carry
$01:D477 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = X high
$01:D479 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:D47B A5 00        LDA $00                         ; [$00]/[$01] = X + $20 relative to the level
$01:D47D C9 30 02     CMP.W #$0230                    ; Compare with $0230
$01:D480 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:D482 90 03        BCC $D487                       ; In range: keep
$01:D484 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Too far off: erase sprite
$01:D487 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get sprite drawing position (GetDrawInfoBnk1)
$01:D48A BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame
$01:D48D 0A           ASL                             ; *2
$01:D48E 85 03        STA $03                         ; [$03] = frame * 2 (tile index)
$01:D490 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction
$01:D493 0A           ASL                             ; *2
$01:D494 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = direction * 2
$01:D496 BD 39 D4     LDA.W $D439,X                   ; OAM index for this sprite slot
$01:D499 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Store in sprite OAM index
$01:D49C A8           TAY                             ; Y = OAM index
$01:D49D DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:D49E BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer
$01:D4A1 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: draw two tiles
$01:D4A3 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:D4A5 90 01        BCC $D4A8                       ; / Timer < 8: two tiles
$01:D4A7 CA           DEX                             ; Timer >= 8: X = 0, only one tile
$01:D4A8 DA           PHX                             ; Save tile counter
$01:D4A9 DA           PHX                             ; Save again
$01:D4AA 8A           TXA                             ; A = tile counter
$01:D4AB 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D4AC 65 02        ADC $02                         ; + direction * 2
$01:D4AE AA           TAX                             ; X = index into the offset/property tables
$01:D4AF A5 00        LDA $00                         ; Sprite screen X ([$00])
$01:D4B1 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D4B2 7D 42 D4     ADC.W $D442,X                   ; + tile X offset
$01:D4B5 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X position
$01:D4B8 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; Frame counter
$01:D4BA 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:D4BB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:D4BC 6A           ROR                             ; } } Y-flip bit alternates every 2 frames
$01:D4BD 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; /
$01:D4BF 1D 4A D4     ORA.W $D44A,X                   ; OR tile properties
$01:D4C2 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; OAM properties
$01:D4C5 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; Sprite screen Y ([$01])
$01:D4C7 1A           INC A                           ; \
$01:D4C8 1A           INC A                           ; / Y + 2
$01:D4C9 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; OAM Y position
$01:D4CC 68           PLA                             ; Restore tile counter
$01:D4CD 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D4CE 65 03        ADC $03                         ; + frame * 2
$01:D4D0 AA           TAX                             ; X = tile table index
$01:D4D1 BD 46 D4     LDA.W LudwigFireTiles,X         ; Tile number
$01:D4D4 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile
$01:D4D7 FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile counter
$01:D4D8 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:D4D9 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:D4DA C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM slot: Y += 4
$01:D4DB C8           INY                             ; /
$01:D4DC CA           DEX                             ; Tile counter--
$01:D4DD 10 C9        BPL $D4A8                       ; Loop for all tiles
$01:D4DF FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:D4E0 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$01:D4E2 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: two tiles drawn
$01:D4E4 4C BB B7     JMP.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish OAM write (FinishOAMWriteRt)


}

;;; $D4E7..D4F3: Table: parachute sway data ;;;
{
;; Sway direction steps, turn-around limits and X acceleration by sway index.
$01:D4E7              .db $01,$FF                     ; Sway index steps by direction: +1, -1

$01:D4E9              .db $0F,$00                     ; Sway turn-around limits: $0F, $00

$01:D4EB              .db $00,$02,$04,$06,$08,$0A,$0C,$0E ; Sway X acceleration by sway index (0-14, up then down)
$01:D4F3              .db $0E,$0C,$0A,$08,$06,$04,$02,$00 ; (continued) descending half

}

;;; $D4FB: Para-Goomba and Para-Bomb main (ParachuteSprites) ;;;
{
;; Sprites 3F and 40. Descends 1 pixel every other frame while swaying left/right (X acceleration from
;;     $D4EB, applied
;; temporarily). Touching a wall stops the sway; hitting the ground starts a $20 frame landing timer, after
;;     which the
;; sprite turns into a normal Goomba or Bob-omb (table at $01D5AE) with timer $80. Also does that if status is
;;     not 8.
;; The canopy and the enemy are drawn at different offsets (code at $01D5B3).
$01:D4FB BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status
$01:D4FE C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:D500 F0 03        BEQ $D505                       ; / Status 8 (normal)? Yes: run
$01:D502 4C 71 D6     JMP.W $D671                     ; Otherwise turn into plain Goomba/Bob-omb ($D671)

$01:D505 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:D507 D0 4F        BNE $D558                       ; / Sprites locked: just draw
$01:D509 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:D50C D0 4A        BNE $D558                       ; / Landing timer running: just draw
$01:D50E A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter
$01:D510 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 into carry
$01:D511 90 07        BCC $D51A                       ; Even frame: skip
$01:D513 F6 D8        INC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Odd frames: Y position++ (slow descent)
$01:D515 D0 03        BNE $D51A                       ; No wrap
$01:D517 FE D4 14     INC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Y high++
$01:D51A BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C] (set when it touches a wall)
$01:D51D D0 39        BNE $D558                       ; Non-zero: stop swaying
$01:D51F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter
$01:D521 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 into carry
$01:D522 90 16        BCC $D53A                       ; Even frame: skip sway index update
$01:D524 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state (sway phase)
$01:D526 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Bit 0 = sway direction
$01:D528 A8           TAY                             ; Y = direction
$01:D529 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; Sway index [$1570]
$01:D52C 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D52D 79 E7 D4     ADC.W $D4E7,Y                   ; +/- 1
$01:D530 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; Store sway index
$01:D533 D9 E9 D4     CMP.W $D4E9,Y                   ; Reached the turn-around limit?
$01:D536 D0 02        BNE $D53A                       ; No: keep going
$01:D538 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yes: state++ (reverses direction and swing side)
$01:D53A B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed
$01:D53C 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:D53D BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; Y = sway index
$01:D540 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state
$01:D542 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 into carry (swing side)
$01:D543 B9 EB D4     LDA.W $D4EB,Y                   ; Sway acceleration for this index
$01:D546 90 03        BCC $D54B                       ; Left side: negate
$01:D548 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:D54A 1A           INC A                           ; / Negate A
$01:D54B 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D54C 75 B6        ADC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Add to X speed
$01:D54E 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store X speed
$01:D550 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Apply X speed to position
$01:D553 68           PLA                             ; Restore real X speed
$01:D554 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store it
$01:D556 80 00        BRA $D558                       ; Continue

$01:D558 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when off-screen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:D55B 4C B3 D5     JMP.W $D5B3                     ; Go draw


}

{
$01:D55E              .db $0D,$0D,$0D,$0D,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0C ; Canopy animation frame by sway index: $0D/$0C
$01:D566              .db $0C,$0C,$0C,$0C,$0D,$0D,$0D,$0D ; (continued)
}

{
$01:D56E              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Canopy direction flag by sway index: 0 then 1

}

}

;;; $D5B3: Parachute sprites: draw and physics ;;;
{
;; Draws the canopy (palette 3, frame $0C/$0D) then the carried enemy at a swaying offset, runs sprite
;;     interaction,
;; and handles the landing countdown and ground/wall checks. Position is saved on the stack and restored at
;;     the end.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:D55B: Para-Goomba and Para-Bomb main (ParachuteSprites)
$01:D5B3 9C 5E 18     STZ.W $185E                     ; [$185E] = 0 (canopy collapse offset)
$01:D5B6 A0 F0        LDY.B #$F0                      ; Y = $F0: canopy is 16 pixels above the enemy
$01:D5B8 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Landing timer
$01:D5BB F0 0A        BEQ $D5C7                       ; Not landed: use default
$01:D5BD 4A           LSR                             ; Timer / 2
$01:D5BE 49 0F        EOR.B #$0F                      ; EOR $0F: grows as the timer runs down
$01:D5C0 8D 5E 18     STA.W $185E                     ; [$185E] = collapse offset
$01:D5C3 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D5C4 69 F0        ADC.B #$F0                      ; Add $F0
$01:D5C6 A8           TAY                             ; Y = canopy Y offset
$01:D5C7 84 00        STY $00                         ; [$00] = Y offset
$01:D5C9 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Sprite Y low
$01:D5CB 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:D5CC 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D5CD 65 00        ADC $00                         ; Add offset
$01:D5CF 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Move sprite up to the canopy position
$01:D5D1 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Y high
$01:D5D4 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:D5D5 69 FF        ADC.B #$FF                      ; Sign extension
$01:D5D7 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$01:D5DA BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Sprite palette
$01:D5DD 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:D5DE 29 F1        AND.B #$F1                      ; \
$01:D5E0 09 06        ORA.B #$06                      ; / Palette = 3 (canopy)
$01:D5E2 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store palette
$01:D5E5 BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; Y = sway index
$01:D5E8 B9 5E D5     LDA.W $D55E,Y                   ; Canopy frame ($0C/$0D)
$01:D5EB 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store in [$1602]
$01:D5EE B9 6E D5     LDA.W $D56E,Y                   ; Canopy direction
$01:D5F1 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Store in sprite direction
$01:D5F4 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the canopy (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:D5F7 68           PLA                             ; Restore palette
$01:D5F8 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store palette
$01:D5FB BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; OAM index
$01:D5FE 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D5FF 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; Skip the canopy's tile (+4)
$01:D601 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Store OAM index
$01:D604 BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; Y = sway index
$01:D607 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D609 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:D60A 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D60B 79 7E D5     ADC.W $D57E,Y                   ; Add swing X offset
$01:D60E 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store X low
$01:D610 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; X high
$01:D613 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:D614 79 8E D5     ADC.W $D58E,Y                   ; Add high offset
$01:D617 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store X high
$01:D61A 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0 (Y high sign)
$01:D61C B9 9E D5     LDA.W $D59E,Y                   ; Swing Y offset
$01:D61F 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$01:D620 ED 5E 18     SBC.W $185E                     ; Minus collapse offset
$01:D623 10 02        BPL $D627                       ; Positive: ok
$01:D625 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Negative: [$00] = $FF
$01:D627 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D628 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Add to Y low
$01:D62A 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Store Y low
$01:D62C BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Y high
$01:D62F 65 00        ADC $00                         ; Add sign
$01:D631 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$01:D634 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Frame
$01:D637 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$01:D638 E9 0C        SBC.B #$0C                      ; Minus $0C
$01:D63A C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Equal to 1 (mirror frame)?
$01:D63C D0 04        BNE $D642                       ; No: keep
$01:D63E 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D63F 7D 7C 15     ADC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Add direction
