$01:D642 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store [$1602] (enemy pose)
$01:D645 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Landing timer
$01:D648 F0 03        BEQ $D64D                       ; Not landed: keep
$01:D64A 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Landed: frame 0
$01:D64D BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; Y = frame
$01:D650 B9 B0 D5     LDA.W $D5B0,Y                   ; Tile number for this frame
$01:D653 20 F3 9C     JSR.W SubSprGfx0Entry0          ; Draw the enemy (SubSprGfx0Entry0)
$01:D656 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Sprite-to-sprite and Mario interaction
$01:D659 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Landing timer
$01:D65C F0 35        BEQ $D693                       ; Zero: flying logic ($D693)
$01:D65E 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer - 1
$01:D65F D0 20        BNE $D681                       ; Not last frame: land physics
$01:D661 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Last frame: Y speed = 0
$01:D663 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:D664 68           PLA                             ; } Discard saved X high/X low and one more byte
$01:D665 68           PLA                             ; /
$01:D666 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Restore Y high
$01:D669 68           PLA                             ; Pop saved Y low
$01:D66A 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Restore Y low
$01:D66C A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:D66E 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = $80
$01:D671 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Sprite number
$01:D673 38           SEC                             ; Set carry
$01:D674 E9 3F        SBC.B #$3F                      ; Minus $3F (Para-Goomba = 0)
$01:D676 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index
$01:D677 B9 AE D5     LDA.W $D5AE,Y                   ; Normal sprite number to become
$01:D67A 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Store sprite number
$01:D67C 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload sprite tables for the new sprite
$01:D680 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D681 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Object interaction ($9140)
$01:D684 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:D687 F0 03        BEQ $D68C                       ; No: skip
$01:D689 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Reset Y speed on ground
$01:D68C 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply Y speed
$01:D68F F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Gravity: Y speed++
$01:D691 80 22        BRA $D6B5                       ; Restore position and return

$01:D693 8A           TXA                             ; Slot index
$01:D694 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; XOR frame counter
$01:D696 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0 into carry
$01:D697 90 1C        BCC $D6B5                       ; Run object checks every other frame per slot
$01:D699 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Object interaction ($9140)
$01:D69C 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Touching a wall?
$01:D69F F0 0A        BEQ $D6AB                       ; No: skip
$01:D6A1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D6A3 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C] = 1: stop swaying
$01:D6A6 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:D6A8 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; / Sway index = 7
$01:D6AB 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:D6AE F0 05        BEQ $D6B5                       ; No: skip
$01:D6B0 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:D6B2 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Landing timer = $20
$01:D6B5 68           PLA                             ; Restore X high
$01:D6B6 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store X high
$01:D6B9 68           PLA                             ; Restore X low
$01:D6BA 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store X low
$01:D6BC 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y high
$01:D6BD 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$01:D6C0 68           PLA                             ; Restore Y low
$01:D6C1 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Store Y low
$01:D6C3 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $D6C4: Init: line-guided rope mechanism (InitLineRope) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 64. Slot >= 6 with [$1692] set bumps the tweaker byte, then shares the line init at $D6E0.
$01:D6C4 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; Sprite slot 6 or higher?
$01:D6C6 90 18        BCC $D6E0                       ; No: skip
$01:D6C8 AD 92 16     LDA.W $1692                     ; [$1692] (sprite memory setting)
$01:D6CB F0 13        BEQ $D6E0                       ; Zero: skip
$01:D6CD FE 62 16     INC.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Tweaker byte [$1662]++ (change sprite properties)
$01:D6D0 80 0E        BRA $D6E0                       ; Continue to common init

}

;;; $D6D2: Init: line-guided platform (InitLinePlat) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 63. Frame from X bit 4 ($10 or 0); shares the line init at $D6E0 (timer++, two line steps,
;;     [$1626]++).
$01:D6D2 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D6D4 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; Bit 4 of X
$01:D6D6 49 10        EOR.B #$10                      ; Flip it
$01:D6D8 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602] = $10 or 0
$01:D6DB F0 03        BEQ $D6E0                       ; Zero: skip
$01:D6DD FE 62 16     INC.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; Tweaker byte [$1662]++ (change sprite properties)
$01:D6E0 FE 40 15     INC.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540]++ (marks line start)
$01:D6E3 20 4A D7     JSR.W LineFuzzy+Plats           ; Run line-guide step (first)
$01:D6E6 20 4A D7     JSR.W LineFuzzy+Plats           ; Run line-guide step (second)
$01:D6E9 FE 26 16     INC.W $1626,X                   ; [$1626]++ (probably 'waiting for Mario' flag)
$01:D6EC 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $D6ED: Init: line-guided chainsaw/grinder/fuzzy (InitLineGuidedSpr) ;;;
{
;; Sprites 65-68. Sets variant flag [$187B], then moves X depending on bit 4 of X (left -$140 or right +$0F
;;     with direction 1).
$01:D6ED FE 7B 18     INC.W $187B,X                   ; [$187B]++ (marks a chainsaw/grinder/fuzzy variant)
$01:D6F0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D6F2 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; Bit 4 of X
$01:D6F4 D0 11        BNE $D707                       ; Set: go right
$01:D6F6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D6F8 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:D6F9 E9 40        SBC.B #$40                      ; } } X -= $0140 (16-bit)
$01:D6FB 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:D6FD BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; X high
$01:D700 E9 01        SBC.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D702 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / } X high -= 1 with borrow
$01:D705 80 0A        BRA InitLineBrwnPlat            ; Go set timer

$01:D707 FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction++ (move right)
$01:D70A B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D70C 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D70D 69 0F        ADC.B #$0F                      ; + $0F
$01:D70F 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store X low
}

;;; $D711: Init: line-guided brown platform (InitLineBrwnPlat) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 62. Sets the timer [$1540] = 2.
$01:D711 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:D713 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Timer [$1540] = 2
$01:D716 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D717..D717: Table: chainsaw spark X offsets ;;;
{
$01:D717              .db $F8,$00                     ; X offsets for chainsaw sparks: $F8, $00

}

;;; $D719: Line-guided rope and chainsaw main (LineRope+Chainsaw) ;;;
{
;; Sprites 64-66. Every 8th frame spawns a smoke puff at a small offset above the sprite, then plays the
;;     grinder sound as LineGrinder.
$01:D719 8A           TXA                             ; A = slot index
$01:D71A 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:D71B 0A           ASL                             ; / *4
$01:D71C 45 14        EOR RAM_FrameCounterB           ; XOR frame counter
$01:D71E 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = staggered counter
$01:D720 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; Low 3 bits
$01:D722 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; OR sprites locked
$01:D724 D0 14        BNE LineGrinder                 ; Not every 8th frame or locked: skip sparks
$01:D726 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; Counter
$01:D728 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:D729 4A           LSR                             ; } /8
$01:D72A 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:D72B 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Bit 0
$01:D72D A8           TAY                             ; Y = 0 or 1
$01:D72E B9 17 D7     LDA.W $D717,Y                   ; Spark X offset
$01:D731 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = X offset
$01:D733 A9 F2        LDA.B #$F2                      ; \
$01:D735 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = $F2 (spark Y offset, above sprite)
$01:D737 20 63 80     JSR.W $8063                     ; Spawn smoke puff ($8063)
}

;;; $D73A: Line-guided grinder main (LineGrinder) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 67. Plays sound effect $04 on every 8th frame while unlocked, then runs the common line-guide code.
$01:D73A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter
$01:D73C 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; Low 3 bits
$01:D73E 1D 26 16     ORA.W $1626,X                   ; OR [$1626]
$01:D741 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; OR sprites locked
$01:D743 D0 05        BNE LineFuzzy+Plats             ; Skip sound unless every 8th frame and active
$01:D745 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:D747 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / Play sound effect $04 (grinder noise)
}

;;; $D74A: Line-guided fuzzy and platforms main (LineFuzzy+Plats) ;;;
{
;; Sprites 62, 63 and 68 and tail of the others. Jumps to $D9A7 (line-guide dispatcher). $D74D:
;;     despawn off-screen, then run state routine.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:D6E3: Init: line-guided platform (InitLinePlat)
;;     $01:D6E6: Init: line-guided platform (InitLinePlat)
$01:D74A 4C A7 D9     JMP.W $D9A7                     ; Run the line-guide main code ($D9A7)

$01:D74D 20 2B AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen1Bnk1         ; Despawn when off-screen (SubOffscreen1Bnk1)
$01:D750 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer
$01:D753 D0 07        BNE $D75C                       ; Running: go
$01:D755 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked
$01:D757 1D 26 16     ORA.W $1626,X                   ; OR [$1626]
$01:D75A D0 90        BNE $D6EC                       ; Locked or waiting: return
$01:D75C B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state
$01:D75E 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Execute the state routine

}

;;; $D762: Line-guide states and step routine (Ptrs01D762) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table for sprite state: 0 = $D7F4 (find next segment), 1 = $D768 (step along it), 2 =
;;     $DB44.
;; $D768 walks the step index [$1534] forward (or [$1570] backward when direction is non-zero) and calls
;;     $D7B0,
;; which reads a packed byte from the line table in bank $07 (pointer [$151C]/[$1528]): high nibble = Y, low
;;     nibble = X within the tile.
$01:D762 F4 D7        .dw $D7F4                       ; State 0: find the next line segment
$01:D764 68 D7        .dw $D768                       ; State 1: step along the line
$01:D766 44 DB        .dw $DB44                       ; State 2: $DB44

$01:D768 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:D76A D0 25        BNE $D791                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:D76C BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction
$01:D76F D0 21        BNE $D792                       ; Backward (non-zero): $D792
$01:D771 BC 34 15     LDY.W $1534,X                   ; Y = step index [$1534]
$01:D774 20 B0 D7     JSR.W $D7B0                     ; Place sprite at this table position
$01:D777 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Step index++
$01:D77A BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; Fast variant [$187B]
$01:D77D F0 08        BEQ $D787                       ; No: skip
$01:D77F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter
$01:D781 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0
$01:D782 90 03        BCC $D787                       ; Even: skip
$01:D784 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Fast variants: extra step every other frame
$01:D787 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; Step index
$01:D78A DD 70 15     CMP.W $1570,X                   ; Compare with segment length [$1570]
$01:D78D 90 02        BCC $D791                       ; Not at end: return
$01:D78F 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State 0: pick next segment
$01:D791 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D792 BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; Y = remaining length [$1570]
$01:D795 88           DEY                             ; Y - 1
$01:D796 20 B0 D7     JSR.W $D7B0                     ; Place sprite at this table position
$01:D799 DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; Length--
$01:D79C F0 0F        BEQ $D7AD                       ; Zero: done
$01:D79E BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; Fast variant [$187B]
$01:D7A1 F0 0C        BEQ $D7AF                       ; No: return
$01:D7A3 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Frame counter
$01:D7A5 4A           LSR                             ; Bit 0
$01:D7A6 90 07        BCC $D7AF                       ; Even: return
$01:D7A8 DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; Extra step every other frame
$01:D7AB D0 02        BNE $D7AF                       ; Not done: return
$01:D7AD 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State 0: pick next segment
$01:D7AF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D7B0 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$01:D7B1 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:D7B3 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $07 (line tables)
$01:D7B4 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:D7B5 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Line table pointer low [$151C]
$01:D7B8 85 04        STA $04                         ; To [$04]
$01:D7BA BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; Pointer high [$1528]
$01:D7BD 85 05        STA $05                         ; To [$05]
$01:D7BF B1 04        LDA ($04),Y                     ; Table byte for this step
$01:D7C1 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; Low nibble = X offset in 16x16 tile
$01:D7C3 85 06        STA $06                         ; [$06] = X offset
$01:D7C5 B1 04        LDA ($04),Y                     ; Table byte again
$01:D7C7 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:D7C8 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:D7C9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:D7CA 4A           LSR                             ; } High nibble = Y offset
$01:D7CB 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:D7CC 85 07        STA $07                         ; [$07] = Y offset
$01:D7CE B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Sprite Y low
$01:D7D0 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; Align to tile
$01:D7D2 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D7D3 65 07        ADC $07                         ; Add Y offset
$01:D7D5 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Store Y
$01:D7D7 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Sprite X low
$01:D7D9 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; Align to tile
$01:D7DB 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$01:D7DC 65 06        ADC $06                         ; Add X offset
$01:D7DE 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Store X
$01:D7E0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $D7E1..D7ED: Table: line probe point offsets ;;;
{
$01:D7E1              .db $FC,$04,$FC,$04             ; Probe point X offsets (low): $FC, $04, $FC, $04

$01:D7E5              .db $FF,$00,$FF,$00             ; Probe point X offsets (high): $FF, $00, $FF, $00

$01:D7E9              .db $FC,$FC,$04,$04             ; Probe point Y offsets (low): $FC, $FC, $04, $04

$01:D7ED              .db $FF,$FF,$00,$00             ; Probe point Y offsets (high): $FF, $FF, $00, $00

}

;;; $D7F1: Line guide engine and platform sprites ;;;
{
;; Shared code for the line-guided sprites ($62-$68: brown/checker platforms, rope motor, chainsaws, grinder,
;;     fuzz ball).
;; Sprite state ([$C2]): 0 = at a segment end, search for the next line tile ($01D7F4); 1 = follow the segment
;;     ($D768);
;; 2 = fell off a line and flies with its own speed ($01DB44). The chunk holds the search, the Map16 lookup
;;     ($01D94D),
;; the per-sprite dispatcher ($01D9A7), the rope/Mario grab code ($01D9D3) and the platform code ($01DAA2).
;; Line tiles are Map16 $76-$99: tile - $76 is the segment number [$160E] indexing the tables at
;;     $01DCD1-$01DD89.
$01:D7F1 4C 9F D8     JMP.W $D89F                     ; Keep the current segment: continue at $01D89F

$01:D7F4 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; State 0: look for a line guide tile around the sprite (4 probe points)
$01:D7F6 8C 95 16     STY.W $1695                     ; Probe counter [$1695] = Y (3..0)
$01:D7F9 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D7FB 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D7FC 79 E1 D7     ADC.W $D7E1,Y                   ; } $02 = sprite X low + probe X offset (-4,+4,-4,+4)
$01:D7FF 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$01:D801 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:D804 79 E5 D7     ADC.W $D7E5,Y                   ; } $03 = sprite X high + sign extension
$01:D807 85 03        STA $03                         ; /
$01:D809 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D80B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D80C 79 E9 D7     ADC.W $D7E9,Y                   ; } $00 = sprite Y low + probe Y offset (-4,-4,+4,+4)
$01:D80F 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:D811 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:D814 79 ED D7     ADC.W $D7ED,Y                   ; } $01 = sprite Y high + sign extension
$01:D817 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:D819 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540]: just placed or just left a line?
$01:D81C D0 1C        BNE $D83A                       ; Non-zero: skip the same-tile check
$01:D81E A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:D820 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } $04 = probe Y rounded down to its 16x16 tile row
$01:D822 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$01:D824 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D826 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:D828 C5 04        CMP $04                         ; } Different tile row from the sprite: test this probe
$01:D82A D0 0E        BNE $D83A                       ; /
$01:D82C A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:D82E 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } $05 = probe X rounded down to its tile column
$01:D830 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$01:D832 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D834 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:D836 C5 05        CMP $05                         ; } Probe is in the sprite's own tile: ignore it, next probe
$01:D838 F0 27        BEQ $D861                       ; /
$01:D83A 20 4D D9     JSR.W $D94D                     ; Read the Map16 tile at the probe point into [$1693]
$01:D83D D0 B2        BNE $D7F1                       ; Flag set: keep following the current segment (jump to $01D89F)
$01:D83F AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; A = Map16 tile number under the probe
$01:D842 C9 94        CMP.B #$94                      ; \
$01:D844 F0 0B        BEQ $D851                       ; / $94: on/off switch dependent line piece, go check [$0DAF]
$01:D846 C9 95        CMP.B #$95                      ; \
$01:D848 D0 0C        BNE $D856                       ; / Not $95 either: ordinary tile, go to the range check
$01:D84A AD AF 14     LDA.W RAM_OnOffStatus           ; \
$01:D84D F0 12        BEQ $D861                       ; / $95 piece: usable only while ON/OFF is OFF, else skip probe
$01:D84F D0 05        BNE $D856                       ; ON/OFF is ON: go to the range check
$01:D851 AD AF 14     LDA.W RAM_OnOffStatus           ; \
$01:D854 D0 0B        BNE $D861                       ; / $94 piece: usable only while ON/OFF is ON, else skip probe
$01:D856 AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; A = Map16 tile number
$01:D859 C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; \
$01:D85B 90 04        BCC $D861                       ; / Below $76: not a line guide tile, next probe
$01:D85D C9 9A        CMP.B #$9A                      ; \
$01:D85F 90 34        BCC $D895                       ; / $76-$99 is a line guide tile: attach to it
$01:D861 AC 95 16     LDY.W $1695                     ; \
$01:D864 88           DEY                             ; / Next probe: Y = [$1695] - 1
$01:D865 10 8F        BPL $D7F6                       ; Loop for all four probe points
$01:D867 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:D869 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Already falling (state 2): nothing more to do
$01:D86B F0 27        BEQ $D894                       ; /
$01:D86D A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:D86F 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / No line found: sprite state = 2 (fall off the end)
$01:D871 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = current segment number [$160E]
$01:D874 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:D877 F0 05        BEQ $D87E                       ; / Moving forward: use the first half of the speed tables
$01:D879 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:D87A 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D87B 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; } Moving backward: use the second half (index + $20)
$01:D87D A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:D87E B9 11 DD     LDA.W $DD11,Y                   ; A = Y speed for leaving this segment end
$01:D881 10 01        BPL $D884                       ; Positive: skip the extra shift
$01:D883 0A           ASL                             ; Negative speeds are shifted an extra time (x4 total)
$01:D884 5A           PHY                             ; Save the table index
$01:D885 0A           ASL                             ; Speed x2
$01:D886 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Sprite Y speed = table value x2 (x4 if negative)
$01:D888 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the table index
$01:D889 B9 51 DD     LDA.W $DD51,Y                   ; A = X speed for leaving this segment end
$01:D88C 0A           ASL                             ; Speed x2
$01:D88D 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = table value x2
$01:D88F A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:D891 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $10: do not search for a new line for 16 frames
$01:D894 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D895 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:D896 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:D897 E9 76        SBC.B #$76                      ; |
$01:D899 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = tile number - $76 (segment number), keep A = tile
$01:D89A 68           PLA                             ; /
$01:D89B C9 96        CMP.B #$96                      ; \
$01:D89D 90 05        BCC $D8A4                       ; / Tiles $76-$95: move onto the new segment
$01:D89F BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Tiles $96-$99: stay on the current segment [$160E]
$01:D8A2 80 24        BRA $D8C8                       ; Go load the segment

$01:D8A4 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D8A6 85 08        STA $08                         ; |
$01:D8A8 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:D8AB 85 09        STA $09                         ; |
$01:D8AD B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:D8AF 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; |
$01:D8B1 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } $08-$0B = current sprite Y and X (saved so a bad probe can be undone)
$01:D8B4 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; /
$01:D8B6 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:D8B8 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:D8BA A5 01        LDA $01                         ; |
$01:D8BC 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:D8BF A5 02        LDA $02                         ; |
$01:D8C1 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:D8C3 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; } Sprite position = probe point ($00-$03)
$01:D8C5 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:D8C8 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:D8C9 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; |
$01:D8CB 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $07 (where the line tables live)
$01:D8CC AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:D8CD B9 F3 FB     LDA.W $FBF3,Y                   ; \
$01:D8D0 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C] = low byte of the line table pointer for this segment
$01:D8D3 B9 13 FC     LDA.W $FC13,Y                   ; \
$01:D8D6 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / [$1528] = high byte of the line table pointer
$01:D8D9 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$01:D8DA B9 D1 DC     LDA.W $DCD1,Y                   ; \
$01:D8DD 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; / [$1570] = number of steps in this segment
$01:D8E0 9E 34 15     STZ.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534] = 0: step counter starts at the beginning
$01:D8E3 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:D8E4 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / [$160E] = current segment number
$01:D8E7 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer [$1540] still running (just placed)?
$01:D8EA D0 47        BNE $D933                       ; Yes: skip the direction check, start following (state 1)
$01:D8EC 9E 7C 15     STZ.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Direction [$157C] = 0 (forward)
$01:D8EF B9 F1 DC     LDA.W $DCF1,Y                   ; A = slope type of this segment (0, 1 or 2)
$01:D8F2 F0 0B        BEQ $D8FF                       ; Type 0: use the X position
$01:D8F4 A8           TAY                             ; Y = slope type
$01:D8F5 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; A = sprite Y low
$01:D8F7 C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; Type 1: Y is measured from the opposite edge
$01:D8F9 D0 02        BNE $D8FD                       ; Not type 1: use Y as is
$01:D8FB 49 0F        EOR.B #$0F                      ; Type 1: A = Y low EOR $0F
$01:D8FD 80 02        BRA $D901                       ; Join the common check

$01:D8FF B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; A = sprite X low
$01:D901 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; A = position within the 16x16 tile (0-15)
$01:D903 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; In the last 6 pixels (>= $0A)?
$01:D905 90 09        BCC $D910                       ; No: enter at the start, run forward
$01:D907 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:D909 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Falling (state 2): keep the forward direction
$01:D90B F0 03        BEQ $D910                       ; /
$01:D90D FE 7C 15     INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Entered at the far end: run the segment backward ([$157C] = 1)
$01:D910 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D912 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / $0C = sprite Y low before the trial step
$01:D914 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D916 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; / $0D = sprite X low before the trial step
$01:D918 20 68 D7     JSR.W $D768                     ; Take one step along the segment ($D768)
$01:D91B A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$01:D91D 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:D91E F5 D8        SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:D920 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D921 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:D923 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; } Y moved by 8 pixels or more? Then reject this segment
$01:D925 B0 11        BCS $D938                       ; /
$01:D927 A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; \
$01:D929 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:D92A F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:D92C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:D92D 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:D92F C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; } X moved by 8 pixels or more? Then reject this segment
$01:D931 B0 05        BCS $D938                       ; /
$01:D933 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:D935 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Sprite state = 1: follow the segment
$01:D937 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D938 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$01:D93A 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:D93C A5 09        LDA $09                         ; |
$01:D93E 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:D941 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; |
$01:D943 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:D945 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; } Restore the sprite position saved in $08-$0B
$01:D947 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:D94A 4C 61 D8     JMP.W $D861                     ; Segment rejected: try the next probe point

$01:D94D A5 00        LDA $00                         ; Read Map16 tile at ($02,$00): [$1693] = tile number, Z = flag
$01:D94F 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:D951 85 06        STA $06                         ; / $06 = Y & $F0: tile row in the high nibble
$01:D953 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:D955 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:D956 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:D957 4A           LSR                             ; } A = X >> 4: tile column
$01:D958 4A           LSR                             ; /
$01:D959 48           PHA                             ; Save the column
$01:D95A 05 06        ORA $06                         ; Combine into the tile index within the screen: A = column | row
$01:D95C 48           PHA                             ; Save the tile index within the screen
$01:D95D A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$01:D95F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Vertical level? Use the vertical layout
$01:D961 F0 14        BEQ $D977                       ; /
$01:D963 68           PLA                             ; Vertical: A = tile index
$01:D964 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; X = Y position high byte
$01:D966 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:D967 7F 80 BA 00  ADC.L $BA80,X                   ; } $05 = low byte of the Map16 address (vertical level)
$01:D96B 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$01:D96D BF BC BA 00  LDA.L $BABC,X                   ; \
$01:D971 65 03        ADC $03                         ; } $06 = high byte of the Map16 address (vertical level)
$01:D973 85 06        STA $06                         ; /
$01:D975 80 12        BRA $D989                       ; Join the common code

$01:D977 68           PLA                             ; Horizontal: A = tile index
$01:D978 A6 03        LDX $03                         ; X = X position high byte (screen number)
$01:D97A 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:D97B 7F 60 BA 00  ADC.L $BA60,X                   ; } $05 = low byte of the Map16 address (horizontal level)
$01:D97F 85 05        STA $05                         ; /
$01:D981 BF 9C BA 00  LDA.L $BA9C,X                   ; \
$01:D985 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } $06 = high byte of the Map16 address (horizontal level)
$01:D987 85 06        STA $06                         ; /
$01:D989 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$01:D98B 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = $7E: pointer is [$05] -> $7E:xxxx
$01:D98D AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:D990 A7 05        LDA [$05]                       ; A = Map16 tile number (low byte)
$01:D992 8D 93 16     STA.W $1693                     ; Save it in [$1693]
$01:D995 E6 07        INC $07                         ; $07 = $7F: same offset in the next table
$01:D997 A7 05        LDA [$05]                       ; A = byte at $7F:xxxx
$01:D999 7A           PLY                             ; Y = saved tile column
$01:D99A 84 05        STY $05                         ; $05 = tile column
$01:D99C 48           PHA                             ; Save the byte
$01:D99D A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$01:D99F 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Y = column AND 7
$01:D9A1 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:D9A2 68           PLA                             ; Restore the byte
$01:D9A3 39 00 80     AND.W $8000,Y                   ; Isolate bit (column AND 7); Z = 1 if clear (exact meaning unclear)
$01:D9A6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:D9A7 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:D9A9 C9 64        CMP.B #$64                      ; $64: rope mechanism
$01:D9AB F0 26        BEQ $D9D3                       ; Go to the rope code
$01:D9AD C9 65        CMP.B #$65                      ; \
$01:D9AF 90 1F        BCC $D9D0                       ; / Sprite < $65 ($62/$63 platforms): go to the platform code
$01:D9B1 C9 68        CMP.B #$68                      ; \
$01:D9B3 D0 05        BNE $D9BA                       ; / Not $68 (fuzz ball): go check $67
$01:D9B5 20 D4 DB     JSR.W $DBD4                     ; Fuzz ball: draw it ($DBD4)
$01:D9B8 80 07        BRA $D9C1                       ; Go interact with Mario

$01:D9BA C9 67        CMP.B #$67                      ; \
$01:D9BC D0 08        BNE $D9C6                       ; / Not $67 either, so a chainsaw ($65/$66)
$01:D9BE 20 0B DC     JSR.W $DC0B                     ; Grinder: draw it ($DC0B)
$01:D9C1 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Check contact with Mario (MarioSprInteractRt)
$01:D9C4 80 07        BRA $D9CD                       ; Then move along the line

$01:D9C6 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Chainsaw: check contact with Mario
$01:D9C9 22 63 C2 03  JSL.L $C263                     ; Draw the chainsaw ($C263)
$01:D9CD 4C 4D D7     JMP.W $D74D                     ; Move along the line guide (state machine at $01D74D)

$01:D9D0 4C A2 DA     JMP.W $DAA2                     ; Platforms: run the platform code

$01:D9D3 20 54 DC     JSR.W $DC54                     ; Draw the rope and motor
$01:D9D6 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:D9D8 48           PHA                             ; / Save the sprite X low
$01:D9D9 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:D9DB 48           PHA                             ; / Save the sprite Y low
$01:D9DC 20 4D D7     JSR.W $D74D                     ; Move along the line guide
$01:D9DF 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:D9E0 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:D9E1 F5 D8        SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:D9E3 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:D9E5 1A           INC A                           ; } [$185E] = Y movement this frame (new - old)
$01:D9E6 8D 5E 18     STA.W $185E                     ; /
$01:D9E9 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:D9EA 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:D9EB F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:D9ED 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:D9EF 1A           INC A                           ; } [$18B6] = X movement this frame (new - old)
$01:D9F0 8D B6 18     STA.W $18B6                     ; /
$01:D9F3 A5 77        LDA RAM_MarioObjStatus          ; \
$01:D9F5 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Mario touching a wall or ceiling/floor ($77 & 3): return
$01:D9F7 D0 10        BNE $DA09                       ; /
$01:D9F9 20 0F A8     JSR.W $A80F                     ; Check contact between Mario and the sprite
$01:D9FC B0 0C        BCS $DA0A                       ; Contact: go grab or carry Mario
$01:D9FE BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; No contact: is Mario flagged as on the rope?
$01:DA01 F0 06        BEQ $DA09                       ; No: done
$01:DA03 9E 3E 16     STZ.W $163E,X                   ; Clear the hold timer
$01:DA06 9C BE 18     STZ.W $18BE                     ; Clear Mario on rope flag [$18BE]
$01:DA09 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DA0A BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status
$01:DA0D F0 28        BEQ $DA37                       ; Sprite is gone: release Mario
$01:DA0F AD 70 14     LDA.W $1470                     ; \
$01:DA12 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; } Carrying an item or riding Yoshi: do not grab, release
$01:DA15 D0 E7        BNE $D9FE                       ; /
$01:DA17 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:DA19 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; / [$163E] = 3: Mario is on the rope (grace timer)
$01:DA1C BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; Interaction disabled timer [$154C] (after a jump off)
$01:DA1F D0 6E        BNE $DA8F                       ; Running: return without grabbing
$01:DA21 AD BE 18     LDA.W $18BE                     ; Already hanging on? ([$18BE])
$01:DA24 D0 09        BNE $DA2F                       ; Yes: go carry Mario
$01:DA26 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:DA28 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Not hanging: grab only if Up is held
$01:DA2A F0 63        BEQ $DA8F                       ; /
$01:DA2C 8D BE 18     STA.W $18BE                     ; [$18BE] = 8: Mario is hanging on the rope
$01:DA2F 24 16        BIT $16                         ; Test the newly pressed buttons ([$16]) bit 7: B
$01:DA31 10 0C        BPL $DA3F                       ; Not pressed: keep hanging
$01:DA33 A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; \
$01:DA35 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / B pressed: Mario Y speed = $B0 (jump off the rope)
$01:DA37 9C BE 18     STZ.W $18BE                     ; Release Mario: clear [$18BE]
$01:DA3A A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:DA3C 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable interaction for $10 frames so Mario does not re-grab
$01:DA3F A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (high byte of the Y movement)
$01:DA41 AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; A = Y movement of the sprite
$01:DA44 10 01        BPL $DA47                       ; Positive: high byte stays 0
$01:DA46 88           DEY                             ; Negative: high byte = $FF
$01:DA47 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:DA48 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; } Mario Y low += Y movement
$01:DA4A 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$01:DA4C 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:DA4D 65 97        ADC RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; } Mario Y high += carry / sign
$01:DA4F 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$01:DA51 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:DA53 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = sprite Y low
$01:DA55 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:DA58 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = sprite Y high
$01:DA5A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:DA5C A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:DA5E 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DA5F E5 00        SBC $00                         ; |
$01:DA61 C9 00 00     CMP.W #$0000                    ; } Mario already below the sprite Y? Then no correction
$01:DA64 10 02        BPL $DA68                       ; /
$01:DA66 E6 96        INC RAM_MarioYPos               ; Mario above the sprite: pull him down 1 pixel (unreferenced)
$01:DA68 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:DA6A AD B6 18     LDA.W $18B6                     ; A = X movement of the sprite
$01:DA6D 20 90 DA     JSR.W $DA90                     ; Add it to Mario X
$01:DA70 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:DA72 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DA73 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } Compare sprite X - 8 with Mario X
$01:DA75 C5 94        CMP RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$01:DA77 F0 0B        BEQ $DA84                       ; Equal: no nudge needed
$01:DA79 10 04        BPL $DA7F                       ; Mario is right of the rope X: go move him right
$01:DA7B A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF (move Mario left)
$01:DA7D 80 02        BRA $DA81                       ; Skip over

$01:DA7F A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = $01 (move Mario right)
$01:DA81 20 90 DA     JSR.W $DA90                     ; Nudge Mario 1 pixel toward the rope (add A to Mario X)
$01:DA84 BD 26 16     LDA.W $1626,X                   ; Rope waiting flag [$1626]?
$01:DA87 F0 06        BEQ $DA8F                       ; Clear: return
$01:DA89 9E 26 16     STZ.W $1626,X                   ; Clear the waiting flag
$01:DA8C 9E 40 15     STZ.W $1540,X                   ; Clear the line search timer
$01:DA8F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DA90 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (high byte for the add)
$01:DA92 C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; Set N from A
$01:DA94 10 01        BPL $DA97                       ; Positive: high byte 0
$01:DA96 88           DEY                             ; Negative: high byte = $FF
$01:DA97 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:DA98 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } Mario X low += A
$01:DA9A 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$01:DA9C 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:DA9D 65 95        ADC RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; } Mario X high += carry / sign
$01:DA9F 85 95        STA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; /
$01:DAA1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DAA2 A0 18        LDY.B #$18                      ; Platform code: Y = $18 (horizontal offset to the platform's left edge)
$01:DAA4 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Platform type [$1602]
$01:DAA7 F0 02        BEQ $DAAB                       ; Type 0: keep $18
$01:DAA9 A0 28        LDY.B #$28                      ; Type non-zero: Y = $28 (wider platform)
$01:DAAB 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = horizontal offset
$01:DAAD B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:DAAF 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite X low
$01:DAB0 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:DAB1 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Sprite X low -= offset (move to the left edge for drawing)
$01:DAB3 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:DAB5 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:DAB8 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:DAB9 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Same for X high, saving it first
$01:DABB 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:DABE B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:DAC0 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite Y low
$01:DAC1 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:DAC2 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } Sprite Y low -= 8
$01:DAC4 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:DAC6 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:DAC9 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:DACA E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Same for Y high, saving it first
$01:DACC 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:DACF 20 DF B2     JSR.W $B2DF                     ; Draw the platform tiles at the shifted position ($B2DF)
$01:DAD2 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DAD3 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore Y high
$01:DAD6 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DAD7 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore Y low
$01:DAD9 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DADA 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Restore X high
$01:DADD 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DADE 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Restore X low
$01:DAE0 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:DAE2 48           PHA                             ; / Save X low before moving
$01:DAE3 20 4D D7     JSR.W $D74D                     ; Move along the line guide
$01:DAE6 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DAE7 38           SEC                             ; } A = old X - new X
$01:DAE8 F5 E4        SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:DAEA BC 28 15     LDY.W $1528,X                   ; Y = old [$1528]
$01:DAED 5A           PHY                             ; Save it (restored at the end)
$01:DAEE 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:DAF0 1A           INC A                           ; } [$1528] = X movement this frame (new - old), used by Mario's platform carry
$01:DAF1 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; /
$01:DAF4 A0 18        LDY.B #$18                      ; \
$01:DAF6 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:DAF9 F0 02        BEQ $DAFD                       ; } Y = $18 or $28 by platform type
$01:DAFB A0 28        LDY.B #$28                      ; /
$01:DAFD 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = horizontal offset
$01:DAFF B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:DB01 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite X low
$01:DB02 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:DB03 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Sprite X low -= offset
$01:DB05 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
$01:DB07 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:DB0A 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:DB0B E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Same for X high, saving it first
$01:DB0D 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$01:DB10 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:DB12 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite Y low
$01:DB13 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:DB14 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } Sprite Y low -= 8
$01:DB16 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:DB18 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:DB1B 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:DB1C E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Same for Y high, saving it first
$01:DB1E 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:DB21 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; Solid platform contact with Mario ($B457)
$01:DB24 90 0B        BCC $DB31                       ; No contact: skip
$01:DB26 BD 26 16     LDA.W $1626,X                   ; \
$01:DB29 F0 06        BEQ $DB31                       ; / Waiting flag [$1626] set?
$01:DB2B 9E 26 16     STZ.W $1626,X                   ; \
$01:DB2E 9E 40 15     STZ.W $1540,X                   ; / Mario boarded: clear [$1626] and the line search timer [$1540]
$01:DB31 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DB32 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore Y high
$01:DB35 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DB36 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore Y low
$01:DB38 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DB39 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Restore X high
$01:DB3C 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DB3D 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Restore X low
$01:DB3F 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:DB40 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / Restore [$1528]
$01:DB43 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DB44 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; State 2: sprite fell off the end of a line
$01:DB46 D0 11        BNE $DB59                       ; Sprites locked: return
$01:DB48 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Apply speed to position (SubUpdateSprPos)
$01:DB4B BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Search timer [$1540]
$01:DB4E D0 09        BNE $DB59                       ; Still running: return
$01:DB50 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = Y speed
$01:DB52 C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; \
$01:DB54 30 03        BMI $DB59                       ; / Y speed too low (negative result of speed - $20): return
$01:DB56 20 F4 D7     JSR.W $D7F4                     ; Fast enough: look for a line guide again ($D7F4)
$01:DB59 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DB5A..DB5A: Table: grinder X speed by direction ;;;
{
$01:DB5A              .db $18,$E8                     ; Grinder X speed by direction: $18 right, $E8 left

}

;;; $DB5C: Sprite B4: Grinder (not line-guided) (Grinder) ;;;
{
;; Draws the grinder, then (status 8, sprites not locked) plays its sound every 4th frame, hurts Mario on
;;     contact,
;; walks left/right at $18/$E8 with gravity and turns around at walls.
$01:DB5C 20 A2 DB     JSR.W $DBA2                     ; Draw the grinder
$01:DB5F BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status
$01:DB62 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:DB64 D0 2F        BNE $DB95                       ; / Not normal (8): return
$01:DB66 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:DB68 D0 2B        BNE $DB95                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:DB6A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:DB6C 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Every 4th frame...
$01:DB6E D0 05        BNE $DB75                       ; /
$01:DB70 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:DB72 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / ...play the grinder sound (sound effect $04 on port $1DFA)
$01:DB75 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when off-screen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:DB78 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Check contact with Mario (hurts him)
$01:DB7B BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction [$157C]
$01:DB7E B9 5A DB     LDA.W $DB5A,Y                   ; A = X speed for that direction
$01:DB81 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Sprite X speed = A
$01:DB83 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Apply speed to position
$01:DB86 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Is the sprite on the ground?
$01:DB89 F0 02        BEQ $DB8D                       ; No: keep Y speed
$01:DB8B 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; On ground: Y speed = 0
$01:DB8D 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Touching a wall?
$01:DB90 F0 03        BEQ $DB95                       ; No: return
$01:DB92 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Wall hit: turn around (FlipSpriteDir)
$01:DB95 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DB96..DB9E: Table: grinder OAM offsets and properties ;;;
{
$01:DB96              .db $F8,$08,$F8,$08             ; X offsets of the four 16x16 tiles: -8, +8, -8, +8

$01:DB9A              .db $00,$00,$10,$10             ; Y offsets of the four tiles: 0, 0, +16, +16

$01:DB9E              .db $03,$43,$83,$C3             ; Tile properties: palette 1, no flip / X / Y / XY flip

}

;;; $DBA2: Grinder and fuzz ball graphics ;;;
{
;; $01DBA2: draws the grinder as four 16x16 tiles ($6C/$6E animated). $01DBD4: draws the fuzz ball as one
;;     16x16 tile ($C8),
;; shifted up and left by 8. Both end in FinishOAMWriteRt with Y = 2 (16x16).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:DB5C: Sprite B4: Grinder (not line-guided) (Grinder)
$01:DBA2 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get OAM index and screen position ([$00] = X, [$01] = Y)
$01:DBA5 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:DBA6 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: four tiles
$01:DBA8 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:DBAA 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DBAB 7D 96 DB     ADC.W $DB96,X                   ; } Tile X = sprite X + offset
$01:DBAE 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:DBB1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:DBB3 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DBB4 7D 9A DB     ADC.W $DB9A,X                   ; } Tile Y = sprite Y + offset
$01:DBB7 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:DBBA A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:DBBC 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$01:DBBE 09 6C        ORA.B #$6C                      ; } Tile = $6C or $6E, alternating every 2 frames (spinning)
$01:DBC0 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$01:DBC3 BD 9E DB     LDA.W $DB9E,X                   ; \
$01:DBC6 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Tile properties (flips) from the table
$01:DBC9 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:DBCA C8           INY                             ; |
$01:DBCB C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$01:DBCC C8           INY                             ; /
$01:DBCD CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$01:DBCE 10 D8        BPL $DBA8                       ; Loop for the four tiles
$01:DBD0 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: tiles drawn - 1
$01:DBD2 80 2F        BRA $DC03                       ; Finish the OAM write

$01:DBD4 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Fuzz ball: draw one 16x16 tile (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:DBD7 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:DBDA B9 00 03     LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; \
$01:DBDD 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DBDE E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } Tile X -= 8
$01:DBE0 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:DBE3 B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$01:DBE6 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DBE7 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } Tile Y -= 8
$01:DBE9 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:DBEC DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:DBED A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:DBEF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DBF0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DBF1 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } X = (frame counter >> 2) AND 1: animation frame
$01:DBF3 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:DBF4 A9 C8        LDA.B #$C8                      ; \
$01:DBF6 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = $C8
$01:DBF9 BD 09 DC     LDA.W $DC09,X                   ; \
$01:DBFC 05 64        ORA $64                         ; } Properties = table value | sprite properties [$64]
$01:DBFE 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:DC01 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: one tile drawn - 1
$01:DC03 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:DC04 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$01:DC06 4C BB B7     JMP.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish OAM write (A = tiles - 1)


}

;;; $DC09..DC09: Table: fuzz ball tile properties ;;;
{
$01:DC09              .db $05,$45                     ; Fuzz ball properties: palette 2, plus X flip on alternate frames

}

;;; $DC0B: Line-guided grinder graphics ;;;
{
;; Draws the line-guided grinder as four 16x16 tiles ($6C/$6E animated), then shares the finish code at
;;     $01DBD0.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:D9BE: Line guide engine and platform sprites
$01:DC0B 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Line-guided grinder: get draw info
$01:DC0E DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:DC0F A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: four tiles
$01:DC11 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:DC13 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DC14 7D 3B DC     ADC.W $DC3B,X                   ; } Tile X = sprite X + offset
$01:DC17 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:DC1A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:DC1C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DC1D 7D 3F DC     ADC.W $DC3F,X                   ; } Tile Y = sprite Y + offset
$01:DC20 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:DC23 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:DC25 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$01:DC27 09 6C        ORA.B #$6C                      ; } Tile = $6C or $6E, alternating every 2 frames
$01:DC29 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; /
$01:DC2C BD 43 DC     LDA.W $DC43,X                   ; \
$01:DC2F 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Tile properties (flips) from the table
$01:DC32 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:DC33 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:DC34 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$01:DC35 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:DC36 CA           DEX                             ; Next tile
$01:DC37 10 D8        BPL $DC11                       ; Loop for the four tiles
$01:DC39 80 95        BRA $DBD0                       ; Finish with A = 3 (shared code at $01DBD0)


}

;;; $DC3B..DC43: Table: line-guided grinder OAM data ;;;
{
$01:DC3B              .db $F0,$00,$F0,$00             ; X offsets of the four tiles: -16, 0, -16, 0

$01:DC3F              .db $F0,$F0,$00,$00             ; Y offsets of the four tiles: -16, -16, 0, 0

$01:DC43              .db $33,$73,$B3,$F3             ; Tile properties: palette 1, priority 3, flips none / X / Y / XY

}

;;; $DC47: Table: rope motor animation tiles (RopeMotorTiles) ;;;
{
$01:DC47              .db $C0,$C2,$E0,$C2             ; Rope motor animation tiles

}

;;; $DC4B: Rope mechanism graphics and tile table (LineGuideRopeTiles) ;;;
{
;; Rope tile table, then the draw routine at $01DC54: a motor tile on top (animated from RopeMotorTiles) and a
;;     vertical
;; rope of $CE tiles below, ending in a $DE tile. 5 tiles normally, 9 if [$1692] is set and the sprite slot is
;;     6 or higher.
$01:DC4B              .db $C0,$CE,$CE,$CE,$CE,$CE,$CE,$CE ; Rope tiles: motor top ($C0, replaced by animation), then $CE rope pieces
$01:DC53              .db $CE

$01:DC54 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Rope: get draw info
$01:DC57 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:DC59 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DC5A E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } $00 = X - 8
$01:DC5C 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:DC5E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:DC60 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DC61 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } $01 = Y - 8
$01:DC63 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:DC65 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:DC66 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:DC67 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:DC68 45 14        EOR RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$01:DC6A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DC6B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DC6C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DC6D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } $02 = ((index * 4) EOR frame counter) >> 3 AND 3: motor frame
$01:DC6F 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$01:DC71 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; A = 5: rope tile count
$01:DC73 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$01:DC75 90 07        BCC $DC7E                       ; / Sprite slots 0-5: keep 5 tiles
$01:DC77 AC 92 16     LDY.W $1692                     ; \
$01:DC7A F0 02        BEQ $DC7E                       ; / [$1692] (probably sprite memory setting) zero: keep 5
$01:DC7C A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; Otherwise 9 tiles (longer rope)
$01:DC7E 85 03        STA $03                         ; $03 = number of tiles
$01:DC80 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:DC83 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: first tile
$01:DC85 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:DC87 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / Tile X = $00
$01:DC8A A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:DC8C 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / Tile Y = $01
$01:DC8F 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:DC90 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } $01 += $10: next tile 16 pixels lower
$01:DC92 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:DC94 BD 4B DC     LDA.W LineGuideRopeTiles,X      ; A = tile from LineGuideRopeTiles
$01:DC97 E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; \
$01:DC99 D0 07        BNE $DCA2                       ; / First tile only: use the motor animation tile instead
$01:DC9B DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:DC9C A6 02        LDX $02                         ; |
$01:DC9E BD 47 DC     LDA.W RopeMotorTiles,X          ; A = RopeMotorTiles[$02]
$01:DCA1 FA           PLX                             ; /
$01:DCA2 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store the tile number
$01:DCA5 A9 37        LDA.B #$37                      ; \
$01:DCA7 E0 01        CPX.B #$01                      ; } Properties $37 for the first tile (palette 3, priority 3)
$01:DCA9 90 02        BCC $DCAD                       ; /
$01:DCAB A9 31        LDA.B #$31                      ; Rope pieces: properties $31 (palette 0, priority 3)
$01:DCAD 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Store the properties
$01:DCB0 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:DCB1 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:DCB2 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$01:DCB3 C8           INY                             ; /
$01:DCB4 E8           INX                             ; Next tile
$01:DCB5 E4 03        CPX $03                         ; All tiles drawn?
$01:DCB7 D0 CC        BNE $DC85                       ; No: loop
$01:DCB9 A9 DE        LDA.B #$DE                      ; \
$01:DCBB 99 FE 02     STA.W $02FE,Y                   ; / Last tile = $DE (rope end)
$01:DCBE AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:DCC1 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: tiles - 1 (5 tiles)
$01:DCC3 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$01:DCC5 90 07        BCC $DCCE                       ; / Sprite slots 0-5: use 5 tiles
$01:DCC7 AC 92 16     LDY.W $1692                     ; \
$01:DCCA F0 02        BEQ $DCCE                       ; / [$1692] zero: use 5 tiles
$01:DCCC A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8: tiles - 1 (9 tiles)
$01:DCCE 4C 04 DC     JMP.W $DC04                     ; Finish OAM write (size 16x16)


}

;;; $DCD1..DCE9: Table: line segment step counts ;;;
{
;; Indexed by segment number (Map16 tile - $76). Number of steps the sprite takes along the segment ([$1570]).
$01:DCD1              .db $15,$15,$15,$15,$0C,$10,$10,$10 ; Steps per segment, line tile $76-$7D
$01:DCD9              .db $10,$0C,$0C,$10,$10,$10,$10,$0C ; Steps per segment, line tile $7E-$85
$01:DCE1              .db $15,$15,$10,$10,$10,$10,$10,$10 ; Steps per segment, line tile $86-$8D
$01:DCE9              .db $10,$10,$10,$10,$10,$10,$15,$15 ; Steps per segment, line tile $8E-$95
}

;;; $DCF1..DD09: Table: line segment slope type ;;;
{
;; 0 = measure position by X, 1 = by Y from the opposite edge, 2 = by Y. Used to decide the direction of
;;     travel.
$01:DCF1              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$02 ; Slope type, line tile $76-$7D (0 = X, 1 = Y inverted, 2 = Y)
$01:DCF9              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$02,$01,$00,$00 ; Slope type, line tile $7E-$85
$01:DD01              .db $00,$00,$01,$02,$01,$02,$00,$00 ; Slope type, line tile $86-$8D
$01:DD09              .db $00,$00,$02,$02,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Slope type, line tile $8E-$95
}

;;; $DD11..DD49: Table: Y speed when leaving a line ;;;
{
;; 64 entries: 32 segments forward, then 32 backward. Doubled (x4 if negative) when a sprite falls off the
;;     end.
$01:DD11              .db $00,$10,$00,$F0,$F4,$FC,$F0,$10 ; Y speed leaving forward, segments $00-$07
$01:DD19              .db $04,$0C,$0C,$00,$10,$F0,$FC,$F4 ; Y speed leaving forward, segments $08-$0F
$01:DD21              .db $F0,$10,$F0,$10,$F0,$10,$F8,$F8 ; Y speed leaving forward, segments $10-$17
$01:DD29              .db $08,$08,$10,$10,$00,$00,$F0,$10 ; Y speed leaving forward, segments $18-$1F
$01:DD31              .db $10,$00,$F0,$F0,$0C,$04,$10,$F0 ; Y speed leaving backward, segments $00-$07
$01:DD39              .db $00,$F4,$F4,$FC,$F0,$10,$00,$0C ; Y speed leaving backward, segments $08-$0F
$01:DD41              .db $10,$F0,$10,$00,$10,$F0,$08,$08 ; Y speed leaving backward, segments $10-$17
$01:DD49              .db $F8,$F8,$F0,$F0,$00,$00,$10,$F0 ; Y speed leaving backward, segments $18-$1F
}

;;; $DD51..DD89: Table: X speed when leaving a line ;;;
{
;; Same layout as the Y speed table; doubled when the sprite falls off the line end.
$01:DD51              .db $10,$00,$10,$00,$0C,$10,$04,$00 ; X speed leaving forward, segments $00-$07
$01:DD59              .db $10,$0C,$0C,$10,$04,$00,$10,$0C ; X speed leaving forward, segments $08-$0F
$01:DD61              .db $10,$10,$08,$08,$08,$08,$10,$10 ; X speed leaving forward, segments $10-$17
$01:DD69              .db $10,$10,$00,$00,$10,$10,$10,$10 ; X speed leaving forward, segments $18-$1F
$01:DD71              .db $00,$F0,$00,$F0,$F4,$F0,$00,$FC ; X speed leaving backward, segments $00-$07
$01:DD79              .db $F0,$F4,$F4,$F0,$00,$FC,$F0,$F4 ; X speed leaving backward, segments $08-$0F
$01:DD81              .db $F0,$F0,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F0,$F0 ; X speed leaving backward, segments $10-$17
$01:DD89              .db $F0,$F0,$00,$00,$F0,$F0,$F0 ; X speed leaving backward, segments $18-$1F

}

;;; $DD90..DDAA: Table: bonus game sprite start data ;;;
{
;; Start X, Y and direction for the ten bonus game sprite slots (slots 1-9 used).
$01:DD90              .db $F0                         ; X position by slot: slot 0 unused

$01:DD91              .db $50,$78,$A0,$A0,$A0,$78,$50,$50 ; X positions, slots 1-8
$01:DD99              .db $78                         ; X position slot 9; also Y position table slot 0 (unused)

$01:DD9A              .db $F0,$F0,$F0,$18,$40,$40,$40,$18 ; Y positions, slots 1-8
$01:DDA2              .db $18,$03,$00,$00,$01,$01,$02,$02 ; Y position slot 9 ($18); initial [$157C] for slots 1-7 follows
$01:DDAA              .db $03,$FF                     ; Initial [$157C] for slots 8 and 9

}

;;; $DDAC: Sprite 82: Init bonus game (InitBonusGame) ;;;
{
;; First instance spawns nine more copies of sprite $82 in slots 9-1 at positions from the tables, sets their
;;     directions
;; and animation phase, picks a random starting value into [$1579] and sets [$1B94]. Later calls just erase
;;     themselves.
$01:DDAC AD 94 1B     LDA.W $1B94                     ; A = bonus game initialised flag [$1B94]
$01:DDAF F0 04        BEQ $DDB5                       ; Not yet: initialise all ten sprites
$01:DDB1 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Already initialised: remove this duplicate sprite
$01:DDB4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DDB5 A2 09        LDX.B #$09                      ; X = 9: initialise slots 9 down to 1
$01:DDB7 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:DDB9 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:DDBC A9 82        LDA.B #$82                      ; \
$01:DDBE 9D 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,X           ; / Sprite number = $82 (bonus game sprite)
$01:DDC1 BD 90 DD     LDA.W $DD90,X                   ; \
$01:DDC4 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Sprite X low = start position table
$01:DDC6 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:DDC8 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Sprite X high = 0
$01:DDCB BD 99 DD     LDA.W $DD99,X                   ; \
$01:DDCE 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Sprite Y low = start position table
$01:DDD0 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = bit 7 of Y
$01:DDD1 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$01:DDD3 B0 01        BCS $DDD6                       ; Y >= $80: Y high = 0
$01:DDD5 1A           INC A                           ; Y < $80: Y high = 1
$01:DDD6 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Store Y high
$01:DDD9 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize the sprite tables
$01:DDDD BD A2 DD     LDA.W $DDA2,X                   ; A = initial direction/orientation value for this slot
$01:DDE0 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Store in [$157C]
$01:DDE3 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:DDE4 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DDE5 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$01:DDE7 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } [$1570] = (slot + frame counter) AND 7: staggered animation
$01:DDE9 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; /
$01:DDEC CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$01:DDED D0 C8        BNE $DDB7                       ; Loop until X = 0
$01:DDEF 9C 8F 18     STZ.W $188F                     ; Clear $188F
$01:DDF2 9C 90 18     STZ.W $1890                     ; Clear $1890
$01:DDF5 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; Get a random number
$01:DDF9 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:DDFB 65 14        ADC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; |
$01:DDFD 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Y = (random EOR frame counter + frame counter B) AND 7
$01:DDFF A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:DE00 B9 21 DE     LDA.W $DE21,Y                   ; \
$01:DE03 8D 79 15     STA.W $1579                     ; / [$1579] = random starting value from $DE21
$01:DE06 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:DE08 85 CB        STA $CB                         ; / [$CB] = 1
$01:DE0A EE 94 1B     INC.W $1B94                     ; Mark the bonus game as initialised: [$1B94]++
$01:DE0D AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; Restore X = this sprite's index
$01:DE10 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DE11..DE29: Table: bonus game direction data ;;;
{
$01:DE11              .db $10,$00,$F0,$00             ; Bonus game, 4 directions: X step (right, none, left, none)

$01:DE15              .db $00,$10,$00,$F0             ; Bonus game, 4 directions: Y step (none, down, none, up)

$01:DE19              .db $A0,$A0,$50,$50             ; Bonus game, 4 values: $A0,$A0,$50,$50 (probably corner positions)

$01:DE1D              .db $F0,$40,$40,$F0             ; Bonus game, 4 values: $F0,$40,$40,$F0 (probably corner positions)

$01:DE21              .db $01,$01,$01,$04,$04,$04,$07,$07 ; Bonus game random starting values, 8 entries (index AND 7), $01/$04/$07
$01:DE29              .db $07

}

;;; $DE2A: Bonus game block main (BonusGame) ;;;
{
;; Main routine of sprite $82. Nine blocks (slots 1-9) cycle through nine symbols and travel around a
;;     rectangular track.
;; Mario hits one from below to freeze its symbol; when all are hit, lines of three equal symbols are counted.
;; Slot 1 also pays out rewards ($E26A). Blocks move one 8x8 grid step per corner, turning 90 degrees
;;     each time.
$01:DE2A 9E A0 15     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Clear this block's off-screen-horizontal flag
$01:DE2D E0 01        CPX.B #$01                      ; \
$01:DE2F D0 03        BNE $DE34                       ; / Only the block in sprite slot 1 does the per-frame bonus game work
$01:DE31 20 6A E2     JSR.W $E26A                     ; Count down the match payout and spawn the reward sprite ($E26A)
$01:DE34 20 19 DF     JSR.W $DF19                     ; Draw the block ($DF19)
$01:DE37 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:DE39 D0 05        BNE $DE40                       ; / Return if sprites are locked
$01:DE3B AD 8F 18     LDA.W $188F                     ; \
$01:DE3E F0 01        BEQ $DE41                       ; / [$188F] != 0: game finished, blocks no longer move
$01:DE40 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DE41 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:DE43 D0 47        BNE $DE8C                       ; / Block already hit (state != 0): skip the hit test, just keep moving
$01:DE45 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:DE47 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:DE49 D0 0D        BNE $DE58                       ; / Every 4th frame ...
$01:DE4B FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:DE4E BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; |
$01:DE51 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; |
$01:DE53 D0 03        BNE $DE58                       ; } ... advance the symbol shown on the block: [$1570] = ([$1570] + 1) mod 9
$01:DE55 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; /
$01:DE58 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Check contact between this block and Mario
$01:DE5B 90 2F        BCC $DE8C                       ; No contact: just move
$01:DE5D A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:DE5F 10 2B        BPL $DE8C                       ; / Only counts if Mario is moving up (hitting the block from below)
$01:DE61 A9 F4        LDA.B #$F4                      ; \
$01:DE63 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$01:DE65 F0 02        BEQ $DE69                       ; |
$01:DE67 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; } A = Y offset for the height test: $F4 (small Mario) or 0 (powered up)
$01:DE69 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:DE6A 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:DE6C 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DE6D E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:DE6F C5 80        CMP $80                         ; } Compare block Y (on screen) + offset with Mario's screen Y [$80]
$01:DE71 B0 19        BCS $DE8C                       ; / Mario is not below the block: no hit
$01:DE73 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:DE75 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $10: bounce him back down
$01:DE77 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:DE79 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play hit-block sound (SFX $0B)
$01:DE7C F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Block state = 1 (hit; its symbol is now frozen)
$01:DE7E BC 70 15     LDY.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:DE81 B9 21 DE     LDA.W $DE21,Y                   ; } Round the symbol down to the start of its group of three: 0-2 -> 1, 3-5 -> 4, 6-8 -> 7
$01:DE84 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; /
$01:DE87 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:DE89 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $10: block bounce animation timer
$01:DE8C BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction of travel (0 right, 1 down, 2 left, 3 up)
$01:DE8F 30 1E        BMI $DEAF                       ; Bit 7 set: block does not move
$01:DE91 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:DE93 D9 19 DE     CMP.W $DE19,Y                   ; } Compare X with this direction's corner X ($DE19)
$01:DE96 D0 07        BNE $DE9F                       ; / Not at the corner X: keep moving
$01:DE98 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:DE9A D9 1D DE     CMP.W $DE1D,Y                   ; } Compare Y with this direction's corner Y ($DE1D)
$01:DE9D F0 11        BEQ $DEB0                       ; / At the corner: handle the turn
$01:DE9F B9 11 DE     LDA.W $DE11,Y                   ; \
$01:DEA2 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = $DE11[direction]
$01:DEA4 B9 15 DE     LDA.W $DE15,Y                   ; \
$01:DEA7 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $DE15[direction]
$01:DEA9 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move X by speed
$01:DEAC 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move Y by speed
$01:DEAF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DEB0 A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: check all nine blocks
$01:DEB2 B9 C2 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; \
$01:DEB5 F0 20        BEQ $DED7                       ; / Some block not hit yet: this block just turns to the next direction
$01:DEB7 B9 D8 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; \
$01:DEBA 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DEBB 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:DEBD 29 F8        AND.B #$F8                      ; |
$01:DEBF 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; } Snap block Y to the 8-pixel grid: Y = ([Y] + 4) & $F8
$01:DEC2 B9 E4 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; \
$01:DEC5 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DEC6 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:DEC8 29 F8        AND.B #$F8                      ; |
$01:DECA 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; } Snap block X to the 8-pixel grid: X = ([X] + 4) & $F8
$01:DECD 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:DECE D0 E2        BNE $DEB2                       ; / Next block
$01:DED0 EE 8F 18     INC.W $188F                     ; All nine blocks hit: [$188F]++ (game finished)
$01:DED3 20 D9 DF     JSR.W $DFD9                     ; Count the matching lines of blocks and play the result sound ($DFD9)
$01:DED6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:DED7 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:DEDA 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:DEDB 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Direction = ([direction] + 1) & 3 (turn 90 degrees)
$01:DEDD A8           TAY                             ; \
$01:DEDE 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Store it
$01:DEE1 80 BC        BRA $DE9F                       ; Continue moving in the new direction


}

;;; $DEE3..DF06: Table: bonus block symbol tiles ;;;
{
;; 4 tile numbers per symbol frame (indexed by [$1570] * 4).
$01:DEE3              .db $58                         ; Symbol tile data: 4 8x8 tiles per frame, indexed by [$1570] * 4 (frame 0: tile 1)

$01:DEE4              .db $59                         ; Frame 0: tile 2

$01:DEE5              .db $83                         ; Frame 0: tile 3

$01:DEE6              .db $83,$48,$49,$58,$59,$83,$83,$48 ; Frame 0: tile 4, then frames 1-2 (each frame = TL, TR, BL, BR tile)
$01:DEEE              .db $49,$34,$35,$83,$83,$24,$25,$34 ; Frames 2-4
