$01:DEF6              .db $35,$83,$83,$24,$25,$36,$37,$83 ; Frames 4-6
$01:DEFE              .db $83,$26,$27,$36,$37,$83,$83,$26 ; Frames 6-8
$01:DF06              .db $27                         ; Frame 8: last tile

}

;;; $DF07..DF0F: Table: bonus block palette bits ;;;
{
;; One per symbol frame.
$01:DF07              .db $04,$04,$04,$08,$08,$08,$0A,$0A ; OAM palette bits per symbol frame: frames 0-2 = $04, 3-5 = $08, 6-8 = $0A
$01:DF0F              .db $0A                         ; Frame 8 palette bits

}

;;; $DF10..DF18: Table: bonus block bounce height ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$1540] / 2.
$01:DF10              .db $00,$03,$05,$07,$08,$08,$07,$05 ; Block bounce height, indexed by [$1540] / 2 (rises then falls)
$01:DF18              .db $03                         ; Last bounce height

}

;;; $DF19: Draw bonus game block ;;;
{
;; Draws the symbol as four 8x8 tiles over a 16x16 base tile $E4, with the bounce offset from [$1540] and
;;     blinking when [$154C] is set.
;; Hits OAM slots at +$00 to +$13 of the sprite's OAM index.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:DE34: Bonus game block main (BonusGame)
$01:DF19 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:DF1C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DF1D A8           TAY                             ; } Y = [$1540] / 2: index into the bounce table
$01:DF1E B9 10 DF     LDA.W $DF10,Y                   ; \
$01:DF21 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = bounce height
$01:DF23 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = index into sprite OAM
$01:DF26 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:DF28 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DF29 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } A = block X on screen
$01:DF2B 99 10 03     STA.W $0310,Y                   ; Base tile (OAM slot 5) X
$01:DF2E 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; Symbol tile 1 X
$01:DF31 99 08 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y          ; Symbol tile 3 X
$01:DF34 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:DF35 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / A = X + 8
$01:DF37 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; Symbol tile 2 X
$01:DF3A 99 0C 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispX,Y          ; Symbol tile 4 X
$01:DF3D BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:DF40 18           CLC                             ; / Match flash timer [$154C], carry cleared; zero: skip
$01:DF41 F0 0B        BEQ $DF4E
$01:DF43 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:DF44 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DF45 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DF46 4A           LSR                             ; } A = [$154C] >> 4
$01:DF47 80 04        BRA $DF4D                       ; / Go to the final shift

$01:DF49 18           CLC                             ; Unreachable
$01:DF4A 6D E9 15     ADC.W $15E9                     ; Unreachable
$01:DF4D 4A           LSR                             ; Shift bit 0 of the value into carry (carry = blink: hide the symbol)
$01:DF4E 08           PHP                             ; Remember carry
$01:DF4F B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:DF51 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DF52 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; |
$01:DF54 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:DF55 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } A = block Y - bounce height - screen Y
$01:DF57 99 11 03     STA.W $0311,Y                   ; Base tile (OAM slot 5) Y
$01:DF5A 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry
$01:DF5B B0 0F        BCS $DF6C                       ; Blinking: leave the four symbol tiles' Y unset (hidden)
$01:DF5D 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; Symbol tile 1 Y
$01:DF60 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Symbol tile 2 Y
$01:DF63 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:DF64 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / A = Y + 8
$01:DF66 99 09 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y          ; Symbol tile 3 Y
$01:DF69 99 0D 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4DispY,Y          ; Symbol tile 4 Y
$01:DF6C BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = symbol frame [$1570]
$01:DF6F DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:DF70 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:DF71 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:DF72 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:DF73 AA           TAX                             ; } Keep frame and sprite index on stack, X = frame * 4
$01:DF74 BD E3 DE     LDA.W $DEE3,X                   ; Symbol tile 1 number
$01:DF77 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store it
$01:DF7A BD E4 DE     LDA.W $DEE4,X                   ; Symbol tile 2 number
$01:DF7D 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; Store it
$01:DF80 BD E5 DE     LDA.W $DEE5,X                   ; Symbol tile 3 number
$01:DF83 99 0A 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y               ; Store it
$01:DF86 BD E6 DE     LDA.W $DEE6,X                   ; Symbol tile 4 number
$01:DF89 99 0E 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y               ; Store it
$01:DF8C A9 E4        LDA.B #$E4                      ; \
$01:DF8E 99 12 03     STA.W $0312,Y                   ; / Base tile (OAM slot 5) = $E4, the 16x16 block graphic
$01:DF91 FA           PLX                             ; X = symbol frame
$01:DF92 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:DF94 1D 07 DF     ORA.W $DF07,X                   ; / A = level sprite priority [$64] | palette bits for this frame
$01:DF97 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; Symbol tile 1 properties
$01:DF9A 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; Symbol tile 2 properties
$01:DF9D 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; Symbol tile 3 properties
$01:DFA0 99 0F 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4Prop,Y           ; Symbol tile 4 properties
$01:DFA3 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:DFA5 99 13 03     STA.W $0313,Y                   ; / Base tile properties = same + 1 (second page)
$01:DFA8 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X = sprite index
$01:DFA9 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:DFAA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DFAB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:DFAC A8           TAY                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4: index into the OAM size table
$01:DFAD A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0 (8x8 size)
$01:DFAF 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; Symbol tile 1 size
$01:DFB2 99 61 04     STA.W $0461,Y                   ; Symbol tile 2 size
$01:DFB5 99 62 04     STA.W $0462,Y                   ; Symbol tile 3 size
$01:DFB8 99 63 04     STA.W $0463,Y                   ; Symbol tile 4 size
$01:DFBB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:DFBD 99 64 04     STA.W $0464,Y                   ; / Base tile size = 2 (16x16)
$01:DFC0 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $DFC1..DFD1: Table: bonus game winning lines ;;;
{
;; 8 lines x 3 block positions: 0-7 = ring around the edge, 8 = center.
$01:DFC1              .db $00,$01,$02,$02,$03,$04,$04,$05 ; Lines 0-1 (positions 0-1-2, 2-3-4) and start of line 2 (4-5-6); edge triples around the ring
$01:DFC9              .db $06,$06,$07,$00,$00,$08,$04,$02 ; Rest of line 2 (6), line 3 (6-7-0), 0-8-4, 2-8-6 start (8 = center)
$01:DFD1              .db $08,$06,$03,$08,$07,$01,$08,$05 ; Rest of 3-8-7, then 1-8-5

}

;;; $DFD9: Count bonus game matches ;;;
{
;; For each of 8 lines of three positions, finds the three blocks, and if their symbols are equal counts it in
;;     [$1890] and starts their flash timers.
;; Plays sound $29 if any line matched, else $2A and sets [$14AB] = $58.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:DED3: Bonus game block main (BonusGame)
$01:DFD9 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:DFDB 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = line counter, 7 down to 0
$01:DFDD A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; \
$01:DFDF 86 01        STX $01                         ; / X = $01 = cell counter, 2 down to 0
$01:DFE1 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:DFE3 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:DFE4 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$01:DFE6 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:DFE7 65 01        ADC $01                         ; } Y = line * 3 + cell
$01:DFE9 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into the line table
$01:DFEA B9 C1 DF     LDA.W $DFC1,Y                   ; \
$01:DFED A8           TAY                             ; / Y = block position number from $DFC1
$01:DFEE B9 9A DD     LDA.W $DD9A,Y                   ; \
$01:DFF1 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = Y position of that position ($DD9A)
$01:DFF3 B9 91 DD     LDA.W $DD91,Y                   ; \
$01:DFF6 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = X position of that position ($DD91)
$01:DFF8 A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = 9: search sprite slots 9 down to 1
$01:DFFA B9 D8 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; \
$01:DFFD C5 02        CMP $02                         ; |
$01:DFFF D0 07        BNE $E008                       ; / This block's Y matches? No: try the next one

$01:E001 B9 E4 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; \
$01:E004 C5 03        CMP $03                         ; |
$01:E006 F0 05        BEQ $E00D                       ; / X matches too: found the block at this position
$01:E008 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:E009 C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; |
$01:E00B D0 ED        BNE $DFFA                       ; / Next sprite slot
$01:E00D B9 70 15     LDA.W $1570,Y                   ; \
$01:E010 95 04        STA $04,X                       ; / $04+X = symbol [$1570] of the block at this position
$01:E012 94 07        STY $07,X                       ; $07+X = slot of that block
$01:E014 CA           DEX                             ; \
$01:E015 10 C8        BPL $DFDF                       ; / Next cell of the line
$01:E017 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$01:E019 C5 05        CMP $05                         ; |
$01:E01B D0 18        BNE $E035                       ; / Symbols of cells 0 and 1 differ: no match
$01:E01D C5 06        CMP $06                         ; \
$01:E01F D0 14        BNE $E035                       ; / Symbol of cell 2 differs: no match
$01:E021 EE 90 18     INC.W $1890                     ; Matching line: [$1890]++
$01:E024 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$01:E026 A4 07        LDY $07                         ; / A = $70: flash timer
$01:E028 99 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,Y        ; Flash timer for the first block of the line ([$154C])
$01:E02B A4 08        LDY $08                         ; \
$01:E02D 99 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,Y        ; / Flash timer for the second block
$01:E030 A4 09        LDY $09                         ; \
$01:E032 99 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,Y        ; / Flash timer for the third block
$01:E035 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$01:E037 10 A4        BPL $DFDD                       ; / Next line
$01:E039 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = this sprite index
$01:E03C A0 29        LDY.B #$29                      ; Y = $29: match sound
$01:E03E AD 90 18     LDA.W $1890                     ; \
$01:E041 8D 20 19     STA.W $1920                     ; / [$1920] = [$1890] (number of matching lines)
$01:E044 D0 06        BNE $E04C                       ; Some match: keep sound $29
$01:E046 A9 58        LDA.B #$58                      ; \
$01:E048 8D AB 14     STA.W $14AB                     ; / No match: [$14AB] = $58 (probably a delay before the game ends)
$01:E04B C8           INY                             ; Y = $2A: no-match sound
$01:E04C 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; Play the sound effect
$01:E04F 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $E050: Init Podoboo fireball (InitFireball) ;;;
{
;; Remembers the spawn Y in [$1528]/[$151C], then moves the sprite down 16 pixels at a time until it is in
;;     lava, and picks a launch speed from the depth.
$01:E050 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E052 9D 28 15     STA.W $1528,X                   ; / Remember spawn Y position low: [$1528]
$01:E055 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:E058 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / Remember spawn Y position high: [$151C]
$01:E05B B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E05D 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E05E 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:E060 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Y position += $10 ...
$01:E062 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:E065 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:E067 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / ... (16 bit)
$01:E06A 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks and liquid
$01:E06D BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:E070 F0 E9        BEQ $E05B                       ; / Not in lava yet: move down another 16 pixels
$01:E072 20 E2 E0     JSR.W $E0E2                     ; Pick the launch speed from the depth below the spawn point ($E0E2)
$01:E075 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:E077 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $20: wait before the first jump
$01:E07A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E07B..E08B: Table: Podoboo launch speed by depth ;;;
{
;; Indexed by depth below the spawn point / 16.
$01:E07B              .db $F0,$DC,$D0,$C8,$C0,$B8,$B2,$AC ; Initial jump Y speeds by depth in lava (index = depth / 16)
$01:E083              .db $A6,$A0,$9A,$96,$92,$8C,$88,$84 ; Y speeds, continued
$01:E08B              .db $80,$04,$08,$0C,$10,$14     ; Last entries: positive, used only by unreachable code

}

;;; $E091..E091: Table: Podoboo max fall speed ;;;
{
;; Indexed by sprite state.
$01:E091              .db $70,$20                     ; Max fall speed by state: $70 (state 0), $20 (state 1)

}

;;; $E093: Podoboo and falling flame (Fireballs) ;;;
{
;; Main routine of sprite $33 (Fireball) and $B5 (sinking fireball). State 0: Podoboo that jumps out of lava,
;;     waits $60-$9F frames, repeats.
;; Other state: a flame that swerves left and right on a timer, lands and turns into smoke.
$01:E093 9E D0 15     STZ.W $15D0,X                   ; Clear [$15D0] (waiting flag)
$01:E096 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:E099 F0 0C        BEQ $E0A7                       ; / Waiting timer [$1540] = 0: go act
$01:E09B 9D D0 15     STA.W $15D0,X                   ; [$15D0] = timer (marks the sprite as waiting)
$01:E09E 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:E09F D0 05        BNE $E0A6                       ; / Timer reaches 1: play the jump sound
$01:E0A1 A9 27        LDA.B #$27                      ; \
$01:E0A3 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play fireball jump sound (SFX $27)
$01:E0A6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E0A7 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:E0A9 F0 03        BEQ $E0AE                       ; / Sprites locked: draw only
$01:E0AB 4C 2D E1     JMP.W $E12D                     ; Skip to the draw code

$01:E0AE 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Mario contact check
$01:E0B1 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; \
$01:E0B4 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; / Advance the animation frame twice (fast animation)
$01:E0B7 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:E0BA 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; / A = palette/flip byte with bit 7 (Y flip) cleared
$01:E0BC B4 AA        LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y = Y speed
$01:E0BE 30 08        BMI $E0C8                       ; Rising: keep frame and no flip
$01:E0C0 FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:E0C3 FE 02 16     INC.W $1602,X                   ; / Falling: use the frames 2 higher
$01:E0C6 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; Falling: set Y flip
$01:E0C8 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store the flip bit
$01:E0CB 20 40 91     JSR.W $9140                     ; Interact with blocks and liquid
$01:E0CE BD 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,X                   ; \
$01:E0D1 F0 33        BEQ $E106                       ; / Not in lava: move normally
$01:E0D3 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:E0D5 30 2F        BMI $E106                       ; / Rising: move normally
$01:E0D7 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$01:E0DB 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; |
$01:E0DD 69 60        ADC.B #$60                      ; |
$01:E0DF 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; } Back in lava and falling: [$1540] = $60 + random (0-$3F), wait before the next jump
$01:E0E2 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E0E4 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:E0E5 FD 28 15     SBC.W $1528,X                   ; |
$01:E0E8 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = Y position low - spawn Y low (depth below the spawn point)
$01:E0EA BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:E0ED FD 1C 15     SBC.W $151C,X                   ; / Same for the high byte
$01:E0F0 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:E0F1 66 00        ROR $00                         ; / Depth / 2 (16 bit)
$01:E0F3 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:E0F5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E0F6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E0F7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E0F8 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = depth / 16
$01:E0F9 B9 7B E0     LDA.W $E07B,Y                   ; A = launch speed from the table
$01:E0FC 30 05        BMI $E103                       ; Negative (normal): use it
$01:E0FE 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; Unreachable: [$1564] = timer
$01:E101 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; Unreachable: A = $80
$01:E103 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = launch speed
$01:E105 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E106 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move Y by speed
$01:E109 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E10B 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$01:E10D 15 C2        ORA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; } Every 8th frame, state 0 only ...
$01:E10F D0 04        BNE $E115                       ; / ... skip otherwise
$01:E111 22 DF 85 02  JSL.L $85DF                     ; Spawn a trail particle (minor extended sprite)
$01:E115 BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$01:E118 D0 10        BNE $E12A                       ; / [$1564] != 0: no gravity
$01:E11A B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:E11C 30 07        BMI $E125                       ; / Rising: add gravity
$01:E11E B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:E120 D9 91 E0     CMP.W $E091,Y                   ; |
$01:E123 B0 05        BCS $E12A                       ; / Y = state; falling at max speed already: no gravity
$01:E125 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E126 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; / Y speed += 2 (gravity)
$01:E128 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store Y speed
$01:E12A 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:E12D B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:E12F F0 67        BEQ $E198                       ; / State 0: normal fireball, go draw it with dynamic graphics
$01:E131 A4 9D        LDY RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:E133 D0 2F        BNE $E164                       ; / Sprites locked: skip the physics
$01:E135 BD 88 15     LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; \
$01:E138 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$01:E13A F0 15        BEQ $E151                       ; / Not on the ground: swerve in the air
$01:E13C 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; On the ground: Y speed = 0
$01:E13E BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:E141 F0 07        BEQ $E14A                       ; / Timer [$1558] = 0: start it
$01:E143 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E145 D0 08        BNE $E14F                       ; / Timer not 1: wait
$01:E147 4C CB 9A     JMP.W $9ACB                     ; Timer reaches 1: turn into a spin-killed sprite with smoke ($9ACB)

$01:E14A A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:E14C 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / [$1558] = $80: time to stay on the ground
$01:E14F 80 13        BRA $E164                       ; Skip the swerve

$01:E151 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:E152 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E153 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E154 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E155 65 13        ADC RAM_FrameCounter            ; } A = slot * 4 + frame counter
$01:E157 A0 F0        LDY.B #$F0                      ; Y = $F0 (X speed left)
$01:E159 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; \
$01:E15B F0 02        BEQ $E15F                       ; / Bit 2 clear: keep $F0
$01:E15D A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; Y = $10 (X speed right)
$01:E15F 94 B6        STY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = Y
$01:E161 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move X by speed
$01:E164 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E166 C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:E168 90 03        BCC $E16D                       ; / Y position below $F0: still on screen
$01:E16A 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Free the sprite slot (left the screen)
$01:E16D 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite (2x2 generic routine)
$01:E170 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = index into sprite OAM
$01:E173 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:E174 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E176 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; |
$01:E178 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E179 6D E9 15     ADC.W $15E9                     ; |
$01:E17C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E17D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } A = (([FrameCounterB] & $0C) / 2 + sprite slot) / 2 & 3: flame animation index
$01:E17F AA           TAX                             ; X = index
$01:E180 BD 90 E1     LDA.W BowserFlameTiles,X        ; \
$01:E183 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = flame tile from BowserFlameTiles
$01:E186 BD 94 E1     LDA.W $E194,X                   ; \
$01:E189 05 64        ORA $64                         ; |
$01:E18B 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Properties = $E194 | level priority [$64]
$01:E18E FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:E18F 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E190: Flame draw and Podoboo graphics setup (BowserFlameTiles) ;;;
{
;; $01E190: tile table for the flame. $01E198 (state 0): draws the Podoboo and sets the dynamic graphics
;;     source addresses $0D8B/$0D95.
$01:E190              .db $2A,$2C,$2A,$2C             ; Flame tile numbers

$01:E194              .db $05,$05,$45,$45             ; Flame properties (palette 2, X flip for the last two)

$01:E198 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E19A 20 F3 9C     JSR.W SubSprGfx0Entry0          ; / Draw the fireball with the single-tile routine
$01:E19D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:E19F A9 08 00     LDA.W #$0008                    ; \
$01:E1A2 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E1A3 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E1A4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E1A5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E1A6 0A           ASL                             ; } A = $0008 << 5 = $0100
$01:E1A7 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E1A8 69 00 85     ADC.W #$8500                    ; / A += $8500
$01:E1AB 8D 8B 0D     STA.W $0D8B                     ; Dynamic graphics source (top half): $0D8B = $8600
$01:E1AE 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E1AF 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; / A += $0200
$01:E1B2 8D 95 0D     STA.W $0D95                     ; Dynamic graphics source (bottom half): $0D95 = $8800
$01:E1B5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:E1B7 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $E1B8: Init keyhole (InitKeyHole) ;;;
{
;; Moves the sprite 8 pixels right.
$01:E1B8 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:E1BA 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E1BB 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:E1BD 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } Sprite X position += 8 (center the keyhole)
$01:E1BF BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:E1C2 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; / Carry into the high byte
$01:E1C4 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Store it
$01:E1C7 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $E1C8: Keyhole main (Keyhole) ;;;
{
;; Finds the key sprite ($80) and checks contact between it (or Mario when on Yoshi) and the keyhole. On
;;     contact starts the keyhole exit: timer [$1434], music change, sprites locked, position saved.
;; Draws the keyhole as two 8x8 tiles.
$01:E1C8 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: search all sprite slots
$01:E1CA B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:E1CD C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / Status below 8 (not active): next slot
$01:E1CF 90 07        BCC $E1D8                       ; Skip it
$01:E1D1 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:E1D4 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; |
$01:E1D6 F0 03        BEQ $E1DB                       ; / Sprite number $80 (key)? Found
$01:E1D8 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:E1D9 10 EF        BPL $E1CA                       ; / Next slot
$01:E1DB AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:E1DE F0 05        BEQ $E1E5                       ; / Not on Yoshi: use the key sprite
$01:E1E0 AD 1C 19     LDA.W $191C                     ; \
$01:E1E3 D0 08        BNE $E1ED                       ; / On Yoshi, and [$191C] != 0 (probably Yoshi holds the key): use Mario's hitbox
$01:E1E5 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E1E6 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / [$151C] = key slot ($FF if none)
$01:E1E9 30 4F        BMI $E23A                       ; No key: just draw
$01:E1EB 80 06        BRA $E1F3                       ; Go check the key

$01:E1ED 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario's hitbox
$01:E1F1 80 0E        BRA $E201                       ; Go test contact

$01:E1F3 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:E1F6 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; |
$01:E1F8 D0 40        BNE $E23A                       ; / Key not being carried (status $0B): just draw
$01:E1FA DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:E1FB BB           TYX                             ; |
$01:E1FC 22 E5 B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB        ; |
$01:E200 FA           PLX                             ; } Get the key's hitbox (as sprite B)
$01:E201 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get this keyhole's hitbox
$01:E205 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check for contact
$01:E209 90 2F        BCC $E23A                       ; No contact: draw
$01:E20B BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:E20E D0 2A        BNE $E23A                       ; / Already triggered ([$154C] != 0): draw
$01:E210 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:E212 8D 34 14     STA.W $1434                     ; / [$1434] = $30: keyhole exit animation timer
$01:E215 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E217 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Change music ([$1DFB] = $10)
$01:E21A EE FB 13     INC.W $13FB                     ; [$13FB]++ (freeze Mario for the keyhole exit)
$01:E21D E6 9D        INC RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites
$01:E21F BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:E222 8D 37 14     STA.W $1437                     ; / Keyhole X high -> [$1437]
$01:E225 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:E227 8D 36 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; / Keyhole X low -> [RAM_KeyHolePos1]
$01:E22A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:E22D 8D 39 14     STA.W $1439                     ; / Keyhole Y high -> [$1439]
$01:E230 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E232 8D 38 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; / Keyhole Y low -> [RAM_KeyHolePos2]
$01:E235 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:E237 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / [$154C] = $30
$01:E23A 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get drawing position
$01:E23D A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:E23F 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / Top tile X
$01:E242 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; Bottom tile X
$01:E245 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:E247 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; / Top tile Y
$01:E24A 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E24B 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; / A = Y + 8
$01:E24D 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; Bottom tile Y
$01:E250 A9 EB        LDA.B #$EB                      ; \
$01:E252 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Top tile = $EB
$01:E255 A9 FB        LDA.B #$FB                      ; \
$01:E257 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; / Bottom tile = $FB
$01:E25A A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:E25C 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Properties = $30 (top priority)
$01:E25F 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; Bottom tile properties
$01:E262 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$01:E264 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: two tiles
$01:E266 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish the OAM write
$01:E269 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E26A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:E26C 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; |
$01:E26E D0 0B        BNE $E27B                       ; / Every 64th frame ...
$01:E270 AD 90 18     LDA.W $1890                     ; \
$01:E273 F0 06        BEQ $E27B                       ; / ... if [$1890] (matching lines to pay out) != 0 ...
$01:E275 CE 90 18     DEC.W $1890                     ; ... decrement it
$01:E278 20 81 E2     JSR.W $E281                     ; ... and spawn one reward (extended sprite)
$01:E27B A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E27D 8D B8 18     STA.W $18B8                     ; / [$18B8] = 1 (probably tells the sprite spawner the bonus game is active)
$01:E280 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E281 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Y = 7: search for a free extended sprite slot
$01:E283 B9 92 18     LDA.W $1892,Y                   ; \
$01:E286 F0 04        BEQ $E28C                       ; / Free slot found
$01:E288 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:E289 10 F8        BPL $E283                       ; / Next slot
$01:E28B 60           RTS                             ; Return (no free slot)

$01:E28C A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E28E 99 92 18     STA.W $1892,Y                   ; / Extended sprite number = 1
$01:E291 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:E293 99 02 1E     STA.W $1E02,Y                   ; / Extended sprite Y position low = 0
$01:E296 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E298 99 2A 1E     STA.W $1E2A,Y                   ; / Extended sprite X position low = 1
$01:E29B A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$01:E29D 99 16 1E     STA.W $1E16,Y                   ; / Extended sprite ($1E16) = $18
$01:E2A0 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:E2A2 99 3E 1E     STA.W $1E3E,Y                   ; / Extended sprite ($1E3E) = 0
$01:E2A5 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E2A7 99 66 1E     STA.W $1E66,Y                   ; / Extended sprite ($1E66) = 1
$01:E2AA A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E2AC 99 52 1E     STA.W $1E52,Y                   ; / Extended sprite timer ($1E52) = $10
$01:E2AF 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E2B0..E2C8: Unused data ;;;
{
;; $FF padding and values $13-$19.
$01:E2B0              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Unused, $FF padding
$01:E2B8              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Unused, $FF padding
$01:E2C0              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Unused, $FF padding
$01:E2C8              .db $13,$14,$15,$16,$17,$18,$19 ; Unused values $13-$19

}

;;; $E2CF: Monty Mole main (MontyMole) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $4D and $4E. State dispatch: 0 wait underground, 1 pop out, 2 in air, 3 walk/hop toward Mario.
$01:E2CF 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:E2D2 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:E2D4 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the state routine

}

;;; $E2D8: Monty Mole states and routines (Ptrs01E2D8) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table, then state 0 and 1 code (wait until Mario is near; spawn dirt and the mole hole).
$01:E2D8 E0 E2        .dw $E2E0                       ; State 0: wait underground
$01:E2DA 09 E3        .dw $E309                       ; State 1: pop out of the ground
$01:E2DC 7F E3        .dw $E37F                       ; State 2: in the air
$01:E2DE 93 E3        .dw $E393                       ; State 3: walking and chasing Mario

$01:E2E0 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; \
$01:E2E3 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; / $0F = horizontal distance to Mario
$01:E2E5 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E2E6 69 60        ADC.B #$60                      ; / A = distance + $60
$01:E2E8 C9 C0        CMP.B #$C0                      ; \
$01:E2EA B0 19        BCS $E305                       ; / Farther than $60 pixels: keep waiting
$01:E2EC BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$01:E2EF D0 14        BNE $E305                       ; / Off-screen: keep waiting
$01:E2F1 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 1
$01:E2F3 AC B3 0D     LDY.W $0DB3                     ; \
$01:E2F6 B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; / A = current submap of the player ([$1F11] indexed by player)
$01:E2F9 A8           TAY                             ; Y = submap
$01:E2FA A9 68        LDA.B #$68                      ; A = $68
$01:E2FC C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E2FE F0 02        BEQ $E302                       ; / Submap 1: keep $68
$01:E300 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Otherwise A = $20
$01:E302 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; [$1540] = time to wait before popping out
$01:E305 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get drawing position (draws nothing)
$01:E308 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E309 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:E30C 1D D0 15     ORA.W $15D0,X                   ; / Wait while [$1540] or [$15D0] is non-zero
$01:E30F D0 32        BNE $E343                       ; Still waiting: draw the dirt
$01:E311 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 2
$01:E313 A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; \
$01:E315 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $B0: jump out of the ground
$01:E317 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Off-screen?
$01:E31A D0 04        BNE $E320                       ; Yes: skip the dirt particles
$01:E31C A8           TAY                             ; Y = 0
$01:E31D 20 E1 99     JSR.W $99E1                     ; Spawn dirt particles ($99E1)
$01:E320 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:E323 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:E325 C9 4E        CMP.B #$4E                      ; / Sprite $4E (ledge Monty Mole)?
$01:E327 D0 1A        BNE $E343                       ; No: skip
$01:E329 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:E32B 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$01:E32D BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:E330 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; } Block X = sprite X (for block creation)
$01:E332 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E334 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$01:E336 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:E339 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; } Block Y = sprite Y (for block creation)
$01:E33B A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:E33D 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; / Block to generate = $08 (mole hole)
$01:E33F 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; Generate the block
$01:E343 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:E345 C9 4D        CMP.B #$4D                      ; / Sprite $4D (ground Monty Mole)?
$01:E347 D0 1A        BNE $E363                       ; No: draw the other mole
$01:E349 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E34B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E34C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E34D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E34E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E34F 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:E351 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = ([FrameCounterB] >> 4) & 1: slow alternate
$01:E352 B9 5F E3     LDA.W $E35F,Y                   ; \
$01:E355 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame = $E35F[Y]
$01:E358 B9 61 E3     LDA.W $E361,Y                   ; A = $E361[Y]
$01:E35B 20 F3 9C     JSR.W SubSprGfx0Entry0          ; Draw with the single-tile routine (dirt mound)
$01:E35E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E35F..E361: Table: dirt mound frames ;;;
{
$01:E35F              .db $01,$02                     ; Animation frames for the dirt mound

$01:E361              .db $00,$05                     ; Parameter for the draw routine

}

;;; $E363: Draw shaking Monty Mole ;;;
{
;; State 1 for sprite $4E: frame 3 with random flip bits.
$01:E363 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E365 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E366 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E367 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; |
$01:E369 09 31        ORA.B #$31                      ; } Properties = $31 | random X/Y flip bits from the frame counter (shaking)
$01:E36B 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store
$01:E36E A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:E370 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame 3
$01:E373 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite
$01:E376 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:E379 29 3F        AND.B #$3F                      ; |
$01:E37B 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Clear the flip bits again
$01:E37E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E37F 20 EF E3     JSR.W $E3EF                     ; Move, interact and draw ($E3EF)
$01:E382 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:E384 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame 2 (in the air)
$01:E387 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:E38A F0 02        BEQ $E38E                       ; No: stay in this state
$01:E38C F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Landed: state = 3
$01:E38E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E38F..E391: Table: Monty Mole speeds ;;;
{
;; Hop speeds and max walk speeds.
$01:E38F              .db $10,$F0                     ; Hop X speeds by direction

$01:E391              .db $18,$E8                     ; Max walk X speeds by direction

}

;;; $E393: Monty Mole states 2 and 3 ;;;
{
;; State 2: in the air. State 3: walk toward Mario or hop after him. Includes the common move/draw routine
;;     $E3EF.
$01:E393 20 EF E3     JSR.W $E3EF                     ; Move, interact and draw ($E3EF)
$01:E396 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:E399 D0 2C        BNE $E3C7                       ; / [$151C] != 0: hop-chase mode
$01:E39B 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; \
$01:E39E 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; / Advance the animation frame twice
$01:E3A1 22 F9 AC 01  JSL.L GetRand                   ; \
$01:E3A5 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; / Random bit
$01:E3A7 D0 1D        BNE $E3C6                       ; / Half the time do nothing
$01:E3A9 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:E3AC B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:E3AE D9 91 E3     CMP.W $E391,Y                   ; / Already at the max speed toward Mario?
$01:E3B1 F0 13        BEQ $E3C6                       ; Yes: return
$01:E3B3 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E3B4 79 B4 EB     ADC.W $EBB4,Y                   ; / X speed += acceleration ($EBB4)
$01:E3B7 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store
$01:E3B9 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E3BA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E3BB 6A           ROR                             ; |
$01:E3BC 55 B6        EOR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } A = direction sign XOR X speed
$01:E3BE 10 06        BPL $E3C6                       ; Not changing direction: return
$01:E3C0 20 4E 80     JSR.W $804E                     ; Turning around: kick up dust ($804E)
$01:E3C3 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Advance the animation frame
$01:E3C6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E3C7 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:E3CA F0 1D        BEQ $E3E9                       ; / In the air: show the jump frame
$01:E3CC 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; \
$01:E3CF 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; / Advance the animation frame twice
$01:E3D2 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = direction
$01:E3D5 B9 8F E3     LDA.W $E38F,Y                   ; \
$01:E3D8 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = hop speed for that direction
$01:E3DA BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:E3DD D0 09        BNE $E3E8                       ; / Jump delay running: return
$01:E3DF A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$01:E3E1 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / [$1558] = $50: delay before the next hop
$01:E3E4 A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:E3E6 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $D8: hop
$01:E3E8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E3E9 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E3EB 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame 1
$01:E3EE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E3EF A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:E3F1 48           PHA                             ; / Save the level sprite priority [$64]
$01:E3F2 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:E3F5 F0 04        BEQ $E3FB                       ; / [$1540] = 0: draw normally
$01:E3F7 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E3F9 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Emerging: priority $10 (draw behind the layer)
$01:E3FB 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite
$01:E3FE 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:E3FF 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore the priority
$01:E401 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:E403 D0 17        BNE $E41C                       ; / Sprites locked: skip the rest and return from the caller too
$01:E405 20 C1 8F     JSR.W SubSprSpr+MarioSpr        ; Sprite-to-sprite and Mario contact
$01:E408 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update position with gravity
$01:E40B 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; \
$01:E40E F0 03        BEQ $E413                       ; / In the air: skip
$01:E410 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; On the ground: reset the Y speed
$01:E413 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; \
$01:E416 F0 03        BEQ $E41B                       ; / Not touching a wall: return
$01:E418 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Flip direction
$01:E41B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E41C 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:E41D 68           PLA                             ; / Drop the return address
$01:E41E 60           RTS                             ; Return to the caller of the caller


}

;;; $E41F..E427: Data for Dry Bones code ;;;
{
$01:E41F              .db $08,$F8,$02,$03,$04,$04,$04,$04 ; Data for Dry Bones and Bony Beetle code (X speeds $08,$F8, others unknown)
$01:E427              .db $04,$04,$04,$04             ; Data, continued

}

;;; $E42B: Dry Bones and Bony Beetle main (DryBonesAndBeetle) ;;;
{
;; Sprites $30-$32. If not status 8, flips the sprite upside down and jumps to the dead sprite code at
;;     $E5BF.
$01:E42B BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:E42E C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / Status 8 (normal)?
$01:E430 F0 0C        BEQ $E43E                       ; Yes: run the normal code
$01:E432 1E F6 15     ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:E435 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:E436 7E F6 15     ROR.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / Set bit 7 of the palette/flip byte (flip upside down)
$01:E439 4C BF E5     JMP.W $E5BF                     ; Go to the dead sprite code


}

;;; $E43C..E43C: Table: Dry Bones X speeds ;;;
{
;; $08, $F8.
$01:E43C              .db $08,$F8                     ; Data: X speeds $08,$F8

}

;;; $E43E: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt ;;;
{
;; Second half of the Dry Bones / Bony Beetle main routine (sprites $30, $31, $32). [$1534] = collapsed flag.
;; Collapsed: draws a bone pile of two tiles, shakes during the last $40 frames, then stands up when [$1540]
;;     runs out.
;; Walking: speed from $E41F, slope adjusted; $31 (Bony Beetle) cycles a spike phase using [$1540]; $30
;;     and $32 (in translevel $31) throw bones.
;; $E5C4: stomping collapses the sprite ([$1534]++, [$1540] = $FF) unless the beetle has spikes out,
;;     which hurts Mario.
$01:E43E BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534] (collapsed flag) = 0: walking, go to $01E4C0
$01:E441 F0 7D        BEQ $E4C0
$01:E443 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Collapsed: draw the first tile (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:E446 BC 40 15     LDY.W $1540,X                   ; Y = [$1540] (reassemble timer)
$01:E449 D0 08        BNE $E453                       ; Timer still running: stay collapsed
$01:E44B 9E 34 15     STZ.W $1534,X                   ; Timer expired: [$1534] = 0, sprite stands up again
$01:E44E 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:E44F 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Turn to face Mario
$01:E452 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:E453 A9 48        LDA.B #$48                      ; A = tile $48 (bone pile, default)
$01:E455 C0 10        CPY.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E457 90 06        BCC $E45F                       ; |
$01:E459 C0 F0        CPY.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:E45B B0 02        BCS $E45F                       ; } A = tile $2E while the timer is $10-$EF, else $48 (reassembling)
$01:E45D A9 2E        LDA.B #$2E                      ; /
$01:E45F BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of this sprite
$01:E462 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; First tile = A
$01:E465 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E466 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E467 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } Advance the sprite's OAM index by 4 (a second tile follows)
$01:E469 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$01:E46C DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:E46D BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; A = sprite direction
$01:E470 AA           TAX                             ; X = direction (0 right, 1 left)
$01:E471 B9 00 03     LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; A = first tile X position
$01:E474 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E475 7D 3C E4     ADC.W $E43C,X                   ; / Second tile X = first + [$E43C + dir] (+8 or -8)
$01:E478 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:E479 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; Store second tile X
$01:E47C B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$01:E47F 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; / Second tile Y = first tile Y
$01:E482 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$01:E485 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; / Second tile properties = first tile properties
$01:E488 B9 02 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$01:E48B 3A           DEC A                           ; } Second tile number = first tile number - 1
$01:E48C 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; /
$01:E48F BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540] (reassemble timer)
$01:E492 F0 18        BEQ $E4AC                       ; Zero: no shaking
$01:E494 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; Timer >= $40: no shaking
$01:E496 B0 14        BCS $E4AC                       ; \
$01:E498 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E499 4A           LSR                             ; } Carry = bit 1 of timer / 4: shake bit, flips every 8 frames; save it
$01:E49A 08           PHP                             ; /
$01:E49B B9 00 03     LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; \
$01:E49E 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } First tile X += shake carry
$01:E4A0 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:E4A3 28           PLP                             ; Restore the shake carry
$01:E4A4 B9 04 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; \
$01:E4A7 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Second tile X += shake carry
$01:E4A9 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$01:E4AC A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = $02: tiles are 16x16
$01:E4AE A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: two tiles
$01:E4B0 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish OAM write (FinishOAMWriteRt)
$01:E4B3 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position with gravity
$01:E4B6 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Sprite on the ground?
$01:E4B9 F0 04        BEQ $E4BF                       ; No: return
$01:E4BB 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:E4BD 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / On ground: X speed = Y speed = 0 (the pile does not slide)
$01:E4BF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E4C0 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Walking state: A = sprites locked flag
$01:E4C2 1D 3E 16     ORA.W $163E,X                   ; OR with [$163E] (some timer, nonzero skips movement)
$01:E4C5 F0 03        BEQ $E4CA                       ; Both zero: do normal movement
$01:E4C7 4C B6 E5     JMP.W $E5B6                     ; Locked: skip to interaction/graphics ($01E5B6)

$01:E4CA BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = sprite direction
$01:E4CD B9 1F E4     LDA.W $E41F,Y                   ; A = walking speed for this direction ($E41F: +8 / -8)
$01:E4D0 5D B8 15     EOR.W $15B8,X                   ; EOR with slope speed [$15B8]
$01:E4D3 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = 1 if signs differ
$01:E4D4 B9 1F E4     LDA.W $E41F,Y                   ; Reload walking speed
$01:E4D7 90 04        BCC $E4DD                       ; Signs match: use speed as is
$01:E4D9 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E4DA 7D B8 15     ADC.W $15B8,X                   ; / Signs differ: speed += slope speed [$15B8]
$01:E4DD 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Store as X speed
$01:E4DF BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540]
$01:E4E2 D0 09        BNE $E4ED                       ; Timer running (throwing or spiked): stop walking
$01:E4E4 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E4E5 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:E4E6 3D 88 15     AND.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X        ; |
$01:E4E9 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Zero X speed if blocked by an object on the side it walks toward (dir+1 & [$1588])
$01:E4EB F0 02        BEQ $E4EF                       ; /
$01:E4ED 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:E4EF 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; Hit ceiling?
$01:E4F2 F0 02        BEQ $E4F6                       ; No: skip
$01:E4F4 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$01:E4F6 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn check when far offscreen
$01:E4F9 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position with gravity
$01:E4FC B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:E4FE C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; $31 = Bony Beetle?
$01:E500 D0 1C        BNE $E51E                       ; No: Dry Bones
$01:E502 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Beetle: A = [$1540] (spike phase timer)
$01:E505 F0 3B        BEQ $E542                       ; Zero: normal walking animation
$01:E507 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = animation frame 0
$01:E509 C9 70        CMP.B #$70                      ; Timer >= $70: frame 0
$01:E50B B0 0B        BCS $E518
$01:E50D C8           INY                             ; \
$01:E50E C8           INY                             ; / Y = 2
$01:E50F C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Timer < $08: frame 2
$01:E511 90 05        BCC $E518
$01:E513 C9 68        CMP.B #$68                      ; Timer >= $68: frame 2
$01:E515 B0 01        BCS $E518
$01:E517 C8           INY                             ; Timer $08-$67: frame 3 (spikes out, can hurt Mario)
$01:E518 98           TYA                             ; A = frame
$01:E519 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store animation frame in [$1602]
$01:E51C 80 45        BRA $E563                       ; Skip the walking animation

$01:E51E C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; $30 = Dry Bones that throws bones?
$01:E520 F0 0B        BEQ $E52D                       ; Yes: go to the throw check
$01:E522 C9 32        CMP.B #$32                      ; $32 = Dry Bones that stays on ledges?
$01:E524 D0 1C        BNE $E542                       ; No: normal walk animation
$01:E526 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; A = [$13BF] (translevel number)
$01:E529 C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; Only in translevel $31 does sprite $32 throw bones (probably a special case)
$01:E52B D0 15        BNE $E542                       ; Other levels: normal walk animation
$01:E52D BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540] (throw timer)
$01:E530 F0 10        BEQ $E542                       ; Zero: walk
$01:E532 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1: moment of the throw
$01:E534 D0 04        BNE $E53A                       ; Not 1: just pose
$01:E536 22 4E C4 03  JSL.L $C44E                     ; Spawn the thrown bone ($C44E, probably)
$01:E53A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Frame 2 = throwing pose
$01:E53C 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store frame in [$1602]
$01:E53F 4C B6 E5     JMP.W $E5B6                     ; Skip walking, go to interaction/graphics

$01:E542 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Sprite on the ground?
$01:E545 F0 1C        BEQ $E563                       ; No: in the air
$01:E547 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Ground: set Y speed (landing)
$01:E54A 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate the walk frame
$01:E54D B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:E54F C9 32        CMP.B #$32                      ; $32 (stays on ledge)?
$01:E551 D0 04        BNE $E557                       ; No
$01:E553 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; $32: [state] = 0 (may turn around at a ledge again)
$01:E555 80 0A        BRA $E561                       ; Continue

$01:E557 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = [$1570] (walk counter)
$01:E55A 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; \
$01:E55C D0 03        BNE $E561                       ; / Every 128 frames of walking...
$01:E55E 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; ...turn to face Mario
$01:E561 80 18        BRA $E57B                       ; Continue to the periodic timers

$01:E563 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; In air: walk counter [$1570] = 0
$01:E566 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:E568 C9 32        CMP.B #$32                      ; $32 (stays on ledge)?
$01:E56A D0 0F        BNE $E57B                       ; No: continue
$01:E56C B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; [state] = 0?
$01:E56E D0 0B        BNE $E57B                       ; Already turned: continue
$01:E570 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; [state] = 1: only turn around once per ledge
$01:E572 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Flip direction
$01:E575 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move back in X (undo the step off the ledge)
$01:E578 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move back in X again
$01:E57B B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:E57D C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; $31 Bony Beetle?
$01:E57F D0 17        BNE $E598                       ; No
$01:E581 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$01:E583 4A           LSR                             ; Carry = odd frame
$01:E584 90 03        BCC $E589                       ; Even: skip
$01:E586 FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Odd frame: [$1528]++ (phase counter)
$01:E589 BD 28 15     LDA.W $1528,X                   ; A = [$1528]
$01:E58C D0 28        BNE $E5B6                       ; Not wrapped to 0: go on
$01:E58E FE 28 15     INC.W $1528,X                   ; Wrapped: [$1528] = 1
$01:E591 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$01:E593 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Start the spike phase: [$1540] = $A0
$01:E596 80 1E        BRA $E5B6                       ; Go to interaction/graphics

$01:E598 C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; $30 Dry Bones?
$01:E59A F0 0B        BEQ $E5A7                       ; Yes: bone-throw timer
$01:E59C C9 32        CMP.B #$32                      ; $32 Dry Bones?
$01:E59E D0 16        BNE $E5B6                       ; No: done
$01:E5A0 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; A = [$13BF] (translevel number)
$01:E5A3 C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; Only translevel $31
$01:E5A5 D0 0F        BNE $E5B6                       ; Other level: done
$01:E5A7 BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; A = [$1570] (walk counter)
$01:E5AA 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E5AB 69 40        ADC.B #$40                      ; |
$01:E5AD 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; } Every 128 frames (counter + $40 = 0 mod $80)...
$01:E5AF D0 05        BNE $E5B6                       ; /
$01:E5B1 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; \
$01:E5B3 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / ...start a bone throw: [$1540] = $3F
$01:E5B6 20 C4 E5     JSR.W $E5C4                     ; Check contact with Mario ($E5C4)
$01:E5B9 20 0D A4     JSR.W SubSprSprInteract         ; Sprite-to-sprite interaction
$01:E5BC 20 89 90     JSR.W FlipIfTouchingObj         ; Flip direction when touching an object
$01:E5BF 22 90 C3 03  JSL.L $C390                     ; Draw Dry Bones / Bony Beetle ($C390)
$01:E5C3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E5C4 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Test contact with Mario
$01:E5C7 90 47        BCC $E610                       ; No contact: return
$01:E5C9 A5 D3        LDA $D3                         ; \
$01:E5CB 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E5CC 69 14        ADC.B #$14                      ; |
$01:E5CE D5 D8        CMP RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; } If Mario's Y + $14 >= sprite Y (Mario not above it): hurt Mario
$01:E5D0 10 32        BPL $E604                       ; /
$01:E5D2 AD 97 16     LDA.W $1697                     ; A = [$1697] (consecutive enemies stomped counter)
$01:E5D5 D0 04        BNE $E5DB                       ; Nonzero: allow stomp
$01:E5D7 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$01:E5D9 30 29        BMI $E604                       ; Moving up: hurt Mario
$01:E5DB B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:E5DD C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; $31 Bony Beetle?
$01:E5DF D0 0A        BNE $E5EB                       ; No: stomp works
$01:E5E1 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:E5E4 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:E5E5 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:E5E7 C9 60        CMP.B #$60                      ; } Beetle with spikes out ([$1540] - 8 < $60): hurt Mario instead
$01:E5E9 90 19        BCC $E604                       ; /
$01:E5EB 20 46 AB     JSR.W $AB46                     ; Award points / bounce ($AB46)
$01:E5EE 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Show contact star (DisplayContactGfx)
$01:E5F2 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:E5F4 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 7 ($1DF9)
$01:E5F7 22 33 AA 01  JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed           ; Bounce Mario off the sprite (BoostMarioSpeed)
$01:E5FB FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534]++: sprite collapses into a bone pile
$01:E5FE A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:E600 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / [$1540] = $FF: stay collapsed for $FF frames
$01:E603 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E604 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario
$01:E608 AD 97 14     LDA.W $1497                     ; A = [$1497] (Mario invincibility timer)
$01:E60B D0 03        BNE $E610                       ; Invincible: return
$01:E60D 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Turn to face Mario
$01:E610 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E611..E619: Table: springboard animation frames ;;;
{
;; Frame number written to [$1602] indexed by [$1540]/2.
$01:E611              .db $00,$01,$02,$02,$02,$01,$01,$00 ; Springboard animation frame by [$1540]/2 (0 = up, 1 = mid, 2 = fully compressed)
$01:E619              .db $00                         ; (last entry)

}

;;; $E61A..E622: Table: springboard Mario Y offsets ;;;
{
;; Mario's Y offset from the sprite indexed by [$1540]/2; +$12 added on Yoshi.
$01:E61A              .db $1E,$1B,$18,$18,$18,$1A,$1C,$1D ; Springboard: Mario's Y offset above the board by [$1540]/2 ($1E = top, $18 = pressed)
$01:E622              .db $1E                         ; (last entry)

}

;;; $E623: Portable springboard main routine (SpringBoard) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $2F. Physics (gravity, friction, wall bounce) like other carryable sprites.
;; [$1540] is the bounce timer (starts at $11 when Mario lands): Mario is held on top, then launched with Y
;;     speed $B0 or, with A/B held, $80 (spin jump if A).
;; Not bouncing: Mario can stand on it, or pick it up with X/Y (status $0B). Always ends by drawing two tiles
;;     via SubSprGfx0Entry1. $01E6F0 is also the entry used while stunned/carried.
$01:E623 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$01:E625 F0 03        BEQ $E62A                       ; Not locked: run physics
$01:E627 4C F0 E6     JMP.W $E6F0                     ; Locked: just draw

$01:E62A 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn check when far offscreen
$01:E62D 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position with gravity
$01:E630 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; On the ground?
$01:E633 F0 03        BEQ $E638                       ; No: skip
$01:E635 20 D5 97     JSR.W $97D5                     ; Ground friction / landing ($97D5)
$01:E638 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Touching an object on the side?
$01:E63B F0 0C        BEQ $E649                       ; No: skip
$01:E63D 20 98 90     JSR.W FlipSpriteDir             ; Flip direction
$01:E640 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:E642 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E643 08           PHP                             ; |
$01:E644 76 B6        ROR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; |
$01:E646 28           PLP                             ; } X speed = X speed / 4 (arithmetic shift right twice)
$01:E647 76 B6        ROR RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:E649 20 14 80     JSR.W IsTouchingCeiling         ; Touching ceiling?
$01:E64C F0 02        BEQ $E650                       ; No: skip
$01:E64E 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$01:E650 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540] (bounce timer, set when Mario lands)
$01:E653 F0 5B        BEQ $E6B0                       ; Zero: not bouncing, go to $01E6B0
$01:E655 4A           LSR                             ; A = timer / 2
$01:E656 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index
$01:E657 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = [RAM_OnYoshi]
$01:E65A C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Carry = 1 if riding Yoshi
$01:E65C B9 1A E6     LDA.W $E61A,Y                   ; A = Mario Y offset from $E61A
$01:E65F 90 03        BCC $E664                       ; No Yoshi: use it
$01:E661 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E662 69 12        ADC.B #$12                      ; / Yoshi: offset += $12 (Yoshi is taller)
$01:E664 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = offset
$01:E666 B9 11 E6     LDA.W $E611,Y                   ; \
$01:E669 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Springboard frame [$1602] = $E611[Y]
$01:E66C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E66E 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:E66F E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Mario Y position (low) = sprite Y - offset
$01:E671 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$01:E673 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:E676 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Mario Y position (high) = sprite Y high - borrow
$01:E678 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$01:E67A 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario not flying
$01:E67C 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$01:E67E A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:E680 8D 71 14     STA.W $1471                     ; / [$1471] = 2: Mario stands on a platform sprite
$01:E683 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540]
$01:E686 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; Timer >= 7: still compressing, no launch
$01:E688 B0 24        BCS $E6AE
$01:E68A 9C 71 14     STZ.W $1471                     ; Launch time: [$1471] = 0 (Mario leaves the board)
$01:E68D A0 B0        LDY.B #$B0                      ; Y = $B0: normal bounce Y speed
$01:E68F A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; A = [RAM_ControllerB] ($17, bit 7 = A button)
$01:E691 10 07        BPL $E69A                       ; A not pressed: check B
$01:E693 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:E695 8D 0D 14     STA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; / A pressed: spin jump flag = 1
$01:E698 80 04        BRA $E69E                       ; Go to jump

$01:E69A A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; A = [RAM_ControllerA] ($15, bit 7 = B button)
$01:E69C 10 09        BPL $E6A7                       ; B not pressed: low bounce
$01:E69E A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:E6A0 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / Jump pressed: Mario flying state [$72] = $0B
$01:E6A2 A0 80        LDY.B #$80                      ; Y = $80: high bounce Y speed
$01:E6A4 8C 06 14     STY.W $1406                     ; [$1406] = $80 (springboard high-jump flag, probably)
$01:E6A7 84 7D        STY RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = Y ($B0 or $80)
$01:E6A9 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:E6AB 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect 8 ($1DFC: springboard)
$01:E6AE 80 40        BRA $E6F0                       ; Go to graphics

$01:E6B0 20 F7 A7     JSR.W ProcessInteract           ; Not bouncing: check Mario contact (ProcessInteract)
$01:E6B3 90 3B        BCC $E6F0                       ; No contact: go to graphics
$01:E6B5 9E 4C 15     STZ.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; Re-enable interaction timer [RAM_DisableInter] = 0
$01:E6B8 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E6BA 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:E6BB E5 96        SBC RAM_MarioYPos               ; |
$01:E6BD 18           CLC                             ; } A = sprite Y - Mario Y + 4: vertical overlap
$01:E6BE 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; /
$01:E6C0 C9 1C        CMP.B #$1C                      ; Overlap < $1C: Mario is level with / on top of the board
$01:E6C2 90 0A        BCC $E6CE                       ; Mario above the board: go to $01E6CE
$01:E6C4 10 21        BPL $E6E7                       ; Mario higher up (positive): possible bounce start, go to $01E6E7
$01:E6C6 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario below the board: A = Mario Y speed
$01:E6C8 10 26        BPL $E6F0                       ; Moving down: nothing
$01:E6CA 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Moving up: Y speed = 0 (bump head)
$01:E6CC 80 22        BRA $E6F0                       ; Go to graphics

$01:E6CE 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; Test controller: V = bit 6 (X/Y button, grab)
$01:E6D0 50 10        BVC $E6E2                       ; Not held: skip pickup
$01:E6D2 AD 70 14     LDA.W $1470                     ; \
$01:E6D5 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; / A = carrying something or riding Yoshi
$01:E6D8 D0 08        BNE $E6E2                       ; Yes: cannot pick it up
$01:E6DA A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:E6DC 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = $0B (carried by Mario)
$01:E6DF 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Frame [$1602] = 0
$01:E6E2 20 31 AB     JSR.W $AB31                     ; Place Mario on top of the sprite ($AB31)
$01:E6E5 80 09        BRA $E6F0                       ; Go to graphics

$01:E6E7 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$01:E6E9 30 05        BMI $E6F0                       ; Moving up: nothing
$01:E6EB A9 11        LDA.B #$11                      ; \
$01:E6ED 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Mario landed on top: start the bounce, [$1540] = $11
$01:E6F0 BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; Y = frame [$1602]
$01:E6F3 B9 FD E6     LDA.W $E6FD,Y                   ; A = tile table offset for this frame
$01:E6F6 A8           TAY                             ; Y = it
$01:E6F7 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: two tiles
$01:E6F9 20 F5 9C     JSR.W SubSprGfx0Entry1          ; Draw the springboard (SubSprGfx0Entry1)
$01:E6FC 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E6FD..E6FD: Table: springboard tiles by frame ;;;
{
$01:E6FD              .db $00,$02,$00                 ; Springboard tile table by frame ($1602): 0, 2, 0

}

;;; $E700: Draw smushed sprite (SmushedGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws a flattened sprite as two 8x8 tiles side by side (second flipped horizontally), 8 pixels lower than
;;     the sprite position.
;; Tile depends on sprite number: $3E POW = $FE, $BD or <4 = $EE, 4-$0E (Koopas) = $4D, others $C7. Called
;;     from the stunned/killed-state graphics.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:9B10: Move and draw smushed sprite (ShowSmushedGfx)
;;     $01:A209: Draw P-switch (StunPow)
$01:E700 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get draw info (X in $00, Y in $01, OAM index in Y)
$01:E703 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Offscreen?
$01:E706 D0 52        BNE $E75A                       ; Yes: return
$01:E708 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:E70A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; / First tile X = sprite X
$01:E70D 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E70E 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Second tile X = sprite X + 8
$01:E710 99 04 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y          ; /
$01:E713 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:E715 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E716 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:E718 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; } Both tiles Y = sprite Y + 8 (squashed, lower)
$01:E71B 99 05 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y          ; /
$01:E71E DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:E71F B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; A = sprite number
$01:E721 AA           TAX                             ; X = sprite number
$01:E722 A9 FE        LDA.B #$FE                      ; A = tile $FE
$01:E724 E0 3E        CPX.B #$3E                      ; \
$01:E726 F0 12        BEQ $E73A                       ; / Sprite $3E (POW): tile $FE
$01:E728 A9 EE        LDA.B #$EE                      ; A = tile $EE
$01:E72A E0 BD        CPX.B #$BD                      ; \
$01:E72C F0 0C        BEQ $E73A                       ; / Sprite $BD (sliding Koopa): tile $EE
$01:E72E E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$01:E730 90 08        BCC $E73A                       ; / Sprite < 4 (shelless Koopa): tile $EE
$01:E732 A9 C7        LDA.B #$C7                      ; A = tile $C7
$01:E734 E0 0F        CPX.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:E736 B0 02        BCS $E73A                       ; / Sprite >= $0F: tile $C7
$01:E738 A9 4D        LDA.B #$4D                      ; Sprites 4-$0E (Koopas): tile $4D
$01:E73A 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$01:E73D 99 06 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y               ; / Both tiles use the same tile number
$01:E740 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:E741 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:E743 1D F6 15     ORA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; } First tile properties = [$64] priority | sprite palette
$01:E746 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:E749 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; \
$01:E74B 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; / Second tile = same, flipped horizontally
$01:E74E 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E74F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E750 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4: index into the size table
$01:E751 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:E752 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: 8x8 tile
$01:E754 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; \
$01:E757 99 61 04     STA.W $0461,Y                   ; / Both tiles are 8x8
$01:E75A 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $E75B: Sprite $19/$3E main stub (message trigger) (PSwitch) ;;;
{
;; Shared by sprites $19 (message box) and $3E (POW). When [$1564] reaches 1: sets [$1F11] and [$1FB8] to 1,
;;     erases the sprite and increments [$1426] (message box trigger).
;; Purpose of the two flags is unclear; the POW itself is mostly handled elsewhere.
$01:E75B BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; A = [$1564] (timer)
$01:E75E C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1?
$01:E760 D0 0C        BNE $E76E                       ; No: return
$01:E762 8D 11 1F     STA.W $1F11                     ; [$1F11] = 1
$01:E765 8D B8 1F     STA.W $1FB8                     ; [$1FB8] = 1
$01:E768 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the sprite
$01:E76B EE 26 14     INC.W $1426                     ; [$1426]++ (trigger the message box)
$01:E76E 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E76F..E777: Table: cloud puff X offsets ;;;
{
;; 16 values: 4 animation frames x 4 puffs.
$01:E76F              .db $FC,$04,$FE,$02,$FB,$05,$FD,$03 ; Cloud puff X offsets, 4 puffs per animation frame (frame 0)
$01:E777              .db $FA,$06,$FC,$04,$FB,$05,$FD,$03 ; Cloud puff X offsets (frames 2 and 3, 4 puffs each)
}

;;; $E77F..E78F: Table: cloud puff Y offsets ;;;
{
;; 16 values used (4 frames x 4 puffs), 4 trailing bytes not referenced in this chunk.
$01:E77F              .db $00,$FF,$03,$04,$FF,$FE,$04,$03 ; Cloud puff Y offsets, 4 puffs per animation frame (frame 0)
$01:E787              .db $FE,$FF,$03,$03,$FF,$00,$03,$03 ; Cloud puff Y offsets (frames 2 and 3)
$01:E78F              .db $F8,$FC,$00,$04             ; Unreferenced here: $F8,$FC,$00,$04 (looks like OAM indexes)

}

;;; $E793..E7A3: Table: cloud wobble offsets ;;;
{
;; Y offsets of the cloud below Mario or of Lakitu above the cloud, indexed by 0-7 (+8 on Yoshi).
$01:E793              .db $0E,$0F,$10,$11,$12,$11,$10,$0F ; Cloud wobble Y offsets for Mario riding (8 entries, no Yoshi)
$01:E79B              .db $1A,$1B,$1C,$1D,$1E,$1D,$1C,$1B ; Cloud wobble Y offsets for Mario riding Yoshi (8 entries)
$01:E7A3              .db $1A                         ; (last entry)

}

;;; $E7A4: Lakitu's cloud main routine (LakituCloud) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $87. If sprites are locked just draws it, otherwise falls into NoCloudGfx.
$01:E7A4 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$01:E7A6 F0 03        BEQ NoCloudGfx                  ; Not locked: run cloud logic
$01:E7A8 4C CA E8     JMP.W LakituCloudGfx            ; Locked: just draw

}

;;; $E7AB: Lakitu's cloud logic (NoCloudGfx) ;;;
{
;; Counts down the cloud life [$18E0] every 4th frame; when it ends [$1540] = $1F and the cloud vanishes, then
;;     Lakitu is respawned ([RAM_SpriteToRespawn] = $1E, timer $FF).
;; Looks for a Lakitu in slots 0-9: if found, the cloud follows him ([$160E] = slot, $E898).
;; Otherwise state 0 = empty cloud (falls, Mario can land on it), state 1 = Mario riding it (position follows
;;     Mario, B jumps off).
$01:E7AB AC E0 18     LDY.W $18E0                     ; Y = [$18E0] (cloud lifetime counter)
$01:E7AE F0 15        BEQ $E7C5                       ; Zero: no countdown
$01:E7B0 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; A = frame counter B
$01:E7B2 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Every 4th frame only
$01:E7B4 D0 0F        BNE $E7C5
$01:E7B6 AD E0 18     LDA.W $18E0                     ; A = [$18E0]
$01:E7B9 F0 0A        BEQ $E7C5                       ; Zero: skip
$01:E7BB CE E0 18     DEC.W $18E0                     ; [$18E0]--
$01:E7BE D0 05        BNE $E7C5                       ; Not yet zero: continue
$01:E7C0 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:E7C2 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Lifetime over: [$1540] = $1F (vanish timer)
$01:E7C5 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540]
$01:E7C8 F0 11        BEQ $E7DB                       ; Zero: cloud is active
$01:E7CA 3A           DEC A                           ; Timer - 1
