$01:E7CB D0 DB        BNE $E7A8                       ; Not the last frame: just draw
$01:E7CD 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the cloud
$01:E7D0 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:E7D2 8D C0 18     STA.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn       ; / [RAM_TimeTillRespawn] = $FF
$01:E7D5 A9 1E        LDA.B #$1E                      ; \
$01:E7D7 8D C1 18     STA.W RAM_SpriteToRespawn       ; / [RAM_SpriteToRespawn] = $1E: respawn Lakitu
$01:E7DA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E7DB A0 09        LDY.B #$09                      ; Y = $09: search all sprite slots
$01:E7DD B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; A = status of slot Y
$01:E7E0 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Normal (8)?
$01:E7E2 D0 0E        BNE $E7F2                       ; No: next
$01:E7E4 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = sprite number of slot Y
$01:E7E7 C9 1E        CMP.B #$1E                      ; $1E = Lakitu?
$01:E7E9 D0 07        BNE $E7F2                       ; No: next
$01:E7EB 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E7EC 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / [$160E] = slot of the Lakitu riding this cloud
$01:E7EF 4C 98 E8     JMP.W $E898                     ; Lakitu is here: cloud follows Lakitu ($E898)

$01:E7F2 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$01:E7F3 10 E8        BPL $E7DD                       ; Loop for all slots
$01:E7F5 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; No Lakitu: A = [state] (0 empty, 1 Mario riding)
$01:E7F7 D0 47        BNE $E840                       ; Mario riding: go to $01E840
$01:E7F9 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; A = [$151C] (falling flag)
$01:E7FC F0 06        BEQ $E804                       ; Zero: not falling
$01:E7FE 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move in X
$01:E801 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y (falls)
$01:E804 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; A = [RAM_DisableInter]
$01:E807 D0 34        BNE $E83D                       ; Nonzero: no interaction, draw
$01:E809 20 F7 A7     JSR.W ProcessInteract           ; Mario contact (ProcessInteract)
$01:E80C 90 2F        BCC $E83D                       ; No contact: draw
$01:E80E A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$01:E810 30 2B        BMI $E83D                       ; Moving up: draw
$01:E812 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; [state] = 1: Mario boards the cloud
$01:E814 A9 11        LDA.B #$11                      ; A = $11: cloud offset below Mario
$01:E816 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Y = [RAM_OnYoshi]
$01:E819 F0 02        BEQ $E81D                       ; No Yoshi: use $11
$01:E81B A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; Yoshi: offset $22
$01:E81D 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E81E 65 D3        ADC $D3                         ; } Cloud Y (low) = Mario Y + offset
$01:E820 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:E822 A5 D4        LDA $D4                         ; \
$01:E824 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Cloud Y (high) = Mario Y high + carry
$01:E826 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:E829 A5 D1        LDA $D1                         ; \
$01:E82B 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Cloud X (low) = Mario X
$01:E82D A5 D2        LDA $D2                         ; \
$01:E82F 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Cloud X (high) = Mario X high
$01:E832 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E834 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Cloud Y speed = $10
$01:E836 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; [$151C] = $10: cloud keeps falling
$01:E839 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:E83B 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Cloud X speed = Mario X speed
$01:E83D 4C CA E8     JMP.W LakituCloudGfx            ; Draw the cloud

$01:E840 20 CA E8     JSR.W LakituCloudGfx            ; Mario riding: draw the cloud
$01:E843 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:E844 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:E846 48           PHA                             ; } Set data bank to $02 for the call
$01:E847 AB           PLB                             ; /
$01:E848 22 14 D2 02  JSL.L $D214                     ; Cloud movement/control ($D214, probably)
$01:E84C AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:E84D B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:E84F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E850 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } Mario Y speed = cloud Y speed + 3
$01:E852 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; /
$01:E854 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E856 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E857 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E858 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E859 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Y = (frame counter B / 8) & 7: wobble index
$01:E85B A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:E85C AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = [RAM_OnYoshi]
$01:E85F F0 05        BEQ $E866                       ; No Yoshi: skip
$01:E861 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E862 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E863 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Yoshi: index += 8
$01:E865 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:E866 A5 D1        LDA $D1                         ; \
$01:E868 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Cloud X (low) = Mario X
$01:E86A A5 D2        LDA $D2                         ; \
$01:E86C 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Cloud X (high) = Mario X high
$01:E86F A5 D3        LDA $D3                         ; \
$01:E871 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E872 79 93 E7     ADC.W $E793,Y                   ; } Cloud Y (low) = Mario Y + wobble offset
$01:E875 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; /
$01:E877 A5 D4        LDA $D4                         ; \
$01:E879 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Cloud Y (high) = Mario Y high + carry
$01:E87B 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$01:E87E 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario not flying
$01:E880 EE 71 14     INC.W $1471                     ; [$1471]++: Mario stands on a platform sprite
$01:E883 EE C2 18     INC.W $18C2                     ; [$18C2]++ (Mario is riding the cloud flag, probably)
$01:E886 A5 16        LDA $16                         ; A = [$16] (buttons newly pressed)
$01:E888 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; Isolate bit 7 (B)
$01:E88A F0 0B        BEQ $E897                       ; Not pressed: return
$01:E88C A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; A = $C0
$01:E88E 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = $C0: jump off the cloud
$01:E890 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E892 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable cloud interaction for $10 frames
$01:E895 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; [state] = 0: cloud is empty again
$01:E897 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:E898 5A           PHY                             ; Cloud with Lakitu: save Lakitu slot
$01:E899 20 8D E9     JSR.W $E98D                     ; Move the cloud ($E98D)
$01:E89C A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E89E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E89F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E8A0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E8A1 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Y = (frame counter B / 8) & 7: wobble index
$01:E8A3 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:E8A4 B9 93 E7     LDA.W $E793,Y                   ; \
$01:E8A7 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = wobble offset
$01:E8A9 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Lakitu slot
$01:E8AA B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:E8AC 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; / Lakitu X (low) = cloud X
$01:E8AF BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:E8B2 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / Lakitu X (high) = cloud X high
$01:E8B5 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:E8B7 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:E8B8 E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } Lakitu Y (low) = cloud Y - wobble offset
$01:E8BA 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; /
$01:E8BD BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:E8C0 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } Lakitu Y (high) = cloud Y high - borrow
$01:E8C2 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$01:E8C5 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:E8C7 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Cloud: interaction disabled for $10 frames
}

;;; $E8CA: Draw Lakitu's cloud (LakituCloudGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws four 16x16 puffs from $E76F/$E77F with an animation that depends on the frame counter,
;;     plus an 8x8 face tile at OAM slot 2 ($0208).
;; Puff tile shrinks via CloudTiles while [$1540] counts down. OAM indexes $F8/$FC and $00 or $30 (empty
;;     cloud).
;; Called by:
;;     $01:E7A8: Lakitu's cloud main routine (LakituCloud)
;;     $01:E83D: Lakitu's cloud logic (NoCloudGfx)
;;     $01:E840: Lakitu's cloud logic (NoCloudGfx)
$01:E8CA 20 65 A3     JSR.W GetDrawInfoBnk1           ; Get draw info
$01:E8CD BD 6C 18     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; A = vertical offscreen flag
$01:E8D0 D0 C5        BNE $E897                       ; Offscreen: return
$01:E8D2 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$01:E8D4 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / $0C = $F8: OAM index of puff 3
$01:E8D6 A9 FC        LDA.B #$FC                      ; \
$01:E8D8 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; / $0D = $FC: OAM index of puff 2
$01:E8DA A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: OAM index base when Mario or Lakitu is riding
$01:E8DC B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = [state]
$01:E8DE D0 02        BNE $E8E2                       ; Riding: use 0
$01:E8E0 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; Empty cloud: OAM index base $30
$01:E8E2 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; $0E = OAM index of puff 1
$01:E8E4 8D B6 18     STA.W $18B6                     ; [$18B6] = same, saved for the second draw
$01:E8E7 09 04        ORA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:E8E9 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / $0F = $0E + 4: OAM index of puff 0
$01:E8EB A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:E8ED 8D B0 14     STA.W $14B0                     ; / [$14B0] = cloud screen X
$01:E8F0 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:E8F2 8D B2 14     STA.W $14B2                     ; / [$14B2] = cloud screen Y
$01:E8F5 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:E8F7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E8F8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E8F9 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; } $02 = (frame counter B / 4) & $0C: puff animation frame * 4
$01:E8FB 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$01:E8FD A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:E8FF 85 03        STA $03                         ; / $03 = 3: puff counter
$01:E901 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; A = puff counter
$01:E903 AA           TAX                             ; X = puff counter
$01:E904 B4 0C        LDY $0C,X                       ; Y = OAM index for this puff ($0C + X)
$01:E906 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E907 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } X = puff counter + frame offset: table index
$01:E909 AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:E90A BD 6F E7     LDA.W $E76F,X                   ; \
$01:E90D 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E90E 6D B0 14     ADC.W $14B0                     ; } Puff X = cloud X + $E76F[X]
$01:E911 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:E914 BD 7F E7     LDA.W $E77F,X                   ; \
$01:E917 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E918 6D B2 14     ADC.W $14B2                     ; } Puff Y = cloud Y + $E77F[X]
$01:E91B 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:E91E AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:E921 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$01:E923 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = $60 (cloud puff)
$01:E926 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540] (vanish timer)
$01:E929 F0 0A        BEQ $E935                       ; Zero: use the normal tile
$01:E92B 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:E92C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:E92D 4A           LSR                             ; } X = timer / 8
$01:E92E AA           TAX                             ; /
$01:E92F BD 85 E9     LDA.W CloudTiles,X              ; \
$01:E932 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Tile = CloudTiles[X]: shrinking puff as the cloud vanishes
$01:E935 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:E937 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / Puff properties = [$64]
$01:E93A C8           INY                             ; \
$01:E93B C8           INY                             ; |
$01:E93C C8           INY                             ; } Y += 4: OAM index of the next puff
$01:E93D C8           INY                             ; /
$01:E93E C6 03        DEC $03                         ; Next puff
$01:E940 10 BF        BPL $E901                       ; Loop for 4 puffs
$01:E942 AE E9 15     LDX.W $15E9                     ; X = sprite index
$01:E945 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$01:E947 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / OAM index = $F8 (puffs 3 and 2)
$01:E94A A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = $02: 16x16 tiles
$01:E94C A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: two tiles
$01:E94E 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish OAM write
$01:E951 AD B6 18     LDA.W $18B6                     ; \
$01:E954 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; / OAM index = [$18B6] (puffs 1 and 0)
$01:E957 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = $02: 16x16 tiles
$01:E959 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: two tiles
$01:E95B 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish OAM write
$01:E95E BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; A = horizontal offscreen flag
$01:E961 D0 21        BNE $E984                       ; Offscreen: return
$01:E963 AD B0 14     LDA.W $14B0                     ; \
$01:E966 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E967 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } OAM tile 2 X = cloud X + 4 (the face)
$01:E969 8D 08 02     STA.W $0208                     ; /
$01:E96C AD B2 14     LDA.W $14B2                     ; \
$01:E96F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E970 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; } OAM tile 2 Y = cloud Y + 7
$01:E972 8D 09 02     STA.W $0209                     ; /
$01:E975 A9 4D        LDA.B #$4D                      ; \
$01:E977 8D 0A 02     STA.W $020A                     ; / OAM tile 2 number = $4D
$01:E97A A9 39        LDA.B #$39                      ; \
$01:E97C 8D 0B 02     STA.W $020B                     ; / OAM tile 2 properties = $39
$01:E97F A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:E981 8D 22 04     STA.W $0422                     ; / OAM tile 2 size = 8x8
$01:E984 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $E985: Cloud tiles, speed limits, cloud movement (CloudTiles) ;;;
{
;; CloudTiles: tiles $66,$64,$62,$60. $E989/01E98B: max X speed and Y bob limit.
;; $01E98D: cloud movement. Faces Lakitu toward Mario (or away if [$18BF] is set), accelerates X every other
;;     frame toward +/-$20, bobs in Y between +/-$10, adds scroll speed [$17BD]*8.
;; Every 128 frames it makes the Lakitu throw (sets his [$1558] = $20, calls $EA21 to spawn).
$01:E985              .db $66,$64,$62,$60             ; Cloud puff tiles by [$1540]/8: $66, $64, $62, $60 (fade out)

$01:E989              .db $20,$E0                     ; Cloud max X speed: $20 (right) / $E0 (left)

$01:E98B              .db $10,$F0                     ; Cloud Y speed limit: $10 (down) / $F0 (up)

$01:E98D A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A = sprites locked flag
$01:E98F D0 F3        BNE $E984                       ; Locked: return
$01:E991 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side of Mario (0 right, 1 left) (SubHorizPos)
$01:E994 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$01:E995 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = Lakitu slot
$01:E998 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; Lakitu direction = A: faces Mario
$01:E99B 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = A
$01:E99D A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = side of Mario
$01:E99F AD BF 18     LDA.W $18BF                     ; A = [$18BF] (Lakitu flee flag, probably)
$01:E9A2 F0 19        BEQ $E9BD                       ; Zero: approach Mario
$01:E9A4 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:E9A5 DA           PHX                             ; Save cloud index
$01:E9A6 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; A = Lakitu slot
$01:E9A9 AA           TAX                             ; X = Lakitu slot
$01:E9AA 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn check for Lakitu
$01:E9AD BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; A = Lakitu status
$01:E9B0 FA           PLX                             ; Restore cloud index
$01:E9B1 C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; Status = 0 (erased)?
$01:E9B3 D0 03        BNE $E9B8                       ; No
$01:E9B5 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the cloud too
$01:E9B8 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:E9B9 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:E9BA 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Y = Y xor 1: move away from Mario
$01:E9BC A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:E9BD A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:E9BF 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; / Only every other frame
$01:E9C1 D0 23        BNE $E9E6                       ; Odd frame: skip acceleration
$01:E9C3 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = X speed
$01:E9C5 D9 89 E9     CMP.W $E989,Y                   ; At max speed for this direction?
$01:E9C8 F0 06        BEQ $E9D0                       ; Yes: skip
$01:E9CA 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:E9CB 79 B4 EB     ADC.W $EBB4,Y                   ; } X speed += $EBB4[Y] (acceleration, +/-)
$01:E9CE 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:E9D0 BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:E9D3 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Y = [$1534] & 1: bobbing phase
$01:E9D5 A8           TAY                             ; /
$01:E9D6 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:E9D8 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E9D9 79 B4 EB     ADC.W $EBB4,Y                   ; } Y speed += $EBB4[Y]
$01:E9DC 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; /
$01:E9DE D9 8B E9     CMP.W $E98B,Y                   ; Reached the limit ($10 or $F0)?
$01:E9E1 D0 03        BNE $E9E6                       ; No: continue
$01:E9E3 FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; [$1534]++: reverse bobbing direction
$01:E9E6 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; A = X speed
$01:E9E8 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:E9E9 AC BF 18     LDY.W $18BF                     ; Y = [$18BF]
$01:E9EC D0 0B        BNE $E9F9                       ; Fleeing: skip the scroll adjustment
$01:E9EE AD BD 17     LDA.W $17BD                     ; \
$01:E9F1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E9F2 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E9F3 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:E9F4 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:E9F5 75 B6        ADC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed += [$17BD] * 8 (compensate for screen scrolling)
$01:E9F7 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; /
$01:E9F9 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Move in X
$01:E9FC 68           PLA                             ; Restore X speed
$01:E9FD 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X
$01:E9FF 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Move in Y
$01:EA02 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = Lakitu slot
$01:EA05 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$01:EA07 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; \
$01:EA09 19 1C 15     ORA.W $151C,Y                   ; / Every 128 frames when Lakitu's [$151C] = 0...
$01:EA0C D0 08        BNE $EA16                       ; Not now: return
$01:EA0E A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:EA10 99 58 15     STA.W $1558,Y                   ; / ...set Lakitu's [$1558] = $20 (throw animation timer)
$01:EA13 20 21 EA     JSR.W $EA21                     ; Spawn a Spiny egg ($EA21, probably)
$01:EA16 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $EA17..EA17: Data: Lakitu cloud speeds $10/$F0 ;;;
{
$01:EA17              .db $10,$F0                     ; Pair of $10, $F0 (unreferenced in this chunk, probably Lakitu related speeds)

}

;;; $EA19: Spawn item from sprite; Yoshi on-Mario update ;;;
{
;; $01EA19 (long wrapper, called from bank $02) / $01EA21: spawns a sprite at the current sprite's position
;;     with sprite number $14, or $21 (moving coin, palette 2) while the Silver POW timer is running. Status 8, Y
;;     speed $D8, X speed +/-$10 toward Mario. Returns with no effect if there is no free slot.
;; $01EA70 (long entry from the Mario handler at $00E2C6): runs only if a Yoshi slot is registered in [$18E2]
;;     (slot + 1). Sets [$15E9] to Yoshi's slot, runs $EA8F and restores [$15E9].
;; $EA8F: picks Yoshi's pose index [$1602] (walk cycle, jump, turn, tongue, pipe) and, while Mario rides
;;     him (state [$C2] = 1), snaps Yoshi to Mario's position and falls into BackOnYoshi.
;; Quirk: pose numbers are used as indices into the tile/offset tables below (0 stand, 1-2 walk, 3 turn, 4
;;     duck/look down, 5 rising, 6-7 tongue, 8-9 in pipe, $0A-$0C growing); meanings are inferred.
;; Called by:
;;     $02:E9CA: Pipe Lakitu state routines (PipeLakituPtrs)
$01:EA19 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$01:EA1A 4B           PHK                             ; \
$01:EA1B AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($01)
$01:EA1C 20 21 EA     JSR.W $EA21                     ; Spawn the sprite ($EA21)
$01:EA1F AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:EA20 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:EA21 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; Find a free sprite slot in Y
$01:EA25 30 48        BMI $EA6F                       ; None free: return
$01:EA27 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:EA29 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:EA2C AD AE 14     LDA.W RAM_SilverPowTimer        ; \
$01:EA2F C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EA31 A9 14        LDA.B #$14                      ; |
$01:EA33 90 02        BCC $EA37                       ; |
$01:EA35 A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; } Sprite number = $14, or $21 (moving coin) if Silver POW timer is non-zero
$01:EA37 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / Set sprite number
$01:EA3A B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:EA3C 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; / New sprite X low = spawner's X low
$01:EA3F BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:EA42 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / New sprite X high = spawner's X high
$01:EA45 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:EA47 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; / New sprite Y low = spawner's Y low
$01:EA4A BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:EA4D 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; / New sprite Y high = spawner's Y high
$01:EA50 DA           PHX                             ; Save spawner index
$01:EA51 BB           TYX                             ; X = new sprite index
$01:EA52 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$01:EA56 A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$01:EA58 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $D8 (shoot upward)
$01:EA5A 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side of Mario (0 right, 1 left)
$01:EA5D B9 17 EA     LDA.W $EA17,Y                   ; \
$01:EA60 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = +$10 or -$10 toward Mario
$01:EA62 B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:EA64 C9 21        CMP.B #$21                      ; |
$01:EA66 D0 05        BNE $EA6D                       ; |
$01:EA68 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:EA6A 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; } If it is the moving coin, use palette 2
$01:EA6D 9B           TXY                             ; Y = new sprite index
$01:EA6E FA           PLX                             ; Restore spawner index
$01:EA6F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:EA70 AE E2 18     LDX.W $18E2                     ; X = Yoshi slot + 1 ([$18E2])
$01:EA73 F0 19        BEQ $EA8E                       ; No Yoshi: return
$01:EA75 9C 8B 18     STZ.W $188B                     ; Clear [$188B] (Mario Y offset on Yoshi)
$01:EA78 9C 1C 19     STZ.W $191C                     ; Clear [$191C]
$01:EA7B AD E9 15     LDA.W $15E9                     ; \
$01:EA7E 48           PHA                             ; / Save current sprite index [$15E9]
$01:EA7F CA           DEX                             ; X = Yoshi slot
$01:EA80 8E E9 15     STX.W $15E9                     ; [$15E9] = Yoshi slot
$01:EA83 8B           PHB                             ; \
$01:EA84 4B           PHK                             ; |
$01:EA85 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank
$01:EA86 20 8F EA     JSR.W $EA8F                     ; Update Yoshi's pose and position ($EA8F)
$01:EA89 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$01:EA8A 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EA8B 8D E9 15     STA.W $15E9                     ; / Restore [$15E9]
$01:EA8E 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$01:EA8F AD E8 18     LDA.W $18E8                     ; \
$01:EA92 0D C6 13     ORA.W $13C6                     ; |
$01:EA95 F0 03        BEQ $EA9A                       ; } Growing timer [$18E8] or cutscene [$13C6] non-zero: skip pose selection
$01:EA97 4C 48 EB     JMP.W $EB48                     ; Go to position update ($01EB48)

$01:EA9A 9C DC 18     STZ.W $18DC                     ; [$18DC] = 0 (Yoshi ducking/looking down flag)
$01:EA9D B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:EA9F C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$01:EAA1 90 04        BCC $EAA7                       ; } Yoshi state [$C2] >= 2 (not ridden)? Use fixed speed index $30
$01:EAA3 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30
$01:EAA5 80 0B        BRA $EAB2                       ; Go compute walk frame ($01EAB2)

$01:EAA7 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (pose stand)
$01:EAA9 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:EAAB F0 32        BEQ $EADF                       ; / Mario X speed = 0: not walking, go to $01EADF
$01:EAAD 10 03        BPL $EAB2                       ; \
$01:EAAF 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:EAB1 1A           INC A                           ; / A = |Mario X speed|
$01:EAB2 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:EAB3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EAB4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EAB5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EAB6 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = |Mario X speed| / 16 (0-3): index into the frame timer table
$01:EAB7 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:EAB9 D0 15        BNE $EAD0                       ; / Sprites locked: keep current frame
$01:EABB DE 70 15     DEC.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:EABE 10 10        BPL $EAD0                       ; / Decrement walk timer [$1570]; frame change when it goes negative
$01:EAC0 B9 F5 ED     LDA.W $EDF5,Y                   ; \
$01:EAC3 9D 70 15     STA.W $1570,X                   ; / Reload timer from $EDF5 (faster when Mario is faster)
$01:EAC6 CE AD 18     DEC.W $18AD                     ; \
$01:EAC9 10 05        BPL $EAD0                       ; |
$01:EACB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$01:EACD 8D AD 18     STA.W $18AD                     ; } Walk frame index [$18AD] = ([$18AD] - 1) mod 3
$01:EAD0 AC AD 18     LDY.W $18AD                     ; \
$01:EAD3 B9 EE ED     LDA.W YoshiWalkFrames,Y         ; |
$01:EAD6 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = pose from YoshiWalkFrames[[$18AD]]
$01:EAD7 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:EAD9 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$01:EADB B0 51        BCS $EB2E                       ; } State >= 2: skip the airborne checks, go to $01EB2E
$01:EADD 80 03        BRA $EAE2                       ; Skip to $01EAE2 (airborne checks)

$01:EADF 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Walk timer = 0
$01:EAE2 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:EAE4 F0 0A        BEQ $EAF0                       ; / Mario on ground: skip
$01:EAE6 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2 (pose falling/jumping)
$01:EAE8 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:EAEA 10 04        BPL $EAF0                       ; |
$01:EAEC A0 05        LDY.B #$05                      ; } Mario moving upward: Y = 5 (pose rising)
$01:EAEE 80 00        BRA $EAF0                       ; Continue

$01:EAF0 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:EAF3 F0 02        BEQ $EAF7                       ; |
$01:EAF5 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; } Turning timer [$15AC] non-zero: Y = 3 (turning pose)
$01:EAF7 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:EAF9 D0 26        BNE $EB21                       ; / Mario in the air: skip the tongue and duck checks
$01:EAFB BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:EAFE F0 0C        BEQ $EB0C                       ; / Tongue state [$151C] zero: check duck instead
$01:EB00 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Y = 7 (tongue out)
$01:EB02 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:EB04 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$01:EB06 F0 02        BEQ $EB0A                       ; |
$01:EB08 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; } If Up is held: Y = 6 (looking up with tongue)
$01:EB0A 80 15        BRA $EB21                       ; Go to $01EB21

$01:EB0C AD AF 18     LDA.W $18AF                     ; \
$01:EB0F F0 05        BEQ $EB16                       ; |
$01:EB11 CE AF 18     DEC.W $18AF                     ; |
$01:EB14 80 06        BRA $EB1C                       ; } Timer [$18AF] (after mounting) running: count down and use pose 4

$01:EB16 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:EB18 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$01:EB1A F0 05        BEQ $EB21                       ; } Else if Down held
$01:EB1C A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4 (ducking/looking down)
$01:EB1E EE DC 18     INC.W $18DC                     ; [$18DC]++ (flag: Yoshi ducking)
$01:EB21 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:EB23 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EB25 F0 07        BEQ $EB2E                       ; } State = 1 (ridden): keep pose
$01:EB27 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:EB2A D0 02        BNE $EB2E                       ; / Tongue active: keep pose
$01:EB2C A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Otherwise pose = 4
$01:EB2E AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:EB31 F0 11        BEQ $EB44                       ; / Not on Yoshi: skip
$01:EB33 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:EB36 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EB38 D0 0A        BNE $EB44                       ; } Only if Yoshi is entering a pipe ([$1419] = 1)
$01:EB3A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:EB3C 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$01:EB3E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EB3F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EB40 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EB41 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:EB43 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = 8 + ([FrameCounter] bit 3): alternate pipe poses 8 and 9
$01:EB44 98           TYA                             ; A = pose
$01:EB45 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; Store pose in [$1602]
$01:EB48 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:EB4A C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EB4C D0 49        BNE $EB97                       ; } Not ridden (state != 1): go to drawing at $01EB97
$01:EB4E BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = Yoshi direction
$01:EB51 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$01:EB53 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EB54 79 F1 ED     ADC.W YoshiPositionX,Y          ; |
$01:EB57 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } Yoshi X low = Mario X low + YoshiPositionX[dir]
$01:EB59 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$01:EB5B 79 F3 ED     ADC.W $EDF3,Y                   ; |
$01:EB5E 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / Yoshi X high = Mario X high + carry
$01:EB61 BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; Y = pose
$01:EB64 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:EB66 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EB67 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:EB69 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; } Yoshi Y low = Mario Y low + $10
$01:EB6B A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$01:EB6D 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:EB6F 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Yoshi Y high = Mario Y high + carry
$01:EB72 B9 E4 ED     LDA.W $EDE4,Y                   ; \
$01:EB75 8D 8B 18     STA.W $188B                     ; / [$188B] = Mario Y offset on Yoshi for this pose
$01:EB78 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$01:EB7A BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:EB7D C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; |
$01:EB7F D0 01        BNE BackOnYoshi                 ; |
$01:EB81 1A           INC A                           ; } A = 2 if pose is 3 (turning), else 1
}

;;; $EB82: Mark Mario as riding Yoshi (BackOnYoshi) ;;;
{
;; Stores [RAM_OnYoshi] (1, or 2 when pose = 3), flags the overworld as having Yoshi, copies Yoshi's palette
;;     to [RAM_YoshiColor] and sets Mario's direction opposite to Yoshi's sprite direction.
;; Then draws Yoshi through HandleOffYoshi (the graphics routine) with [$64] set to $10 while Yoshi is in a
;;     pipe, restoring [$64] afterwards.
$01:EB82 8D 7A 18     STA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; [RAM_OnYoshi] = A
$01:EB85 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:EB87 8D C1 0D     STA.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; / Overworld: Mario has Yoshi
$01:EB8A BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:EB8D 8D C7 13     STA.W RAM_YoshiColor            ; / [RAM_YoshiColor] = Yoshi's palette
$01:EB90 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:EB93 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EB95 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; } Mario direction = opposite of Yoshi's sprite direction (EOR 1)
$01:EB97 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; \
$01:EB99 48           PHA                             ; / Save [$64] (sprite OAM priority bits)
$01:EB9A AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:EB9D F0 0E        BEQ $EBAD                       ; / Not on Yoshi: draw normally
$01:EB9F AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:EBA2 F0 09        BEQ $EBAD                       ; / Not in a pipe: draw normally
$01:EBA4 AD 05 14     LDA.W $1405                     ; \
$01:EBA7 D0 07        BNE $EBB0                       ; / [$1405] non-zero: skip the priority change
$01:EBA9 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:EBAB 85 64        STA $64                         ; / [$64] = $10: Yoshi drawn behind the foreground (in pipe)
$01:EBAD 20 61 EE     JSR.W HandleOffYoshi            ; Draw Yoshi (HandleOffYoshi)
$01:EBB0 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EBB1 85 64        STA $64                         ; / Restore [$64]
$01:EBB3 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $EBB4..EBBC: Table: X offsets for sprite spawning ;;;
{
$01:EBB4              .db $01,$FF,$01,$00,$FF,$00,$20,$E0 ; $00-$07: small X offsets by direction (used by several sprites): +1, -1, +1, 0, -1, 0, +$20, -$20
$01:EBBC              .db $0A,$0E                     ; $08-$09: +$0A, +$0E

}

;;; $EBBE..EBC0: Table: X offsets by direction ;;;
{
$01:EBBE              .db $E8,$18                     ; $E8, $18: X offsets by direction (used at $F732)

$01:EBC0              .db $10,$F0                     ; Offsets: +$10, -$10

}

;;; $EBC2: Table: baby Yoshi growing poses (GrowingAniSequence) ;;;
{
$01:EBC2              .db $0C,$0B,$0C,$0B,$0A,$0B,$0A,$0B ; Poses $0C,$0B,$0C,$0B,$0A,$0B,$0A,$0B for the growing animation

}

;;; $EBCA: Yoshi sprite main routine (Yoshi) ;;;
{
;; Clears the per-frame flags, copies the wings flag to [RAM_YoshiHasWingsB], clears stomp. If status is not 8
;;     (normal) it just draws and clears the overworld Yoshi flag.
;; Handles growing (timer [$18E8] picks the pose via GrowingAniSequence and locks sprites), the swallow/egg
;;     spit timer [$18DE] (spawns sprite $2C, status 9, from Yoshi's mouth), then physics, Mario-contact mounting
;;     (SetOnYoshi) and dismounting.
$01:EBCA 9C FB 13     STZ.W $13FB                     ; Clear [$13FB] (Yoshi busy flag)
$01:EBCD AD 1E 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; \
$01:EBD0 8D 10 14     STA.W RAM_YoshiHasWingsB        ; / [RAM_YoshiHasWingsB] = winged Yoshi flag
$01:EBD3 9C 1E 14     STZ.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; Clear real winged flag (set again by the wing tile)
$01:EBD6 9C E7 18     STZ.W RAM_YoshiHasStomp         ; Clear stomp Yoshi flag
$01:EBD9 9C 1B 19     STZ.W $191B                     ; Clear [$191B]
$01:EBDC BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:EBDF C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:EBE1 F0 06        BEQ $EBE9                       ; } Status 8 (normal)? Else draw dead Yoshi
$01:EBE3 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Mario has no Yoshi on return to overworld
$01:EBE6 4C 61 EE     JMP.W HandleOffYoshi            ; Draw Yoshi only (HandleOffYoshi)

$01:EBE9 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:EBEA 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:EBEB 8D DF 18     STA.W $18DF                     ; } [$18DF] = Yoshi slot + 1
$01:EBEE AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:EBF1 D0 11        BNE $EC04                       ; / Mario on Yoshi: skip offscreen check
$01:EBF3 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn Yoshi if far offscreen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:EBF6 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:EBF9 D0 09        BNE $EC04                       ; / Still alive: continue
$01:EBFB AD 95 1B     LDA.W $1B95                     ; \
$01:EBFE D0 03        BNE $EC03                       ; / [$1B95] set: return
$01:EC00 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Overworld: Mario has no Yoshi
$01:EC03 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:EC04 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:EC07 F0 05        BEQ $EC0E                       ; / Not on Yoshi: skip pipe test
$01:EC09 AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:EC0C D0 53        BNE $EC61                       ; / Yoshi in pipe: go to physics
$01:EC0E AD DE 18     LDA.W $18DE                     ; \
$01:EC11 D0 4E        BNE $EC61                       ; / Swallow/spit timer [$18DE] non-zero: go to physics
$01:EC13 AD E8 18     LDA.W $18E8                     ; \
$01:EC16 F0 34        BEQ $EC4C                       ; / Growing timer [$18E8] zero: skip growing code
$01:EC18 CE E8 18     DEC.W $18E8                     ; Count the growing timer down
$01:EC1B 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites while growing
$01:EC1D 8D FB 13     STA.W $13FB                     ; Yoshi busy flag [$13FB] = timer
$01:EC20 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:EC22 D0 1C        BNE $EC40                       ; / Last frame of growing? If not, go to pose
$01:EC24 64 9D        STZ RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Unlock sprites
$01:EC26 9C FB 13     STZ.W $13FB                     ; Clear busy flag
$01:EC29 AC B3 0D     LDY.W $0DB3                     ; \
$01:EC2C B9 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,Y                   ; |
$01:EC2F 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$01:EC30 0D F8 0E     ORA.W $0EF8                     ; |
$01:EC33 0D 09 01     ORA.W $0109                     ; |
$01:EC36 D0 08        BNE $EC40                       ; } If this is the first Yoshi in level (conditions on [$1F11], [$0EF8], [$0109]),
$01:EC38 EE F8 0E     INC.W $0EF8                     ; Mark message shown [$0EF8]++
$01:EC3B A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:EC3D 8D 26 14     STA.W $1426                     ; / Show a message box: [$1426] = 3 (Yoshi message)
$01:EC40 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:EC41 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EC42 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EC43 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EC44 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = ([A] - 1) / 8: index into growing poses
$01:EC45 B9 C2 EB     LDA.W GrowingAniSequence,Y      ; \
$01:EC48 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / [$1602] = pose from GrowingAniSequence
$01:EC4B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:EC4C A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:EC4E F0 11        BEQ $EC61                       ; / Sprites not locked: go to physics
$01:EC50 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Y = [RAM_OnYoshi]
$01:EC53 F0 05        BEQ $EC5A                       ; Not on Yoshi: return Y = 0
$01:EC55 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; \
$01:EC57 8C 8B 18     STY.W $188B                     ; / Mario Y offset on Yoshi [$188B] = 6 (Y = 6)
$01:EC5A 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $EC5B..EC5F: Table: X speed and offsets for spat sprite ;;;
{
$01:EC5B              .db $F0,$10                     ; X speed for spat sprite: -$10, +$10

$01:EC5D              .db $FA,$06                     ; X offset low: -6, +6

$01:EC5F              .db $FF,$00                     ; X offset high: $FF, $00

}

;;; $EC61: Yoshi physics, mounting and dismount ;;;
{
;; $01EC61: Yoshi movement and Mario contact. If Mario is not on Yoshi, applies gravity and object collisions,
;;     builds a small hitbox at Yoshi's saddle and tests contact with Mario.
;; Mounting requires Mario in the air, falling, not carrying anything and not already on Yoshi.
;; $01ED70: while ridden, handles turning (timer [$15AC] = $10) and dismount on pressing X/Y ([$18] bit 7) or
;;     when [$13F3] is set. Dismounting launches Mario upward and gives Yoshi Mario's X speed.
;; $01EDCC/$01EDCE: sets Mario's Y position from Yoshi's Y minus a table offset (Y = 0 off Yoshi, 1 on Yoshi).
$01:EC61 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:EC63 D0 05        BNE $EC6A                       ; / Mario in the air: go to physics
$01:EC65 AD DE 18     LDA.W $18DE                     ; \
$01:EC68 D0 03        BNE $EC6D                       ; / [$18DE] non-zero: swallow/spit code
$01:EC6A 4C E1 EC     JMP.W $ECE1                     ; Go to Yoshi physics ($01ECE1)

$01:EC6D CE DE 18     DEC.W $18DE                     ; Count down [$18DE]
$01:EC70 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:EC72 D0 04        BNE $EC78                       ; / Last frame? Else skip
$01:EC74 64 9D        STZ RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Unlock sprites
$01:EC76 80 F2        BRA $EC6A                       ; Go to physics

$01:EC78 EE FB 13     INC.W $13FB                     ; [$13FB]++ (Yoshi busy)
$01:EC7B 20 50 EC     JSR.W $EC50                     ; Y = 0 or 6 ($EC50), sets [$188B] = 6 if on Yoshi
$01:EC7E 84 9D        STY RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites during swallow
$01:EC80 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; \
$01:EC82 D0 06        BNE $EC8A                       ; / At [$18DE] = 2: spawn the sprite, else return
$01:EC84 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; \
$01:EC88 10 01        BPL $EC8B                       ; / Find a free slot or return
$01:EC8A 60           RTS                             ; /

$01:EC8B A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:EC8D 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$01:EC90 A9 2C        LDA.B #$2C                      ; \
$01:EC92 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / New sprite number = $2C (Yoshi egg/spit item; probably)
$01:EC95 5A           PHY                             ; \
$01:EC96 5A           PHY                             ; / Save new sprite index twice
$01:EC97 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = Yoshi direction
$01:EC9A 84 0F        STY $0F                         ; [$0F] = direction
$01:EC9C B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:EC9E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EC9F 79 5D EC     ADC.W $EC5D,Y                   ; |
$01:ECA2 7A           PLY                             ; } X low = Yoshi X low + offset by direction
$01:ECA3 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; Store in new sprite
$01:ECA6 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:ECA9 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:ECAC 79 5F EC     ADC.W $EC5F,Y                   ; |
$01:ECAF 7A           PLY                             ; } X high = Yoshi X high + carry
$01:ECB0 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; Store
$01:ECB3 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:ECB5 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:ECB6 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:ECB8 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; } Y low = Yoshi Y low + 8
$01:ECBB BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:ECBE 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:ECC0 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; } Y high = Yoshi Y high + carry
$01:ECC3 DA           PHX                             ; Save Yoshi index
$01:ECC4 BB           TYX                             ; X = new sprite
$01:ECC5 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialize new sprite tables
$01:ECC9 A4 0F        LDY $0F                         ; Y = direction
$01:ECCB B9 5B EC     LDA.W $EC5B,Y                   ; \
$01:ECCE 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / X speed = -$10 or +$10 by direction
$01:ECD0 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:ECD2 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F0 (toss upward)
$01:ECD4 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:ECD6 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Disable interaction timer = $10
$01:ECD9 AD DA 18     LDA.W $18DA                     ; \
$01:ECDC 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; / New sprite's [$151C] = [$18DA] (what Yoshi swallowed)
$01:ECDF FA           PLX                             ; Restore Yoshi index
$01:ECE0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:ECE1 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:ECE3 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:ECE5 D0 03        BNE $ECEA                       ; } Yoshi ridden (state 1)? Skip the physics
$01:ECE7 4C 70 ED     JMP.W $ED70                     ; Go to $01ED70

$01:ECEA 20 32 90     JSR.W SubUpdateSprPos           ; Update sprite position with gravity (SubUpdateSprPos)
$01:ECED 20 0E 80     JSR.W IsOnGround                ; Check whether on ground
$01:ECF0 F0 0F        BEQ $ED01                       ; Not on ground: skip
$01:ECF2 20 04 9A     JSR.W SetSomeYSpeed??           ; Set a small Y speed when on ground
$01:ECF5 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:ECF7 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$01:ECF9 B0 06        BCS $ED01                       ; } State >= 2: keep speed
$01:ECFB 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:ECFD A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:ECFF 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed = $F0
$01:ED01 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Face Mario/direction update
$01:ED04 20 08 80     JSR.W IsTouchingObjSide         ; Check wall contact
$01:ED07 F0 03        BEQ $ED0C                       ; No wall: skip
$01:ED09 20 A2 90     JSR.W $90A2                     ; React to wall ($90A2)
$01:ED0C A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$01:ED0E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:ED0F 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$01:ED11 85 04        STA $04                         ; } Hitbox X low = Yoshi X + 4
$01:ED13 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:ED16 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:ED18 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; } Hitbox X high
$01:ED1A A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$01:ED1C 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:ED1D 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:ED1F 85 05        STA $05                         ; } Hitbox Y low = Yoshi Y + $13
$01:ED21 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:ED24 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:ED26 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; } Hitbox Y high
$01:ED28 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:ED2A 85 07        STA $07                         ; |
$01:ED2C 85 06        STA $06                         ; } Hitbox width and height = 8
$01:ED2E 22 64 B6 03  JSL.L GetMarioClipping          ; Get Mario's clipping box
$01:ED32 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check Mario contact
$01:ED36 90 38        BCC $ED70                       ; No contact: skip
$01:ED38 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:ED3A F0 34        BEQ $ED70                       ; / Mario on ground: skip
$01:ED3C AD 70 14     LDA.W $1470                     ; \
$01:ED3F 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$01:ED42 D0 2C        BNE $ED70                       ; } Carrying a sprite or already on Yoshi: skip
$01:ED44 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$01:ED46 30 28        BMI $ED70                       ; / Mario moving upward: skip
}

;;; $ED48: Put Mario on Yoshi (SetOnYoshi) ;;;
{
;; Called when Mario lands on Yoshi's back: positions Mario on him, zeroes Mario's speed, sets Yoshi state 1
;;     (ridden), plays sounds, spawns a smoke effect and starts a $20-frame timer.
$01:ED48 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1
$01:ED4A 20 CE ED     JSR.W $EDCE                     ; Place Mario on Yoshi ($EDCE)
$01:ED4D 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:ED4F 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario speed = 0
$01:ED51 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:ED53 8D AF 18     STA.W $18AF                     ; / [$18AF] = $0C (mount timer)
$01:ED56 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:ED58 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; / Yoshi state = 1 (ridden)
$01:ED5A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:ED5C 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / Sound effect: $02 (Yoshi mount)
$01:ED5F A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:ED61 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $1F
$01:ED64 22 B0 8B 02  JSL.L DisabledAddSmokeRt        ; Spawn smoke (disabled)
$01:ED68 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:ED6A 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; / Timer [$163E] = $20
$01:ED6D EE 97 16     INC.W $1697                     ; [$1697]++ (reset consecutive-enemies counter)
$01:ED70 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:ED72 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:ED74 D0 55        BNE $EDCB                       ; } Not ridden: return
$01:ED76 20 22 F6     JSR.W $F622                     ; Run Yoshi's tongue/mouth logic ($F622)
$01:ED79 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$01:ED7B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:ED7D F0 16        BEQ $ED95                       ; } Left/Right pressed?
$01:ED7F 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:ED80 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$01:ED83 F0 10        BEQ $ED95                       ; } Already facing that way: skip
$01:ED85 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:ED88 1D 1C 15     ORA.W $151C,X                   ; |
$01:ED8B 0D DC 18     ORA.W $18DC                     ; |
$01:ED8E D0 05        BNE $ED95                       ; } If not turning, tongue out or ducking...
$01:ED90 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:ED92 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / ...set turning timer [$15AC] = $10
$01:ED95 AD F3 13     LDA.W $13F3                     ; \
$01:ED98 D0 04        BNE $ED9E                       ; / [$13F3] set (forced dismount): jump to dismount
$01:ED9A 24 18        BIT $18                         ; \
$01:ED9C 10 2D        BPL $EDCB                       ; / X/Y button not pressed: return
$01:ED9E A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:EDA0 9D E2 1F     STA.W $1FE2,X                   ; / [$1FE2,X] = 2: no-grab timer
$01:EDA3 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yoshi state = 0 (free)
$01:EDA5 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:EDA7 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / Sound effect 3 (Yoshi dismount)
$01:EDAA 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Overworld: no Yoshi
$01:EDAD A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:EDAF 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; / Yoshi X speed = Mario X speed
$01:EDB1 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; A = $A0 (Mario jump speed up)
$01:EDB3 A4 72        LDY RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:EDB5 D0 0A        BNE $EDC1                       ; / Mario in the air: use that Y speed only
$01:EDB7 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side of Mario (SubHorizPos)
$01:EDBA B9 C0 EB     LDA.W $EBC0,Y                   ; \
$01:EDBD 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = $EBC0[Y] (+$10 or -$10 kick-off)
$01:EDBF A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; A = $C0
$01:EDC1 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = A (jump away)
$01:EDC3 9C 7A 18     STZ.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Mario is no longer on Yoshi
$01:EDC6 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Yoshi Y speed = 0
$01:EDC8 20 CC ED     JSR.W $EDCC                     ; Place Mario beside/above Yoshi ($EDCC)
$01:EDCB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:EDCC A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$01:EDCE B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:EDD0 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:EDD1 F9 E2 ED     SBC.W $EDE2,Y                   ; } Mario Y low = Yoshi Y low - $EDE2[Y]
$01:EDD4 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:EDD6 85 D3        STA $D3                         ; / Mario Y position (and copy in $D3)
$01:EDD8 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:EDDB E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:EDDD 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; } Mario Y high = Yoshi Y high - borrow
$01:EDDF 85 D4        STA $D4                         ; Copy to [$D4]
$01:EDE1 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $EDE2..EDEC: Table: Mario Y offset above Yoshi ;;;
{
$01:EDE2              .db $04,$10                     ; Mario Y offset above Yoshi: $04 (off Yoshi), $10 (on Yoshi)

$01:EDE4              .db $06,$05,$05,$05,$0A,$05,$05,$0A ; Mario Y offset on Yoshi by pose $00-$07: 6,5,5,5,A,5,5,A
$01:EDEC              .db $0A,$0B                     ; Poses $08-$09: $0A, $0B

}

{
$01:EDEE              .db $02,$01,$00                 ; Walk frame poses by [$18AD]: 2, 1, 0

}

{
$01:EDF1              .db $02,$FE                     ; Yoshi X offset low from Mario by direction: +2, -2

$01:EDF3              .db $00,$FF                     ; X offset high: $00, $FF

$01:EDF5              .db $03,$02,$01,$00             ; Walk frame timer by Mario speed / 16: 3, 2, 1, 0

}

{
$01:EDF9              .db $00,$01,$02,$03,$02,$10,$04,$05 ; Head tile by pose $00-$07
$01:EE01              .db $00,$00,$FF,$FF,$00         ; Head tile by pose $08-$0C

}

{
$01:EE06              .db $06,$07,$08,$09,$0A,$0B,$06,$0C ; Body tile by pose $00-$07
$01:EE0E              .db $0A,$0D,$0E,$0F,$0C         ; Body tile by pose $08-$0C

}

;;; $EE13: Table: Yoshi head X displacement (YoshiHeadDispX) ;;;
{
$01:EE13              .db $0A,$09,$0A,$06,$0A,$0A,$0A,$10 ; Head X displacement, facing left, poses $00-$07
$01:EE1B              .db $0A,$0A,$00,$00,$0A,$F6,$F7,$F6 ; Poses $08-$0C then facing right $00-$02
$01:EE23              .db $FA,$F6,$F6,$F6,$F0,$F6,$F6,$00 ; Facing right poses $03-$0A
$01:EE2B              .db $00,$F6                     ; Facing right poses $0B-$0C

$01:EE2D              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Head X displacement high byte (sign extension), facing left
$01:EE35              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Poses $08-$0C, then facing right (all $FF)
$01:EE3D              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$00 ; Facing right
$01:EE45              .db $00,$FF                     ; Facing right last two

}

;;; $EE47: Table: Yoshi body Y displacement per pose (YoshiPositionY) ;;;
{
$01:EE47              .db $00,$01,$01,$00,$04,$00,$00,$04 ; Head/body Y displacement by pose $00-$07
$01:EE4F              .db $03,$03,$00,$00,$04         ; Poses $08-$0C

}

;;; $EE54: Table: Yoshi head Y displacement per pose (YoshiHeadDispY) ;;;

$01:EE5C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$05         ; Poses $08-$0C

;;; $EE61: Yoshi: draw, wings, mouth and tongue state (HandleOffYoshi) ;;;
{
;; Per-frame Yoshi graphics and mouth logic. Handles the turn-around flip, draws head and body, sets up the
;;     dynamic tile DMA
;; source addresses ($0D8B-$0D97), draws the wings, then runs the tongue/mouth state machine ($F0A2).
;; Sub-routines in this section: $01EF18 draws head+body (two SubSprGfx2 calls) and picks the mouth tile
;;     (blink, open, swallow);
;; $01F0A2 runs the tongue state machine; $01F0D3 gives the reward for a swallowed item (berries, coin sound).
;; Key RAM (names inferred): [$1594,X] tongue state, [$151C,X] tongue length, [$160E,X] sprite index in mouth
;;     ($FF none),
;; [$18AC] hold-in-mouth timer, [$18AE] tongue wind-up timer, [$1564,X] swallow timer, [$1602,X] animation
;;     frame.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:EBAD: Mark Mario as riding Yoshi (BackOnYoshi)
;;     $01:EBE6: Yoshi sprite main routine (Yoshi)
$01:EE61 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; Save the Yoshi animation frame [$1602,X] for later
$01:EE64 48           PHA                             ; (saved frame is restored at $01EED8)
$01:EE65 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; Y = turn timer [$15AC,X]
$01:EE68 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; / Turn timer = 8 (halfway through the turn)?
$01:EE6A D0 11        BNE $EE7D                       ; No: skip the flip
$01:EE6C AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:EE6F 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; |
$01:EE71 D0 0A        BNE $EE7D                       ; } Skip the flip if Yoshi is in a pipe or sprites are locked
$01:EE73 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:EE76 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; | Mario direction = Yoshi direction (before the flip)
$01:EE78 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EE7A 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Flip Yoshi's direction
$01:EE7D AD 19 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; \
$01:EE80 30 08        BMI $EE8A                       ; | [$1419] (Yoshi in pipe) negative: skip
$01:EE82 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$01:EE84 D0 04        BNE $EE8A                       ; } Pipe state 2: use animation frame 3
$01:EE86 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:EE87 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; /
$01:EE8A 20 18 EF     JSR.W $EF18                     ; Draw head and body ($EF18), mouth tile chosen there
$01:EE8D A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; Y = OAM index of the head tile
$01:EE8F B9 02 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$01:EE92 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = tile number the head was drawn with (Yoshi GFX buffer tile)
$01:EE94 64 01        STZ $01                         ; /
$01:EE96 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:EE98 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Head OAM tile = $06 (fixed VRAM slot for the dynamic head graphics)
$01:EE9B BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the body tile
$01:EE9E B9 02 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$01:EEA1 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = tile number the body was drawn with
$01:EEA3 64 03        STZ $03                         ; /
$01:EEA5 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:EEA7 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Body OAM tile = $08 (fixed VRAM slot for the dynamic body graphics)
$01:EEAA C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:EEAC A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:EEAE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEAF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEB0 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEB1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEB2 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEB3 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EEB4 69 00 85     ADC.W #$8500                    ; } $0D8B = $8500 + head tile * 32: source of the head's top row in the DMA graphics buffer
$01:EEB7 8D 8B 0D     STA.W $0D8B                     ; /
$01:EEBA 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:EEBB 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; |
$01:EEBE 8D 95 0D     STA.W $0D95                     ; } $0D95 = $0D8B + $0200: head's bottom row (16 tiles later)
$01:EEC1 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; / (note: A = head tile number)
$01:EEC3 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:EEC4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEC5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEC6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEC7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:EEC8 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EEC9 69 00 85     ADC.W #$8500                    ; |
$01:EECC 8D 8D 0D     STA.W $0D8D                     ; } $0D8D = $8500 + body tile * 32: source of the body's top row
$01:EECF 18           CLC                             ; /
$01:EED0 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; \
$01:EED3 8D 97 0D     STA.W $0D97                     ; } $0D97 = $0D8D + $0200: body's bottom row
$01:EED6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; / A 8-bit
$01:EED8 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EED9 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Restore the original animation frame
$01:EEDC 20 A2 F0     JSR.W $F0A2                     ; Run the tongue and mouth state machine
$01:EEDF AD 10 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiHasWingsB        ; \
$01:EEE2 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$01:EEE4 90 31        BCC $EF17                       ; } Return if Yoshi has no wings ([$1410] < 2)
$01:EEE6 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$01:EEE9 F0 28        BEQ $EF13                       ; / Mario not on Yoshi: draw wings with A = 0
$01:EEEB A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:EEED D0 11        BNE $EF00                       ; / Mario flying with Yoshi? Then flap animation at $01EF00
$01:EEEF A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$01:EEF1 10 03        BPL $EEF6                       ; |
$01:EEF3 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:EEF5 1A           INC A                           ; } A = |Mario X speed|
$01:EEF6 C9 28        CMP.B #$28                      ; \
$01:EEF8 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; |
$01:EEFA B0 17        BCS $EF13                       ; } Wing frame A = 1 if |speed| >= $28, else 0
$01:EEFC A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$01:EEFE 80 13        BRA $EF13                       ; /

$01:EF00 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:EF02 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EF03 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EF04 A4 7D        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; |
$01:EF06 30 02        BMI $EF0A                       ; |
$01:EF08 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EF09 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:EF0A 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Wing frame bit from the frame counter (slower when Mario is moving down)
$01:EF0C D0 05        BNE $EF13                       ; / Frame bit set: no sound
$01:EF0E A0 21        LDY.B #$21                      ; \
$01:EF10 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; / Play wing flap sound effect
$01:EF13 22 23 BB 02  JSL.L $BB23                     ; Draw the wings; A = wing frame
$01:EF17 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:EF18 BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:EF1B 8C 5E 18     STY.W $185E                     ; } Y = frame; remember it in $185E
$01:EF1E B9 F9 ED     LDA.W YoshiHeadTiles,Y          ; \
$01:EF21 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; |
$01:EF24 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; } Head tile = YoshiHeadTiles[frame]; kept in $0F (bit 7 = hide head)
$01:EF26 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:EF28 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:EF29 18           CLC                             ; | Save Y position lo
$01:EF2A 79 47 EE     ADC.W YoshiPositionY,Y          ; |
$01:EF2D 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; } Y position += YoshiPositionY[frame] (body bob)
$01:EF2F BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:EF32 48           PHA                             ; | Save Y position hi
$01:EF33 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:EF35 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / ... with carry
$01:EF38 98           TYA                             ; A = frame
$01:EF39 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = Yoshi direction
$01:EF3C F0 03        BEQ $EF41                       ; Facing right (0): use the first half of the tables
$01:EF3E 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:EF3F 69 0D        ADC.B #$0D                      ; / Facing the other way: index += $0D
$01:EF41 A8           TAY                             ; Y = table index
$01:EF42 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:EF44 48           PHA                             ; | Save X position lo
$01:EF45 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EF46 79 13 EE     ADC.W YoshiHeadDispX,Y          ; |
$01:EF49 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } X position += YoshiHeadDispX[index] (head offset)
$01:EF4B BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:EF4E 48           PHA                             ; | Save X position hi
$01:EF4F 79 2D EE     ADC.W $EE2D,Y                   ; |
$01:EF52 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / ... high byte from $EE2D
$01:EF55 BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:EF58 48           PHA                             ; / Save OAM index
$01:EF59 BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:EF5C 0D 19 14     ORA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; |
$01:EF5F F0 05        BEQ $EF66                       ; } Turning or in a pipe: use OAM index 4 (different slot)
$01:EF61 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; |
$01:EF63 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; /
$01:EF66 BD EA 15     LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; \
$01:EF69 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / $0E = OAM index of the head
$01:EF6B 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the head tile
$01:EF6E DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:EF6F BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index
$01:EF72 AE 5E 18     LDX.W $185E                     ; X = frame
$01:EF75 B9 01 03     LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; \
$01:EF78 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EF79 7D 54 EE     ADC.W YoshiHeadDispY,X          ; |
$01:EF7C 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; } OAM Y += YoshiHeadDispY[frame]
$01:EF7F FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:EF80 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EF81 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EF82 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:EF84 9D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; } OAM index = saved index + 4 (body uses the next slot)
$01:EF87 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EF88 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; | Restore X position hi
$01:EF8B 68           PLA                             ; |
$01:EF8C 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Restore X position lo
$01:EF8E AC 5E 18     LDY.W $185E                     ; Y = frame
$01:EF91 B9 06 EE     LDA.W YoshiBodyTiles,Y          ; \
$01:EF94 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Body tile = YoshiBodyTiles[frame]
$01:EF97 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:EF99 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:EF9A 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:EF9C 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; } Y position += $10 (body is below the head)
$01:EF9E 90 03        BCC $EFA3                       ; |
$01:EFA0 FE D4 14     INC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / ... carry into Y hi
$01:EFA3 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the body tile
$01:EFA6 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EFA7 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / Restore Y position hi
$01:EFAA 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:EFAB 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore Y position lo
$01:EFAD A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; Y = OAM index of the head
$01:EFAF A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:EFB1 10 05        BPL $EFB8                       ; |
$01:EFB3 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; |
$01:EFB5 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; } Head tile table bit 7 set: hide the head (OAM Y = $F0)
$01:EFB8 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yoshi state [$C2,X]
$01:EFBA D0 0A        BNE $EFC6                       ; Non-zero: skip the blink
$01:EFBC A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:EFBE 29 30        AND.B #$30                      ; |
$01:EFC0 D0 19        BNE $EFDB                       ; } State 0: every 64 frames, 16 frames long, blink
$01:EFC2 A9 2A        LDA.B #$2A                      ; \
$01:EFC4 80 34        BRA $EFFA                       ; / Head tile = $2A (eyes closed)

$01:EFC6 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; State 2?
$01:EFC8 D0 11        BNE $EFDB                       ; No: go to the tongue checks
$01:EFCA BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:EFCD 0D C6 13     ORA.W $13C6                     ; |
$01:EFD0 D0 09        BNE $EFDB                       ; } Tongue out or cutscene: skip the idle expression
$01:EFD2 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:EFD4 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$01:EFD6 F0 25        BEQ $EFFD                       ; } Alternate head tile every 16 frames
$01:EFD8 80 1E        BRA $EFF8                       ; / ... tile $0C

$01:EFDA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:EFDB BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; Tongue state [$1594,X]
$01:EFDE C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$01:EFE0 F0 0C        BEQ $EFEE                       ; / State 3 (spit recovery): head tile $2A (mouth open)
$01:EFE2 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:EFE5 F0 0C        BEQ $EFF3                       ; / Tongue length 0: skip
$01:EFE7 B9 02 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$01:EFEA C9 24        CMP.B #$24                      ; |
$01:EFEC F0 05        BEQ $EFF3                       ; } Head tile already $24? skip; otherwise use $2A (mouth open)
$01:EFEE A9 2A        LDA.B #$2A                      ; \
$01:EFF0 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Head tile = $2A
$01:EFF3 AD AE 18     LDA.W $18AE                     ; \
$01:EFF6 F0 05        BEQ $EFFD                       ; / Tongue wind-up timer [$18AE] active?
$01:EFF8 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:EFFA 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Head tile = $0C (mouth winding up)
$01:EFFD BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; A = swallow timer [$1564,X]
$01:F000 AC AC 18     LDY.W $18AC                     ; \
$01:F003 F0 0A        BEQ $F00F                       ; / Y = hold timer [$18AC]; zero: go to swallow animation
$01:F005 C0 26        CPY.B #$26                      ; \
$01:F007 B0 2F        BCS $F038                       ; } Item held with timer >= $26: puffed cheeks tile (Y = 4)
$01:F009 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:F00B 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; |
$01:F00D D0 29        BNE $F038                       ; } Otherwise flash the cheeks every 8 frames
$01:F00F BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; A = swallow timer
$01:F012 C9 00        CMP.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F014 F0 C4        BEQ $EFDA                       ; / Timer 0: nothing to draw, return
$01:F016 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: default tile
$01:F018 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:F01A 90 1E        BCC $F03A                       ; / Timer < $0F: tile 0
$01:F01C C9 1C        CMP.B #$1C                      ; \
$01:F01E 90 18        BCC $F038                       ; / Timer < $1C: cheek tile Y = 4
$01:F020 D0 0D        BNE $F02F                       ; Not exactly $1C: skip the swallow action
$01:F022 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$01:F024 48           PHA                             ; | Save head OAM index
$01:F025 22 F3 D1 02  JSL.L SetTreeTile               ; | Turn the tree tile into the eaten state (berry removal)
$01:F029 20 D3 F0     JSR.W $F0D3                     ; | Swallow reward (SFX, coin, berries)
$01:F02C 68           PLA                             ; |
$01:F02D 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / Restore head OAM index
$01:F02F EE FB 13     INC.W $13FB                     ; Increment [$13FB] (probably a count of eaten items)
$01:F032 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Timer value 0
$01:F034 A0 2A        LDY.B #$2A                      ; Y = $2A: mouth tile
$01:F036 80 02        BRA $F03A                       ; Go store the tile

$01:F038 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = $04: cheek tile
$01:F03A 48           PHA                             ; Save timer
$01:F03B 98           TYA                             ; A = tile
$01:F03C A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; Y = head OAM index
$01:F03E 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Head OAM tile = A
$01:F041 68           PLA                             ; Restore timer
$01:F042 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:F044 B0 5A        BCS $F0A0                       ; / Timer >= $0F: done
$01:F046 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$01:F048 90 56        BCC $F0A0                       ; / Timer < 5: done
$01:F04A E9 05        SBC.B #$05                      ; A = timer - 5 (0-9): position along the throat
$01:F04C BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:F04F F0 03        BEQ $F054                       ; |
$01:F051 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F052 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; / Facing the other way: index += $0A
$01:F054 BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:F057 C0 0A        CPY.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F059 D0 03        BNE $F05E                       ; |
$01:F05B 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F05C 69 14        ADC.B #$14                      ; } Frame $0A: index += $14
$01:F05E 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = offset table index
$01:F060 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Sprite off screen?
$01:F063 D0 3B        BNE $F0A0                       ; Yes: return
$01:F065 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:F067 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F068 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } $00 = Yoshi screen X
$01:F06A 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$01:F06C B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:F06E 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F06F E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } $01 = Yoshi screen Y
$01:F071 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$01:F073 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F074 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = table index
$01:F076 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:F078 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F079 7F 76 C1 03  ADC.L $C176,X                   ; |
$01:F07D 8D 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX                 ; } OAM slot 0 X = screen X + $C176[index]
$01:F080 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:F082 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F083 7F 9E C1 03  ADC.L $C19E,X                   ; |
$01:F087 8D 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY                 ; } OAM slot 0 Y = screen Y + $C19E[index]
$01:F08A A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; \
$01:F08C 8D 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile                  ; / OAM slot 0 tile = $3F (small tile that travels along the neck, probably the swallowed item)
$01:F08F FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F090 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = Yoshi OAM index
$01:F093 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$01:F096 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F098 8D 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop                  ; } OAM slot 0 properties = Yoshi's, palette bit 0 set
$01:F09B A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F09D 8D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize              ; / OAM slot 0 size = small
$01:F0A0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F0A1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F0A2 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yoshi state [$C2,X]
