$01:F0A4 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:F0A6 D0 04        BNE $F0AC                       ; / Not 1 (Mario riding): skip
$01:F0A8 22 D4 D0 02  JSL.L $D0D4                     ; Tongue/berry tile interaction ($D0D4); only when nothing is in the mouth
$01:F0AC AD 10 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiHasWingsB        ; \
$01:F0AF C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F0B1 F0 EE        BEQ $F0A1                       ; } [$1410] = 1: return (unused fireball ability)
$01:F0B3 AD A3 14     LDA.W $14A3                     ; \
$01:F0B6 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; / Tongue animation timer [$14A3] = $10?
$01:F0B8 D0 0A        BNE $F0C4                       ; No: skip
$01:F0BA AD AE 18     LDA.W $18AE                     ; \
$01:F0BD D0 05        BNE $F0C4                       ; / Wind-up timer already running: skip
$01:F0BF A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:F0C1 8D AE 18     STA.W $18AE                     ; / [$18AE] = 6: start the wind-up
$01:F0C4 BD 94 15     LDA.W $1594,X                   ; \
$01:F0C7 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Jump on tongue state [$1594,X]

}

;;; $F0CB: Pointer table: Yoshi tongue states (Ptrs01F0CB) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$1594,X]: 0 idle ($01F14B), 1 tongue extending ($01F314), 2 tongue retracting ($01F332), 3 spit
;;     recovery ($01F12E).
;; Also contains $01F0D3 (swallow reward: SFX, coin, berry counters) and $01F12E (state 3).
$01:F0CB 4B F1        .dw $F14B                       ; State 0: idle
$01:F0CD 14 F3        .dw $F314                       ; State 1: tongue extending
$01:F0CF 32 F3        .dw $F332                       ; State 2: tongue retracting
$01:F0D1 2E F1        .dw $F12E                       ; State 3: spit recovery

$01:F0D3 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:F0D5 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play swallow sound effect
$01:F0D8 22 4A B3 05  JSL.L $B34A                     ; Give a coin ($B34A)
$01:F0DC AD D6 18     LDA.W $18D6                     ; \
$01:F0DF F0 4C        BEQ $F12D                       ; / [$18D6] (eaten item type) zero: return
$01:F0E1 9C D6 18     STZ.W $18D6                     ; Clear it
$01:F0E4 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$01:F0E6 D0 11        BNE $F0F9                       ; / Type 1 (red berry)?
$01:F0E8 EE D4 18     INC.W $18D4                     ; \
$01:F0EB AD D4 18     LDA.W $18D4                     ; |
$01:F0EE C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F0F0 D0 3B        BNE $F12D                       ; } Count it; return unless the count reaches 10
$01:F0F2 9C D4 18     STZ.W $18D4                     ; Reset the count
$01:F0F5 A9 74        LDA.B #$74                      ; \
$01:F0F7 80 2C        BRA $F125                       ; / Reward sprite $74

$01:F0F9 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$01:F0FB D0 19        BNE $F116                       ; / Type 3 (green berry)?
$01:F0FD A9 29        LDA.B #$29                      ; \
$01:F0FF 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $29
$01:F102 AD 32 0F     LDA.W $0F32                     ; \
$01:F105 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F106 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; |
$01:F108 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F10A 90 05        BCC $F111                       ; } Add 2 to the time counter's ones digit [$0F32] ...
$01:F10C E9 0A        SBC.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F10E EE 31 0F     INC.W $0F31                     ; / ... carrying into the tens digit [$0F31]
$01:F111 8D 32 0F     STA.W $0F32                     ; Store the ones digit
$01:F114 80 17        BRA $F12D                       ; Return

$01:F116 EE D5 18     INC.W $18D5                     ; \
$01:F119 AD D5 18     LDA.W $18D5                     ; |
$01:F11C C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$01:F11E D0 0D        BNE $F12D                       ; } Other berry: count it; return unless the count reaches 2
$01:F120 9C D5 18     STZ.W $18D5                     ; Reset the count
$01:F123 A9 6A        LDA.B #$6A                      ; Reward sprite $6A
$01:F125 8D DA 18     STA.W $18DA                     ; [$18DA] = reward sprite number
$01:F128 A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; \
$01:F12A 8C DE 18     STY.W $18DE                     ; / [$18DE] = $20: reward timer
$01:F12D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F12E BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:F131 D0 03        BNE $F136                       ; / State 3: wait for the recovery timer [$1558,X]
$01:F133 9E 94 15     STZ.W $1594,X                   ; Then back to state 0 (idle)
$01:F136 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F137: Table: ability from Yoshi and shell colors (YoshiShellAbility) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by (YoshiAbilityIndex[Yoshi color] << 2) | YoshiAbilityIndex[shell color]. Bit 1 = wings, bit 0 =
;;     stomp (ground pound).
$01:F137              .db $00,$00,$01,$02,$00,$00,$01,$02 ; Rows of 4: Yoshi color group 0, 1, 2, 3 (table is 14 bytes), by shell color group 0-3
$01:F13F              .db $01,$01,$01,$03,$02,$02     ; (continuation of the table)

}

;;; $F145: Yoshi tongue and spit logic (YoshiAbilityIndex) ;;;
{
;; Starts with the 6-byte table YoshiAbilityIndex (palette >> 1 -> color group 0-3 for YoshiShellAbility).
;; $01F14B (state 0, idle): grants wings/stomp while a Koopa shell is held in the mouth, counts down the hold
;;     timer and
;; swallows when it ends, runs the tongue wind-up timer, and on a Y/X press either starts the tongue or spits
;;     out the item.
;; Spitting: item placed in front of Yoshi, status $0A (kicked) or $09 (carryable); red shells/Yoshi turn it
;;     into 3 fireballs.
;; $01F295: spawn one Yoshi fireball (extended sprite $11). $01F2DF: spit sound and optional sprite change.
$01:F145              .db $03,$02,$02,$03,$01,$00     ; Color group per palette index (palette >> 1 & 7)

$01:F14B AD 95 1B     LDA.W $1B95                     ; \
$01:F14E F0 05        BEQ $F155                       ; / [$1B95] (Yoshi Wings bonus area flag) non-zero?
$01:F150 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:F152 8D 1E 14     STA.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; / Yoshi has wings ([$141E] = 2)
$01:F155 AD AC 18     LDA.W $18AC                     ; \
$01:F158 F0 48        BEQ $F1A2                       ; / Hold timer [$18AC] zero: nothing in mouth, skip to $01F1A2
$01:F15A BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = sprite held in the mouth
$01:F15D B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:F160 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; |
$01:F162 D0 03        BNE $F167                       ; } Held sprite is $80 (key)?
$01:F164 EE 1C 19     INC.W $191C                     ; Yes: [$191C]++
$01:F167 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; \
$01:F169 B0 37        BCS $F1A2                       ; / Sprite number >= $0D (not a Koopa): no ability, go to timer
$01:F16B 5A           PHY                             ; Save held sprite index
$01:F16C B9 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,Y                   ; \
$01:F16F C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F171 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; |
$01:F173 B0 20        BCS $F195                       ; } If [$187B,Y] non-zero (special shell), A = 3 (wings and stomp)
$01:F175 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:F178 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F179 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$01:F17B A8           TAY                             ; } Y = Yoshi's color index (palette >> 1 & 7)
$01:F17C B9 45 F1     LDA.W YoshiAbilityIndex,Y       ; \
$01:F17F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F180 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F181 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = YoshiAbilityIndex[Y] * 4
$01:F183 7A           PLY                             ; \
$01:F184 5A           PHY                             ; } Y = shell sprite index (kept on the stack)
$01:F185 B9 F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,Y           ; \
$01:F188 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F189 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$01:F18B A8           TAY                             ; } Y = shell's color index
$01:F18C B9 45 F1     LDA.W YoshiAbilityIndex,Y       ; \
$01:F18F 05 00        ORA $00                         ; |
$01:F191 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = (Yoshi group << 2) | shell group
$01:F192 B9 37 F1     LDA.W YoshiShellAbility,Y       ; / A = YoshiShellAbility[Y]
$01:F195 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:F196 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$01:F198 8D 1E 14     STA.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; } [$141E] = bit 1 of A: Yoshi has wings
$01:F19B 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:F19C 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F19E 8D E7 18     STA.W RAM_YoshiHasStomp         ; } [$18E7] = bit 0 of A: Yoshi has stomp
$01:F1A1 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:F1A2 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:F1A4 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / Only every 4th frame: otherwise go to $01F1C6
$01:F1A6 D0 1E        BNE $F1C6
$01:F1A8 AD AC 18     LDA.W $18AC                     ; \
$01:F1AB F0 19        BEQ $F1C6                       ; / Hold timer zero: skip
$01:F1AD CE AC 18     DEC.W $18AC                     ; \
$01:F1B0 D0 14        BNE $F1C6                       ; / [$18AC]--; when it reaches 0 swallow the item
$01:F1B2 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = held sprite
$01:F1B5 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F1B7 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Held sprite status = 0 (gone)
$01:F1BA 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:F1BB 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Nothing in mouth: [$160E,X] = $FF
$01:F1BE A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; \
$01:F1C0 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / Swallow timer [$1564,X] = $1B
$01:F1C3 4C D3 F0     JMP.W $F0D3                     ; Swallow reward

$01:F1C6 AD AE 18     LDA.W $18AE                     ; \
$01:F1C9 F0 14        BEQ $F1DF                       ; / Wind-up timer [$18AE] zero: go to input check
$01:F1CB CE AE 18     DEC.W $18AE                     ; \
$01:F1CE D0 0E        BNE $F1DE                       ; / [$18AE]--; return unless it reached 0
$01:F1D0 FE 94 15     INC.W $1594,X                   ; Tongue state = 1 (extending)
$01:F1D3 9E 1C 15     STZ.W $151C,X                   ; Tongue length = 0
$01:F1D6 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:F1D8 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Nothing caught yet: [$160E,X] = $FF
$01:F1DB 9E 64 15     STZ.W $1564,X                   ; Swallow timer = 0
$01:F1DE 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F1DF B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:F1E1 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F1E3 D0 F9        BNE $F1DE                       ; } Return unless Mario is riding (state 1)
$01:F1E5 24 16        BIT $16                         ; \
$01:F1E7 50 F5        BVC $F1DE                       ; } Return unless the Y/X button was just pressed
$01:F1E9 AD AC 18     LDA.W $18AC                     ; \
$01:F1EC D0 03        BNE $F1F1                       ; / Hold timer zero: nothing in mouth, so start the tongue
$01:F1EE 4C 09 F3     JMP.W $F309                     ; Start the tongue

$01:F1F1 9C AC 18     STZ.W $18AC                     ; Hold timer = 0 (item leaves the mouth)
$01:F1F4 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = held sprite
$01:F1F7 5A           PHY                             ; \
$01:F1F8 5A           PHY                             ; / Save it twice
$01:F1F9 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Y = Yoshi direction
$01:F1FC B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:F1FE 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F1FF 79 05 F3     ADC.W $F305,Y                   ; |
$01:F202 7A           PLY                             ; |
$01:F203 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; } Item X lo = Yoshi X lo + $F305[dir]
$01:F206 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:F209 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:F20C 79 07 F3     ADC.W $F307,Y                   ; |
$01:F20F 7A           PLY                             ; |
$01:F210 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; } Item X hi = Yoshi X hi + $F307[dir]
$01:F213 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:F215 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; } Item Y lo = Yoshi Y lo
$01:F218 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:F21B 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; } Item Y hi = Yoshi Y hi
$01:F21E A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F220 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; |
$01:F223 99 D0 15     STA.W $15D0,Y                   ; |
$01:F226 99 26 16     STA.W $1626,Y                   ; } Clear the item's state, [$15D0] (eaten flag) and [$1626]
$01:F229 AD DC 18     LDA.W $18DC                     ; \
$01:F22C C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F22E A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F230 90 02        BCC $F234                       ; |
$01:F232 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; } Status $0A (kicked), or $09 (carryable) if [$18DC] is non-zero
$01:F234 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Set item status
$01:F237 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F238 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:F23B 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / Item direction = Yoshi direction
$01:F23E AA           TAX                             ; X = direction
$01:F23F 90 02        BCC $F243                       ; \
$01:F241 E8           INX                             ; |
$01:F242 E8           INX                             ; } Status $09: use the gentle speeds (index + 2)
$01:F243 BD 01 F3     LDA.W $F301,X                   ; \
$01:F246 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; / Item X speed = $F301[X]
$01:F249 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F24B 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; / Item Y speed = 0
$01:F24E FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F24F A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:F251 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / [$1558,X] = $10: spit recovery timer
$01:F254 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:F256 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; / Tongue state = 3 (recovering)
$01:F259 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:F25B 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Mouth empty: [$160E,X] = $FF
$01:F25E B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:F261 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; |
$01:F263 B0 7A        BCS $F2DF                       ; } Item sprite number >= $0D (not a Koopa): normal spit
$01:F265 B9 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,Y                   ; \
$01:F268 D0 12        BNE $F27C                       ; / [$187B,Y] non-zero: breath fire
$01:F26A B9 F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,Y           ; \
$01:F26D 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; |
$01:F26F C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:F271 F0 09        BEQ $F27C                       ; } Item palette (and $0E) = 8: breath fire (probably red shell)
$01:F273 BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; \
$01:F276 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; |
$01:F278 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:F27A D0 63        BNE $F2DF                       ; } Yoshi palette = 8 (probably red Yoshi): breath fire, else normal spit
$01:F27C DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F27D BB           TYX                             ; X = item slot
$01:F27E 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Item status = 0: the shell vanishes
$01:F281 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:F283 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Fireball counter $00 = 2
$01:F285 20 95 F2     JSR.W $F295                     ; Spawn fireball 1
$01:F288 20 95 F2     JSR.W $F295                     ; Spawn fireball 2
$01:F28B 20 95 F2     JSR.W $F295                     ; Spawn fireball 3
$01:F28E FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F28F A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$01:F291 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play fire sound effect
$01:F294 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F295 20 EF 8E     JSR.W $8EEF                     ; Find a free extended sprite slot (Y)
$01:F298 A9 11        LDA.B #$11                      ; \
$01:F29A 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / Extended sprite = Yoshi fireball
$01:F29D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:F29F 99 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; / Fireball X lo = Yoshi X lo
$01:F2A2 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:F2A5 99 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y         ; / Fireball X hi
$01:F2A8 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:F2AA 99 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; / Fireball Y lo
$01:F2AD BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:F2B0 99 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y         ; / Fireball Y hi
$01:F2B3 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F2B5 99 79 17     STA.W $1779,Y                   ; / [$1779,Y] = 0
$01:F2B8 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F2B9 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:F2BC 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = Yoshi direction
$01:F2BD A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = fireball number
$01:F2BF BD D9 F2     LDA.W $F2D9,X                   ; A = $F2D9[X] (X speed)
$01:F2C2 90 03        BCC $F2C7                       ; \
$01:F2C4 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:F2C6 1A           INC A                           ; } Negate when facing the other way
$01:F2C7 99 47 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y         ; Store fireball X speed
$01:F2CA BD DC F2     LDA.W $F2DC,X                   ; \
$01:F2CD 99 3D 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y         ; / Fireball Y speed = $F2DC[X]
$01:F2D0 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$01:F2D2 99 6F 17     STA.W $176F,Y                   ; / Fireball lifetime [$176F,Y] = $A0
$01:F2D5 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F2D6 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Next fireball number
$01:F2D8 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F2D9..F2DC: Table: Yoshi fireball speeds ;;;
{
;; X speed ($28,$24,$24) then Y speed ($00,$F8,$08), indexed by fireball number 0-2.
$01:F2D9              .db $28,$24,$24                 ; X speeds: $28 straight, $24 up and $24 down

$01:F2DC              .db $00,$F8,$08                 ; Y speeds: $00 straight, $F8 up, $08 down

}

;;; $F2DF: Spit sound and sprite change ;;;
{
;; Plays the spit SFX; if the spat sprite's tweaker bit $40 is set, turns it into SpriteToSpawn[num] and
;;     reloads its tweaker tables.
;; Parameters: Y = spat sprite slot.
$01:F2DF A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:F2E1 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play spit sound effect
$01:F2E4 B9 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y         ; \
$01:F2E7 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; |
$01:F2E9 F0 13        BEQ $F2FE                       ; } Return unless tweaker $1686 bit 6 (changes sprite when spat out)
$01:F2EB DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F2EC BE 9E 00     LDX.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; X = sprite number
$01:F2EF BF C9 A7 01  LDA.L SpriteToSpawn,X           ; A = SpriteToSpawn[X]
$01:F2F3 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F2F4 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Sprite number = the new sprite
$01:F2F7 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F2F8 BB           TYX                             ; X = item slot
$01:F2F9 22 8B F7 07  JSL.L LoadSpriteTables          ; Reload tweaker bytes for the new sprite
$01:F2FD FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F2FE 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F2FF..F307: Table: spit speeds and offsets ;;;
{
;; $01F2FF: unreferenced here ($20,$E0). $01F301: item X speed ($30,$D0 kick; $10,$F0 gentle). $01F305/07:
;;     item X offset lo/hi from Yoshi (+$10 / -$10).
$01:F2FF              .db $20,$E0                     ; Unreferenced here: $20, $E0

$01:F301              .db $30,$D0,$10,$F0             ; Item X speed: $30 right, $D0 left (kick); $10, $F0 (gentle drop)

$01:F305              .db $10,$F0                     ; Item X offset lo: +$10 right, -$10 left

$01:F307              .db $00,$FF                     ; Item X offset hi: $00, $FF

}

;;; $F309: Tongue start and tongue states 1-2 ;;;
{
;; $01F309: starts the tongue ([$14A3] = $12, SFX). $01F314: tongue extending, +3 per frame up to $20.
;;     $01F332: tongue retracting
;; after a short pause, -4 per frame; when fully back, decides if the caught sprite stays in the mouth or is
;;     swallowed.
;; Swallowed items: status 0, swallow timer $1B, special cases for Changing Item and (unreachable) Bubble;
;;     tweaker $167A bit 6 gives a power-up.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:F1EE: Yoshi tongue and spit logic (YoshiAbilityIndex)
$01:F309 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$01:F30B 8D A3 14     STA.W $14A3                     ; / Tongue animation timer [$14A3] = $12
$01:F30E A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$01:F310 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play tongue sound effect
$01:F313 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F314 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:F317 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F318 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; |
$01:F31A 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; } Tongue length [$151C,X] += 3
$01:F31D C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; \
$01:F31F B0 07        BCS $F328                       ; / Length >= $20: fully out, go to $01F328
$01:F321 20 FE F3     JSR.W $F3FE                     ; Draw the tongue ($F3FE)
$01:F324 20 B2 F4     JSR.W $F4B2                     ; Check tongue contact with sprites ($F4B2)
$01:F327 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F328 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:F32A 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Pause [$1558,X] = 8 before retracting
$01:F32D FE 94 15     INC.W $1594,X                   ; Tongue state = 2 (retracting)
$01:F330 80 EF        BRA $F321                       ; Continue to draw

$01:F332 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:F335 D0 EA        BNE $F321                       ; / Pause timer running: just draw
$01:F337 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:F33A 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F33B E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:F33D 30 05        BMI $F344                       ; } Tongue length -= 4; go to $01F344 if it goes negative
$01:F33F 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; Store new length
$01:F342 80 DD        BRA $F321                       ; Draw the tongue

$01:F344 9E 1C 15     STZ.W $151C,X                   ; Tongue fully in: length = 0
$01:F347 9E 94 15     STZ.W $1594,X                   ; Tongue state = 0 (idle)
$01:F34A BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:F34D 30 21        BMI $F370                       ; / Y = caught sprite; none: done
$01:F34F B9 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y         ; \
$01:F352 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$01:F354 F0 1D        BEQ $F373                       ; } Tweaker $1686 bit 1 clear: swallow it at once
$01:F356 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$01:F358 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Status 7: stuck in Yoshi's mouth
$01:F35B A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:F35D 8D AC 18     STA.W $18AC                     ; / Hold timer [$18AC] = $FF
$01:F360 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:F363 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; |
$01:F365 B0 09        BCS $F370                       ; } Not a Koopa (>= $0D): keep sprite
$01:F367 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F368 AA           TAX                             ; X = sprite number
$01:F369 BD C9 A7     LDA.W SpriteToSpawn,X           ; A = SpriteToSpawn[X]
$01:F36C 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Koopa becomes its shell form
$01:F36F FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F370 4C FA F3     JMP.W $F3FA                     ; Go draw the tongue ($01F3FA)

$01:F373 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F375 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / Caught sprite status = 0 (swallowed)
$01:F378 A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; \
$01:F37A 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / Swallow timer [$1564,X] = $1B
$01:F37D A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:F37F 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Mouth empty: [$160E,X] = $FF
$01:F382 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = caught sprite slot
$01:F384 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:F387 C9 9D        CMP.B #$9D                      ; |
$01:F389 D0 14        BNE $F39F                       ; } Sprite $9D (bubble)?
$01:F38B B9 C2 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; (unused) Bubble contents state ...
$01:F38E C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; ... equals 3?
$01:F390 D0 0D        BNE $F39F                       ; No: skip
$01:F392 A9 74        LDA.B #$74                      ; \
$01:F394 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / (unused) Sprite becomes a Mushroom
$01:F397 B9 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,Y         ; \
$01:F39A 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; |
$01:F39C 99 7A 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,Y         ; } (unused) Set tweaker $167A bit 6: gives power-up when eaten
$01:F39F B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:F3A2 C9 81        CMP.B #$81                      ; |
$01:F3A4 D0 14        BNE $F3BA                       ; } Sprite $81 (Changing Item)?
$01:F3A6 B9 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,Y                   ; \
$01:F3A9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F3AA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F3AB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F3AC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F3AD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F3AE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F3AF 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:F3B1 A8           TAY                             ; } (unused) Y = [$187B,Y] >> 6 & 3
$01:F3B2 B9 13 C3     LDA.W ChangingItemSprite,Y      ; (unused) A = ChangingItemSprite[Y]
$01:F3B5 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; (unused) Y = caught sprite slot
$01:F3B7 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; (unused) Sprite number = the item
$01:F3BA 48           PHA                             ; Save sprite number
$01:F3BB A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = caught sprite slot
$01:F3BD B9 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,Y         ; \
$01:F3C0 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F3C1 0A           ASL                             ; } Carry = tweaker $167A bit 6 (gives power-up when eaten)
$01:F3C2 68           PLA                             ; Restore A
$01:F3C3 90 16        BCC $F3DB                       ; Bit clear: skip to $01F3DB (outside this chunk)
$01:F3C5 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F3C6 BB           TYX                             ; X = caught sprite slot
$01:F3C7 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Its state = 0
$01:F3C9 20 BF C4     JSR.W $C4BF                     ; Process the power-up item ($C4BF, probably collect)
$01:F3CC FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F3CD AC DC 18     LDY.W $18DC                     ; Y = [$18DC]
$01:F3D0 B9 D9 F3     LDA.W $F3D9,Y                   ; \
$01:F3D3 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Yoshi frame = $F3D9[Y]
$01:F3D6 4C 21 F3     JMP.W $F321                     ; Draw the tongue


}

;;; $F3D9..F3D9: Table: Yoshi frame after eating ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [$18DC]: Yoshi animation frame $00 or $04.
$01:F3D9              .db $00,$04                     ; Yoshi frame: $00, $04

}

;;; $F3DB: Yoshi: swallow sprite and draw tongue ;;;
{
;; Tail of Yoshi's swallow routine (sprite $7E gives wings, others give the normal reward) and then the tongue
;;     code.
;; $F3FE draws the tongue as 5 OAM tiles from Yoshi's mouth, spaced by [$151C]/4. $F4B2 moves the
;;     sprite in Yoshi's mouth with the tongue tip, or ($160E negative) searches all sprites for one the tongue
;;     touches.
$01:F3DB C9 7E        CMP.B #$7E                      ; Eaten sprite is $7E (Yoshi wings item)?
$01:F3DD D0 18        BNE $F3F7                       ; No: ordinary swallow ($F3F7)
$01:F3DF B9 C2 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; Sprite state of the $7E sprite (0 = not active yet)
$01:F3E2 F0 13        BEQ $F3F7                       ; Zero: treat as an ordinary swallow
$01:F3E4 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; State = 2?
$01:F3E6 D0 09        BNE $F3F1                       ; No: skip the animation and sound
$01:F3E8 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Mario animation = 8
$01:F3EA 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; Mario animation [$71] = 8
$01:F3EC A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:F3EE 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect 3 (SFX port $1DFC)
$01:F3F1 20 CD F6     JSR.W $F6CD                     ; Give Yoshi wings ($F6CD)
$01:F3F4 4C 21 F3     JMP.W $F321                     ; Continue the Yoshi routine ($F321)

$01:F3F7 20 D3 F0     JSR.W $F0D3                     ; Ordinary swallow: play sound, award points/item ($F0D3)
$01:F3FA 4C 21 F3     JMP.W $F321                     ; Continue the Yoshi routine ($F321)

$01:F3FD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F3FE BD A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; \
$01:F401 1D 6C 18     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X       ; |
$01:F404 0D 19 14     ORA.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; |
$01:F407 D0 F4        BNE $F3FD                       ; / Skip drawing the tongue if Yoshi is off-screen or entering a pipe
$01:F409 BC 02 16     LDY.W $1602,X                   ; Y = Yoshi's current frame index ([$1602])
$01:F40C B9 1A F6     LDA.W $F61A,Y                   ; A = tongue Y offset for this frame
$01:F40F 8D 5E 18     STA.W $185E                     ; $185E = tongue Y offset (kept for the eaten-sprite code)
$01:F412 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F413 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$01:F415 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F416 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; / A = tongue Y offset + Yoshi Y - screen Y (on-screen Y)
$01:F418 85 01        STA $01                         ; $01 = on-screen Y of the tongue
$01:F41A BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Yoshi's direction (0 = right, 1 = left)
$01:F41D D0 05        BNE $F424                       ; Facing left: use the first half of the X offset table
$01:F41F 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:F420 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F421 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:F423 A8           TAY                             ; / Facing right: Y += 8, use the second half of the X offset table
$01:F424 B9 0A F6     LDA.W $F60A,Y                   ; A = tongue X offset for this frame and direction
$01:F427 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; $0D = tongue X offset from Yoshi
$01:F429 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:F42B 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F42C E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:F42E 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F42F 65 0D        ADC $0D                         ; / A = on-screen X of the tongue base = Yoshi X - screen X + [$0D]
$01:F431 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = on-screen X of the next tongue tile
$01:F433 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Yoshi's direction
$01:F436 D0 04        BNE $F43C                       ; Facing left: go to the left-facing overflow check
$01:F438 B0 C3        BCS $F3FD                       ; Facing right: base wrapped past the right edge, no tongue drawn
$01:F43A 80 02        BRA $F43E                       ; Continue

$01:F43C 90 BF        BCC $F3FD                       ; Facing left: base wrapped past the left edge, no tongue drawn
$01:F43E BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; Tongue length [$151C] ...
$01:F441 8D 05 42     STA.W $4205                     ; Dividend high byte = tongue length
$01:F444 9C 04 42     STZ.W $4204                     ; Dividend low byte = 0
$01:F447 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Divisor = 4
$01:F449 8D 06 42     STA.W $4206                     ; Hardware divide: result = length * 64 (high byte = length / 4)
$01:F44C EA           NOP                             ; \
$01:F44D EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:F44E EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:F44F EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:F450 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:F451 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:F452 EA           NOP                             ; |
$01:F453 EA           NOP                             ; / Wait for the hardware divide to finish
$01:F454 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; Yoshi's direction
$01:F457 85 07        STA $07                         ; $07 = direction
$01:F459 4A           LSR                             ; Carry = 1 if facing left
$01:F45A AD 15 42     LDA.W $4215                     ; A = quotient high byte = tongue length / 4
$01:F45D 90 03        BCC $F462                       ; Facing right: keep it positive
$01:F45F 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:F461 1A           INC A                           ; / Facing left: negate (spacing between tongue tiles goes left)
$01:F462 85 05        STA $05                         ; $05 = X spacing between tongue tiles
$01:F464 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4
$01:F466 85 06        STA $06                         ; $06 = tile counter (5 tiles, 4 down to 0)
$01:F468 A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; Y = OAM index $0C (starts at sprite slot 3)
$01:F46A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = X position of this tile
$01:F46C 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; Store tile X in OAM
$01:F46F 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F470 65 05        ADC $05                         ; / Advance X by the spacing
$01:F472 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = X of the next tile
$01:F474 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; A = spacing (sign test)
$01:F476 10 04        BPL $F47C                       ; Positive spacing: check for carry out
$01:F478 90 37        BCC $F4B1                       ; Negative: no carry means wrapped off the left edge, stop
$01:F47A 80 02        BRA $F47E                       ; Draw it

$01:F47C B0 33        BCS $F4B1                       ; Positive: carry means wrapped off the right edge, stop
$01:F47E A5 01        LDA $01                         ; A = on-screen Y of the tongue
$01:F480 99 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y       ; Store tile Y in OAM
$01:F483 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; Remaining tiles counter
$01:F485 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Last tile (counter 0)?
$01:F487 A9 76        LDA.B #$76                      ; A = $76: tongue body tile
$01:F489 B0 02        BCS $F48D                       ; Not the last tile: use the body tile
$01:F48B A9 66        LDA.B #$66                      ; Last tile: A = $66, the tongue tip
$01:F48D 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; Store tile number in OAM
$01:F490 A5 07        LDA $07                         ; Yoshi's direction
$01:F492 4A           LSR                             ; Carry = 1 if facing left
$01:F493 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; A = $09: palette 4, priority from table, no flip
$01:F495 B0 02        BCS $F499                       ; Facing left: no flip
$01:F497 09 40        ORA.B #$40                      ; Facing right: flip X
$01:F499 05 64        ORA $64                         ; Add the sprite priority bits [$64]
$01:F49B 99 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y        ; Store tile properties in OAM
$01:F49E 5A           PHY                             ; \
$01:F49F 98           TYA                             ; |
$01:F4A0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F4A1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F4A2 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = OAM index / 4 (index into the size table)
$01:F4A3 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: 8x8 tile, X bit 8 clear
$01:F4A5 99 20 04     STA.W $0420,Y                   ; Store in the OAM size table at $0420
$01:F4A8 7A           PLY                             ; \
$01:F4A9 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:F4AA C8           INY                             ; |
$01:F4AB C8           INY                             ; |
$01:F4AC C8           INY                             ; / Restore Y and advance to the next OAM slot (Y += 4)
$01:F4AD C6 06        DEC $06                         ; Next tile
$01:F4AF 10 B9        BPL $F46A                       ; Loop for all 5 tiles
$01:F4B1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F4B2 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; Index of the sprite held in Yoshi's mouth ([$160E])
$01:F4B5 30 6D        BMI $F524                       ; None ($FF): look for a sprite to eat ($F524)
$01:F4B7 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the X offset
$01:F4B9 A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; A = tongue base X offset [$0D]
$01:F4BB 30 06        BMI $F4C3                       ; Facing left (negative offset): go to $F4C3
$01:F4BD 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F4BE 7D 1C 15     ADC.W $151C,X                   ; / Right: A = X offset + tongue length [$151C]
$01:F4C1 80 09        BRA $F4CC                       ; Continue

$01:F4C3 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:F4C6 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:F4C8 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:F4C9 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F4CA 65 0D        ADC $0D                         ; / Left: A = X offset - tongue length
$01:F4CC 38           SEC                             ; \
$01:F4CD E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; / A -= 4 (center the sprite on the tongue tip)
$01:F4CF 10 01        BPL $F4D2                       ; Positive result: Y stays 0
$01:F4D1 88           DEY                             ; Negative: Y = $FF (sign extension)
$01:F4D2 5A           PHY                             ; Save the high byte
$01:F4D3 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F4D4 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / A = Yoshi X low + offset
$01:F4D6 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = eaten sprite index
$01:F4D9 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; Eaten sprite X low = tongue tip X
$01:F4DC 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the high byte
$01:F4DD 98           TYA                             ; A = high byte
$01:F4DE 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Add Yoshi's X high (with carry)
$01:F4E1 BC 0E 16     LDY.W $160E,X                   ; Y = eaten sprite index
$01:F4E4 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; Eaten sprite X high
$01:F4E7 A9 FC        LDA.B #$FC                      ; A = $FC
$01:F4E9 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = Y offset $FC (default)
$01:F4EB B9 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,Y         ; Eaten sprite tweaker $1662
$01:F4EE 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; Bit 6 set?
$01:F4F0 D0 0B        BNE $F4FD                       ; Yes: keep the $FC offset
$01:F4F2 B9 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,Y         ; \
$01:F4F5 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; |
$01:F4F7 F0 04        BEQ $F4FD                       ; / Tweaker $190F bit 5 (death frame 2 tiles high) clear: keep $FC
$01:F4F9 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; Tall sprite: A = $F8
$01:F4FB 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = Y offset $F8
$01:F4FD 64 01        STZ $01                         ; $01 = Y high offset = 0
$01:F4FF A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = Y offset
$01:F501 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F502 6D 5E 18     ADC.W $185E                     ; / A = Y offset + tongue Y offset ($185E)
$01:F505 10 02        BPL $F509                       ; Positive: Y high stays 0
$01:F507 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; Negative: Y high offset = $FF
$01:F509 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F50A 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / A = Yoshi Y low + offset
$01:F50C 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; Eaten sprite Y low
$01:F50F BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Yoshi Y high
$01:F512 65 01        ADC $01                         ; Add the Y high offset
$01:F514 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; Eaten sprite Y high
$01:F517 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$01:F519 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; Eaten sprite Y speed = 0
$01:F51C 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; Eaten sprite X speed = 0
$01:F51F 1A           INC A                           ; A = 1
$01:F520 99 D0 15     STA.W $15D0,Y                   ; Eaten sprite flag $15D0 = 1 (being eaten)
$01:F523 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F524 5A           PHY                             ; No sprite held yet: save Y
$01:F525 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte of the X offset
$01:F527 A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; A = tongue base X offset [$0D]
$01:F529 30 06        BMI $F531                       ; Facing left (negative offset): go to $F531
$01:F52B 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F52C 7D 1C 15     ADC.W $151C,X                   ; / Right: A = X offset + tongue length
$01:F52F 80 09        BRA $F53A                       ; Continue

$01:F531 BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; \
$01:F534 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:F536 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:F537 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F538 65 0D        ADC $0D                         ; / Left: A = X offset - tongue length
$01:F53A 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F53B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; / A += 0 (no adjustment for the contact point)
$01:F53D 10 01        BPL $F540                       ; Positive: Y stays 0
$01:F53F 88           DEY                             ; Negative: Y = $FF
$01:F540 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F541 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / A = Yoshi X low + offset (tongue tip X)
$01:F543 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = tongue tip X low
$01:F545 98           TYA                             ; A = high byte
$01:F546 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; Add Yoshi's X high
$01:F549 85 08        STA $08                         ; $08 = tongue tip X high
$01:F54B 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:F54C AD 5E 18     LDA.W $185E                     ; \
$01:F54F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F550 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; |
$01:F552 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F553 75 D8        ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / A = tongue Y offset + 2 + Yoshi Y low
$01:F555 85 01        STA $01                         ; $01 = tongue tip Y low
$01:F557 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Yoshi Y high
$01:F55A 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; Add carry
$01:F55C 85 09        STA $09                         ; $09 = tongue tip Y high
$01:F55E A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8
$01:F560 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = tongue hitbox width
$01:F562 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4
$01:F564 85 03        STA $03                         ; $03 = tongue hitbox height
$01:F566 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Loop over all 12 sprite slots (Y = 11..0)
$01:F568 8C 95 16     STY.W $1695                     ; $1695 = loop counter
$01:F56B CC E9 15     CPY.W $15E9                     ; Is this Yoshi himself?
$01:F56E F0 16        BEQ $F586                       ; Yes: skip
$01:F570 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; Already holding a sprite?
$01:F573 10 11        BPL $F586                       ; Yes ($160E positive): skip
$01:F575 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:F578 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:F57A 90 0A        BCC $F586                       ; / Skip sprite if status < 8 (not alive)
$01:F57C B9 32 16     LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,Y       ; \
$01:F57F D0 05        BNE $F586                       ; / Skip sprite if it is behind scenery
$01:F581 5A           PHY                             ; Save the loop counter
$01:F582 20 8E F5     JSR.W TryEatSprite              ; Check whether the tongue touches it
$01:F585 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the loop counter
$01:F586 88           DEY                             ; Next sprite
$01:F587 10 DF        BPL $F568                       ; Loop for all sprites
$01:F589 22 FA B9 02  JSL.L $B9FA                     ; Extra tongue check ($B9FA, probably Yoshi vs. berries/ blocks)
$01:F58D 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $F58E: Check tongue contact with sprite (TryEatSprite) ;;;
{
;; Tests whether sprite Y touches Yoshi's tongue hitbox. Inedible sprites play a sound; edible ones fall into
;;     EatSprite.
;; Parameters: X: Yoshi, Y: candidate sprite.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:F582: Yoshi: swallow sprite and draw tongue
$01:F58E DA           PHX                             ; Save Yoshi's index
$01:F58F BB           TYX                             ; X = candidate sprite
$01:F590 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Get the candidate's clipping box (A)
$01:F594 FA           PLX                             ; X = Yoshi
$01:F595 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Tongue hitbox ($00-$03, $08-$09) touching the sprite?
$01:F599 90 6E        BCC $F609                       ; No: return
$01:F59B B9 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y         ; \
$01:F59E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F59F 90 06        BCC EatSprite                   ; / If the sprite is inedible (tweaker $1686 bit 0 set)
$01:F5A1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:F5A3 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 1 (SFX port $1DF9)
$01:F5A6 60           RTS                             ; Return

}

;;; $F5A7: Eat sprite: Pokey check (EatSprite) ;;;
{
;; Pokey sprites ($70) are split (SpltPokeyInto2Sprs); everything else goes to $F5FB.
$01:F5A7 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; \
$01:F5AA C9 70        CMP.B #$70                      ; |
$01:F5AC D0 4D        BNE $F5FB                       ; / Branch if the sprite being eaten is not a Pokey
}

;;; $F5AE: Split Pokey when eaten (SpltPokeyInto2Sprs) ;;;
{
;; Removes the eaten segments from the Pokey, spawns a new Pokey at the tongue tip with the remaining
;;     segments, then marks the sprite as in Yoshi's mouth ($160E), tongue state 2 and timer $1558 = $0A.
$01:F5AE 8C 5E 18     STY.W $185E                     ; $185E = index of the sprite being eaten
$01:F5B1 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$01:F5B3 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F5B4 F9 D8 00     SBC.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$01:F5B7 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F5B8 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; / A = tongue Y - Pokey Y: which segment was touched
$01:F5BA DA           PHX                             ; Save Yoshi's index
$01:F5BB BB           TYX                             ; X = Pokey
$01:F5BC 22 1C B8 02  JSL.L RemovePokeySegment        ; Remove the segments below the touched one from the Pokey
$01:F5C0 FA           PLX                             ; X = Yoshi
$01:F5C1 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; \
$01:F5C5 30 42        BMI $F609                       ; / Return if there is no free sprite slot
$01:F5C7 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:F5C9 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:F5CC A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$01:F5CE 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / New sprite = Pokey ($70)
$01:F5D1 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; Tongue tip X low
$01:F5D3 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; New Pokey X low
$01:F5D6 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; Tongue tip X high
$01:F5D8 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; New Pokey X high
$01:F5DB A5 01        LDA $01                         ; Tongue tip Y low
$01:F5DD 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; New Pokey Y low
$01:F5E0 A5 09        LDA $09                         ; Tongue tip Y high
$01:F5E2 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; New Pokey Y high
$01:F5E5 DA           PHX                             ; Save Yoshi's index
$01:F5E6 BB           TYX                             ; X = new Pokey
$01:F5E7 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset the new sprite's tables
$01:F5EB AE 5E 18     LDX.W $185E                     ; X = old Pokey
$01:F5EE B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Old Pokey segment bits
$01:F5F0 25 0D        AND $0D                         ; Keep the segments below the break [$0D]
$01:F5F2 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; New Pokey keeps those segments
$01:F5F5 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$01:F5F7 99 34 15     STA.W $1534,Y                   ; New Pokey flag $1534 = 1
$01:F5FA FA           PLX                             ; X = Yoshi
$01:F5FB 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:F5FC 9D 0E 16     STA.W $160E,X                   ; / Yoshi's mouth sprite [$160E] = sprite being eaten
$01:F5FF A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$01:F601 9D 94 15     STA.W $1594,X                   ; Yoshi tongue state $1594 = 2 (retracting)
$01:F604 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; A = $0A
$01:F606 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; Timer $1558 = $0A
$01:F609 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F60A..F612: Data: tongue X offsets per frame ;;;
{
$01:F60A              .db $F5,$F5,$F5,$F5,$F5,$F5,$F5,$F0 ; Tongue X offset, facing left (8 frames)
$01:F612              .db $13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$13,$18 ; Tongue X offset, facing right (8 frames)
}

;;; $F61A..F61A: Data: tongue Y offsets per frame ;;;
{
$01:F61A              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$13 ; Tongue Y offset per Yoshi frame

}

;;; $F622: Yoshi vs. other sprites contact ;;;
{
;; Every frame, loops over sprites (half per frame) and checks contact with Yoshi's hitbox. Handles the wing
;;     item ($7E), kicked sprites that knock Mario off Yoshi, and specific enemies.
;; $F74C: (long) start hatching an egg.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:ED76: Put Mario on Yoshi (SetOnYoshi)
$01:F622 BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:F625 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; |
$01:F627 D0 3E        BNE $F667                       ; / Return if Yoshi's timer $163E is set or sprites are locked
$01:F629 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = 11: loop over sprite slots
$01:F62B 8C 95 16     STY.W $1695                     ; $1695 = loop counter
$01:F62E 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:F62F 45 13        EOR RAM_FrameCounter            ; |
$01:F631 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F633 D0 2C        BNE $F661                       ; / Check only every other sprite per frame (index xor frame counter, bit 0)
$01:F635 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:F636 DD 0E 16     CMP.W $160E,X                   ; |
$01:F639 F0 26        BEQ $F661                       ; / Skip the sprite Yoshi is holding
$01:F63B CC E9 15     CPY.W $15E9                     ; \
$01:F63E F0 21        BEQ $F661                       ; / Skip Yoshi himself
$01:F640 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:F643 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:F645 90 1A        BCC $F661                       ; / Skip sprite if status < 8
$01:F647 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Load sprite number (unused result)
$01:F64A B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; \
$01:F64D C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; |
$01:F64F F0 10        BEQ $F661                       ; / Skip sprite if status = 9 (carried/kicked item)
$01:F651 B9 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,Y         ; \
$01:F654 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$01:F656 19 D0 15     ORA.W $15D0,Y                   ; |
$01:F659 19 32 16     ORA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,Y       ; |
$01:F65C D0 03        BNE $F661                       ; / Skip if tweaker $167A bit 1, $15D0 (being eaten) or behind scenery
$01:F65E 20 68 F6     JSR.W $F668                     ; Check contact with Yoshi and react ($F668)
$01:F661 AC 95 16     LDY.W $1695                     ; Restore the loop counter
$01:F664 88           DEY                             ; Next sprite
$01:F665 10 C4        BPL $F62B                       ; Loop for all sprites
$01:F667 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F668 DA           PHX                             ; Save Yoshi's index
$01:F669 BB           TYX                             ; X = other sprite
$01:F66A 22 E5 B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB        ; Other sprite's clipping box (B)
$01:F66E FA           PLX                             ; X = Yoshi
$01:F66F 22 9F B6 03  JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA        ; Yoshi's clipping box (A)
$01:F673 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Boxes touching?
$01:F677 90 EE        BCC $F667                       ; No: return
$01:F679 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Other sprite number
$01:F67C C9 9D        CMP.B #$9D                      ; \
$01:F67E F0 E7        BEQ $F667                       ; / Sprite $9D (bubble): ignore
$01:F680 C9 15        CMP.B #$15                      ; Sprite $15 (swimming Cheep Cheep)?
$01:F682 F0 1A        BEQ $F69E                       ; Yes: check $164A (in water) at $F69E
$01:F684 C9 16        CMP.B #$16                      ; Sprite $16 (swimming Cheep Cheep)?
$01:F686 F0 16        BEQ $F69E                       ; Yes: check $164A
$01:F688 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; Sprite >= 4: skip to the general check
$01:F68A B0 17        BCS $F6A3                       ; Yes: general check
$01:F68C C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Sprite $02?
$01:F68E F0 13        BEQ $F6A3                       ; Yes: general check
$01:F690 B9 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,Y                   ; Sprites $00, $01, $03: timer $163E (negative = bit 7 set)?
$01:F693 10 0E        BPL $F6A3                       ; Not negative: general check
$01:F695 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$01:F696 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:F697 BB           TYX                             ; X = other sprite
$01:F698 20 2A B1     JSR.W $B12A                     ; Run the sprite's hit reaction ($B12A)
$01:F69B FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F69C 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$01:F69D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F69E B9 4A 16     LDA.W $164A,Y                   ; Sprite flag $164A
$01:F6A1 F0 F2        BEQ $F695                       ; Zero: react as at $F695
$01:F6A3 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Other sprite number
$01:F6A6 C9 BF        CMP.B #$BF                      ; Sprite $BF (Mega Mole)?
$01:F6A8 D0 0A        BNE $F6B4                       ; No: continue at $F6B4
$01:F6AA A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$01:F6AC 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F6AD F9 D8 00     SBC.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; / A = Mario Y - sprite Y
$01:F6B0 C9 E8        CMP.B #$E8                      ; Less than -$18?
$01:F6B2 30 28        BMI $F6DC                       ; Yes: return
$01:F6B4 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Other sprite number
$01:F6B7 C9 7E        CMP.B #$7E                      ; Sprite $7E (Yoshi wings item)?
$01:F6B9 D0 22        BNE $F6DD                       ; No: continue at $F6DD
$01:F6BB B9 C2 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; Its state
$01:F6BE F0 1C        BEQ $F6DC                       ; 0: return
$01:F6C0 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; State = 2?
$01:F6C2 D0 09        BNE $F6CD                       ; No: just give wings
$01:F6C4 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8
$01:F6C6 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; Mario animation [$71] = 8
$01:F6C8 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:F6CA 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect 3 (SFX port $1DFC)
$01:F6CD A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; A = $40
$01:F6CF 8D AA 14     STA.W $14AA                     ; $14AA = $40 (timer for the wings effect)
$01:F6D2 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$01:F6D4 8D 1E 14     STA.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; / Yoshi has wings = 2
$01:F6D7 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$01:F6D9 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Remove the item sprite (status 0)
$01:F6DC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F6DD C9 4E        CMP.B #$4E                      ; Sprite $4E?
$01:F6DF F0 04        BEQ $F6E5                       ; Yes: check state
$01:F6E1 C9 4D        CMP.B #$4D                      ; Sprite $4D?
$01:F6E3 D0 07        BNE $F6EC                       ; No: continue at $F6EC
$01:F6E5 B9 C2 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; Sprite state
$01:F6E8 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; State < 2?
$01:F6EA 90 F0        BCC $F6DC                       ; Yes: return
$01:F6EC A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$01:F6EE 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F6EF 69 0D        ADC.B #$0D                      ; |
$01:F6F1 C5 01        CMP $01                         ; / Compare [$05]+$0D with Yoshi's tongue Y [$01]
$01:F6F3 30 56        BMI $F74B                       ; Sprite is lower than that: return
$01:F6F5 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Other sprite status
$01:F6F8 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Status $0A (kicked)?
$01:F6FA D0 12        BNE $F70E                       ; No: skip the direction check
$01:F6FC DA           PHX                             ; Save Yoshi's index
$01:F6FD BB           TYX                             ; X = kicked sprite
$01:F6FE 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side Mario is on relative to the sprite
$01:F701 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = that side
$01:F703 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Kicked sprite's X speed
$01:F705 FA           PLX                             ; X = Yoshi
$01:F706 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:F707 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:F708 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; / A = sign bit of the X speed (1 = moving left)
$01:F70A C5 00        CMP $00                         ; Compare with the side
$01:F70C D0 3D        BNE $F74B                       ; Not heading toward Yoshi: return
$01:F70E AD 90 14     LDA.W $1490                     ; \
$01:F711 D0 38        BNE $F74B                       ; / Return if Mario has a star
$01:F713 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$01:F715 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; Yoshi timer $163E = $10
$01:F718 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:F71A 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / Play sound effect 3 (SFX port $1DFA)
$01:F71D A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$01:F71F 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $13 (SFX port $1DFC)
$01:F722 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$01:F724 95 C2        STA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yoshi state = 2 (running away, Mario thrown off)
$01:F726 9C 7A 18     STZ.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Mario is no longer on Yoshi
$01:F729 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; A = $C0
$01:F72B 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = $C0 (jump up)
$01:F72D 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$01:F72F 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = which side Mario is on
$01:F732 B9 BE EB     LDA.W $EBBE,Y                   ; A = Yoshi run-away X speed from table
$01:F735 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; Yoshi X speed
$01:F737 9E 94 15     STZ.W $1594,X                   ; Clear $1594
$01:F73A 9E 1C 15     STZ.W $151C,X                   ; Clear tongue length $151C
$01:F73D 9C AE 18     STZ.W $18AE                     ; Clear $18AE
$01:F740 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Overworld has-Yoshi flag = 0
$01:F743 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:F745 8D 97 14     STA.W $1497                     ; / Mario invincibility timer = $30
$01:F748 20 CC ED     JSR.W $EDCC                     ; Finish Yoshi's departure ($EDCC)
$01:F74B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F74C A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8
$01:F74E 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:F751 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$01:F753 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; Timer $1540 = $20 (hatching delay)
$01:F756 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$01:F758 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $0A (egg hatch)
$01:F75B 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


}

;;; $F75C..F75C: Data: egg shake flip bits ;;;
{
$01:F75C              .db $00,$01,$01,$01             ; Egg shake: palette bit per frame

}

;;; $F760: Data: egg shake tile numbers (YoshiEggTiles) ;;;
{
$01:F760              .db $62,$02,$02,$00             ; Egg shake: tile numbers per frame

}

;;; $F764: Yoshi egg main routine (YoshiEgg) ;;;
{
;; Waits for the hatch timer ($1540) or for Mario to come near ($187B set), shakes the egg, then spawns 4
;;     shards ($F7C8) and turns into the sprite in $151C (baby Yoshi $2D, 1-up $78, or Yoshi $35).
$01:F764 BD 7B 18     LDA.W $187B,X                   ; Egg waiting for Mario ($187B)?
$01:F767 F0 30        BEQ $F799                       ; No: normal hatch timer path ($F799)
$01:F769 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Is the egg off-screen?
$01:F76C D0 1F        BNE $F78D                       ; Yes: just draw it
$01:F76E 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Horizontal distance to Mario
$01:F771 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = distance
$01:F773 18           CLC                             ; Add $20
$01:F774 69 20        ADC.B #$20
$01:F776 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; Within $20 of Mario?
$01:F778 B0 13        BCS $F78D                       ; No: just draw it
$01:F77A 9E 7B 18     STZ.W $187B,X                   ; Egg is no longer waiting
$01:F77D 22 51 F7 01  JSL.L $F751                     ; Start hatching: status 8, timer, sound ($F74C)
$01:F781 A9 2D        LDA.B #$2D                      ; A = $2D: baby Yoshi
$01:F783 AC E2 18     LDY.W $18E2                     ; Does a Yoshi already exist?
$01:F786 F0 02        BEQ $F78A                       ; No: spawn baby Yoshi
$01:F788 A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; Yes: spawn $78 (1-up mushroom) instead
$01:F78A 9D 1C 15     STA.W $151C,X                   ; Remember what to spawn in $151C
$01:F78D 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the egg (shared graphics routine)
$01:F790 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = Index into sprite OAM
$01:F793 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$01:F795 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Tile 0 (draw the egg as tile $00)
$01:F798 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F799 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; Hatch timer $1540
$01:F79C F0 24        BEQ $F7C2                       ; Zero: finished, hatch now ($F7C2)
$01:F79E 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:F79F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F7A0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F7A1 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = timer / 8: index into the shake tables
$01:F7A2 B9 60 F7     LDA.W YoshiEggTiles,Y           ; Egg tile for this timer value
$01:F7A5 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:F7A6 B9 5C F7     LDA.W $F75C,Y                   ; Palette/flip bit for this timer value
$01:F7A9 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$01:F7AA 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the egg
$01:F7AD BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = Index into sprite OAM
$01:F7B0 68           PLA                             ; Pull the flip bit
$01:F7B1 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = flip bit
$01:F7B3 B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$01:F7B6 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; |
$01:F7B8 05 00        ORA $00                         ; |
$01:F7BA 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM properties = ([prop] & $FE) | [$00]
$01:F7BD 68           PLA                             ; Pull the tile number
$01:F7BE 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store tile in OAM
$01:F7C1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F7C2 20 C8 F7     JSR.W $F7C8                     ; Spawn the egg shards ($F7C8)
$01:F7C5 4C 3D F8     JMP.W $F83D                     ; Turn the egg into the hatched sprite ($F83D)

$01:F7C8 20 CB 80     JSR.W IsSprOffScreen            ; Egg off-screen?
$01:F7CB D0 5F        BNE $F82C                       ; Yes: no shards
$01:F7CD B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; Egg X low
$01:F7CF 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = egg X low
$01:F7D1 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; Egg Y low
$01:F7D3 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = egg Y low
$01:F7D5 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; Egg Y high
$01:F7D8 85 03        STA $03                         ; $03 = egg Y high
$01:F7DA DA           PHX                             ; Save the sprite index
$01:F7DB A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: spawn 4 shards
$01:F7DD A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; X = 11: look for a free minor extended sprite slot
$01:F7DF BD F0 17     LDA.W $17F0,X                   ; Slot in use?
$01:F7E2 F0 10        BEQ $F7F4                       ; Free: use it
$01:F7E4 CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$01:F7E5 10 F8        BPL $F7DF                       ; Loop
$01:F7E7 CE 5D 18     DEC.W $185D                     ; All slots full: replace the round-robin slot [$185D]
$01:F7EA 10 05        BPL $F7F1                       ; Still positive: use it
$01:F7EC A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; Wrap to 11
$01:F7EE 8D 5D 18     STA.W $185D                     ; Store
$01:F7F1 AE 5D 18     LDX.W $185D                     ; X = slot
$01:F7F4 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3
$01:F7F6 9D F0 17     STA.W $17F0,X                   ; Minor extended sprite type 3 (egg shard)
$01:F7F9 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$01:F7FB 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F7FC 79 31 F8     ADC.W $F831,Y                   ; / A = egg X + shard X offset
$01:F7FF 9D 08 18     STA.W $1808,X                   ; Shard X low
$01:F802 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:F804 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F805 79 2D F8     ADC.W $F82D,Y                   ; / A = egg Y + shard Y offset
$01:F808 9D FC 17     STA.W $17FC,X                   ; Shard Y low
$01:F80B A5 03        LDA $03                         ; A = egg Y high
$01:F80D 9D 14 18     STA.W $1814,X                   ; Shard Y high
$01:F810 B9 35 F8     LDA.W $F835,Y                   ; Shard Y speed from table
$01:F813 9D 20 18     STA.W $1820,X                   ; Store shard Y speed
$01:F816 B9 39 F8     LDA.W $F839,Y                   ; Shard X speed from table
$01:F819 9D 2C 18     STA.W $182C,X                   ; Store shard X speed
$01:F81C 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:F81D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F81E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F81F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F820 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F821 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F822 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:F823 09 28        ORA.B #$28                      ; / A = (shard index << 6) | $28
$01:F825 9D 50 18     STA.W $1850,X                   ; Shard timer/properties
$01:F828 88           DEY                             ; Next shard
$01:F829 10 B9        BPL $F7E4                       ; Loop for 4 shards
$01:F82B FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:F82C 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $F83D: Turn egg into hatched sprite ;;;
{
;; Becomes sprite [$151C]. Yoshi $35 gets Yoshi init; baby Yoshi $2D becomes carryable and keeps its color.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:F7C5: Yoshi egg main routine (YoshiEgg)
$01:F83D BD 1C 15     LDA.W $151C,X                   ; A = sprite number stored in $151C
$01:F840 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Become that sprite
$01:F842 C9 35        CMP.B #$35                      ; Yoshi ($35)?
$01:F844 F0 26        BEQ $F86C                       ; Yes: initialize as Yoshi ($F86C)
$01:F846 C9 2D        CMP.B #$2D                      ; Baby Yoshi ($2D)?
$01:F848 D0 1D        BNE $F867                       ; No: just initialize
$01:F84A A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$01:F84C 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / Sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$01:F84F BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Sprite palette bits
$01:F852 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; Keep the color bits
$01:F854 48           PHA                             ; Save them
$01:F855 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset sprite tables
$01:F859 68           PLA                             ; Restore the color bits
$01:F85A 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00 = color bits
$01:F85C BD F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Sprite palette bits
$01:F85F 29 F1        AND.B #$F1                      ; Clear the color bits
$01:F861 05 00        ORA $00                         ; Insert the saved color
$01:F863 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; Store (keeps the egg's color)
$01:F866 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F867 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset sprite tables
$01:F86B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:F86C 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset sprite tables
$01:F870 4C B5 A2     JMP.W $A2B5                     ; Continue with Yoshi's own init ($A2B5)


}

;;; $F890: Eerie and wave Eerie main (Eerie) ;;;
{
;; Moves horizontally. The wave Eerie ($39) also accelerates vertically up to a limit and reverses. Interacts
;;     with Mario, animates and draws.
$01:F890 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status
$01:F893 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:F895 D0 32        BNE $F8C9                       ; / Skip movement unless status = 8 (normal)
$01:F897 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:F899 D0 2E        BNE $F8C9                       ; / Skip movement if sprites are locked
$01:F89B 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position
$01:F89E B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Sprite number
$01:F8A0 C9 39        CMP.B #$39                      ; Wave Eerie ($39)?
$01:F8A2 D0 1C        BNE $F8C0                       ; No: plain Eerie, $F8C0
$01:F8A4 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state
$01:F8A6 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; Bit 0 = direction of vertical acceleration
$01:F8A8 A8           TAY                             ; Y = direction
$01:F8A9 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed
$01:F8AB 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F8AC 79 B4 EB     ADC.W $EBB4,Y                   ; / Y speed += acceleration
$01:F8AF 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Store Y speed
$01:F8B1 D9 8E F8     CMP.W EerieSpeedY,Y             ; Reached the limit?
$01:F8B4 D0 02        BNE $F8B8                       ; No
$01:F8B6 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yes: flip direction
$01:F8B8 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position
$01:F8BB 20 21 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen3Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:F8BE 80 03        BRA $F8C3                       ; Continue

$01:F8C0 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen
$01:F8C3 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Contact with Mario
$01:F8C6 20 5F 8E     JSR.W SetAnimationFrame         ; Animate
$01:F8C9 20 15 9A     JSR.W UpdateDirection           ; Face Mario
$01:F8CC 4C 0D 9F     JMP.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw the sprite and return


}
