}

;;; $F8DC: Boo, Big Boo and Boo Block main routine (Boo+BooBlock) ;;;
{
;; Shared by Boo ($37), Big Boo ($28, entering at $01F8D5 which sets [$18B6] = $20) and Boo Block ($AF).
;; Boo state [$C2]: 0 = chasing Mario, 1 = shy (Mario is facing it). Checked every $20 frames. Chasing: every
;;     8th frame accelerates X and Y
;; speed toward Mario (max +/-8). Shy: stops, decelerating to 0 and shows its hands-over-face frame 3.
;; Boo Block ($AF): turns solid (tweaker bytes patched, $B457) when slow, hurts Mario when fast. Plain
;;     Boo ends at $01FA3D.
$01:F8DC 20 31 AC     JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk1         ; Despawn when far off-screen (SubOffscreen0Bnk1)
$01:F8DF A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:F8E1 8D B6 18     STA.W $18B6                     ; / [$18B6] = $10: Y offset used when aiming at Mario (Big Boo enters here with $20)
$01:F8E4 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:F8E7 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:F8E9 D0 04        BNE $F8EF                       ; } Status != 8 (normal): skip the AI, just draw
$01:F8EB A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:F8ED F0 03        BEQ $F8F2                       ; / Sprites not locked: run the AI
$01:F8EF 4C CE F9     JMP.W $F9CE                     ; Skip to the graphics/contact code

$01:F8F2 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side Mario is on (0 = right), [$0F] = horizontal distance
$01:F8F5 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; \
$01:F8F8 D0 1A        BNE $F914                       ; / Facing-check timer [$1540] still running: skip the re-check
$01:F8FA A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:F8FC 9D 40 15     STA.W $1540,X                   ; / Re-check whether Mario faces the Boo every $20 frames
$01:F8FF B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:F901 F0 09        BEQ $F90C                       ; / Sprite state 0 (chasing): re-evaluate at $01F90C
$01:F903 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:F905 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F906 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F908 C9 14        CMP.B #$14                      ; |
$01:F90A 90 23        BCC $F92F                       ; / State 1 and Mario within +/-10 px horizontally: stay as is ($01F92F)
$01:F90C 74 C2        STZ RAM_SpriteState,X           ; State = 0 (chase) by default
$01:F90E C4 76        CPY RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$01:F910 D0 02        BNE $F914                       ; / Mario faces the Boo (side Y = [$76] direction)?
$01:F912 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Yes: state = 1 (Boo is shy and hides its face)
$01:F914 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$01:F916 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:F917 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; |
$01:F919 C9 14        CMP.B #$14                      ; |
$01:F91B 90 12        BCC $F92F                       ; / Mario within +/-10 px horizontally: no turning, go to $01F92F
$01:F91D BD AC 15     LDA.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:F920 D0 4F        BNE $F971                       ; / Turn timer [$15AC] running: continue the turn ($01F971)
$01:F922 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:F923 DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$01:F926 F0 07        BEQ $F92F                       ; } Already facing Mario: go to $01F92F
$01:F928 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$01:F92A 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Start turning: turn timer [$15AC] = $1F
$01:F92D 80 42        BRA $F971                       ; Go to the turn animation

$01:F92F 9E 02 16     STZ.W $1602,X                   ; Animation frame [$1602] = 0 (face visible)
$01:F932 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; \
$01:F934 F0 53        BEQ $F989                       ; / State 0 (chasing): go to the chase code at $01F989
$01:F936 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:F938 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Shy: frame 3 (hands over face)
$01:F93B B4 9E        LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; Y = sprite number
$01:F93D C0 28        CPY.B #$28                      ; \
$01:F93F F0 07        BEQ $F948                       ; / Big Boo ($28): decelerate every frame
$01:F941 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:F943 C0 AF        CPY.B #$AF                      ; |
$01:F945 F0 01        BEQ $F948                       ; / Boo Block ($AF): decelerate every frame
$01:F947 1A           INC A                           ; Boo: mask = 1, decelerate every other frame
$01:F948 25 13        AND RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:F94A D0 23        BNE $F96F                       ; / Not a deceleration frame: skip to movement
$01:F94C FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Shy counter [$1570]++
$01:F94F BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; Reload counter
$01:F952 D0 05        BNE $F959                       ; Not wrapped to 0: skip
$01:F954 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:F956 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Counter wrapped: [$1558] = $20 (purpose unclear)
$01:F959 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:F95B F0 05        BEQ $F962                       ; |
$01:F95D 10 02        BPL $F961                       ; |
$01:F95F 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:F960 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:F961 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$01:F962 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed moves one step toward 0
$01:F964 B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:F966 F0 05        BEQ $F96D                       ; |
$01:F968 10 02        BPL $F96C                       ; |
$01:F96A 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:F96B 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:F96C 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$01:F96D 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed moves one step toward 0
$01:F96F 80 57        BRA $F9C8                       ; Go to movement

$01:F971 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$01:F973 D0 0A        BNE $F97F                       ; / Turn timer = $10 (half way)?
$01:F975 48           PHA                             ; \
$01:F976 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$01:F979 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$01:F97B 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$01:F97E 68           PLA                             ; } Flip sprite direction, keeping the timer in A
$01:F97F 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:F980 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F981 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:F982 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = turn timer / 8
$01:F983 B9 D1 F8     LDA.W $F8D1,Y                   ; \
$01:F986 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602] = $F8D1[Y] (turn frames 1,2,2,1)
$01:F989 9E 70 15     STZ.W $1570,X                   ; Shy counter [$1570] = 0
$01:F98C A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:F98E 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$01:F990 D0 36        BNE $F9C8                       ; } Only accelerate every 8th frame
$01:F992 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side Mario is on (0 = right)
$01:F995 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:F997 D9 CF F8     CMP.W $F8CF,Y                   ; |
$01:F99A F0 06        BEQ $F9A2                       ; } X speed already at max (+8 / -8 by side)? skip
$01:F99C 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F99D 79 B4 EB     ADC.W $EBB4,Y                   ; |
$01:F9A0 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed += $EBB4[Y] (+1 / -1): accelerate toward Mario
$01:F9A2 A5 D3        LDA $D3                         ; \
$01:F9A4 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:F9A5 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:F9A6 ED B6 18     SBC.W $18B6                     ; |
$01:F9A9 85 D3        STA $D3                         ; |
$01:F9AB A5 D4        LDA $D4                         ; |
$01:F9AD 48           PHA                             ; |
$01:F9AE E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:F9B0 85 D4        STA $D4                         ; } Temporarily Mario Y [$D3] -= [$18B6] (aim above Mario's feet)
$01:F9B2 20 42 AD     JSR.W $AD42                     ; Y = vertical side Mario is on ($AD42)
$01:F9B5 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:F9B6 85 D4        STA $D4                         ; |
$01:F9B8 68           PLA                             ; |
$01:F9B9 85 D3        STA $D3                         ; / Restore Mario Y position
$01:F9BB B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:F9BD D9 CF F8     CMP.W $F8CF,Y                   ; |
$01:F9C0 F0 06        BEQ $F9C8                       ; } Y speed already at max? skip
$01:F9C2 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:F9C3 79 B4 EB     ADC.W $EBB4,Y                   ; |
$01:F9C6 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed += $EBB4[Y]: accelerate toward Mario
$01:F9C8 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position (no gravity)
$01:F9CB 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$01:F9CE B5 9E        LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; \
$01:F9D0 C9 AF        CMP.B #$AF                      ; |
$01:F9D2 D0 69        BNE $FA3D                       ; } Not a Boo Block: go to plain Boo contact/graphics ($01FA3D)
$01:F9D4 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:F9D6 10 03        BPL $F9DB                       ; |
$01:F9D8 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:F9DA 1A           INC A                           ; / A = |X speed|
$01:F9DB A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: frame 0 (Boo face tile) when fast
$01:F9DD C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:F9DF B0 28        BCS $FA09                       ; / |X speed| >= 8: hostile Boo, go to contact check
$01:F9E1 48           PHA                             ; Save |X speed|
$01:F9E2 BD 62 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; \
$01:F9E5 48           PHA                             ; / Save tweaker [$1662,X]
$01:F9E6 BD 7A 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; \
$01:F9E9 48           PHA                             ; / Save tweaker [$167A,X]
$01:F9EA 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; \
$01:F9EC 9D 7A 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; / Tweaker $167A |= $80 (do not interact like a normal sprite)
$01:F9EF A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:F9F1 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; / Tweaker $1662 = $0C (block-sized clipping)
$01:F9F4 20 57 B4     JSR.W $B457                     ; Solid-block contact with Mario ($B457)
$01:F9F7 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:F9F8 9D 7A 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X         ; / Restore tweaker $167A
$01:F9FB 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:F9FC 9D 62 16     STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X         ; / Restore tweaker $1662
$01:F9FF 68           PLA                             ; Restore |X speed|
$01:FA00 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: frame 1
$01:FA02 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$01:FA04 B0 0F        BCS $FA15                       ; / |X speed| >= 4: keep frame 1
$01:FA06 C8           INY                             ; |X speed| < 4: frame 2
$01:FA07 80 0C        BRA $FA15                       ; Go to graphics

$01:FA09 BD C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,X                   ; \
$01:FA0C C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FA0E D0 05        BNE $FA15                       ; } Status != 8: skip contact
$01:FA10 5A           PHY                             ; Save frame
$01:FA11 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Mario contact: hurt him (MarioSprInteractRt)
$01:FA14 7A           PLY                             ; Restore frame
$01:FA15 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:FA16 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = Y
$01:FA19 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw one 16x16 tile (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:FA1C BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; A = frame
$01:FA1F BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$01:FA22 DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:FA23 AA           TAX                             ; / Save X, X = frame
$01:FA24 BD 37 FA     LDA.W BooBlockTiles,X           ; \
$01:FA27 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = BooBlockTiles[frame]
$01:FA2A B9 03 03     LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$01:FA2D 29 F1        AND.B #$F1                      ; |
$01:FA2F 1D 3A FA     ORA.W BooBlockGfxProp,X         ; |
$01:FA32 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; } OAM props = (props & $F1) | BooBlockGfxProp[frame] (palette)
$01:FA35 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:FA36 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$01:FA4C              .db $40,$00                     ; X-flip bit by direction: $40, $00

}

;;; $FA4E: Tables: Iggy's ball tiles, props, X speed (IggyBallTiles) ;;;
{
;; IggyBallTiles ($4A,$4C,$4A,$4C), $FA52 (props $35/$F5 for flips), $FA56 (X speed $10/$F0 by
;;     direction).
$01:FA4E              .db $4A,$4C,$4A,$4C             ; Iggy's ball tiles, 4 spin frames

$01:FA52              .db $35,$35,$F5,$F5             ; Iggy's ball OAM props, 4 spin frames (flips alternate)

$01:FA56              .db $10,$F0                     ; Iggy's ball X speed by direction: $10, $F0

}

;;; $FA58: Iggy's ball (sprite $A7) (Iggy'sBall) ;;;
{
;; Ball thrown by Iggy/Larry. Spins through 4 frames, moves horizontally at speed $10, falls with gravity (max
;;     $40) and bounces
;; (Y speed $F0) off the tilting platform tiles ($FF98). Hurts Mario on contact. Vanishes in smoke when
;;     its Y is $44-$4F.
$01:FA58 20 0D 9F     JSR.W SubSprGfx2Entry1          ; Draw one 16x16 tile (SubSprGfx2Entry1)
$01:FA5B BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:FA5E B9 4C FA     LDA.W $FA4C,Y                   ; |
$01:FA61 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = X-flip bit from direction
$01:FA63 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$01:FA66 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:FA68 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FA69 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FA6A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } A = spin frame = ([$14] / 4) & 3
$01:FA6C DA           PHX                             ; \
$01:FA6D AA           TAX                             ; / Save X, X = frame
$01:FA6E BD 4E FA     LDA.W IggyBallTiles,X           ; \
$01:FA71 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = IggyBallTiles[frame]
$01:FA74 BD 52 FA     LDA.W $FA52,X                   ; \
$01:FA77 45 00        EOR $00                         ; |
$01:FA79 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; } OAM props = $FA52[frame] EOR X-flip
$01:FA7C FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:FA7D A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:FA7F D0 32        BNE $FAB3                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$01:FA81 BC 7C 15     LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:FA84 B9 56 FA     LDA.W $FA56,Y                   ; |
$01:FA87 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; } X speed = $FA56[direction]
$01:FA89 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Update X position
$01:FA8C 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position
$01:FA8F B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:FA91 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; / Y speed < $40 (max fall speed)?
$01:FA93 10 05        BPL $FA9A                       ; No: skip gravity
$01:FA95 18           CLC                             ; \
$01:FA96 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; |
$01:FA98 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; } Y speed += 4 (gravity)
$01:FA9A 20 98 FF     JSR.W $FF98                     ; Check ball against the tilting platform tiles ($FF98)
$01:FA9D 90 04        BCC $FAA3                       ; No platform contact: continue
$01:FA9F A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$01:FAA1 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Hit platform: bounce, Y speed = $F0
$01:FAA3 20 E4 A7     JSR.W MarioSprInteractRt        ; Mario contact (hurts Mario)
$01:FAA6 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:FAA8 C9 44        CMP.B #$44                      ; |
$01:FAAA 90 07        BCC $FAB3                       ; |
$01:FAAC C9 50        CMP.B #$50                      ; |
$01:FAAE B0 03        BCS $FAB3                       ; } Ball Y low byte in $44-$4F (reached the lava)?  No: return
$01:FAB0 20 CB 9A     JSR.W $9ACB                     ; Yes: ball vanishes in a puff of smoke ($9ACB)
$01:FAB3 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $FAB4..FABC: Unused: table of unknown data ;;;
{
$01:FAB4              .db $FF,$01,$00,$80,$60,$A0,$40,$D0 ; Unreferenced table (13 bytes), purpose unknown
$01:FABC              .db $D8,$C0,$C8,$0C,$F4         ; (continued) unreferenced table

}

;;; $FAC1: Koopaling sprite main: dispatch by state (KoopaKid) ;;;
{
;; Runs the routine for the Koopaling's state [$C2] via KoopaKidPtrs.
$01:FAC1 B5 C2        LDA RAM_SpriteState,X           ; A = Koopaling sprite state
$01:FAC3 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the routine for state: pointer table follows

}

;;; $FAC7: Pointer table: Koopaling behaviors, and tables (KoopaKidPtrs) ;;;
{
;; 7 pointers by state [$C2]: 0-2 (Morton, Roy, Ludwig) wall, 3-4 (Iggy, Larry) platform, 5-6 (Lemmy, Wendy)
;;     pipe.
;; Followed by $FAD5 (unreferenced), $FADD (stun slide speeds by tilt) and $FAE5 (walk
;;     animation frames).
$01:FAC7 AB CD        .dw WallKoopaKids               ; State 0 (Morton): wall Koopaling
$01:FAC9 AB CD        .dw WallKoopaKids               ; State 1 (Roy): wall Koopaling
$01:FACB AB CD        .dw WallKoopaKids               ; State 2 (Ludwig): wall Koopaling
$01:FACD F5 FA        .dw PlatformKoopaKids           ; State 3 (Iggy): tilting-platform Koopaling
$01:FACF F5 FA        .dw PlatformKoopaKids           ; State 4 (Larry): tilting-platform Koopaling
$01:FAD1 2A CD        .dw PipeKoopaKids               ; State 5 (Lemmy): pipe Koopaling
$01:FAD3 2A CD        .dw PipeKoopaKids               ; State 6 (Wendy): pipe Koopaling

$01:FAD5              .db $00,$FC,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F8 ; Unreferenced table, purpose unknown
$01:FADD              .db $F8,$F8,$F8,$F4,$F0,$F0,$EC,$EC ; Stun slide speed by platform tilt step (0-$F), x4 when applied
$01:FAE5              .db $00,$01,$02,$00,$01,$02,$00,$01 ; Walk animation frames, indexed by ([$1570] / 4) & $F: 0,1,2 cycle
$01:FAED              .db $02,$00,$01,$02,$00,$01,$02,$01 ; (continued) walk animation frames

}

;;; $FAF5: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids) ;;;
{
;; Handles Iggy and Larry on the tilting Mode 7 platform. Walks toward the platform center, throws balls
;;     (timer [$1564] = $28),
;; slides down the tilt when stunned and falls off if it reaches the edge ([$160E]). Defeat timer [$163E] ends
;;     the level.
;; Includes the Mario/fireball contact code ($FC62) and the platform position rotation ($FD50).
$01:FAF5 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:FAF7 1D 4C 15     ORA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; |
$01:FAFA D0 1E        BNE $FB1A                       ; } Sprites locked or interaction timer [$154C] set: skip to $01FB1A
$01:FAFC 20 30 AD     JSR.W SubHorizPos               ; Y = side Mario is on (0 = right)
$01:FAFF 84 00        STY $00                         ; [$00] = side
$01:FB01 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:FB03 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:FB04 2A           ROL                             ; |
$01:FB05 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } A = bit 7 of platform tilt [$36] (tilt direction)
$01:FB07 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; \
$01:FB09 D0 0F        BNE $FB1A                       ; / Tilt direction differs from Mario's side: skip
$01:FB0B FE 34 15     INC.W $1534,X                   ; Time counter [$1534]++
$01:FB0E BD 34 15     LDA.W $1534,X                   ; \
$01:FB11 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; |
$01:FB13 D0 05        BNE $FB1A                       ; } Every $80 frames...
$01:FB15 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$01:FB17 9D 64 15     STA.W $1564,X                   ; / ...[$1564] = $7F: start the shell/throw animation timer
$01:FB1A 9E A0 15     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Clear off-screen flag (never despawn)
$01:FB1D BD 3E 16     LDA.W $163E,X                   ; \
$01:FB20 F0 14        BEQ $FB36                       ; / Defeat timer [$163E] = 0 (not defeated): run the AI
$01:FB22 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$01:FB23 D0 10        BNE $FB35                       ; / Count down, still running: return
$01:FB25 EE C6 13     INC.W $13C6                     ; Timer ran out: [$13C6]++ (advance level end / cutscene)
$01:FB28 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:FB2A 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / [$1493] = $FF (end-of-level timer)
$01:FB2D A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$01:FB2F 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Play music $0B (boss defeated) via [$1DFB]
$01:FB32 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the sprite (status 0)
$01:FB35 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FB36 22 A0 F7 07  JSL.L LoadTweakerBytes          ; Load sprite tweaker bytes
$01:FB3A A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:FB3C F0 03        BEQ $FB41                       ; / Sprites not locked: run the AI
$01:FB3E 4C 08 FC     JMP.W $FC08                     ; Locked: skip to position/contact update

$01:FB41 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:FB44 F0 35        BEQ $FB7B                       ; / [$160E] = 0 (still on the platform): go to $01FB7B
$01:FB46 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; Fallen off the platform: update X position
$01:FB49 20 D8 AB     JSR.W SubSprYPosNoGrvty         ; Update Y position
$01:FB4C B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:FB4E C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; / Y speed < $40?
$01:FB50 10 04        BPL $FB56                       ; No: skip gravity
$01:FB52 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$01:FB54 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / Y speed += 2 (gravity)
$01:FB56 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:FB58 C9 58        CMP.B #$58                      ; |
$01:FB5A 90 12        BCC $FB6E                       ; |
$01:FB5C C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; |
$01:FB5E B0 0E        BCS $FB6E                       ; } Y low byte outside $58-$7F: skip
$01:FB60 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:FB62 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $20
$01:FB65 A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$01:FB67 9D 3E 16     STA.W $163E,X                   ; / Defeat timer [$163E] = $50
$01:FB6A 22 C8 A6 03  JSL.L KillMostSprites           ; Kill all other sprites
$01:FB6E B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FB70 8D B8 14     STA.W $14B8                     ; / Remember kid X position in [$14B8]
$01:FB73 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:FB75 8D BA 14     STA.W $14BA                     ; / Remember kid Y position in [$14BA]
$01:FB78 4C 0E FC     JMP.W $FC0E                     ; Go to the draw/animation tail

$01:FB7B 20 CC AB     JSR.W SubSprXPosNoGrvty         ; On platform: update X position
$01:FB7E A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$01:FB80 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$01:FB82 1D 64 15     ORA.W $1564,X                   ; |
$01:FB85 D0 12        BNE $FB99                       ; } Every $20 frames while not in shell/throw anim ([$1564] = 0)...
$01:FB87 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:FB8A 48           PHA                             ; / Save direction
$01:FB8B 20 7C 85     JSR.W FaceMario                 ; Face Mario
$01:FB8E 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:FB8F DD 7C 15     CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; |
$01:FB92 F0 05        BEQ $FB99                       ; } Direction unchanged: skip
$01:FB94 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:FB96 9D AC 15     STA.W $15AC,X                   ; / Direction changed: turn timer [$15AC] = $10
$01:FB99 74 AA        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; Y speed = 0
$01:FB9B 74 B6        STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = 0
$01:FB9D A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:FB9F 10 03        BPL $FBA4                       ; |
$01:FBA1 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FBA2 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } A = platform tilt [$36] low byte (+8 if bit 7 set)
$01:FBA4 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:FBA5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FBA6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FBA7 4A           LSR                             ; } A = tilt / 16
$01:FBA8 A8           TAY                             ; Y = tilt step 0-$F
$01:FBA9 84 00        STY $00                         ; [$00] = tilt step
$01:FBAB 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:FBAD 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:FBAE 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } A = (-step) & $0F
$01:FBB0 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = mirrored tilt step (used when tilt high byte is set)
$01:FBB2 BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:FBB5 D0 22        BNE $FBD9                       ; / Stunned ([$154C] set): slide, go to $01FBD9
$01:FBB7 A5 37        LDA $37                         ; \
$01:FBB9 D0 0E        BNE $FBC9                       ; / Tilt high byte [$37] set: go to $01FBC9
$01:FBBB B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FBBD C9 78        CMP.B #$78                      ; |
$01:FBBF 90 04        BCC $FBC5                       ; } Kid X >= $78 (right of center)?
$01:FBC1 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:FBC3 80 29        BRA $FBEE                       ; / Walk left: X speed = $FF

$01:FBC5 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:FBC7 80 25        BRA $FBEE                       ; / Walk right: X speed = $01

$01:FBC9 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; Y = mirrored tilt step
$01:FBCB B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FBCD C9 78        CMP.B #$78                      ; |
$01:FBCF B0 04        BCS $FBD5                       ; } Kid X >= $78 (right of center)?
$01:FBD1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:FBD3 80 19        BRA $FBEE                       ; / Walk right: X speed = $01

$01:FBD5 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$01:FBD7 80 15        BRA $FBEE                       ; / Walk left: X speed = $FF

$01:FBD9 A5 37        LDA $37                         ; Stunned: tilt high byte [$37] set?
$01:FBDB D0 0A        BNE $FBE7                       ; Yes: slide the other way
$01:FBDD A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = tilt step
$01:FBDF B9 DD FA     LDA.W $FADD,Y                   ; \
$01:FBE2 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$01:FBE4 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:FBE5 80 05        BRA $FBEC                       ; } A = -$FADD[Y]

$01:FBE7 A4 01        LDY $01                         ; Y = mirrored tilt step
$01:FBE9 B9 DD FA     LDA.W $FADD,Y                   ; A = $FADD[Y]
$01:FBEC 0A           ASL                             ; \
$01:FBED 0A           ASL                             ; / A *= 4: slide speed
$01:FBEE 95 B6        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; X speed = A
$01:FBF0 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; Walk animation counter [$1570]++
$01:FBF3 B5 B6        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X          ; \
$01:FBF5 F0 03        BEQ $FBFA                       ; / Moving: count it twice as fast
$01:FBF7 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570]++ again
$01:FBFA BD 70 15     LDA.W $1570,X                   ; \
$01:FBFD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FBFE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FBFF 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Y = ([$1570] / 4) & $0F
$01:FC01 A8           TAY                             ; Y = walk frame index
$01:FC02 B9 E5 FA     LDA.W $FAE5,Y                   ; \
$01:FC05 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Animation frame [$1602] = $FAE5[Y]
$01:FC08 20 50 FD     JSR.W $FD50                     ; Rotate kid position onto the platform ($FD50)
$01:FC0B 20 62 FC     JSR.W $FC62                     ; Mario / fireball contact ($FC62)
$01:FC0E BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:FC11 D0 3B        BNE $FC4E                       ; / Stunned ([$154C] set): special animation at $01FC4E
$01:FC13 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:FC16 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite direction
$01:FC17 BC AC 15     LDY.W $15AC,X                   ; \
$01:FC1A F0 0E        BEQ $FC2A                       ; / Turn timer [$15AC] = 0: skip
$01:FC1C C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$01:FC1E 90 05        BCC $FC25                       ; / Timer < 8: show turn frame
$01:FC20 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; \
$01:FC22 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Timer >= 8: draw with the opposite direction
$01:FC25 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$01:FC27 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame 6 (turning)
$01:FC2A BD 64 15     LDA.W $1564,X                   ; \
$01:FC2D F0 17        BEQ $FC46                       ; / [$1564] = 0 (no shell/throw timer): go to draw
$01:FC2F 48           PHA                             ; Save timer
$01:FC30 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:FC31 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FC32 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FC33 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = timer / 8
$01:FC34 B9 95 FD     LDA.W $FD95,Y                   ; \
$01:FC37 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame [$1602] = $FD95[Y] (throw animation)
$01:FC3A 68           PLA                             ; Restore timer
$01:FC3B C9 28        CMP.B #$28                      ; \
$01:FC3D D0 07        BNE $FC46                       ; / Timer = $28: time to throw
$01:FC3F A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$01:FC41 D0 03        BNE $FC46                       ; / Sprites locked: skip
$01:FC43 20 A7 FD     JSR.W ThrowBall                 ; Throw the ball (ThrowBall)
$01:FC46 20 BC FE     JSR.W $FEBC                     ; Draw the kid ($FEBC)
$01:FC49 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:FC4A 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; / Restore sprite direction
$01:FC4D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FC4E C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$01:FC50 90 08        BCC $FC5A                       ; / Stun timer >= $10?
$01:FC52 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$01:FC54 9D 02 16     STA.W $1602,X                   ; / Frame 3 (hurt)
$01:FC57 4C BC FE     JMP.W $FEBC                     ; Draw the kid

$01:FC5A C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$01:FC5C 90 F4        BCC $FC52                       ; / Timer < 8: frame 3 too
$01:FC5E 20 5B FF     JSR.W $FF5B                     ; Timer 8-$0F: draw the extra flashing tile ($FF5B)
$01:FC61 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FC62 A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$01:FC64 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$01:FC66 B0 F9        BCS $FC61                       ; } Mario animation >= 1 (not normal): return
$01:FC68 BD 0E 16     LDA.W $160E,X                   ; \
$01:FC6B D0 F4        BNE $FC61                       ; / Kid already fell off ([$160E] set): return
$01:FC6D B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FC6F C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; |
$01:FC71 90 04        BCC $FC77                       ; |
$01:FC73 C9 D8        CMP.B #$D8                      ; |
$01:FC75 90 0D        BCC $FC84                       ; } Kid X in $20-$D7 (on platform)? Yes: go to contact check
$01:FC77 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:FC7A 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Kid walked off the edge: use screen position [$14B8]
$01:FC7C AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:FC7F 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / ...and [$14BA]
$01:FC81 FE 0E 16     INC.W $160E,X                   ; Mark kid as fallen: [$160E]++
$01:FC84 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:FC87 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FC88 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FC8A 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = [$14B8] - 8 (kid hitbox X)
$01:FC8C AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:FC8F 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FC90 69 60        ADC.B #$60                      ; |
$01:FC92 85 01        STA $01                         ; } [$01] = [$14BA] + $60 (kid hitbox Y)
$01:FC94 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:FC96 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $0F (hitbox width)
$01:FC98 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:FC9A 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = $0C (hitbox height)
$01:FC9C 64 08        STZ $08                         ; \
$01:FC9E 64 09        STZ $09                         ; / [$08] and [$09] = 0 (high bytes)
$01:FCA0 A5 7E        LDA $7E                         ; \
$01:FCA2 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FCA3 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; |
$01:FCA5 85 04        STA $04                         ; } [$04] = Mario X [$7E] + 2 (Mario hitbox)
$01:FCA7 A5 80        LDA $80                         ; \
$01:FCA9 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FCAA 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:FCAC 85 05        STA $05                         ; } [$05] = Mario Y [$80] + $10
$01:FCAE A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$01:FCB0 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = $0C (Mario width)
$01:FCB2 A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; \
$01:FCB4 85 07        STA $07                         ; / [$07] = $0E (Mario height)
$01:FCB6 64 0A        STZ $0A                         ; \
$01:FCB8 64 0B        STZ $0B                         ; / [$0A] and [$0B] = 0 (high bytes)
$01:FCBA 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check box overlap (CheckForContact)
$01:FCBE 90 4A        BCC $FD0A                       ; No contact with Mario: check fireballs ($01FD0A)
$01:FCC0 BD 58 15     LDA.W $1558,X                   ; \
$01:FCC3 D0 44        BNE $FD09                       ; / Contact cooldown [$1558] set: return
$01:FCC5 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:FCC7 9D 58 15     STA.W $1558,X                   ; / Contact cooldown [$1558] = 8
$01:FCCA A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$01:FCCC F0 37        BEQ $FD05                       ; / Mario not in the air ([$72] = 0): hurt him ($01FD05)
$01:FCCE A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$01:FCD0 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $28 (stomp)
$01:FCD3 22 33 AA 01  JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed           ; Bounce Mario off the kid (BoostMarioSpeed)
$01:FCD7 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FCD9 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite X
$01:FCDA B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:FCDC 48           PHA                             ; / Save sprite Y
$01:FCDD AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:FCE0 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FCE1 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FCE3 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; } Sprite X = [$14B8] - 8
$01:FCE5 AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:FCE8 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FCE9 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; |
$01:FCEB 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; } Sprite Y = [$14BA] - $10
$01:FCED 9E A0 15     STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X       ; Clear off-screen flag
$01:FCF0 22 99 AB 01  JSL.L DisplayContactGfx         ; Show the contact star (DisplayContactGfx)
$01:FCF4 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:FCF5 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / Restore sprite Y
$01:FCF7 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:FCF8 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / Restore sprite X
$01:FCFA BD 4C 15     LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; \
$01:FCFD D0 0A        BNE $FD09                       ; / Already stunned: return
$01:FCFF A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$01:FD01 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Stun timer [$154C] = $18
$01:FD04 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FD05 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Mario hurt (HurtMario)
$01:FD09 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FD0A A0 0A        LDY.B #$0A                      ; Y = $0A: extended sprite slot to check
$01:FD0C 8C 95 16     STY.W $1695                     ; [$1695] = slot
$01:FD0F B9 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; \
$01:FD12 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; |
$01:FD14 D0 34        BNE $FD4A                       ; } Extended sprite is a Mario fireball (5)?  No: next slot
$01:FD16 B9 1F 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; \
$01:FD19 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FD1A E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$01:FD1C 85 04        STA $04                         ; } [$04] = fireball X - screen X
$01:FD1E 64 0A        STZ $0A                         ; [$0A] = 0
$01:FD20 B9 15 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; \
$01:FD23 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FD24 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$01:FD26 85 05        STA $05                         ; } [$05] = fireball Y - screen Y
$01:FD28 64 0B        STZ $0B                         ; [$0B] = 0
$01:FD2A A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:FD2C 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$01:FD2E 85 07        STA $07                         ; } [$06] = [$07] = 8 (fireball hitbox)
$01:FD30 22 2B B7 03  JSL.L CheckForContact           ; Check box overlap (CheckForContact)
$01:FD34 90 14        BCC $FD4A                       ; No hit: next slot
$01:FD36 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:FD38 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / Extended sprite = smoke puff (1)
$01:FD3B A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$01:FD3D 99 6F 17     STA.W $176F,Y                   ; / Puff timer $176F = $0F
$01:FD40 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$01:FD42 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 1
$01:FD45 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$01:FD47 9D 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X        ; / Interaction timer [$154C] = $10 (kid is hit)
$01:FD4A 88           DEY                             ; \
$01:FD4B C0 07        CPY.B #$07                      ; |
$01:FD4D D0 BD        BNE $FD0C                       ; } Y--; loop for slots $0A, 9, 8
$01:FD4F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FD50 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FD52 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FD53 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FD55 8D B4 14     STA.W $14B4                     ; } [$14B4] = sprite X low + 8
$01:FD58 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$01:FD5B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:FD5D 8D B5 14     STA.W $14B5                     ; } [$14B5] = X high + carry
$01:FD60 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:FD62 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FD63 69 2F        ADC.B #$2F                      ; |
$01:FD65 8D B6 14     STA.W $14B6                     ; } [$14B6] = sprite Y low + $2F
$01:FD68 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; \
$01:FD6B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:FD6D 8D B7 14     STA.W $14B7                     ; } [$14B7] = Y high + carry
$01:FD70 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:FD72 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:FD74 49 FF 01     EOR.W #$01FF                    ; |
$01:FD77 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:FD78 29 FF 01     AND.W #$01FF                    ; |
$01:FD7B 85 36        STA $36                         ; } [$36] = -[$36] & $1FF (negate platform angle)
$01:FD7D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:FD7F DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:FD80 22 9D CC 01  JSL.L $CC9D                     ; Rotate the point by the angle into [$14B8]/[$14BA] ($CC9D)
$01:FD84 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$01:FD85 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$01:FD87 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; \
$01:FD89 49 FF 01     EOR.W #$01FF                    ; |
$01:FD8C 1A           INC A                           ; |
$01:FD8D 29 FF 01     AND.W #$01FF                    ; |
$01:FD90 85 36        STA $36                         ; } [$36] = -[$36] & $1FF (restore angle)
$01:FD92 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$01:FD94 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $FDA7: Find free sprite slot for ball (ThrowBall) ;;;
{
;; Searches slots 5..0 for a free slot and falls into GenerateBall. Returns if none.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:FC43: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
$01:FDA7 A0 05        LDY.B #$05                      ; \
$01:FDA9 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; |
$01:FDAC F0 04        BEQ GenerateBall                ; |
$01:FDAE 88           DEY                             ; |
$01:FDAF 10 F8        BPL $FDA9                       ; } Search sprite slots 5..0 for a free (status 0) one
$01:FDB1 60           RTS                             ; None free: return

}

;;; $FDB2: Spawn Iggy's ball (GenerateBall) ;;;
{
;; Spawns sprite $A7 in the free slot Y, in front of the kid at [$14B8]/[$14BA], with the kid's direction.
;;     Plays sound $20.
$01:FDB2 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$01:FDB4 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $20
$01:FDB7 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$01:FDB9 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; / New sprite status = 8 (normal)
$01:FDBC A9 A7        LDA.B #$A7                      ; \
$01:FDBE 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; / New sprite number = $A7 (Iggy's ball)
$01:FDC1 DA           PHX                             ; Save X (the kid)
$01:FDC2 BB           TYX                             ; X = new slot
$01:FDC3 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset all sprite tables for the new sprite (InitSpriteTables)
$01:FDC7 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X (the kid)
$01:FDC8 DA           PHX                             ; Save X again
$01:FDC9 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:FDCC 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / Ball direction = kid direction
$01:FDCF AA           TAX                             ; X = direction (table index)
$01:FDD0 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:FDD3 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FDD4 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FDD6 7D A5 FD     ADC.W BallPositionDispX,X       ; |
$01:FDD9 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; } Ball X low = [$14B8] - 8 + BallPositionDispX[dir]
$01:FDDC A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$01:FDDE 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; / Ball X high = 0
$01:FDE1 AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:FDE4 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FDE5 E9 18        SBC.B #$18                      ; |
$01:FDE7 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; |
$01:FDEA A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$01:FDEC E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$01:FDEE 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; } Ball Y = [$14BA] - $18 (16-bit)
$01:FDF1 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X (the kid)
$01:FDF2 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $FEBC: Draw platform Koopaling ;;;
{
;; Draws the 4 tiles of a platform Koopaling (frame [$1602]) at its rotated position [$14B8]/[$14BA] (+$60 Y),
;;     with X flip from direction.
;; Iggy (state 3) substitutes placeholder tiles; tiles >= $4A (ball) use palette $35.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:FC46: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
;;     $01:FC57: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
$01:FEBC B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = Koopaling state
$01:FEBE B9 B7 FE     LDA.W $FEB7,Y                   ; \
$01:FEC1 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; / [$0D] = palette/props for this state
$01:FEC3 84 05        STY $05                         ; [$05] = state
$01:FEC5 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$01:FEC8 BD 7C 15     LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; \
$01:FECB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FECC 6A           ROR                             ; |
$01:FECD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FECE 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; |
$01:FED0 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; } A = $40 if direction 0, else 0
$01:FED2 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = X-flip bit
$01:FED4 BD 02 16     LDA.W $1602,X                   ; \
$01:FED7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:FED8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$01:FED9 85 03        STA $03                         ; } [$03] = animation frame [$1602] * 4 (index of its first tile)
$01:FEDB DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$01:FEDC A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: four tiles, last to first
$01:FEDE DA           PHX                             ; Save tile counter
$01:FEDF 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:FEE0 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FEE1 65 03        ADC $03                         ; } X = tile counter + [$03]: index into the frame tables
$01:FEE3 AA           TAX                             ; X = table index
$01:FEE4 DA           PHX                             ; Save table index
$01:FEE5 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$01:FEE7 F0 05        BEQ $FEEE                       ; / Facing the flipped way? Use the second half of the X table
$01:FEE9 8A           TXA                             ; \
$01:FEEA 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FEEB 69 30        ADC.B #$30                      ; |
$01:FEED AA           TAX                             ; } X += $30 (x-flipped offsets)
$01:FEEE AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:FEF1 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FEF2 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FEF4 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FEF5 7D F3 FD     ADC.W $FDF3,X                   ; } A = [$14B8] - 8 + $FDF3[X]
$01:FEF8 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM tile X position
$01:FEFB FA           PLX                             ; Restore table index
$01:FEFC AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:FEFF 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FF00 69 60        ADC.B #$60                      ; |
$01:FF02 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FF03 7D 53 FE     ADC.W $FE53,X                   ; } A = [$14BA] + $60 + $FE53[X]
$01:FF06 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; OAM tile Y position
$01:FF09 BD 83 FE     LDA.W $FE83,X                   ; \
$01:FF0C 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / OAM tile = $FE83[X]
$01:FF0F DA           PHX                             ; Save table index
$01:FF10 A6 05        LDX $05                         ; X = state
$01:FF12 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; \
$01:FF14 D0 0C        BNE $FF22                       ; / Not Iggy (3): keep the tile
$01:FF16 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$01:FF18 B0 08        BCS $FF22                       ; / Tile >= 5: not a placeholder, keep it
$01:FF1A 4A           LSR                             ; \
$01:FF1B AA           TAX                             ; / X = placeholder / 2
$01:FF1C BD B3 FE     LDA.W $FEB3,X                   ; \
$01:FF1F 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; / Iggy only: OAM tile = $FEB3[X]
$01:FF22 B9 02 03     LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; \
$01:FF25 C9 4A        CMP.B #$4A                      ; / Tile >= $4A (ball tiles)?
$01:FF27 A5 0D        LDA $0D                         ; A = state palette [$0D]
$01:FF29 90 02        BCC $FF2D                       ; Not a ball tile: keep it
$01:FF2B A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; Ball tile: palette/props $35 (Iggy ball palette)
$01:FF2D 05 02        ORA $02                         ; \
$01:FF2F 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; / OAM props = A | X-flip bit
$01:FF32 68           PLA                             ; \
$01:FF33 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:FF35 AA           TAX                             ; } X = table index & 3 = tile slot
$01:FF36 5A           PHY                             ; Save OAM index
$01:FF37 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:FF38 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FF39 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FF3A A8           TAY                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$01:FF3B BD B6 FE     LDA.W $FEB6,X                   ; \
$01:FF3E 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; / OAM size bits = $FEB6[slot]
$01:FF41 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM index
$01:FF42 C8           INY                             ; \
$01:FF43 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:FF44 C8           INY                             ; |
$01:FF45 C8           INY                             ; } OAM index += 4
$01:FF46 FA           PLX                             ; Restore tile counter
$01:FF47 CA           DEX                             ; \
$01:FF48 10 94        BPL $FEDE                       ; / Next tile; loop for all 4 tiles
$01:FF4A FA           PLX                             ; Restore X (sprite index)
$01:FF4B A0 FF        LDY.B #$FF                      ; Y = $FF: tile sizes already set
$01:FF4D A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = 3: four tiles
$01:FF4F 20 BB B7     JSR.W FinishOAMWriteRt          ; Finish OAM write (FinishOAMWriteRt)
$01:FF52 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

$01:FF57              .db $00,$00,$40,$00             ; Flashing tile flip bits: $00, $00, $40, $00

;;; $FF5B: Iggy/Larry: draw splash at sink point ;;;
{
;; $01FF5B: draws one 16x16 OAM tile (OAM slot $70) at ([$14B8] - 8, [$14BA] + $60), the spot where the boss
;;     sprite last was when it sank
;; (probably a lava splash). Tile cycles through $2C/$2E every 2 frames, X-flip on frames where $FF57 =
;;     $40, palette bits from
;; $FEB7 indexed by sprite state. Called from the boss death sequence at $01FC5E.
;; $01FF98: computes the sprite's centre-ish point into [$14B4]/[$14B6] (X + 8, Y + $0F, 16-bit) and calls
;;     $CC9D, which
;; appears to be a Map16 tile lookup for that point (carry result used by the Iggy ball code at $01FA9A).
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:FC5E: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
$01:FF5B DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:FF5C B4 C2        LDY RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Y = sprite state ([RAM_SpriteState])
$01:FF5E B9 B7 FE     LDA.W $FEB7,Y                   ; Palette bits for this state ($FEB7)
$01:FF61 85 0D        STA $0D                         ; [$0D] = palette bits
$01:FF63 A0 70        LDY.B #$70                      ; Y = $70: OAM slot byte offset
$01:FF65 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; \
$01:FF68 38           SEC                             ; |
$01:FF69 E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; } OAM X = [$14B8] - 8
$01:FF6B 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; /
$01:FF6E AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; \
$01:FF71 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FF72 69 60        ADC.B #$60                      ; } OAM Y = [$14BA] + $60
$01:FF74 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; /
$01:FF77 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$01:FF79 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FF7A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$01:FF7C AA           TAX                             ; } X = ([frame counter] >> 1) & 3: animation frame
$01:FF7D BD 53 FF     LDA.W $FF53,X                   ; / Tile = $FF53[X] ($2C/$2E alternating)
$01:FF80 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Store OAM tile number
$01:FF83 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$01:FF85 1D 57 FF     ORA.W $FF57,X                   ; |
$01:FF88 05 0D        ORA $0D                         ; } OAM properties = $30 (priority 3) | $FF57[X] (flip) | [$0D] (palette)
$01:FF8A 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; /
$01:FF8D 98           TYA                             ; \
$01:FF8E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FF8F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$01:FF90 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = OAM slot offset / 4: index into the size table
$01:FF91 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: 16x16 sprite size, X-high bit clear
$01:FF93 99 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y            ; Store OAM size/X-high entry
$01:FF96 FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:FF97 60           RTS                             ; Return

$01:FF98 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; \
$01:FF9A 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FF9B 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$01:FF9D 8D B4 14     STA.W $14B4                     ; |
$01:FFA0 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; |
$01:FFA3 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } [$14B4] = sprite X position + $08 (16-bit)
$01:FFA5 8D B5 14     STA.W $14B5                     ; /
$01:FFA8 B5 D8        LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; \
$01:FFAA 18           CLC                             ; |
$01:FFAB 69 0F        ADC.B #$0F                      ; |
$01:FFAD 8D B6 14     STA.W $14B6                     ; |
$01:FFB0 BD D4 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; |
$01:FFB3 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } [$14B6] = sprite Y position + $0F (16-bit)
$01:FFB5 8D B7 14     STA.W $14B7                     ; /
$01:FFB8 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$01:FFB9 22 9D CC 01  JSL.L $CC9D                     ; Check the point against level tiles ($CC9D, probably Map16 lookup)
$01:FFBD FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$01:FFBE 60           RTS                             ; Return


}

;;; $FFBF..FFFF: Freespace: $FF padding to end of bank ;;;
{
$01:FFBF              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFC7              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFCF              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFD7              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFDF              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFE7              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFEF              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFF7              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$01:FFFF              .db $FF
